RD_ALifeLine_6bebbef04da64e4e: Hey- hey, don't sneak up on me like that, jeez
RD_ALifeLine_1b82aae97e57feca: Nice and quiet, I like it
RD_ALifeLine_11d718875bd9d774: Did you hear the plant closed? Did they tell you to go home too?
RD_ALifeLine_4fb35747359da13f: My buddy got bit at the loading dock, don't ask me about it
RD_ALifeLine_38551c144a75c51f: They're saying it's a virus, a virus, like the flu, I don't buy it

RD_ALifeLine_7c603d3311ecb9a3: Whatever you do, don't go near the guys on third shift
RD_ALifeLine_34221d764fceaeff: Stay out of the factory, it's bad in there

RD_ALifeLine_3661ff39409b8a67: Another day of this, you'd think I'd be used to it by now
RD_ALifeLine_154e748f0b3d0404: Foreman's not coming, is he? I stopped waiting
RD_ALifeLine_4a4cb7e5646ad2a6: Never thought I'd miss writing up overtime
RD_ALifeLine_1aec71172f6d5535: Anything left in the hardware store? I need a hammer and some nails
RD_ALifeLine_14b7275555ace102: Whole crew I started with, I'm the last one, don't ask where they are
RD_ALifeLine_5088613358dd6725: Ran into a guy with a forklift, you'd be amazed what that does
RD_ALifeLine_77ae783a61693656: I've got a spare pair of work gloves, you look like you need them
RD_ALifeLine_5cc0900951f8ada9: I fixed the pump at the church, so now I'm the plumber
RD_ALifeLine_56b192c339d15f3a: Everyone's got a job now, mine's keeping the lights on, which is funny
RD_ALifeLine_63c6e2873b27738f: Nobody tells me what shift it is, so I'm on all of them
RD_ALifeLine_0d4281fb04a8cf19: Hands out in the open, same as mine
RD_ALifeLine_4519d3cf33beb17e: You all alright? You need anything?
RD_ALifeLine_29642d2d0fe5a186: We've got water at the station, if you're thirsty
RD_ALifeLine_2976ddee26a2a74b: Hi, we're from the fire station, don't be alarmed
RD_ALifeLine_1aeb799073f1e8b7: Mind the glass, we just cleared it
RD_ALifeLine_6f550e6f4bec87ef: Hello, any of you medical? We could use a hand
RD_ALifeLine_597ed6fd00b43563: We're making rounds, so, don't worry, we're friendly
RD_ALifeLine_0b2f251d5b8ebb82: Are any of you bit? I need to ask everyone, sorry
RD_ALifeLine_128b589a2a0f83e8: There's a cot or two free at the station
RD_ALifeLine_4a1c17446e1cd13b: Hi, we haven't slept, still going
RD_ALifeLine_5e93f1664d414e2a: Hi, we're checking houses, have you seen anyone alive in there?
RD_ALifeLine_2e1e92ec7af4e5b9: Hey, you carrying bandages? Anything sterile?
RD_ALifeLine_0678430f2de48fc4: If you see anyone hurt, tell us, we'll come, I promise
RD_ALifeLine_56969a8b1ab02a5c: We lost three of ours yesterday, so, if we seem short
RD_ALifeLine_5b06724e57e06bea: Hey, you look like you could use some water, we've got a little
RD_ALifeLine_2d2b870c36b87d45: Hello. Anybody hurt? We've got bandages and water
RD_ALifeLine_61a18c7b6ff8694f: You okay? You look pale, come sit down for a minute
RD_ALifeLine_49b6163776ac0e4e: Need bandages? I've got a few, they're not clean, but they're something
RD_ALifeLine_724bf9a172cdb1dc: Hi, we're checking on people, is everyone alright over there?
RD_ALifeLine_1f90af10570fb76b: Anybody seen a doctor? We've got a man with a bad cut
RD_ALifeLine_66d4412b0ca2903c: Where are you headed? We're looking for survivors, if you know of any
RD_ALifeLine_771d0ba12b69802a: We've got room at the church, if you need it
RD_ALifeLine_1c5d84f83d799243: Hello, I'm sorry to stop you, you wouldn't be a nurse, would you?

RD_ALifeLine_6573d01217bf2190: Please, if you hear anything, tell us, we'll come running
RD_ALifeLine_47ca342e2306094c: Hello, folks, need medical? We're the volunteers
RD_ALifeLine_17de50891bd08f21: Please, anybody got a spare blanket? We've got a patient
RD_ALifeLine_51d6e287785c8cf1: Hi, we're on our way to the church, the wounded are there
RD_ALifeLine_1a4524f120717419: Stay hydrated, folks, I'm saying it to everybody
RD_ALifeLine_74cfaff63cfe9a4c: You folks hurt? Burned? Sick? Just checking
RD_ALifeLine_021e255d56e172bd: If anyone's got a pulse, we want to talk to them, ha, that's a joke
RD_ALifeLine_07305ef47350cd1f: Hey, got any spare gauze? We're out, and it's getting bad
RD_ALifeLine_1968864f3c3ddf60: We've got a roster of the dead, if you want to check a name
RD_ALifeLine_00328f637cdb49cc: Everybody's welcome at the clinic, no questions
RD_ALifeLine_0e4ed06d04c7d48c: Do you know CPR? We could use another pair of hands
RD_ALifeLine_299c46c4636e689b: We've been up since Friday, so, if I'm slow, it's me, not you
RD_ALifeLine_19116baa472ea38f: Hey, good to see you, you're the first people today who smiled
RD_ALifeLine_54699ad930f33efb: Another group on foot, thank God, I thought we were the last...
RD_ALifeLine_7594fae53566a2e7: Don't go in the old mill, we found five there
RD_ALifeLine_2fb0b9a675540918: No rush, nobody's hurt right now, so, hi
RD_ALifeLine_01f26308744a4966: Good day for a house call, nobody's home, but still
RD_ALifeLine_062fe3f8160a4e08: Has anyone told you where to go? We don't even know ourselves
RD_ALifeLine_0c813aec5b5a643a: Stay together, don't wander, call us if somebody's hurt
RD_ALifeLine_1fc946350b290980: We're running out of room at the station, but we'll find a spot

RD_ALifeLine_17cd5b7c063df359: Move on, please, we can't help you
RD_ALifeLine_1bbc57626d91415d: Engine's down at the station, if you need us, holler

RD_ALifeLine_616002672ceed385: Hoses all over the place here, mind your feet
RD_ALifeLine_28eea94f3ac695ed: Station's got a meal going, such as it is
RD_ALifeLine_54ec99d413d89070: Any smoke that way? We keep seeing it
RD_ALifeLine_103d49c8753623b8: Station's down the block, if you need a hand, we're there
RD_ALifeLine_2b04ac80112d2e58: If a house ever smells like gas, don't strike a match, just go
RD_ALifeLine_504e0f924ab7f23a: We lost the hose, I've got a bucket and a bad attitude
RD_ALifeLine_2aad7654003af913: If you ever smell gas, don't light anything, just walk away
RD_ALifeLine_44ca6b74162873b7: Hydrants are dead, so it's buckets, it's always buckets
RD_ALifeLine_08c400660186fa59: Anybody feverish? I'm checking everyone, please
RD_ALifeLine_3e842bbf3f83c790: Wash your hands, I know, I know, there's no water, do it anyway

RD_ALifeLine_70229d39780230aa: Don't share cups, don't share canteens, I'm serious
RD_ALifeLine_0e7f6600729dcf8c: Any of you sick? Don't hide it, we can help early
RD_ALifeLine_05d6bd477bc56a23: Anybody feverish? I'll check, it's quick, I promise
RD_ALifeLine_65f1501132fff91b: Drink something, you look dry as a bone
RD_ALifeLine_150151c532d30a22: I can set a bone, if anyone needs, just ask
RD_ALifeLine_5064684e46f02b35: You look like you could use a checkup, quickly, may I?
RD_ALifeLine_13e3ce13381affb7: Any coughing? Any fever? It matters, I promise
RD_ALifeLine_4fdf6e4d7360557e: Anybody here know how to stitch? I've got a line of cuts
RD_ALifeLine_653614253112d6d3: Have some water. Nurse asking, not your mother
RD_ALifeLine_3542738f729e6c37: God keep you on your way
RD_ALifeLine_6f9a6be770bb9309: We hold service in the church, all are welcome
RD_ALifeLine_4a59756e5abbbe8e: I'll say a prayer for your journey, if you'd like
RD_ALifeLine_716f77a95ea9bf02: Pastor here, if you need to talk, my door's open
RD_ALifeLine_53781a2e4c47d838: Peace to you and yours, whoever you are
RD_ALifeLine_530e7fe6122b5aef: I pray for everybody who passes, so you're in it
RD_ALifeLine_6054f3aa6af463dd: The Lord's with you, even if the world isn't
RD_ALifeLine_02555af417bcf81f: Pastor, from the church on the hill, you're welcome anytime
RD_ALifeLine_0b07ab97734569d6: I'm sorry, I talk too much when I'm nervous, bless you
RD_ALifeLine_28c4ecc80da5e4d0: Walk in grace, both of you
RD_ALifeLine_10b7d41530770a15: God keep you, brother or sister, whoever you are
RD_ALifeLine_01eb90d66c47fb82: If you want to pray, I'm here, if not, I'm still here
RD_ALifeLine_13625a2078273aee: The Lord's got a plan, they say, but He hasn't shared it with me
RD_ALifeLine_0c053f963a2bd49e: Pray with me for a minute? Not for me, for the people we lost
RD_ALifeLine_0005d1da5c5f5b73: Welcome, welcome, the church is open, bring whoever
RD_ALifeLine_2661f31b50f45ee6: God keep you both, mind the road
RD_ALifeLine_0f3818ef2fb4ed02: Anybody got a map with the back roads on it?
RD_ALifeLine_4ce3ac1846dede0e: Anyone know a shortcut? I'm done with the road
RD_ALifeLine_5f10883761775c96: Piggly Wiggly's cleared out, but the stock room door is still locked
RD_ALifeLine_5383a0643df020c1: I've been walking all morning, and I think I'm going in circles
RD_ALifeLine_78fb46ea4b5bc044: Careful, the third step on that porch is rotten, I learned the hard way
RD_ALifeLine_685634851f7af3e7: Don't use the main road after noon, there's too many of them out
RD_ALifeLine_76d226052940d88d: My husband's checking the barn, we'll be right behind you
RD_ALifeLine_4fde2ce37196e800: My husband's afraid of strangers, so I'll do the talking, hi
RD_ALifeLine_0251bedc224f385f: My husband says hello, he's too shy to say it himself
RD_ALifeLine_49ad3c540f3b8bc2: Are you okay? My little girl wants to know if you're okay
RD_ALifeLine_5145436132123e41: We're trying to get to Rosewood, is it safe? Is anything safe?
RD_ALifeLine_59b783705b838af4: Please tell me you've got food, even a little, even crackers
RD_ALifeLine_300cd12e3abc7b14: I haven't slept, and I've got a baby, and I'm falling apart, hi
RD_ALifeLine_391171e431391999: Did you see anyone out there? A man with a limp? My brother
RD_ALifeLine_21dda323074528a0: I can't believe we're just walking, like it's normal
RD_ALifeLine_2c22e250298c6974: Are we safe here? Please, I don't know what to do anymore
RD_ALifeLine_3871a6ae08c12266: Look... other people it's okay it's okay
RD_ALifeLine_7694835d77d50948: We've learned to keep quiet... we're not rude just tired
RD_ALifeLine_25afd00a301c0f2c: Our oldest is thirteen, and she's already a better shot than me
RD_ALifeLine_7e7c029b483e892f: Don't touch anything you don't have to... I can't bear getting sick on top of this
RD_ALifeLine_78d129a9543fa877: We've got a cow, can you believe it? A cow, in town
RD_ALifeLine_504e304b61faa7dc: Keep together... even when you're sick of hearing it
RD_ALifeLine_40fe9e705432acd0: I wouldn't drink water just because it looks clear... not worth the risk
RD_ALifeLine_5d0026c468489d83: We trade eggs for bullets, it's a good deal for everyone
RD_ALifeLine_536c74ca46f49c59: My oldest keeps watch, and I keep the count
RD_ALifeLine_29c3c10538043df8: Don't let the little one near the water, it's been bad lately
RD_ALifeLine_69e9570631ea1b90: There's a house down the road, empty, with a well, if you need
RD_ALifeLine_06619ca24f47822c: There's a barn up the road, we slept there, it's dry
RD_ALifeLine_2ef1d7044ffabb15: That road crew's been working since Friday, they never got paid
RD_ALifeLine_3f8c81bc08847f20: Good to see you, you made it through, I'm so glad
RD_ALifeLine_2d8b78935c12c247: You two look like family, and that makes me happy
RD_ALifeLine_7824fbda7f3cb716: Hello, friends, I'm glad you're here, truly
RD_ALifeLine_0d2a3bc21cfe86d6: Hello, I'm not myself today, sorry
RD_ALifeLine_1d949ad2493900f1: I lost someone this week, so, if I'm quiet
RD_ALifeLine_3154e0e631c7d24c: Hi, nice to see people, I just can't talk
RD_ALifeLine_11a9ef6c2909ba11: Hey, you're either lost or going somewhere interesting, which is it?

RD_ALifeLine_0f2b5f5479a25843: If you see my sanity, tell it to come home
RD_ALifeLine_3764f5093fe62fe5: Good day for a picnic, just don't open the basket
RD_ALifeLine_344c777226480395: Don't look back there, trust your gut
RD_ALifeLine_45df32af28c88ed1: Is that you? Oh, thank God, it's you

RD_ALifeLine_6f99b1a52ed81d22: Wait! Are you real? Say something!
RD_ALifeLine_7a8306e628096de8: What do you want? I'm sorry, long day, hi
RD_ALifeLine_66a068ec7f8e3a6b: Don't say a word about my hair, it's been a week
RD_ALifeLine_4927fe281a8a1ccc: I'd stop and talk, but the baby's asleep and the wagon's falling apart, if I sit down I'm not getting up
RD_ALifeLine_795354e20b25f398: We used to have a block party every Fourth, I can't find half those people now
RD_ALifeLine_65b461f42919f0a7: My daughter keeps asking when we're going home, I keep saying soon, and she keeps looking at me
RD_ALifeLine_3c47f033510dc768: You see any infected on your way? We lost count of ours
RD_ALifeLine_7dce11e04c0a65ca: Those things hate the sun, or I'm making that up, hello
RD_ALifeLine_17527a7c7c48842f: Careful, the dead are slow, but they never stop, you know that
RD_ALifeLine_04fd61683c1f43ed: The infected don't like fire, so, we keep a little one going
RD_ALifeLine_4fdb6b0a66b3d306: Monsters... I can't think of a better word for them
RD_ALifeLine_60c848df2eb15b0b: Hey, if you're quiet, they don't notice, at least that's been our luck
RD_ALifeLine_77140a97579f4268: We found one in the garage, and it took four of us
RD_ALifeLine_08169c4f43ecf1cc: Don't let your little ones see them up close, it's not right
RD_ALifeLine_5e0f00e05ca23e65: They've got a smell, you can tell before you see them
RD_ALifeLine_1306770240545f7e: You heard the moaning earlier? I figured it was nothing
RD_ALifeLine_64e80f1d4d5df79b: The Wilsons made it to Louisville, so they say, I hope it's true
RD_ALifeLine_20fdbd5c4f717acc: My cousin heard from a trucker that the bridge is out at Fort Knox
RD_ALifeLine_5a16e1954f2ca156: Hey, the ice cream shop's got a freezer still working, supposedly, a rumor
RD_ALifeLine_14a44e89275e7d1f: Somebody's got a generator running on Third, I heard
RD_ALifeLine_5ebf101739f08ba7: Heard they hung a sign at the courthouse, a list of names, you should look
RD_ALifeLine_0adf55336009e5c0: Bill Wallace's farm has a well, if you're passing, tell him I sent you
RD_ALifeLine_0e8fd32f1c3c2aad: Did you hear the church bell? Somebody's ringing it, bless them
RD_ALifeLine_5f31b73d1451bb3b: The mayor's gone, so they say, left in a helicopter, or so I heard
RD_ALifeLine_6660fd903447d1dd: Everybody's talking about a train, that's coming to take us out, I don't believe it
RD_ALifeLine_6d18ed7a1bcd04d4: I used to know everyone on this road by their dogs, now I don't know anyone, or where the dogs went
RD_ALifeLine_2abbc965737374d6: I spent thirty years learning every back road in this county, and not one of them goes anywhere safe
RD_ALifeLine_2c77c8ff173ac140: Nine days, you keeping count? I lost it at six
RD_ALifeLine_7544f6bb373fe933: Anyone told you the Army's gone? It's just us
RD_ALifeLine_5517135f56e896d5: Hey, you made it through the week, good for you
RD_ALifeLine_1bd47ce93e2c5767: Radio died Tuesday, so, you're my news
RD_ALifeLine_78d3858117658a5b: I haven't seen a soul in two days, so, hello
RD_ALifeLine_1aa6bd7464d22b54: Got a plan? Because I'm all out
RD_ALifeLine_19a3a9c9733038a2: Two weeks, you believe it? Two weeks of this
RD_ALifeLine_7a9569162cfee56d: Hello again, you're still around, I'm glad
RD_ALifeLine_59181ab755c1b6c5: We found a well, if you need water, it's behind the Baptist church
RD_ALifeLine_2820e7d47b9d9367: You trading? I've got socks, they're clean, mostly
RD_ALifeLine_363ec4a377206be7: Everybody I know is gone, so, you're my friends now, sorry
RD_ALifeLine_6a2249e202e976c9: Do you remember what pizza tasted like? I'm losing it
RD_ALifeLine_2b4a298a5128c3da: A month already, can you imagine
RD_ALifeLine_2a0f76c3583782b2: Don't ask what day it is, I've got no idea
RD_ALifeLine_7292867468b0f291: You stayed alive this long, so you're smarter than most
RD_ALifeLine_0d3da7c858b215b5: Our garden's coming in, if you've got seeds, we'll swap
RD_ALifeLine_2d21e5fe1acc344a: We're a little group, ten of us, there's room, if you need it
RD_ALifeLine_1e7a12b04c7ddb27: I stopped waiting for the Army, I started planting corn
RD_ALifeLine_55c88dcc5c3dfc26: Whoa, careful with that, the house is still smoldering
RD_ALifeLine_0aedeaf241495cf7: Did you hear about the Dunns? They left at dawn, nobody knows where
RD_ALifeLine_6d8e13ff62bda442: Y'all want to come in for a minute? The porch is shaded
RD_ALifeLine_3a3757bd21537f9e: Did you see my husband? He's about six foot, red beard, I lost him at the market
RD_ALifeLine_2dd64c297c2a500a: Hey, I know that truck. Who's driving it now? Never mind
RD_ALifeLine_215f3f762adf6262: My wife thinks I'm at work, I tell her I'm at work, I walk around the block
RD_ALifeLine_427342f87f482e06: We pulled a man out of a ditch this morning, he's fine, he's just embarrassed
RD_ALifeLine_5d934fc85ee5cb14: I'm not a doctor, but I play one on this street
RD_ALifeLine_2c7975d4301e1299: Noon, we've been walking five hours, my feet are mush
RD_ALifeLine_4a7c32323fc98b7e: Did you see those things? Did you? I can't be the only one!
RD_ALifeLine_31c9151b527a5b3f: Are they sick? Are they dead? Tell me, you must know
RD_ALifeLine_6cf0ec865af0bc97: My uncle went out for groceries and came back like that, I can't
RD_ALifeLine_4104d3ef6ac9d279: That was Mr. Jenkins, I'd know that coat anywhere, it was him
RD_ALifeLine_535551536368ad04: Who's in charge? Somebody has to be in charge!
RD_ALifeLine_3f54c21324f5f82b: I count the dogs and the dead every day, then myself
RD_ALifeLine_64a1c74d6be46332: I sleep with a bat now, plus a prayer
RD_ALifeLine_05cf665c612ddc31: The dead don't rest, so we do our walking while we can see
RD_ALifeLine_18e99a805c42447a: Nobody's bitten in our group, and we intend to keep it that way
RD_ALifeLine_7a6c92b706fda5a3: They found a stash of canned food in the school basement, and it's mine, ask anyone
RD_ALifeLine_7e9601f86755578f: An alarm! Somebody set off an alarm! Everything will come!
RD_ALifeLine_1032125b2495111e: That alarm's going to bring all of them, run!
RD_ALifeLine_220147ee4056898c: There's an alarm going off, can you hear that?
RD_ALifeLine_47efc16b5c2fb741: Who the hell set off the alarm?
RD_ALifeLine_7ebdbe673ab60d93: Turn it off, somebody turn that thing OFF
RD_ALifeLine_4731dad23f8b1fe5: That whine is gonna wake every dead thing in the county
RD_ALifeLine_5893d3b105982778: Alarm, alarm, alarm, why won't it stop
RD_ALifeLine_38c72eb75f004b6d: Great, now it's singing, loud as a church bell
RD_ALifeLine_106f9ff24f7670f2: Someone's got the whole block lit up and singing
RD_ALifeLine_1f5878716613a6bc: That noise is carrying for miles, you know that, right?
RD_ALifeLine_206193162a9886a3: Great, an alarm, so much for staying quiet
RD_ALifeLine_111e180f660253e5: It's still going, it's still going, why is it still going?
RD_ALifeLine_3e557bd8562b95b0: Is that an alarm or a siren? I can't even tell anymore
RD_ALifeLine_572b033a71d52c87: Piercing, that's what it is, piercing and stupid
RD_ALifeLine_707255b466745d9a: Something's running on battery in this town and it's screaming
RD_ALifeLine_385712ea3150795f: Ears are ringing and it isn't even next to me
RD_ALifeLine_0e3b6683434432fe: That's gonna bring them in like flies on a pie
RD_ALifeLine_115674bc65a8ca30: Of all the things to still work, an alarm
RD_ALifeLine_45b923873241eb53: Heard that? Somebody woke up the whole neighborhood
RD_ALifeLine_4f7670f256d9040d: Nobody's coming to turn it off, that's the sad part
RD_ALifeLine_0a8055cd2d07208d: Whoever's alarm that is, they must've had money
RD_ALifeLine_2c81078a66ca1a4c: No no no- make it STOP, somebody make it stop!
RD_ALifeLine_27edfd5846188682: It's calling them, it's calling every one of them, oh God
RD_ALifeLine_4f2698d9206ed906: I hate that sound, it's like screaming, a machine screaming
RD_ALifeLine_157d1c205f797cdc: Shut it up, please, please somebody shut it up
RD_ALifeLine_538d0eb86b27b1bc: They'll all come, they'll all come to the noise, it's what they do
RD_ALifeLine_471f8c66131f1f5f: My heart, listen to my heart, I can feel it in my throat
RD_ALifeLine_530ba6fc597e05eb: Somebody's coming to help? Is somebody coming? Is the police coming?
RD_ALifeLine_18bc344e1b6efd43: Sirens mean help, right? Right? ...no, it's just an alarm
RD_ALifeLine_3c0b068525491615: That's a car alarm, I know that one, it's a Ford, I think
RD_ALifeLine_65b3286e55e530d5: Alarm- it's an alarm- it could be someone alive over there!
RD_ALifeLine_77c24040255fe548: Don't go near it, don't, it'll draw them to you
RD_ALifeLine_395429e44110d366: Are we leaving? Tell me we're leaving, I want to leave
RD_ALifeLine_6158a8ca689d722e: Alarms don't stop by themselves, battery gives out, eventually
RD_ALifeLine_20f758c468940a11: Leave it, it'll die when the battery dies, we'll be gone
RD_ALifeLine_5ed6e2bd344f5a7a: Somebody broke in somewhere to set that off, I'd bet
RD_ALifeLine_52c17b2706f91d7c: It's either a trap or an accident, both end the same
RD_ALifeLine_5d504c8d7a0b1d64: Count the minutes, if it's still going in ten, they're all coming
RD_ALifeLine_57de71014127c29a: Not our alarm, not our problem, let's move
RD_ALifeLine_7a0d52450a7cbb61: Houses with alarms had money, houses with money had guns, think about it

RD_ALifeLine_54034b8d79ad310f: Once cleared a house on a domestic call, the suspect was asleep on the couch, Mortified, all of us
RD_ALifeLine_19aa9044773f32ae: Our sergeant had a rule: nobody speaks until he's had coffee, worked every time except once
RD_ALifeLine_3701b4df127015a8: First day of basic, a kid saluted a mailbox, we called him Colonel Box after that
RD_ALifeLine_746470ab21d10fdd: I'm not authorized to tell stories
RD_ALifeLine_5cd3bf227ab98b90: Trained a kid who couldn't find his boots every morning, he made corporal anyway, some people just get lucky
RD_ALifeLine_064499173550c3b7: We once held a perimeter for three days with a broken radio and a deck of cards, won by default
RD_ALifeLine_52aa1952452787f9: Soldiers don't tell stories to strangers
RD_ALifeLine_5c739b9926732963: Left a post in the middle of the night, walked fourteen miles before I stopped shaking, haven't been back
RD_ALifeLine_319f034f306c65d2: I knew a man who said the war would never reach us, he's the first one I buried
RD_ALifeLine_55d5ca377705e55f: Spent a month in a place with no maps, learned that people are the same everywhere
RD_ALifeLine_6a53d47865b34197: I once sold a man his own truck, he thanked me, then he asked for the keys
RD_ALifeLine_2ff9c6f91f947977: Spent a summer in a gas station in Ekron, nothing happened, best summer of my life
RD_ALifeLine_6fdd376256ea5dc9: Had a fellow in the yard once begging for his life, offered me his shoes, good shoes, too
RD_ALifeLine_783878ff687b0fbb: We stopped a truck full of chickens last week, dinner was loud
RD_ALifeLine_192ca0081a7a71a4: A kid on my block stole a squad car once, drove it to the lake, parked it right in the water
RD_ALifeLine_2922ea4a7161754f: Crew had a guy who could pick any lock, locked himself in a bathroom for six hours
RD_ALifeLine_180221a5025cf195: Rode a thousand miles once on a bike with no brakes, don't recommend it
RD_ALifeLine_7f023a0a023ed891: Our president once rode into a church to tell the pastor something, pastor's still afraid of us
RD_ALifeLine_63b7e4262c7c14eb: We don't swap stories with strangers
RD_ALifeLine_0efa115a5829919d: A man owed us a lot of money, he paid in cows, we had cows for a year
RD_ALifeLine_04e065225eb71777: We once lost a safe for a week, turned out the janitor had been sleeping on it
RD_ALifeLine_11965e4242bc3760: In the pen a guy ran a lending library out of his cell, had six books and charged by the page
RD_ALifeLine_7556837477c60fae: They taught me welding in prison, funny thing, it's the only thing I've ever been good at
RD_ALifeLine_0c5ec74b251949f7: My aunt used to know everybody's business, never thought I'd miss getting cornered by her at the grocery store
RD_ALifeLine_609dcb554af7f78a: Before this, I heard a neighbor arguing with a lawn mower, kept calling it sir, polite right up till he kicked it
RD_ALifeLine_07040acb4dfb4e29: My brother always said he'd do well in an emergency, man couldn't find his own driveway with the porch light off
RD_ALifeLine_1c91604151806479: I keep thinking about a waitress who called every man 'hon.' Even the one she was throwing out
RD_ALifeLine_5ec3dedf61dda4ff: Used to know a man who kept a fork in his shirt pocket in case someone offered pie, planning ahead, he'd call it
RD_ALifeLine_05ead7725949d1cb: People still argue over who owes who a coffee, I mean, I get it, some bastard still owes ME a coffee
RD_ALifeLine_705a89776a9fcf7d: Used to be gossip meant someone did something stupid at a party, miss that
RD_ALifeLine_0eb1e27859b198ef: Remembered my third-grade teacher's name, been trying for YEARS, now it comes to me, great, thanks, brain
RD_ALifeLine_05036fe877d7a061: You one of those people who liked camping? Still like it? Heh, sorry
RD_ALifeLine_72a7e90005c062c7: Somebody once stole our break-room microwave and left the instruction book, I still want to know why
RD_ALifeLine_5a96a8485f831f07: Our old bookkeeper could hear a coin hit the floor from another room, couldn't hear you asking for a raise, though
RD_ALifeLine_126dbda83e3cd166: I used to know which mechanic was sleeping with whose cousin, haven't got much use for that information now
RD_ALifeLine_403e21a7008e103b: A man I worked with ate the same sandwich for eleven years, then one day he said he'd never liked mustard
RD_ALifeLine_63e5ae4964287d12: Neighbor used to repaint his fence every time he fought with his wife, same fence, must've done it twenty times
RD_ALifeLine_425e638a743cd301: Cousin tried to pay a parking ticket with fishing lures, said they were worth more, clerk didn't care
RD_ALifeLine_3a5e8f8846cc7cd9: My father hid Christmas presents so well one year we got them in April, called it an Easter improvement
RD_ALifeLine_5049e23e56f77746: The last church raffle I went to had a ham nobody wanted to carry home, I'd carry the damn thing now
RD_ALifeLine_50e1090567bbe97b: There was a woman on my street who corrected the newspaper in red pencil, mailed it back, too, every Monday
RD_ALifeLine_383ff52c0170c67d: My granddad once fixed a chair with a belt, then got mad when his trousers fell down carrying it outside
RD_ALifeLine_5a871370418b2774: Tell me something boring, please, somebody burnt their toast or... anything like that
RD_ALifeLine_5085f20a4b31f8de: Our sergeant once lost a map inside another map, we weren't allowed to find that funny until he left the room
RD_ALifeLine_0f126db21ce29a2d: Recruit asked if working past midnight counted as two days, had to turn around so he didn't see me laugh
RD_ALifeLine_24a192e871ebcb6c: We had a deputy who wrote his shopping list on the back of everything, some arrest reports smelled like onions
RD_ALifeLine_179213be4b9e5aaf: I once booked a man who asked whether the cell had a smoking section, it had a bucket, that was the tour
RD_ALifeLine_7e29a79b681ef63f: A patient once sent us a thank-you card with a complaint about the coffee written inside, fair complaint, honestly
RD_ALifeLine_3f9f5a6047923d86: The best meal at our fire hall started as a punishment for whoever left the hose muddy, we stopped cleaning it so well
RD_ALifeLine_26202bd32a248e15: Knew a guy who polished his bike when he was pissed off, wouldn't speak to you, just kept polishing
RD_ALifeLine_1fce220332734cfd: I knew a fence who demanded receipts, for stolen things, said he liked an orderly business
RD_ALifeLine_31c88123184cb61a: One man in the block could make any argument about baseball, even an argument about soap, especially that one
RD_ALifeLine_78c5690b5a0b29c6: You want gossip? Last job I had, a man put his own photograph in the employee-of-the-month frame, nobody noticed
RD_ALifeLine_4fb1cd5f5ee3fbe6: Here's something stupid I did once
RD_ALifeLine_490b7c3a35e629e7: Something that isn't bad news? Uh...
RD_ALifeLine_01f247d55e08ba69: Had this drawer at work nobody was allowed to open
RD_ALifeLine_140436df68f521e7: My sister told everyone I couldn't swim
RD_ALifeLine_28e41a392f0ceedb: A lady on our street kept a tortoise named Gerald, took him for a walk every day, I'd watch from my window
RD_ALifeLine_49f1052849f31f6e: My dad taught me to drive in an empty church parking lot, and I hit the only tree
RD_ALifeLine_2874bd91561c1cda: The week before ALL this, I was complaining my boss never listened, and now I'd give anything to be yelled at by him
RD_ALifeLine_27095a661d1a4b25: I once got stuck in a revolving door for twenty minutes, in front of my whole office
RD_ALifeLine_4828a98128874177: M-my grandmother kept a jar of buttons, and every time I came over she let me pick one
RD_ALifeLine_0117b1b779428278: We had a goat once that ate a whole pie, and the whole church watched
RD_ALifeLine_4c299b2336ebd7e4: My sister and I used to race to the mailbox every day, and she always won, and I always let her
RD_ALifeLine_5be15689684c1823: I had a pet turtle that escaped, and we found it in the garage three years later, ALIVE
RD_ALifeLine_025b3a39092b65e0: The summer I turned twelve, I swam across the lake on a dare, and nobody believed me
RD_ALifeLine_2ddd36c720696057: My neighbor had a rooster that crowed at all the wrong times, I'd give a lot to hear that rooster right now
RD_ALifeLine_38765b2a6c8b1148: I used to hunt with my father, and he'd say, a man who waits is a man who eats, I think about that a lot...
RD_ALifeLine_7358c1f02d21efc8: One winter the whole town got snowed in, forty people at the firehouse, one guitar, nobody left till spring
RD_ALifeLine_37a5abcf3e66819a: I knew a man who could fix any engine by listening, he'd put his ear to it like a doctor
RD_ALifeLine_4e5211fb3024f8d4: Back in '82... the river rose, and we all piled on the roof, and the preacher sang hymns for three hours
RD_ALifeLine_026930d4044f1757: An old man walked to town every day for sixty years, and when his legs gave out the town carried him
RD_ALifeLine_03c12fa7717dd464: I once saw a deer walk right into a diner, order nothing, and walk out
RD_ALifeLine_7cc0658f18a24e4f: My mother canned peaches every August, forty jars, and we ate the last one at her funeral
RD_ALifeLine_270194644ae0bb82: Years ago... I saved a kid from drowning, and I never found out his name, and I think about him
RD_ALifeLine_672288223812a3c0: I worked a night shift once where nothing happened for eight hours, it was the best night of my life
RD_ALifeLine_076af5db5bf7c1c5: The first time I saw the dead walk, I thought it was a parade, and I waved
RD_ALifeLine_4f59ed267d8665eb: The winter my daddy lost the farm, he sold the cows on a Tuesday and sat in the barn until dark
RD_ALifeLine_69fbb23948a8c7d2: You want a story? Alright, my grandpa taught me to whistle by tying a string around my loose tooth
RD_ALifeLine_17a93a443367850d: Asked my wife to marry me with a mouthful of fries, she laughed and said yes

RD_ALifeLine_1322182622880873: I don't tell stories to strangers!
RD_ALifeLine_052ac0d24ded18ce: I don't have any stories for you
RD_ALifeLine_2f37d21a6cfc8d69: Stories are for friends, and you're NOT one yet!!
RD_ALifeLine_5a8c26ba3cf53c3c: My story's short, I trusted a stranger once this month, now I don't

RD_ALifeLine_7ac7dc1771372373: There was a bell that rang every Easter for a hundred years

RD_ALifeLine_7bc3697a713cb98f: Shot a deer once at three hundred yards
RD_ALifeLine_4aa64c3b4c9b6091: When I was a boy, I got lost in a cornfield for six hours
RD_ALifeLine_07eca3b03588fee2: We had a dog named Sarge

RD_ALifeLine_0d0a7cad7fa5ddd5: My boy once glued a quarter to the sidewalk and watched people try to pick it up for an hour
RD_ALifeLine_108dacaf05b46dc1: There was this goat, see, at the county fair, and it ate the judge's hat

RD_ALifeLine_03ef5f174c106b0c: I once got chased by a goose for four blocks... ha
RD_ALifeLine_6d2c1e0b6bed50d1: Old man Pruitt, he used to talk to his tomatoes, called them by name
RD_ALifeLine_498cf72b2fa99af5: Back in high school I got stuck in a locker, in front of the whole cafeteria
RD_ALifeLine_40d15a786c16d830: A fella in my town stole a church bell, once, as a joke!
RD_ALifeLine_37f3b2ea7a064da0: My dog ate my homework, for real, and I got an A for creativity
RD_ALifeLine_3bf561182a7ffc14: There was a woman in the line at the grocery, years ago, who paid for my milk when I came up short
RD_ALifeLine_57cdda1e1d9d04cf: A stranger fixed my flat on a rainy night and wouldn't take a dime!
RD_ALifeLine_3c6349313e27958c: My neighbor brought a pot of soup the day my husband died, didn't say a word, just set it on the porch

RD_ALifeLine_60e76b03499fed35: My daddy used to whistle when he walked in the door, always the same tune
RD_ALifeLine_2113ce8029e597d6: Me and my brother got lost in the woods once, and our dog led us home
RD_ALifeLine_4a73026465e65eb3: An old man gave me his seat on the bus, when I was pregnant and miserable
RD_ALifeLine_7ed33fce4e2dabe5: The preacher at our church always saved me the last cookie, because I was the only kid who said thank you!

RD_ALifeLine_3db76ec62a75d926: I got stuck on a roof once, for hours, with the dead below!
RD_ALifeLine_70d5f1157abb76ee: Back when I was a rookie, I forgot my lunch pail on the roof, and flew it off the side
RD_ALifeLine_26673d8454b786d9: I once sold a man a lawnmower, with a bag of fertilizer, and a hat, and a gallon of gas
RD_ALifeLine_0f1cb6785c82c59d: There's a man in my town who has parked in the same spot every day for thirty years

RD_ALifeLine_2737140f6244769d: I fell through ice at the pond when I was twelve
RD_ALifeLine_53c681514a5b13a2: My granddad taught me to read a trail
RD_ALifeLine_5b88acaa2283888b: I saw a bear once, standing on its hind legs, like a man

RD_ALifeLine_74baae935970f859: Don't loot tired, tired folks miss the one standing in the closet

RD_ALifeLine_79db421a744d1c21: Measure twice, cut once, now it's listen twice, open the door once

RD_ALifeLine_179e4a7b6f22c7f6: I'm, um, not supposed to say, they told us not to tell people, I'm sorry

RD_ALifeLine_238a581a43ae98b4: God, why? What did you notice? You're scaring me
RD_ALifeLine_3b2b66cd16fccb15: I'd try to keep other people safe if I thought something was wrong

RD_ALifeLine_46c7306477bdb396: Would I tell you if I was? Would you tell me? There you go

RD_ALifeLine_576664fb6ca7a694: Virus, bacteria, parasite, call it what you want, it makes the dead walk, that's the only fact I need

RD_ALifeLine_60ebd01232224941: Why do you want to know? does it change anything
RD_ALifeLine_3cd0d51a0fe60623: I don't have answers, and I wouldn't tell you if I did

RD_ALifeLine_6cccc03c0c20b9c6: Folks pray over it, boil herbs, drink moonshine, the only thing I've seen work is a clean shot early
RD_ALifeLine_66f081b957d952ed: Maybe someday, until then we make do and keep each other alive
RD_ALifeLine_1a0c75442487dc91: They never told us anything, I doubt there is one, or I wouldn't be running
RD_ALifeLine_11807d737b32a854: None has been announced, as far as I know
RD_ALifeLine_5eb9add02b4668d3: CDC said they were working on it, then we lost contact, so I just don't know anymore
RD_ALifeLine_022a73da1c4c1a30: Hospital tried antibiotics and isolation for a day or two, none of it worked
RD_ALifeLine_5e35d54d5c4c7b33: I've put down three of my own, so believe me, I'd love one to exist
RD_ALifeLine_34dd585f2c575f55: Don't spread rumors, it only makes people panic
RD_ALifeLine_361aab114fadbb24: I wish I could say yes, honestly, I do, but I haven't heard of one
RD_ALifeLine_22bef0791a7aa1d5: If there is one the Army has it, and the Army isn't telling me a thing
RD_ALifeLine_781be3b67c2c67c8: Research is ongoing, that's all I can say
RD_ALifeLine_7b2709e56e5d7484: There's no authorized treatment at this time
RD_ALifeLine_34b449f76a6cf487: Every medic I've talked to says no, and they'd know
RD_ALifeLine_37b547c92f270c6d: Not discussing that, so drop it
RD_ALifeLine_117ff2363474454f: I want to believe there is, I really do... I've seen things I can't unsee
RD_ALifeLine_66811a5e12189c60: Prevention is the only treatment, so keep your distance and watch your arms
RD_ALifeLine_02cecd2e4e9239fe: They gave us a shot at induction, I thought maybe... but it's just the usual stuff, I think
RD_ALifeLine_08aa22fa59ae9354: I heard they had something at the base, a shot, but... I don't know if it works, I really don't
RD_ALifeLine_5b5fc8da056629d0: If there was a cure, somebody'd be selling it
RD_ALifeLine_68aa14b92ddf5221: Prayer and quarantine, that's all we've got
RD_ALifeLine_048f446c2c18e2cd: Doc Hendricks says there's no cure, just isolation, and he's the only one with a diploma
RD_ALifeLine_79b85cd128c7c79f: We keep hoping, friend, and that's something
RD_ALifeLine_71af5ddc754da32f: They'll have something by next week, they have to, they made a polio shot, didn't they?
RD_ALifeLine_061780581e6928c2: My girl's had a fever since this morning, if you hear about any medicine, anything at all, would you come find us?
RD_ALifeLine_7ada804229e45417: If there was a cure, don't you think somebody would be driving it around with the sirens on?
RD_ALifeLine_05c52bc721f84071: I keep the peroxide close, I know it won't do anything, it makes me feel better, okay?
RD_ALifeLine_67de46816ff42987: I stopped waiting on a cure about the time I stopped waiting on the mail
RD_ALifeLine_452baf786d7e7f8e: There's no cure for a bite, there's a shovel, and there's a decision
RD_ALifeLine_45bbd48e5f58d807: Cure's the same as it was on day one, don't get bit
RD_ALifeLine_67fafe58083ef390: Heard a fella in Riverside took his own arm off at the elbow, didn't take, don't let anybody sell you that one
RD_ALifeLine_44a16dc33aa55416: No cure, and I'm done with questions, beat it
RD_ALifeLine_646dbbb01b2116c5: Lady at the pharmacy in West Point handed out penicillin for free the first week, didn't save a soul, but she tried
RD_ALifeLine_3ebfd0252974b171: I pushed every antibiotic we had into the first ones, not one came down off the fever, there isn't a cure, I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_79199be22e51194f: Scrub a scratch hard and fast and pray it was shallow, that's about all we got left
RD_ALifeLine_35f18ba36092bcec: I pray for one every night, I also tell people not to wait on it
RD_ALifeLine_2cc2486a1dfb4de0: Last bulletin said the state health people were working on it, that was a good while back
RD_ALifeLine_3fe5b4aa0301ca2a: If you're bit, you tell me now, from right where you're standing
RD_ALifeLine_7feb8fca055b805c: Medics on the line had nothing, they quit carrying the kits by the end of the first week
RD_ALifeLine_12c5fbd276c0515b: Show me your forearms and your neck, slowly
RD_ALifeLine_277f0fe0234e3a19: Cure? A bullet's a cure, fixes everything, permanent
RD_ALifeLine_57080d7758e856af: Guy up in Valley Station was selling a cure out of his trunk, twenty bucks a bottle, it was grape drink and rubbing alcohol
RD_ALifeLine_2a70182e5707497d: Somebody finds a cure, they're gonna charge for it, I plan on being the one charging
RD_ALifeLine_58ed833a0260bfec: Only cure out here is staying out of our way
RD_ALifeLine_61ffe9bd715f4fbb: There's a cure for nosy, want me to show you?
RD_ALifeLine_709facea1f18e946: You look sick to me, walk away before somebody decides to fix it
RD_ALifeLine_5434a892733b765f: Somebody said there's a shot up in Louisville, somebody says a lot of things
RD_ALifeLine_1bc4b218234b184f: I keep the radio on all night in case somebody says the word, nobody says it
RD_ALifeLine_1076fb8e5574d530: You can't cure a bite by hoping, that's the nearest thing to medicine I know
RD_ALifeLine_0f82a11e034806ad: No, I've watched nine people go and not one turned back, that's my whole data
RD_ALifeLine_7b31fe3b57112acc: I won't tell you there's a cure, I'd sooner sit with you and be honest
RD_ALifeLine_7f30281864e4b10a: First week everybody said cure, now nobody says it, that tells you something
RD_ALifeLine_3c7c25c859a7ee90: No official word on a treatment, anybody selling one is robbing you slow
RD_ALifeLine_529fb5ec654b6f12: Negative, and if there was, I'd not be standing at this crossroads talking to you
RD_ALifeLine_6b049a356be20c76: I've seen no evidence of one, I'd not build a plan on absence of evidence either
RD_ALifeLine_3e32c08866b6a4a8: There's a fella selling pills he swears by, he sells a lot of things he swears by
RD_ALifeLine_4f2b64405fb6b6ef: Polio took two off my road in '52, took 'em years to fix that, we ain't got years
RD_ALifeLine_0b62678e5da4e952: Cure? Sure, don't get bit, that'll be one can of anything, thank you kindly
RD_ALifeLine_47c176000abcca66: Don't, don't put that in my head, I've got somebody in a back room, don't you dare
RD_ALifeLine_2ee628e3127e047b: Stay off the road after dark, things come out, we keep the doors shut
RD_ALifeLine_16ec55d05fa1ea17: There was a man at the end of our street who wasn't right, I won't say more
RD_ALifeLine_2656fe7f4d28b41e: The danger is getting too close to my kids, back off
RD_ALifeLine_37e8be0025090dec: The creek bottom, the dead seem to collect there, mind where you step
RD_ALifeLine_646e40856afa353e: Strangers on the road scare me more than the sick ones, at least the sick ones are honest
RD_ALifeLine_1016c59f5811e560: The grocery store parking lot, fifty of them in there, I counted
RD_ALifeLine_30144b6476032813: Don't go through the neighborhood on Poplar, somebody's got a gun in every window
RD_ALifeLine_47f1a41c03e88b4f: You, you're the danger if you keep standing there
RD_ALifeLine_2c19c13004a12ed8: Open fields at dusk, sound carries, they follow it
RD_ALifeLine_28ae71e03d7becee: I stay off the roads, roads are where people and trouble meet
RD_ALifeLine_0f57efb1527ce3c8: Stay off the loading docks at the plant, full of them, door's stuck open
RD_ALifeLine_34534e2e5a6ddc67: The truck stop on 31W has a gang now, pay or go around
RD_ALifeLine_5064a33e7bce699c: The danger's anyone who thinks I'm easy, I'm not
RD_ALifeLine_6adbc03725e27427: Smoke over the north ridge, something's burning, avoid it
RD_ALifeLine_413044c23252be86: Gas leaks at the station on Main, one spark and it's over
RD_ALifeLine_0f2d98596ba7763a: Open wounds and dirty water, keep any cut clean, or it'll kill you slow
RD_ALifeLine_4849f2421a648059: The hospital lot is a death trap, don't go in, don't even look
RD_ALifeLine_63199208610c97f4: Giving up is what'll kill you, keep your hope, friend
RD_ALifeLine_663aaefd3390c79a: Folks living on the edge of the river road, desperate people do desperate things
RD_ALifeLine_0ec3647a21fdab6a: Looters on Main Street - armed - stay back from the hardware store
RD_ALifeLine_1b1e019b0c65a5d6: There's a group squatting in the old motel who won't answer the radio, avoid it
RD_ALifeLine_546dfb44172f2373: Anybody who won't show their hands, that's who I'm watching
RD_ALifeLine_697037653fbaec61: Armed crews on the highway, they're not the old drunks and teenagers anymore
RD_ALifeLine_583dc2fd0b494372: Don't go near the Ekron cutoff, we lost two deputies there
RD_ALifeLine_6f9209233db915df: Interstate's a graveyard, Stalled cars, trapped people, stay off the shoulder
RD_ALifeLine_45d8bd59757b72c2: Escaped inmates, some of them are out and they're in no mood to be gentle
RD_ALifeLine_1722e62f448e107f: Multi-story buildings, too many windows, too many places for something to wait
RD_ALifeLine_745e93e4188af089: Don't wander off the road, Mines and strangers in equal numbers
RD_ALifeLine_487f91961f2a5132: Anybody who ignores a halt order
RD_ALifeLine_749e9e065a0b6bf4: Open ground, night, anything on foot, pick one
RD_ALifeLine_484d564114ebcb32: The ridge east of here is contested, don't move in daylight
RD_ALifeLine_4a26e5e031e680cd: Hostile, that's the only classification you need
RD_ALifeLine_649e606a46ad6a6b: Checkpoint patrols, they shoot first if they think you ran
RD_ALifeLine_6ccdc753747c2ec5: You, you'd be surprised how fast I can pull
RD_ALifeLine_34d28d58088b663f: Everything, every sound, every shadow, learn to read the dark
RD_ALifeLine_1424426c722ae44e: Dead ones on the highway, and that bunch at the quarry, don't go there
RD_ALifeLine_2db19c5f1b426b9a: The only danger worth worrying about is a man with a loaded gun and a bad day
RD_ALifeLine_0d003bec77a994df: The crews on 31W will gut you for a pair of boots
RD_ALifeLine_0bfee76b55f92212: Danger's whoever thinks they can walk in here
RD_ALifeLine_3a9819bb3a028a3a: The cut-through at the bridge, enemy set shoots anything that crosses
RD_ALifeLine_05c540a1271a2885: Don't go downtown after dark, whole thing's a shooting gallery
RD_ALifeLine_7e783c80258c1a63: Chain across the road past the river, some of our own put it there
RD_ALifeLine_44ba65bf4e7eb33f: Rotters in the rest stop, went in once, lost a good brother
RD_ALifeLine_214b5dc120965b06: You're riding in the wrong direction, turn around
RD_ALifeLine_6aa6b5887ad4e700: There's a man in town who pays for fresh bodies, don't be fresh
RD_ALifeLine_098dbc704bcaa026: The warehouse district belongs to the wrong people now, avoid it
RD_ALifeLine_3a88c26123d70f8f: Guards with rifles on the old state road, they'll cuff you or kill you
RD_ALifeLine_21c6606531b8a238: I'm the danger if you keep pushing me
RD_ALifeLine_1c389e5709d03799: Everything that moves slow and moans, don't let them touch you
RD_ALifeLine_07e3a4f65ce18cea: The infected, aim for the head, the living, too, everyone's scared and armed
RD_ALifeLine_05ed95a92ab0f0a3: Everywhere! everything! the dead, the people, the noise, I don't know what's worse
RD_ALifeLine_52116de74b0ec112: Be quiet, that's the big one, they hear you, and then they all come
RD_ALifeLine_3126da8a63667be3: D-don't go anywhere you can't see out of, I learned that the hard way!!
RD_ALifeLine_711977c85b2eeb51: Don't trust anyone who's too friendly, or too hungry, or too quiet, ugh, that's everyone
RD_ALifeLine_791a565775b4d302: I don't know, I'm new at this, everything looks dangerous, and everything might be
RD_ALifeLine_261d4e6c079c92ed: Watch your back, they come from the sides, you think you're clear, and then there's three of them
RD_ALifeLine_6c4afdc26b48250c: Don't run unless you have to, running makes noise, I know that sounds crazy
RD_ALifeLine_7907c40779763547: Anything that moves, honestly, anything, even a branch, even a cat
RD_ALifeLine_696e7f122772bbca: S-stay AWAY from big groups, they attract more, and then you can't get out
RD_ALifeLine_4ff0fe836cdafeb3: The usual, the dead are slow but patient, and the living are fast but stupid
RD_ALifeLine_2e48686f39d17ab9: Big crowds of 'em now, one loud noise and they all come this way, so hush
RD_ALifeLine_4533ad49026ba6b0: The dead don't bother me so much as the folks who figured out you can take what you want
RD_ALifeLine_59577e2c6f10bb4a: Don't go out alone, and if you must, tell somebody which way, so they know where to look for the body
RD_ALifeLine_12818a336b9f0300: Watch the sky... if it clouds over, the dead get bolder, I don't know why...
RD_ALifeLine_63da4d8d6324a04c: Whatever you hear, count to ten before you check, half the time it's nothing, half the time it's everything
RD_ALifeLine_4fc6d73c20ca71aa: The worst part is you get used to it, and used to is when you die
RD_ALifeLine_185c61d04b1df2f6: Come stay close, and I'll point out what I know, there's three spots I won't go near
RD_ALifeLine_4d12ff0604877e3a: You're one of us, so I'll say it plain, the east side is rough, the west side is worse, and the middle is a trap
RD_ALifeLine_261cfca1363d08b2: For you, because I like you, never trust a locked door that's already open
RD_ALifeLine_54ba2d910900894c: I'm not telling you where it's safe, I'm telling you to go!!
RD_ALifeLine_13b67a7c6f3d74f6: Why, you looking for a good place to ambush?
RD_ALifeLine_2ba17b18525f9ada: Dead ones, plus the ones who figure they can take your stuff, the second kind is smarter
RD_ALifeLine_4d759ece7584921a: Water, don't drink standing water, I saw a man die from that, not from a bite, from water
RD_ALifeLine_03f0ea800a5ec077: Keep the racket down and watch the ground ahead, I don't trust a quiet stretch just because it's quiet
RD_ALifeLine_7abba44f24c25e3d: Anywhere with a big open yard, you'll see 'em coming, but they'll also see you
RD_ALifeLine_15f5bd774263eff1: Don't cross open ground at dusk, that's when they stir, I'd bet money on it
RD_ALifeLine_30319ef076e1185c: Swamps, culverts, tunnels, you get cornered, and it's over
RD_ALifeLine_2b3e29a243f3f38e: Lone men with a story, if a man tells you he's alone and begging, he's got three friends within shouting distance
RD_ALifeLine_429f9d370d26c963: Pack up before dark, always, I've never regretted leaving early
RD_ALifeLine_4b391bbe0a39448b: Danger is anywhere I'm not, so I'm leaving
RD_ALifeLine_7b1078b1197805f6: You're the danger, near as I can tell
RD_ALifeLine_4c54ec2f38ec0c71: Keep the kids close, don't let 'em wander, they get curious, and curious is how they die
RD_ALifeLine_485afba90773403d: Watch for smoke, someone's burning something, and that's either a signal or a trap
RD_ALifeLine_68ec25e8257302b0: The dead gather where it's quiet, don't ask me why, it's just what we've seen
RD_ALifeLine_553087f66d98ba84: Don't go near the wide streets, too open, stay on the backs, the alleys
RD_ALifeLine_6ca3db8173f2fd26: If you hear singing, don't go, it's not people singing
RD_ALifeLine_7017b03e646040e3: Honey, at my age everything is dangerous, a stair, a stone, a stranger...
RD_ALifeLine_0dab37f5039ec1a3: Stay out of the dark, and stay in a group, that's the best I've got
RD_ALifeLine_42c6bdfd56edce5e: Never go where you can't come back from, I learned that in '52
RD_ALifeLine_156edee625adbe65: Like, everything, I guess? The dead ones, guys with guns... the dark mostly
RD_ALifeLine_62fb1d4a123e2a0b: Don't trust anyone over thirty, ha, no, don't trust anyone who looks too clean
RD_ALifeLine_5be9837675bb9bfc: There's weird stuff out there, noises, shapes, I don't go out after sundown
RD_ALifeLine_55fbc2165f063d22: Wide open ground gets you picked off, I stay by a wall, always
RD_ALifeLine_53f398cb0e1a5c90: Blind corners, and corners you can't see around, stop, listen, then go
RD_ALifeLine_015e92bf175c832b: Folks with a grudge... folks with guns, folks with nothing to lose, those are your three kinds of bad...
RD_ALifeLine_0027ae2074fe0a50: Gas leaks, wires down, flooded basements, the world's full of things that can kill you without teeth
RD_ALifeLine_569ec7d41225ad7a: Any cut at all, clean it and wrap it, infection kills about as many as bites do
RD_ALifeLine_68fbd8863ce0f832: Dehydration, bad water, filthy hands, it's the boring things that kill you
RD_ALifeLine_1fe2c3ed587e0149: Sleeping rough... in the cold, in the wet, don't do it, pneumonia is silent
RD_ALifeLine_6364c464131455bd: Despair, my friend, that's the most dangerous thing out here, and it comes quietly
RD_ALifeLine_311cb11466183658: Isolation, don't wander alone, hear me, find someone, anyone, to keep you honest
RD_ALifeLine_7b02e8e41f81208f: Smoke, fire, walls coming down... it all happens faster than you think
RD_ALifeLine_24fb56ef082561bd: Stairwells... closets, basements, anywhere with one exit, the dead pile in there...
RD_ALifeLine_15907349017f3f9e: Gas... electric, structural, I check all three before I breathe
RD_ALifeLine_3747337e4d78e450: Open lanes of fire, bad crossings, and strangers walking up too casual, that's my list
RD_ALifeLine_6170f1c63ff24761: Everything within fifty yards that I can't identify, which is a lot...
RD_ALifeLine_65b2ea5335ae8c42: Walk the edges, never the middle, and watch for the second guy, there's always a second guy
RD_ALifeLine_403eba8d60501752: For you? I'd show you the safest way through, and who not to trust
RD_ALifeLine_7ef7acbe018748e3: Take what I say seriously, I wouldn't tell you this if I didn't care
RD_ALifeLine_47a629517d147109: Sit down, listen close, step by step, because I want you alive tomorrow
RD_ALifeLine_3f71ae1c39fb3360: Careful, careful, friend, here's the straight truth, let me draw it out for you!
RD_ALifeLine_5beea79b5db3ddeb: Of all people, you I'll warn: there's a pack in the east, armed, mean, moving at night
RD_ALifeLine_0b193d2746ed1f62: Worst of it's folks who think you owe 'em something, keep away from those
RD_ALifeLine_48c435256570afc5: Stay off the main road, there's trouble at the junction, I've seen it with my own eyes
RD_ALifeLine_69c13d0418f9a111: The old mill is crawling, don't go in, I lost a friend there!
RD_ALifeLine_0bf2e38c350aa1a7: There's a stretch past the cemetery, thick with them, go around
RD_ALifeLine_6fea905a0a2ed117: Mind your fire and your toes out there
RD_ALifeLine_5716f7641c07d3bf: A group's been grabbing travelers, quietly, one at a time, don't wander alone
RD_ALifeLine_07433aef5aea99c6: I trust you with this: stay clear of high ground in town, there's a sniper, or a rumor of one
RD_ALifeLine_74e21d746ce483c5: Watch the sky at dusk, when the birds go quiet, that's when it starts
RD_ALifeLine_5d9109965c99fde2: Keep your voice low after sundown, I'd rather not advertise where we are
RD_ALifeLine_6c8b0d3b266d6c04: Folks are getting desperate, and desperate means dangerous, even the nice ones
RD_ALifeLine_4520a06e102fb0e2: Don't pick up anything shiny, there's tripwires, I'm not kidding
RD_ALifeLine_68505c946b88fbfd: Take the long way round the school, the gym's full of them
RD_ALifeLine_0e07412664306b9f: If you hear a bell, don't answer, it's a lure
RD_ALifeLine_09dde6de16d02925: Shake your boots out every morning, learned that the hard way
RD_ALifeLine_50dc797e20d8c9ee: Trust your gut, it's smarter than your brain right now
RD_ALifeLine_747d5ad222ee4b70: I'd walk with you if I could, I'd cover your back
RD_ALifeLine_0bc9a55810e3cac3: Be careful with strangers, even kind ones, especially kind ones
RD_ALifeLine_763ad48a51dd3394: The danger changes by the hour, so stay flexible
RD_ALifeLine_5bd86d4b1824b8ed: Bridges are bad, tunnels are worse, open ground is bad too, honestly everywhere is bad
RD_ALifeLine_4d6b2b117a558778: There's a spot where the ground gives way, near the creek, I'd hate to lose you
RD_ALifeLine_7023cd826a186764: You've survived this long, so you know, but I'll remind you: don't get comfortable
RD_ALifeLine_31ddbf2f708ee3c6: Moonless nights are the worst, you can't see them till they're touching you
RD_ALifeLine_039827bf346230c0: Go out if you have to, just not alone
RD_ALifeLine_7730be7131774ed8: One more thing: if you get hurt, come find me, no questions
RD_ALifeLine_21d861c86d305524: Avoid the south end, there's a group that doesn't welcome visitors
RD_ALifeLine_5ef8cb7722d67604: Eyes open and keep walking, that's about all I know
RD_ALifeLine_401575147e0ac05a: The biggest danger is the one you stop watching for!
RD_ALifeLine_59d16689422ab696: I'd hate to lose you, so be careful, please
RD_ALifeLine_6ac2faa13347b170: If I knew a trap, I wouldn't warn you
RD_ALifeLine_78c68d5707ab0173: I'm not helping you, move on
RD_ALifeLine_22f75d0e510a7b36: EVERYTHING! everything's dangerous, the dark is dangerous, the quiet is dangerous, you're dangerous, I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_0b4164e33d210760: I don't know, I don't know, I just keep waiting for something to jump out, anything, a leaf, a cat
RD_ALifeLine_50df1de239cfd179: Watch the corners, watch the shadows, watch your own feet, watch ME, I'm kidding, sort of
RD_ALifeLine_5577a5261b15a443: Don't go that way- not that way- I don't know why, I just have a feeling, a bad one
RD_ALifeLine_671f7716312a0fd7: Behind you, behind you, always behind you, check behind you, constantly
RD_ALifeLine_52a912986f628897: The dead I understand... they're simple, it's the people that scare me!
RD_ALifeLine_63e4f3441c2057a5: They're everywhere- nowhere, then all of a sudden everywhere!
RD_ALifeLine_5fd9b47e5be3cdc4: Same stuff you've seen, just more of it
RD_ALifeLine_22ad2e4e2865b1b8: The dead I can predict, the living, no idea, so I watch both
RD_ALifeLine_15a94f9c39471a81: Moving after dusk is the mistake that kills people... so don't make it
RD_ALifeLine_7614806b0242ce9b: Everything wants something from you... your food, your boots, your blood, your time
RD_ALifeLine_53a67a6f61410758: The next mistake you make could be your last, so make it a small one
RD_ALifeLine_7a431ebc47e5e494: The worst danger is losing hope... and I've come close, twice
RD_ALifeLine_057f5f110ba7f9b0: Watch the ones you love, they're the ones who'll break your heart
RD_ALifeLine_71cedbbb69be1929: Carelessness, it killed my husband, one careless step on a Tuesday
RD_ALifeLine_155ec505657cb839: Grief, it makes you reckless, I'd know
RD_ALifeLine_74d28ee06ee46fcf: The danger took my wife on the porch
RD_ALifeLine_6891280766e4410c: I think about the child I couldn't carry
RD_ALifeLine_65fbc32b2a0fbdba: Idiots! idiots with guns, that's the danger, people who shoot at shadows and call it defense
RD_ALifeLine_652e9a0a48992198: Anything in a uniform that doesn't answer your questions, anything that points a rifle first
RD_ALifeLine_07baf5215578ffea: Dangerous? People who think they're in charge, God help us
RD_ALifeLine_51c4f05b54f83ad2: The real danger's the idiots with guns who fire at shadows
RD_ALifeLine_1f2c9fdf5f8d5e9e: Stay by me, I've got a feel for when to duck and when to run
RD_ALifeLine_47553b93315d41ef: I've got your back, but you've got to promise me you'll watch your own, deal?
RD_ALifeLine_433657df3986baf5: You worry me, you know that? don't do anything stupid out there
RD_ALifeLine_6f86f992706b0a61: Well, there's the dead, the living, the dark, the dogs, the bears, and my cooking
RD_ALifeLine_469d116c3ef7a01c: Honestly? Boredom, then the sudden screaming, boredom, then screaming, repeat
RD_ALifeLine_3207a8b707aa56dc: Dangerous? Only if you take up the habit of trusting people
RD_ALifeLine_7b69de861d1fa893: Biggest danger around here? My cooking
RD_ALifeLine_707c2de414f7827b: The danger? I've been doing this a whole week
RD_ALifeLine_50e26d842cc982f1: You, for one, you're the danger, now go away

RD_ALifeLine_1090324e5f990087: My wife... my wife is- fuck- I can't, I can't, I can't say it
RD_ALifeLine_09c7537010ff489f: Two kids... two beautiful kids... and I... I... ha... ha... I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_452fce710ec5bd94: I'm fine, I'm FINE, don't look at me like that, I'm fine
RD_ALifeLine_10b01fd31277be86: They- they were... they are... no... were... WERE... god damn it
RD_ALifeLine_5c12260606f219d5: My mom used to say- oh, hell, I can't do this
RD_ALifeLine_721b9ee743898720: My family's gone because some bureaucrat sat on a report, and I will never forget it
RD_ALifeLine_22f56eb50ca523da: They took my kids, the Army took my kids, "for their safety," and I haven't seen them since
RD_ALifeLine_7c5da3da7d95efb2: Don't ask me about my family unless you plan to help me find them, God damn it

RD_ALifeLine_43fe0a2a43de484a: I've got a husband who snores, a mother-in-law who criticizes, and a dog who steals socks, I love 'em all, heh
RD_ALifeLine_01d9c8fa18e9d8f8: Family? A bunch of loud, stubborn, hot-tempered people, and I'd give a kidney to hear them argue
RD_ALifeLine_4e2ffe6d4ce30cdd: Family? A husband who snores, three kids who argue, a mother-in-law who inspects my dusting
RD_ALifeLine_575cbd073fc78c4b: My brother-in-law is the dumbest man alive, and the most loyal, ha

RD_ALifeLine_28e5796d472412f9: Leave my family out of this, back off
RD_ALifeLine_33bf75a13b5dfc34: My husband's a doctor, too, we were on shift, I last saw him in the hall, he waved

RD_ALifeLine_08d7a6d64b293d18: My mom is eighty-three, in a care facility, and I know exactly what's happened there
RD_ALifeLine_76144fa40551bc8d: I have a granddaughter, Josie, nine years old, and she wants to be a veterinarian
RD_ALifeLine_40db77e1636e346f: My husband and I will be married thirty years in October
RD_ALifeLine_3719f3745cc725a0: Three kids, all grown and scattered, they call the church collect every Sunday and leave me a message
RD_ALifeLine_1a0fcdf3671adee8: My mother's got a voice like gravel, and a heart like a pillow
RD_ALifeLine_77395e14373d2003: My sister and I have a signal, two flashes of a lantern from her roof, and two back from mine!
RD_ALifeLine_1bdc8cc0483cade5: My twin brother can't cook, can't fix anything, can't sit still
RD_ALifeLine_023106ba6f48d0b5: Why? you want to find them? you stay away from them!
RD_ALifeLine_24de77a956602380: That's none of your business, stranger, keep your hands where I can see them
RD_ALifeLine_1468b198031fb30c: Funny you ask, I was thinking about them this morning, all of them, each face
RD_ALifeLine_313992e83e65f24c: My family is not your concern!

RD_ALifeLine_6db840a6538aed85: Don't ask about them, I'll ask you to leave
RD_ALifeLine_73021cf4106e4b3e: I won't speak of my people with you
RD_ALifeLine_3578e1973fb6f032: They're safe, and they'll stay that way, away from you!

RD_ALifeLine_3b7ea9f03ef8e8af: After what you did to the Wallaces? never
RD_ALifeLine_0d8798e64a0af893: My family has nothing to say to you

RD_ALifeLine_054461c135cb7317: Move along, and leave my people out of it

RD_ALifeLine_3bf2783b7d87f84b: Where is my family? Safe from you

RD_ALifeLine_318ffa612e487ea1: The less you know, the safer they are
RD_ALifeLine_16cb7e6514838a0d: Not now, not now, I'll cry if I think of them, and crying makes noise
RD_ALifeLine_02ddede5740870db: They're at home, they're safe, I need to get back, but THEY'RE in the way
RD_ALifeLine_48c52ae81c49726a: My family needs me alive, so I'm hiding, hush
RD_ALifeLine_2e870d2f2096bf70: Ask me when it's quiet, when I can think
RD_ALifeLine_34aa893977ef109b: I can't talk about them while those things are around
RD_ALifeLine_704cf075692b623f: They're safe, they have to be, shh, shh
RD_ALifeLine_32dee9c83a127dd5: My family would feel safer with someone like you around
RD_ALifeLine_01ebb10f65362504: I've got kids, and a spouse, and a lot of respect for what you're carrying
RD_ALifeLine_0a87cc79593087f6: My husband passed in the spring
RD_ALifeLine_04f6f196528aa342: Mom and Dad... and my little brother
RD_ALifeLine_4f4487a522f5e5e7: It's just me and my sister
RD_ALifeLine_4039e0c424aeb69a: I've been trying to reach them since Friday
RD_ALifeLine_5f57522d7c23a192: I keep thinking they'll walk up any minute
RD_ALifeLine_45376c36161da7bc: Three days, and not a word
RD_ALifeLine_67ee40c64f5cbdea: I've given up expecting a call
RD_ALifeLine_6cf7f5af29ff59ca: A week, now, and I still look at every face
RD_ALifeLine_2e5526cb6a804167: I say their names at dusk
RD_ALifeLine_59d247295bf5f25a: Family? Ha! Mine's the people standing next to me, the rest are dead or worse
RD_ALifeLine_7135c7637ebfb37d: Had one... don't anymore, and I'm not talking about it
RD_ALifeLine_59c4ddad6c4ca322: My old man taught me everything I know, mostly how to take

RD_ALifeLine_25beabaa25586e6e: What's it to you? You gonna use them against me?!
RD_ALifeLine_7fb26c1654f85d4c: Leave my family out of this or I'll leave yours out of everything
RD_ALifeLine_0b0dba733a0a40c6: Wife and two kids, I don't know where they are, can't stop thinking about it
RD_ALifeLine_11903cf669744083: My crew's my family, blood don't mean much
RD_ALifeLine_6282b2be5f8e78cc: My mama's back on the block, she'd kill me if she saw me now
RD_ALifeLine_2040af625db6ac96: Brother's inside, he's... I don't know where he is
RD_ALifeLine_1a3cd90e142f1cc0: You ask about my family again and I'll make yours cry
RD_ALifeLine_0a9364186e8d3687: Little sister, she's fifteen, I'm trying to find her
RD_ALifeLine_5afe19d3511a19da: The brothers are my family now, the club took me in when nobody else did
RD_ALifeLine_64af7d9b27e25821: Ex-wife, two kids, they don't talk to me, can't blame them
RD_ALifeLine_58bd8c34463bc717: Don't ask about my blood, it'll end badly
RD_ALifeLine_46c616bf6e7c476c: Got a daughter, she's twelve, I think about her every day
RD_ALifeLine_1f0312411f0a4fd1: I prefer to keep that private
RD_ALifeLine_1793ac992be08125: A sister, a cousin or two, nothing more
RD_ALifeLine_4063cb011a2d59c3: Wife and a son, I just want them safe
RD_ALifeLine_3c37273946f00b3f: Yeah, I had a-- I had a wife, she stopped writing, I don't know
RD_ALifeLine_718214987c03ac97: Mother, I think, probably dead, they wouldn't tell me anything
RD_ALifeLine_452fa4ed57660077: Don't you talk about my family!
RD_ALifeLine_5f126bb159715986: A little girl, she's seven, I haven't seen her in three years
RD_ALifeLine_62bcab21130b23a6: Dad's gone, mom's gone, brother went to the city, I don't know
RD_ALifeLine_5c4b51e05c441e78: A brother in Elizabethtown, I'm trying to reach him
RD_ALifeLine_0f08c92c5f50c396: A mother in Ohio, I'm hoping she's alive
RD_ALifeLine_400bf4110e8c6472: Wife and two daughters, I haven't seen them in days

RD_ALifeLine_347691d9381cc2ef: My family is not part of this conversation
RD_ALifeLine_78af82b313053106: Wife, two boys, they're sheltering with her sister, I hope
RD_ALifeLine_2c817211268c5b9a: My wife passed years ago, my daughter's a nurse in Louisville, I've been trying to reach her
RD_ALifeLine_25bdf8c7348c9109: Wife, a baby on the way, if she's still alive, God help us
RD_ALifeLine_3f099ae7000694da: Ex-wife, a teenage son, and I don't know where either of them are
RD_ALifeLine_66171f1e3e42ad83: Parents in Texas, a younger brother, I haven't been able to call
RD_ALifeLine_450a9606166888bc: A wife in Georgia, I can't reach her
RD_ALifeLine_1f4699ab3f0733f7: Mom and my sisters, I miss them like crazy
RD_ALifeLine_37433c2f3963513d: My mom, she's gonna worry so much, she doesn't even know where I am
RD_ALifeLine_218ace0275673fb6: No comment, and I mean it
RD_ALifeLine_5ca2b33a7bc0f834: Wife, two sons, one still in diapers, they're why I'm out here
RD_ALifeLine_1b3397e2612bfbda: A whole farm of cousins, but nobody's answering
RD_ALifeLine_5dfbeba5573d8495: Yes, a big family, thank God they're all with me
RD_ALifeLine_34ef0a6610327244: That's a bigger question than it sounds, can we take it slowly?
RD_ALifeLine_6090012f1bc04143: I don't have news I'd trust. I try not to turn that into an answer

RD_ALifeLine_603e2ee747bd934a: I've got people I think about, I don't always want to name them out loud
RD_ALifeLine_123701a068e18cc2: I can talk about them, just don't tell me you know how it feels
RD_ALifeLine_2162cb9e43e2535d: That's private, I'm not angry you asked, but that's my answer
RD_ALifeLine_60f536fe2602dd5c: I lost my wife, they got her, my daughter as well, please, let me go my way... okay?
RD_ALifeLine_123f4f9329142fe9: My husband drove to the pharmacy in Muldraugh on Saturday for my insulin, truck's not back, I leave the door unlocked
RD_ALifeLine_5344c4946c16f06a: Mama's in a nursing home in Louisville, I called eleven times before the phones went dead, nobody picked up, not once
RD_ALifeLine_5a57157f5de903fc: My folks live out past Ekron, I keep telling myself they had the sense to stay put, Mama always had sense
RD_ALifeLine_19014c6672d0e048: It's just me and my brother now, he's asleep behind that car, keep it down, he hasn't slept since Tuesday
RD_ALifeLine_31730420266c5d01: Our boy was at church camp up by Brandenburg when it started, I'm walking there, please don't try to stop me
RD_ALifeLine_2232c5be49897eda: Mom and Dad were at the house in Riverside, I was at a friend's, I haven't gone back to look, I'm not ready to look
RD_ALifeLine_5a3c671772f6fe9e: Had a wife and two boys, buried the wife, boys headed for Fort Knox and I ain't heard since, ain't nobody else to tell you about
RD_ALifeLine_6341b95f06553cc7: Family's whoever's still standing next to me come morning, right now that's a hound dog and a fella named Ray

RD_ALifeLine_1fa3b4512445d3bd: Why? What do you want with my family? Ask your questions from that side of the road
RD_ALifeLine_0f278ace2087e7ca: You don't get to ask about my family, you get to turn around and walk
RD_ALifeLine_710c62ac67444779: Wife works dispatch at the fire station in Rosewood, last I heard on the radio she was still at her desk, that's where I'm going
RD_ALifeLine_78401297524d00a8: Husband's on second shift at the plant, I keep his lunch pail by the door so he knows I'm still here
RD_ALifeLine_5753536e71e84720: Got a crew, if that counts, six of us from the lumber yard, four now, we still eat lunch together at noon, out of habit
RD_ALifeLine_72b3e0fa3405f106: My family's the folks sleeping in the fellowship hall tonight, forty-one of them, I know every name, I made sure
RD_ALifeLine_142370484faa4162: Wife and kids went up to her mother's in Indiana the week before, best thing she ever did was not listen to me
RD_ALifeLine_2b474f027da3991e: The department was my family, near enough, we were eleven deputies on the ninth, we're three
RD_ALifeLine_62d56b660473cdb1: I'm not discussing my family with you, step back and state your business
RD_ALifeLine_04bba17c3e7aacf7: My mom's in Ohio, she thinks I'm at Fort Knox doing paperwork, I guess I kind of am, paperwork with a rifle
RD_ALifeLine_7d4ac15327428d11: Unit's my family out here, the ones back home get letters I can't mail, writing them keeps my head straight
RD_ALifeLine_6283ef1608b44857: Keep moving, my family's not your concern, and yours isn't mine
RD_ALifeLine_52b73aa50c94b22c: Had a cousin ran shine with me out past Irvington, they got him in his own still house, drunk and bit, hell of a way
RD_ALifeLine_2cda0b531aff2c20: My old lady took the kids and the station wagon in April, guess she was smarter than all of us
RD_ALifeLine_6cc56ac11f9da455: Family? The boys I ride with, the rest of my blood can rot, most of 'em already are
RD_ALifeLine_7854f1231ee87685: Mama said I'd end up dead or in jail, did the jail part, now the whole county's dead, she got it half right
RD_ALifeLine_7cfca6d269a44615: You fishing for something? Ask me about family one more time and see what it gets you
RD_ALifeLine_722064596354b7a4: Got a family? Good, think about 'em real hard while you walk away from me
RD_ALifeLine_1878677308448274: Why, you wanna visit 'em? They're in a ditch off 31W, go on, tell 'em I said hi
RD_ALifeLine_41601ede1e11bac1: My mother's in Brandenburg, or she was, that's the extent of what I know
RD_ALifeLine_04e1c3912e3140e8: All of us are in this house, every one, I count 'em in the night sometimes
RD_ALifeLine_09c6938e6e1f5bd9: Wife's people were in Louisville, we don't talk about Louisville in this truck
RD_ALifeLine_70bc77837a376c30: My sister and her two, they're at the church with me, that's more than most
RD_ALifeLine_23e26aa71e40b487: I buried my Earl in 1987, first time in my life I've been glad about it...
RD_ALifeLine_0cc7cf97454e75e2: My daughter's a nurse in Lexington, I'd give this county to know that's still true
RD_ALifeLine_545cd7790fab436e: Family's a letter I can't send, that's what the word means right now
RD_ALifeLine_4e63cdcb53500449: Don't, please, I'll talk about anything else you want, anything else
RD_ALifeLine_43371a8405d6337e: Family? Yeah, these four ugly fellas right here, we picked each other

RD_ALifeLine_7bf3ef400d458941: I can tell you where I found some, but I can't hand it over

RD_ALifeLine_1ce80c7738dde325: I used to get everybody fed before I sat down, now I can't even--... Sorry, nothing I can spare
