RD_ALifeLine_608c7a1e4976924c: She's a nurse, so she leads like one: calm and firm!!
RD_ALifeLine_36873c874ff19961: He led us out of the first night, and we've followed since!
RD_ALifeLine_7564768a581c7986: It changes, but the heart doesn't
RD_ALifeLine_6c1c4a696344f9a4: We call ourselves a family, and that makes Mom the leader
RD_ALifeLine_3def1f37216c41c1: It's whoever stays up latest, which is me, most nights
RD_ALifeLine_3fb0216e3619bbc0: He's a good man, a bit stubborn, but he'd take you in
RD_ALifeLine_65ea6b9c6e00df43: She could use a hand, and I'd say you'd be a good one
RD_ALifeLine_7aab3f4b6cd7e4f7: You'd be welcome to meet them, tell them I sent you
RD_ALifeLine_678645dc063b8bd4: We follow common sense, and the best of us
RD_ALifeLine_6875c4ee4aa51888: You'll never meet our leader, I'll see to that
RD_ALifeLine_3cbed0891de3890c: Why? Looking for someone to bribe?
RD_ALifeLine_2b55dc525fe43e7f: Our leader would have you run out of town
RD_ALifeLine_78ad1b612c3cc149: She knows about you, and she's not happy
RD_ALifeLine_387450525bd9fad5: He'd send you packing, I guarantee it
RD_ALifeLine_7926d15e143ec939: Leave our leader out of it
RD_ALifeLine_04b738b8003026a0: Our captain doesn't care for visitors, especially you
RD_ALifeLine_152df66021f67f48: You'd have to get past me first
RD_ALifeLine_68ae6c2c77f35fd1: You want to speak to the boss? Ha!
RD_ALifeLine_3ad540197ee189bb: We don't take orders from the likes of you
RD_ALifeLine_61b923e63ef24ba5: Our people stick together, and you're not one
RD_ALifeLine_098d569f1ce3e6e8: I'd sooner introduce you to a firing squad!
RD_ALifeLine_44a137ea0c063915: You'd better stay out of his way
RD_ALifeLine_2a1830d9461d36ae: If you want a boss, hire a boss
RD_ALifeLine_27289bc360654001: They don't want to meet you
RD_ALifeLine_494b87082dc6d68e: It's not your place to ask
RD_ALifeLine_69de04d404d0ce6f: She'd have words for you, and not nice ones
RD_ALifeLine_588fe35738009437: Our leader wouldn't give you the time of day
RD_ALifeLine_25f047557293686c: We don't have one for you
RD_ALifeLine_5e73fc223953cfb8: He'd have you arrested, if there were police
RD_ALifeLine_6bb8b2be07fbe85c: We're an independent bunch, especially from you!
RD_ALifeLine_1c1f09702d9a369d: He's busy, and he's disinclined to meet you
RD_ALifeLine_77e3df6545dc703c: She has NO interest in you!
RD_ALifeLine_54f5896c5f918f00: Why? You looking for another job?
RD_ALifeLine_4a7353b56342d0ef: Our leader's name is none of your business
RD_ALifeLine_24c7ddb6124c84ef: I answer to nobody, and if I did I wouldn't tell you
RD_ALifeLine_0994af757cda34d3: The boss decides, not you, not me
RD_ALifeLine_340b8edd113036e3: Who's in charge? Whoever's holding the gun, and right now that's me
RD_ALifeLine_366b641f3b319f98: You want to meet the boss? You really don't
RD_ALifeLine_5dc568f5672da00c: You're talking to the man you need to impress, so impress me
RD_ALifeLine_069c1df118c63f45: The only boss you need is me, start talking
RD_ALifeLine_1f486bc251fafd91: Big man's resting, he'd like you maybe, I'll ask
RD_ALifeLine_796ef52f725fd0b7: You're looking at him, say what you came to say
RD_ALifeLine_75f2c8b80ce59a82: Me, always me, what do you want
RD_ALifeLine_6d427e1d763db50f: Shot caller's not for strangers, say it to me
RD_ALifeLine_2f8782fa5fb7a857: The big homie runs it, I run errands, tell me what you need
RD_ALifeLine_7184a8504eea9fd2: You got a problem, you take it up with me, right here, right now
RD_ALifeLine_08076ee15a86955e: Head of our set is Calvin, you wanna talk to him, I'll vouch
RD_ALifeLine_18937d3a1e266196: That would be me, my friend, be brief
RD_ALifeLine_75bf3509559b332d: The president, and you've got to earn that audience
RD_ALifeLine_149895c063d0d7d8: We vote, and you don't have a vote
RD_ALifeLine_2294fe5030985b84: Chain of command, you're at the bottom of it
RD_ALifeLine_3774ab421364c3b2: You'll meet him if you push your luck
RD_ALifeLine_27245796132b16f3: You are looking at him, choose your words
RD_ALifeLine_19af370122274924: There is an authority, you're not in a position to meet him
RD_ALifeLine_6eb7e9f84202634f: Ask whoever's in charge, if you can find them
RD_ALifeLine_794708b1150b93f0: Ask someone else, someone who won't hurt you for it
RD_ALifeLine_34012a692ca340da: Nobody, not anymore, we don't have bosses out here
RD_ALifeLine_42c2a5bc675805b9: Don't have a leader, had a warden, he's not a factor
RD_ALifeLine_1b37fa2a53cb6265: No one tells me what to do, not anymore!
RD_ALifeLine_6190430c5cba3fbc: Nobody leads, we take what comes
RD_ALifeLine_0b384e8e6de6a699: Whoever eats first, and that's usually me
RD_ALifeLine_3e7bd08b3d7ded03: The sheriff, if you want to speak with him I can arrange it
RD_ALifeLine_12d1150146527780: My sergeant, what do you need
RD_ALifeLine_353c193d065c6dd6: Chain of command is the sheriff, then the county judge, for what's left of either
RD_ALifeLine_3892aeea78594e66: You answer to me, here, cooperate and it's simple
RD_ALifeLine_79f5f0bd546a20e5: Sheriff Dawson, good man, I'll introduce you if you need
RD_ALifeLine_273ee64143b90804: That'd be me, what's the trouble
RD_ALifeLine_253a366c70bb5eee: Warden's dead, captain's missing, I'm the senior man now
RD_ALifeLine_1f940b65628827fb: The lieutenant, if you want to talk to him I can walk you over
RD_ALifeLine_36f066da45f23497: You'll deal with me, the Captain doesn't talk to civilians
RD_ALifeLine_20641f0d06af741a: Captain Briggs, he's a fair man, you'd like him
RD_ALifeLine_2479ea9143af55bd: I am, for this detail, state your issue
RD_ALifeLine_2050264f36db5ebf: Uh, the Sergeant, he's, um, not nice, nice to me I mean, I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_09bf2c3619238142: No one you can speak to
RD_ALifeLine_00320fe268c788a5: The man holding the contract, not me
RD_ALifeLine_406213e10bc50211: We vote, or we do what Harlan says, usually the second
RD_ALifeLine_5d87b22f7fa6b59f: No one's in charge, everyone's in charge, it's complicated
RD_ALifeLine_6f94f09e08dcd750: Old Jim Burris runs it, great fella, I'll take you to him if you like
RD_ALifeLine_3e05b82c1a924117: Why? You planning on talking to somebody above my head?
RD_ALifeLine_5652d8757644f3b6: My husband, bless him, he thinks he's in charge, but we all know it's me
RD_ALifeLine_655424b74963e147: Grandpa, he fought in Korea, he's our leader and our nightmare
RD_ALifeLine_795bb8ab46e5091d: Sheriff's still in charge, wherever he is
RD_ALifeLine_4004ddd7524f3c4a: Sergeant Cole, if you can find him
RD_ALifeLine_73507cb9227860f0: Commanding officer's name is classified, state your business
RD_ALifeLine_224889d82ea372ac: Captain Reyes, I'll take you to him, if you behave
RD_ALifeLine_4a48801221aaac91: The boss, and you don't wanna meet him unless you're invited
RD_ALifeLine_72c3612403495956: Big Ray, he runs this whole stretch, and he doesn't like surprises
RD_ALifeLine_765335b9306f3fbb: Why, you want to challenge him? Ha, good luck
RD_ALifeLine_0ed236ff050fe5d4: Leader? Nobody, really, Mr. Collins kind of decides things 'cause he has the generator
RD_ALifeLine_77f64d5c612366dc: I don't think anybody's in charge, I think that's the problem, if I'm honest
RD_ALifeLine_56aa992a1ccc7c0b: My husband thinks he is, I do the actual deciding, don't tell him
RD_ALifeLine_5f464e0409b14938: Me, I guess, God help us all
RD_ALifeLine_7b90a6c347f40b11: My mom, she'd kill me for calling her the leader, but yeah, my mom
RD_ALifeLine_27f5d0af77aac4d0: Me, I'm the oldest and I own the well, that's how it's always worked out here
RD_ALifeLine_44bd730f76226626: Woman named Darlene, ran the school cafeteria for thirty years, she scares us all into line
RD_ALifeLine_39b442cd0f172c24: Nobody's in charge, we vote, takes forever, and mostly we vote on supper
RD_ALifeLine_131fea576d0e9483: Captain Roy, not a real captain, real enough out here
RD_ALifeLine_2fb41c0231743f1c: Foreman's still the foreman, name's Lonnie, didn't see a reason to change it
RD_ALifeLine_74a54abc216bf644: The Lord, and after Him, a committee, the committee's harder to deal with
RD_ALifeLine_580d1a1277d866c1: Chief Mudd, he's got a burn on his arm the size of a dinner plate and he still outworks all of us
RD_ALifeLine_6e2292a668b35cd0: Dr. Bell, when she's awake, when she's not, whoever's holding the clipboard
RD_ALifeLine_78f035c379d7c003: Please don't ask me that, they told me not to tell anybody anything
RD_ALifeLine_2cd705d871e4e49f: The one holding the shotgun, that's me, get off my property
RD_ALifeLine_355d6ea541f7dea4: Sheriff Cundiff, last I heard, chain of command's a little thin right now
RD_ALifeLine_19b64f3b4cccd00d: Chief's gone, so the ranking officer is Sergeant Kessinger, he's a good man
RD_ALifeLine_58cc6bf71438bbdf: I report to my post commander, the post doesn't answer, so right now I report to me
RD_ALifeLine_50fd08d732248a10: You're looking at it, the county elected me twice, nobody's held an election since
RD_ALifeLine_1fcf7a0255a0cd1e: You'll talk to me, not my supervisor, stay right there
RD_ALifeLine_0d2840172532b88f: I'm in charge of you right now, that's the only chain of command you get
RD_ALifeLine_5cf554b778aa3087: Team leader, you deal with me
RD_ALifeLine_2df166a55956da40: Lieutenant's in charge, he's twenty-three, we do what he says, then we do what the sergeant says
RD_ALifeLine_11918f363f8cdf5a: On paper, a colonel at Fort Knox, on this road, me
RD_ALifeLine_401056231ef4031e: Sergeant Oakes, he's really scary, and really good, please don't mess with him
RD_ALifeLine_13e0f0d67369e785: Command authority is not up for discussion with civilians, step back
RD_ALifeLine_5184e5a20292efca: Nobody leads me, whole reason I'm out here is so nobody can
RD_ALifeLine_4537da36162ceef2: I got out from under one chain of command, I'm not climbing under yours
RD_ALifeLine_3e5979e9633173b1: Asking for the boss is how people get shot, don't
RD_ALifeLine_440a9a5030817b35: Big Ricky, you'll know him when he's laughing, that's when you run
RD_ALifeLine_6c8973c338fba6d0: You're looking at him, kneel, if it helps you feel better
RD_ALifeLine_45a88eb70b9ba703: Shot caller don't talk to strays, you talk to me, and I decide if he hears about you
RD_ALifeLine_615b1e057e036d48: The president, you don't talk to the president, you talk to me, and I think about it
RD_ALifeLine_1abcdcf91279f24c: I wear the patch that says president, that settles it
RD_ALifeLine_6149b86a2328f6a3: Big Otis, he ran D-Block, now he runs this, same rules, more room
RD_ALifeLine_1fe67ee42b2c7179: You're not getting anywhere near the top, so quit looking
RD_ALifeLine_5eb41db069c09e8c: You wanna speak to management? Management's got a rifle pointed at your knees
RD_ALifeLine_6759e363244fd5fd: The man who pays everyone, you won't meet him, that's a kindness
RD_ALifeLine_4d1f355a773ccaee: If you need to ask, you're not meant to know, walk away
RD_ALifeLine_0ea7178749f0c047: Houses on the north side haven't been checked, we took what we could carry
RD_ALifeLine_3eacd77d45f0890f: The elementary school pantry, we got half of it before the others came
RD_ALifeLine_7b1673c61adbdd80: The Johnson house on Elm, they left in a hurry and left the cupboards stocked
RD_ALifeLine_0dfaf3630b85a3b4: Hardware store on Main, everybody hit the front, nobody checked the back
RD_ALifeLine_7cf72ac83e0dcf25: Hunting cabins up the ridge, nobody thinks to look there
RD_ALifeLine_0e4e6a6a5ae1c8d4: Old farmsteads, Cellars, preserved food goes a long way
RD_ALifeLine_4b1eac182331475e: The plant's break room, vending machines, still full, it's a long walk
RD_ALifeLine_0eef0cac69910bee: Auto shop on 31W, tools, batteries, a little of everything
RD_ALifeLine_020f2e813631ce44: Gas stations have bottled water in the back, check the cooler
RD_ALifeLine_172fb5bd79e198fe: Station houses, every firehouse has a kitchen, and nobody remembers that
RD_ALifeLine_66950f60374f3540: Veterinary clinics, nobody looks there, and they keep antibiotics and bandages
RD_ALifeLine_58a8f49c67cce1ab: School nurse offices, small and overlooked, usually stocked
RD_ALifeLine_0b72121e79e1fc29: Churches keep canned goods in the basement for charity, we took a share, take a share
RD_ALifeLine_206b3305688eb7a8: The rectory on St. Mark's, nobody's home, I left the key under the mat
RD_ALifeLine_6fed10a55873f5ba: The county garage on Pike, locked, but I've got the combination, don't broadcast it
RD_ALifeLine_5f3a1f6d4b32660e: Hardware store on Main, don't force the door, there's a key in the lockbox out front
RD_ALifeLine_442e1fd306473c1c: I'm not a tour guide for looters
RD_ALifeLine_71168076208ef667: I can't approve of looting, but the school cafeteria is unattended
RD_ALifeLine_434ccc5510692154: If I told you, I'd have to arrest you, move on
RD_ALifeLine_105a97765484f5fc: Truck stops, Cabs sit full of food and nobody checks them
RD_ALifeLine_08096bc8117a2a3b: Abandoned cars on the interstate, glove boxes, trunks, take your time
RD_ALifeLine_760e675408005e41: Jail commissary's still stocked, but the key stays with me
RD_ALifeLine_77f02e165bf14644: Armory at the sheriff's office, don't bother, we emptied it
RD_ALifeLine_1477a0c11f1c4be3: Supply depots are picked clean, try the little places nobody listed
RD_ALifeLine_51359a6239517a31: The empty barracks on the east side, Footlockers, most of them, don't touch the ammo
RD_ALifeLine_4a111f3a4fbe37a4: I won't tell you, move out
RD_ALifeLine_5fd5725f2a48a0fd: Abandoned guard posts, they left rations behind
RD_ALifeLine_60673e0a631a2289: One-door buildings with no sign, big targets get hit first
RD_ALifeLine_74eabba161ec4814: Check the farms off Highway 31, people left in a hurry
RD_ALifeLine_5a5872b5575da8c7: Convenience stores in the back country, easy pickings, still
RD_ALifeLine_1611305d50ba3955: Why share? You think I'm stupid
RD_ALifeLine_1f1ede1a523a4ccf: Look around, everybody's got something, take it
RD_ALifeLine_019ce1092749584e: The houses along the river have boats and canned goods, and a few dead owners
RD_ALifeLine_6fce5d1f4dbecfae: Check the liquor store on the corner, some bottles survived
RD_ALifeLine_227d5ad02ecfbab4: The empty tenement on 4th Street, folks left cans
RD_ALifeLine_1b51c6f776182518: The roadside diner on the county line, back freezer was untouched
RD_ALifeLine_07e10c0200777008: Truck stops, every one has a pantry
RD_ALifeLine_72d2098602d85bb8: The warehouse on the south side, it's locked, but I know a man with a key, price applies
RD_ALifeLine_3a6a3d544a7856d0: The state road gas station, back room, don't let anyone see you
RD_ALifeLine_037f30c9461d590f: Houses with the doors left open, nobody's home
RD_ALifeLine_4114aa5c296705cd: Not telling a guard's cousin where to find things
RD_ALifeLine_591566db4a6d5e6f: Houses! the ones nobody's touched, the ones with drawn curtains, but, uh, bring a bat, just in case
RD_ALifeLine_0931a4dd459e3068: Pantries... cupboards, under sinks, people hide the good stuff in boring places
RD_ALifeLine_2a77d6a60f2b1dc2: Pharmacies, but they've been hit, so try the back rooms, the stockrooms, the places people forget
RD_ALifeLine_29b726631a2d4db7: Garages... toolboxes, workshops, you'd be amazed what people leave in a garage
RD_ALifeLine_23879c3e2df40515: Check the nightstands, medicine cabinets, the junk drawers, it all adds up
RD_ALifeLine_78715c6914e0ac4b: I don't know, I just kinda wander, and sometimes I get lucky, most times I don't!
RD_ALifeLine_4d9712455c003067: Churches have food drives... boxes of canned goods in the basement, I got a whole case once
RD_ALifeLine_39137d761fb938f3: Schools have cafeterias, big freezers, though the freezers are gone by now, pantries aren't
RD_ALifeLine_1f975aa012a024f0: Everywhere's been looted, so look where people stopped looking, the high shelves, the back rooms
RD_ALifeLine_5259153118a8c52f: Houses on the edge of town, they were last to be hit, some have gardens still
RD_ALifeLine_3fb23f434b4ce62e: Crawl spaces... attics, cellars, folks hid stuff in 'em, it's old-fashioned, it works
RD_ALifeLine_2e0d7f5135471c76: Farms, outbuildings, sheds, seed, feed, canned goods, even tools
RD_ALifeLine_34d60d705b4947d1: Check anything with a lock, the locked places are the least picked
RD_ALifeLine_4c77a48337c7fd02: The newer the house, the emptier it is, the old farmhouses still have stores
RD_ALifeLine_5916ac162d52ce46: Funeral homes, I'm not joking, they've got caskets and cold rooms and, oddly, coffee
RD_ALifeLine_2a39493f4788c6bb: For you, there's a place I haven't been brave enough to try, but you might be!
RD_ALifeLine_4c03bf4e3aee1edd: I've got a list, and I'd give you half, you'd be doing me a favor, I don't like going alone
RD_ALifeLine_151d8ae36f65107f: There's a good spot I know, I'll tell you if you come back and tell me what you found
RD_ALifeLine_0356a348379e31fd: If I knew, I wouldn't tell you
RD_ALifeLine_133c37a524d5e41d: You wanna rob my spot? no thanks
RD_ALifeLine_6abbcd6e1770b06e: Find your own, I found MINE, so can you
RD_ALifeLine_50c5a1b41dc68ead: Every house has something if you've got a crowbar and nowhere to be
RD_ALifeLine_42e97bd42c15007c: Hunting cabins, they're stocked for winter, nobody remembers them, and the doors are weak
RD_ALifeLine_4c11b3dc5add7192: Back of a barn, behind the hay, folks hide jars and tins there, I've found money too
RD_ALifeLine_00566f931ef65a6b: Cabins down by the lake, folks left ice chests, fishing gear, even coffee once
RD_ALifeLine_44567c96360feccb: Roadside stands, motels, truck stops, but they're picked clean, so you'll have to go deeper
RD_ALifeLine_2f621db00291e2f9: Look for the places that smell wrong, the smell scares the scavengers, and I don't mind it
RD_ALifeLine_443337420c889bb5: Any building where the door's been forced, somebody already took the easy stuff, so look for the hard stuff
RD_ALifeLine_1e93e99c045ea9e4: If I tell you, you'll go, then the next fella follows you, so, no
RD_ALifeLine_4e6e1ad24559ae62: We found a whole pantry at a church, they'd stocked up for the winter, we took only half, we left the rest
RD_ALifeLine_7633f0fd326cc741: Houses with kids' rooms, there's usually cookies, or juice boxes, or something sweet
RD_ALifeLine_0855608f24e73ceb: Check under beds, behind the water heater, inside the oven, people hide cash and canned goods
RD_ALifeLine_46ddf1395eb715f8: Basements! old houses, root cellars, jars of preserves, you won't believe what's down there
RD_ALifeLine_3f788d042734868f: My late husband's workshop has nails, screws, rope, wire, if you can pry the door
RD_ALifeLine_540d6ab068a11c65: The church kitchen, the Ladies Auxiliary stored coffee and sugar, enough for a hundred suppers
RD_ALifeLine_384a35b77ea14c1d: Everybody's attic, honey, everybody's got an attic, and nobody ever cleans it
RD_ALifeLine_7abd3e1826507fa4: School vending machines, I know, they've been robbed, but the back ones, the teachers' lounge, nobody checks
RD_ALifeLine_4e087c0507d34d47: Houses, I guess? I don't know, I just grab whatever I can
RD_ALifeLine_1a20a2a404230fe2: Check bedrooms, kids hide candy in their closets, I know because I do too
RD_ALifeLine_0c9bd78606fd5463: Shops, the plant, any warehouse, there's first aid kits and rope and a whole stockroom sometimes
RD_ALifeLine_20f32309221844dc: Loading docks, back offices, break rooms, the vending machines and the fridge
RD_ALifeLine_0af73408563bedc0: Lockers, desks, toolboxes, folks leave lunch in 'em, sometimes a pistol
RD_ALifeLine_1d791a2f2ffe57a9: Hardware stores go first, so try the lumber yards, the fence suppliers, the places nobody thinks about
RD_ALifeLine_59586fd105edba96: Pharmacies, doctors' offices, vet clinics, you'd be surprised what vets have...
RD_ALifeLine_677e32b7353ceda8: Nursing homes, if you can stomach it, they keep a lot of supplies, and a lot of other things
RD_ALifeLine_249b7255415f8057: Dental offices... they have lidocaine, they have sterile instruments, don't laugh, they do
RD_ALifeLine_411776eb085a20e6: Parish halls have kitchens, kitchens have flour, and flour has been my savior
RD_ALifeLine_2e7d4bb078dad54e: There's a food bank in the basement, but we've emptied it, check the neighboring parishes
RD_ALifeLine_2020d09d7be47905: Fire stations have first aid, flashlights, hoses, ropes, but we've stripped ours
RD_ALifeLine_6b8a0f531e915872: Schools have medical supplies, a nurse's office with bandages and ice packs
RD_ALifeLine_46c5a8024ec3c3de: Camping stores, hardware stores, check the back for the heavy stuff, tents, tarps, tools
RD_ALifeLine_368f2a4c3aeb5048: Armories, gun shops, pawn shops, hardware stores, all of them hit, but sometimes there's a safe
RD_ALifeLine_258ff1052ec5b44f: Check the sheds behind the farms, the old men kept their rifles there, and a lot of ammo
RD_ALifeLine_4e9a01fb775f19d4: Outbuildings, hunting cabins, tool sheds, that's where I'd start
RD_ALifeLine_07ddc8093424e855: Check around the back rooms first, you've been a friend, you deserve a break
RD_ALifeLine_6e2931c95cd1f187: There's a spot I've saved for someone I trust, and that someone is you
RD_ALifeLine_41aac5ff45fd085f: Here's a secret, I found a stash, I'll tell you where, but share it with me, deal?
RD_ALifeLine_4d07d56968c113ce: Try the stockroom behind a pharmacy, the back shelves, hardly touched
RD_ALifeLine_4c58b91a4fd34355: Try the hunting cabins up the ridge, nobody remembers them, there's canned goods and blankets
RD_ALifeLine_249dbdc3097605d5: The church basement on the far side of town, they stored a winter's worth, it's open to those who need it
RD_ALifeLine_0d8d7d983c9591eb: There's a farm with a root cellar, past the second bridge, the family left in a hurry, they won't mind
RD_ALifeLine_748d799320792ce5: The school nurse's office, bottom drawer, bandages and aspirin, I checked yesterday!
RD_ALifeLine_2beb21f65b2c7585: I found a case of soup in a garage, a couple of streets over, and I left half for the next person
RD_ALifeLine_3b552dc2608f4483: Check inside the feed store, behind the seed bags, there's a locked cabinet
RD_ALifeLine_4a0952f579d44212: Any tool shed out back of a house, rope, wire, a good axe, the owners don't need them now
RD_ALifeLine_3f33f3cc4dc7554e: Behind the barbershop, a storeroom, towels, soap, razors, candles
RD_ALifeLine_247a501a3ea83ad1: Find a house with a real pantry, I only took a little from mine, you take what you need
RD_ALifeLine_495f8dae3b16d097: The old gas station, in the back, a cooler of bottled water, still sealed
RD_ALifeLine_51ad13d872eb7beb: Check the junk drawers, I found matches and gum in one, you never know!
RD_ALifeLine_60d2e22411624a9b: I know a bakery with flour sacks stacked in the back, still dry, still good
RD_ALifeLine_3d1ba407440993a4: Take what you need from the shop on the corner, the owner told me before he left
RD_ALifeLine_7386a0a8530a18cf: Try the library basement, books burn, so there's wood, and cans from the staff kitchen!
RD_ALifeLine_3497e1996d5f9176: Don't forget the attics, people hide things in attics, I found a box of canned peaches!
RD_ALifeLine_1fd1099c625aeda9: The funeral home has a lot of supplies, tidy, locked, but I know a window
RD_ALifeLine_0ff6cf111aa30e8a: I can't promise it's full, but the old hardware store has some
RD_ALifeLine_671da18e0d6ece46: Hit the houses with the drawn blinds, nobody's been in!!
RD_ALifeLine_65a6e539669dccee: There's a little grocery out by the lake, I'd take it, but I can't carry it all
RD_ALifeLine_242fdfd94b1c4785: The VFW hall stocked up for a hunting dinner, forty pounds of beans in the pantry
RD_ALifeLine_4fd50327494d2248: Check the trailers behind the lot, they're easy to forget
RD_ALifeLine_38bf5bfe52241f12: A fire station's pantry is probably untouched, nobody thinks to look
RD_ALifeLine_704a19f21dd5104f: A bunch of canned goods in the basement of the old bank, don't ask how!
RD_ALifeLine_62dd0d2142755dbe: There's a cabin by the water, full of fishing gear, hooks, line, a net
RD_ALifeLine_1b28aa95490c6c1d: The dentist's office has surprisingly good first aid, the dentist was a tidy man
RD_ALifeLine_48407d155e8cc898: Try the car dealership's break room, snacks, coffee, a coat rack of jackets
RD_ALifeLine_7ab50f43521c380a: The old mill's storeroom, but only in daylight, and bring a friend
RD_ALifeLine_586f29ae2025821f: I keep a stash, you can borrow from it, just leave a note
RD_ALifeLine_4e20582d773d6ba6: There's a place I'm saving, just in case, for you, if you ever need it
RD_ALifeLine_11cc5a3100c2b658: If I KNEW a good spot, I'd keep it from you
RD_ALifeLine_6224e6404c292c56: Nothing, and don't ask me again
RD_ALifeLine_0678d0f7626ce248: I can't tell you a good place, I'd be afraid to send you somewhere I haven't checked
RD_ALifeLine_75d055256c9550f4: The houses on the end, but be quiet, be so quiet, please, I heard something in the last one
RD_ALifeLine_162f3a0d613bb28a: I found canned food in a basement once, I had to crawl over- never mind, I don't want to say
RD_ALifeLine_7a7511ea1b0bba7d: Anywhere... everywhere, nowhere, I don't know, I eat what I find, and I run
RD_ALifeLine_61f019762fe873c0: Wherever people lived and died quickly, they left the best behind
RD_ALifeLine_653a2b7620ab1e4c: Ignore the obvious places, the obvious places are bare, go for the odd ones
RD_ALifeLine_108433fb09e61117: A house with the curtains drawn and a bad smell, that's usually untouched
RD_ALifeLine_1011a1ad5d0935a0: My own house, the pantry, I couldn't bring myself to go back... but it's full... go ahead... take what you need
RD_ALifeLine_5c2817881e9db4e5: Missus Allen's kitchen, she kept so many jars... I think about them... I think about her
RD_ALifeLine_1bae469e22627aa1: They've picked it all clean, the vultures, every shelf, every drawer, every crumb
RD_ALifeLine_5a9c2a381f3bd5fe: Wherever you look, someone got there first, and left the mess, the bastards
RD_ALifeLine_0f9a592e7a01778a: I've got a map, I marked the good ones, copies are hard to come by, though
RD_ALifeLine_33375bde44b6e3ea: There's a place I saved for a friend, and I'd like it to be you
RD_ALifeLine_01e4800911d02e21: My secret spot? The back of my mother-in-law's closet, it's full of fruitcake, you're welcome
RD_ALifeLine_70b5f4a817d2795a: Oh, try anywhere that says "no trespassing," those are always the best!
RD_ALifeLine_5df199b95a1c27eb: Everywhere but the places you already looked
RD_ALifeLine_557009e116c04179: Find your own, don't follow me
RD_ALifeLine_077230787f4acc80: Not telling, those spots are MINE
RD_ALifeLine_2cf9c4f029f8e8c3: Pharmacies have been picked clean, but veterinary clinics, dental offices, school nurse stations, they're overlooked
RD_ALifeLine_1d1021ee4e32d4fe: Look for anything marked "first aid," any cabinet with a red cross, and don't skip the bathrooms
RD_ALifeLine_4dd5e1705db71471: Drugstores' back rooms... the shelves behind the pharmacist, people forget they're there
RD_ALifeLine_3cbe301d76e796f3: Nursing homes keep gloves, gowns, bleach, saline, if you can stomach the walk
RD_ALifeLine_43ef1fa545046637: School nurse offices, it ain't a hospital, but nobody's looted a school nurse
RD_ALifeLine_51b49a08577e5514: My supplies are for my patients, NOT for browsing
RD_ALifeLine_5ec0bbf676824fe6: I wouldn't tell you where to find a puddle!
RD_ALifeLine_0d7862b67a759848: Looting is what people like you do
RD_ALifeLine_49dc44a835f86c0f: Everything's been taken, probably by you
RD_ALifeLine_24346c5a4c19691e: Walk in circles, maybe you'll trip over something
RD_ALifeLine_3be7c7f4229df3b4: No supplies, no stash, no secrets, not for you
RD_ALifeLine_5c9429b4023f3666: Your reputation precedes you, and I'm not helping
RD_ALifeLine_26de90ff6476aec3: Go ahead and search, you'll find only disappointment
RD_ALifeLine_1279c2bb065bc8b8: I know where everything is, and I'm not saying
RD_ALifeLine_3ff76afe76826e4f: Would you share if I asked?
RD_ALifeLine_2e22f9f361d71e43: Go on, ask someone who trusts you
RD_ALifeLine_3bee55f4794c45e3: You'll NEVER get anything from me
RD_ALifeLine_37ffd3c65e438fcf: I'd rather burn it than give it to you
RD_ALifeLine_73b4571c09c00f44: Don't count on me to feed your habits
RD_ALifeLine_3cd4f3802b50fa3d: Help yourself, as you always do
RD_ALifeLine_643362406031618e: There's nothing left, and if there was, it's not for you
RD_ALifeLine_6a43d2d21c89e6c3: Go find your own, I did
RD_ALifeLine_34e8a7096e590c46: The only thing you'll get from me is directions to leave
RD_ALifeLine_5fc049e2054b8c61: You know what you've done, so don't ask!
RD_ALifeLine_435727e35b601730: I'm NOT a charity, and you're not a cause
RD_ALifeLine_7a344e1f619563d2: Ha! Look who needs a favor
RD_ALifeLine_70d17f45180f8b1d: Loot? Are you kidding? with THOSE out there
RD_ALifeLine_73963436659d1837: Not now, not now, later, when it's safe
RD_ALifeLine_748a3b3d04ffa91c: Anywhere but HERE, here is no good!
RD_ALifeLine_5289c3176b1a4d4e: If you can't see the dead... search THERE, but not now
RD_ALifeLine_43ed626244a1ef62: Hush, hush, they're close, we can search in a minute
RD_ALifeLine_154e52ce6197f002: Right now the only loot is your life... don't lose it!
RD_ALifeLine_21f3b2c570a9be6f: With that, you can clear a house, then search it, one room at a time...
RD_ALifeLine_33d3f7fe06c2843d: Try the places people wouldn't think to check
RD_ALifeLine_571feadb54e81942: The houses with a lot of kids' bikes in the yard
RD_ALifeLine_7c281ae174a9af27: Look for the ones that already look picked over
RD_ALifeLine_79153869367bdbcf: Anywhere with a lot of pets
RD_ALifeLine_164247ae6bffc57b: Under the porch, behind the lattice
RD_ALifeLine_5e291369637ce241: Wherever the last one was empty
RD_ALifeLine_2d1d6d6722108b67: I'll share a trick: go during the day, go slow, and go with a friend
RD_ALifeLine_2a5bec5f70630599: I'll tell you my secret place, once you promise to share the finds
RD_ALifeLine_1d2bb91c33034a17: Why should I tell you where I find things
RD_ALifeLine_419246d657fa02e7: If I told you, I'd have competition
RD_ALifeLine_24449b934925eabd: Why would I tell a stranger
RD_ALifeLine_0ce4960d72834cd2: Hardware stores, but go to the back room
RD_ALifeLine_74f1628035ad2960: The church kitchen, the Sunday school, the pastor's study
RD_ALifeLine_3a972a617b9e4adf: A garage with a chest freezer, folks froze more than they ever ate
RD_ALifeLine_5dcc41261ba4408e: Where to find supplies? Wherever I haven't been yet, and I've been most places
RD_ALifeLine_564fd0ae7639593a: I could tell you, but then I'd have to compete with you, and I hate competition
RD_ALifeLine_54e60b2041299615: Try the houses off the main roads, nobody checks the bedrooms, the good stuff's in the bedrooms
RD_ALifeLine_7b7cb79655aa378c: Houses with the curtains still drawn, the ones nobody's touched, that's where the cans are
RD_ALifeLine_0395aa6848b3ff5a: Pantries, kid, check the pantries, and the garage freezer if it still has ice
RD_ALifeLine_3b09d503446e93c4: Supplies?! You're standing in front of the best supply source in the county, take a guess!
RD_ALifeLine_28cc2ac47be7062c: One spot, a farmhouse past the creek, and you didn't hear it from me
RD_ALifeLine_368ce8902d852764: Try the places that look too sad to check, a kid's room, a nursery, I hate it, but that's where the juice boxes are
RD_ALifeLine_51f0c7f303181da8: Check the corner stores first, then the apartments above them, people stash food there
RD_ALifeLine_599eedda2f4d86c4: Try the basements, always the basements, nobody thinks to look down
RD_ALifeLine_146889ba055b9e2a: Back of the barber shop, the old man kept a pantry, last I checked it was still full
RD_ALifeLine_2a514a7c51c5d9e5: You want supplies? Take 'em from the ones that have 'em, like me, if you can!
RD_ALifeLine_17f777eb3aa9e5d2: There's a church couple blocks over with a storeroom, the pastor's cool, ask him nice
RD_ALifeLine_4437046a4a80504b: Garages for tools, kitchens for food, bathrooms for pills, same as always
RD_ALifeLine_568387620b6f12a8: Farm stands on the county road, people left whole crates of canned stuff
RD_ALifeLine_42f5886b68e5046c: Why would I tell you? So you can beat me to it?
RD_ALifeLine_3f52a0166b848965: Information of that kind has a market value, I'd be a fool to give it away
RD_ALifeLine_564667262cc655de: There are caches, I know of three, none of them are free to reveal
RD_ALifeLine_2b6f305e68b9b415: The best supplies are always in places the average man does not think to look
RD_ALifeLine_16d98b0f6e5b925d: I may know a location or two, for a fair trade
RD_ALifeLine_2f99d9d4767a19ef: Don't ask me that, I'll tell you wrong, I get lost, I only know my own hiding spots
RD_ALifeLine_3ff89417213c8ebe: Everything's empty, I've been through half the houses on this road, nothing, nothing
RD_ALifeLine_02573d634c0df35e: Try the kitchens, I guess, but wear gloves, some of them aren't empty
RD_ALifeLine_6ef99ac2702a16b4: No! Don't ask me for anything! I need it all!
RD_ALifeLine_1ff063b81a8de116: There was a house with a root cellar, jars of peaches, I almost cried
RD_ALifeLine_4dccab8e5ca6cfbb: Barns, sheds, root cellars, the places nobody breaks into because nobody thinks of them
RD_ALifeLine_6b68aecf597444d5: Old hunting cabins have canned goods, a stove, sometimes a rifle, if you're lucky
RD_ALifeLine_53748ee54ac3d6ca: Chimneys with smoke- no, wait, don't, that's people, go for the dark ones
RD_ALifeLine_404521d12cf8e0a5: There's a cabin up the ridge, some canned stuff in the floorboards, I'll draw you a map
RD_ALifeLine_213eb4b34bb2e937: Check with the courthouse, they're keeping a list of cleared buildings
RD_ALifeLine_5bed7cbf459a05b3: I can't recommend specific locations, but houses off the main road are less likely to be picked clean
RD_ALifeLine_115bc3d27274196d: Pharmacies and groceries were hit first, try churches and schools, they keep emergency stores
RD_ALifeLine_6cdde8141f1691f0: Don't turn uncertainty into permission to break into somebody's home
RD_ALifeLine_11f2459c7802b612: Looting is a crime, I'm not going to help you commit one
RD_ALifeLine_1f5eee143990ed16: There's a supply drop we've been using, I'll tell you where if you share what you find
RD_ALifeLine_277acd6045f0b182: All supplies are being collected for distribution, report to the staging area
RD_ALifeLine_542810d4417dd156: Looting is prohibited, any necessary supplies will be provided through official channels
RD_ALifeLine_68bc125b0f5a5967: Schools and churches are on the survey list, don't enter those without authorization
RD_ALifeLine_0d75fc7c2f89adf6: There's a ration point at the base, if you can get there
RD_ALifeLine_4fb296b848225a2d: I don't know, I never get to go on supply runs, they say I'm too jumpy
RD_ALifeLine_13609a7b03986744: Farms, mostly, folks who left their larders full, but ask first, someone might still be home
RD_ALifeLine_7cb9cf4d1b917860: Feed stores, silos, we've already cleaned out the ones near us
RD_ALifeLine_394acabe43b1235e: Come to our barn, we'll share what we have, it's not much but it's honest
RD_ALifeLine_1e04a8b917193c98: I can't point you to a place I know is stocked, I haven't checked
RD_ALifeLine_2c34cc01629f3d5d: Even if I knew, I wouldn't hand a stranger a shopping list
RD_ALifeLine_2618ea450f6256b1: Keep looking, somewhere that isn't next to me
RD_ALifeLine_4b978e9f3c1f3a5d: I'm still thinking in terms of buying groceries, stupid, isn't it?
RD_ALifeLine_27abcfde2841dca1: No verified supply point to report
RD_ALifeLine_7686ad530c917322: A place being quiet doesn't tell you whether anybody needs what's inside
RD_ALifeLine_1cc1fdb50f85b787: Everybody remembers the hardware store, that's the trouble with obvious ideas
RD_ALifeLine_281cc8e438e003be: I'd be suspicious of anybody giving away a supposedly untouched place
RD_ALifeLine_315d228a5314b3ec: Free directions usually mean somebody else gets to do the dangerous part
RD_ALifeLine_586b99de2caa4ee9: Church pantries, nobody thinks of a church pantry and every one of 'em had one
RD_ALifeLine_4e94caa25b05dd0a: Not the grocery, everybody did the grocery on the fifth, try the little places
RD_ALifeLine_56e21ea01fe5fc8b: Try the fellowship halls, a cold cellar keeps canned goods longer than you'd think
RD_ALifeLine_07f49033099fdc37: Laundromats, sounds dumb, soap, a pop machine, and nobody's been in one since
RD_ALifeLine_2665211c2c306bfa: Old folks keep a deep pantry, check houses with a ramp built onto the porch
RD_ALifeLine_781e5d014ffc42c6: I can't send you into a house, I will say the county garage had a pop machine
RD_ALifeLine_6425089966e323f2: You're asking a sheriff where to steal, I'll pretend that part came out garbled
RD_ALifeLine_32a4598a62644350: Resupply points are gone, try small places nobody ever wrote on a list
RD_ALifeLine_6296ae36234080a9: Anywhere with one door and no sign, big signs pull big crowds
RD_ALifeLine_1d9ec9de4831df71: Bait shops, crackers, jerky, gas cans, and no line at the counter, you're welcome
RD_ALifeLine_392d067425b5a717: Storage units, folks put a year of their life in a metal box and paid by the month
RD_ALifeLine_06844ece55ca48e3: I sell locations, first one's free since you look broke, check behind pharmacies
RD_ALifeLine_0e692bc747a9ea49: Loading docks, half a truck never gets unloaded and nobody remembers the truck
RD_ALifeLine_1298ca3247a63345: Any gate with a deer camp sign on it, hunters stock a cabin like a bunker
RD_ALifeLine_3d3cd36579740f76: I don't know, I really don't, I've been eating out the same cupboard a week
RD_ALifeLine_364f140815086c7e: I'm not giving directions to a break-in, Creek water's free, though
RD_ALifeLine_674458393726647f: No, a place I name turns into a crowd, and a crowd turns into my problem
RD_ALifeLine_29d441230672c61e: Not the roads with the cordon on them, everything else is fair, and I'd hurry
RD_ALifeLine_401e80da2e2b3cb9: We've cleared everything inside two miles, go further out, and not back through us
RD_ALifeLine_63ced6ed1d282261: I've had little luck looking, doesn't mean you'll find nothing, but don't count on a place being stocked
RD_ALifeLine_09ede36d66b3f819: Sure, I'll tell you a good spot, stand right there and I'll draw you a map, Ha
RD_ALifeLine_1dcd328b73241f27: Everything worth having on this block is already ours, move along
RD_ALifeLine_4479f44b4737800f: I'll tell you where I've been, go see what I left, which is nothing
RD_ALifeLine_78b5f87b19adff3f: Find your own, I ain't your parole officer
RD_ALifeLine_3f30d0b76ddfff04: Why don't you go look? That's what I've been doing, on foot, in this heat
RD_ALifeLine_7bb3ee565c405c86: Last two people I gave a spot to went and brought friends, so I'm done with that
RD_ALifeLine_3261f66e572715fd: They set up at the high school and left again, we watched them drive away
RD_ALifeLine_257addfb09d59ab5: I don't know, they were supposed to come, my husband waits for them every morning
RD_ALifeLine_4c68f7f13691cfb3: Boys in trucks went through two days ago, never stopped to say a word
RD_ALifeLine_5d4e80096eefd41e: In my day, the Army came when you called, not anymore
RD_ALifeLine_45e97cd142b40823: The Guard set up a roadblock, then they left, left all their gear in the road
RD_ALifeLine_0e8bb76a3387e3d3: I saw helicopters Friday, nothing since
RD_ALifeLine_497258957ae9d00d: Saw a convoy heading north, never saw it come back
RD_ALifeLine_4eb162344d7586a5: Trucks rolled past the plant Sunday, they didn't wave
RD_ALifeLine_4b4155740b9b4426: Soldiers at the interstate told us to turn around, then they were gone
RD_ALifeLine_02ec22f403aa919a: National Guard came to the station, took our trucks, haven't seen them since
RD_ALifeLine_1fcd49f62b717fda: A major told us they'd send supplies, that was the sixth, I'm still waiting
RD_ALifeLine_34d1da807cb53b88: They blessed the cordon and then sealed it, I don't understand what was blessed
RD_ALifeLine_279ec8ff240991e2: Guard unit came through Saturday, told us to hold, then they went east
RD_ALifeLine_00a28bd25d5343af: Dispatch says they're regrouping at Fort Knox, that's all I know
RD_ALifeLine_70666ed0194b5aab: They promised support, I got a single truck with two cases of MREs
RD_ALifeLine_3495df53680eb48e: A colonel told me the situation was contained, that was Saturday, look around
RD_ALifeLine_669e70555861dfc9: I saw their checkpoint on the interstate, they told us to turn around or be arrested
RD_ALifeLine_3b22f5d806c0396d: Guard unit reinforced the prison for two days, then they left, and so did my faith
RD_ALifeLine_001dd1652d0a54f6: We tried coordinating with them, they sent a lieutenant and a map, that was it
RD_ALifeLine_10c1efd9134e876d: I'm not allowed to talk about unit movements
RD_ALifeLine_0a4ab4926d587c1b: Command hasn't updated us in days, maybe they've forgotten
RD_ALifeLine_3c90d4d96190ecb4: We've lost contact with battalion, that's all I can say
RD_ALifeLine_6245a0d14a093ff2: Half the unit walked away, the other half is me
RD_ALifeLine_674cc37d70d494d9: The Army's gone, or it's busy shooting people, same thing
RD_ALifeLine_0f8cf72f52f9c2af: They'll tell you they're here to help, they're here to hold a line, not the same
RD_ALifeLine_037867c3539af78a: Soldiers shoot on sight at the checkpoints, be careful
RD_ALifeLine_53e1b7bf6b3bb241: Never trusted the Army, never will
RD_ALifeLine_3dcee3e36563c9b1: Army's busy, their loss is our gain
RD_ALifeLine_5abd9c25743884ac: Soldiers got guns and orders, we got numbers and nothing to lose
RD_ALifeLine_5033a2f53575e6fe: Hit a roadblock outside Radcliff, turned around fast
RD_ALifeLine_7266d4db5716a107: The government has other concerns, so do I
RD_ALifeLine_4bd9f8be554b0c02: The guard towers were empty when we left, that should tell you something
RD_ALifeLine_24610e8864fcc8a8: The Guard is coming, they have to be coming, it's their job, it's literally their job
RD_ALifeLine_5af0c4eb1a54515d: They set up a line on the highway... I saw the trucks, I saw the guys in green, they're going to fix this
RD_ALifeLine_4504d7ac1fd40fa6: Maybe they're regrouping... maybe they're planning, I tell myself that every night
RD_ALifeLine_6f4002696878a313: They closed the roads, that's what I know, so they KNOW, so somebody's doing SOMETHING
RD_ALifeLine_406404d306de14af: They stopped answering, the line went quiet, and I think they ran, I think they just- ran
RD_ALifeLine_295465d572cb1b59: I saw a convoy go north... and it never came back, and I don't know what that means, do you?
RD_ALifeLine_67be0ec17760aeb6: They told us to stay put, so we stayed, and now there's nobody left to tell us anything else
RD_ALifeLine_181e0deb4bacfa31: Maybe they're waiting for orders, maybe the orders never came, maybe they're dead
RD_ALifeLine_48526bc04755615e: Gone, I'd say, gone or dead, there hasn't been a soldier on the road in weeks
RD_ALifeLine_0c0ade542eab2b97: Heard they pulled out the same day it got bad, left their equipment behind, even some of their dead
RD_ALifeLine_3355c69431b5ca3d: If they were coming, they'd be here, so stop hoping, I stopped, it helps
RD_ALifeLine_7933713d431a1422: I saw a helicopter once, high, heading away, never saw another
RD_ALifeLine_61cd08ab4c58bcf2: The army left us the same way it left Louisville, with a handshake and a lie
RD_ALifeLine_6a00ac9a557587f4: I hope they come, I do, and when they do, I'll be the first to buy them a drink
RD_ALifeLine_7a383e6d16330078: Waiting on them, same as you, and I hate every minute of it
RD_ALifeLine_6d1d1162175934f1: Don't talk to me about the army
RD_ALifeLine_048a420f523b33ac: Why do you ask? you one of them?
RD_ALifeLine_31d4953708604a05: They left us, and I don't forgive that
RD_ALifeLine_70f570197c8fde28: Army's like weather, it comes or it doesn't, I don't plan around either
RD_ALifeLine_07a8f794117cc844: Seen 'em at the bridge, seen 'em pull out, seen 'em shoot at their own, I steer clear
RD_ALifeLine_4eddf23773564aca: Soldiers are men, men get scared, scared men with guns are the worst thing out here
RD_ALifeLine_22ddfbaa02c28f39: Heard a few stayed behind, set up shop at the base, I wouldn't go near
RD_ALifeLine_65df5e246960387f: We keep hoping, the kids ask every morning, "are the soldiers here yet?" and I say soon, and I feel like a liar
RD_ALifeLine_6118414e789c1b61: My brother's in the Guard, he's out there somewhere, and I don't want to think about what he's seen
RD_ALifeLine_23dfddea4e03685d: The army told us to evacuate, and then the army blocked the road, tell me how that makes sense
RD_ALifeLine_36ec14e23f858762: My boy was in the Gulf, honey, I know soldiers, and they would've come if they could
RD_ALifeLine_141584f7030996d4: They'd never leave their own, never, so if they're not here, something worse than this happened
RD_ALifeLine_424d3f730bbca885: I served in Korea, nursing, and I know what a retreat looks like, this was a retreat
RD_ALifeLine_1a72128a62514d5a: I mean, they're the Army, they have tanks and stuff, right? why aren't there tanks
RD_ALifeLine_78a0822d77109136: My cousin's in the National Guard, he called me, before the phones went out, said they were pulling back
RD_ALifeLine_7a4357c909ea7316: Soldiers shot at a car full of people at the checkpoint, I saw it from the hill, so, like, I'm not sure I want them
RD_ALifeLine_75f354320ee0b189: They're saving their own skin, same as everybody, who can blame 'em
RD_ALifeLine_7b5e42c93d1094db: Unit stopped at the plant, took our trucks, said it was for the war effort, and left us with nothing
RD_ALifeLine_3b72aa8705e009b7: Guard wouldn't let us through the line, called us contaminated, I'm not contaminated, I'm tired
RD_ALifeLine_0d2086ba3871c36c: I treated a soldier who'd been shot by his own sergeant for trying to desert... so I don't trust the ones who stayed
RD_ALifeLine_1e88e6c0296034d2: They need medics worse than they need rifles, and none of them thought to bring any
RD_ALifeLine_02ce0f6820b9b9b5: The Army's got a protocol for everything, but this wasn't in the manual
RD_ALifeLine_3e9cc14c007687b5: They're just boys in uniforms, scared ones, and I pray for every one, even the ones who frighten me
RD_ALifeLine_56cd16932e42d3fb: A boy in uniform came to the church for confession, three days ago, he was nineteen, and his hands wouldn't stop shaking
RD_ALifeLine_76d7910717cfe85e: They commandeered our trucks on day two, and promised to return them, I'm still waiting
RD_ALifeLine_5dafd94a0aca9cbd: Their medics and ours worked side by side for a day, then they left without a word
RD_ALifeLine_67564fc1704bec65: We're what's left, the locals, the volunteers, we hold the line because the real line is gone
RD_ALifeLine_6383030e1f05c9da: Active duty pulled out, no orders, no relief, I heard a few officers shot themselves instead of going back
RD_ALifeLine_19acf601417540c5: If you see a soldier, treat him like a rattlesnake, he's scared, he's armed, and he's got nowhere to go
RD_ALifeLine_655f4bdb382733ea: I can tell you what I know, which isn't pretty, but you deserve to hear it from someone who's not lying!!
RD_ALifeLine_3aabe5aa3a0a00a9: Far as I can tell they've left the whole county, I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_16de4538304bb3b5: I'd trust you with this: I think they abandoned us, and I think it was a decision
RD_ALifeLine_2ad845cf70472bca: They're not coming, friend, and I wish I had better news, but I won't lie!!
RD_ALifeLine_0bc83a550e028ceb: Last I saw, a convoy headed north, with the headlights off, and not one soldier waved
RD_ALifeLine_4cb0046f07ebdf7d: I know a man who was on the line, he says they got orders to hold, then orders to leave!!
RD_ALifeLine_13afc9f97670bcf3: Maybe some of them are still out there, doing right, some of them were decent
RD_ALifeLine_1cf03ca21e03ee05: I talked to a private once, scared, young, he wanted to go home as badly as I do!
RD_ALifeLine_1f0ba31d6306edca: The Guard set up a perimeter, then folded it up in the night, and nobody left a note
RD_ALifeLine_38912cd23be4f1d3: Honestly? I think they're as lost as we are
RD_ALifeLine_21bb0a5f17c86478: There are a few left, scattered, guarding something, but I don't know what
RD_ALifeLine_6cd3042935497e49: I wouldn't count on them, but I wouldn't count them out, either
RD_ALifeLine_7f40a51f292db648: They used to wave at us from the trucks, those boys, now there's nothing
RD_ALifeLine_523d5fac7826b920: I heard they quarantined the whole county, and then forgot to let us know!
RD_ALifeLine_62d6afa85c3b0f08: A sergeant told me once, "we're doing all we can," and I believed him
RD_ALifeLine_1b1e044c6c5c6290: They came, they went, they left behind a lot of empty promises
RD_ALifeLine_1e71dc5607c5717e: I hope some of them make it home, I do, they're someone's kids!
RD_ALifeLine_66e54dff0fe66a9c: It's hard to say, it's hard to know, I try not to hate them
RD_ALifeLine_2ca0e4926794f327: Rumor is they've gathered at the base, waiting for orders that never come
RD_ALifeLine_66141f6228f4684f: Whatever they were supposed to do, they didn't, and we paid for it
RD_ALifeLine_781edede0382f0d7: I saw one crying in a doorway, rifle on the floor, and I didn't know what to say!!
RD_ALifeLine_10cac6ae53ac426a: You'd think they'd have a plan, a map, a rescue, but, no
RD_ALifeLine_1fb5c1396bdeaff8: We shared water with a squad once, they were kind, and then they vanished!
RD_ALifeLine_6d797abd7d4fd58c: The military's like the weather, you can't count on it
RD_ALifeLine_25ed9dcd49bccb4f: I pray for them, even though they didn't pray for us
RD_ALifeLine_1c6610ea21d607ff: There's good and bad in every uniform
RD_ALifeLine_042d4be230eeb5ea: They're out there, I believe that, somewhere, doing something
RD_ALifeLine_66a864603c121049: It's a mystery, and I don't like mysteries
RD_ALifeLine_6b537b6752115930: All I know is the hum of engines has stopped
RD_ALifeLine_13286be35ae22912: I'd salute them, if I could find one
RD_ALifeLine_648b41e32cf6b6e0: The last one I met told me to keep my head down, and he was right
RD_ALifeLine_72b771a9190aa167: They're as scared as we are, I'm sure of it
RD_ALifeLine_581baed740e3d72c: Why should I tell you anything about the army? you're not on my side
RD_ALifeLine_23c85a1941e908a4: Please don't say they're gone, please, they have to be coming, they HAVE to be
RD_ALifeLine_0eb5d82833c3bcd2: I saw them leave, I saw the trucks go, I stood in the road and waved like an idiot
RD_ALifeLine_3238b1e1523cfcf3: They shot at us, at the barrier, they shot first and asked nothing, I'm scared of them now
RD_ALifeLine_0b54ce1c3bd9b952: The army? I don't know, I don't know, I just want somebody, ANYBODY, to take charge
RD_ALifeLine_3975292c0ebf0e01: Gone, I'd say, gone or dead or hiding, either way, they're not coming
RD_ALifeLine_161871fb08ec0976: The army knows how to win wars, not how to fix this, and they're out of their depth
RD_ALifeLine_68529d4f62d2ad5e: Last I saw them, they were burning something in a pit, I turned and walked away
RD_ALifeLine_383935e262ba1ef0: Don't count on them, count on whoever's standing next to you
RD_ALifeLine_0a9dd01316a11613: My son's in the Guard, I don't know where, I don't know if... I don't know
RD_ALifeLine_6408c91d5da14be0: There was a boy in a uniform... he couldn't have been twenty... he cried when he told us to turn back
RD_ALifeLine_7f3f13b06a654bef: The army ABANDONED us, I will say it to anyone, I'll say it to their faces
RD_ALifeLine_71ce9fd21087d374: They locked the roads, they locked us in, and then they left, and I will never forgive that
RD_ALifeLine_22f4f498410c5317: Soldiers, my ass, they ran at the first sign of trouble, and called it a strategic retreat!
RD_ALifeLine_70be2273161110af: I like to think some of them are still out there, helping, saving, doing right
RD_ALifeLine_379a530b3baab84f: I've met a few decent soldiers, they gave my daughter a candy bar, I haven't forgotten
RD_ALifeLine_524bd7d557fc6338: The army? Oh, they're on a very long coffee break, a very, very long one
RD_ALifeLine_4d5da932677d5dad: They said they'd be here in an hour, they're only a week late, give 'em time
RD_ALifeLine_3f009a8219b18c5d: The Army? They're on lunch break
RD_ALifeLine_5044c621654de584: Every time I see a soldier... I salute
RD_ALifeLine_6437be465460e259: I don't trust soldiers, I don't trust you, and I don't trust the news
RD_ALifeLine_1b0013272a32a4dc: Soldiers? They shoot first, I'd STAY clear!
RD_ALifeLine_1e889121700adc2c: The Guard brought us three soldiers with bites, said "treat them," and then they never came back
RD_ALifeLine_02f2b0366265c04c: They took our supply truck on day two, said it was for the cause, I'm still waiting for the cause
RD_ALifeLine_59e626407c37f8eb: A medic from the Army stood next to me for an hour, then got a call, and left, and I haven't seen him
RD_ALifeLine_7fa177033aacddcc: Their field hospital is a rumor, I've heard it a hundred times, never met a patient who'd seen it
RD_ALifeLine_10328dd65a5c84cf: I don't discuss who I've treated, or which uniform they wore
RD_ALifeLine_2f57f4b63f868b9f: The army would arrest you on sight, I bet
RD_ALifeLine_47c761ef17629624: Why would I tell you anything about soldiers
RD_ALifeLine_232e586c210384a7: Ask them yourself, if you can find one that doesn't shoot you!
RD_ALifeLine_63d7c6ea2fa6930d: Soldiers have NO use for people like you
RD_ALifeLine_6696a329105d1822: They'd love to meet you, I'm sure
RD_ALifeLine_605dc2033dd092df: They're not on your side, I assure you
RD_ALifeLine_281fecb9028d5572: You want to know about soldiers? Ask your victims!
RD_ALifeLine_5ab98c1e1a017be8: You can't HIDE from them forever!
RD_ALifeLine_768cc46007ca2068: Don't mention the military to me!
RD_ALifeLine_27878f18767d12eb: If the Army knew what you'd done, they'd come running!
RD_ALifeLine_67cd7fbd4009ea97: That's classified, and I won't be sharing it with you
RD_ALifeLine_75da18f87034d6c1: The army can't help you, and neither can I!
RD_ALifeLine_0525e3ed628d1c1c: I wouldn't tell you where they are if I knew
RD_ALifeLine_68fd07937c2432be: Go ask a soldier, and see how it goes
RD_ALifeLine_1512484967cd2da2: They're not coming for you, and that's a shame
RD_ALifeLine_5646bdac6ee64a70: Why? are you running from them?
RD_ALifeLine_4a4fae453091e26b: Soldiers? Gone... good riddance to everybody
RD_ALifeLine_061646984c3ae441: I'd rather you didn't find them
RD_ALifeLine_164b04112988b5c6: Don't look to me for introductions
RD_ALifeLine_2baab0886915896f: Stay off the roads where they patrol!
RD_ALifeLine_1f3e8f9c7ea1c91c: You and the army would not get along
RD_ALifeLine_00b0c2b8505a24f1: They aren't your friends, and neither am I
RD_ALifeLine_5e14653f3a9a38d4: Keep it to yourself, and keep your questions to yourself
RD_ALifeLine_2452114f33ad4647: Find a recruiter, and ask him
RD_ALifeLine_3aeb4b1e797fd181: Forget the army, nobody is coming for you
RD_ALifeLine_44d467f37575af92: I won't talk about them with you
RD_ALifeLine_5987221169ea92bd: You make me nervous, so, NO
RD_ALifeLine_30e5c76925eeb6b6: Where's the army when you need them, right? RIGHT NOW!
RD_ALifeLine_4e8254e116c2d3bf: They're not coming, look, look at what's here
RD_ALifeLine_317663285734d8a3: The army? Pfft, there's no army, there's us
RD_ALifeLine_56a008757b3d7504: If the army were here... they'd be shooting by now
RD_ALifeLine_1a98eeec7669edca: N-no time, no time, defend yourself!!
RD_ALifeLine_542147fe1f8224f4: You look like army, with that, are you? you could be
RD_ALifeLine_3cc85535594de4f5: A soldier gave me a bottle of water at a checkpoint
RD_ALifeLine_1866272f3f4abe40: Half of them are just kids
RD_ALifeLine_0301cbd04996c21b: I heard they closed the whole county
RD_ALifeLine_523daef912daa3b4: A sergeant told me, "Ma'am, go home"
RD_ALifeLine_77a89f5a38bd06f8: They shot at a car at the roadblock
RD_ALifeLine_5bf9fb0d55c5df74: The Guard used to march in parades
RD_ALifeLine_2809c4e8169ea23d: I think most of them are dead
RD_ALifeLine_45a6e6824a5ad209: They're out there... somewhere, I'm sure of it
RD_ALifeLine_4710dda50d63ccab: I like to think they'll come back for us
RD_ALifeLine_3deebee8208ddcfb: Why are you asking about the Army? You one of them? Keep your hands out where I can see them
RD_ALifeLine_075810c368df3b32: They came through in trucks, then they went through the other way
RD_ALifeLine_33c30155728c7503: I stay out of the army's business
RD_ALifeLine_15d7c86069cce08b: Soldiers walk loud and shoot quick
RD_ALifeLine_0d51ebf03eab944a: Soldiers aren't my concern, and neither are you
RD_ALifeLine_739743080fe64d8a: I served in the war, I'll have you know, nursing
RD_ALifeLine_729a7e0e43da68e2: Soldiers are boys... dear, and boys get frightened...
RD_ALifeLine_4cc55f5e04d731ac: They set up a camp near the church
RD_ALifeLine_49b9186838318a46: Okay, so, my cousin's in the Guard, and he said they got orders to leave
RD_ALifeLine_6cc492d11da9ea92: The soldiers at the checkpoint were super scared
RD_ALifeLine_63a8c3486bae92ed: The Guard closed the plant gate and put a soldier on it
RD_ALifeLine_555beb11308bca86: I drove a delivery truck for the Army once
RD_ALifeLine_35eef39e11c8676d: They took our fuel on the third day
RD_ALifeLine_4a9bbdb564bdfd2f: A soldier let us through a barricade with the kids in the back
RD_ALifeLine_75eb069520b20cce: They told us to wait for evacuation
RD_ALifeLine_0993f63f55f9b02f: I counsel the soldiers, when they come
RD_ALifeLine_208a714e316bed2c: A lieutenant sat in my pew and wept
RD_ALifeLine_565431aa375b008f: I pray for them, as I pray for you!!
RD_ALifeLine_3c72006e0b3a9872: We worked beside the Guard on the second day
RD_ALifeLine_32c248277465c8e0: They took our hoses, said they'd return them
RD_ALifeLine_4830a1f136ac57ae: They gave us radios and a phone number
RD_ALifeLine_4d6d43b30cbd556c: They'll be here any minute, I'm sure of it, any minute now
RD_ALifeLine_4c7936285d45cf53: The Guard was on the highway yesterday, I saw the trucks
RD_ALifeLine_643b04b73c500c72: A week and no sign of them
RD_ALifeLine_6251014925bb95f0: They stopped coming past the checkpoint, I guess they're regrouping
RD_ALifeLine_79c212d14a8eea8b: They're not coming, we all know it
RD_ALifeLine_63939e655a9f5cbb: After all this time, I don't even hope anymore
RD_ALifeLine_197433605ec5a306: The Army? They sealed the county and left us in here, so no, I'm not holding my breath
RD_ALifeLine_2031c1de5d53621f: A soldier shot a neighbor of mine and the guy wasn't even sick, so don't ask me for a good word about them
RD_ALifeLine_69df3cb11edf30a8: They're out there, sure, parked at the line, but they sure as hell aren't coming to help
RD_ALifeLine_28bc378618b73027: The Army has its own mess to clean up, we're just the leftovers
RD_ALifeLine_22382107587dcf77: I saw a convoy rolling north on the second day, packed with gear, no stopping, no waving, nothing
RD_ALifeLine_7a772b46266e1512: Soldiers are the only ones with bigger guns than me, so I stay out of their way and they stay out of mine
RD_ALifeLine_2b664f997b601250: Boys in uniform stand at the roadblocks and shoot anybody who looks sick, and half the time they're wrong
RD_ALifeLine_34d2a50f58041141: They'll be back to clean up when it's convenient for them, and I'll be long gone by then
RD_ALifeLine_208448215d5c423c: You want the Army? Wave at them from the ground
RD_ALifeLine_4f5252aa6b6c5b90: You with them? You better not be, because I got something special for soldiers
RD_ALifeLine_5f14ba8b017a2c1d: I keep hoping a convoy rolls in with food and medicine, you know? Dumb, but I keep hoping
RD_ALifeLine_675e2c6323920030: Honestly I'd turn myself over to the Army in a second if they promised me a bed and a hot meal
RD_ALifeLine_3bcce2aa05a08374: Army's at the checkpoints, shooting anybody who looks sick, that's what I heard, anyway
RD_ALifeLine_0bb092aa656df4a4: They sealed the roads and bounced, that's the Army for you
RD_ALifeLine_3c2d6fdc44d0a330: Man, the Guard came through our neighborhood on day two, kicked in doors, took whatever they wanted
RD_ALifeLine_1fe6dd314962729d: My cousin's in the Guard, ain't heard from him since Friday, I'm real worried
RD_ALifeLine_611a91845a6f29c1: They don't care about us, they protect the rich side of Louisville first
RD_ALifeLine_36da3c51051a82e9: Army can kiss my ass, they're no help to anybody
RD_ALifeLine_7e568ee97457671b: I heard they're setting up a camp up north, maybe that's good news, maybe it's a trap, I don't know
RD_ALifeLine_573b63c229e6a219: They came through two days ago, shot at us, then left, so no, I don't trust 'em
RD_ALifeLine_5c8710f318d2004d: Saw a whole squad driving the wrong direction, away from the base, nobody looked happy
RD_ALifeLine_6e2a163338e3c04d: Don't trust them, they're protecting themselves, not us
RD_ALifeLine_661a887d23ecabe6: I did four years in the service, so I know exactly how little they care about civilians
RD_ALifeLine_39da111e748701c0: Army's the enemy, and so are you if you're with them
RD_ALifeLine_770d15aa4e1f55d9: The military are following orders, none of which benefit us
RD_ALifeLine_3684cf174a2444a2: They are inconsistent, to put it mildly, one day a checkpoint, the next day nothing
RD_ALifeLine_67c1c9037ac0c4d1: I do business with soldiers when I can, they are always more reasonable than their officers
RD_ALifeLine_7d175a73492034ec: They want the county sealed, but I notice they don't want to come inside and see why
RD_ALifeLine_33c23fb223ad7bee: I wish I knew what they were planning, for all our sakes
RD_ALifeLine_00f3a50c0728f509: Army came to the prison, took some guards, left the rest of us locked in until the dead broke the doors
RD_ALifeLine_5134b9385bf98ea4: They shot at us when we ran, I'm not going near them ever again
RD_ALifeLine_7ac3d91e319c0cab: Soldiers don't care who you are, convict or not, they'll shoot first
RD_ALifeLine_2d84f5fa0ebf1708: Army, cops, they're all the same! They'd send me right back!
RD_ALifeLine_3871a33a64992cec: If they offered me food I'd probably surrender, honestly
RD_ALifeLine_6994461e1ef96780: They set up roadblocks, then abandoned them, I don't know what to think
RD_ALifeLine_3efe95e91a3d901b: Saw a convoy the other day, kept going, didn't stop for anybody
RD_ALifeLine_783ccea91db5fd9c: Fort Knox is right there, how do they not know what's going on? Or do they
RD_ALifeLine_0148ca786cb982d9: I figure the Army is waiting for us all to die so they can clean it up quietly
RD_ALifeLine_705350cf518716f6: They'll come, friend, they always do eventually, it's just a matter of how long we hold on
RD_ALifeLine_34829b261040cac9: I can't-- I just can't talk about that, please
RD_ALifeLine_66ae1afe67054558: They told us to keep civilians in, not to let anyone out, I didn't like it
RD_ALifeLine_1a881cce34e686a0: Leave the Army out of this, you hear me? I'll shoot you if you tell them I'm here!
RD_ALifeLine_7842ae2b4e518ad9: We've had limited contact with the Guard, nothing official
RD_ALifeLine_68af3b4705d9900c: They're deployed in the county, but they haven't coordinated with us
RD_ALifeLine_059b6a5d3d83823c: The Army has the authority, but I haven't seen them use it
RD_ALifeLine_3eaac93216ee74ec: I called the base three times on the first night and got a recording, a recording, can you believe that
RD_ALifeLine_4fd77173107129c5: That's above both our pay grades
RD_ALifeLine_604dab4a1028adcf: I hope they get here soon, we need all the help we can get
RD_ALifeLine_76397c9f299cae5b: I've asked Fort Knox for help three times and got nothing, not one answer
RD_ALifeLine_322a20773efcec67: We are the Army, and we're doing our best
RD_ALifeLine_194e045b23f18b15: I'm not authorized to speak about operational matters
RD_ALifeLine_1083486c7949bfae: Reinforcements are expected, but there's no timeline
RD_ALifeLine_3e81d19524f69e9e: Orders are to hold and contain, that's the full extent of what I know
RD_ALifeLine_55abfb6a2f3fc089: Questions about the military are not welcome
RD_ALifeLine_06d1295b0041c3ec: We're trying to help, we really are, there's just so much to do and not enough of us
RD_ALifeLine_4c063e2a2878ec7d: The Army will get us out, give it time
RD_ALifeLine_414ceb713b435243: Anybody tells you the Army has abandoned you is lying, and I'll put them on a charge
RD_ALifeLine_38359cbf38d7bb86: I don't know, honestly, nobody tells us anything, we just do what we're told... please don't ask me more
RD_ALifeLine_3d7c78d90f56c755: Half my squad is gone, I don't even know who's in charge anymore
RD_ALifeLine_23ba205b76f403a5: There are people above this you don't want to meet
RD_ALifeLine_7f85191931df6051: The Army pays slow, I prefer cash
RD_ALifeLine_641dec1567ede08f: We saw them pull out on the second day, left their trucks and everything
RD_ALifeLine_322d1c5932e8bb40: Army ain't coming, and I don't blame them, it's bigger than anyone
RD_ALifeLine_3f8892aa634eb7a2: Last thing the Army told us was to stay inside, so we stayed inside, and look where it got us
RD_ALifeLine_06fda92d6c67679d: We keep watching the road, hoping for good news
RD_ALifeLine_1928649214747964: They're coming, my cousin saw trucks on 31W headed north, a whole line of them, they're coming, right?
RD_ALifeLine_1a820a7e1a7d6550: Soldiers at the roadblock told us to go home and wait, so I'm waiting, I'm just waiting out here instead
RD_ALifeLine_1d0e96487e6c7cc1: I waved at a helicopter for twenty minutes yesterday, it went right on by, like I was a mailbox
RD_ALifeLine_1e1dbcec60b87a14: Army's out there somewhere, they're just not out here, I made my peace with that last week
RD_ALifeLine_194e57016dc48214: The Army came and put up fences, and then pointed the guns at US, go figure
RD_ALifeLine_133aa44964804118: Guard came in the first days, some of them are still around, just not standing up
RD_ALifeLine_142e73f73ccc7a38: Army can come get you for all I care, keep walking
RD_ALifeLine_4e0ee85f063bd33a: Saw a convoy blow through the weigh station on 31W doing about eighty, no stopping, no waving, just gone
RD_ALifeLine_7aee587631bc28ff: Drove parts out to Fort Knox for nine years, gate guards knew my name, last time I went up, they aimed at my truck
RD_ALifeLine_477b79de51acdb24: We asked the Guard for help at the station, they took our diesel and our generator, signed a paper for it, at least
RD_ALifeLine_2c7bc3b371ff6fd6: Army medics came through the clinic on day two and took our patient list, never said where the list was going
RD_ALifeLine_747aee202004f81c: Guard's supposed to be holding the perimeter, we lost contact with their liaison the third day
RD_ALifeLine_07aa53c76086c1d1: Soldiers took over our roadblock on 31W, real polite about it, then they turned the rifles on the people we'd been helping
RD_ALifeLine_4e63937a3723a48f: State Police were told to coordinate with the Guard, we coordinated, they left, we didn't
RD_ALifeLine_5b0671247fdefded: The military isn't taking visitors and neither am I, back up
RD_ALifeLine_3e21351d3f166de7: We're around, not as many as you'd like, and not doing what you'd like
RD_ALifeLine_4e8f57220b8196c2: My orders are to hold the perimeter, not escort civilians, I'm sorry, that's the truth of it
RD_ALifeLine_685931b241cdc53d: Last I heard, battalion pulled back toward post, I'm the part that didn't get pulled back
RD_ALifeLine_1944b49352a8b315: I've been in eight months, basic didn't cover anything like this, and nobody's told us a thing since
RD_ALifeLine_44f72da82e003770: Assets are committed, none of them are for you
RD_ALifeLine_61bd50bd7fd6cbb9: You're looking at the military, stop right there
RD_ALifeLine_1357d75f6d21c597: That's close enough, keep your hands up and tell me where you came from
RD_ALifeLine_1aa913b71750b403: Army's who shot that family at the roadblock outside Muldraugh, so no, I'm not with them anymore
RD_ALifeLine_133e66981ed91ffe: Soldier boys are the scariest thing in this county, and I'm counting the dead, stay off the highway
RD_ALifeLine_2032092272386c04: Took a rifle off a Guardsman on 31W, he didn't need it anymore, that's your military
RD_ALifeLine_06852417669dd3e7: Army? They left their trucks on the shoulder with the keys in 'em, that's how bad they want to come back
RD_ALifeLine_60f439d77a42c4fd: Army ain't coming for you, nobody's coming for you, that's the fun part
RD_ALifeLine_392963764debcb5d: See any soldiers around? Me neither, keep that in mind while you're standing there
RD_ALifeLine_358e5da6535a8146: You want what I saw at the line? It ain't the official version of it
RD_ALifeLine_1ba43e884b06aaf1: They're doing what they were told, that's the frightening part, not the opposite
RD_ALifeLine_35f1b74d19c40ee8: I stood a roadblock till the eighth, you want to hear why I ain't on it now?
RD_ALifeLine_36807723435ae362: Folks think they're coming back through here, you want my opinion on that?
RD_ALifeLine_25c0febf2d4c2be6: They came through on the sixth with loudspeakers, then they went back the other way
RD_ALifeLine_3924f65b15d70cd5: Convoy went past our house twice, second time they wasn't stopping for anybody
RD_ALifeLine_3d8efc9100a9b9f0: They're on the roads, not in the towns, that's what I've seen with my own eyes
RD_ALifeLine_21b1181115a8a832: The Guard boys at the school were kids, scared kids with rifles, worst kind there is
RD_ALifeLine_7c269fcc607cd2d7: A soldier asked me to pray with him at the roadblock, nineteen, maybe twenty
