RD_ALifeLine_559cf58900e68ade: Oh honey, I'm alright, just these old bones, how are you?
RD_ALifeLine_5137729f538cbd4b: Not great, dear, but better now that someone cared enough to ask
RD_ALifeLine_289b07266c52604f: I'm fine, dear, my old bones are just grumpy
RD_ALifeLine_668490ac73ac6f66: Tired, mostly, tired to the soul, but alive, thank the Lord
RD_ALifeLine_14812db84f4c1fd8: I'm functioning, haven't slept in two days, but functioning
RD_ALifeLine_07308c603a531baa: Functional, which at this point is a victory
RD_ALifeLine_7d386c7d3c1e9758: I'm fine, why do you want to know
RD_ALifeLine_1f95601511c07c0f: I'm all right, you can stop looking so worried
RD_ALifeLine_772eff271a2b7d00: I could use a hot meal and a week of sleep, I'm not looking for a fuss
RD_ALifeLine_7b9db1443c8f5b62: Ha, I'm great, never better, can't you tell? Why, you worried about me
RD_ALifeLine_659dfb5e7c47cb74: Okay? Nah, but I'm still breathing, so who's complaining
RD_ALifeLine_31f610c1627724ff: Ha, I've been worse, I've been better. Today I don't feel much like explaining
RD_ALifeLine_545c1cf814dd8af7: Okay? Never been better, ask the dead
RD_ALifeLine_5542b41276b200c2: What's it to you? Mind your own damn business
RD_ALifeLine_1bf4e0ea093876ff: Why do you ask? Do I look bad? Do I
RD_ALifeLine_7357139a11f6b2c3: Better than you're gonna be if you don't back off
RD_ALifeLine_5b31e88a43da2454: I'm great, I'm about to be greater
RD_ALifeLine_346d949c2201650c: I'm great, you, on the other hand, look like you're about to have a real bad day
RD_ALifeLine_70a053435644b203: I'm okay, I'm, I'm okay, I keep forgetting what I was about to do
RD_ALifeLine_5826fb0c377a1941: Yeah... you're the first person who's asked me anything in days
RD_ALifeLine_693e359e37e549f9: Not really, but I'm here talking to you, I'll take that
RD_ALifeLine_2413c26107a34b17: I'd rather take things slowly today. Please don't rush me
RD_ALifeLine_47f9c16307e5cf69: Fine as anybody, sore feet, no sleep, bad coffee, you?
RD_ALifeLine_4ec98fc710567287: I'm upright, ain't much more to report than that
RD_ALifeLine_58cd57ad236f5976: I've had enough worrying about injuries to last me a lifetime
RD_ALifeLine_09e880f409237c9a: I'm alright, been on my feet eighteen hours, ask me again when I sit down
RD_ALifeLine_30d8ce661d6505a1: I'm alright, thank you, would you mind rolling your sleeves up for me? It's procedure now, for everybody
RD_ALifeLine_60efb9631848d17a: Been better, my pride's taken enough tumbles for one lifetime
RD_ALifeLine_58a4a5b719d31de5: I'm fine, you're the one I'm assessing, stay put
RD_ALifeLine_77ed38db179a4f96: I keep wondering if I've overlooked something, can't settle my mind
RD_ALifeLine_7b0bb47b558841c7: I'm all right, don't let me keep you
RD_ALifeLine_4755de01312e4bcb: Worry about yourself, don't come any closer
RD_ALifeLine_7bf6abe27cb0b08d: Been worse, been shot at by the state police twice, and I'm still prettier than both of 'em
RD_ALifeLine_575c88b318f38307: I used to laugh at my own little accidents. Harder to do that now
RD_ALifeLine_213a7e977a24f518: Never better. That's what you want to hear, isn't it
RD_ALifeLine_18152deb268e388b: Took a shank in the ribs in '89 and walked it off, this is a vacation
RD_ALifeLine_2a75c0ab7047260e: No, but I'm standing and talking, and that's two more than yesterday
RD_ALifeLine_5e3d58ae5e622d58: I'm getting by, ask me again when I don't feel so responsible for everybody
RD_ALifeLine_0f2870af21280a42: I feel worn down. Other than that, I'm in the pink
RD_ALifeLine_5c80fe5b02ed021d: I'm fine, I say that about forty times a day and four of 'em are true
RD_ALifeLine_575f638e7396e1b7: I'm well... nobody asks the fella that's supposed to be steady, so, thanks
RD_ALifeLine_3fd0a46a275092e1: Hard to shake off the old job, I keep trying to act like everything will pass
RD_ALifeLine_7009a6c85a627ad9: I'm okay, I'm the kind of okay where you don't ask it a second time
RD_ALifeLine_16eb37d620125ad5: I miss my husband, some days that takes up the whole answer
RD_ALifeLine_51f07ec405be47a4: I'm functional, that's the word I've settled on, functional
RD_ALifeLine_6e2d26365fef4da1: Combat effective, which ain't the same as okay, but it's what I've got
RD_ALifeLine_065c18e90567f976: I can't get my thoughts straight today, so, no
RD_ALifeLine_5d48d7f31379618c: I miss laughing without thinking something bad will follow
RD_ALifeLine_4e4218327cdf7786: I'm real good, ain't that the strangest thing a man's had to admit lately
RD_ALifeLine_58cbd02f0332cc1f: I was, till somebody walked up on me
RD_ALifeLine_504a1408242d72ac: I'm fine, I'm, I'm fine, why can't I make a simple thought come out right
RD_ALifeLine_09eb87796c8ba682: I'm having the best month of my entire life, how about you?
RD_ALifeLine_79c1cc8835503242: Others? There are others? tell me there are others, I haven't seen another living face in two days
RD_ALifeLine_393b701754f0e885: A few, we've waved from a distance, nobody's brave enough to come closer
RD_ALifeLine_56713bff7b3a597f: I heard people last night, laughing, real laughing!! I almost went looking for 'em, almost!!
RD_ALifeLine_180eea8d29f61662: Some, yes, a family down the way, they have a little girl, I hear her singing sometimes
RD_ALifeLine_0a6fd96e1dee386d: Yes! a couple of guys, and a woman with a baby, we shared a fire, then they moved on, I miss them
RD_ALifeLine_6e5020fb6b98453e: I don't know... I thought I saw smoke from a chimney, but it could've been anything
RD_ALifeLine_75183db365e66842: Everybody's hiding, so there must be a lot of us, right? if everybody's hiding, there must be a lot of us
RD_ALifeLine_2a364c4e34aee6cb: Not many, and the ones I've met were scared, like me, we all jump at our own shadows
RD_ALifeLine_37ab351447576169: I saw a few folks the other day, but they ran when they saw me, I don't blame them
RD_ALifeLine_4cfbab0d27daa768: You're the first living person I've talked to in days, honestly
RD_ALifeLine_0ae1ca12521ae0db: A few, scattered, mostly keeping to themselves, some are friendly, some aren't, I've learned the difference
RD_ALifeLine_0acb53222077551a: Enough that I don't feel crazy, not enough that I feel safe
RD_ALifeLine_1291363355e57403: Yeah, a pocket of survivors here, a camp there, a lone wolf in the hills, we're out there
RD_ALifeLine_58faf3fe72662b82: More than you'd think, fewer than you'd hope, everyone's moving, everyone's wary
RD_ALifeLine_3e54c1e0089c0cd8: Folks are dug in, boarded up, quiet as mice, you don't see them unless they want you to
RD_ALifeLine_75275a14204e9c37: I met a woman last week, she traded me a jar of peaches for a bandage, best deal of my life
RD_ALifeLine_34a35f1e49e69041: A group of nine, up the road, they've got a system, but they don't let outsiders in
RD_ALifeLine_49465b8f6cdb9d4c: Some, here and there, they keep to themselves, can't blame them
RD_ALifeLine_3efa970877480ee2: A few, but trust is short supply, so be careful who you approach
RD_ALifeLine_761f5df14cd39174: You're looking at one, and I'm glad to meet another, believe me, glad
RD_ALifeLine_3b9c70ee6d96bfed: There's a few, and now one more, you!! That's something!
RD_ALifeLine_51b59e6607fc36f4: Why do you ask? looking for someone to rob?
RD_ALifeLine_4eeb68426d6d0f35: There are no others, you hear me? none!
RD_ALifeLine_119ac2a02210776d: If there were, I wouldn't TELL you
RD_ALifeLine_70aec168544f2ad6: Maybe, maybe not, I'm not telling you
RD_ALifeLine_18c726a85bd3abe2: I'm not telling a stranger where people are, what would you do with that?
RD_ALifeLine_7375d85a2767fc98: Maybe, why? Who's asking, and who's that behind you?
RD_ALifeLine_135961f67b57e9ce: Others? Yeah, just saw somebody, hold on, they were right over- they're gone now
RD_ALifeLine_3856f8261ccc7acc: There's a group close by, I just heard 'em, keep it quiet till we know who they are
RD_ALifeLine_589e58c943f53d6d: Couple hermits like me, some trappers, a family up on the ridge, we just nod and leave it at that
RD_ALifeLine_40d418527ce7bdfb: Ran into a man last week, shared a rabbit with him, we didn't exchange names, that's how I like it
RD_ALifeLine_57b5f5c141105046: There's a cluster of families a mile or two off... we trade, we gossip, we check on the kids
RD_ALifeLine_217a061334ad0b05: Church group, mostly, and some neighbors, I'd say forty people within walking distance
RD_ALifeLine_6498693a1f5c25b1: The church ladies, honey, a dozen of us, we meet on Wednesdays, no matter what
RD_ALifeLine_66661a25012e6d2e: Some kids from my school are around, we signal with flashlights, it's actually kind of cool
RD_ALifeLine_00aff01e2eb257ed: Plant crew's scattered, a handful at the garage, a few at the depot, I don't know who's alive
RD_ALifeLine_2b2ad3bb06cdbc05: There are others, the sick and the wounded, and the ones who look after them, I see them every day
RD_ALifeLine_1cca9fc9424eb85b: Beloved, you are never alone, there are always others, even if they're hidden
RD_ALifeLine_37c809cc049fb68e: Radio has a few voices, other units, other stations, we check in when we can
RD_ALifeLine_287a5c261fed4f18: Other watches, other posts, other men with rifles, we wave from a distance
RD_ALifeLine_4f2c8d5d3a40a7d6: There's a few, yes, and they'd be glad to meet you, they've heard of you
RD_ALifeLine_452b53ed44f6ff80: Plenty, and the number's growing, because folks like you make it safe to come out
RD_ALifeLine_14f688cf6312faa0: I know of three groups, within a day's walk, and all three would welcome you
RD_ALifeLine_26a38f4a1a41bd5d: Sure, more than you'd think, and all of them are hoping for kindness
RD_ALifeLine_697e01326407813c: There's a family near the creek, they trade with us, they'd love a visit
RD_ALifeLine_6404388d6d975bcf: A few stragglers, a few scouts, a few hermits, I'll introduce you
RD_ALifeLine_09099b703b6a95a3: They're out there, don't worry, you're not alone
RD_ALifeLine_3ed8675504e97059: There's a church group across the way, praying, singing, getting by!
RD_ALifeLine_23d61c927a795593: A handful here, a handful there, scattered, but connected
RD_ALifeLine_190b89714c3e25a2: There's talk of a gathering at the end of the month, I'd like you to come
RD_ALifeLine_798306a66cb107c4: Yes, and some of them know your name, and think highly of it
RD_ALifeLine_566a63650a006304: More than one, and more than two, and more than I can count on one hand
RD_ALifeLine_159115ef00470f31: We exchange signals, so I know they're alive
RD_ALifeLine_4bb58917375212fe: The other groups would kill for someone like you!
RD_ALifeLine_5fc3648b07356392: Few and far between, but good, the good ones, I mean
RD_ALifeLine_130ec4f874fe5c26: I met two farmers last week, honest as the day is long
RD_ALifeLine_7f2435682075fc28: Several, each with a story, and a need
RD_ALifeLine_641645d707698ad2: There's a woman and her three boys, hiding in a barn, I leave food out!
RD_ALifeLine_49a69d3b7b37c0c1: A couple of old-timers, tough as leather, in a farmhouse to the north
RD_ALifeLine_31b4628814dc0ba4: You'll find folks, if you look in the right places
RD_ALifeLine_65af2ac278179bc5: Don't lose hope, there are more of us than you think
RD_ALifeLine_581dc7983dd9155e: A good number, and a few great ones
RD_ALifeLine_0e0968ee3e3f26e9: A band of travelers passes through every week, with news
RD_ALifeLine_1377bd3273e12ef5: I've heard radio chatter, so, yes, others are out there
RD_ALifeLine_3bbf43be36425117: Depends who you ask, I've met some brave ones and some scared witless
RD_ALifeLine_3638ec8216b84b33: Yes, and they're asking about you
RD_ALifeLine_21b10351009341e9: It gets lonely, but we're not alone, I promise
RD_ALifeLine_26679718794e17d8: We have neighbors, and the neighbors have neighbors
RD_ALifeLine_6d6da88c3a26022a: Quite a few, scattered across the county like stars
RD_ALifeLine_640bec750a470b56: There's others, I'm sure of it!!
RD_ALifeLine_027876fe71e1052e: The only others I know are the ones you wronged
RD_ALifeLine_39de46d860167b51: They're hiding from people like you
RD_ALifeLine_78db5f706c80ab4e: Others? Hmm, none I'd introduce you to!!
RD_ALifeLine_6cd90ad746deb4d1: Plenty, and they all steer clear
RD_ALifeLine_514021ad4af584eb: They'd rather die than meet you
RD_ALifeLine_161afd142ee2bfa5: I won't lead you to them!
RD_ALifeLine_7a57c7a5484a197b: Everyone else knows who you are
RD_ALifeLine_5e05060e45252e41: You're welcome to look, but they won't welcome you
RD_ALifeLine_06d70642176a1a23: Not a one who'd give you the time
RD_ALifeLine_3e5be28137e2f185: Others have the sense to avoid you
RD_ALifeLine_3859156c34924b5c: I know some, but they wouldn't want to know you
RD_ALifeLine_6f5e17d473d39a9e: Plenty out there, none for you
RD_ALifeLine_10f307c10b18525b: No one worth meeting, from your perspective
RD_ALifeLine_1e1fa97862d2d066: They don't want any part of you
RD_ALifeLine_309777cc4b319591: You're on your own, and that's how it should be
RD_ALifeLine_47df90943fef6775: They know about you, and they've circled the wagons
RD_ALifeLine_7a14110675964310: Find your own friends, if you can!
RD_ALifeLine_391f3e051d1bf9de: Look around, and see who's looking back!
RD_ALifeLine_0218301515b317bd: The only ones left are tired of people like you
RD_ALifeLine_2016a3013e4f2f3c: Others? I hope so, but right now it's just us and THEM
RD_ALifeLine_0fd5865f6075fb9a: If there are others, they're hiding, as we should be
RD_ALifeLine_67840b7b3d5f5d5a: Not that I can see... only the dead!

RD_ALifeLine_00cc07e23274b35d: I heard a voice yesterday, calling a name
RD_ALifeLine_1b949f175269988c: There's a farm family, three houses down
RD_ALifeLine_3b17b7312db5ddf1: A preacher with a dozen followers
RD_ALifeLine_6cc4ad9358106c45: I met a man on the road
RD_ALifeLine_1eaf4149489500cf: I've seen smoke from three different chimneys
RD_ALifeLine_78826ce2590e48b8: Yes, and some of them are even nice
RD_ALifeLine_3488d16c43180bc1: They're out there... and they're afraid of us, the same way we're afraid of them
RD_ALifeLine_1965195d256a1adb: Other survivors? There's a guy who plays the accordion at three in the morning
RD_ALifeLine_1fa6c1e74ce078e7: Everybody's inside, doors locked, curtains drawn
RD_ALifeLine_6e0077a71652ad3b: I can see lights in the neighbors' windows... so, yes
RD_ALifeLine_64c6cac934977580: A few are venturing out... in pairs, in packs
RD_ALifeLine_19d1eb402802e54b: I see smoke from chimneys, so there are some
RD_ALifeLine_166cdf526ad18a64: There are communities now, here and there
RD_ALifeLine_49faee2d2e9c9490: We trade with the farm up the road
RD_ALifeLine_58d70fbd1ccb39e4: Other survivors? You're the first live one I've talked to in days and I haven't decided what to do with you yet
RD_ALifeLine_61e2c3955a9113d7: Saw a family yesterday, mom, dad, two kids, I let them keep their lives, you're welcome
RD_ALifeLine_1aae78f10b492385: There's folks around, sure, and every one of them is hiding something worth taking
RD_ALifeLine_21c7316865afcb23: Some, but they're not the friendly kind, and neither am I

RD_ALifeLine_10fb049e18e41452: Why, you looking for friends? I'm the only friend you're going to find around here
RD_ALifeLine_4049f54d2c254256: Heard a baby crying a few days back, never found it... still hear it
RD_ALifeLine_244c098d0c7f629b: Survivors? You're looking at one, and you're about to be a former one!
RD_ALifeLine_15b86bb913388fdd: Why, you counting how many of us are left? Count to one, that's me
RD_ALifeLine_4ef95cd32806f218: There was a guy and his dog, we shared a can of beans, then he left, I miss him already
RD_ALifeLine_50e5e2c365b67def: The survivors worth knowing are already working for me
RD_ALifeLine_0e15faa875fd7c22: Few of us left on this side, we keep to ourselves
RD_ALifeLine_7151d459016b3133: Saw some people yesterday, but we didn't stop to chat, you know how it goes
RD_ALifeLine_024a0522481ca618: My cousins are hiding out in the basement, they won't come out for nobody
RD_ALifeLine_79e3a49e24f2a149: Saw three dudes pushing a cart full of cans, took one look at us and ran
RD_ALifeLine_108704010bdbee9b: Man, I miss the block party, hundreds of people, now it's me and my homies
RD_ALifeLine_4848f5fc1ee887cb: Not telling you where anybody is, so quit asking
RD_ALifeLine_071afcc74bf880a7: There's a church couple blocks over with people inside, they're cool, tell them I sent you
RD_ALifeLine_74d1941379022b98: We run into folks on the road, most want something and few have anything
RD_ALifeLine_3a9a786f35fa6293: Our chapter's still together, a few others too, good people mostly
RD_ALifeLine_5d38442d24372d69: Saw a woman with a shotgun and a little girl, they were hungry, I left them a can
RD_ALifeLine_0549637875940b95: Lost count of how many we've buried, so I'd say there's not as many as there used to be
RD_ALifeLine_156083627e2e872d: Ain't going to answer questions I don't like
RD_ALifeLine_45b9f4b80d850cc8: There are always survivors, the question is which are worth knowing
RD_ALifeLine_2408a6317e1c6cb6: I've been meeting a few, selectively
RD_ALifeLine_218477a70bf1cb47: Most are not interesting, a few are useful, I keep track
RD_ALifeLine_002af3cf30360d36: A group of about ten is holed up not far from here, they seem decent
RD_ALifeLine_118a53353ba82c07: Other survivors? I try not to look, I try not to be seen
RD_ALifeLine_31af2f4d6feb8ab0: There's a guy named Ray in my group, he's okay, the rest I don't know
RD_ALifeLine_489734583fca9983: Heard voices in the woods, I didn't go closer
RD_ALifeLine_2b6e6678202c66c9: Why? You want to find them? Why?!
RD_ALifeLine_1f1f704b5bd95a0b: I'd love to see another face, even if it's a stranger
RD_ALifeLine_4ec909c7342e93d8: A few, scattered, mostly keep to themselves
RD_ALifeLine_01f4377c4c78e249: Saw smoke last week, never went to look, don't plan to
RD_ALifeLine_51fdcfbc35a39f50: Met an old couple up the hollow, they're doing alright, got chickens
RD_ALifeLine_23e3a3040c21d616: You're not the first one I've come across, you won't be the last
RD_ALifeLine_27bc0aa810f7559f: I've seen a few, I don't talk to them, they ask too many questions
RD_ALifeLine_7e36501b6a296fe2: We've identified several groups of survivors, and we're trying to establish contact
RD_ALifeLine_0b9209b61909abcd: We've been escorting survivors to the courthouse, about twenty so far
RD_ALifeLine_63fff77d71ce4a70: Reports of a church group, a farm family, and some stragglers, that's the extent of it
RD_ALifeLine_32801b4c15cf49fc: Unauthorized gatherings are discouraged, tell me where they are
RD_ALifeLine_10f54f5844a5333e: Yes, there are others, and we can help you find them
RD_ALifeLine_3e73f8973a1c8a70: There are survivors, and I want every one of them accounted for
RD_ALifeLine_25ce4f5f526ecf92: We've encountered civilians, they've been directed to shelter in place
RD_ALifeLine_3a96382f0245c24c: That is classified, so drop it
RD_ALifeLine_6c7da0b614e4fcbc: Civilian movements are restricted, do not wander
RD_ALifeLine_68eca8a36ff744c9: We've helped a few families, and we'll help more if we can
RD_ALifeLine_7ee760ec7f92ab6f: There's survivors out there, but I can't spare the men to find them
RD_ALifeLine_225cd003772a3a8b: I saw a little girl in a window, she waved at me, I didn't know what to do
RD_ALifeLine_1320478450993d64: There are survivors, and some of them pay well
RD_ALifeLine_367bc45622b5f9cd: There's several farms still holding out, we keep in touch with the ones we can
RD_ALifeLine_0864c2fa1e30f715: A few families came to us, we took them in, put them to work
RD_ALifeLine_6f4e00931c737c72: Folks across the county, hidden away, praying like us
RD_ALifeLine_7b28ff410d2a34e4: Plenty of good people left, friend, you're proof of that
RD_ALifeLine_5e4d8da849c4b7fa: Oh, honey, there's folks all over, hidden, scared, waiting, just like us
RD_ALifeLine_06a368ec086bd732: A few groups, we're trying to organize them, slowly
RD_ALifeLine_6c478a4378fd475d: Plenty sheltering in place, armed and nervous, announce yourself before you walk up on anybody's porch
RD_ALifeLine_43de63fb683ddcba: Plenty, some nice, some not, you'll know the difference when it's too late
RD_ALifeLine_503514787a0ad0f7: Old couple two streets over still hangs laundry out, so I know they're alive, I just don't knock
RD_ALifeLine_7cf218010f53db40: You're the first person I've talked to in three days, sorry, I'm talking a lot, sorry
RD_ALifeLine_0bb3832f7ad2e367: The Dawsons next door are gone, but I heard kids laughing by the church yesterday, I'm sure I did
RD_ALifeLine_5e28a5857ad7a178: We're a few families at the end of our road, we could use somebody who isn't scared of everything, would you want to join us?
RD_ALifeLine_606feb50284d8051: Lots of folks are still in their houses, waiting like they were told, you'll see curtains move when you walk past
RD_ALifeLine_64ab090763f03b83: Sure, some of them you want to meet, most you don't, learn to tell the difference from a long way off
RD_ALifeLine_3d65d4266c4b9de9: Saw chimney smoke out toward March Ridge, in July, so somebody's cooking, and somebody isn't careful
RD_ALifeLine_72b811f237fd4857: There's one right here telling you to back off
RD_ALifeLine_21266d2d2c4d73cc: Couple of the boys from the lumber yard are holed up in the office, forklift parked across the door
RD_ALifeLine_5bf6804521476635: Found a note taped to a payphone in West Point, names and a meeting time, the time came and went last week
RD_ALifeLine_3c3a209a7da87314: I've treated eleven people since the clinic closed, so yes, there are survivors, some even say thank you
RD_ALifeLine_67b4e09551813ec1: Every Sunday a few more come to the service, some Sundays a few less, we keep the count in the back of a hymnal
RD_ALifeLine_4396608d29f33d21: We check houses when we can and mark the door, a circle means somebody's living, we've drawn a lot more X's
RD_ALifeLine_2aea1a2007a52aae: We cleared a subdivision in Muldraugh and found nine living, nine, out of forty houses
RD_ALifeLine_4b23b80673816c3e: Whoever I know about is my business, not yours, now back up
RD_ALifeLine_7cb8a6c66fbe4fd3: There may be other people, I'd rather talk before anybody gets frightened and does something stupid
RD_ALifeLine_6c5e265a431011df: There's pockets of them, in the towns, mostly, folks on farms do better
RD_ALifeLine_7162c97d2e96e265: A little girl waved at our Humvee from a window yesterday, Sergeant wouldn't let me wave back
RD_ALifeLine_4de6c7184a051ec8: Civilians present in all towns, numbers declining
RD_ALifeLine_38d5e92a5b1c056c: Only survivors I care about right now are in my squad, back up

RD_ALifeLine_2d7324cc473b58e3: The AM band has one station left, plays hymns around the clock, strange comfort
RD_ALifeLine_059fc68613169053: Don't have one, don't want one, a radio draws attention, and I like my peace
RD_ALifeLine_3f74e87c63de178b: We have a battery radio, and we listen for ten minutes every evening, to save the batteries
RD_ALifeLine_75285bd8324c499d: My son found a channel, kids talking, kids! on the radio, it was the best thing I've heard all week
RD_ALifeLine_023b28ab36dee1df: My little kitchen radio, it still plays, but only static, I keep it on for company
RD_ALifeLine_033249c86f9b069e: I listen to the preacher at noon, he's still there, God bless him, he reads for the shut-ins
RD_ALifeLine_454a7957047753ee: My brother has a walkie-talkie, and we talk across the field, it's lame, but it works
RD_ALifeLine_5d2bb33623694da9: I found a tape player in a drawer, no batteries, just a tape of my favorite band, I hold it
RD_ALifeLine_176d5ca1240d8d9e: CB in my truck, no use now, but I leave it on, in case somebody calls
RD_ALifeLine_10fe256e341f14d0: Plant has a PA system, and a handheld, we use it for the watch, it works fine, within a mile
RD_ALifeLine_7ffbf7e864c80df4: Ham radio operator at the clinic, he's the only link we have, he tells us what's happening in other counties
RD_ALifeLine_4bc1b5566bf94b4b: We listen for medical broadcasts... and so far, we've heard nothing
RD_ALifeLine_7603d3865a8b98c4: The church has an old radio, and we listen for the faithful, they call it the prayer line
RD_ALifeLine_45f9cbac6af0442a: Fire frequency, lots of dead air now, sometimes a distant voice, sometimes a scream
RD_ALifeLine_38f4e5ae6a4d5068: We listen to the sheriff's channel, the Guard's frequency, and anything else we can find, mostly static
RD_ALifeLine_350f08c1742456be: T-the radio? I heard a woman crying... she was so close, I think she was in the next building
RD_ALifeLine_2036ba7f530aee5f: It said "do not approach," over and over, "do not approach," I turned it off, I was shaking
RD_ALifeLine_6952a1f008859d8a: I keep the volume off... because what if it says something I can't unhear
RD_ALifeLine_00b0d6bb1ba94dc8: Static... static... then a scream... static... I can't listen anymore
RD_ALifeLine_79a2553f38a28489: Nothing useful... mostly static, mostly recordings, mostly lies
RD_ALifeLine_18ec80061d50e09e: A man reading names, every night, same time, same voice, as if names mattered
RD_ALifeLine_11ff50a54a616629: Radio's mostly garbage... I only believe what I see myself
RD_ALifeLine_01f109502474fb90: I listen for my son's voice... he was a ham operator... he'd talk to the world... I keep listening
RD_ALifeLine_3d4ef40c68300481: They read my sister's name once... a short list... "found alive"... I almost died of joy
RD_ALifeLine_41f79a725b248299: I leave it on for company
RD_ALifeLine_43c95cb5429929c8: Nothing but government lies, and music that doesn't fit, and silence, I want to smash it
RD_ALifeLine_6e045ba34830a7b3: They broadcast "remain calm" to a town on fire, and then they went off the air
RD_ALifeLine_0b401e7b2836e518: Lies, all lies, on every channel
RD_ALifeLine_6e973a9903484a9b: I heard a child singing a lullaby last night, over the air, I don't know who or where, but it was beautiful
RD_ALifeLine_17a12bea5e31de2f: Come hear it with me, a voice is a voice, and we could use a few of them
RD_ALifeLine_4648d4f5307eede2: Come listen with me, it's nice not to be alone with it
RD_ALifeLine_7e6c7eab21c9e61f: There's a guy who does a nightly weather report, from inside a bunker, "partly cloudy, with a chance of the dead"
RD_ALifeLine_6be4c19c0a36306b: Static... and a country song that keeps cutting off at the chorus, it's like the end of the world has a bad DJ, heh
RD_ALifeLine_6ba48dc37c8901d7: The radio says the weather's perfect for the end of the world, ha
RD_ALifeLine_42c26a2963486c61: My radio only gets one station... ha
RD_ALifeLine_0735fb406b296cbc: I don't have a radio, I don't know anything about a radio
RD_ALifeLine_36e79db2537d4a68: The radio is mine, and no, you can't LISTEN
RD_ALifeLine_67db97f277042899: We keep a radio at the nurses' station, on low, for the broadcasts, mostly static, sometimes a doctor's voice
RD_ALifeLine_191ec51d3a8935c9: A ham operator relays patient numbers... "four fevers in Brandenburg, six in Rosewood," it's all grim
RD_ALifeLine_0b54f3a133bc3981: I listen for hospital frequencies, for anybody saying "we need help," I've answered twice
RD_ALifeLine_4d0cf4f941ece603: The radio is for emergencies, not entertainment
RD_ALifeLine_2eabdff940c1d4d4: The radio can wait... they can't
RD_ALifeLine_364e546b3f7dcb0e: Turn it off, turn it OFF, they'll hear it
RD_ALifeLine_4414384b22d87366: If it crackles, they come, keep it off!
RD_ALifeLine_5b76449242d0e1ab: Radio's handy, but your weapon's more useful right now
RD_ALifeLine_1b50dea76511bc44: Some nights I hear a man reading Bible verses
RD_ALifeLine_4370fef93186fc44: There's a woman who reads names
RD_ALifeLine_498a6b6845ba5afd: I picked up a signal last night, in code
RD_ALifeLine_70cbe2bb34da3cb3: It's a dead hobby now, the radio
RD_ALifeLine_77f9bdce61bec55b: Once, I heard a child singing
RD_ALifeLine_0ac744392b00d4c9: A man on the CB calls himself "Night Hawk"
RD_ALifeLine_7dc3e4875c99029d: They broadcast a message on the hour, the same one
RD_ALifeLine_4906e90435c05cd2: There's music sometimes, an old song
RD_ALifeLine_63fc80015014b48d: I heard my own voice once... a recording
RD_ALifeLine_3eb973ee797eb206: Last night a voice said, "Don't go to the river"...
RD_ALifeLine_0d4e37041fd3dc11: Come hear it with me tonight!
RD_ALifeLine_53779f474a3e74a6: I don't discuss what I listen to
RD_ALifeLine_1395430925d519d2: Why? you want to listen in?
RD_ALifeLine_7605b8914ad08384: What do you want with a radio? Who are you calling? Stay back there
RD_ALifeLine_02068b18707ad807: I don't tell folks what frequency we're on, you can understand why
RD_ALifeLine_18cb5355704d7b05: Heard one once, in a farmhouse
RD_ALifeLine_5c747f0915ef3f95: No, no radio, I don't trust what comes out of it
RD_ALifeLine_02e65e67709655c3: The radio is my company, dear
RD_ALifeLine_45d3c7a5067b3667: I have a tape player, but no tapes
RD_ALifeLine_284063c61c283e8e: There's a station that plays old music
RD_ALifeLine_459cc29f7619da0e: We listen for ten minutes at night... to save batteries
RD_ALifeLine_1aeeda4105743b31: A man reads the Psalms every evening
RD_ALifeLine_54644c81645fa24d: We monitor the sheriff's channel and the Guard's
RD_ALifeLine_0782738234ebcd69: The emergency broadcast, the tone, the message, over and over
RD_ALifeLine_6b89a3bd7c7eac0d: It's mostly static now, a few survivors broadcasting
RD_ALifeLine_69a8e6316866eee0: The official channel went off on the fifth
RD_ALifeLine_5d7978c019081d5e: Mostly voices of people like us
RD_ALifeLine_155c10190bd5241c: Radio? I turned it off the first day, noise draws them, and I'm not interested in company
RD_ALifeLine_11de161a06183d34: Heard a loop saying "remain calm, stay in your homes", I laughed so hard I cried
RD_ALifeLine_672607b95b5cdfeb: Some guy reads names off a list every few hours, I never listen, I don't want to hear mine
RD_ALifeLine_6a2c697358667c47: I smash radios, they make noise, they give away positions, they never say anything useful
RD_ALifeLine_521bbe750b0acff3: Nothing on it but static and the occasional crazy person, and sometimes I am the crazy person
RD_ALifeLine_06ae54964ca0548b: My boys use radios to find easy marks, funny how it works both ways
RD_ALifeLine_061fd083491eea6f: Don't ask me about radios, I broke the last one on a guy's head
RD_ALifeLine_4e302dfe14656364: I listen every night, hoping for a voice, any voice, just to hear somebody who isn't screaming
RD_ALifeLine_0a9100ec14aaf75d: Yeah, there's one station, a woman, she keeps reading the same warning, I know it by heart now
RD_ALifeLine_30d8283e5d14af5e: I keep a radio on for information, and I don't discuss what I learn
RD_ALifeLine_7bcf9eb618b165fb: Radio? Man, all I get is static and some old preacher yelling about hell
RD_ALifeLine_08ff3a557eed87aa: Used to listen to the station every night, now it's emergency broadcasts, the same one over and over
RD_ALifeLine_2bda0b9002905cfd: Batteries ran out, now it's just a paperweight
RD_ALifeLine_7ceda4974d7f57c1: We hear the Army on it sometimes, talking in code, can't make sense of it
RD_ALifeLine_5fa49674056da6f5: Radio's for snitches, you a snitch?
RD_ALifeLine_32146a93086a352c: CB's the only thing that works, old truckers talking, mostly rumors
RD_ALifeLine_5cacf6a41105a080: Radio's got a loop about the quarantine, over and over, I could recite it
RD_ALifeLine_2d5cacca5aab687c: We keep one on the shelf, hardly use it, no one's saying anything worth hearing
RD_ALifeLine_5e63ca0e0aeec0a0: Heard a guy on CB yesterday, said he was in Radcliff, begging for help, then nothing
RD_ALifeLine_6deb1e6b3da48bc9: Stay away from our radio, you hear me?
RD_ALifeLine_5639dbc942dc99eb: I monitor several frequencies, for business purposes
RD_ALifeLine_6e9214607f0d7be8: It's mostly noise, but occasionally one learns something
RD_ALifeLine_36f521e57cb4bfcd: Emergency Broadcast System is looping, nothing new, nothing helpful
RD_ALifeLine_1e6a32172954db86: Police scanner went silent day three, that told me more than the broadcast did
RD_ALifeLine_1aee60232f756316: If I hear something worth sharing, I'll pass it along
RD_ALifeLine_0ffdc0fe075006b4: Radio? We had one in the yard, now I don't want to hear anything, ever
RD_ALifeLine_1e4f5175215c8bd6: Voices in the dark, that's all it is, and I've had enough voices for one lifetime
RD_ALifeLine_5a63d38109448ad1: Keep it low if you turn it on, I'd like to hear anything else coming
RD_ALifeLine_6926b05e22d71a7a: Turn it off! Turn it off!
RD_ALifeLine_022234b64e01b907: I'd listen to anything just to not feel alone
RD_ALifeLine_29ec649f60ed3b70: Battery-powered, only on at night, low volume, I don't need anyone finding me
RD_ALifeLine_56f9d0a81f6c8339: Couple of stations still running, one's religious, one's the government, and neither's helping
RD_ALifeLine_41d6fbcc00f22db2: I listen for gunfire more than voices, it tells me where not to go
RD_ALifeLine_5121109b1e21fe27: Try 1610 AM, there's a voice that sounds almost human
RD_ALifeLine_278d410b0c818647: Radio was how they gave us orders, and I don't ever want to hear that again
RD_ALifeLine_0b92d6156373a8dc: Dispatch frequency went quiet on day three, we're monitoring other channels
RD_ALifeLine_49f7a97862da227d: We pick up the EBS, loops, nothing local
RD_ALifeLine_6566cc982ee8339f: The scanner is our only link, and it's mostly static
RD_ALifeLine_6842dc9e0f7c1d23: Radio communications are restricted, please stay off the air
RD_ALifeLine_76890a744b613ab9: If you hear anything on yours, let me know, anything at all
RD_ALifeLine_0ce2dbb15ba643bc: I've been trying to raise the state for four days, nothing
RD_ALifeLine_7b6d407b0e037f8a: Can't talk about the radio, move along
RD_ALifeLine_663c23f36371fd22: Communications are restricted to authorized personnel
RD_ALifeLine_18efacc7121282cc: Do not touch the radio, that is an order
RD_ALifeLine_2d3594094b10b1ec: We're monitoring, that's all I can say, but I'll tell you if I hear something
RD_ALifeLine_0916027433dc3f88: Keep the chatter off the net, soldier, unless you got something to report
RD_ALifeLine_6b85004e5b333e0f: I tried calling my mom on the unit's radio, they yelled at me... I just wanted to say I'm alive
RD_ALifeLine_034f35266b936702: Radio is a liability, we don't use it unless necessary
RD_ALifeLine_643caa7d423515ba: I use mine for work, not for company
RD_ALifeLine_541cfa5266984821: We listen for the preacher in the evenings, he reads scripture, it helps the kids
RD_ALifeLine_77416d527d222b8f: Got a ham radio from my uncle, picks up all kinds of folks, mostly scared
RD_ALifeLine_1f6a4f7f74c55950: Batteries are precious, so only an hour at dusk
RD_ALifeLine_5d0b9aec5e589811: Come by and listen, it's company, if nothing else
RD_ALifeLine_4c6ba69e203ff87b: There's a station on 99.6 FM, somebody broadcasting right here in Knox County, they read names sometimes, I listen for my boy's
RD_ALifeLine_4856772c4a7961e4: The emergency broadcast keeps saying stay inside and wait for instructions, it's been saying that since Friday
RD_ALifeLine_503bbbd55c3045f9: Daddy's got a CB in the truck, channel 19 was nothing but crying the first night, we turned it off
RD_ALifeLine_19d866f0298a261d: I found a Walkman with a radio in it, I only turn it on at night so the batteries last, it's company
RD_ALifeLine_458a431104a1822e: Try 99.6 FM, Knox County Radio Channel, fella on there doesn't know much, but he's honest about it
RD_ALifeLine_67afd45c407b1e57: Radio's mostly static and preachers, once in a while somebody reads off a trade, that part's worth waiting for
RD_ALifeLine_3e5ef7b035734305: Keep the volume low, a radio carries farther than you think, and they hear it just fine
RD_ALifeLine_423dd54214cdea19: Army frequencies went quiet around day ten, now it's just us talking to us
RD_ALifeLine_266352bf24ba06d0: Radio says leave strangers alone, I'm listening to it
RD_ALifeLine_04b35e9028d2b0f7: Dispatch channel at the plant still clicks every morning at six, nobody on it, just the timer, I guess
RD_ALifeLine_1b53c25a07bb6321: Scanner in my truck grabs the Army net now and then, they talk in letters and numbers, they don't sound happy
RD_ALifeLine_6cd1ae356efc3b0e: Our fire band is dead, I leave it on anyway, if anybody from Station 2 comes on, I want to be here to answer
RD_ALifeLine_2c9af2033e611bd3: A nurse called in to the Knox County Radio Channel on 99.6 with wound care tips, better than nothing, most days better than me
RD_ALifeLine_2b4517524efa1ce7: County channel still keys up once in a while, I hear somebody ask for a 10-20 and nobody answers, I quit answering it myself
RD_ALifeLine_3d7a78c16dcfd850: Try the Knox County Radio Channel, 99.6 FM, it's not official, but it's more accurate than we ever were
RD_ALifeLine_1c2d0ff802c6e2df: Got a portable on the sheriff's band, battery lasts about four hours, I spend them listening for my own unit number
RD_ALifeLine_2ccadc8453425b27: Radio's for official traffic, you're not official, move along
RD_ALifeLine_5df15c1e694838d5: Not permitted to share net frequencies, try the civilian FM band, there's a local station on 99.6
RD_ALifeLine_3603fecc441c6321: Say again? You want a frequency? Negative, civilian band's all you get
RD_ALifeLine_4b3fea7001376a2f: Net frequencies are restricted, don't transmit near us
RD_ALifeLine_666f36ae1ce9fffd: If you've got a radio, keep it off, transmitting near this position gets you shot
RD_ALifeLine_10f80ae37911a790: Guy on 99.6 reads out trades, and somebody always says where they're holding, people are real trusting
RD_ALifeLine_742b641f67adf17b: We listen to the Army channel for laughs, they don't know where anything is either
RD_ALifeLine_674d5be404e3b94f: Only thing on the radio is how nobody's coming, real comforting for you, huh?
RD_ALifeLine_53ee108d6e63ed11: Radio won't hear you scream, keep your hands off that bag
RD_ALifeLine_0a3fc4ea25e8bfc7: There's a fella broadcasting at night, he takes calls, only voice I've got left
RD_ALifeLine_102a9c6f645cb122: We run the radio one hour a night to save batteries, the kids pick the hour
RD_ALifeLine_2786043617e2021a: CB beats FM right now, nineteen for the road, nine if you're in real trouble
RD_ALifeLine_1d27ccc2500e4c51: There was a medical frequency to monitor, it's been carrier hum for a week
RD_ALifeLine_7878aa031f8cf861: A man reads names on the air some nights, just names, best thing on the dial
RD_ALifeLine_56690d9a760fd2e4: Emergency broadcast ran the same loop two days and then went to nothing
RD_ALifeLine_669f73d712390da0: Our repeater's still up, ain't nobody on it but me and a whole lot of static
RD_ALifeLine_1554c8ff6b2e9b83: Military nets are scrambled and you won't hear them, don't waste batteries hunting
RD_ALifeLine_317b647e7090964e: Mostly just listen on it, every time you transmit you give away where you are
RD_ALifeLine_499d54913922b199: Scanner in the shop picks up everything, most of it's folks asking if anybody's there
RD_ALifeLine_0da9cb2a336abbba: Batteries are the new money, I'd swap a radio for a case of D cells any day
RD_ALifeLine_568dbfc266678b90: I heard my own words come back at me on nineteen once, wasn't an echo, either
RD_ALifeLine_0c4cf83858053c04: We listen, y'all say your positions right out loud on nineteen, thanks for that
RD_ALifeLine_63b4264e0e0b686f: They took everything from the house on Elm, left a note, written in lipstick
RD_ALifeLine_785022a52746003e: They came at night, we hid in the cellar and held our breath
RD_ALifeLine_2f5611c519e962b7: The gang at the truck stop, stay clear of them
RD_ALifeLine_2b11c7196810dd34: Men took the fuel truck from the co-op at gunpoint, knew exactly which one was full, somebody told them
RD_ALifeLine_6ce1494a4ccf3c31: They don't touch the clinic, not yet, don't test it
RD_ALifeLine_3ef72a720dba9de9: Armed crews out on Highway 31, we've lost two units to them
RD_ALifeLine_7e14cd6373c7dc8a: Any roadblock that isn't marked, steer clear, that's not us and it's not the Guard
RD_ALifeLine_486ce5ec4c96de61: Hostile groups in the northeast, avoid
RD_ALifeLine_0d3ccd951d7b4e39: Hostiles are active in the sector, keep clear
RD_ALifeLine_595e96c663a0d0be: Armed civilians hitting convoys, we treat any unmarked roadblock as hostile
RD_ALifeLine_1197a6d1563324f1: Plenty of them, plenty worse than me
RD_ALifeLine_5808b4f507424e94: Raiders? Never heard of them, Hah
RD_ALifeLine_6ca40d9618b0f141: Everyone's raiding, ask a specific crew
RD_ALifeLine_1210e7f720c4e0a5: Bunch on the river road took one of ours
RD_ALifeLine_63712a0a3bbbb706: Several groups, all on the same market
RD_ALifeLine_4ac8663a53a2c88b: Couple of crews out there, we ain't one of 'em, we're more of a service industry
RD_ALifeLine_32c8659308ab3177: Hell, I'm one of them, but not by choice
RD_ALifeLine_0554f1a319b71eea: Some of the guys I came out with, I don't run with them anymore, they like it too much
RD_ALifeLine_236a884778a4ec34: Raiders? there are raiders? oh no, what do they do? what do they WANT!
RD_ALifeLine_4f960b80205bafc1: Yes, I've heard of them, bad people, nobody wants to meet them, they take everything
RD_ALifeLine_20a2135966b0e147: A man told me about a group, they've got trucks and guns and no mercy, I don't know where
RD_ALifeLine_7c9a00da4891f530: Be careful, please, THERE are people worse than the dead, I wish that weren't true!
RD_ALifeLine_7562dd04543ea578: Never met any, thank God, I hear they wear masks or paint their faces or something
RD_ALifeLine_5ca9c9c469acbf54: They hit a farm a few miles off, took everything, even the dog, I can't talk about it
RD_ALifeLine_3f37fe415294899f: Plenty, some call themselves militias, some call themselves gangs, they're all the same
RD_ALifeLine_17f8a33a10f61cfd: Folks out on the highways, folks who figured out stealing is easier than scavenging
RD_ALifeLine_6296838004d38619: Avoid anyone with more guns than sense, and anyone with too much food
RD_ALifeLine_0f08a6016b376caf: They'll smile first, then rob you, or rob you first, then smile, depends on the day
RD_ALifeLine_5e151f852a1e49e6: Gangs from the city, Louisville mostly, came out here when the food ran out
RD_ALifeLine_64e8762539a3caf0: Biker types, a pack of 'em, loud, mean, armed, stay clear
RD_ALifeLine_5ea34b18484c63f5: Watch your back, and I'll watch mine, deal? there's a bad bunch out there
RD_ALifeLine_404f0a255ed6347d: I can't tell you who's who, don't take somebody's word for it just because they smile at you
RD_ALifeLine_577a87b025ad5c24: Stick with me, and we'll keep out of their way
RD_ALifeLine_650db2132cd1436c: You're asking me? you tell me, are YOU a raider?
RD_ALifeLine_455efcfe7e79ff28: Don't ask questions you don't want answered
RD_ALifeLine_3bc2d44461dbb1ff: How do I know you're not one of them? Stay back there
RD_ALifeLine_184ffb4f60810fa6: People asking about raiders are usually scouting for them, which are you?
RD_ALifeLine_3a1332dd3e4d7a2a: Crews of five or six, working the roads, they stop travelers, take their packs, sometimes their boots
RD_ALifeLine_3eafa2ae0d92e7a2: Saw smoke from a camp I used to use, now there's a flag, and men with rifles, I moved on
RD_ALifeLine_71bd12e33caf1293: Armed groups, hostile, answer to nobody, we watch 'em and hit back if they come close
RD_ALifeLine_32c09caa241898f9: Folks with guns and no conscience, so I keep my guard up and a prayer in my heart
RD_ALifeLine_4604bfb15585a6d0: You didn't hear this from me, but there's a gang on the east road, ten or twelve, well armed
RD_ALifeLine_030d4a1d2510d0fd: They hit a farm last week, took everything, left the family alive, which is more than most
RD_ALifeLine_5f305d9d146d5c5e: Watch for men in matching jackets, they travel in a pack, polite at first, then not
RD_ALifeLine_3aa4025f51907eca: There's a rumor of a crew that's recruiting, forcing people to join, avoid them
RD_ALifeLine_753c5b150aa7eab0: They have a signal, a whistle, two short, one long, if you hear it, hide!
RD_ALifeLine_21e52c4e6dde2401: If somebody offers you a ride, say no, that's how they got my neighbor!
RD_ALifeLine_4bd0a68f3ebf5d7d: A bunch of ex-cons, I heard, who broke out of the county jail
RD_ALifeLine_103bc1dc7451d398: They're led by a man with a limp, mean as a snake, don't look him in the eye!
RD_ALifeLine_1717f61474614a99: They like to take your boots first, then your pack, then your name
RD_ALifeLine_24f4eef5419861d6: I know someone they robbed, he still hasn't stopped shaking
RD_ALifeLine_5e5d92ad051e5349: Keep your valuables close, and your valuables hidden, there's a difference
RD_ALifeLine_2402cad502803b93: They avoid daylight, mostly, so travel by day
RD_ALifeLine_0e29713a616a2721: There's a trail of burned barns marking where they've been
RD_ALifeLine_1335b72a1655adf0: Two women ran from them last week, they said the leader has a scar on his cheek
RD_ALifeLine_701d6c6e37803834: Stay clear of the quarry, they use it as a hideout, I'm told
RD_ALifeLine_418d4e2805064938: I'd walk you out of town, but I'd draw attention, so just go quietly
RD_ALifeLine_745a824d77fec27a: They speak softly, smile a lot, and steal everything not bolted down
RD_ALifeLine_459c8eee320fe7f8: My cousin got away from them, with a broken wrist
RD_ALifeLine_79746d3e74c37560: If you see a truck with no lights, run!
RD_ALifeLine_6b631c0560e1c264: Some of 'em don't even carry a gun, they just wait you out
RD_ALifeLine_643c09d922a7dfd4: They've been seen at dusk, along the creek, like wolves
RD_ALifeLine_70d929e93055ae57: Those people have no rules, and no mercy
RD_ALifeLine_4fa5402a5ccba40a: They look like anyone else, which is the scariest part
RD_ALifeLine_1e7ac5fc1ce034a9: A little girl told me they sing while they work, a happy song, it gives me chills
RD_ALifeLine_259b76173d200d43: Rumor is they're moving, heading this way
RD_ALifeLine_3d7075721f29621f: Their leader used to be a deputy, can you believe it?
RD_ALifeLine_7a71657a73c0e106: They take hostages, so, don't wander alone
RD_ALifeLine_236f23321e78ed29: A pack of dogs follows them, big ones
RD_ALifeLine_2f27f2943dd469af: Keep a weapon close, and a plan closer
RD_ALifeLine_1f49a9224ae8ae89: Someone's got to stop them, and I wish it were me
RD_ALifeLine_4ab198c910e89b6d: Raiders? You'd know more than I do
RD_ALifeLine_0eb3c9364754c8ad: Funny, you ask me about raiders
RD_ALifeLine_26df80770fe6a14a: You don't need directions, you need a conscience!
RD_ALifeLine_52d871782ce10674: Everyone's wondering whose side you're on
RD_ALifeLine_6ed990a666c37af9: I won't help you find your friends!
RD_ALifeLine_0d0919c134f97097: Why? Are you looking for your crew?
RD_ALifeLine_5004fd2943624d08: There are no raiders here, except you
RD_ALifeLine_14ca85f076162f58: You tell me, you seem to be the expert
RD_ALifeLine_55e3d355094b8811: Some people say you're one of them
RD_ALifeLine_6245ce524305bf07: Ask the ones in the ditch!
RD_ALifeLine_734a270175dbf290: I'm not discussing them with you
RD_ALifeLine_27eaa0962b962d51: Raiders? Can't say I've heard of any
RD_ALifeLine_64a16713318eb869: Find them yourself, you've got the right smell
RD_ALifeLine_0e064d094f1ae699: It takes one to know one!!
RD_ALifeLine_4d305c3a1cf9c9f0: I stay out of that business
RD_ALifeLine_478095380c935ec5: Ask the sheriff, if there's a sheriff
RD_ALifeLine_36d3117b558f9afe: We have a few, and they all look like you
RD_ALifeLine_1737fa0b395647ef: Try the quarry, the creek, the road, anywhere you like
RD_ALifeLine_5c19747345c8349b: I don't talk to people who might be spies
RD_ALifeLine_005c67d432ed5103: You have no right to ask
RD_ALifeLine_7ed414fe3047b5b0: I wouldn't tell you where they are, even for a million dollars
RD_ALifeLine_47851f7e3187998f: If you see them, say hello for me
RD_ALifeLine_6f0fcb1d1c995fa9: I'm not afraid to say no
RD_ALifeLine_7835565117f0f88e: Raiders? Those are people, these are monsters, I'm more worried about these
RD_ALifeLine_0b8bd3262eac37f3: At the moment, the dead are worse than the living!
RD_ALifeLine_11bd94a3715d2c35: You look like you could take on a raider or two
RD_ALifeLine_290e066436dde95e: Raiders? Maybe... I heard voices, there could be some around
RD_ALifeLine_5cf59f442833b64b: I just saw strangers, I don't know who they were
RD_ALifeLine_5469b254418ebf37: They come at dusk, when you're tired
RD_ALifeLine_2e4b51f479526a10: A man with a smile and a shotgun is a scary thing
RD_ALifeLine_58396ffb65f62dbf: I met some on the road
RD_ALifeLine_1c55b160002b1548: You can tell by the way they walk
RD_ALifeLine_6b91a5cc11f682d8: I saw a farm they hit
RD_ALifeLine_3e1f74541835eb62: They took a girl from the church group
RD_ALifeLine_440d415f0c0f7794: Raiders? Oh, I've seen worse at the church bake sale
RD_ALifeLine_7afd703e3c610a36: Raiders? They'd starve at my house, I've got nothing but rice
RD_ALifeLine_07e7e97b05174ce6: They took everything... my cow, my garden, my husband's tools...
RD_ALifeLine_36c943103525e501: Raiders?! Cowards, thieves, scum, I'd like five minutes alone with each of them
RD_ALifeLine_73f0b5e3168965c1: They'll pay for what they did, if THERE's a God, they'll pay!
RD_ALifeLine_3a3a67a96fdea534: If they come I'm standing with you, you and me and everybody here
RD_ALifeLine_0a725dc44cad7c48: Raiders? Never heard of them, ha, you're looking at the nicest guy in the county
RD_ALifeLine_077b359720f3bb52: If you see them, you won't be talking about it for long
RD_ALifeLine_4cd147095e8ee9ff: Dangerous people, plenty of them, and none of them like being asked about
RD_ALifeLine_06f46c6275b6178b: There's raiders and there's raiders, and I'm the second kind, the kind you want to avoid
RD_ALifeLine_0ec6be6b60990326: Why, you looking for them? Or are you running from them
RD_ALifeLine_054b72700c154d42: Who's dangerous? Me, you idiot, right now!
RD_ALifeLine_430e133473696c26: Everyone's dangerous, but there are worse than me, trust that much
RD_ALifeLine_4ace8cd650a71a24: There are people who take what they want, and there are people who stop them, you're about to find out which I am
RD_ALifeLine_77143aa034aff3a0: Raiders? Man, there's crews out there, taking whatever, I don't mess with them
RD_ALifeLine_5bbba98f0c649bf7: Stay away from the east side, that's all I'll say
RD_ALifeLine_1aebc47605cd62b2: We keep our distance, they keep theirs, uneasy truce
RD_ALifeLine_42beb9b171660d38: Some people are more dangerous than the dead, you know what I'm saying?
RD_ALifeLine_523a5d89217a9009: Why, you looking for a fight? Because I'm happy to oblige
RD_ALifeLine_1aab812e02bf730a: Watch out for guys with rifles on the overpass, they're not friendly
RD_ALifeLine_4871899d2c1f0c75: I'd avoid anybody with more than two weapons and no friends
RD_ALifeLine_2ba5e41d48f1a474: We've had a few run-ins, most ended badly for them
RD_ALifeLine_00d537594a4a2368: Keep asking and you'll find out who's dangerous
RD_ALifeLine_67e354a07014e117: Be careful with strangers on the road, even ones who smile
RD_ALifeLine_2b122077216286e8: Some people look at all this and see a payday, that's all
RD_ALifeLine_17043bdf6bdca54f: Opportunists, yes, I know several personally
RD_ALifeLine_32a65d2037625ec1: I'd avoid anyone offering protection, they're usually the threat
RD_ALifeLine_0f76d24b46c8ef28: Be cautious, friend, I've seen what they do
RD_ALifeLine_7e49d57838bc3147: Raiders? Everybody's a raider now, including me, sorry
RD_ALifeLine_158c5a16212ae351: Stay away from groups of men with matching jackets
RD_ALifeLine_15cbb99e22932d9c: Don't tell anybody where you sleep, that's how they find you
RD_ALifeLine_2d1ae3ae31607793: I'm nobody's raider, I just want to be left alone!
RD_ALifeLine_5aac790272f63299: I was almost caught by a gang last week, ran for hours
RD_ALifeLine_1057b6bb793bc5f2: Heard about a crew near the quarry, took everything from a family
RD_ALifeLine_70e494576c53c9fb: Folks around here call them wolves, and they've earned it
RD_ALifeLine_3aa42d216c2252c7: Stay off the back roads after dark, that's their hunting ground
RD_ALifeLine_46250d2965ab6b23: If you meet them, don't resist, just give them what they want and walk away
RD_ALifeLine_250501e70e67a866: Some of the men from my unit went bad, I'm not proud of that
RD_ALifeLine_4a4d5d38660d7f21: We've received multiple reports of armed groups engaged in robbery and assault
RD_ALifeLine_0611fad55d2d6349: Deputies are working to identify them, but our resources are limited
RD_ALifeLine_4e87929023b6fd65: If you encounter armed individuals, do not confront them
RD_ALifeLine_3eae6f6e36ba827a: Several have been seen near the highway, we're trying to track them
RD_ALifeLine_2f7ce1ba23e41b2c: Are you reporting a crime? If not, move along
RD_ALifeLine_2382b8584f7d6a6f: We're doing everything we can to stop them, you can help by telling us what you've seen
RD_ALifeLine_06ea95187583c400: I know the ones causing trouble, and I intend to stop them
RD_ALifeLine_413d3bdd0f51b873: We have reports of armed civilians engaged in looting
RD_ALifeLine_2a95f26925915714: Avoid armed groups, return to your location
RD_ALifeLine_291ab3c6402a2ece: Armed civilians will be treated as hostile
RD_ALifeLine_14c5c11435800564: If you've seen any, let us know, we'll take care of it
RD_ALifeLine_5493039218227391: Some of the worst men I've ever met are wearing civilian clothes now
RD_ALifeLine_2e8bb8fb6aaeceed: I don't want to meet them, I really don't, I'm terrified of everyone with a gun
RD_ALifeLine_7aaa5738174d31a7: I deal with them, you don't need to
RD_ALifeLine_73be7c2c23d4b03b: Where there's chaos, there's profit, I'm sure they've noticed
RD_ALifeLine_7b5d775222e3c9be: There's a crew that hit the Johnson place last week, took everything
RD_ALifeLine_19e8d20e774fd5d5: We post guards every night, watch for strangers, anyone armed is trouble
RD_ALifeLine_521eaf7032f5a249: Not from around here, that's for sure, no local'd do that
RD_ALifeLine_1a4e120d075425d8: If you see anything, come tell us, we'll take care of it together
RD_ALifeLine_422e724b3c1382b9: A truck full of men took everything off the Millers' porch while they watched, didn't even hurry
RD_ALifeLine_17eda5f417c65348: Some men came by asking about my husband's guns, I said we didn't have any, I don't think they believed me
RD_ALifeLine_3252aa5f28b69da6: Yes, they killed my friend, I don't want to say who, just stay off the county roads in the evening
RD_ALifeLine_1977cb874162ea00: There's men in painted trucks going house to house, if you could do anything about them... would you help us?
RD_ALifeLine_074fd9fb1d23766b: Road crews on 31W, they lay out spike strips and wait, don't drive at night
RD_ALifeLine_7cc0febc23dff90c: Bad people, same as always, just nobody stopping them now, the ones who smile are the worst
RD_ALifeLine_24eb0c6e48275afc: Bunch of escapees came down from the prison, orange pants cut off into shorts, you'll know them
RD_ALifeLine_532aefd64f5aff9c: There's a crew stripping houses from West Point to Muldraugh, they spray-paint a mark on the doors they've hit
RD_ALifeLine_2b16b0c070195348: Could be you, for all I know, get going
RD_ALifeLine_70e37855673bc967: They shot up our ambulance for the drugs, we don't keep drugs in it anymore, we don't advertise that
RD_ALifeLine_159e4f6a06f2ab38: Men came for the church pantry, I gave them half and asked them to leave the rest for the children, they took it all
RD_ALifeLine_639886732804200c: At least two organized armed groups in the county, I'd call them what they are, robbers
RD_ALifeLine_33be70643cb2fc19: There's escapees loose from the prison, some were in there for good reason, tell me if you see them
RD_ALifeLine_264e898d5f4aeb93: I'm not briefing you, for all I know you're running with them, hands where I can see them
RD_ALifeLine_7924d93961f589ba: Hostile groups working near the river, we don't have the manpower to go after them
RD_ALifeLine_5eb17cff2af728ff: Armed groups present, known locations tracked, not your problem unless you make it one
RD_ALifeLine_1ae18077280529ce: Anybody armed and unidentified is hostile, that includes you right now
RD_ALifeLine_4ab109c77ca8f154: Watch the bikers by the river, they'll trade with you in the morning and rob you that night
RD_ALifeLine_7892435f2724e787: The city boys, kids with guns and nothing to lose, we keep our distance, you should too
RD_ALifeLine_484b668860a3ea50: Raiders? Nah, we're the welcoming committee
RD_ALifeLine_396e411851148df0: Who should you avoid? Us, bit late for that, though
RD_ALifeLine_7937405224fb1bd5: There's a crew works this road, I counted four, one of 'em carries a fence post
RD_ALifeLine_14b14baa7c16071b: I could tell you what they did at the Pruitt place, you want that in your head?
RD_ALifeLine_1d30ecac102c69dc: The ones in the blue van, you see a blue van, get off the road entirely
RD_ALifeLine_66cf1c1a01a16749: I won't call anybody evil, I will say don't be on Tanner Road after dark
RD_ALifeLine_7d3956a07f415854: Watch for anybody too friendly too fast, that's the tell, it's always the tell
RD_ALifeLine_68a836672128227e: We had names for some of 'em before, now they've got friends and no reason to stop
RD_ALifeLine_694db6063865deb8: Armed civilians in organized groups, that's the polite term and it ain't accurate
RD_ALifeLine_176cc42655bec1a2: Anybody with a lookout posted high has a plan, plans are what get people robbed
RD_ALifeLine_4330d6701c964448: There's a crew out there pretending to be us, same jackets, we aim to fix that
RD_ALifeLine_23368f240bcce20d: Two kinds, ones that want your food, and ones that want your company, second's worse
RD_ALifeLine_2dc041103e73adcd: Dangerous people, yeah, well, you've found some, congratulations to you
RD_ALifeLine_2379c98b521f58b0: There's more to it, you want the whole list, or just enough to stay clear?
RD_ALifeLine_5e7284ff028e44b0: I've kept a list, names, vehicles, days, you want to hear it read out?
RD_ALifeLine_240ec42969b2b007: The church on Elm Street has a cellar, we spent two nights there
RD_ALifeLine_37f5d008036a87f0: Barn at my cousin's place, only one door, easy to defend
RD_ALifeLine_10b4985c0095135f: The plant's storage room, steel door, no windows, plenty of room
RD_ALifeLine_1ac3178b7c6461e6: Fire station on Main, we keep the lights low and the doors barred
RD_ALifeLine_01531eb94d03e1b7: Courthouse, stone walls, one way in, it's holding for now
RD_ALifeLine_11904eea34dd11e4: Anywhere with one entrance and two exits, get it?
RD_ALifeLine_700684224c42435d: Hold at the checkpoint on 31W, we've got room for civilians
RD_ALifeLine_7020a39363ab36d1: Upper floor, one way in, clear sightlines, and take turns on watch
RD_ALifeLine_0b54f4bd4e607ed6: Nowhere is safe, pick the least bad
RD_ALifeLine_06e13ea63178ad4a: The quarry, good cover, a creek, nobody likes going there
RD_ALifeLine_0949d9e9734e7a82: Safe? Our place, but you'd have to earn your way in
RD_ALifeLine_2537082959a8c4b6: Back of the old laundromat, ain't nobody bothered us yet
RD_ALifeLine_32ddd4a8225ef42c: Clubhouse is as safe as it gets, not for the likes of you, though
RD_ALifeLine_5c39de32094430dc: A place exists, it has a price
RD_ALifeLine_38f4b4a852451b88: Not here, not anywhere, but the rail yard has boxcars
RD_ALifeLine_2bad902b44b4429a: Safe? Safe from WHAT? from them? from the living? from the cold? nowhere's safe, but some places are better
RD_ALifeLine_5c40c920190ffbf4: Try a cellar, with a lock, and a bucket, and a prayer, that's the best I can suggest
RD_ALifeLine_66e026d34fd04151: Somewhere high, upstairs, with the stairs blocked, somewhere with one way in!
RD_ALifeLine_265f7f8e435b74d7: I slept in a bathtub last night, with the door locked, and the radio on low, it was okay!
RD_ALifeLine_2cb9b2de65f8beba: Where nobody knows you're there, that's the safest, it's the only safe
RD_ALifeLine_3cc1f9ec27209d74: Don't ask me, I don't sleep, I sit up all night with a bat, so my advice isn't great
RD_ALifeLine_18a602bf29704c04: Anywhere with thick walls, a heavy door, and a back exit, and a plan for each
RD_ALifeLine_0a417d6762ae8849: I wouldn't count on one place staying safe, have somewhere else in mind before you settle in
RD_ALifeLine_1cb7c0900b5588e4: Somewhere you can see trouble coming and still get out, don't trust height alone
RD_ALifeLine_7a70ec52370aa8a6: Barns are decent, the loft, pull the ladder, stay quiet, sleep light
RD_ALifeLine_31a0bc5c5606c52b: Churches are good, they were built to last, and they're quiet, and people leave them alone
RD_ALifeLine_406b4a0e788d67b7: Check how you'd get out before you settle in, a good hiding place can turn into a trap
RD_ALifeLine_50b1f63a61511352: Look for a place that's already been cleared, someone did the work for you
RD_ALifeLine_1b1429a73c3919aa: You can stay with us for a night, if you promise to leave at dawn, no hard feelings
RD_ALifeLine_0e2e90a234c7225d: I know a spot, it's quiet, but you've got to keep it to yourself, deal?
RD_ALifeLine_43f61c0d6d9b6791: Stay close, I'll find us a spot
RD_ALifeLine_2e6a92574284bfb9: My spot's mine, it's not for sharing
RD_ALifeLine_743ffdf260a5245a: There's no safe place for you here
RD_ALifeLine_32cb737c53a26bdb: Safe places are for people I trust
RD_ALifeLine_595527f13437dfe2: You're standing in the safest place for you
RD_ALifeLine_406c9de35e1e323e: Don't know, and I wouldn't tell you if I did
RD_ALifeLine_51cdc35e07bcf32d: I'm not showing you where I sleep, find your own
RD_ALifeLine_3dcb32e41fca2a46: Anywhere away from me, that's safe for both of us
RD_ALifeLine_1496eac14107ca23: A hollow in the woods, a cave if you can find one, a rock overhang, nature's got better doors than people do
RD_ALifeLine_6bd88ce76dc8c93f: Treestand, off the ground, out of the reach, quiet, and a clear view, I've spent whole weeks in one
RD_ALifeLine_05c73bcb1398cefd: We hold a house on the edge of town, you can stop for a quick rest, but don't make a habit of it
RD_ALifeLine_7b1db38d7af4e718: My kitchen, honey, it's the only safe place I know, I've cooked three thousand meals there
RD_ALifeLine_39c85c7d724300ab: Under my bed, ha, I know, I'm a kid, but I've gone there three times, and it works
RD_ALifeLine_1bb2c3913245780a: Anywhere with a steel door, I'd say the plant, the garage, the warehouse, anywhere built like a fortress
RD_ALifeLine_00806ddf0245babb: Anywhere clean, anywhere quiet, anywhere with a bed and a door that locks
RD_ALifeLine_3acc513d2cdbe211: The sanctuary, always, the walls are thick, the doors are old, the pews are hard, but it's safe
RD_ALifeLine_3ca3a8b80f04dcc1: The firehouse, if you can get in, the bay doors are thick, the roof is flat
RD_ALifeLine_0a71f99322dc30bb: Our post, but we don't take outsiders, the numbers don't work
RD_ALifeLine_405698552146ee22: Anywhere clean... anywhere quiet, anywhere with a door that locks and a floor you can sleep on
RD_ALifeLine_2197995d2d232d41: You want safe? Find water and a bed and somebody you trust, then don't leave any of 'em
RD_ALifeLine_406075d45e981aea: Not a hospital, God no, not a hospital, never again
RD_ALifeLine_1043163363ffea47: One door, no windows, no carpet... something you can scrub and defend
RD_ALifeLine_17141391095ca7f3: There's no safe place for you, not from me, not from here
RD_ALifeLine_2c7ad6b064c0cdef: Come to ours, there's room, and I'll put in a word for you
RD_ALifeLine_6c2bc883401cc42e: There's a cellar by the church, with a lock only I have the key to, take it, hide there
RD_ALifeLine_6af2a1ac57aa12ce: Follow the creek north to the old stone barn, nobody knows it, nobody goes, it's yours
RD_ALifeLine_76c40cc22ae08ad0: I know a house on the hill, the owners left, the windows are boarded, it's quiet!
RD_ALifeLine_55a4dd7b50be133a: Try a school gym, the back door, say a friend sent you
RD_ALifeLine_114d50b27a9f4392: An attic over a hardware store is solid, if the ladder is still there
RD_ALifeLine_17979f331f395a57: Stay with my cousin on the north side, tell him I sent you, he'll feed you
RD_ALifeLine_5947014572b841c7: If you hear whistling, three notes, that's us, follow it
RD_ALifeLine_414c79545084da9f: There's a bunker behind the cemetery, an old root cellar, perfect!!
RD_ALifeLine_256ee6e155259a0c: Come by sundown, knock twice, say your name, and wait
RD_ALifeLine_46a1253e4eb8c80a: The fire station's loft is dry and quiet, tell them I said so
RD_ALifeLine_5a9e042809bc110e: I'd offer my own home, but it's full, so ask around for a friend of mine!
RD_ALifeLine_37c6d2bf077cf3c5: Take the key from under the third flowerpot, it's the cabin by the pond, make yourself at home
RD_ALifeLine_526ecb3339228150: Funeral home's got a basement that's real comfortable, weird as that sounds!!
RD_ALifeLine_14f336295fd23e18: There's a spot in the woods, a hunting blind, with a view and a blanket
RD_ALifeLine_55de04412938c4ec: My sister's got a spare room, and a strong lock, tell her I sent you!!
RD_ALifeLine_6110befc32f34bfd: It's not fancy, but the old rail depot has a stove and a roof
RD_ALifeLine_288eb79e7928d4a8: Go where the smoke is thin and the chimney's tall, and ask for the old woman
RD_ALifeLine_15abe07c574ce18e: You've done right by us, so we'll do right by you, come on in
RD_ALifeLine_5976992939e113e6: The church has room, always has, always will, and you're welcome
RD_ALifeLine_1b6d4fad69348ed7: It's no trouble to find, you'll see the smoke!
RD_ALifeLine_30056d2c75cc88d0: Look for the house with the swing set, tell them a friend sent you
RD_ALifeLine_7f70b5f4545a0b5d: Look for a red ribbon on a post, it ends somewhere safe
RD_ALifeLine_54d9d5a91e6dffcc: Safe? With us, that's my answer!
RD_ALifeLine_2b82f2ea775d42c2: There's a cot in my place, you can have it for the night, no questions
RD_ALifeLine_6c0294a64b7f1821: We share, we always share, and you've shared with us, so, come!
RD_ALifeLine_7ebdca837f4a993f: The library's back room has beds, and nobody to bother you
RD_ALifeLine_0d6cb4476cba1ae6: There's a key on a nail somewhere that opens a door you'll like
RD_ALifeLine_2c9f8d492c59f0c7: I can't promise perfect, but I can promise it's better than the ditch!
RD_ALifeLine_65d8b194407a9248: You can sleep at my place tonight, the couch is lumpy, but it's safe
RD_ALifeLine_5e4c8fe07447c19b: There's a ditch down the road, try that
RD_ALifeLine_047fd7c028271d1a: Safe for you? That's a joke
RD_ALifeLine_2d258203360f380a: Find your own place, I had to
RD_ALifeLine_143ed1196652fcbd: Nobody will take you in, not around here
RD_ALifeLine_25524a7f17bfb62c: There's an empty field, and that's it
RD_ALifeLine_04494e8565b61242: You'll sleep where you've made your bed
RD_ALifeLine_7c9c34a973453ec8: No, no, no, a thousand times no
RD_ALifeLine_685c127c182da58b: Try the wilderness, it doesn't know you yet
RD_ALifeLine_2a1f8871308ab904: Safe places are for decent people
RD_ALifeLine_5b1378ef4a19be84: Sorry, I don't know of any, and I wouldn't tell you
RD_ALifeLine_3cb1800326c3e17b: Pick a tree, and climb it
RD_ALifeLine_1d9f92c97c90ebe5: You've burned too many bridges, so you'll have to cross the river
RD_ALifeLine_1b08ced5106975a8: Don't look at me for shelter
RD_ALifeLine_18070082168feae0: The quarry might have an open hole for you
RD_ALifeLine_2919435b142731ac: I hear the cold is bracing this time of year
RD_ALifeLine_5a381531622484ba: You could try asking the people you wronged!
RD_ALifeLine_4a2fb46800c7bf97: There's nothing safe for you, anywhere, I suspect
RD_ALifeLine_2dd063fa1609eb3d: Just keep walking, you'll find a ditch eventually
RD_ALifeLine_05baba595eb65cc4: I'd offer a blanket, but I don't!
RD_ALifeLine_4e50a7773083702b: If you find a safe place, don't TELL me where!
RD_ALifeLine_189643ef5bfe7a0c: Hide wherever you can, I don't care
RD_ALifeLine_6dafe80661f84e3e: The woods are lovely this time of year, I HEAR!!
RD_ALifeLine_2716b73c580dc9c3: Not my problem, not my place, not my choice
RD_ALifeLine_7d27829a66219a4a: I'd leave the county, if I were you
RD_ALifeLine_1c0e55006c5d92b8: Sleep with one eye open, you'll need it!
RD_ALifeLine_3a9c45fc03fd75e6: There's no shelter for people like you, not tonight!
RD_ALifeLine_5c93919009f48cac: Not here! not HERE! somewhere else, somewhere quiet
RD_ALifeLine_1b4744cc1ab15fa8: C-come on, come on, I know a place, nearby, nearby enough
RD_ALifeLine_1ff3849d2b2aa2d5: N-not this spot... that's for sure, not this spot
RD_ALifeLine_0cded5385f998c9d: We'll find one, we'll find one, just move
RD_ALifeLine_2d93e11f377c3478: Wherever you're standing, as long as you cover the door
RD_ALifeLine_334ee65e4b5729c6: I slept in a church last night
RD_ALifeLine_409ce1675dc8686c: Find a room with a lock and a window you can see out of, and not be seen through
RD_ALifeLine_4ad008520f57d01d: The attic is good, if you can pull up the ladder
RD_ALifeLine_4039bde116540122: Somewhere near water... but not too near
