RD_ALifeLine_2dfb9ac63c3719da: Last fella traded me a jar of pickles with a dead man's finger in it - so I'm looking real close this time
RD_ALifeLine_50f228474a1665cc: Not with you, I seen who you run with
RD_ALifeLine_6271473b16adef7e: I swapped at the Rosewood flea market forty years, I know a bad deal before you open your mouth, go on
RD_ALifeLine_115255687452ccd0: I've got a socket set and duct tape, tools for food, that's the only deal I make
RD_ALifeLine_169d103b5b55f416: Swapping's how the plant ran on second shift, smokes for shifts, sandwiches for favors, show me
RD_ALifeLine_556339990e5989ee: I'll trade you medical care for food, that's a fair deal and you know it
RD_ALifeLine_03f2cb7d69d312b6: We don't trade at the church, we share, but if you want to leave something, I'll give something back
RD_ALifeLine_3f0657ea28a14275: Put it on the ground and step away, we'll see if there's a trade after
RD_ALifeLine_18e8a99a4326e821: I'm not buying anything you picked out of a dead man's house, or am I, show me
RD_ALifeLine_5437ff9a318fd52f: Not a swap meet, move along before I ask where you got that
RD_ALifeLine_392350d65203eca6: I got a Walkman and two tapes, you got any candy? Anything sweet? I'd trade for sweet
RD_ALifeLine_711cab6d573c87b1: Soldiers trade MREs for everything, fine, what've you got and what do you want?
RD_ALifeLine_078a190e4287f7ba: Negative on trade with the patrol, clear the road
RD_ALifeLine_0c3aabed33228f68: I trade, I also remember faces, don't try to pass me watered gas
RD_ALifeLine_7f1c5ca13c3d57f9: Trade? Sure, you give me everything, I give you your legs back, fair?
RD_ALifeLine_08ee3535294002e0: Look at this, a businessman, okay, businessman, what'cha got in the bag?
RD_ALifeLine_0d263843130b33a7: The block does business, boss sets the rates - you take the rates or you take a walk
RD_ALifeLine_1d7aba7075514450: Trade with us? You don't even know who you're talking to, beat it
RD_ALifeLine_1572634726f79f2e: Citizens don't trade with patches, citizens pay tolls, know the difference
RD_ALifeLine_0651365b523598e5: Of course, everything in Knox County is for sale now, including loyalty, what are you offering?
RD_ALifeLine_274eb693019d725c: I don't do business with nervous people, you look nervous
RD_ALifeLine_2151b4404becbb7d: Inside I ran the commissary on my tier, Soups and stamps, I'll trade you, I'll also cheat you, deal?
RD_ALifeLine_37271f235c3296a9: Depends, you carrying anything worth my time, or just asking around?
RD_ALifeLine_5b07b0ad14bc1d40: I'll trade, are we doing this straight, both hands where I can see 'em?
RD_ALifeLine_683ccb3c024e9e6a: I've got goods, do you actually have something, or are you just looking?
RD_ALifeLine_050ee202482616e5: I only take useful stuff, batteries, fuel, blades, don't bring me jewelry or promises
RD_ALifeLine_6c31b9177047369a: I don't trade, I give what we can spare, you give what you can, same thing, kinder
RD_ALifeLine_1a29cc4b1e749378: I'm not running a commissary, if you're hungry, say hungry, and I'll see
RD_ALifeLine_11c110576da23932: Now you're speaking my language, show me first, I never go first
RD_ALifeLine_736ddb1c0c8e3c05: I trade, Rate's whatever you need worse than I need it, that's just economics
RD_ALifeLine_7ab4a8c128b795b4: Trade! Sure, you give me everything and I let you walk, that's the trade
RD_ALifeLine_0764e30c4d95912a: Weapon? You'd have to look for something yourself, I'm not offering one
RD_ALifeLine_4c028345051e0615: I can't supply you, maybe ask around, without assuming anybody owes you
RD_ALifeLine_20e045e709a073e5: I'm not giving you anything that can hurt me
RD_ALifeLine_02a0bbca32da48e6: You want me to give you a gun? Are you insane!
RD_ALifeLine_5347b22070e4b555: No weapon from me, keep your eyes off my stuff
RD_ALifeLine_13655a0c4c1783dd: Go find your own, I'm not arming a stranger
RD_ALifeLine_79b68d1b04e5fd92: I'm not agreeing to arm you!
RD_ALifeLine_7db5d2765beaed27: I'd rather give you a lecture
RD_ALifeLine_6e7ecab721b21a29: Not mine to promise, you could check hardware stores, but I don't know what's left
RD_ALifeLine_58975c87028b7308: You want a weapon? That's a bad idea, friend
RD_ALifeLine_6f48b38a4fa91ca4: I won't agree to hand you a weapon
RD_ALifeLine_30b6dad51e336a96: A weapon costs, you got something worth a gun?
RD_ALifeLine_40a6e95f0b10a2a2: Look for something you know how to handle, don't take a guess because it's heavy
RD_ALifeLine_7f48270209809e2b: Why? So you can use it on me?
RD_ALifeLine_6e6189990fec302c: You want me to arm you? Keep dreaming
RD_ALifeLine_5e7a75d4176a5e91: Find your own, I can't tell you where one will be
RD_ALifeLine_090e347241989bd3: A weapon? I- no, I'm terrified, and I don't want to arm someone I don't know
RD_ALifeLine_5a064f9762932493: Kitchen tools might be worth looking at, don't count on me having a spare
RD_ALifeLine_0aeef0eb19b66e0e: N-no, never liked guns, now I don't know what to think
RD_ALifeLine_5096e3920e4664b2: I used to reach for a wrench when anything went wrong. Different trouble now
RD_ALifeLine_53480340282c0847: I wouldn't agree to arm you, I'm sorry, I just can't
RD_ALifeLine_7f23658f28e1dc2f: Everyone needs one, and no one wants to give theirs up, can't blame you
RD_ALifeLine_278402254ee11c30: I'm not lending weapons, please don't ask again
RD_ALifeLine_1562c4fb48090798: You could try hardware stores or hunting lodges, I don't know what you'd find
RD_ALifeLine_1fbe2ec114a15ba2: I could talk about improvised weapons, don't mistake me for an expert
RD_ALifeLine_64677f1914fbcd48: Sorry, I can't offer you one
RD_ALifeLine_006c96cb183c113f: I'd share if I could, I can't promise a weapon
RD_ALifeLine_1f43bdde0cf48994: Look, if you're in trouble, say so, I can't give you much, but I can stand beside you
RD_ALifeLine_7a1504f123d0150c: Quiet doesn't mean safe, I'd choose something I actually knew how to handle
RD_ALifeLine_01203fa77ace22bf: Weapons are issued, not given, and I'm not authorized to issue anything
RD_ALifeLine_3d623fb36dd3ab1d: You've got one already... what more do you want? that thing in your hands looks plenty dangerous
RD_ALifeLine_45ddf16b529ad48f: I wish I could hand you an easy answer, I can't promise a weapon
RD_ALifeLine_0a52a31969a762e5: You're welcome to look for yourself, I don't know what you'll find
RD_ALifeLine_6ba44f920a402aae: Places people kept tools might be worth checking, I'm not promising a find
RD_ALifeLine_31245d4041d880b9: I trust you, still doesn't mean I can promise to arm you
RD_ALifeLine_16b3ab073a21852f: I can't point you to a rifle I know is still there, ask around
RD_ALifeLine_27f57794531da0ad: I could talk through some ideas. We'd have to check what was actually usable
RD_ALifeLine_3d7fe56b3762da1d: A cast-iron pan works fine, I've used one!
RD_ALifeLine_1b524b357f07814d: You've been good to us, so I won't send you chasing a made-up stash
RD_ALifeLine_4518c0b3618aba21: Maybe we can discuss what would help, I can't promise a weapon
RD_ALifeLine_324fc7900807c045: Wrap a towel around a pipe, and you've got a good grip and a better swing!
RD_ALifeLine_71da7a4604e4f669: You could ask somebody who hunts, ask, don't assume they have spares
RD_ALifeLine_23af687345d0f885: Tools might help if you know how to handle them, don't hurt yourself experimenting
RD_ALifeLine_0dcdf78e33565782: I wish I could, I truly do, I'd hate to see you out there with nothing
RD_ALifeLine_4c2dcb467294ad8b: Make friends, a friend is the best weapon there is!
RD_ALifeLine_55b9af154e4e27d0: Sorry. Arming somebody isn't something I'll agree to lightly
RD_ALifeLine_339925033ef102c1: Ask around, carefully, I don't know who has something to spare
RD_ALifeLine_0007d5ba26a71216: I'd rather disappoint you than promise a weapon I can't provide
RD_ALifeLine_76122f8933b2cae2: You might find something useful among ordinary tools. You'd have to look
RD_ALifeLine_27eb37c61aeb91ff: Take care of yourself, and don't wander without something in your hand!
RD_ALifeLine_747b4c7e66d55fd3: Keep your eyes open, I can't tell you which place will have a weapon
RD_ALifeLine_65f98465661c5745: My boy used to carry a baseball bat everywhere. Makes me think of him when people ask
RD_ALifeLine_2e26d2cf29e884bd: Look, I want to help, but I can't, and I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_50878e53103e90a1: I miss the days when the hunting rifle was just for hunting
RD_ALifeLine_0cfad31622279208: Sorry, not this time, maybe next time
RD_ALifeLine_29e411e3351dc0b5: I'll keep an ear out for spares, and I'll tell you if I hear of any
RD_ALifeLine_166e6a79132a65a3: I can't promise a weapon for myself or anybody else
RD_ALifeLine_2bc5468b4fe18e46: You deserve one, honestly, you've earned it
RD_ALifeLine_56c034976ed05d7b: I can't offer a spare gun, and I won't speak for anybody else
RD_ALifeLine_7ceaf06c7b00db79: I'd drive you to the armory, if there were a car, and an armory
RD_ALifeLine_1102de7025f82743: The best weapon is a head start, so, run fast
RD_ALifeLine_6a03bee31fc327f4: You want a weapon? Hit yourself with a rock
RD_ALifeLine_598f0e0f424dc633: Don't give you a weapon? I'd sooner give you a map to hell
RD_ALifeLine_066a6b683e5dcf33: The thought of arming you is terrifying
RD_ALifeLine_79ad048560911a76: Why would I arm someone I don't trust?!
RD_ALifeLine_2e5b49582f9b2d62: Go find a stick, since you're good at hitting people
RD_ALifeLine_43683ba759293f8f: I'd give you my fist, if it came to that
RD_ALifeLine_11f3cdfe5de2d452: I'm not the arsenal you're looking for
RD_ALifeLine_095db43108615e41: Do you ever stop wanting something that can hurt people
RD_ALifeLine_7b1b41d625c01d5c: Steal one, like you always do
RD_ALifeLine_6170c5fd765288d2: I'm not going to agree to arm you
RD_ALifeLine_0aa14484677eb725: You're the kind of person who makes weapons necessary
RD_ALifeLine_13ff278a25342cc3: Try breaking into a house, I hear you're good at it
RD_ALifeLine_53b57f503d6b1e0b: I'd rather you walked around unarmed
RD_ALifeLine_578aa8a641430a11: That's the last thing I'd do
RD_ALifeLine_02fcf5c94b7a5239: Try asking someone who doesn't know you!
RD_ALifeLine_7c706e19301a0429: A weapon? Anything! Find anything! A bat, a pipe, a shovel!
RD_ALifeLine_56ba564e64341c3b: If I had a weapon, I'd be using it!
RD_ALifeLine_7cf5e5f74894adcd: I'm trying to think! Don't expect an easy answer from me
RD_ALifeLine_01c79ce757a3bfd6: Grab a branch, grab a brick, grab a brain
RD_ALifeLine_4b6af8772976d32b: You've got one, remember? use it
RD_ALifeLine_55ecb0c03e956fde: We don't discuss that around here, especially with you
RD_ALifeLine_69c3560706e20070: I'll spare you the details, and myself the trouble
RD_ALifeLine_5873944711a45499: That! THAT is what happened, right there!
RD_ALifeLine_3c6860d526ff982c: Later, later, tell you later, right now we run
RD_ALifeLine_15bced8d4422076d: I- it's happening again, right now, right here
RD_ALifeLine_5c5e8d3f36091e09: No time to explain, no time, move
RD_ALifeLine_3a0b6e602d42d2f0: They happened, they're happening, they're about to happen to us
RD_ALifeLine_05bd1e9513d1e7fe: I'd love to tell you... but we have company!
RD_ALifeLine_012e7c1640f12f2a: It's still happening, it never stopped, look!
RD_ALifeLine_12a0b20e76c5441e: Something bad, something that needs people like you, armed and ready
RD_ALifeLine_7d59e1e241ac888d: I came out of the woods and the world had changed
RD_ALifeLine_12ff42a724178110: A man stumbled up my trail, begging
RD_ALifeLine_2e16ff1e725e7cbb: I was shelling beans on the porch when the sirens started
RD_ALifeLine_3e4b3a5b302d8476: The sickness came on the wind, I think
RD_ALifeLine_31cee3734024647b: Dear, I lived through the polio summers
RD_ALifeLine_08ec04f40cb67904: Ask the young ones, they have a screen for EVERYTHING!
RD_ALifeLine_52742fef48a3653f: Somebody got sick, like REALLY sick, then died, then... un-died
RD_ALifeLine_3d114653531939c4: I was at a friend's house, we were watching TV
RD_ALifeLine_1e1966815de7af74: Friday, shift change, a guy collapsed on the line
RD_ALifeLine_2da312983461d441: Nobody told us anything, we just got an announcement to go home
RD_ALifeLine_473a2f357a69632f: The guy next to me at the machine... he coughed blood on the part
RD_ALifeLine_0c903e6c0ffc14fb: We were at my in-laws' for dinner when the news broke
RD_ALifeLine_748ed6954d731811: The kids' school called... said to pick them up
RD_ALifeLine_77e1c2493cf01827: My wife was at the store
RD_ALifeLine_720214397de73ca1: I was in the vestry, preparing for Sunday
RD_ALifeLine_122ab97e2765a522: It came upon us like the plagues of old
RD_ALifeLine_0ce6938e7b2094e5: The first funeral was a Saturday...
RD_ALifeLine_3a0e0b88556a798e: I won't speak of it with a stranger
RD_ALifeLine_7347599263b7b5ee: We got a call for a man down at the grocery...
RD_ALifeLine_78e1d79321ab4ecf: Dispatch started sending us to the same address over and over
RD_ALifeLine_3038c6b755c5828a: We pulled twelve out of a church basement
RD_ALifeLine_7e70018945712620: We got called out on a Friday
RD_ALifeLine_5c4bf47e70379c6c: Orders changed three times in the first hour
RD_ALifeLine_31afeeaf3bb0c8f2: The first night, we lost four to friendly fire
RD_ALifeLine_57e9fd170fc94683: It was Friday, Friday afternoon, everything normal, and then
RD_ALifeLine_71730de959f4eedb: I can't make sense of it, it happened THIS WEEK, it's still happening
RD_ALifeLine_64d54d674ca436ba: It started on the Fourth... I think, or just after...
RD_ALifeLine_57a369cf24129926: Three days ago I had a job, a house, a husband
RD_ALifeLine_17a8286d5ad89f9e: About a week ago, everything fell apart
RD_ALifeLine_7caf03000757c8d0: The first few days were chaos, now it's just survival
RD_ALifeLine_7152bcb83c0a627f: It was the start of the summer, and now the summer's nearly gone
RD_ALifeLine_63b0d6651f2171b0: The details blur, but the feeling never does
RD_ALifeLine_5a8d97676dfe6140: My husband was fixing the mower when the neighbors started screaming
RD_ALifeLine_5e507bad03a7623e: My brother called and said turn on the TV
RD_ALifeLine_40626c2f15a91277: I drove through three towns that morning
RD_ALifeLine_7ad7007f204e304f: It started in the next county
RD_ALifeLine_4c4954ab1d8d203f: A man walked into my store, white as a sheet, and asked for a glass of water
RD_ALifeLine_59c5fe3325d4db3e: Sit with me, I'll tell you, but hold my hand through the bad part
RD_ALifeLine_23a4dc912f6a00df: The whole damn world fell on its face and I got a front row seat with a gun in my hand, best thing that ever happened
RD_ALifeLine_3127577406c4bc8c: You really don't know? Friday night people started biting people, what rock were you hiding under
RD_ALifeLine_26279f6a11bdb364: Dead folks got up and went for the living, and nobody with a badge showed to fix it, that's what happened
RD_ALifeLine_60b4d1f960dcb468: I was in the middle of a job, looked up, whole street was screaming, and I thought, huh, there goes the neighborhood
RD_ALifeLine_1647a5cc3b133295: Rules ended, simple as that, now it's whoever's got the most guns and the least manners
RD_ALifeLine_481cf30f67627141: Something knocked out everybody who used to tell me what to do, so no, I'm not crying about it
RD_ALifeLine_5542da894568bca8: My boss turned on me in the middle of a count, bit a chunk out of a guy's neck... best day of my life, honestly
RD_ALifeLine_4ceee86b2f0ebe71: It all went to hell in about six hours, then the radio died, then the lights flickered, then it was us
RD_ALifeLine_308ffd505b8e51de: You want the long version or the one where I don't get bored? Dead walk, the living lose, I don't
RD_ALifeLine_4fc7211b3f15bc2c: Don't act like you didn't see it, half the county's chewing on the other half
RD_ALifeLine_35a5359d2cdd500d: You want a history lesson? Take one from the dirt!
RD_ALifeLine_1d2632c9483ec92b: Happened is, you stumbled up on the wrong guy at the wrong time, keep talking, find out more
RD_ALifeLine_65e241c643bfa4d7: Ask the dead, they're real chatty right before they eat you
RD_ALifeLine_6f8fb4cc55174553: Friday the ninth, I'll never forget it, sirens never stopped and then they did all at once
RD_ALifeLine_7a4cd11565f45e07: I wish I could tell you, I keep going over it and over it, none of it makes sense
RD_ALifeLine_73299b8c760a3f20: Just a regular night, then screaming, then it never stopped... I don't wanna talk about it, sorry
RD_ALifeLine_67156a5e6bb0624c: The old world died and somebody had to pick up the pieces, I intend to be the somebody
RD_ALifeLine_28f006ae1a3b93a6: What happened is a lot of weak people stopped being a problem
RD_ALifeLine_25022b5f7c8650c3: Everything went crazy, my cousin got bit at the cookout then he ate my aunt, I'm not making this up
RD_ALifeLine_3c1644f01634eb5e: Whole block lost its mind, cops stopped coming, it was every man for himself
RD_ALifeLine_49e5d0c8746e2e74: Folks started turning, the news went dark, and now WE are the law, you feel me?
RD_ALifeLine_153b76fa1bd5c47a: Nobody knows, but I'll tell you this, it ain't stopping
RD_ALifeLine_6f78be7921167ada: We were having a regular Friday, then somebody started screaming at the corner store and it spread like wildfire
RD_ALifeLine_3d9427da59d987ea: Mama called me crying about the neighbors, by the time I got there she was gone, that's what happened
RD_ALifeLine_139e9dcb7dc1aaf7: Dead people eating live people, how many ways you want me to say it
RD_ALifeLine_50b8b6a37e44f1e4: Ask the dead, they'll tell you, right before they eat your face
RD_ALifeLine_3fccf1316f5f78fc: What happened is you walked into the wrong block, that's what!
RD_ALifeLine_6a7a77fd4b5ffbe9: Man... I wish I knew, I lost half my people in the first two days, still can't believe it
RD_ALifeLine_5c6e9e3a24baa2f2: One day we're running the streets, next day the streets are running us, hand to God
RD_ALifeLine_65cc23b86ef8ff73: We were at a rally, hand to God, whole crowd just turned, brothers eating brothers
RD_ALifeLine_5d08ee2f34febda4: Who the hell knows, I was on the road and by the time I got back it was already over
RD_ALifeLine_73aa428e12e74ff1: The Army locked the county and left us to rot, that's what happened
RD_ALifeLine_506ece8d2e0feabb: Somebody screwed up somewhere and we're paying for it, always the same
RD_ALifeLine_39a0045a337044b8: I was on the highway when the radio started going nuts, by the time I stopped, everything was burning
RD_ALifeLine_64ae31d45e261133: Folks got sick, got mean, got dead, got up again, in that order
RD_ALifeLine_55f43a4774ccc753: What happened is you asked the wrong man the wrong question
RD_ALifeLine_655ae1765bd34635: Lost four of my guys in a day, I'm still trying to wrap my head around it
RD_ALifeLine_400db8ec324810d6: There was an incident, then a cover-up, and now there's this, fill in the rest yourself
RD_ALifeLine_6de9accb1b76b7e8: Someone made a mistake, and everyone is paying for it, as usual
RD_ALifeLine_455d00661b43e126: Rumor is it started at a plant and spread, but rumors are cheap
RD_ALifeLine_01c5d12113d672bf: My sources said the Army knew and let it go anyway, which doesn't surprise me
RD_ALifeLine_67192a913fb2c1d0: It looked like a flu, then like a riot, then like the end of everything
RD_ALifeLine_55a7b1ea1bc897a7: I lost three associates in one night, it's hard to put into words
RD_ALifeLine_45e594a71dee3cae: We were on lockdown, then the guards started screaming, then the lights went out... that's how I got out
RD_ALifeLine_0f3ad9bd298eadd0: The whole place went crazy, dead men walking in the cafeteria, I-- I saw things I can't say
RD_ALifeLine_1f9e98016f9c91fa: I don't know, honest, I was in a cell, I only heard the screaming through the vents
RD_ALifeLine_7c65089a6f1f690b: Guards ran, doors opened, so I ran... that's it, that's ALL I know
RD_ALifeLine_73e52c37093da2f1: Nobody told us anything, one day the hacks just stopped coming, and then the sounds started
RD_ALifeLine_2323bacb48ff9253: I don't know! Don't ask me! Leave me alone!
RD_ALifeLine_4178a5ed73f0a0de: Somebody died, somebody got up, I got out, end of story!
RD_ALifeLine_38ed4daa0f174a94: Honestly? Best day of my life and the worst, hard to explain
RD_ALifeLine_781928af49836e30: Folks got sick, died, got up, bit their families, pretty straightforward when you boil it down
RD_ALifeLine_4ea277f60dca759c: Sheriff's office went quiet first, then the radios, then everything else
RD_ALifeLine_5eb1dab02081e6b1: I was camping up in the hills, came down and the whole town was on fire
RD_ALifeLine_553d9176357360fb: One day the grocery store was full of people, next day it was full of something else
RD_ALifeLine_46a2a6cc71841eeb: Somebody dropped the ball and the ball broke the county
RD_ALifeLine_7b1c5d245d775852: You want answers, ask the dead
RD_ALifeLine_61061c505f166fc1: Nobody knows, friend, but I'm glad we both made it this far
RD_ALifeLine_380e360b278dc2a6: I-- they told us to hold the line, then they told us to run, I don't know what happened in between
RD_ALifeLine_5e81d80368cc8424: We got orders to fire on civilians, I didn't do it, cross my heart I didn't
RD_ALifeLine_25fc92ec5aa93af7: Calls came in all night, the dispatchers couldn't keep up, then the lines went dead
RD_ALifeLine_676462c32c1faf87: First it looked like a riot, then a disease, now I don't know what to call it
RD_ALifeLine_23b4374224e9724c: Nobody told us a thing, we found out when the first deputy got bitten
RD_ALifeLine_67c26314782e1b4a: We got reports of assaults, then more, then they stopped being assaults and started being something worse
RD_ALifeLine_0aff33b1300f2638: It started at the hospital, a man died and stood back up, and I knew right then
RD_ALifeLine_6228b11109917445: It went from bad to worse so fast, I'm still trying to remember what day it is
RD_ALifeLine_2e74ce816894a555: That's not a question you should be asking, answer mine instead
RD_ALifeLine_15045fb632e4c103: It's a nightmare, but we'll get through it together, I promise you that
RD_ALifeLine_486b69dd335eebc0: Honestly, I don't have good answers either, but I'm glad to see someone alive
RD_ALifeLine_3a22eaf87fb43432: It started as a flu on the north end of the county, within two days we had bodies in the street
RD_ALifeLine_2251c1d1015fa7b9: Highways jammed, people trying to leave, then the roadblocks went up and nobody could
RD_ALifeLine_671096e73c170e98: I saw it first at the hospital, a man died and stood back up, and I knew
RD_ALifeLine_6201fe995fb99800: Inmate bit a guard, guard bit a guard, within an hour the cell block was a slaughterhouse
RD_ALifeLine_3a0479637e3ba0d4: We got called for a barricade, that barricade turned out to be the first of many
RD_ALifeLine_7cd7876e3157d2ef: Entered a house on a domestic, found something that was not a domestic
RD_ALifeLine_181f2fb936466757: We were deployed under quarantine protocol, that's all I can tell you

RD_ALifeLine_4e9fcd973f74ba91: To a patient, always to a patient, there's always another one
RD_ALifeLine_0f1ca41e3d9b504c: Away from you, as quickly as possible
RD_ALifeLine_1ba4d18f55f18b4c: None of your business, and don't follow me
RD_ALifeLine_6ae1e2727e018d18: Not telling you, and not looking back
RD_ALifeLine_0195d62461d9f6cf: I'll go where I like, and you'll go where you like, separately
RD_ALifeLine_53638c0457c170cd: Why? do you want a head start?
RD_ALifeLine_77a6b0f6123a2318: Where I'm going stays mine, and don't follow me
RD_ALifeLine_15febca4269e8522: Somewhere quiet, and free of you
RD_ALifeLine_5b0022755ccbf473: I'm not sharing my plans with you
RD_ALifeLine_668b48185be69f7a: You'll see my back, that's all
RD_ALifeLine_238570e50aeb5368: If I told you, you'd show up
RD_ALifeLine_17c158da6d7779be: Home, and I'd lock the door behind me
RD_ALifeLine_17a1694d423aa331: Out of town, and out of reach
RD_ALifeLine_76beb14252a4b3a8: You can guess, but you'll guess wrong
RD_ALifeLine_1a1240df0667ddd3: I don't owe you a destination
RD_ALifeLine_542ca39e2d3b91df: I'm headed where I'm needed, and that's not here, not with you
RD_ALifeLine_260303612632f4f5: That's my business, and I'd like to keep it that way!!
RD_ALifeLine_0e31760f5cf4af26: Why, so you can ambush me?!
RD_ALifeLine_53923fe330da9b4a: Oh, don't worry, you won't be invited!!
RD_ALifeLine_309decc8189c49a7: Away from THAT, away from THAT, that's where I'm going
RD_ALifeLine_22e95a863be06598: Anywhere but here, anywhere, I'm leaving, come if you want
RD_ALifeLine_210bc8dd484b8480: Out, out, out, out of here
RD_ALifeLine_48ac1f4d7b1b6b4f: I had a plan, but they ruined it, new plan: run
RD_ALifeLine_093ba5b657aa27c7: Toward the quiet, away from the noise
RD_ALifeLine_567869225ff633c5: Wherever you're going, I'd feel safer behind you
RD_ALifeLine_3321292238ef7a30: I'm going to find my brother
RD_ALifeLine_4abd95fb01fb918a: Just to the end of the road
RD_ALifeLine_22cf7c76724693b4: To check on an old friend
RD_ALifeLine_134fb06a157e31b2: Down to the creek to fill my jugs
RD_ALifeLine_24e61a39189b32eb: To check on a man up the road
RD_ALifeLine_684e57213687d521: Over to see about a dog
RD_ALifeLine_503baa405522e4ff: To the end of the lane and back
RD_ALifeLine_797dcba456a18df6: To find some folks I met
RD_ALifeLine_010ac1cc59310001: I'd love for you to come along
RD_ALifeLine_1d457edb6ee3b316: I'd like company on the walk
RD_ALifeLine_2f7bb6f82428ba9f: Where I'm going is my business
RD_ALifeLine_3b91c616157121ed: I'll let you know when it's none of your business!
RD_ALifeLine_0f1f502b022d4105: Mind your own, I'm going where I'm going!
RD_ALifeLine_5b6f0c1447506171: Up the ridge, to see about a trap line
RD_ALifeLine_605a251c7b560110: Down the creek, to see about supper
RD_ALifeLine_12c6b90a2d2fcd87: Why would I tell you where I'm headed? Nope
RD_ALifeLine_7db684d733f2f089: To the shelter, the one on the radio
RD_ALifeLine_388025d63be8db18: To a roof, any roof, before the sun's gone
RD_ALifeLine_4c9347d5390634b5: Isn't that enough for you? it looks plenty for me
RD_ALifeLine_313f0a2173aeefd2: That's a nice piece, hold on to it
RD_ALifeLine_3973bed440703909: A gun? You want me to arm you so you can shoot me? Keep dreaming
RD_ALifeLine_7bc00d1326db4cf9: I don't give weapons, I take them
RD_ALifeLine_18e08a120e724385: You'll need a weapon, yeah, but not from me
RD_ALifeLine_5d83e9161d3faa51: Weapons are for people who've earned them, and you haven't
RD_ALifeLine_62e79fdd7775ca53: You want a weapon? Use your fists!
RD_ALifeLine_786bb843121b2cc6: A gun? Man, that's like asking for my heart
RD_ALifeLine_799e5e0000d0c04f: You could check a pawn shop, watch your back and don't count on finding anything
RD_ALifeLine_09fe93860b1589d1: We don't hand out iron, no way
RD_ALifeLine_44855e555f9b8d72: Arming people takes trust, I don't trust you
RD_ALifeLine_4d6379561aa9d485: Weapon? I'll show you a weapon!
RD_ALifeLine_1179e9bd6d6d206b: We could talk about what you need, I'm not offering a weapon yet
RD_ALifeLine_60e870941890e898: You'll need your own, you can't ride on borrowed gear
RD_ALifeLine_5e0e4d665db3b5e5: Try looking for tools you know how to handle, I don't know what's available
RD_ALifeLine_1cdbdedb65c37db1: You want me to arm you? I want you to stop asking
RD_ALifeLine_447c3d8435609a23: We could discuss a price, don't call that a promise to supply you
RD_ALifeLine_353adaf46909db50: Weapons don't get promised on demand. Start with a conversation
RD_ALifeLine_4007ba262e0d7e9d: I may have something, let me think
RD_ALifeLine_43aa87af65ca102a: I can't offer you one, I'm lucky to be managing at all
RD_ALifeLine_7592fd402370312c: Don't ask me for a weapon, they'll think I'm planning something
RD_ALifeLine_56d8e7a0743fb086: I'm not helping you get a weapon. Leave me alone!
RD_ALifeLine_1a0aa9876e48bc08: I wish I could, I really do
RD_ALifeLine_57648f65058e4dc7: I don't know where you'd find a rifle. You'll have to ask around
RD_ALifeLine_5e7b6be631f8892a: I'd be careful improvising something, don't assume an idea will work
RD_ALifeLine_548e459c64e34c57: Borrowing a weapon would take trust and a real agreement, we don't have that
RD_ALifeLine_7e73782d51621913: I won't agree to give you a firearm
RD_ALifeLine_14981d72058cc422: I'm not agreeing to arm civilians
RD_ALifeLine_0e23ef1d0572e355: I can't give you a weapon, but I can suggest where to find one
RD_ALifeLine_3899e6fb28def0f5: I'm not sending you to an armory I haven't checked
RD_ALifeLine_20b5d0b4241033c6: I wish I could, truly, but regulations prohibit it
RD_ALifeLine_70a88ec13d166644: I can't arm civilians, not yet, though I might have to soon
RD_ALifeLine_2135908a1519fd54: Weapons are not issued to civilians
RD_ALifeLine_28a4f9f264012276: I can't, but I understand why you'd ask
RD_ALifeLine_3d3759d21c9d9126: Get your own, soldier, I mean civilian
RD_ALifeLine_5c5feced286b8a10: I can't agree to hand a weapon over, sorry
RD_ALifeLine_057c983812a4c5e2: Weapons cost money, and I don't extend credit
RD_ALifeLine_094ef8ed33691a87: Joining us wouldn't be a promise of equipment, don't make that your reason
RD_ALifeLine_5430670e0705043b: You'd have to find something for yourself, I'm not handing a weapon over
RD_ALifeLine_175dfc05716d53d6: My son used to write his name on his softball bat. Funny what a question brings back
RD_ALifeLine_261c906b77e41942: Dennis used to carry a golf club, never broke ninety with it anyway
RD_ALifeLine_5764a9af6fd33b51: A gun? No, no, I'm not giving anybody a gun, I don't know you, I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_7a5cfffb3c010cd7: Stay back! I'm not agreeing to arm you!
RD_ALifeLine_273037cd3d239ab4: A hatchet might be worth looking for, I can't tell you where you'll find one
RD_ALifeLine_7d218d2e64b009ab: I used to laugh at keeping a shovel close, nothing seems as funny now
RD_ALifeLine_65ae50700644f703: Every man I ever lent a gun to is dead, not the gun's fault, still... find your own
RD_ALifeLine_568ddc315842d6f7: Framing hammer was the best tool I ever bought. Different world when I bought it
RD_ALifeLine_23b089e27154e237: A pry bar might be worth finding, don't expect me to point you to one
RD_ALifeLine_48083a2d27b8095c: I can't promise a spare tool, don't plan on borrowing one from me
RD_ALifeLine_2c2ff2160f1a3184: I don't arm people, I patch them up after they arm themselves
RD_ALifeLine_6bcd80c80460edf5: You could check a pawn shop, I don't know whether you'd find anything usable
RD_ALifeLine_3aae8d716e3229a4: You ask a deputy for a gun, I start wondering what happened to yours, hands out
RD_ALifeLine_5610741c1cf35a85: I can't promise you military equipment, please don't count on that
RD_ALifeLine_531017df085e7c42: We don't arm locals, orders came down on the eighth, no exceptions
RD_ALifeLine_434556c72e4c71c7: I'd rather have something I know how to handle than something that only sounds useful
RD_ALifeLine_46ef2e6a169afbba: Back away, I will not agree to arm you
RD_ALifeLine_7d21f2bb31a34de6: Don't rip something apart just because you need a weapon, you could hurt yourself
RD_ALifeLine_30187d766349277f: We could talk about a price, I haven't promised you a gun
RD_ALifeLine_47ead8f21f944130: A gun? You think asking a stranger is enough? God help you
RD_ALifeLine_50468c7e375829c0: Hahaha! You want a gun! Keep asking, see how that goes
RD_ALifeLine_06610ec127eef189: You want a weapon, that's the last thing I'm handing you, and you know it
RD_ALifeLine_3c486011213fa213: You want a weapon? Pick up a rock, then see what happens
RD_ALifeLine_5950623c7308aa28: I remember what people did to get into the gun shops, nobody was proud of it
RD_ALifeLine_7796c5ae69aea4ab: We could discuss a trade, don't turn that into a promise about a particular gun
RD_ALifeLine_3e42da2d0d236d21: Club don't arm hangarounds, you'd have to ride with us a long time first
RD_ALifeLine_75dbd2a91a321336: I'm not promising a gun or a deadline. Start by telling me what you want to offer
RD_ALifeLine_555c5b281350bcea: Made a shank from a toothbrush in D-block once. Nostalgia isn't a reason to trust a weapon
RD_ALifeLine_25c4012410f3117f: I've got a bad attitude. You're welcome to none of it
RD_ALifeLine_62c47d5a46a4d1f7: Daddy's old shotgun belonged to a different world, I think about that sometimes
RD_ALifeLine_493cd95f158fb093: Take a pry bar over a bat every time, it works on doors too, and doors matter more
RD_ALifeLine_5cf0f0294a9cc469: A good axe is heavy in the wrong way, get something with a shorter handle
RD_ALifeLine_36a7800e3beeb86d: I can't arm you, I can tell you a stranger with a gun is why I don't sleep
RD_ALifeLine_604568f022adeb72: You don't want a rifle, you want a rifle you can feed, different problem entirely
RD_ALifeLine_63d4979300ea236c: I'd prefer something quiet, still wouldn't assume it makes me safe
RD_ALifeLine_25aef4e313952690: I used to carry a length of chain. Said plenty before it ever did anything
RD_ALifeLine_48b5fcb20e3afb08: We could discuss a sale. Depends whether I trust what you'd do with a weapon
RD_ALifeLine_1ea099e90fcde401: I still think of the shotgun my son used to take hunting. Hard not to
RD_ALifeLine_01adfbbd25d95aaa: It was the weekend, everyone said it was the flu, then the neighbors started... changing
RD_ALifeLine_77fc914904d9edab: Friday night, the lights went out, by Sunday nobody was answering the phone
RD_ALifeLine_1e0e301f2e7c5538: I don't know, child, I heard a car alarm and then a scream and then nothing, for a long time
RD_ALifeLine_1e1ff4097da9091f: I watched my neighbor stagger up the street, he had no business walking, I knew then
RD_ALifeLine_23d39052716b11d7: Looked like a bad flu, then folks started biting, I still can't say it out loud
RD_ALifeLine_1e189c8c62068bc9: The news said it was contained, then the news stopped
RD_ALifeLine_34b63c4f047b51fa: I was out in the woods, came home to find the town empty, that's all I know
RD_ALifeLine_789638e64c42d881: Saw smoke from the ridge, saw people running, then it was quiet
RD_ALifeLine_6c3aaa435052fd69: Whistle blew on Friday, by Monday half the shift didn't come in, those who did, weren't right
RD_ALifeLine_7f16582855e52c9a: Plant manager said go home, we went, we never came back
RD_ALifeLine_21d99d2b5c88959e: Calls started coming in all at once, bites, fights, fires, we couldn't keep up
RD_ALifeLine_112ca0e35c5a3d72: The hospital called for us twenty times in an hour, then it stopped calling
RD_ALifeLine_444f168b421b9158: It's a pathogen, a bite spreads it, the fever kills, and then the dead walk, that's all I understand
RD_ALifeLine_53803f0b355d9656: We had a patient who coded and sat up forty minutes later, I haven't slept since
RD_ALifeLine_0e6bf07b7bb59117: The Book of Revelation has an answer, I don't, I only know the church bell rang for three days
RD_ALifeLine_5c4148e84d34f41a: People came to the church and wouldn't leave, then some of them wouldn't stay dead
RD_ALifeLine_495233377c9f466c: Calls started Friday, Assaults, bites, attacks, by Sunday we'd lost contact with half the county
RD_ALifeLine_153061766ef0206c: We were told to keep order, there was no order to keep
RD_ALifeLine_555d24a71836c7f6: I've seen riots and floods, this is neither, it started in the hospitals and spread from there
RD_ALifeLine_22839790138e50f4: Federal advisories said quarantine, by then it was already in the courthouse
RD_ALifeLine_3bfd8d504f40f471: Highway shut down Friday night, by dawn, the whole interstate was a graveyard
RD_ALifeLine_509b615c605181a0: We were ordered to hold the roadblock, nobody told us what we were holding against
RD_ALifeLine_50f2735854da6b9e: Riot in the block on Friday, half the guards didn't come back, the dead did
RD_ALifeLine_534f6b3a61850391: Inmates stopped answering the count, then they stopped being inmates
RD_ALifeLine_627750145cc98e7a: We got called out on a domestic, the suspect wouldn't go down, not with a vest full of rounds
RD_ALifeLine_7c4defe948037921: Eight calls in an hour, same thing every time
RD_ALifeLine_61442efd63ebe2ae: We got deployed Saturday, nobody told us the target was a street full of people
RD_ALifeLine_4639a3693f6068f2: We held a checkpoint, then the checkpoint fell, that's all I'm allowed to say
RD_ALifeLine_767fc4bc6e7f6923: Orders came down Saturday, hold the line, the line was the town, we lost it by Monday
RD_ALifeLine_5bebfed63fbe401d: Quarantine zone broke in the first 48 hours, I won't speculate on why
RD_ALifeLine_48ce3f6d7da1fb1b: They told us to fire on civilians, I put my rifle down and walked
RD_ALifeLine_74c585f574c2ea61: Command collapsed in about two days, everyone for themselves after that
RD_ALifeLine_2474718a4b3a61a4: Information is limited, the situation is what it is
RD_ALifeLine_0d81ba5f787d0c9d: Hell if I know, one day the world was normal, next day it was a buffet
RD_ALifeLine_4f555ac035c48677: Folks got sick, then they got hungry, then they got everyone else
RD_ALifeLine_473b930e1997e395: The world ended and I got rich, don't know about you
RD_ALifeLine_2ddfce4d2ac9ec02: Everything fell apart, that's an opportunity, if you're quick
RD_ALifeLine_66fd12e65e936381: City went crazy Friday night, by Saturday it was all fire and screaming
RD_ALifeLine_53ca38ee2292ac12: Cops ran, then the dead showed up, we held our block
RD_ALifeLine_06a368c77ac637b2: We were coming back from a run, roads were jammed, we left the bikes and ran
RD_ALifeLine_1e118bef1eb2ccd3: Rode through three towns that were empty, then we found the first ones
RD_ALifeLine_307b966077bc0115: Business slowed Friday, by Saturday nobody was calling, by Sunday nobody was alive
RD_ALifeLine_3f30abf274997c0e: We had warning, not enough, never enough
RD_ALifeLine_24f9531630f13216: They locked down the unit, we heard screaming, then the doors opened
RD_ALifeLine_5999c2fe4a388d76: Guards stopped coming, the dead didn't, we got out the back
RD_ALifeLine_76a6d3007f96f997: I don't know, neither do the people in charge, just don't get bitten
RD_ALifeLine_45b0265578fd3eec: They aren't human anymore, the dead walk, shoot them in the head, that's all I've got
RD_ALifeLine_0f17931e0cf60e84: Calls came in all night, folks attacking folks, now we're here, fight for your life
RD_ALifeLine_56240a70597de2c0: I don't KNOW! Friday it's normal, then my neighbor sits up after his heart stopped, and he's- he's HUNGRY
RD_ALifeLine_76ae6f9676195a04: A man bit a woman at the grocery, security tackled him, then she got up, and I ran, that's all I saw, I just ran
RD_ALifeLine_5d11e7ad19fe390d: Flu, then riot, then the TV just went dead on us...
RD_ALifeLine_373b53375fc90c27: Everybody got sick, and then everybody got WORSE than sick, and I'm- I'm sorry, I don't want to say the next part
RD_ALifeLine_34e629fa3597af81: It was a normal day, I was ironing, ironing! and somebody started screaming in the yard
RD_ALifeLine_4c7f106c23c28473: Dead people got up... that's it, that's what happened, say it out loud and it still sounds insane
RD_ALifeLine_63b3649d42f1e4d3: N-nobody told us, that's the worst part, nobody told us a single thing before it was too late!!
RD_ALifeLine_616e0725061f7034: Ask the Army, ask the government, ask whoever let this out, because it sure as hell wasn't me
RD_ALifeLine_231eb8e4233468b5: I was at work... then my boss was on the floor, then he wasn't, he was on me, I got out through the loading dock
RD_ALifeLine_23f81f5b3b75c69a: The ambulances came and then they stopped coming, and the sirens didn't, they went on and on and then just...
RD_ALifeLine_7370343004a866f8: It's only been a few days, can you believe that? a FEW DAYS and everything's gone
RD_ALifeLine_6521ffb15166f8b2: Friday I was on the phone with my sister, she said "hold on, somebody's at the door" and that was it
RD_ALifeLine_052f03087eddbbde: They're calling it an outbreak on the radio... an outbreak, like measles, like a bad batch of potato salad!
RD_ALifeLine_3ae3e8556fe823e4: Short version, someone got bit, someone got sick, someone didn't stay dead, and it took about a week to fall apart
RD_ALifeLine_619023fc694f22e8: Hospitals filled up, then emptied, then the army shut the roads, and that was that
RD_ALifeLine_3235e2021c81c083: Nobody knows where it started, and anybody who tells you different is selling something
RD_ALifeLine_550d94134ef2ecd7: Started with a rumor, then a body, then it was the whole street
RD_ALifeLine_030fb940197060b2: I used to wonder about the end of the world, I never pictured it so quiet, or so smelly...
RD_ALifeLine_6878c46106c95b23: We got an announcement, "remain calm," then nothing, I think that was the day they gave up on us
RD_ALifeLine_7b257fc7172fc28c: A virus... a bug, a bad batch of something, take your pick, the result's the same
RD_ALifeLine_29d5c96a7adb829e: You really want to know? okay, sit, it's long, but I'll tell you, and I'll try not to cry
RD_ALifeLine_08401b4e04ef08de: I'll tell you what I saw, but don't judge me, I did some things I ain't proud of
RD_ALifeLine_49581cc7520985aa: I don't know, I keep trying to make sense of it, and I can't
RD_ALifeLine_4dbd7c9a4454031d: Why are you asking? who sent you
RD_ALifeLine_5bf223b44624d9ed: That's a long story, and I'm not telling it to a stranger!
RD_ALifeLine_735645607e8c6bf3: Sickness, spread by bite, I figured that out in about a day, the rest is just details
RD_ALifeLine_78230c5f45113eeb: I was up the holler hunting when it started, came down to a town full of strangers eating each other
RD_ALifeLine_0222a70502c1d765: Folks got careless, crowded together, and the thing ran through 'em like a brush fire
RD_ALifeLine_23dd601461b77763: Government, military, doesn't matter, somebody opened a door they shouldn't have
RD_ALifeLine_036fc0df05797d3e: I don't speculate, I watch what happens, and what happens is the dead walk
RD_ALifeLine_52011abc27966a46: Heard it started at the base, heard it started at the prison, heard it started in Louisville, take your pick
RD_ALifeLine_06540c2a44e01b6c: The how doesn't matter, the what-now does, I stick to the second part
RD_ALifeLine_759948b00de069ec: We were at my mother-in-law's for Sunday dinner, and she wasn't well, and then she was worse, and then- I can't, please
RD_ALifeLine_292160053244cfba: Like a bad flu at first, then folks started dying, and then they didn't stay dead
RD_ALifeLine_5e5838f0168b7604: My husband went to work Friday morning and the world ended by Friday night
RD_ALifeLine_5c531cdd625796e1: I can tell you what it did to my kids, I can't tell you what caused it
RD_ALifeLine_043e280846b27432: We watched the TV till the TV died, then we watched the street till the street got loud
RD_ALifeLine_6d60ad4f1ce586fe: In my day we'd call it a plague... honey, and the Lord sends them from time to time
RD_ALifeLine_22e7d65d451f6d38: I saw it come up the road, people running, the dead behind them, I thought it was the Rapture, and it wasn't
RD_ALifeLine_340d7b896e6a3cac: Something in the water, the air, the blood, I read the paper sixty years, and NOBODY warned us
RD_ALifeLine_7708cee03337d777: So there's like a virus? or a thing? and when you die you come back? that's literally all I know
RD_ALifeLine_388802a0533ece4a: My mom said stay home... my dad said stay home, the principal said stay home, and then nobody said anything
RD_ALifeLine_09e6ca1445de6e2c: Somebody at my school started biting people in the cafeteria, I don't know why
RD_ALifeLine_0b8a653f5b7e2ea6: Thursday we had a guy come in sick, Friday we had six, Saturday the foreman locked us in the plant for safety
RD_ALifeLine_22d5cde13c71081b: Somebody gave the wrong order somewhere, and a thing got loose, that's how it always goes
RD_ALifeLine_55820b7e29053a4c: Truckers on the CB said it was an accident, a spill, a leak, I don't buy it
RD_ALifeLine_79c8217e557ab3e4: People came in with fevers and bites, raving, we had nothing to give them, by Saturday nobody was left to work
RD_ALifeLine_58c457e575756608: It looks like a hemorrhagic fever at first, then neurological, then it's something no textbook describes
RD_ALifeLine_360eb56b388dae6b: I wrote it up for the health department... nobody answered, that was Sunday, I stopped writing after that
RD_ALifeLine_23dcf7f837c56db1: It began like a plague from the old Book, and I'm not sure what else to call it
RD_ALifeLine_353947ee3ecce4ac: I buried eleven people in two days, and the twelfth got up and walked away, and I haven't buried anyone since
RD_ALifeLine_374a2d8e1258d3d0: The church bell rang for the first dead, then the second, then we stopped ringing it
RD_ALifeLine_7e8ae26828c32d4e: We got a call for a man down, we arrived, he got up and bit my partner, that was our first sign
RD_ALifeLine_16cb132b427e28e5: After that... calls came in so fast we couldn't keep up, ten, twenty, fifty, and then the dispatch went quiet
RD_ALifeLine_35b25e257e8372e6: It was a bad day, and every day after has been worse
RD_ALifeLine_024c3e4b2155ea50: I won't pretend to know, but I saw convoys moving in before anything got bad, and that makes me think
RD_ALifeLine_22272fa96ec03de7: The locals will tell you virus, the military will tell you nothing, I tell you both are lying
RD_ALifeLine_3aebdbff1209d9b6: The line at the checkpoint didn't hold, and I don't know who to blame
RD_ALifeLine_53f33b97240525a5: You deserve the truth, so here it is, what I saw, what I heard, what I think
RD_ALifeLine_29acdd6e37c98639: Sit down, I'll start at the beginning, and I won't skip the ugly parts!
RD_ALifeLine_73c1f58464117a59: Because it's you, I'll tell it, I haven't told anyone else
RD_ALifeLine_466f4b9e1ec43513: Sit, I'll tell you all of it, from the beginning, since you've earned it
RD_ALifeLine_17bacda470aeafba: It started with a rumor, a whisper in the diner, a sick man in the next county
RD_ALifeLine_20941a3322834743: I can tell you what I saw, ain't pretty, and what I heard is worse
RD_ALifeLine_006eed055591ed98: I was there for the first night, and I haven't slept right since
RD_ALifeLine_3b7e99d33c8b5ffc: The truth is, nobody knows, but I have a theory, and I trust you with it

RD_ALifeLine_68319a37010cfd6d: Let her in, hide the lighter fluid

RD_ALifeLine_34e189275445d784: Good, then it stays where we put it

RD_ALifeLine_0fd3122517f0cc62: Moon had the route drawn on a gas station map, every stop circled in red

RD_ALifeLine_79e015d926efcb95: Open the gate, open the damn gate!

RD_ALifeLine_0126e45c07b1766c: We were both drunk, both of us laughing
RD_ALifeLine_573da74d48b1602e: Did it out in the parking lot, not inside, he liked this place too much
RD_ALifeLine_3c9942446792ca94: Man in Rosewood says a bunch wearing our colors robbed the Methodist church
RD_ALifeLine_3d12616c04932d56: We ain't set foot in Rosewood in two weeks
RD_ALifeLine_7ed8e2203f8676af: Somebody took the vests off our dead at the Muldraugh warehouse, that's who
RD_ALifeLine_7cf2c01873ffb61c: Wearing our brothers' names to rob old women
RD_ALifeLine_25f9845613014d80: Then we find 'em, and they give the vests back, one way or the other
RD_ALifeLine_0db88ca9737de816: Pilgrim's, wire shorted when he hit the rail crossing, been blowing ever since
RD_ALifeLine_2ee6da9f45147098: He's trying, he's riding and trying, with about thirty of them behind him like a parade
RD_ALifeLine_201fe343384da0bc: Nobody opens this gate, wave him past the water tower, he knows what to do
RD_ALifeLine_3aff4ef3017f27d0: When I prospected, Dutch smacked me upside the head every time I talked at the table
RD_ALifeLine_07d01271625b85e2: You still talk too much at the table
RD_ALifeLine_1cee0d6e40ca991c: So how come nobody's allowed to smack the new kid?
RD_ALifeLine_4c81baf51505c650: New kid's the only one of us with all his teeth, we're protecting the investment
RD_ALifeLine_7f0e43f93a0eb846: Heard the Irvington club's patching in anybody who shows up with ten gallons
RD_ALifeLine_407237a23f84e005: Ten gallons is a lot of gas right now
RD_ALifeLine_3fd7adc735e96df8: My patch cost me two years, a wired jaw, and my first marriage
RD_ALifeLine_13b53f2e77e4c517: Yeah, but did you have ten gallons?

RD_ALifeLine_0326ecc13db4a71e: Nomads don't pull nobody's weight, that's why they're nomads
RD_ALifeLine_08282b5b5aec7faa: He's got a toolbox on that bike the size of a coffin
RD_ALifeLine_300212f0524ce9f3: Well, let's see him pull some weight

RD_ALifeLine_555ac36c3a0bb4ab: So Tiny gets the pipes, he loved them pipes, the carb goes on yours
RD_ALifeLine_1fd2e89642a797dc: He'd have called that fair, he'd have called you a thief first, then fair

RD_ALifeLine_41c8f57457977fdb: Because mine's got no front brake and his has two good ones

RD_ALifeLine_69f5f6493aafa83e: Rule don't say a word about coming back
RD_ALifeLine_72f6e93d4b398022: Then I'll push it to church and y'all can vote on my brakes
RD_ALifeLine_2556e31144249b61: That Brandenburg patch on our wall, took it off a man in a bar fight in eighty-six
RD_ALifeLine_1f320bc830687bba: Saw him Monday, the man it came off of, walking circles down by the river landing
RD_ALifeLine_333b1d8d18a9f5c6: Yeah, figured I owed him that much, leave the patch up
RD_ALifeLine_78a5d18c6553d028: They hung Chigger's cut off the Riverside water tower, hung it right where we'd see
RD_ALifeLine_4b1c99dd6802f225: On what? We got gas for one run, the farm for food, or Riverside to bleed
RD_ALifeLine_3338f36e05ae5f61: He just did, food run, Riverside keeps till we got the gas to hate 'em with
RD_ALifeLine_561e9a5b787056ca: Ran the Rosewood road at seventy with thirty of them strung out behind us
RD_ALifeLine_3334b2383d8b7422: Old days it was cops chasing
RD_ALifeLine_6cade2b571126e26: Gypsy's tank's got forty-one state stickers on it, she wanted all forty-eight down below
RD_ALifeLine_45275f871e5560c2: Seven short, and a fence around the county
RD_ALifeLine_1a7659906e3db806: Put a second Kentucky on there, she'd laugh at that
RD_ALifeLine_0c520e9e4953207c: Little boy in the church lot asked could he sit on my bike
RD_ALifeLine_2b1c492949250cd1: Let him twist the throttle, engine off, key in my pocket
RD_ALifeLine_270c72ce10c5388b: Made the engine noise himself, loudest thing in Knox County all week, nobody shushed him
RD_ALifeLine_5272e19935ba09cd: Shirley at the roadhouse kept my tab on a bar napkin under the register, since eighty-nine
RD_ALifeLine_646879120fa3e5d3: Napkin's still there, four hundred and twelve dollars, in her handwriting, door was busted in, but nobody took the napkin
RD_ALifeLine_368d7a9f0b7f38ab: Paid it, every dollar I had on me, and a twenty on top, Shirley always did expect a tip
RD_ALifeLine_1cc17a20402d415a: Had her name put on this arm in seventy-eight, paid for it with a carburetor
RD_ALifeLine_2c2df63d0be9b39f: Covered it with a rattlesnake in eighty-four, when she left with the bass player
RD_ALifeLine_6f9ae7da1098b8ed: One of 'em bit me Thursday, right on the snake, hahaha! Snakebit, wonder how the snake's feeling
RD_ALifeLine_45e9f2532f41f70a: Ain't talked to You since my mama's funeral, you know why
RD_ALifeLine_5fc6e7891c41a823: Still mad about it, still riding
RD_ALifeLine_1eb19c1851d6bf89: Keep the road clear to the clubhouse tomorrow, that's all, just the road
RD_ALifeLine_5ecefb796e6a38a5: Man that taught me to ride said watch the other fella's front wheel, never his face
RD_ALifeLine_593818fa7ee193ae: Same with these things, watch the feet, the face'll lie to you
RD_ALifeLine_64cc6f6c4bc2944f: Used to lie to you, now it just kinda hangs there
RD_ALifeLine_4c5d46fb41bc3c9c: My old lady's making me ride in a reflective vest, the orange road crew kind
RD_ALifeLine_4194c65d0f84d985: Over my colors, says she's not burying me on account of a dark road
RD_ALifeLine_472a78ff28787fc4: Don't you dare tell her that
RD_ALifeLine_4685eb5a2c9bf1ad: What's with the doll zip-tied to your handlebars?
RD_ALifeLine_0b5aa818455a725e: Granddaughter did it at Easter, so she could pick out Papaw's bike in a parking lot full of 'em

RD_ALifeLine_0d8aba5c671d2b14: Rode to Nashville and back in one day once, eight hundred miles, couldn't feel my legs for a week
RD_ALifeLine_0718105952268fcb: Rode four miles today and called it a real good day
RD_ALifeLine_33b0ad4f0f2451e9: Four miles, and I can still feel my legs, I'll take the trade
RD_ALifeLine_0f031d8c47eb66bb: Your club still owes my family nine hundred dollars from the Labor Day party
RD_ALifeLine_33dff7a315289467: That party was last September, and half the men who drank it are dead
RD_ALifeLine_665a686f2aed2895: Fine, we'll settle up in gas, two gallons
RD_ALifeLine_66a2348e53a53e19: Nine hundred dollars is not two gallons
RD_ALifeLine_1be0dd71384ca818: Jukebox going in a tavern with the poles down in the ditch
RD_ALifeLine_35657be67098b731: Ride past it, don't slow, don't look in the window, ride past it
RD_ALifeLine_536a23b5588c61e3: Woman at the church clinic says an ounce gets us a bottle of amoxicillin
RD_ALifeLine_3ab7f8ec113f346b: For the ones who can't keep food down, the nurse there knows what she's doing
RD_ALifeLine_152599c64518cefa: Church people buying off us, Mama'd laugh herself sick
RD_ALifeLine_2c3e6922564749c3: First customer after they shut the roads was an Army boy, still in uniform

RD_ALifeLine_441112732e00b6f6: Then where'd he get off to?

RD_ALifeLine_21c8e4e97218e45a: Could we fire a still after dark without being noticed?

RD_ALifeLine_31d91b9d46bd0af3: What if the roof's half gone? Walls aren't a promise of cover
RD_ALifeLine_3fe9d274364684e3: Then I keep thinking. Hell, can't even make a plan without an argument

RD_ALifeLine_5eafb4fb4a59c9ad: Best in Kentucky, nobody could tell
RD_ALifeLine_042afc9631546936: And now nobody takes the real ones either
RD_ALifeLine_2abd75d7167f79e5: So mine are finally worth exactly what theirs are

RD_ALifeLine_48a8236f1116865e: His bass boat, and the trailer

RD_ALifeLine_3cc30f99756ee951: Who's gonna buy it? Louisville's gone

RD_ALifeLine_652e169e676b3656: All of 'em, one time or another

RD_ALifeLine_1553bf5b1594223c: A case a week is all we make
RD_ALifeLine_4c5ca5e93dea362d: On their corn, tell 'em if they want liquor, bring corn, Papaw made everybody that deal
RD_ALifeLine_0410935e0dec7715: Twenty years hiding in these rows, now I stand in the middle of 'em in broad daylight
RD_ALifeLine_0572579e42b28ffc: Nobody to catch me, nobody to sell to, nobody to brag to
RD_ALifeLine_487f4e6e685bbcb8: Grew it anyway, Junior'd cuss out loud at how tall it got

RD_ALifeLine_2890ad05595b520e: A job, says he knows every hiding spot in the county, since he found most of 'em
RD_ALifeLine_7ffbece348e65c4b: Then his first job is finding us new copper
RD_ALifeLine_61a78de3727c54fd: Opal's still got the orders taped up on the kitchen cabinet

RD_ALifeLine_17491c4176219a4d: Then we drill, Drill's loud, get the bats
RD_ALifeLine_47bb91ff53c20ed8: I once strung cans on fishing line round a patch.. deer and nosy kids

RD_ALifeLine_6fb080487f59fe05: With a flat shovel.. every night
RD_ALifeLine_232d2ac51ffd57e0: Four hundred car stereos, pull-out decks, every one, took me three years to fill that garage
RD_ALifeLine_4ca4905476978fbc: Traded one for a chicken yesterday
RD_ALifeLine_452d014a5629cdeb: Live one, she lays, so I'm up on the deal

RD_ALifeLine_2a3cf7a005223539: Army, didn't even slow down over the patch

RD_ALifeLine_55898223583968ad: Danny Hurt, sold him fishing lures every spring for twenty years
RD_ALifeLine_1b0912ad556fb87b: Traded, kept the ring behind the counter, somebody ought to know where it ended up

RD_ALifeLine_670e5bd77549d5a7: Cleaning wounds, cleaning tools, they ran out of rubbing alcohol the second week
RD_ALifeLine_24c52828038c9fc2: Stitches for anybody in the family, and he don't ask how you got cut

RD_ALifeLine_34f28bd42371e315: Cowbell, one ring, stranger, two, dead ones, three, run
RD_ALifeLine_5f2048201fe3eedc: Dog bit me, least I'm pretty sure it was a dog, hahaha, poured shine on it and drank the rest
RD_ALifeLine_3ebed16406b94ce5: Shine don't cure nothing but sober
RD_ALifeLine_57624e05431922db: Then I'm cured of that much
RD_ALifeLine_4772e0a872e2cd0b: Deacon Hollis came round the back door for a jar

RD_ALifeLine_6bbaa5b31ad30428: Said it's for his wife's toothache
RD_ALifeLine_1c65c704639e3119: Then I reckon it's for her memory

RD_ALifeLine_1a945a0c29831e94: What's a diamond do? Don't shoot, don't burn, can't eat it
RD_ALifeLine_5178807f233b1d4c: Get the watches, at least a watch tells time
RD_ALifeLine_17333a960e1047c9: Dickie Farris is coming up the road with a white flag, the one who testified on Uncle Roy

RD_ALifeLine_1b4acd3722d067ea: Let him go by, don't help him, don't lay a hand on him, we never saw him

RD_ALifeLine_6b1bd22c09c0426b: Yeah, and he gets to keep walking. That's us being merciful
RD_ALifeLine_1e7ea91c231211dc: Doris Whitt walked in this morning, alive, skinny as a rail
RD_ALifeLine_6816a877415c517d: Asked what she owed, I told her the interest was waived on account of the end of the world
RD_ALifeLine_089704962f9a03fc: Paid me a can of pears anyhow, said she don't take charity from a pawnbroker
RD_ALifeLine_62513e325c13802e: They love it, laying out in the pen hollering

RD_ALifeLine_1a27e56b7df06d68: Then that's the best alarm in Knox County, it's just drunk

RD_ALifeLine_5ae14bb74d9b0655: Only law left standing in Knox County
RD_ALifeLine_171a4a7a6cc30437: And it's still the one nobody obeys

RD_ALifeLine_52fc14ac5807ec77: Guess he ain't buying it back this April
RD_ALifeLine_67be450b33ede82f: Papaw's old truck still has the false floor in the bed, holds forty jars
RD_ALifeLine_6bf869a0122a5005: What are we hiding in it?
RD_ALifeLine_7130200d786ec9a3: Everything we don't want the West Point boys taking, shells, pills, the good knife
RD_ALifeLine_5e3f80e109a7b8a1: Thirty years that truck hid liquor from the law, now it hides bandages from thieves, truck's come up in the world
RD_ALifeLine_7d66bc1955ecc5d9: Papaw always said a favor owed don't die with the man
RD_ALifeLine_0ea5e10d520f2417: Wendell Tate pulled Papaw out of the river in sixty-eight, Papaw never paid it back

RD_ALifeLine_72dbd572156b1908: Then open the gate, we're paying

RD_ALifeLine_64284d445357ee80: Can of beef stew, can't get it, box of shells, can't get it, dry socks, don't even ask
RD_ALifeLine_642e8dea0a0baca8: Twenty years in this business, and I should've been in socks
RD_ALifeLine_3cce9ec86748a574: Don't drink off the first quart of the run, that's the part that'll blind you, swear to God
RD_ALifeLine_3be700fe721dc77e: Tackett boys drink the first quart
RD_ALifeLine_07722e9c2ddf0583: Tackett boys can't find their own front door
RD_ALifeLine_6a35a0537f308b75: I always figured that was the liquor
RD_ALifeLine_27dd8eea49f77827: Man walked in wearing a fur coat, hundred degrees out
RD_ALifeLine_166c635850e4d687: Only way to carry it, wanted to trade it for a pistol
RD_ALifeLine_3717860c35d27dd8: Took it, first thing I've bought in months I'll be glad of come January
RD_ALifeLine_1a76fd27347f91b6: Granny says no more guns at the supper table
RD_ALifeLine_7f92b4b65396406e: There's dead ones in the yard, Granny
RD_ALifeLine_4c9650697d2617cf: Then eat fast, guns on the porch
RD_ALifeLine_459dece271f5be1b: She's got a pistol in her apron pocket
RD_ALifeLine_636230a907b5b2c9: My granddaddy ran liquor to Louisville in nineteen twenty-nine, in a hearse
RD_ALifeLine_5bdff6170873d9a6: Nobody stops a hearse, he'd lay a lily on the dash and do thirty-five the whole way
RD_ALifeLine_76db342812ce0f47: Funeral home in Muldraugh's got a hearse sitting out back
RD_ALifeLine_5f36f321046d9952: Nobody'd stop a hearse now, either, different reasons
RD_ALifeLine_225a202131974086: Shake the jar, watch the bubbles
RD_ALifeLine_76915b402b83eede: They're big, they're sitting up on top
RD_ALifeLine_6def1db32ff70823: That's a good bead, that's over a hundred, your granddaddy'd call that honest
RD_ALifeLine_7206d2f638d304aa: Little bubbles that run off quick, like the man selling it

RD_ALifeLine_6cf19a774956673a: Honey mash, that's near about mead
RD_ALifeLine_3f22c90623b755e4: Papaw drank it at my cousin's wedding and danced with the preacher's wife

RD_ALifeLine_6ea1920d3bcd7b55: Do it before you tell me you're doing it

RD_ALifeLine_57e9302525ed6110: Neither can the man on the ridge with the deer rifle
RD_ALifeLine_4409f280258b4656: You heard it right the first time
RD_ALifeLine_1e3e8e4c79976cbc: Rifle's length is too close, anything under ten feet is a mistake somebody made
RD_ALifeLine_64af0e2459322c12: SAW goes to short bursts, three rounds
RD_ALifeLine_0a57c105313d7f12: Three rounds won't stop a crowd
RD_ALifeLine_08519be945a81e8b: Nothing stops a crowd, three rounds buys the time to leave
RD_ALifeLine_0687561809a5e635: I remember government night vision.. thousands of dollars
RD_ALifeLine_31adc6265e1c0150: We ran it on batteries from a kid's remote-control truck
RD_ALifeLine_3555bcdb79c1f217: Told myself the kid wouldn't mind.. didn't know whose it was

RD_ALifeLine_3678a48656657157: Oil the bolt, oil the rails, wipe the face

RD_ALifeLine_0e4256076a4194c6: Boy in Rosewood asked me to find his mama, gave me her picture out of his wallet
RD_ALifeLine_32f1dfbc29e4bfed: Found her on Main Street, by the bank
RD_ALifeLine_5bbfa3b81f3b5a9d: Gave him back the picture, told him I looked everywhere and didn't find her
RD_ALifeLine_5a46c03f0ef75005: You gave that kid your last ration
RD_ALifeLine_50d682242d74808f: Woman by the swing set, she's turned, boy about ten is holding her hand
RD_ALifeLine_48976089518928e7: Local militia asked us to teach them some tactics
RD_ALifeLine_1dc6133b61e64d92: Don't stand in front of the man with the rifle
RD_ALifeLine_4cf694554b6935f1: Hands shake after, never during, twenty years, never once during
RD_ALifeLine_6fb7e1a6053969e9: Sit on them, count to sixty, then stand up
RD_ALifeLine_795076bd6cc52abf: Not a praying man, checked the box on my enlistment form

RD_ALifeLine_2072687d3ee60193: Kid at the Muldraugh overpass asked if I was Army
RD_ALifeLine_77ce60ef58cb24f4: Told him no, told him I'm nobody
RD_ALifeLine_57f94230381b332d: Kid said okay, nobody, thank you, handed me a rock with a smiley face painted on it
RD_ALifeLine_01a168ac2ea0b014: Rock's in my left cargo pocket, team doesn't need to know about the rock
RD_ALifeLine_60b7e3c96633e7bb: Rules for tonight, no light, no fire, no talking
RD_ALifeLine_7bea9e8d6c051595: Told Jeanie this was my last deployment, promised her
RD_ALifeLine_229c3dad22ac22c5: Short drive, I said, two hours down the road to Knox, home by the weekend
RD_ALifeLine_36dd5cd7480b494e: Still true, technically, real short drive, real long weekend
RD_ALifeLine_2f4a11b9758bd78d: Yellow apple tree behind the Methodist church, early kind, picked one standing in the ditch
RD_ALifeLine_189750ea713b6177: Sour enough to turn my face inside out, juice all down my sleeve, every fly in the county found me
RD_ALifeLine_4cd2527307837131: Worth it, that doesn't go in the report
RD_ALifeLine_460b99b06616d48c: Wind left to right, two minutes, hold one mil
RD_ALifeLine_14b725a625aacf34: Target's a mailman, satchel and all
RD_ALifeLine_465f07b9206f8d69: Local asked me if we're the good guys
RD_ALifeLine_32da94e5036cefcd: Said we're the ones with a schedule
RD_ALifeLine_513f64034a7fd1e8: He asked me to do it before he turned
RD_ALifeLine_2a951cab53cb8e6d: You ask him did he want a minute?
RD_ALifeLine_2a56ce9959ad9a03: I asked, he said he'd had thirty-one years, and that was plenty of minutes
RD_ALifeLine_4c35ab434b39b1ec: Family crossed the bean field at dusk, Daddy carrying the little one, Mama carrying a lamp, not lit
RD_ALifeLine_6d7acd8616e6437b: Walked right past the hide, thirty meters, never saw us
RD_ALifeLine_69bb17e07a4d5a37: Didn't log it... didn't feel right putting it down
RD_ALifeLine_34f6f57659f547bf: Old woman on a porch in Ekron called me sonny and told me to wipe my feet
RD_ALifeLine_70fed4d32fae4770: Both feet, twice, rifle on my back, then she gave me a biscuit
RD_ALifeLine_675a344a57d710eb: You don't say no to a woman who calls you sonny

RD_ALifeLine_7503d5e553b0d119: Mama, I'm not a baby anymore!
RD_ALifeLine_04b62a560224e258: As long as you eat my food you're a baby
RD_ALifeLine_16511f6d5a63af85: Fine, I won't eat your food then!
RD_ALifeLine_3a63fc3c441762d3: I'm just saying, we could try the school, maybe somebody's there
RD_ALifeLine_5b323d7414dfebcb: ...I'll talk to him, but don't get your hopes up
RD_ALifeLine_6b6c5c107fb3e7d3: I know, I can hear her
RD_ALifeLine_12f62fad37be14eb: It helps more than you think, go on
RD_ALifeLine_36f12bfb5da11a04: Papa, why do the stars twinkle?
RD_ALifeLine_0c7db6363cef617f: Because they're happy to see us
RD_ALifeLine_50abe147204d889b: Mama, I had a bad dream
RD_ALifeLine_4361fe6077d0a9a1: Well, I'm bigger, and I'm your mama, and I say it can't come in
RD_ALifeLine_0575d40219f53542: I'll try, I've lost my teeth, but I'll try
RD_ALifeLine_4a8202f748d4e010: Here, little man, the best crumbs in the house
RD_ALifeLine_15d92188466256d2: Come sit on my lap, little one
RD_ALifeLine_27b828267bc8193e: You're never too big for your Nana's lap
RD_ALifeLine_334aa4e60058386a: Okay, but only a little while
RD_ALifeLine_212d207a55f4b0fa: Sing me the song about the moon
RD_ALifeLine_0a86aed443a354dc: The one with the cow jumping over it
RD_ALifeLine_1dedffd23faeb24e: Go to sleep, little man, tomorrow you can watch over me
RD_ALifeLine_5ad1858153223353: Do you remember Sunday dinners at Grandma's?
RD_ALifeLine_0c82326740606d29: Fried chicken, biscuits, green beans cooked with fatback
RD_ALifeLine_039bb1685762bdcf: I'd trade my right arm for a slice
RD_ALifeLine_7fc357ba447ce6bd: Papa used to listen to the Reds on the radio
RD_ALifeLine_65350557062ceedb: Every single one, and he'd shout at the radio like it could hear him
RD_ALifeLine_4ee657ab31e5d925: The one about the little bird
RD_ALifeLine_0b60138402623b7b: Hush, little baby, don't say a word...
RD_ALifeLine_411dea2321b84b51: Mama's gonna buy you a mockingbird...
RD_ALifeLine_6b0047b25186eebb: That's because I used her pot
RD_ALifeLine_5ac849e16e396b0b: With water and love, now go
RD_ALifeLine_6859d96a0572fd4c: He's both, give him time, and a hug
RD_ALifeLine_0b1335e23666fa16: I'll hug him, he never says no to a hug
RD_ALifeLine_0819be6263513e25: Mrs. Adams, I'll trade you a jar of peaches for some thread
RD_ALifeLine_336eeac35f9463a0: Black, I need to mend Papa's shirt
RD_ALifeLine_544abe1022ffccb6: Here you go, and thank you for the peaches
RD_ALifeLine_4fc3813932f38533: I once tried to trade my baseball card for a cookie
RD_ALifeLine_131015900e190ea1: You kept it.. tell me you kept it
RD_ALifeLine_43a56d44327b36b8: Papa, why did the chicken cross the road?

RD_ALifeLine_7d56d6ce45b2b765: No, Papa, to get to the other side
RD_ALifeLine_1cafd0fa5f6a1816: Well, that's the best reason I've heard
RD_ALifeLine_710733743a71140e: Why is the sky so big, Mama?
RD_ALifeLine_42cee6d46f7cb3b4: So we have somewhere to put our hopes
RD_ALifeLine_6e55e89d2a7b65db: Some do, some don't, you carry yours lightly
RD_ALifeLine_3efd39df0f17af51: Will you hold my hand while I sleep?
RD_ALifeLine_56ae0e837eebfa4b: No, sweetheart, I've got something in my eye

RD_ALifeLine_4bc075594f0b0325: I promise, I promise, I won't
RD_ALifeLine_1e0cb61052a5d2b7: Yes, thank God for everything, even the bad stuff

RD_ALifeLine_4fb03dba633eecbc: Grandma, tell us about when you were young
RD_ALifeLine_3d04296159d3c8ff: The part where you met Grandpa
RD_ALifeLine_330e3c5b05295276: He had a mustache that tickled, and a truck that sputtered, and a laugh that filled the room
RD_ALifeLine_6cfe4abc24d6db6c: And you fell in love right away?
RD_ALifeLine_53715f975d090e80: I fell in love when he gave me his last sandwich
RD_ALifeLine_5e290af77bfe0034: But the nice man said there's bad things out there
RD_ALifeLine_5c01e7e670a5f617: The kind that don't like little boys who wander
RD_ALifeLine_28a064ac565ffb67: I want to see the stars
RD_ALifeLine_661bde140a4c7d5d: Fine, put your coat on, and you hold my hand the whole time
RD_ALifeLine_5f91ca261b2f4cd5: Honey, did you take your pills?
RD_ALifeLine_2d65d581481f0f9f: And I'm sixty-eight, and I'll count the pills, thank you
RD_ALifeLine_3ead9a233173e1ca: Tell me about Papaw's farm again
RD_ALifeLine_626674aa2089e050: The part with the creek and the cows
RD_ALifeLine_45b1eae018c8cbd9: The creek ran cold even in August, and the cows came down at dusk, slow as molasses
RD_ALifeLine_3214572e36bbc401: Come on, 'Amazing Grace', all of us
RD_ALifeLine_0e62f2ca0b0d1a82: Quietly, yes, quietly, like we're in church
RD_ALifeLine_4d66e9645bbbf107: Hush now, we'll be warm soon
RD_ALifeLine_6eb954741bc453be: 'Because I said so' isn't a reason!
RD_ALifeLine_092e713800bede3b: It's the oldest one there is
RD_ALifeLine_4fbf603434502165: Not tonight, I don't think, but you've got me here
RD_ALifeLine_13c62d9304dfdb4e: There was a brave little girl
RD_ALifeLine_6a6ab5453ea29fd0: Exactly, and her name was you
RD_ALifeLine_3643d22702c22a3d: I used to ask Grandpa why he was so old
RD_ALifeLine_09d7b2161099fb9e: For what we are about to receive
RD_ALifeLine_193c932f120a3e23: May the Lord make us truly thankful
RD_ALifeLine_591baa5716aa3c59: Yes, yes, here, there you are, snug as a bug

RD_ALifeLine_3ed57ce64c095339: Same food, honey, just somebody sharing it with you
RD_ALifeLine_3d656d064761d6a0: My face is tired, it looks mad, there's a difference
RD_ALifeLine_18e9af2431227842: Because staying will hurt us more than going
RD_ALifeLine_1edcb2f714c7aaa9: Grandma, why are your hands shaking?
RD_ALifeLine_7133d44a4c142ee8: Only when I don't hold something dear
RD_ALifeLine_3d91d80c3f1c232d: Louder than a freight train, and just as welcome
RD_ALifeLine_4d2f80ff5efcdce7: They're always singing, we just stopped listening
RD_ALifeLine_5ee1c83550613ea6: Papa, will you teach me to whistle?
RD_ALifeLine_5273905468bd5d54: Pucker up, blow, and don't spit
RD_ALifeLine_67d84ddf19d75e18: There's love, plenty of love, eat that
RD_ALifeLine_177566d10f135f27: Grandpa, tell me about the war
RD_ALifeLine_5c242c3578160b1f: It was long, and hot, and I lost my best friend, and I'd do it again to keep you safe
RD_ALifeLine_207371a404582ed9: Not as strong as I look
RD_ALifeLine_24d0b2e5614e6972: With help from the hand of the Lord
RD_ALifeLine_5335dcf257c9a8ec: Mama, I'm sorry I broke it
RD_ALifeLine_7f696def1a1a1337: Then blue, because blue's my favorite
RD_ALifeLine_371fadbe0e948993: We have each other, and a pot of beans
RD_ALifeLine_62e06ff2693d80d7: Mama, will you braid my hair?
RD_ALifeLine_727b0dbf45a064c7: Come sit with me.. I could use the company
RD_ALifeLine_2ed48c11738f35b8: Hope.. if you've got some spare
RD_ALifeLine_2a828ac641862216: I'll see what I can do
RD_ALifeLine_5c755e236e324752: Put it under the pillow, the tooth fairy is still on duty
RD_ALifeLine_3ae17aa50d2d67ba: Mama, will it always be like this?
RD_ALifeLine_6d5a0d9d27e325b0: Because nothing lasts, not even the bad
RD_ALifeLine_20be10826493da78: Then we're the same, you and me
RD_ALifeLine_513fa5505bf57729: Come here, let me fix your collar
RD_ALifeLine_3a671a964f3b9dd2: You're a mess, hold still, there
RD_ALifeLine_2d4b871c42898ef5: Now I look like a baby
RD_ALifeLine_4bd442a16117b20c: You'll always be my baby, deal with it
RD_ALifeLine_2d3e11025d3ead2d: Grandpa, tell me about the old days
RD_ALifeLine_0c94d85015af2273: Which ones? The good ones or the bad ones?
RD_ALifeLine_3cb821812bd63a7c: Well, there was a Fourth of July in '52, we had a watermelon as big as a washtub...
RD_ALifeLine_6754492e19cc17bf: Papa, are we going to be okay?
RD_ALifeLine_06d4a3bb1b765d2a: I promise we'll stick together, how's that?
RD_ALifeLine_0b377f7a41f10d0b: Nobody likes beans, eat them anyway
RD_ALifeLine_53542878041c78b9: Can I at least have ketchup?
RD_ALifeLine_73bbd14b22ca5408: ...we're out, but I'll let you pretend
RD_ALifeLine_7cf38ef06f08a2d9: Salt, baking soda, whatever you got
RD_ALifeLine_6f14f7024778cf5d: Mamaw's quilt is still the warmest thing I own
RD_ALifeLine_582c4157528ed077: Every square from somebody's old dress
RD_ALifeLine_16ee053028217cba: There's a piece of mine in there, the blue gingham
RD_ALifeLine_68f9b1555040ca08: I know, I look at it every night
RD_ALifeLine_2e13edf7553e8063: I'm not going to the shelter
RD_ALifeLine_677ad0057393b253: Too many strangers, too many sick, too many scared
RD_ALifeLine_782b335e10ae08af: Home, our home, it's still ours, whatever they say
RD_ALifeLine_62ac3d35650ad410: Did the Guard say when the buses are coming?
RD_ALifeLine_5a2619295e99c03f: ...and the day before, honey, hush now
RD_ALifeLine_3a2027523b0a835e: He told me a camp with kids in it defends itself better, said it like a fact
RD_ALifeLine_2fae406b3713f795: Probably, that's what I hate, he put our babies in a sentence about walls
RD_ALifeLine_378ac80f2acc88bd: My boy's took to standing like Kemble, hands hooked on his belt, like that
RD_ALifeLine_3291f1dc0864fef2: Asked me could he carry the list around, I said no and he sulked all evening
RD_ALifeLine_582e2dd4194642b0: Callie's put weight back on since we come here, got color in her face again
RD_ALifeLine_42588d9a1ed36326: So he does something I hate and I look at her face and I shut my mouth
RD_ALifeLine_06f84a3278f15eb7: It's something, I ain't decided what yet
RD_ALifeLine_077affa034e55110: Bug asked me is Mr. Kemble a bad guy
RD_ALifeLine_263074ba005d1f0e: What did you say to her?
RD_ALifeLine_4149020770c780a5: Said he's the man that keeps the door locked, she said okay, went back to her cards
RD_ALifeLine_3b420ed85ae2f890: That was a coward's answer and she'll work it out by fifteen
RD_ALifeLine_655eef17067d7e46: Daddy's mine had a man like that in twenty-nine, kept the checks coming, broke a fella's jaw
RD_ALifeLine_3e76d30727733c25: Nothing happened to him, died old in his bed, folks brought food to the house
RD_ALifeLine_125236336e7c63f7: Wesley cried when we walked out, first he's cried since Riverside
RD_ALifeLine_4ef2be4173d7af25: He had a bed for one night
RD_ALifeLine_12d9612030d0c594: A bed, cold milk, a girl his own age, that's what I took off him
RD_ALifeLine_0f3b30014273d86a: You took him out of a place we don't understand yet
RD_ALifeLine_0aa4290e7c9ad99d: You go tell him that, I tried, he's eight
RD_ALifeLine_2586b29f034fdb43: They'll take the group, all of it, except Papaw
RD_ALifeLine_591473da63d0ac0b: Said they can't feed a mouth that can't work, said it real kind, too
RD_ALifeLine_0a9374fa6e4aafb1: Then they can't feed us neither, 'cause we ain't splitting up
RD_ALifeLine_00844736193bdbdb: Say that in front of him, go on, he's sat right there and he can hear you
RD_ALifeLine_65ebc46171dd930b: Papaw, they've got a doctor and a bed with springs in it
RD_ALifeLine_76fb0b220821b336: I been inside a fence once before, in Korea, on the good side of the wire, no
RD_ALifeLine_4d4888402721aa14: Alright, you go on if you want, leave the truck keys where I can reach 'em
RD_ALifeLine_657b6ed173abf628: I'll go in by myself and look, y'all hold at the Kelso place three days
RD_ALifeLine_644594f803c2c25b: And if you don't come out?
RD_ALifeLine_697154221e63e2a1: You don't come after me, you go to Riverside and find Aunt Cleo, say it back
RD_ALifeLine_0eb380ea37cd2987: Three days and then you go, don't you dare come through that gate
RD_ALifeLine_05445c0d506c4e52: At that place they put men in the school.. women and kids in the Methodist annex
RD_ALifeLine_391281387fb65a95: Till they knew you.. I asked how long that took and the man changed the subject
RD_ALifeLine_64599b77650f4bfb: Mrs. Tandy sent over half a pone of cornbread, I about handed it back to her
RD_ALifeLine_2f6bb0434af1f3da: I know, my mother'd have died before she took charity off a neighbor
RD_ALifeLine_2de2e5b10898e6d0: Your mother'd have sent the cornbread, and she'd have wanted it eat
RD_ALifeLine_5ed134a6490b6ab4: It's Bug's birthday Sunday, she's asking for a cake
RD_ALifeLine_0002146f679c758f: We've got no eggs to spare and no sugar at all
RD_ALifeLine_5069f2ac61d3fbb0: I know what we've not got, I'm asking what we have got
RD_ALifeLine_15b1a5b2633b4235: Cornmeal, a little lard, jar of blackberry off your mother
RD_ALifeLine_6880223837e1b068: Then that's a cake, don't tell me it ain't, Sunday, that is a cake
RD_ALifeLine_0a62759920d48e9a: I remember you giving Callie a grown woman's plate
RD_ALifeLine_7364f28b03cbacc5: The whole table watched, you knew they would

RD_ALifeLine_2134c3564de8d99d: I keep hoping for a pay stub
RD_ALifeLine_3891a5cc02ea4dac: Do we still get hazard pay?
RD_ALifeLine_50b30aa1141eb451: I'll write 'bad' and leave the rest blank
RD_ALifeLine_106a47454cc2f8f5: Did you hear back from your wife?

RD_ALifeLine_03dfcd4e2af7994e: Don't know, she's in Elizabethtown, phone lines are down
RD_ALifeLine_7ee4350455f63b4f: Maybe, I tell myself that every morning

RD_ALifeLine_28448cc87297ad5e: Just a paragraph, who gets my truck, my badge, my gun
RD_ALifeLine_79a1f3da4bca0851: It's practical, and it made me feel better

RD_ALifeLine_287fed203fd8cc86: I need a lot of things
RD_ALifeLine_6841bb32018fe31a: Is it? How can you tell?

RD_ALifeLine_64204fb4032256b5: Rule of three: eat, sleep, shoot
RD_ALifeLine_449c49f454922a86: And I'm still alive, and so are you
RD_ALifeLine_3bcac77949d7ada9: I'm putting you on desk duty
RD_ALifeLine_767217cb5671449f: Out of service, and that's me, most days
RD_ALifeLine_0c73334a47f18889: I'm too tired to be scared
RD_ALifeLine_3aeb1b593445acfb: Anyplace you'd be fine not coming back from
RD_ALifeLine_1674e5f041bfef51: I've been working since before dawn
RD_ALifeLine_5ea838c8679834f5: Then I'll never get them on

RD_ALifeLine_3dac368723954f0e: Write it now, in your head, tell me
RD_ALifeLine_1261c5a31ac15812: It was loud, and dark, and we were not ready
RD_ALifeLine_656e4ed67d3e8ee4: I will, until it works or I do
RD_ALifeLine_3e58c8661d97324b: The ones with the bad acting?
RD_ALifeLine_1d953c8c2c576fa3: I'd watch them all night now
RD_ALifeLine_0f0b9c507d3d5c04: What did you want to be?
RD_ALifeLine_4dad87cc29751ac5: My dad was a cop, and I couldn't disappoint him
RD_ALifeLine_45ccffe626bf9b64: First time you drew your weapon?
RD_ALifeLine_44f6904a76ee22e0: In a garbage can, I was twenty-two and jumpy
RD_ALifeLine_72ff73d10e19580e: You carry a lot of photographs
RD_ALifeLine_07d2f503435255b2: My partner used to sing off-key
RD_ALifeLine_48dbd96306827166: He's gone, I'd give anything to hear it again
RD_ALifeLine_76f85e0e294355ed: It's never enough, but it's something
RD_ALifeLine_0853d84b25cf3de4: Anyone else got a feeling about this?
RD_ALifeLine_29709fd01942dd0a: The kind that's never wrong, unfortunately
RD_ALifeLine_3cb7229b35b6cef9: Makes me a target, but I keep it close
RD_ALifeLine_1e7e09090655a157: Then I'll sleep for a week
RD_ALifeLine_1318b518195534b7: A granola bar, half a granola bar
RD_ALifeLine_1769854133b667a9: In my pocket, saving it for a worse day
RD_ALifeLine_49e511281faebb77: Brother, today IS the worse day
RD_ALifeLine_178316e129d5368f: Remember when the worst thing in this job was a drunk and disorderly?
RD_ALifeLine_0aa4b04133af98b1: Friday nights at the Tastee-Freez, yeah
RD_ALifeLine_1e4d0bd53b6b37b9: I'd give my pension to arrest one more drunk
RD_ALifeLine_11a70d9f4c421d3b: You'd give your pension to hear him complain about the coffee
RD_ALifeLine_2a75c96f36700590: Chief used to say, 'Write it all down'
RD_ALifeLine_4996049172c182c7: I wrote it all down, I've got two notebooks
RD_ALifeLine_1828fefe1abd45ca: Mostly dates, and names of people I couldn't save
RD_ALifeLine_187b6c2049e5d146: ...that's useful, Ray, that's the most useful thing in the county
