RD_ALifeLine_1839beb668f4f784: You told me she was in Louisville
RD_ALifeLine_49dc4a2a0f2c8eb7: She is, I can't stop picturing it, a light on in an empty house
RD_ALifeLine_4d3d5bc1201f8307: Eleven rounds, three flares, one working radio
RD_ALifeLine_2a6308ea2644f75e: It's a lot more than yesterday, if you think about it
RD_ALifeLine_6a00ea1d4353ba57: Don't make me think, I'm barely holding together
RD_ALifeLine_5937a35f5350dd04: Roll call, 0600, I'll do the honors
RD_ALifeLine_47faf4073bdd0984: Four's still a roll call, Deputy
RD_ALifeLine_75f94b177b4b9557: ...no, no he's not, mark him absent
RD_ALifeLine_6ec3e1275b137eeb: You ever fire that thing before the ninth?
RD_ALifeLine_611448857df0dc0a: Qualified every year, never once at a person
RD_ALifeLine_4ecfcba27e2c2889: Now I qualify every day, at 'em
RD_ALifeLine_62412c195ae6f415: Gotta say, you handle yourself better than I expected
RD_ALifeLine_3a5f197f53e87e3a: Take it before I change my mind
RD_ALifeLine_15891e020ecc2ead: Did you hear the man on the radio last night?
RD_ALifeLine_43437b4c79fbbe4c: The one who plays the old country songs?
RD_ALifeLine_136d3d8c27306d44: Yeah, he played one of Daddy's favorites, I had to step outside
RD_ALifeLine_4507976d332f081c: 'He Stopped Loving Her Today', go ahead and laugh
RD_ALifeLine_7cdd2c066329b3e6: Hey, you remember Mrs. Hadley's cat?
RD_ALifeLine_7ea1334c38b5df14: Biscuit, up the tree again, we got him down three times
RD_ALifeLine_58f22c2c6358b516: I'd give anything to get that cat out of a tree right now
RD_ALifeLine_5050ef4d19305856: Dead, it's dead, I'd take sirens over this
RD_ALifeLine_69330ced2ac113d9: I hate being alone with my thoughts more
RD_ALifeLine_61b3071103037a2c: Citizens keep asking when the curfew ends
RD_ALifeLine_12816ebf2151b23b: They don't have to like it, they just have to survive it

RD_ALifeLine_2725ba407919fe60: Mostly families, a few vets, a couple of strays
RD_ALifeLine_536dc62c42a74bef: Keep the strays near the door, I don't trust strays
RD_ALifeLine_1e5dd3ec3bf37367: Another group came in from the north, wounded
RD_ALifeLine_493044e1535075ec: Out on a call, I'll find her
RD_ALifeLine_370ee2e277f3dc66: Somebody's keeping a log of our patrol in a mailbox on our own route
RD_ALifeLine_2957583d72105a28: Times, plate, how many in the car, neat little column, we're on there nine times

RD_ALifeLine_6d522dae23bfda29: Found a monitor taped up inside a light fixture, battery pack, fresh cells, wire run neat
RD_ALifeLine_78542059507903a2: Ours, the one we've been sleeping in for nine days
RD_ALifeLine_13e37ed563aa21e8: So tonight we talk about the route in the truck with the engine running, not in the house

RD_ALifeLine_2a73c45e47fe26b6: Hold it right there, show me your hands, both of 'em

RD_ALifeLine_2be5ecc626b6a276: I am looking at the hands, Sir, how many with you? Anybody hurt? Anybody bit?
RD_ALifeLine_3447423f343f2250: He answered all three in the same order you asked 'em, word for word order
RD_ALifeLine_21d7279a1e176ed8: Lay the long gun down and step off it, then wait there, somebody's coming out to you
RD_ALifeLine_7b672ce1104ec802: Round in the chamber, snap off, round in the chamber, snap off
RD_ALifeLine_71969f740ff898f2: You're checking it every thirty seconds, quit it
RD_ALifeLine_05cfd702322c6afb: Told her I'd be home by eleven, that was Friday
RD_ALifeLine_009982673bf7c68f: She's gonna give me hell for it, good, I want her to give me hell
RD_ALifeLine_00c35bd7736afd1f: Called the house from the squad room, got the machine, got my own voice saying we can't come to the phone
RD_ALifeLine_5017aac37b03eb5e: Called again, just to hear it pick up
RD_ALifeLine_79e8cd7055937cd7: Then two's the number, load up
RD_ALifeLine_131bc82e4e30fc54: He made me shake on it in the diner parking lot, back in April, like a joke, if I ever come back from the dead on you, you do it
RD_ALifeLine_3aa1ea4e70f70152: And when it came to it?
RD_ALifeLine_5f4ed11e465350d8: I kept my word, took his badge off first, didn't want it getting dirty
RD_ALifeLine_7d2bc07a2c8c3ed3: I keep a list of every one of ours that got bit, day, hour, what they were doing
RD_ALifeLine_06ee5496599037bd: Because they all made the same mistake, and I want to know which one
RD_ALifeLine_102ae2fe519e1dc6: Clean hands, clean forearms, neck, you can't see your own neck
RD_ALifeLine_49c2d6df791ff671: Somebody's gonna have to look at my neck tomorrow, heh
RD_ALifeLine_722b473f696f3a4f: One of us gets bit, it's his call, he can walk off, or he can ask
RD_ALifeLine_6fe521f4464e7bd9: Then the senior officer chooses for him
RD_ALifeLine_1b65d52e23cb13d7: Hair up under the hat, sleeves down, gloves on, nothing for 'em to grab
RD_ALifeLine_1d10b60520cd3347: Cutting it tonight, all of it, should've done it the first day
RD_ALifeLine_316abcb77d93087e: Mama's gonna kill me, heh, mama's gonna kill me
RD_ALifeLine_2936f8454712540e: If we were down to a few rounds, how would you decide who carried them?
RD_ALifeLine_2912612a63815224: I'd check which weapon they actually fit, then who could use it safely, not who had the stripes
RD_ALifeLine_3934a57849c25dfd: Neither would I, if I was the sergeant, doesn't make rank a substitute for checking
RD_ALifeLine_7eb76e650572c309: We heard that bell on the line every night and the LT wrote it up as civilian activity
RD_ALifeLine_0501dec55e81b56c: We walked to it once, church was shut and the road behind us was full when we turned around
RD_ALifeLine_49c9d0da70467ae5: We once searched a house on Tanner, I still wouldn't have slept there
RD_ALifeLine_11cbf0bc0721717a: All the interior doors were off the hinges and stacked in the hall, eleven of 'em
RD_ALifeLine_6aab74355f46284b: That's enough to make me look for somewhere else too
RD_ALifeLine_651a73396b42699a: I'm not going to be the only one that's seen 'em, I'm not doing that
RD_ALifeLine_7d23eb324a84dc70: I'll wake him up, he can be mad at me, being mad is fine
RD_ALifeLine_4b5cea773d6a93ed: Sergeant, there's prints on the inside of the wire, inside, not outside
RD_ALifeLine_707a62c53e3a6197: I'd rather show you now, if that's alright, I'd rather not be the only one that's seen 'em
RD_ALifeLine_4da51c8f7f5722d1: Alright, get a light, walk behind me and don't step where I step
RD_ALifeLine_3c5cb26903f01ec7: Woman went into labor in a Buick right at the barrier this morning
RD_ALifeLine_7238ca6817f07373: Couldn't, Doc talked the husband through it on the bullhorn from behind the jersey barriers, forty minutes
RD_ALifeLine_5db233977ab01e26: Whole line went quiet, engineers even shut the generator off
RD_ALifeLine_5f073b84409af0c2: Little girl, Mama hollered the name across so it'd be written down someplace official
RD_ALifeLine_0131e8e57c51de29: Back of my range card, grace Ann, 0710
RD_ALifeLine_4867562c43fce8c9: That's my mama, lady in the blue Chevy, that's my actual mama out there
RD_ALifeLine_3e7efff0060bcf13: Don't wave, lieutenant's looking right at us
RD_ALifeLine_580d9f6f7047c186: She's holding up a bag, she brought my good socks, I told her Thursday on the phone my feet hurt
RD_ALifeLine_1a7300a51a5b329f: Nod, then, nod real big so she sees

RD_ALifeLine_54f978754b2eb7ee: Told him keep 'em in the plastic sleeves, out of the damp, that's all I had to give him
RD_ALifeLine_24bd5edf3160c4a7: There's a cassette caught in the second strand, tape all pulled out, blowing around
RD_ALifeLine_32e48c9505fc3505: So every time the wind picks up it catches the light tower, I keep thinking it's a flashlight coming
RD_ALifeLine_51d045ea7cbd1964: No, I'll get used to it

RD_ALifeLine_4eb8deb90c7d3dbd: Before the gate went, they were singing, the whole crowd out there, some church song

RD_ALifeLine_3107718a540e44bf: My grandma's church sang that one every homecoming, I knew all the words

RD_ALifeLine_62c8745c5bc8f0cc: I know you didn't, I was right next to you
RD_ALifeLine_52e6c438575d104f: The whole time, figured one of us ought to be able to say so

RD_ALifeLine_6a6c6b0a5eefcec5: You're looking, Looking's how you end up walking over there

RD_ALifeLine_676b0b081bebe1fd: Yes ma'am, that's all I said to her, yes ma'am

RD_ALifeLine_1a42a5b07d3c1f3d: He didn't want out, he wanted somebody to carry the cooler across, just the cooler

RD_ALifeLine_56b7af69242f7025: She said yesterday her knee was acting up

RD_ALifeLine_6c55c88174755d5d: State representative doesn't outrank a jersey barrier

RD_ALifeLine_18c9eaca03555e34: Well, it is traffic, it's just not moving
RD_ALifeLine_44ad75494a3a7484: She asked how long the wait was, I said ma'am, I honestly don't know

RD_ALifeLine_278714d11e0b3ce3: Phones don't work, man, nothing out there rings
RD_ALifeLine_5d2f00b82b852b29: I know it, I memorized it anyhow

RD_ALifeLine_2fc722b640f5ab50: Quit making any noise around Tuesday, wind's out of the south today, too

RD_ALifeLine_6bb7eb954d4df124: Somebody who just made the last payment on it
RD_ALifeLine_758360426474fa44: He cut the straps and left it right there on the shoulder when we turned him, door hanging open
RD_ALifeLine_1b0c63bb560df67a: Read the sitrep that went up for that night, civil disturbance, dispersed
RD_ALifeLine_46cdbb3b717fab43: One word, typed nice and neat, no mistakes
RD_ALifeLine_769aea892977a6f0: What word would you have used?
RD_ALifeLine_24ff8a4e343d5927: I don't have one, that's why I'm so mad at theirs
RD_ALifeLine_3590d0857b2626b6: Wire runs right between the Gaddie house and his dairy barn, house on our side, barn on theirs
RD_ALifeLine_124cfb01224787eb: Nobody's milking 'em, he comes down to the wire at five every morning anyway and stands there while they bawl
RD_ALifeLine_38aa71114b256df7: About as long as it used to take him to milk
RD_ALifeLine_7905b3fa7dd57c11: Searchlight picked up a swimmer off the boat ramp at Brandenburg last night, headed for Indiana
RD_ALifeLine_732b8e116852cde5: Halfway's a long way to swim in the dark
RD_ALifeLine_24548a7c10d09ae1: When Tammy asks, I'll tell her I directed traffic, that's what it was, traffic
RD_ALifeLine_658954175cb4ac10: Directed traffic in July, real hot, real boring, nothing to tell
RD_ALifeLine_164f505615707d97: She'll buy it, she always said I was a lousy liar, so she'll never figure I'd try
RD_ALifeLine_31cb5ef0253ec86a: Engineers want to drop the old railroad trestle over Otter Creek
RD_ALifeLine_474bafb1533656d3: Why? Nobody's driving over a trestle
RD_ALifeLine_0a6eabf51cecafe7: Because they walk over it, single file, all night long, like they're filing into church
RD_ALifeLine_3c760b2b161129eb: Railroad's gonna be sore about it
RD_ALifeLine_4b5db5047f625cf1: Railroad's welcome to file a complaint, through the wire
RD_ALifeLine_5a1a5c62260c8e71: Guy at the barrier asked could we get three rental tapes back to the video store in Radcliff, due Monday
RD_ALifeLine_60689734789e9ce9: The late fee, that's what's keeping him up at night
RD_ALifeLine_3584b3d160546c9e: I told him the store would understand
RD_ALifeLine_4f117961588f4a3e: And what did he say to that?
RD_ALifeLine_21cf61cb072d7438: Said I'd never met the lady who runs it
RD_ALifeLine_2adc3c4e1274b73a: Old fella in the car line went down in the heat, right on the asphalt next to his Oldsmobile
RD_ALifeLine_42502788654086d9: Other civilians did, poured their own drinking water on his neck and fanned him with a road map
RD_ALifeLine_7d5776be5935c7ff: Doc was hollering instructions over the barrier the whole time
RD_ALifeLine_1ed0b4e63f063a62: Sat up, drank somebody's warm pop, then he waved at Doc like they were old friends
RD_ALifeLine_3070071020be7000: Kessler won't eat, says he saw his old shop teacher in the crowd at the gate that night
RD_ALifeLine_7798c1fb1017cdbf: Dark as it was? No way he could tell
RD_ALifeLine_568186e9424aac4e: Says the man had on the booster club windbreaker, same one he wore to every home game
RD_ALifeLine_4a7a1faa29d1806f: Half the men in Muldraugh own that windbreaker
RD_ALifeLine_405f6f861bdff18b: That's what I told him, he said not with Mr. Priddy stitched on the pocket
RD_ALifeLine_0f2ac53f55070f52: Mail carrier pulled up to the barrier in the little white truck, asked could she leave the route's mail with us
RD_ALifeLine_1d65235e2fa25410: Said nobody told her to stop, said she'll keep coming till somebody in Washington signs something
RD_ALifeLine_35dedeea4422764d: Major's map in the command post has red pins everywhere the line's been breached
RD_ALifeLine_111a41a61fbe6e56: They ran out of red pins Wednesday, it's yellow thumbtacks now
RD_ALifeLine_553763f57e447d23: Yellow's a cheerier color, at least
RD_ALifeLine_78560a6e12b14f49: MPs flex-cuffed a civilian to the post by the processing tent, said he bit a medic
RD_ALifeLine_73b734851628316c: Bit him? Or bit him bit him?
RD_ALifeLine_6e493c9f6e1afeec: That's what everybody's waiting to find out
RD_ALifeLine_0d134d892b5d3256: Doc says by supper, the medic's sitting over by the water buffalo, not talking to anybody
RD_ALifeLine_37d7743b74a7dd75: A kid once asked me if soldiers ate astronaut food
RD_ALifeLine_2fd4dcfc56c60f30: Told him yes.. he started saluting every morning I couldn't bring myself to correct it
RD_ALifeLine_58a4bf5c35082b36: You know what I keep hearing when I try to sleep? The barracks box fan
RD_ALifeLine_604fc0ff51289525: It rattled on every third turn, I used to hate it
RD_ALifeLine_7a5b23e722d2b730: Power's been off on post since Tuesday
RD_ALifeLine_091d4fac0bb9cd6b: I know, I still hear it rattle, every third turn
RD_ALifeLine_4ffd91645d555967: Engineers wired the Salt River bridge last night, just in case
RD_ALifeLine_4f0584a508f08d8b: In case the line has to move, nobody's saying which direction
RD_ALifeLine_4fa22a2f2d3c5d9a: An engineer captain, he sleeps with it on his chest like a teddy bear
RD_ALifeLine_5717855a0797f8e5: Drill Sergeant, does this count as a deployment? For a ribbon?
RD_ALifeLine_421a330b5b08a5ba: My dad's got a whole row from Panama, I'd just like the one
RD_ALifeLine_7e2f351c56c3f325: Private, you finish this with all ten fingers and I'll cut you a ribbon out of an MRE box myself
RD_ALifeLine_032ed9443078f048: Everybody still standing at the end gets a cardboard ribbon
RD_ALifeLine_7ee633f01d568771: Federal law says my boss has to hold my job while I'm activated
RD_ALifeLine_233b5dc215be65e9: Snack delivery route, potato chips, most of it's right here in this county
RD_ALifeLine_3f64e14202abf626: Route's here, stores are here, it's the customers I'm worried about
RD_ALifeLine_1ac2568508f8b17a: Who opened this case and pulled out every last packet of cocoa?
RD_ALifeLine_61df88c6052894eb: Then why does Hollis's canteen cup smell like a candy store?
RD_ALifeLine_345a3280590c9210: Hollis is a lot of things, Sergeant, Innocent's not one of them
RD_ALifeLine_09c03cbf455c168a: I remember Doc sitting three hours with that heat case.. the kid from Bowling Green
RD_ALifeLine_37536cad095ab3c0: He was drinking.. making jokes about the IV
RD_ALifeLine_7ed5e03c7b4e95be: Lost somebody Wednesday who'd been drinking and joking too.. that was why
RD_ALifeLine_4816e0b075705fb7: These crackers are so dry I could send Morse code tapping 'em on my helmet
RD_ALifeLine_1361387c14ea32a0: Send water, stop, send more cheese spread, stop, send me home
RD_ALifeLine_23014729304bd87d: I remember a boy with the chaplain, shaking a dairy pouch like a maraca
RD_ALifeLine_3f48982914e4286f: Did he ever tell anybody his name?
RD_ALifeLine_562872862b67b86e: Not while I was there, but he said thank you every time. Somebody raised him right
RD_ALifeLine_052ddf2f4af39662: Why's Specialist Bohannon talking to the dozer?
RD_ALifeLine_258147796540f9dd: Says she's got a hydraulic leak and she likes hearing it's gonna be okay
RD_ALifeLine_7f32325e00815163: Every hour on the hour, nicer than he's ever talked to any of us
RD_ALifeLine_5c036cf139152033: Look at Petrie, look at his arms
RD_ALifeLine_43cae47b4424b07b: Bone dry, it's ninety-eight degrees and he's dry as a paper sack
RD_ALifeLine_390679636c125b43: Get his helmet off and go get Doc, walk, don't run, running makes the whole line jumpy
RD_ALifeLine_07707e542e99debc: Somebody clipped a full canteen to my web belt while I was asleep in the Humvee
RD_ALifeLine_5daf189958659ffe: Don't know, nobody's owning up, it's got the cold water from the ice chest in it
RD_ALifeLine_047486550fbc8f9d: Then drink it and quit asking, whoever did it wants you to drink it
RD_ALifeLine_0ac0224536c4dc7f: Hot skin, confused, throwing up, Doc, is that the heat or is that the other thing?
RD_ALifeLine_625444a2567b718c: For the first hour they look exactly the same
RD_ALifeLine_280ba27862f7c7d0: So what do we do for the first hour?
RD_ALifeLine_2df7f5c638fe3adb: Cool him down, check every inch of skin for a break, and flex-cuff one wrist to the cot
RD_ALifeLine_6519a4386760cb91: If it's heat, he'll be alive to hate it
RD_ALifeLine_6ee6bef550029b6f: Who dumped a whole can of grape drink mix in the water buffalo?
RD_ALifeLine_55bd145f300622af: Nobody was drinking, Sergeant, now everybody's drinking
RD_ALifeLine_404609f93e1b8c94: The whole line's got purple mouths
RD_ALifeLine_2e9656b91595f2b0: The whole line's pissing clear, I call that a win
RD_ALifeLine_7e4cab325837e057: Ammo point started wanting a signature for every box.. name unit what it was for
RD_ALifeLine_2c7b97382f7e1adb: What for?.. What did they think it was for?
RD_ALifeLine_1507b6cc357d0ca0: They wanted it written down.. somebody wanted a paper trail
RD_ALifeLine_10b1d4bf2f8932e5: I wrote the same, it's easier to spell
RD_ALifeLine_433ce7652befb29e: Civilian lady in the processing tent had a baby bottle and nothing to warm it with
RD_ALifeLine_067d0a3f4781a65e: So what did you do for her?
RD_ALifeLine_6a380334416d7f26: Showed her the ration heater, splash of water in the bag, bottle in, wait five minutes
RD_ALifeLine_0acb76e218a00d03: Baby quit crying, she asked could she keep the heater, I gave her four
RD_ALifeLine_16ef8fd81addb832: Holding area's got forty civilians who got caught inside the line after curfew
RD_ALifeLine_096cdf906be3a85d: Sleeves up, temperature, twenty-four hours on a cot where we can see 'em
RD_ALifeLine_5d685f8a28ad064d: After the twenty-four we bleach the cots and fill 'em again
RD_ALifeLine_6687fed00ebe359c: Nguyen can't understand one word Tolliver says
RD_ALifeLine_5dd9677e5cfe4666: I understand him fine, he says holler and he means valley
RD_ALifeLine_064ad5fe423a52ad: I say holler 'cause it's a holler
RD_ALifeLine_0552cb003c117e49: And now Nguyen says y'all, three weeks in Kentucky
RD_ALifeLine_2e144063667aa7e6: It's a useful word, it saves time in a firefight
RD_ALifeLine_21c3e80048854073: Engineers cracked the fire hydrant on Main with a pipe wrench
RD_ALifeLine_585a70bc30294580: City's not sending out bills this month
RD_ALifeLine_522277fa33cb4355: Whole platoon ran through it in their boots, Sergeant too, Sergeant went through twice
RD_ALifeLine_55a613934cab009a: Bring the sheets! Soak 'em in the ice chest and wrap him head to toe
RD_ALifeLine_09706c35395c685e: Then it's cold water, wrap him, somebody hold his head up off the dirt
RD_ALifeLine_5a1927ca09304a28: Good, shivering means he's still in there, keep talking to him, say his name
RD_ALifeLine_633347273d722387: Nobody goes anywhere alone, not even the latrine
RD_ALifeLine_02ce8fd338fe0e9a: Then go stand outside that door and hum, so he knows you're out there
RD_ALifeLine_54af69950d9a4d5d: Anything that isn't the Army song, he's heard enough of that
RD_ALifeLine_193713d3078da338: Monday morning I was supposed to be at my desk at the bank, I'm a loan officer
RD_ALifeLine_6d78f2232da72e58: Young couple, closing on their first house, I had the folder all ready on my desk
RD_ALifeLine_59e3d2346d115d02: Mess hall still had hot chow on Saturday, real trays, big fans going
RD_ALifeLine_3fc002a06e9f088c: Salisbury steak and those carrots nobody eats
RD_ALifeLine_46d0e0177462ab6f: I'd eat the carrots and write the cook a thank-you note
RD_ALifeLine_354fb36b57d12dfb: Ingredients, water, beef, modified food starch, salt, natural flavorings
RD_ALifeLine_0cf3a8f13b2e7687: Natural flavorings, some man at a desk had to sign off on calling it that
RD_ALifeLine_050d09be6fc56eda: Bet they gave him a medal
RD_ALifeLine_6feec47c182601a6: Drill Sergeant Pettaway hasn't yelled once since Friday
RD_ALifeLine_1f19ee206d1077b1: He called me by my first name this morning, asked had I slept
RD_ALifeLine_6efa979860b3f4ed: That's the scariest thing that's happened on this whole post
RD_ALifeLine_260a8da6187a3719: Look at the date stamped on this pouch, nineteen eighty-seven
RD_ALifeLine_0eb4b83223e2a7fb: Pork and rice, six years old
RD_ALifeLine_6c5df8187293e279: Pork's holding up better, eat it
RD_ALifeLine_0215712a1686e816: Fireguard log, 0300, bay secure, Beasley talking in his sleep about pancakes
RD_ALifeLine_0cda1e9876b09333: 0315, Beasley still on pancakes, syrup has entered the conversation
RD_ALifeLine_0c268ec37042314e: 0330, Beasley wants bacon, honestly, Beasley, me too
RD_ALifeLine_2a8b5f6578102e93: Engineers are chainsawing the tree line back two hundred meters, fields of fire
RD_ALifeLine_3884ae630d2484ad: Peach trees, lady who owns it stood on her porch and watched the whole morning
RD_ALifeLine_4a2511c77bb07048: Asked could she pick the rest before they got to 'em, she's been picking since noon, filled a bathtub
RD_ALifeLine_23470710164a265d: Rash under the vest, under the belt too
RD_ALifeLine_6e4592f61e86a2e4: Rash behind both knees, where I didn't know a person could even sweat
RD_ALifeLine_6353c924135b1591: If the dead get me, at least they're getting a real itchy meal
RD_ALifeLine_6395032461621387: No heaters after dark on the wire, eat it cold
RD_ALifeLine_7e91ce0d248c85db: Makes steam, makes a hiss, makes a smell, pick which one you want to explain to the ditch
RD_ALifeLine_449b8e674bf62b30: Mabry's passing out salt tablets like it's Vietnam
RD_ALifeLine_4bc6b59c650fa7c1: Mabry says Doc's never seen a real hot day in his life
RD_ALifeLine_334dca6457b986c8: I'm not the one telling Mabry that
RD_ALifeLine_2bb3d1656a91c3a4: Filled five hundred sandbags since breakfast
RD_ALifeLine_563519c8248b2f29: Started naming 'em after old girlfriends to keep myself going
RD_ALifeLine_5199705d0b4e80da: Bag three, then I switched to cousins
RD_ALifeLine_4adaf2c324ddb83a: Engineers pulled every school bus out of the county lot and parked 'em nose to tail across the Riverside road
RD_ALifeLine_4fe46e895e26e3fe: With the school district painted down the side, bus numbers and all
RD_ALifeLine_1acfe456565c48f7: Little boy came up yesterday and showed his mama which one was his
RD_ALifeLine_21183a5e4d355df9: Tolliver froze up when one came to the wire this morning
RD_ALifeLine_336061142c41fa0f: Everybody freezes on the first one
RD_ALifeLine_504c946b0805b0ae: It was the old man from the shoppette, still had his name badge on, Tolliver bought sunflower seeds off him every Sunday
RD_ALifeLine_5a02aea87744066b: How many bags of Ringer's left?
RD_ALifeLine_32d2fe9669911fcd: Put the word out, six, not sixty, six
RD_ALifeLine_4f2f3a9a0326fa5e: Men find shade on their own real quick when they know the number
RD_ALifeLine_4544cccd2ad49756: MPs picked up two of ours in the drugstore in Muldraugh, pockets full of pills
RD_ALifeLine_39de73eb4f3970bd: Sleeping pills, for the guys on nights who can't anymore
RD_ALifeLine_10823c75286ef944: Nobody knows where to lock up a soldier right now, they're in the back of the MP truck, asleep, actually
RD_ALifeLine_0cd43da524916528: Deputy on the other side of the barrier used to play softball against our MP company, county league
RD_ALifeLine_2f6a77775b744971: Terrible, couldn't hit a slow pitch with a canoe paddle
RD_ALifeLine_2181eb795f9d185b: Wanted to know did we still have the league trophy, said keep it safe, then he drove off
RD_ALifeLine_780f9ab834236ff1: Active duty got the new Kevlar, we got steel pots out of the armory basement in Frankfort
RD_ALifeLine_07b8540e061b5e2e: Steel pots went out ten years ago
RD_ALifeLine_2b2c4b115cc380a0: This one's got a name scratched inside, Eddie Lyle, 1971
RD_ALifeLine_14c0d4672bc45e8f: Then Eddie's pot has been through worse, let it do its job
RD_ALifeLine_6a10c9a108f3fde9: Weld every storm grate on this side of the line shut
RD_ALifeLine_13feb28c1d5e3186: Those things don't crawl drain pipes
RD_ALifeLine_544fb8067f76ed83: Ruiz watched one come out of a culvert Tuesday on its belly, welding's cheaper than finding out how many
RD_ALifeLine_0487f5cc1f11d3ac: I remember seven heat casualties before we'd even seen any of them
RD_ALifeLine_6e7f794729d70b9d: Kentucky was doing more damage to us than the dead
RD_ALifeLine_45683e261588e91c: I wrote that in a report.. nobody laughed
RD_ALifeLine_6cb7f9fc2ee6c0f4: Toilet paper out of the accessory packs is going for two Tootsie Rolls a sheet over in second platoon
RD_ALifeLine_70d3cfed315997c6: That's economics, the whole company's been on the bean menus for a week
RD_ALifeLine_3de3542c00fdb40a: Corporal Linville still wears the MP traffic whistle, there's no traffic
RD_ALifeLine_1bddb37d107da1fe: Them things turn their heads at it
RD_ALifeLine_52b6f68f371abc1f: He figured that out, now he blows it at the far end of the lot and walks back real quick
RD_ALifeLine_092b56ea43cd7a6f: And he still calls it traffic control
RD_ALifeLine_54ea4295731db4bc: Can't keep a gunner up in the turret more than forty minutes, the ring gets too hot to lean on
RD_ALifeLine_60503b697a92bb63: Rotated Scruggs out at noon, he left a patch of elbow on the hatch
RD_ALifeLine_361d9c966e59b06d: Every twenty minutes, then, and somebody find him a towel to put down
RD_ALifeLine_22fbe36728bbe4d1: Drill Sergeant, I qualified two weeks ago, twenty-four out of forty
RD_ALifeLine_7356fabf51baf1f6: One over is a soldier, and nothing out there pops up for three seconds, they walk straight at you, slow
RD_ALifeLine_1676551e70cdf183: Twelve hundred calories a bag, it says on the side
RD_ALifeLine_47874fd30ca80538: I was dieting before all this, lost eleven pounds for my cousin's wedding
RD_ALifeLine_23c6c8ec5f1f6124: Was the seventeenth, so I'm eating the brownie
RD_ALifeLine_003ec1b15669cc7e: Down! Under the trees, helicopter coming in low
RD_ALifeLine_3285b6f830948f01: Nobody's burning fuel to look for four privates
RD_ALifeLine_03568f2c3da8c6e2: Then why are we under the trees?
RD_ALifeLine_3aff77773c6897b4: You still wearing your dog tags?
RD_ALifeLine_345c833106eb5fb6: What for? You're not in the Army anymore
RD_ALifeLine_7e050b9811c9ee4e: If I turn, whoever does it ought to know what name to write down
RD_ALifeLine_7c943d7347dc0791: A Humvee with Army bumper numbers rolling down 31W, real sneaky
RD_ALifeLine_55f678d9484273a9: It needs diesel and there isn't any, we'd be sitting in the most expensive shade in Kentucky
RD_ALifeLine_6d8b98cc062412a0: Not if I come up in daylight, hands on my head, hollering my name and unit
RD_ALifeLine_6ea5f1c73bf49c04: I know what the civilians did, I was standing there
RD_ALifeLine_6db3928208a4197d: Why is Wills still giving orders? He walked off same as the rest of us
RD_ALifeLine_552095e679900a29: Because he's the only one who can read a map
RD_ALifeLine_089b06e27a3cc7be: I can hear you, I'm no sergeant anymore, just a guy with a map
RD_ALifeLine_1855f0ab5071fe14: Alright, guy with a map, where are we?
RD_ALifeLine_7204523a04567cb1: Lost, but I'm lost in the right direction
RD_ALifeLine_6e8b2e7b5986e2f6: Why are you holding your arm like that?
RD_ALifeLine_6ec63e221ad643b8: It's a scratch off the concertina, two days ago, I'm fine
RD_ALifeLine_7347ea7d7f2a11bc: Two days isn't enough to be fine or not fine
RD_ALifeLine_5b036b8c01a3bf1d: River's four miles, we find a boat, we're in Indiana by morning
RD_ALifeLine_3d2492576698c89c: Every boat on that river gets a searchlight and a warning shot, then it gets no warning
RD_ALifeLine_14dde174158fffc5: So we go south through the knobs, nobody's watching the knobs
RD_ALifeLine_1a4573601b9f8309: Because nobody's dumb enough to walk the knobs in July
RD_ALifeLine_51a3d04a518d60bc: You got a better way? Say it, say it now, or quit shooting mine down
RD_ALifeLine_2a2f787b1b5553c0: Six o'clock, we'd be in formation right now
RD_ALifeLine_1c4f943e735501d1: I know, I stood up anyway, just for a second, my feet did it by themselves
RD_ALifeLine_30f05c6b5ade5a8e: What's the punishment for desertion? You sat through that class
RD_ALifeLine_62da6a224d6e914b: In wartime it can be death
RD_ALifeLine_4d84c3cd708bad98: Nobody declared a war, so technically we just left work early
RD_ALifeLine_790eacca75c4c35d: You think the MPs are out hunting for us?
RD_ALifeLine_7435cd4852e06966: MPs are hunting for their next hot meal, same as us
RD_ALifeLine_7638303a606f8271: Still, every time I see somebody with something on his arm I think MP brassard
RD_ALifeLine_0552831366b198f1: Out here, something tied around an arm means a bite, I'd be more scared of that
RD_ALifeLine_53e5ccf9130208fb: Cut your name tape off before we burn the blouses
RD_ALifeLine_1d14608a636573a5: My mom sewed this name tape on, not the tailor shop, my mom, at the kitchen table
RD_ALifeLine_64f7ddc113a621f0: Then keep it in your boot, just don't wear it
RD_ALifeLine_0a932c1c40e1d744: Quit calling it deserting, Charlie Company was nine men and a radio that didn't talk back
RD_ALifeLine_503ef4d00b7ea62e: Nine men and Staff Sergeant Tackett telling us to hold
RD_ALifeLine_46e25be6730c1561: Tackett told us hold, and then Tackett got bit, who were we holding for?
RD_ALifeLine_06a8b7376313ad47: I don't know, somebody, I just know what the word is for what we did
RD_ALifeLine_16de2d892d133e4e: Gilley says he's Ranger qualified, that's how come he knows which berries are okay
RD_ALifeLine_4e3d02ca321e2553: I was Ranger qualified in spirit
RD_ALifeLine_7ba7a23d3523f38b: We leave the rifles, walk out looking like civilians and nobody asks us anything
RD_ALifeLine_1fcaa63d0c6d6729: Leave the rifles? With what's walking around out there?
RD_ALifeLine_3acfd00344072c63: A rifle's what gets you shot at the next checkpoint, they see a rifle, they see a deserter
RD_ALifeLine_6bcdd17c648889ba: They see no rifle, they see lunch
RD_ALifeLine_79b904b12aff87fd: Fine, the rifles come, but the uniforms go in the creek
RD_ALifeLine_48ba71434bdba59e: It's got my initials scratched in the cap
RD_ALifeLine_2ee7d336129f4283: You scratched them in last night, I watched you do it with your knife
RD_ALifeLine_50a3e428157acf6b: Then it's been mine since last night
RD_ALifeLine_00b2ebe35649e991: Clothesline behind that farmhouse, jeans, work shirts, the works
RD_ALifeLine_5c20c42254868c72: You walked off a federal quarantine line with a government rifle, take the jeans
RD_ALifeLine_4eac33fe1bad9f6a: Pack of smokes says that line isn't standing a month from now
RD_ALifeLine_69ae29d7043ae1a6: The line, or the soldiers on it?
RD_ALifeLine_4e9572393702c33e: Does it matter for the bet?
RD_ALifeLine_46e9ffb820061edb: Matters for the smokes, somebody's got to still be around to pay up
RD_ALifeLine_23da339d266826b4: My mom's in Radcliff, that's outside, twenty minutes, driving
RD_ALifeLine_502c8b8d4a9692a2: I know where the wire is, I strung it
RD_ALifeLine_7e0733f379ab2586: Then you know there's no hole in it
RD_ALifeLine_6f1c3d8731b187bb: Militia up at Irvington's taking in soldiers, heard it on the CB in that pickup
RD_ALifeLine_1b8296fa17a51cc0: Taking in? Or taking our rifles and our boots?
RD_ALifeLine_3a9016785fbc402f: Either way, they know you ran
RD_ALifeLine_1eb6fbca5e59b6fa: Everybody in Kentucky knows we ran, only the militia's offering supper
RD_ALifeLine_5eb851ce7d542807: Farmhouse up the road has a garden and a family, we have rifles, they have tomatoes
RD_ALifeLine_2c69b48604c0ba3c: We are not doing that to a family
RD_ALifeLine_74bdc362381541d0: We ask nice with rifles on our shoulders, that's still asking

RD_ALifeLine_2f26944a682f0869: Nobody on this line chats with civilians, you challenge 'em, point 'em, step back
RD_ALifeLine_1a0ec37e318c71ad: Sergeant, a lady over there just asked if I was hungry
RD_ALifeLine_48b821bc17546791: She gave him a ham biscuit wrapped in a napkin
RD_ALifeLine_15b4b6f579e8230f: Split it three ways and quit talking
RD_ALifeLine_5d2736b800932421: Deputy on the far side of the wire asked if I knew a Sergeant Wendell Harp, said that's his brother
RD_ALifeLine_63a3bbfd315795ab: Yeah, I didn't have it in me
RD_ALifeLine_121f7adf23f4fdd8: So what'd you say to him?
RD_ALifeLine_6f8301e6023d2312: Said Harp was on another sector, it's near enough true
RD_ALifeLine_6b4d0fca09d9772c: Put your hand flat on that Humvee hood
RD_ALifeLine_1f9972f432dfbb8c: Why in the world would I do that?
RD_ALifeLine_23971477621cf6dd: Because I just did, and I don't want to be the only idiot
RD_ALifeLine_6b2bde3772c241fa: Including our own? What's that supposed to mean?
RD_ALifeLine_422dda4c74fc3dde: It means you walk out past the line, you don't walk back in
RD_ALifeLine_318a40dd2aea1b4c: Boat on the Ohio says there's johnboats trying to cross every night now
RD_ALifeLine_1ae342080f7a34eb: We got a boat out there?
RD_ALifeLine_5a2c65e40c583a14: Somebody with a searchlight is out there, says Coast Guard when they come up on the net
RD_ALifeLine_1835d6874b6aab20: They get told to turn around, same as the cars
RD_ALifeLine_14e39de86002c63b: Doesn't matter who, you're not coming in
RD_ALifeLine_3a8af0c84f34e8a4: Ain't a joke, just the job with a door in the way
RD_ALifeLine_1a94f7c268af7c33: Light towers are up, generator drinks a can of diesel every six hours
RD_ALifeLine_12c7761b7cd2bd82: And the bugs drink a pint of me every six minutes
RD_ALifeLine_4c994db344fb1ba9: Then step out of the light, genius
RD_ALifeLine_10cc314a6c10b0f1: Six hung up on the concertina between post two and post three this morning
RD_ALifeLine_4bccedc668ef06e7: Get the pole team, nobody fires until the civilians are off that road
RD_ALifeLine_7ca6d3bf6b072282: This area is under federal quarantine, turn your vehicle around, return to your homes
RD_ALifeLine_0c067f754e625e4b: Said it four hundred times today, I say it in my sleep now, Ramirez told me so
RD_ALifeLine_1a00467d258f8b10: Return to your homes, like half of 'em still got a home to go back to
RD_ALifeLine_41eacd6870b04b37: Civilian offered me a whole carton of Marlboros for one look at our map
RD_ALifeLine_69f7aae70253523a: And that's all I'm saying about it
RD_ALifeLine_7e5bb114267aef88: Somebody once left Moon Pies by the barrier. Note said, for the boys, God bless
RD_ALifeLine_7b29457c230e6c75: You didn't worry about what was in them?
RD_ALifeLine_6c4c078771c78ff9: I worried. Hated that my first thought about a kindness was being scared of it
RD_ALifeLine_11d6e09d4489b625: I'd have wanted a banana one, wouldn't have wanted to be the first to say so
RD_ALifeLine_6c12e6b35022a55b: Somebody up the chain decided it was a gas, so we stood the line in MOPP Four, in July, in Kentucky
RD_ALifeLine_71264d8a7f99c211: Harris went down in forty minutes, face red as a beet
RD_ALifeLine_37aae1337eeaaf77: They pulled the order at noon, nobody said sorry
RD_ALifeLine_19e6f4755d62d8a7: Army don't say sorry, Army says drink water
RD_ALifeLine_5e435b1871d734d9: Indiana, Ohio, Tennessee, two from Illinois, folks drove a long way to get stuck here
RD_ALifeLine_6862b8cc0c6a0d7a: There was a tour bus at the Patton Museum when it started, Retirees from Michigan
RD_ALifeLine_32639cff0eb6dff3: Bus is parked on the shoulder at Muldraugh, they're living in it, one of them keeps bringing us crossword puzzles
RD_ALifeLine_71f6052b1df82a16: I remember counting posts, men, radios. Waiting for relief at 0600
RD_ALifeLine_57f3eed437d8b25c: Water runs and ammo counts, every change, another list
RD_ALifeLine_418f900961a9c86d: Wrote it all down so there'd be no room left to think
RD_ALifeLine_76b6cc0c3287dff5: TV van out of Louisville tried to come in on the Dixie Highway, MPs turned it around
RD_ALifeLine_7724aa3a5a518fcf: Got a nice picture of my back, I made sure
RD_ALifeLine_2f0a3ddf73be614f: Your mama could've seen you on the six o'clock news
RD_ALifeLine_50b326e1639e8731: My mama would've seen what was behind me
RD_ALifeLine_777a261d47bd2594: No cars today, first whole day with no cars
RD_ALifeLine_1b8631d434bdf8ea: Means there's nobody out there with gas left, or nobody left to drive it
RD_ALifeLine_0bdd08cf799e95d5: I said good, let me keep it
RD_ALifeLine_71047dab709c9cf9: Who painted that orange stripe out past the barrier?
RD_ALifeLine_7a05593b4e1d7a15: Engineers, fifty meters out, anybody steps over it, you challenge
RD_ALifeLine_136c234a722dbe07: Half of it's already wore off under the tires
RD_ALifeLine_1c9ea6bb1c414937: With what, Sergeant? The paint truck went back to post Wednesday
RD_ALifeLine_6ab890f969c1e9eb: Challenge, then password, challenge is lantern, password is cabin
RD_ALifeLine_11df21e31e976f62: No, no, lantern, then harbor, cabin was yesterday
RD_ALifeLine_51b92c3748767bb5: Please don't anybody walk up on me tonight, I'll get it wrong
RD_ALifeLine_582564d51149e8ad: Payphone at the gas station on 31W still had a dial tone yesterday, civilians lined up forty deep
RD_ALifeLine_0e6a369b2afac3f8: Cut this morning, signal guys did it
RD_ALifeLine_60e3a5f4001a3681: Woman at the front of the line had her quarter in the slot when it went
RD_ALifeLine_13d9f27757f199a6: Police call on the fence line, Sergeant wants every piece of brass picked up
RD_ALifeLine_7cc615e8307f872d: What for? Who's counting brass now?
RD_ALifeLine_3239a33550e27e2c: Didn't say, wants it gone before daylight
RD_ALifeLine_0a5500e82066d093: Before the families come back to look
RD_ALifeLine_0f7e72b3770b4ac5: Keep telling myself I was on post four, post four was quiet that whole night
RD_ALifeLine_64ef49df16c678a9: Bootlace keeps coming undone, third time today, can't get the knot to hold
RD_ALifeLine_2117999b3fe38992: Preacher from one of the churches in Muldraugh walked up to the barrier, asked could he pray over us
RD_ALifeLine_08f5bb537654ee27: Let him stand on his side of the paint and pray loud, took his own cover off for it
RD_ALifeLine_3a755afa1834cb80: Beagle came under the wire at the culvert this morning, nobody shot it
RD_ALifeLine_3824f14b3ec25eef: Nobody was ever told to shoot dogs
RD_ALifeLine_26e9d70e65173685: Morales gave it half his crackers, it's asleep in the back of the Humvee
RD_ALifeLine_5e11466e512e5ddc: Private Crackers, he outranks you by lunch
RD_ALifeLine_08cf1f224ec7e58b: ROE card says verbal warning, show the weapon, then a warning shot, it's printed right here in black and white
RD_ALifeLine_2e5160f23341cf3c: The card is paper, Specialist, put it back in your pocket
RD_ALifeLine_2faeb05e6add39c8: Somebody's horse is walking the fence on the Fallas Lake side, saddle and all
RD_ALifeLine_5eae7d695b9f59a4: Just the horse, keeps coming back to the gate right about feeding time
RD_ALifeLine_3fef136b1c55396e: I can't stand listening to it, somebody go catch it
RD_ALifeLine_5692967f592e2fbc: Catch it and put it where?
RD_ALifeLine_1c5bbec450743fb6: Ammo count at post two is short thirty rounds from yesterday
RD_ALifeLine_054b1277757ca8e7: Night shift fired on the wire
RD_ALifeLine_29f85de07463b34f: Then the log's short thirty rounds, Sergeant
RD_ALifeLine_404332695e722c90: Blue station wagon this morning, Indiana plates, cat carrier in the back window
RD_ALifeLine_31423bf053014eee: I know we turned it around, I was standing right there
RD_ALifeLine_069d77ed101fe1e4: Cat hollered the whole time, you could hear it through the glass
RD_ALifeLine_1fa03b0e47720279: Listen up, tonight they'll come to the wire and some of them will still be talking, you don't answer
RD_ALifeLine_4b3430ce55e2e2df: Still talking, Sergeant? The sick ones talk?
RD_ALifeLine_19f2256f5ef49021: The ones who aren't sick yet, you don't answer them either
RD_ALifeLine_3ff595937a121fd2: Here it comes, look at that sky over the river
RD_ALifeLine_3fa3f5ee05cf4711: Good, maybe it'll cool the asphalt
RD_ALifeLine_7380a79742065e8d: And wash the paint line right off
RD_ALifeLine_6d313169313df883: Get your poncho on, will you? Christ, you're making it sound worse
RD_ALifeLine_10e6eb720a2989af: That family on the Brandenburg road wasn't sick, I looked at 'em
RD_ALifeLine_6fd191cc45619a92: You looked at 'em from sixty meters through a rear sight
RD_ALifeLine_07ad5ddb60afe3f2: The little girl had a sunburn, that's all she had, a sunburn
RD_ALifeLine_534e38e46aded59e: Both of you knock it off, it's done
RD_ALifeLine_49be5fd242065426: That's what I'm saying, it's done
RD_ALifeLine_79b66b800c9a3f78: Engineers used to talk about cutting a tank ditch across a road
RD_ALifeLine_690ff4f329d0bb38: No. And I wouldn't promise a ditch would stop them either
RD_ALifeLine_3026dd602e56cdd1: Go tell the engineers, they'll want that in writing
RD_ALifeLine_54d361f925e009c6: I remember people at the barrier asking for food.. not to get through just food
RD_ALifeLine_1b14a241551d6600: We had MREs stacked in a conex
RD_ALifeLine_1d53dbd507ab2737: And orders not to pass anything over the wire.. contact risk
RD_ALifeLine_1fb369682fca0b28: Contact risk, from a sealed brown bag
RD_ALifeLine_3e6da4253df4c544: I threw one over, nobody saw
RD_ALifeLine_02dc128d20dd99b0: You told me to throw two next time
RD_ALifeLine_24bd4e3547d39ee5: Red pickup came at the barrier doing fifty, maybe sixty
RD_ALifeLine_3ff01bf403ef62f2: He was bit, had his forearm wrapped in a beach towel, that's why he tried it
RD_ALifeLine_3c3abf2c4f4cc935: You keep staring at that tree line like it owes you money
RD_ALifeLine_527580b66ae6c558: Same tree line they came out of that night
RD_ALifeLine_0af044c4333804b7: Trees didn't do a thing, watch your sector
RD_ALifeLine_7445741a11cccde8: State trooper at the Ekron junction told our LT this is a state road and he don't take orders from the Guard
RD_ALifeLine_4ee1388b3014c098: LT got on the net, twenty minutes later that cruiser was on the wrong side of the wire
RD_ALifeLine_6a170f0e78bb1c0b: Lights still going, battery's gonna die before his pride does
RD_ALifeLine_1daf4a312830f813: Old man at the barrier had his truck title out, signed it over right there on the hood
RD_ALifeLine_780c895a7e7bdd60: To me, I take the truck, he walks through, that was the deal he wanted
RD_ALifeLine_2fbcea5669dec52d: Does it matter what kind of truck?
RD_ALifeLine_15502302255787a8: Woman handed me a list of names across the barrier, folks she's looking for, twelve names in pencil
RD_ALifeLine_49a4f0be5e72a18c: Read 'em, every one, out loud, so she'd know I did
RD_ALifeLine_5bbef9f82fa3ab0b: Overwatch on the water tower has eyes a mile down the pike, anybody walks in, we know in five minutes
RD_ALifeLine_5cbd85516366a2db: Same five minutes, then they take a good while longer to actually get here
RD_ALifeLine_5271f5be03303d2e: You hear that? Out past the second strand
RD_ALifeLine_7d2dca1813199352: Wire's singing, one of them walked into it
RD_ALifeLine_69a4b7b005e126b9: How do you know it's one of them?
RD_ALifeLine_6c1b720a5b67e02a: Because a person would have quit pushing by now
RD_ALifeLine_7223d39e4a8a6b91: Lady with the yellow umbrella came back, fourth day running
RD_ALifeLine_7af8a9d153ba8297: Same one, her boy works nights at a hospital up in Louisville, wants to know if we heard anything
RD_ALifeLine_10284dda6f575945: Nobody's heard a thing out of Louisville
RD_ALifeLine_4e46e9b44fb5c48a: I told her I'd ask around, she thanked me, she thanked me, man
RD_ALifeLine_4a036de97a20f9c6: Good news, battalion's sending a resupply
RD_ALifeLine_638b05fa46a00220: It's a pallet of bug spray and a chaplain
RD_ALifeLine_252635904625a101: For when the bug spray doesn't work
RD_ALifeLine_30cdbec449cd0df4: I remember calling for more ammo.. over and over
RD_ALifeLine_10232bb25e125da8: They kept asking us to say again
RD_ALifeLine_55ee80df71e286db: And they thought we said camo.. said they'd send more
RD_ALifeLine_561cc352532b0948: We joked they'd never see us die.. wasn't that funny then either
RD_ALifeLine_073517f6514e7619: Captain asked who'd take post one at the school tomorrow, nobody put a hand up
RD_ALifeLine_59c43d18600a7242: The Captain did, then six more hands went up
RD_ALifeLine_7086706c2da9358f: I remember hearing we'd lost Specialist Ruiz at the Salt River bridge
RD_ALifeLine_374c83ae3bda3bfd: I tried changing the subject. Asked if your coffee was hot water with ideas
RD_ALifeLine_2b608abb40569cf8: It was, we both knew what you didn't want to talk about
RD_ALifeLine_5829ed1e4bfa4e2f: Sergeant, what do I put on the sign-out sheet for Hollins?
RD_ALifeLine_716c096f43bb2334: Just departed, let whoever reads it next worry about where
RD_ALifeLine_273c30492f3a0c25: Family day was July third, Mom brought fried chicken in a cooler out to the parade field
RD_ALifeLine_7147a0e40051bb77: Wore my patrol cap all day, down over his eyes, wouldn't give it back at the gate
RD_ALifeLine_75d6ad2668e75bc4: How'd you get those kids across the creek with forty of them in the yard?
RD_ALifeLine_78afbefd6ff8fe5b: Lopez took the radio and walked out into the soybeans hollering into it, loud as he could
RD_ALifeLine_5ee39f526e5203b0: I took the kids across the creek, like he told me
RD_ALifeLine_3d0cbc6c2ddd58a7: Nobody saw what happened to Sergeant Vance after the bridge
RD_ALifeLine_6065d3617510b381: So he's missing, that's how it goes on the report
RD_ALifeLine_0685618b0e2bc43e: I wrote him down late for formation
RD_ALifeLine_36976faf015cd1f0: Private, why is there a goat in my Humvee?
RD_ALifeLine_0b92971e0487df2c: Cook found one can of frosting in the mess hall storeroom, chocolate
RD_ALifeLine_4ee58b1c5e6269c6: Put it on crackers for Pruett's birthday, wrote a two and a zero on it with a knife
RD_ALifeLine_4d37d80e426f40e6: Twenty today, cried in front of the whole platoon, nobody said one word to him about it
RD_ALifeLine_275c051d4b7f2164: General order number one, take charge of this post and all government property in view
RD_ALifeLine_775597eb1eba0877: Government property in view, one fence, one Humvee with a flat, one dead cow
RD_ALifeLine_14559b9662d6ba53: Cow's not government property, I'm taking charge of it anyway, nobody's touching my cow
RD_ALifeLine_4c9b83ee3c6d1d17: Recruiter said two years, see the world, money for college
RD_ALifeLine_314fa8a45b7c29bc: I've seen forty miles of the world, my mama's house in Radcliff is right over that ridge
RD_ALifeLine_702d1ac52e216377: Flare's up, count 'em, nine in the bean field
RD_ALifeLine_24b2db2e56f17409: Ten, eleven, the eleventh one's in a uniform like mine
RD_ALifeLine_0afe8f3041876c0a: Don't look at the name tape, don't read it, front sight, and squeeze
RD_ALifeLine_52e5ab29439f8056: Twenty-two years, Panama, the Gulf, two winters in Germany freezing my tail off
RD_ALifeLine_5a04b3ff6e17da0c: Always knew where the front was, you pointed your rifle at it and you went to sleep with your back to the other way
RD_ALifeLine_1d4fe6d70a056a71: Front's everywhere now, front's in the latrine, front was in the chow line Tuesday
RD_ALifeLine_796094f167372c45: Still break my crackers in two, half for Cruz
RD_ALifeLine_34ba121f050e3543: Cruz hated the vegetable crackers, took his half every time anyhow, said it'd hurt my feelings
RD_ALifeLine_3d5bb1e8676e05e5: Ate both halves tonight, tasted like cardboard, tasted like his half
RD_ALifeLine_0e44857b31094818: Mail sack from the Thursday before, sat in the orderly room this whole time, nobody sorted it
RD_ALifeLine_7b8c006e3e605c7c: Sorted it tonight, put everybody's letters on their cots
RD_ALifeLine_422869a32150bdf2: Some cots, I put the letter up under the pillow, seemed more private
RD_ALifeLine_50e01b7b35b0d67f: Sergeant says you never hear the one that gets you
RD_ALifeLine_4f6599e3744a2fc1: So every one I can hear out there is one that's not getting me
RD_ALifeLine_620dca2a7f8b030f: That's a whole lot of good news out there tonight
RD_ALifeLine_433c491f6cad7ec8: Somebody pinned my prom picture on the orderly room bulletin board, powder blue tux, ruffles
RD_ALifeLine_69d7b4e068df48dd: Building's half burned, that board's the only wall still standing
RD_ALifeLine_7a41ff111cb25a5b: Powder blue ruffles, outlasting the end of the world, course it did
RD_ALifeLine_1260196d3b4bf666: Any station, this is Private Dunn, I don't know my callsign, Sergeant had it written on his arm
RD_ALifeLine_14ada6590b9191e3: I'm at the Rosewood fire station with two civilians and one rifle, over
RD_ALifeLine_1ab287664d3cf91c: Please somebody just say over back, over
RD_ALifeLine_090762c75fc1b282: Our Father, who art, who art in heaven
RD_ALifeLine_4f3d40dd61ff81cd: Drill sergeant says prayer is a personal matter and to do it quietly
RD_ALifeLine_62644fdf5311606c: This is me being quiet, God, I'm real scared, amen, I guess
RD_ALifeLine_57b50eab0fa19d5b: Hey, Tina, I know I said I'd call Sunday
RD_ALifeLine_58a971e73a01749c: Phones are down, that's the truth, you can ask anybody on this line
RD_ALifeLine_00b3341b549a5c7a: You can't ask anybody, I know that, I'm just, I'm sorry about Sunday
RD_ALifeLine_0ff7fa46781ab7a2: Sergeant, what's the plan if the plan doesn't work?
RD_ALifeLine_757383073c575b75: Why is your face black, Private?
RD_ALifeLine_681834ad15b1398b: Camouflage, Sergeant, no face paint left, so I used boot polish
RD_ALifeLine_57d13b7c3421eec0: You look like a raccoon that fell in a tar pit
RD_ALifeLine_04c28383435f762c: Twenty questions, I'm thinking of something
RD_ALifeLine_086f17e52664848e: Is it bigger than a breadbox?
RD_ALifeLine_417795f14353ceeb: Is it out there past the wire right now?
RD_ALifeLine_3736be1f03f74bc2: Don't do that, ask a regular question
RD_ALifeLine_5e142a6b06cd7f17: Those are Doc's glasses, thick as a pop bottle, nobody else can see a thing through 'em
RD_ALifeLine_67129b496bf952a4: Put 'em on at night sometimes, whole world goes blurry, figure that's how he saw it, figure he did fine
RD_ALifeLine_6c6195322152799f: Drill sergeant said I'd never amount to anything, said it to my face in front of the whole bay
RD_ALifeLine_4f604e50575ba48d: Well, Drill Sergeant, I'm the ranking man on this entire stretch of fence
RD_ALifeLine_68a5aacc73426183: Ranking man out of one, private First Class, commanding
RD_ALifeLine_4b051711253895fa: ...yeah, it is, but keep it down, the men are listening
RD_ALifeLine_642a817b326b6c1a: Then it grew legs and walked away?! Find out, now!
RD_ALifeLine_23be9cdc6ba7e9f5: We're out of rations by Thursday
RD_ALifeLine_0daf16455e1eabd9: Then we find more by Thursday
RD_ALifeLine_25d8355702c4e27c: Sir, with respect, find them WHERE?
RD_ALifeLine_0c34f8e747297ccc: Figure it out, Private, that's what I pay you for
RD_ALifeLine_46e370d72b58d28f: No, you don't get it, I MEAN IT, I want to go HOME
RD_ALifeLine_37908e0107605678: Easy, kid, easy... home's gone, we're all we've got now
RD_ALifeLine_0d44a58f55c53df8: ...I know, I just needed to say it out loud
RD_ALifeLine_36803a145c2d5bc4: Remembered finding an unopened pack of gum, sir
RD_ALifeLine_370e2ba570537d87: My daddy's lungs didn't make it
RD_ALifeLine_0bdb50f14d3dc839: He used to say 'son, keep your head up and your boots dry', I think of that every day
RD_ALifeLine_59a4b564760f1264: Heard the lieutenant's wife is expecting
RD_ALifeLine_1ce5c17d4ccdc94c: Congratulations to him, and God help him
RD_ALifeLine_0915edac7fd9f144: What do you miss most about the Army before all this?
RD_ALifeLine_059cbc9b0772c6bb: Having someone to tell me what to do
RD_ALifeLine_332a68eb206c3d09: Nobody tells you how heavy a rifle gets
RD_ALifeLine_5aa684a72fbc8df3: After the first week, you learn to love the weight
RD_ALifeLine_4fc39fe113805c8b: That's okay, none of us are, sit with me
RD_ALifeLine_1e8d8c0f1a6ae44b: You ever write to your folks?
RD_ALifeLine_295a67e921cc008d: I wrote one, I don't know if it'll ever reach them
RD_ALifeLine_722103591dc7ba33: 'I'm fine, I love you, I'll see you soon'
RD_ALifeLine_284094fd2d412d50: Perfect, that's all a letter needs
RD_ALifeLine_68dbdf483292016e: What music do you listen to?
RD_ALifeLine_296ae91d626671d1: Whatever's on the boombox, mostly old country
RD_ALifeLine_603c4ac273fa99c2: Heard the president's coming to Fort Knox
RD_ALifeLine_59ff0eac37c264cb: Okay, the spaghetti, but only because of the cheese spread
RD_ALifeLine_2c245e8c47a78ad8: Beef, and something that used to be beef
RD_ALifeLine_50c033ae1daea046: They're all kids, Private, that's what makes it hard
RD_ALifeLine_25ecafdd6da4d547: What do I do with that?
RD_ALifeLine_52fc08da59ea4037: You carry it, and you keep moving, and when you can't, you ask me to carry it
RD_ALifeLine_24611cdc6131bd6e: His name, the roll call, I can't
RD_ALifeLine_116bd8b839398b40: Four, scared, hungry, one with a limp
RD_ALifeLine_3dd43ae701a665a3: Get them chow, get them cots, we'll brief at dawn
RD_ALifeLine_6da1884b0b9fbd2c: Wrap it, and stay off it tomorrow, that's an order
RD_ALifeLine_0b97930b1b7cbbd0: Anyone got a spare pair of socks?
RD_ALifeLine_1d9aa1711693ce67: I'll trade my MRE for your MRE
RD_ALifeLine_5af4e73864ca8408: What do you call a hungry Marine?
RD_ALifeLine_12e34c0f30fe22a7: It is if you've met one
RD_ALifeLine_23798e3953e9d306: Then why does it look like it isn't?
RD_ALifeLine_4472971455046100: ...that's the funniest thing I've heard all week, carry on
RD_ALifeLine_526e381d0f9ca7b0: Army says, 'Be all you can be'
RD_ALifeLine_48d3cfdd244703f7: Sergeant, did you ever want to be something else?
RD_ALifeLine_1f8193c46d9172d1: You'd have been a good one
RD_ALifeLine_57eb0ff21930cdf1: You'd have been a good co-pilot, Private
RD_ALifeLine_0f3a0a9017fa7c2b: Someone found a stash, don't tell the lieutenant
RD_ALifeLine_1f9325dd780ea454: My lips are sealed, pass the cup
RD_ALifeLine_57e2b85a6a2f0760: ...we're the ones left, Private, that has to be enough
RD_ALifeLine_2934fd484c432e97: He said he'd be back by dawn
RD_ALifeLine_009d3e794e1e339f: Add a line for me, 'Sergeant Hill was right again'
RD_ALifeLine_6ed948665eff51b1: Better than yesterday, they got a hot meal
RD_ALifeLine_4a4929c65e90d694: Remind me to thank the cook
RD_ALifeLine_7ddee95539b7dad7: Permission to ask a personal question, Sergeant
RD_ALifeLine_04f57cb63523bc20: A daughter in Fayetteville, fourteen, she plays the clarinet

RD_ALifeLine_6911132d3602d1da: That's the sensible answer, still seemed a lot of trouble to go to
RD_ALifeLine_7815756f56263e23: Ninety eight out there and that man is dry as a bone, long sleeves, buttoned at the wrist

RD_ALifeLine_4fdc8423742ab0bf: Rain, an inch would do, half an inch, and I'll quit cussing the county extension agent
RD_ALifeLine_02d389ae4458ff4d: Extension agent's probably dead, strike that part, just the rain
RD_ALifeLine_1fc7a1375bd376dc: I worked under a foreman at the quarry just like him, Hollis Tharp
RD_ALifeLine_76328c65192db9e1: He was safe, nobody lost a hand on his shift in nineteen years, also a son of a bitch
