RD_ALifeLine_7b85b39b369ae412: Both, you tell 'em both or you ain't telling it
RD_ALifeLine_40e0c8275fb29ce5: Soon as I said pipefitter, that whole room turned around on me
RD_ALifeLine_26d75bc75564ad08: They offered me a house, a house, with a door that locks from the inside
RD_ALifeLine_661df03c100f04c2: They offered my wife nothing, just me and the house, so, no
RD_ALifeLine_5ccfbb903b7945ac: I remember people counting cans while the creek got low and the well went gritty
RD_ALifeLine_4987724f1976d36a: They thought having food was enough?
RD_ALifeLine_182c45f848cb19dc: They kept saying, we've got food. Like that answered what we'd drink
RD_ALifeLine_2e6869a0219cf827: Gallon a head a day just for drinking, sixteen head, that's sixteen gallon hauled
RD_ALifeLine_3208af9f335cc81c: Washing's a want, the garden ain't, I'll wash in the creek and be happy
RD_ALifeLine_5812bce229c3dd9e: Two hundred foot of green beans and a hard freeze the second week of October
RD_ALifeLine_225ba9f10edbb8af: We can everything, and that's jars, lids and a fire three days, lids is the trouble
RD_ALifeLine_0efa2d5373a40fd1: Salt, nobody thought about salt and now everybody's thinking about salt
RD_ALifeLine_6da559655347318f: Box and a half, salt's how you keep meat, so that ain't a seasoning problem
RD_ALifeLine_4a9db49d0c081532: Hogs are hanging, we've got salt for one and we've got two hogs
RD_ALifeLine_61d9fe60366f3220: One gets eat this week and every soul here is gonna feel rich and stupid about it
RD_ALifeLine_2d2456d6152b5a90: Somebody sits in that corn dark to light, every night, till it's picked
RD_ALifeLine_24b78c936b45e930: Sitting, that's the job, you sit in the corn so the corn knows somebody's there
RD_ALifeLine_4369766552ccba50: Somebody with two toes and a tail, it's deer, look at the tracks
RD_ALifeLine_16510f1a30b07f1a: Huh, best news I've had all month and I still lost the beans
RD_ALifeLine_6b9397b67df1b030: We drop them two big elms across the drive at the curve, no truck gets past that
RD_ALifeLine_7cb999d47d5fa6cd: Ours goes out the field gate, it's two ruts and a prayer, but it goes
RD_ALifeLine_3a1810437a84cb0d: Seed, that's what I lay awake on now, not cans, seed
RD_ALifeLine_4f5dce5e2d8799ce: You can loot a house for beans, you can't loot a house for next year's seed corn
RD_ALifeLine_21384826126304c2: Ground's working, I put my hand in it this morning and it's ready
RD_ALifeLine_6fba65de5a58e1eb: It's the twenty-sixth of February and that ground is ready, get the potatoes out the cellar
RD_ALifeLine_31c2a82e3a90cf8c: Gate's wide open, girls, walk on out if you want
RD_ALifeLine_43ef7e997181a35b: No? Thirty head bunched in a corner with the gate open, alright
RD_ALifeLine_050284376fd035fc: Somebody's taking a coffee can of corn out of the crib every night, one can
RD_ALifeLine_2016b9247e3ff730: Coon don't put the lid back on the can and set it where it was
RD_ALifeLine_6595346e7310f840: First cutting's still laying in the Hagan field, got rained on twice
RD_ALifeLine_77ce9df80fb53418: Daddy never left hay down in a field in his whole life
RD_ALifeLine_0cbd19c56fe02ad4: Daddy never had a field full of company
RD_ALifeLine_1259ce245a92af85: Easy, Clementine, easy, I know I'm late, I know
RD_ALifeLine_035ec2f95591478b: Nobody's buying the milk, I'm pouring it in the ditch, and I'm sorry about that
RD_ALifeLine_5a0800fe5d878aa2: Doesn't matter to you, though, does it? You still got to be milked, hold still, girl
RD_ALifeLine_0ef5ad5529508025: Old man on the bank below the power plant, lawn chair, pole in a forked stick
RD_ALifeLine_32306c6930a3f1cf: No, he waved, asked if they were biting
RD_ALifeLine_3f67428e41172ea6: Said not much today, he said that's alright, he mostly comes for the sitting
RD_ALifeLine_55c6ec3759245d61: They followed us along the bank for two miles
RD_ALifeLine_0c2de26f268cb84d: Walking right along with the boat, like folks following a float at the Christmas parade
RD_ALifeLine_3e29d3a33ab2a8e6: Went around the far side of the island, they just kept walking, right on into the river
RD_ALifeLine_097b2fb03f89e4db: Johnboat drifting past, nobody in it
RD_ALifeLine_7d19e165358b4a95: Cooler, two poles, a thermos, lines still in the water
RD_ALifeLine_4599208b449af3ba: Grab it yourself, the lines are still in the water
RD_ALifeLine_394230ea6af1f607: I once heard a boat motor whining with something wrapped on the prop
RD_ALifeLine_5966e87447aa2d56: Not weeds, I wish I hadn't looked over the side
RD_ALifeLine_044b67f814a94bb9: I still can't talk about it, just remember staring at the bank after
RD_ALifeLine_2d07b4dc4560c7ef: Army's running a gray patrol boat up the river at dawn, big gun up on the bow
RD_ALifeLine_278f52102e998081: If you've got to wave, wave from inside the tree line
RD_ALifeLine_6586bd032fa2ee99: They're somebody's Army, they don't know we're somebody
RD_ALifeLine_3af4e02574f3c445: Come on, Choke's out, Primer bulb's hard, come on, you sorry thing
RD_ALifeLine_64b7b02a441ff50d: Please, I'll clean your plug, I'll buy you the good oil, please
RD_ALifeLine_1f02901e2d119c5d: There, there she goes, good girl, I'm sorry for the sorry thing
RD_ALifeLine_78620c914c15742e: On the water, nobody hollers, one whistle, stop, two, back up, three, get down
RD_ALifeLine_566440c1293bff59: A long one means I fell in, come get me
RD_ALifeLine_016eeb523e586713: What if I'm the one who falls in?
RD_ALifeLine_34aa2da3219082f9: Then blow long and I'll think it over
RD_ALifeLine_2811942f2211f8c7: Three women asked me for birth control pills this week
RD_ALifeLine_314a12880e5c8a5d: That's what we're spending a run on?
RD_ALifeLine_4587cebe684d33cf: You want to deliver a baby in a hay barn next April with no hospital? Then yes, it's on the list
RD_ALifeLine_03ef9d88396cc217: I remember arguing those children deserved the truth about their parents
RD_ALifeLine_4190fa2e1b2c718a: They already knew.. I thought they were waiting to see if we'd lie
RD_ALifeLine_21c694ba48622095: Not that night.. they'd had cornbread I wanted them to have one night with cornbread
RD_ALifeLine_5a42d74b3dcf573f: Glenda's glasses are still hanging on their chain off the register
RD_ALifeLine_486ead9d34dd6a66: Nineteen years she counted pills by fives with a butter knife, faster than me
RD_ALifeLine_436404850231ec9d: I'm fine, it's just the, the tray, I can't count on the tray right without her knife
RD_ALifeLine_45e4fd777d07add5: Where's Harold been keeping his heart pills?
RD_ALifeLine_62e6c38a1bf2b5a4: Glovebox of his truck, since Friday
RD_ALifeLine_4d44b0da09f7e1c9: Nitro tablets in a glovebox in July, they're about as strong as breath mints by now
RD_ALifeLine_32ac038b19ef337f: Find him a fresh bottle before his chest finds out
RD_ALifeLine_29ec98ec5851e1fc: Pet store in Muldraugh has fish antibiotics, same pills as people get, with a goldfish on the box
RD_ALifeLine_3fe9d3804a44f77a: Same powder as the capsules I sold you last winter for your sinuses, minus the goldfish
RD_ALifeLine_3d75313c0f3ae9ee: I've split every blood pressure pill in the bag, half doses for everybody
RD_ALifeLine_762865f8063cfa96: Is half a dose any good?
RD_ALifeLine_313960fe263974bf: Half a dose on a Thursday beats a whole one you haven't got
RD_ALifeLine_4534ad043013d47c: Expiration date on this bottle says June
RD_ALifeLine_3bef817146e14269: It didn't turn to poison on the first of July, it just got a little lazy, most of them do
RD_ALifeLine_6970d8925f68a132: Somebody cleaned the phenobarbital out of the Rosewood drugstore, nothing else, just that
RD_ALifeLine_48418a436a8c9a8f: Seizures, two people filled it with me, old Mr. Kersey, and a little girl named Amber
RD_ALifeLine_3394bca0789a3a54: So Amber's people are alive, and they're walking distance from Rosewood
RD_ALifeLine_43c1b65b59eea99d: Don't pray over my brother, I mean it, not one word
RD_ALifeLine_600b8775319a5495: God had forty years to say something to him and picked this week to go quiet
RD_ALifeLine_6d660c1920ec7c47: Alright, I'll just sit, then, is sitting alright?
RD_ALifeLine_06291dfa711daacc: Which of these can people do without?
RD_ALifeLine_5be425d16db3f274: Thyroid, a while, Cholesterol, forever, Seizure pills and insulin, not a day
RD_ALifeLine_73b638535563b1da: Depends on the heart, I'm putting a star by the ones where it doesn't depend
RD_ALifeLine_192b097d558148e6: Told them that for thirty-one years, they'd nod and pull up their sleeve to show me the rash anyway
RD_ALifeLine_3abb3e782a5b67a1: Before I locked up, I filled a stock bottle with sugar pills and set it on the counter marked morphine
RD_ALifeLine_438a6fec3e15f339: First night, somebody out there is real calm and real disappointed
RD_ALifeLine_5562ca6a4ad2003a: I remember children getting sick with diarrhea at a shelter
RD_ALifeLine_3fe5e31a0b434c75: What could you do for them?
RD_ALifeLine_2160edf77724dc0f: Try to find proper rehydration supplies and qualified help, I wouldn't trust a recipe half remembered in a panic
RD_ALifeLine_1ab51c4502392d21: People kept telling you sugar, salt and water?
RD_ALifeLine_066199e263480b6b: They did. Getting quantities wrong matters, and I couldn't promise a homemade drink would keep every child alive
RD_ALifeLine_6ac0c13256be779a: You're not what I pictured when you rolled up, I figured we were dead
RD_ALifeLine_2da4f1b353121630: I get that a lot, the leather, the beard, it's a bad first look
RD_ALifeLine_1e81ab1731033293: So what's the club do now?
RD_ALifeLine_2d7134e8640049c2: Same as before, ride around and annoy people, only now we carry groceries, you got a list?
RD_ALifeLine_49d8c60a1a6da4c1: You never sleep and I never see you eat, who are you people?
RD_ALifeLine_4ef996e547d9b6f2: We eat when you're not looking, it's a habit
RD_ALifeLine_0d05c3fc4b6020e2: Ma'am, eat something, we move in ten
RD_ALifeLine_3a2c9720250d8a0e: They're on every street we try, officer, you're the only one with a badge, where do we GO?
RD_ALifeLine_157df1791bf0df22: Gym's out, I looked, the church on Elm maybe, if the pastor opened it
RD_ALifeLine_42100f417656e7e9: I said maybe 'cause I don't lie to people, c'mon, we look at it together
RD_ALifeLine_0bd3d59843e2e7ff: You said the bridge, Hale, you told us the bridge was open
RD_ALifeLine_07b00382380ae63b: Hell, it was open Friday, I never said it'd STAY open
RD_ALifeLine_2327c7be500d00b0: Now the boat landing at Rosewood, if anybody's running boats, if nobody is we think again
RD_ALifeLine_4c0aa5944a2bbbaf: Does that damn radio of yours still work?
RD_ALifeLine_0d36423834297a13: Works fine, it just don't say anything, I keep it on
RD_ALifeLine_4f5fda8c1c5a89ce: State police post in E-town had a generator, if they're up they'll key a mic someday, I wanna be listening
RD_ALifeLine_197a156874edad69: Where do deputies go when there's no department?
RD_ALifeLine_5ba08e7603508a07: The station, honest answer, habit, plus the long guns are in the rack
RD_ALifeLine_660bb8dc092448f9: Guns, okay, I hadn't thought of the rack
RD_ALifeLine_11a4038a6ad0cb1d: Nobody thinks of the rack until they need one, we go in, we take what's ours, we leave a receipt
RD_ALifeLine_51f4a4c17ec6ecab: If we find more people, we bring 'em, right?
RD_ALifeLine_1e16bdb147a74203: We check 'em first, arms and legs, anybody bit stays outside
RD_ALifeLine_2db111566e88f974: And if they won't stay outside?
RD_ALifeLine_3c8f1075295c7ad2: Then I explain it with this, and I hope I never have to
RD_ALifeLine_0e5b7da81206df4a: I'm twenty-six, eleven months on the job, I'm nobody's boss
RD_ALifeLine_3e238f620bddbe12: You're the closest thing we got
RD_ALifeLine_0584155b375c6cf6: ...Then you're stuck with a kid in a uniform, church, I say we go to the church
RD_ALifeLine_69350ca474dcbd0d: Cruiser's on fumes, so we walk or we stall
RD_ALifeLine_61367a8a2c6441fe: County road garage has a fuel tank, they filled the plows there
RD_ALifeLine_0cc88af745ebdac2: Hand crank on the side, the old boys always kept one, three miles, bring a can
RD_ALifeLine_017649ef208799b3: We should leave a sign for anybody looking, spray paint, on the road
RD_ALifeLine_55b3186873cc5955: Where we are, how many of us
RD_ALifeLine_7babb4823826eef8: ...Put the church and the number, not the date, the date's just for them
RD_ALifeLine_443293a7264eea50: Last I heard, my wife was in Louisville. On shift Friday
RD_ALifeLine_07cc40d81f157696: Then go, find her, we'll manage
RD_ALifeLine_6992d1c97e0ef37b: I keep setting myself a day to go. Moving the day doesn't tell me where she is
RD_ALifeLine_641f5b0e79662ac7: Why the hell do we stop so early? There's hours of light left
RD_ALifeLine_4bc710432d2e70b4: I'd rather look for a place while we can still see the way in. Less to guess about
RD_ALifeLine_6f53a5427233c9db: Sleep early, up with the sun, I can do that, my mother raised me on a farm
RD_ALifeLine_6d89d4e24fd86a17: Can I have a gun? I'm sick of being the only one with a spatula
RD_ALifeLine_232f338016710bce: Once, a pellet gun, at the county fair, I won a goldfish
RD_ALifeLine_777be74e642259be: ...You start with this, safety's here, aim at the middle, don't shoot unless I say
RD_ALifeLine_1db940fb3937fcfa: That notebook of yours... you've got addresses written down, haven't you?
RD_ALifeLine_54b1e1d54be65f61: Forty people I know living alone in their houses, I get round to check on them when I can
RD_ALifeLine_164eb90113c92de5: Then I'll take Oak Street, you take the other side, we meet at the corner in an--
RD_ALifeLine_5a123b1035f440ab: I'm not sending you off alone, we go two by two
RD_ALifeLine_72806ed0054f459a: Is the jail a good place to sleep?
RD_ALifeLine_1a04544118a66a3e: Bars on every window for a reason, ma'am
RD_ALifeLine_089511f402801154: The cells have bunks, a bucket, and whatever the last guy left, I'd rather the school
RD_ALifeLine_445bdca40b28b82e: Truckers, the CB, channel 19, there's a rig stuck at the overpass with a battery
RD_ALifeLine_7bc4ad170b8a2b8f: We listen, we don't talk, you talk, you tell the whole county where we are
RD_ALifeLine_4d0bd4fb30ca1d70: The Marathon's got gas in the ground, I know the owner
RD_ALifeLine_56b5a980011e9a6c: Gary Doyle, we bowl together on Thursdays
RD_ALifeLine_4f5329592fdb17dd: Gary won't mind, we bring a note, a hand pump, a few guys who can lift
RD_ALifeLine_6beaf6df124bb5d7: Why do we always go the long way?!
RD_ALifeLine_6eafd46a141dc291: Because the short way has a roadblock I don't wanna meet
RD_ALifeLine_7ac936e6785b525b: What the hell kind of roadblock?
RD_ALifeLine_52d0f8ff4155c4dd: The kind with men who stopped being the Army, don't ask, just walk
RD_ALifeLine_2c374a6f7eb524f3: Do you ever think this'll end?
RD_ALifeLine_7d3aff826a78b67a: I, I think about parking tickets a lot, it helps
RD_ALifeLine_01482234077c3d78: Somebody's gonna need to write 'em again, and I figure that somebody's me
RD_ALifeLine_0b9b9c841b261fb5: They said the school's clear, a boy ran in and out, said nothing's moving
RD_ALifeLine_4cdea4db7ffeb63e: He's thirteen, but he's sharp, he's been right all week
RD_ALifeLine_2a8194c836a24ca4: Thirteen's not enough, I'm sending two men first, the boy stays out of it
RD_ALifeLine_5f86c0555b9dde21: Because I'm more sure about it than anything else, and we can't stay here
RD_ALifeLine_09040c206c64355c: Is it true the old man's dead?
RD_ALifeLine_214776653cba6167: Hell, I heard that too, I don't know it
RD_ALifeLine_0180650158fb7420: Then we don't say it till we know
RD_ALifeLine_5adc872c1b27dff1: We agreed on the church, we agreed an hour ago, why are we at the Kroger?!
RD_ALifeLine_067deac608334215: Because you were hungry, you said, I'm just following the plan, the plan was your stomach
RD_ALifeLine_3bffe5c43d5fcb3c: The plan was the CHURCH, I don't care about my stomach
RD_ALifeLine_728c764005de3a7d: church, but you owe me an apology, I carried your bag the whole way
RD_ALifeLine_669f5cca212cc38e: We should stick to the route, I don't care what's on the side of the road
RD_ALifeLine_6323fa16647c73d5: It's a gas station, we might get fuel
RD_ALifeLine_556ac5415a843f11: We said no detours, you said it yourself, you made me say it back
RD_ALifeLine_026bc6a82d7d63ce: I did, I did, I'm sorry, no detours, I'm a man of my word
RD_ALifeLine_02006f03131e3d09: Why are cops always the ones to say we can't?
RD_ALifeLine_4289bfd240aba806: Because we're the ones who see what happens when you can
RD_ALifeLine_6a43cad4782b2a0f: It's job security, ma'am, ten more minutes, then we can
RD_ALifeLine_3b046363398cbf5e: Nobody's driving, it's a dog, a dog with something in its mouth, go around, don't look at it
RD_ALifeLine_261c4001456991af: Mrs. Tate made a casserole, she wants the officer to carry it
RD_ALifeLine_5c8f6de86db0e8e8: I'm NOT carrying a casserole into a fight
RD_ALifeLine_2dc577e12795ae1c: She says it's for the people at the church, you carry it or she carries it
RD_ALifeLine_3f6f9c9d390954cb: Hand it over before she decides to bring it herself, tell her thanks, and that she scares me
RD_ALifeLine_15e47afe52d85700: My daughter wants to learn the hand signals, the ones you use
RD_ALifeLine_381b0e010874a561: Palm out means stop, fist means hold, two fingers means look there
RD_ALifeLine_76b537a809d9e13e: She's eight, she's gonna be bossy with 'em
RD_ALifeLine_5e6154845ffd4a73: Let her, I'd rather have a bossy eight-year-old than a quiet one right now
RD_ALifeLine_43ba64a70338c34b: You wanna run the siren to draw them away from us?
RD_ALifeLine_227b333625ce9042: It worked in the drill, the horn pulls 'em off the building
RD_ALifeLine_1db83cd0780fe654: Pulls 'em toward the horn? Is that the idea?
RD_ALifeLine_284209c2367e59a8: That's the point, then we walk the other way, quiet, in the dark
RD_ALifeLine_1c0ba35c13e5ac00: You were Army, why won't you take us to Knox?!
RD_ALifeLine_1c7dad8116db1783: Because I walked off Knox, and they don't forget deserters
RD_ALifeLine_70a95f736c603db8: It's been a week, they'd forget
RD_ALifeLine_6f286a2e29d23abf: They shoot first and remember later, find your own gate
RD_ALifeLine_379dd9b03a55510a: Who are you people? Are you Army?
RD_ALifeLine_480822bb3241adc4: We're NOT here to answer that
RD_ALifeLine_2b30acd53252c385: Then why are you helping us?!
RD_ALifeLine_23bd646a766f883c: You're in the way of where we're going, and I don't like leaving things behind
RD_ALifeLine_66eed3ce610a8aeb: I've never seen it, who watches while you do?
RD_ALifeLine_3d81260c1b853fb9: Nobody, so I do it at noon in the truck, ma'am, ten minutes, don't wake me
RD_ALifeLine_052b96656507b871: Soldier, where does the Army take us? Somebody said Knox
RD_ALifeLine_304447da35e79bed: Knox is locked, folks, I was at the gate Saturday, NOBODY in, nobody out
RD_ALifeLine_3e12ee9805a8f408: Then what the hell are we doing following you?!
RD_ALifeLine_6157b35c75810899: You're following me to the school, my lieutenant's got a collection point there, twelve miles
RD_ALifeLine_79e27cf953ed47b0: You can't take us, can you?
RD_ALifeLine_67e159db37abd3bf: I'm not authorized to take civilians
RD_ALifeLine_4e532c361bd86553: I'm also not authorized to leave you standing in the road, so get in the truck before I think about it
RD_ALifeLine_3dc631ec66e05e88: The colonel said no civilians past the goddamn wire, I heard him on the loudspeaker
RD_ALifeLine_2c19b3db3f6ba0b0: The colonel's NOT here, ma'am, I am
RD_ALifeLine_25d08f9a293492aa: So I'm taking you to the gate, and if they shoot me for it, put it on my headstone, he tried
RD_ALifeLine_5c65dffa0f0a97c5: Is the road to the bridge clear?
RD_ALifeLine_53a3bea8043d8807: I can't give you an all clear. We'd have to look before we go
RD_ALifeLine_1c6e02556884b2fa: Then we keep another way in mind
RD_ALifeLine_640d143d321591f3: Yeah, don't let wanting a shortcut decide for us
RD_ALifeLine_2dcecdce3615ab84: What the hell are your orders now, soldier?
RD_ALifeLine_4f4cc4402baf8044: Orders were to protect the town, I'm doing that, I'm looking at it
RD_ALifeLine_47a5b70f74d3646c: What town? It's three streets and a church!
RD_ALifeLine_3cad93c51a27adc6: Then I protect three streets and a church, ma'am, it's what I got
RD_ALifeLine_62f6afcf6d737d8f: You said you had a squad, where's the rest of 'em?
RD_ALifeLine_58aad52436d3db66: Water tower, we were supposed to link up Friday, I haven't seen 'em
RD_ALifeLine_5e05a27a10f61038: Then we go to the water tower
RD_ALifeLine_6c715b163058642a: We? It's not on your way, sir, you got people to look after
RD_ALifeLine_6b51e6256a3a61a4: Are you gonna shoot if somebody comes at us?!
RD_ALifeLine_26c9562715bf8744: Only if I have to, damn it
RD_ALifeLine_0c31a04f67513e72: What-- what if you wait too long?
RD_ALifeLine_2cde3e3476b4b8c5: Then I'm slow, and you'll be glad you stayed behind me, c'mon, move
RD_ALifeLine_1058296a76b60981: The Army dropped this on us, didn't it?
RD_ALifeLine_57c7ab5e17afedf2: Ma'am, I don't know what the Army did or didn't do, I know I'm a private who ran out of orders
RD_ALifeLine_08d0115c6e89b4f1: It's the only one I got, and I'm still here, so how about we spend the energy getting you to the church
RD_ALifeLine_4fcb4cbe4d8fa3b5: Is that a rifle or a stick?
RD_ALifeLine_1c4a54466f275ce3: It's a rifle, I'm going to teach you how to hold it, it ain't hard
RD_ALifeLine_6af32c620fa76a0b: I don't want to hold it
RD_ALifeLine_57ed1dfe1017c86b: You don't have to want to, you just have to hold it, right hand here, left hand there
RD_ALifeLine_7c4a0e3e0656667c: You're the first person who's told me the truth in a week
RD_ALifeLine_0680871c3067c66a: The truth is, I don't know, I really don't, I just know where to point the rifle
RD_ALifeLine_288dfc8543fff869: It's less than I'd like, ma'am, but thank you
RD_ALifeLine_43a9eddf744cf6d4: What if the Army never comes back?
RD_ALifeLine_793bc8922d4b0a2d: Then we're the Army, ma'am, somebody has to be
RD_ALifeLine_0354ff3514023e0c: I know what you meant, I didn't have a better answer
RD_ALifeLine_3dd439702eff4162: Safer than without me, damn it
RD_ALifeLine_5d53f6b4660c45d4: It's the best I got, but I'm NOT going anywhere, neither's my rifle
RD_ALifeLine_248315c76e1c66ed: Chili mac, best one, I'm sharing
RD_ALifeLine_46695c7c3a6412ca: You're hungry, and I'm tired of eating ALONE
RD_ALifeLine_331e8ad142632098: So who decides? The cop, the soldier, or me?
RD_ALifeLine_2ddc676362b193ba: I got a badge, but NOBODY's paying me
RD_ALifeLine_5319410965198662: I got orders, but nobody's giving 'em, damn it
RD_ALifeLine_20d9424620649180: Then I guess I decide, we go to the church, right now
RD_ALifeLine_74f89bf93705fcf0: Fine by me, ma'am, you're the first one here with a plan
RD_ALifeLine_50221d6d4e8987e8: I keep wondering whether a cemetery would be a shortcut
RD_ALifeLine_00c6f705649604cf: Ask the officer.. he's got the badge
RD_ALifeLine_154691ac7b22ef51: Badge doesn't tell me where a path goes
RD_ALifeLine_097e1263594cf3af: I just hate walking the long way round
RD_ALifeLine_219cc7d33d733adf: So do I.. but I'm not calling a cemetery safe because it's shorter
RD_ALifeLine_631421e261a1ebb6: Truck's got a bad radiator, we're going nowhere
RD_ALifeLine_0f3984df2fab99e5: I can patch it with epoxy and a prayer
RD_ALifeLine_3c1b6b9f37a8b624: Two hours, and it holds fifty miles, maybe sixty
RD_ALifeLine_3aed7ec6083d5294: Fifty's enough, do it, I'll stand watch
RD_ALifeLine_7b3d49d05781e0a3: My hands won't stop shaking, I can't hold the flashlight
RD_ALifeLine_1a51fa405766b12c: Give it to me, breathe with me, in through the nose
RD_ALifeLine_75edfdc371d3b69f: I'm breathing, I'm breathing, I can't make it stop
RD_ALifeLine_440b8e6a04c618dc: It's okay if it doesn't stop, you carry the map, I'll carry the light, we walk
RD_ALifeLine_72dd6397583cb23c: The hardware store's locked, can you open it?
RD_ALifeLine_1a6bf59e05f291ca: I can open anything, I don't know what's behind it
RD_ALifeLine_75113ab4740d66ff: You stand back, I knock first, if something knocks back we go home
RD_ALifeLine_5d71ad9704a78d42: You got a truck and no guns, we got guns and bikes that can't pull a wagon, you see where I'm going
RD_ALifeLine_1bb7c28060843ea7: I wanna ride in front of you, twelve miles to the farm, for a tank of gas
RD_ALifeLine_3fbffd0e41683be5: ...A tank, fine, half now, half when we're in the yard
RD_ALifeLine_553ecc2873aa4569: Officer, I got eleven outstanding warrants, I'm hoping we skip that part
RD_ALifeLine_7416196b30d81af1: I lost the paperwork, it's a miracle, I need your bikes at the bridge by six
RD_ALifeLine_169d5cca0fda3be7: My bikes are at the bridge at six, I might even bring coffee
RD_ALifeLine_6a5ce08f5c7b6c2b: Coffee? Then I lose the paperwork twice
RD_ALifeLine_3fcb3d6a3ea02df0: My club's got a prospect who can't ride, he keeps dumping the goddamn bike
RD_ALifeLine_37da03da7b2ecf07: Sounds like a good prospect, honestly
RD_ALifeLine_2cc5788926a3a3c8: He's the best I got, so we take him to the hardware store, let him carry something heavy
RD_ALifeLine_68ac372b5586eef1: That's the kind of plan I like, a man learning to carry
RD_ALifeLine_15f7ba894ca0800a: You're the new guys, you're on lookout
RD_ALifeLine_648136e272a0b06b: That's why, nobody trusts you, and nobody should, stand at the corner
RD_ALifeLine_07e7266e71dcf226: Fine, but when you want us to do something real, ask us nice
RD_ALifeLine_28293e985d384cd4: We're a business, you're a crew, you work for us
RD_ALifeLine_076cbf9e021d59e7: You work for a share, that's different, I'll explain it slowly
RD_ALifeLine_3006f3ec47bd9008: We don't stop at the church, we stop at the water
RD_ALifeLine_05fc29d93b13ff5f: One has people who ask questions, one has a pump
RD_ALifeLine_3d708ae3214b3a74: ...Then I'll show you the pump, and I'll keep my questions to myself
RD_ALifeLine_7e2dbabc07049b0c: We go dark tonight, no fire, no talk
RD_ALifeLine_73efcde255870861: Whispers carry, nod, point, tap, that's it
RD_ALifeLine_4bacb26c7b78933f: What if I need to cough?
RD_ALifeLine_57daefbb4d0fa764: Cough into your sleeve and think about how stupid you're being
RD_ALifeLine_4320ef060d4ef947: We work with you, you don't ask questions
RD_ALifeLine_7d80d68e32c3d846: That's how you work today, or you work alone
RD_ALifeLine_68849bcb27d950fd: ...Fine, but I'm writing it in my notebook that I didn't ask
RD_ALifeLine_1906ad7f4ba2c490: You follow, you stay quiet, and the first time I say move, you move
RD_ALifeLine_50f923980e44ff97: What if I got a question?
RD_ALifeLine_0920cf424647de2a: ...I'll move first, but I'm gonna have a lot of questions after
RD_ALifeLine_12bb80af7493b2eb: Where would you look for somewhere children could sleep?
RD_ALifeLine_3071bf93164a8af9: Maybe a records room, if we could check it properly and find a way out
RD_ALifeLine_32521c5279c5d78d: I wouldn't promise a records room or a lock I hadn't seen. Being bored beats being trapped
RD_ALifeLine_25a903217f611bcd: Where would the evac point be, if there is one?!
RD_ALifeLine_56459a5174597006: I'd bet the armory in Brandenburg, it's got a fence, a flagpole, a gate
RD_ALifeLine_4ef27a8b356257d9: Is that your guess or your orders?!
RD_ALifeLine_18b7794d48081ccc: My guess, there ain't been orders in a week
RD_ALifeLine_23a08f284bfddd64: We can't stay in the house, one of them's in the yard, he won't go
RD_ALifeLine_0d91680337f48127: The back, by the swing set, he's just standing there
RD_ALifeLine_0883fa9a3febcec8: Then we leave out the front, quiet, I walk behind you, don't look at the swing set
RD_ALifeLine_6ea7732f5340b70e: Where do you take kids, officer, when there's nobody left to take them?
RD_ALifeLine_31bdad05528a1dfc: I'd want somewhere checked and somebody willing to stay with them.. I couldn't just name a church
RD_ALifeLine_4cc125fc3a52fdd2: I'd ask.. but I wouldn't tell you there were cots and carers waiting without knowing
RD_ALifeLine_255f477f5582a86c: My baby's got a fever, a hundred and four, I don't know what to give her
RD_ALifeLine_5e0e2f5a6d83a9ca: Tylenol drops and a cool cloth, no blanket, when'd she last eat?
RD_ALifeLine_6ab016d85b3caf1b: This morning, she won't take the bottle
RD_ALifeLine_4b0bec1e4d05156c: Then fluids with a spoon, a little at a time, I'll check on her every hour
RD_ALifeLine_78179bcd55bbce1d: Papaw's insulin is down to the last vial, I been stretching it
RD_ALifeLine_7961e41937133a4d: Four days, he's shaky in the mornings, he won't say so
RD_ALifeLine_7187080d1c3c0ee5: Then we find more today, the clinic first, we tell Papaw what we're doing
RD_ALifeLine_2c89ab0f4c34ed41: Mama can't walk the mile to the church, her hip's gone
RD_ALifeLine_269e063433f4ca9f: We got a stretcher in the truck
RD_ALifeLine_06c3fc9a4edab475: She'll hate it, she'll say she can walk
RD_ALifeLine_277510756a3fc4fe: She can say it all she wants, two of us lift, she gets a pillow, a blanket
RD_ALifeLine_7cf5e6650257fdea: When the house went we got out with the kids and the dog.. that was it
RD_ALifeLine_06b0cac7161696de: I remember standing by the truck.. they wouldn't stop looking at the house
RD_ALifeLine_2aabb9f062009474: You needed somewhere to lie down.. not somebody telling you it'd all be fine tomorrow
RD_ALifeLine_15cc9bca1e735291: Can you show me the breathing thing? The one for babies, just in case
RD_ALifeLine_7c24b1ff4027f3bf: Sure, sit down, he's about the size of that loaf of bread, tilt the head back a little
RD_ALifeLine_57ef8efc22f19312: Like that, two fingers on the chest, gentle, you won't break him
RD_ALifeLine_14221c5e119ed5a7: He fell off the porch, his arm's bent the wrong way
RD_ALifeLine_66f025d973939b19: Don't touch it, hold it still, I'll make a splint out of a magazine
RD_ALifeLine_53177fe438027795: Rolled tight and taped, you'd be amazed, now get him in the truck, easy
RD_ALifeLine_6093fc4a1e053b40: We buried Mama this morning, now what do I do with the rest of the day
RD_ALifeLine_2f04010231e1330a: Sit, that's the job today, tomorrow we walk to the church, see who's left
RD_ALifeLine_49ec5e6f3c5cda48: I can't sit, I keep wanting to do dishes
RD_ALifeLine_730561b01680be96: Then do the dishes, I'll dry, nobody's looking
RD_ALifeLine_32f168a9114a3aeb: The church kitchen's got a gas stove, can we cook there for everybody?
RD_ALifeLine_2f5234e759b940b0: Smell the line first, if you smell gas we light nothing
RD_ALifeLine_7b94daea519e6fba: Pilot's burning, I checked it myself, two burners
RD_ALifeLine_425fcfe9312dc79d: Then the church it is, I'll bring the big pot, you bring every can on the street
RD_ALifeLine_6aaa617933a194df: Our well's still sweet, you can fill your tank here any time, I mean it
RD_ALifeLine_79feff0202b4b09e: That's a lot to hand out
RD_ALifeLine_68cbb6de47e6165d: Folks brought us food the first week, I remember who
RD_ALifeLine_6b906ab57aeca6bd: Then we park the engine in your yard Friday, and my guys pump the trough for your cows
RD_ALifeLine_57cbc5b5681d5fd3: My boy's got a fever, do you have a medic?!
RD_ALifeLine_7040759004a23490: Our medic didn't make it out of the motor pool, ma'am, I'm sorry, I got a first aid kit, an aspirin
RD_ALifeLine_6bee53f03e59fa00: That's it, but I'll look at him, hold the flashlight, let him lie down, we'll go from there
RD_ALifeLine_68b6353b02a4ce35: Granddad's cabin's got a well and a woodstove, but it's twelve miles
RD_ALifeLine_2aa7e6fc45ea0b38: Twelve miles I can do in the truck, I'll siphon gas on the way
RD_ALifeLine_2d33bb651a86fd9a: And I got a first aid kit, a good one, in case anybody gets hurt on the way
RD_ALifeLine_48abf4556c998cd2: That's it, we go, we're all going to the cabin, nobody argues
RD_ALifeLine_494adf6a19d98d0c: Nobody argues, we got a plan
RD_ALifeLine_65f25cb62105e491: Don't leave us, please, we got nobody
RD_ALifeLine_345e3ed53372ed69: Ma'am, I'm only going to the corner, I'll be back in two minutes
RD_ALifeLine_6b91e5a4540473e2: That's what everybody says, everybody says two minutes
RD_ALifeLine_541811f9359d22f8: Then I take the boy with me, he holds my belt, you watch from the window, two minutes
RD_ALifeLine_697be25e38fcf357: You guys got bikes, we got a truck, we take the supermarket together
RD_ALifeLine_379af43b45779490: What the hell do we get out of it?
RD_ALifeLine_632e769579e69dd9: Half of everything, and you don't have to push your bikes
RD_ALifeLine_42be868c05dfdf0f: Half, fine, but I drive, I don't trust anyone else with a truck
RD_ALifeLine_61623d0e65242bb3: My block's got forty people and no food, you got a grocery truck, let's talk
RD_ALifeLine_5fc87679429629ee: Half the truck, my guys unload it, nobody touches your people
RD_ALifeLine_3da665c0479703d7: ...A third, your guys unload it, I watch every can
RD_ALifeLine_3e0daf0b0f48ab44: You folks know the creek road? I ain't been out that way since the flood
RD_ALifeLine_220d452a78c309c1: Washed out at the bridge, but you can wade it, knee deep
RD_ALifeLine_1ae984f17e6de3fc: We wade it, anything on the other side?
RD_ALifeLine_50f0f812435a08d5: Teague's farm, cattle and a gate, he might let us in
RD_ALifeLine_1ae94d9135db3277: I got first watch, you two get some sleep
RD_ALifeLine_482598ff39c5215a: You been up since Thursday, Hale
RD_ALifeLine_2c0d146d77e26f58: Cops don't sleep, it's in the handbook
RD_ALifeLine_6898c7d26dfe5b9e: Like hell it is, take a nap, Hale, I'll wake you at two
RD_ALifeLine_0e9d7ee7145f00b5: I need a volunteer to check the pharmacy with me
RD_ALifeLine_7dcdddcc0c1faa3d: I'll do it, I used to work for the pharmacist
RD_ALifeLine_7fcc06be5f0ee796: Everything, I know where he kept the good stuff and where he kept the key, let's go
RD_ALifeLine_275558807f527521: Everybody gets a whistle, one blast, come to me, two blasts, run
RD_ALifeLine_3a1a036863293f33: What if I blow it by accident?
RD_ALifeLine_1fd7b26c1478355b: Then somebody's mad at you, but they come, that's how it works
RD_ALifeLine_16d2ef3e03bf0bc2: I'll hold it in both hands, just in case
RD_ALifeLine_69acbef0484eaeb7: You got rifles, we got a radio that reaches the state post on a good night
RD_ALifeLine_25b9a469538c30d7: Trade you the first for the second, I'm tired of being alone out here
RD_ALifeLine_4764eff320a4d2ac: It's a partnership, officer, I'm bringing four guys
RD_ALifeLine_56d8519633af76c9: Mine's nine-millimeter, we got nothing to trade, but we got a pickup full of canned food
RD_ALifeLine_18f4c0444324d63d: Food's better than ammo today, show me the cans
RD_ALifeLine_3134264141267896: Your unit pulled out and left you?
RD_ALifeLine_1d2932ff751a36a8: Left us to hold the line, then the line went away
RD_ALifeLine_11714a1b47489f85: That's a hell of a way to get left
RD_ALifeLine_450cddc776f5877c: Yeah, I'd rather have somebody to hold it with, so, you busy?
RD_ALifeLine_38e700f373035c44: We need every truck with gas, the old folks out on the east end still aren't out
RD_ALifeLine_289550201b6a3b08: I want you AND your truck, I can't drive 'em all
RD_ALifeLine_03cc3ca07186d354: So I drive, you ride shotgun, three trips, I'll bring blankets
RD_ALifeLine_10cdd4c014ef62b3: How many of you? Exactly, I need a number
RD_ALifeLine_4b20a27f3f7c9e1b: Eleven, if you count the baby
RD_ALifeLine_1da65c425ac25d24: I count the baby, eleven, the church basement holds twenty
RD_ALifeLine_5a493253012cef24: That's where we sleep, and the baby's gonna be thrilled
RD_ALifeLine_6af1d19442285ce5: If we couldn't agree whether to stay or move, how would you decide?
RD_ALifeLine_22667035408759d1: I'd want a say, I hate feeling shut in
RD_ALifeLine_43bd67a831ab16a7: I'd want to know whether anybody needed rest first
RD_ALifeLine_13e90c68696e19cf: Then we'd talk about what moving actually meant, no tie-breaking vote makes a wagon appear
RD_ALifeLine_6355fb4b4deb269a: Four, maybe, the sun's getting low
RD_ALifeLine_07948cd3482465cd: Then we find a place before dark, I don't want to be walking when it goes
RD_ALifeLine_37429db81bc610c9: We keep a list of who's missing, I need names, ages, where you saw 'em last
RD_ALifeLine_35405f464e1f062b: What do you do with it?
RD_ALifeLine_5b897a030a3f542c: Hold onto it, in case somebody comes looking, or in case I find somebody
RD_ALifeLine_787167a51bc7fb3b: Then put my sister on it, Annie, nineteen, she was at the mall Friday
RD_ALifeLine_1a590d6623541ff0: You folks got room in that truck for two more?
RD_ALifeLine_3adf8bd5017b38a6: An old couple on Pike Road, they won't leave without somebody they know
RD_ALifeLine_1ff3638214facaaf: Then I'm the somebody, I know 'em from church, we go now, it's four miles
RD_ALifeLine_31c6950c773e2e91: Who's in charge here, soldier? You or me?
RD_ALifeLine_3b51b16a6b12a8b6: With respect, sir, I don't care
RD_ALifeLine_5f46af7b213f6d44: We got one of each, so we split it, I take the bridge, you take the town, we radio when we need the other
RD_ALifeLine_793b6fc54d2930d8: Gone Saturday, took half the battalion north, I got the lieutenant's map, a squad
RD_ALifeLine_1190e11434917809: I'm a guy with a map, sir, I'll be colonel if it gets me coffee
RD_ALifeLine_1025d78525b1978f: The Guard armory in Brandenburg, the old man's got a key on a chain
RD_ALifeLine_1040c30172e1d665: Key's in his desk, second drawer, I watched him put it there
RD_ALifeLine_46eb92b2319de0ee: We get the key, open the damn armory, before anybody else thinks of it
RD_ALifeLine_791af46f10865067: What the hell did you expect?
RD_ALifeLine_6a4bba6863225fab: A bigger gun, a harder face
RD_ALifeLine_779a8b5e77152838: I'm a mechanic from Ohio, officer, the gun's borrowed
RD_ALifeLine_4c84a3bd5483cae2: My squad takes the ground floor, your guys the second, civilians the basement
RD_ALifeLine_69bb49bd47a9c0f8: If something comes through the front, the basement's the last place it looks
RD_ALifeLine_742256b021db6818: You still got the fairgrounds keys, Hap?
RD_ALifeLine_7315c16e561fdd96: Every gate, the livestock barn too, why?
RD_ALifeLine_039d14bc5a0ef2a7: Livestock barn's got a roof and a spigot, and the stalls have doors
RD_ALifeLine_3fe3a13135b63152: Doors, I like that, we bed the old folks down in clean straw, I bring blankets
RD_ALifeLine_51606da363950ad0: Where's the safest place in the plant, you know it better than me
RD_ALifeLine_5ab972d765c9affc: Not the chlorine room, steel door, one way in, I wouldn't sit in there for money
RD_ALifeLine_275f41c25eb942d2: Chlorine, officer, that gas'll kill you quicker than anything out there, pick the loading dock
RD_ALifeLine_73e8eec34d019c88: What's the one thing you'd carry out of the plant?
RD_ALifeLine_27a9b9de4f6d26f8: The coffee maker, it's industrial, makes sixty cups
RD_ALifeLine_70ce653b521ee3bb: Sixty cups, I'd carry it myself
RD_ALifeLine_3558cfbd48133d11: Then we go at dawn, it weighs a hundred pounds, you're on the left handle
RD_ALifeLine_036fb41635ffc880: We sleep in shifts, two hours each, you two first
RD_ALifeLine_7de5e42f1bcf4084: Where the hell do we sleep?
RD_ALifeLine_717f000f322bb80e: The back pews, away from the windows, keep your shoes on
RD_ALifeLine_4608bd442755d4ce: Shoes on, sleeping in a church, my mother would be thrilled
RD_ALifeLine_0515fda8506f981e: We stop at the Hendersons' for the night, I know the family, they'll take us
RD_ALifeLine_230f097a3012d1f1: Then we sleep in their barn, I've done it before, they never knew
RD_ALifeLine_2d4ad63456e86223: You slept in a farmer's barn as a cop?
RD_ALifeLine_2d90029d59c67e7d: As a teenager, ma'am, I was a different kind of law then
RD_ALifeLine_0a27c29a7d8f80ca: You went into that house without telling me, you could've died in there
RD_ALifeLine_25f5eda3770447ea: There was a woman on the floor, I wasn't gonna wait for your okay
RD_ALifeLine_57aeb6f01f425cfa: I know there was, I saw her, I'm saying tell me first, I'll go in with you
RD_ALifeLine_1783c9e527626205: ...Next time I yell, you come, deal
RD_ALifeLine_0abdf11035fdbfc1: Deal, and put the damn helmet on
RD_ALifeLine_17d376334dee30e3: Last thing dispatch said was engine two respond, then nothing
RD_ALifeLine_7218bc22155e9739: That's, that's us, that's the call we never took
RD_ALifeLine_0c62fc1e5d904b66: You wanna go now? Tell 'em we're on our way
RD_ALifeLine_01e9a7c6091faf01: It's ten days late, but yeah, I'd like to answer it
RD_ALifeLine_275b3901696bbc3e: We buried Dutton behind the station, you wanna say something?
RD_ALifeLine_2664d6b402798ac6: Say it short, I can't stand long speeches today
RD_ALifeLine_23604aa61f9fc1fc: ...Short's fine, he was a good man, he made good coffee, he's missed
RD_ALifeLine_2203fe23009846cd: My orders were to hold the damn bridge, so I'm holding it
RD_ALifeLine_73ccd9e95c0b4948: Anything that comes, officer, that's what holding means
RD_ALifeLine_23feff5469110c32: Then I'm holding it with you, I'm not leaving a soldier alone on a bridge
RD_ALifeLine_3459585d63a0b711: If we had two vehicles, would you want the person who knew the roads in front?
RD_ALifeLine_24d1ca8b4235f89b: You'd put a cruiser in front?
RD_ALifeLine_310e8a0b0ab22c86: I'd want the one with the best chance of spotting trouble, not just the loudest siren
RD_ALifeLine_21b4ef153f0755a7: Good, a siren doesn't clear a road just because people used to listen to it
RD_ALifeLine_5644e17a38c55ec9: Civilians in the middle, deputies on the flanks, soldiers at both ends
RD_ALifeLine_498aba443fb1aa42: That's one cop, one soldier, a bunch of people who can't shoot
RD_ALifeLine_059c0f745ad5d303: ...Then you're on the flank, ma'am, God help us all
RD_ALifeLine_2a8d0da1459f07b5: Orders were to hold this intersection, nobody's relieved us, shit
RD_ALifeLine_46e9ee7431e8640e: Till noon, then we pull back, you can't stay, go to the church, it's got walls
RD_ALifeLine_250267466a933d27: If we have to move at night I'd want us close enough to tap a shoulder.. no shouting
RD_ALifeLine_2bd2e9d719afeb48: What if somebody can't keep quiet?
RD_ALifeLine_32704e387d0d407a: Then we'd stop and work it out.. not leave them alone
RD_ALifeLine_2211d529052c7aaf: You make that sound easier than it is
RD_ALifeLine_74e0878b5b3618e2: I know.. but I can't promise a chocolate bar would make fear go away
RD_ALifeLine_4e5cfc56580d9705: Ma'am, where's the nearest clean water? My map's worthless
RD_ALifeLine_4f827f4d07fa6298: There's a spring behind the Methodist church, the old pump house
RD_ALifeLine_052e8c1b31ef0091: Half a mile, I'll show you, it comes out cold, my husband used to fill jugs there
RD_ALifeLine_0cc53b89372a9ba6: If we try an armory I'd go first.. you keep clear
RD_ALifeLine_1711dd6d4bfefa09: Because if something's in there I don't want it reaching you before we've seen it
RD_ALifeLine_0b7150423df010c6: ...I don't like it but I understand
RD_ALifeLine_51c2d02416985dad: Any of you got food? We ran out of MREs Thursday, I'm living on hope, gum
RD_ALifeLine_056af7d6080959f3: Peaches! Real ones, in a can? I'll trade you ammo for peaches
RD_ALifeLine_644c7d1e5c0a9ade: Keep your damn ammo, sit down, eat, we're not animals
RD_ALifeLine_5c64a7e43172af96: You walk behind me, step where I step
RD_ALifeLine_4496ac0078976bb4: No, but I don't know what's under the weeds, I like my people with all their toes
RD_ALifeLine_5aff23765a675114: Behind you, step where you step, got it
RD_ALifeLine_60e80a52203a8ac8: If I'm not back from the church by dark, wait for nobody, go
RD_ALifeLine_3dfbfc6a61febb00: That's an awful thing to say
RD_ALifeLine_5015c3e773e22c1e: It's a plan, ma'am, it's the kind they teach us
RD_ALifeLine_3fdbdb081b329a05: ...I'll wait an hour, I don't care what you teach, an hour
RD_ALifeLine_72eb42470c484da6: Who here can drive a stick?
RD_ALifeLine_2af73fa076642545: I can, just don't let me go fast
RD_ALifeLine_76f21f456aa777f4: I can, and I'll go as fast as I want
RD_ALifeLine_4c86de2f7c31e7e2: Slow one drives, the fast one rides shotgun, I don't need a cowboy in the road
RD_ALifeLine_5ca0843e403a7a84: If we drive, we keep it slow and stop if we can't see the road, I'll help watch the turns
RD_ALifeLine_63cb462f6007fdd1: Slow? We'll be a day getting anywhere
RD_ALifeLine_49524d8750ce66cd: Slow doesn't mean silent, it means I'm not rushing down a road I haven't checked
RD_ALifeLine_22e2156b24710daa: You call the turns, I drive, I'll holler when I gotta pee
RD_ALifeLine_34f146b17fca7d17: First light, we go to the school, the lieutenant's there, I hope
RD_ALifeLine_63f0a6116a99be94: He said Saturday and it's Tuesday, I don't know, I haven't heard a word
RD_ALifeLine_7de6e1ae2128fabf: ...Then we go, and if he's NOT there, we make a new plan, together
RD_ALifeLine_6565cccb4bd40b14: If we find a way through wire we check it before squeezing anybody in
RD_ALifeLine_44835bcd6f6edd9b: How big would the hole need to be?
RD_ALifeLine_642611db62b2b903: Big enough to get through without snagging.. and see what's waiting on the other side
RD_ALifeLine_649bd00608f651c8: Then nobody gets shoved through first just because they're smaller
RD_ALifeLine_33658acb2fe5aea2: How old a map would you trust? Ten years?
RD_ALifeLine_588aefeb4052adc2: Even a two-year-old gas station map could miss a lot now
RD_ALifeLine_109c11a967ab5654: Two years is better than ten, though
RD_ALifeLine_3cbea83c1be95bcc: For road names, maybe, it wouldn't tell you what was waiting on them
RD_ALifeLine_7a96d5ad70a28cc0: Everybody in a line, ten feet apart, I don't care who you are
RD_ALifeLine_595ad5ce043d5798: One shot, one problem, not ten, stay in the line, don't bunch up
RD_ALifeLine_665dbf6348696a2b: Ten feet, I can do ten feet, I'll count my steps
RD_ALifeLine_6bb850553cef11e8: Two weeks of MREs, I'd kill for something that came out of a pot
RD_ALifeLine_58fe782f2c9e648d: I got a pot, I got rice, I got half an onion, you're gonna cry
RD_ALifeLine_24369e855c0a84e8: Move the wounded, I'll bring it back, I'll leave you my rifle as collateral
RD_ALifeLine_0f9a4433076cc7e2: Keep your rifle, sir, take the truck, I just want the keys back, I love that truck
RD_ALifeLine_24c5df203334bafd: If you had to move a family by truck, where would you put them?
RD_ALifeLine_307258b7713f85a8: Would you put somebody at the tailgate?
RD_ALifeLine_4d45d67f4a3ffa95: I'd want to see the truck and work out the safest seating before promising them a place
RD_ALifeLine_76dd50ef1c85c23b: I'd want you to explain it to them too. Kids know when grown-ups are just guessing
RD_ALifeLine_5c39d5db39f21f98: We lost four Saturday, nobody said anything over them, I'd like somebody to
RD_ALifeLine_66a293cf4b126ac5: I can do that, it's what I'm for
RD_ALifeLine_5910b2872d9c366e: Dusk, behind the motor pool, five minutes, the guys are tired
RD_ALifeLine_4b1144cb7b43453d: Five minutes, and I'm bringing coffee, they'll stay for the coffee
RD_ALifeLine_6bbc7db47cd40d8e: We got a medic who's nineteen and never saw blood, I need you to teach him
RD_ALifeLine_5c99944666c69c2b: Teach him what? I got no time
RD_ALifeLine_2d96fd7d2ab57a55: Everything, he's the only one we got, please
RD_ALifeLine_03902b3c26f5109b: ...Send him over, he carries my bag, he watches my hands, I'll talk the whole time
RD_ALifeLine_2025ddb67b9d11f3: I remember bringing you a kid with a fever.. I'd run out of ideas
RD_ALifeLine_3156cf770ad29509: You said he'd been hot since the night before?
RD_ALifeLine_74b2cb784b8fe519: I remember you asking if water would fix it.. I couldn't promise that
RD_ALifeLine_746468143fc4cd84: You know this county, I don't, where do we get water that ain't poisoned?
RD_ALifeLine_7968858030515d96: Well at the old Dunn place, hand pump, my daddy dug it
RD_ALifeLine_0cee3bb423593104: Mile and a half, I'll walk it with you, bring every canteen you got

RD_ALifeLine_5c3974aa0baf0e00: No power steering, and a clutch like a mule
RD_ALifeLine_315dd7815b02c60f: ...I'll follow you in the milk truck, I got a feeling about that clutch
RD_ALifeLine_6d4e8f8a18603889: Bridge is ten miles, we do it in one push, no stopping
RD_ALifeLine_386e230d6850148a: Ten miles with a baby, ma'am, or we sleep out, take our chances
RD_ALifeLine_232d888806b4584d: ...Then we do it in one push, but I'm not carrying the bag, somebody else carries the bag
RD_ALifeLine_31e8d1083d287b14: I'm sorry, ma'am, I can't let you through, I got orders
RD_ALifeLine_4e30fbe30de1fca5: My husband's just past that wire, I can see the roof
RD_ALifeLine_51e4b87301b59961: I know, ma'am, I got people on the other side of something too, I can't
RD_ALifeLine_726502f0360a5d9d: Then give me five minutes at the fence, you don't see me, you're looking at the road
RD_ALifeLine_174aadfe6d9f16b6: ...I'm looking at the road, I'm looking at the road, go
RD_ALifeLine_37fa2ff60c16b74b: You got food, I got a rifle, I walk with you, I eat what you eat
RD_ALifeLine_6925f9590e76e931: We got eleven mouths, we'll make twelve
RD_ALifeLine_2e0725ea5fef9347: And I carry more than I eat, you'll see
RD_ALifeLine_5da0b2716803ca10: ...One mistake and you're gone, understand? I'm saying it plain
RD_ALifeLine_4e0d18ee7fde24ca: You got a boss, we got a plan, we take the warehouse together
RD_ALifeLine_2514d03d4591920d: The one by the tracks, it's got boxes, I'm told the boxes have stuff in 'em
RD_ALifeLine_0fe030bb56c50ccb: I like a man who has a plan with boxes, I'll tell the boss

RD_ALifeLine_47e33fa63ca778f0: No catch, half's what I'm offering, take it or hit the next store alone
RD_ALifeLine_2c0fc4e169eda5cd: ...Half, fine, but I get first pick of the fucking cigarettes
RD_ALifeLine_57cb5d29424a2869: You got bikes, we got a truck, we hit the gas station on the bypass together
RD_ALifeLine_7fa914725137c61f: What the hell's in it for us?
RD_ALifeLine_72acd5834aa38ddc: Gas, a whole tank, pour what you can carry
RD_ALifeLine_724fe2fc5fec7e20: bikes need gas, and I like not walking, deal
RD_ALifeLine_79be3ff40831fc01: The boss's cousin has a warehouse in Valley Station, he says it's full
RD_ALifeLine_439a8c47435260c5: Boxes, he won't say, he says it's worth the walk
RD_ALifeLine_4c125eeb4dcc2a23: Boxes, that's it? I ain't walking thirty fucking miles for boxes, tell your cousin to bring it here
RD_ALifeLine_3d843bd95883c1d4: Three crews, one truck, who drives?
RD_ALifeLine_109b9e7d582d122c: I do, I'm the best driver
RD_ALifeLine_73650e6471146bb1: You're the worst driver, I was in the back last time
RD_ALifeLine_520408f03c2883b2: I drive, I'm the one with the keys
RD_ALifeLine_6175e1cc78a8a131: You have the keys because you stole 'em from me
RD_ALifeLine_4cdcac2f7fe9e37f: Everybody shut the fuck up, we're late
RD_ALifeLine_6e77d252151ce263: If we find water we don't just hand it round.. we make sure it's safe
RD_ALifeLine_0184c43d12ed7a72: Nobody likes waiting when they're thirsty
RD_ALifeLine_53f8ca212c6be489: I know.. I'd rather hear complaining than find out I made somebody sick

RD_ALifeLine_1c7d730569333447: A raft? You wanna build a raft?
RD_ALifeLine_659a74fa0c55d481: You don't have to swim, you lie on the door, I'll show you
RD_ALifeLine_6f636bc00d7a47bb: ...I'll lie on the door, but if I die I want you to feel guilty
RD_ALifeLine_63ac2e1537436605: We check the houses that burned, there might be people in the cellars
RD_ALifeLine_1a4b85c543c218fe: Might's enough, my chief would've said so
RD_ALifeLine_2e3ecb52447c7d41: Then we go, and the truck stays running, you hear me, the truck STAYS running
RD_ALifeLine_05cd153734374214: I'd like to say a few words at the grave before we move on
RD_ALifeLine_20aa436040299b74: Then I'll say a very few
RD_ALifeLine_0edf5b194654ca41: ...Take your time, I'll stand guard, I talk to the dead too, every night
RD_ALifeLine_1cdb2a7a77729365: You always carry that notebook, what's in it?
RD_ALifeLine_134127706aad2cfe: Names, every address I've checked, every house, who's alive, who's not
RD_ALifeLine_39471099736e106d: Somebody's going to want 'em, someday, I wanna be the one who has 'em
RD_ALifeLine_6b54bdbe756dbc5b: If we find somebody hurt, what can you actually do for them?
RD_ALifeLine_1f3f498b5ecb32cb: Help carry them, keep watch, I can't promise beds or medicine
RD_ALifeLine_713c188f7f441be6: Then you tell me what needs doing first, I'll listen

RD_ALifeLine_5ee9bfb73324ff11: We could use the water.. if it was fit to use
RD_ALifeLine_23124f44396c5067: I'd need to check the engine and hose first.. can't promise it works
RD_ALifeLine_1b714b036a00981f: And I'd keep watch while you did.. no point rushing ourselves into trouble
RD_ALifeLine_2ed877577ca6574d: The whole block's burning, my crew's two guys and a pump, we can't hold it
RD_ALifeLine_3eae0a5828dee5aa: Men with buckets, wet blankets, anybody, we save the end house, the rest burns
RD_ALifeLine_42f3c72b393cd9fa: Then we save the end house, I'll get everybody I can, you tell me when to pull back
RD_ALifeLine_13713fb322097459: The ambulance runs, stretcher bed, oxygen, no driver
RD_ALifeLine_4f7100d60e2866c6: I drive, I hauled wounded two tours
RD_ALifeLine_468bb160193c432b: Then I ride in back, we do the county house to house, anybody sick
RD_ALifeLine_21c12fd93dffc188: Slow, siren off, I'm not drawing a crowd

RD_ALifeLine_67077e187c1ae716: Every one, I plowed 'em, graded 'em, patched 'em, there's a gravel road behind the quarry nobody's heard of
RD_ALifeLine_7fed132000e05be0: Where the hell's it come out?
RD_ALifeLine_0af368e61eedee15: By the river, a mile from the boat ramp, I drive, you hold the map

RD_ALifeLine_3c448ebc17229c01: Pipe wrench in the truck, twenty-four inch
RD_ALifeLine_6df264944eecffbc: That'll do it, bring buckets, it won't last
RD_ALifeLine_7199ceeb67ec6c20: I'll bring the wheelbarrow too, I ain't doing this twice
RD_ALifeLine_5ea020d232cc93ff: We need light, a lot of it, I can't work in the dark
RD_ALifeLine_172a1ba3180fdd5e: I can rig work lights off a car battery, I do it at the plant for night shift
RD_ALifeLine_2152625c750ffc0d: Twenty minutes, gimme a battery, some wire, don't talk to me
RD_ALifeLine_626752334a0e7f0e: If someone couldn't walk, what could we use for a stretcher?
RD_ALifeLine_47f2a7d4098da3dd: Maybe a door, if we could remove it and it was strong enough
RD_ALifeLine_0687b7b14f8fbd49: My granddad used one at the mill, doesn't mean any door would do; we'd have to check it and work out how to carry it
RD_ALifeLine_0179190d57ca4880: Radio in the truck's been calling two days, NOBODY answers
RD_ALifeLine_644f6d0b4a9e47d5: County fire, channel one, I don't know the others
RD_ALifeLine_63df995c7bd546eb: Try the plant channel, we used it for shift change, the foreman's got a base station on his desk
RD_ALifeLine_23eec0cc052aea2b: We move the hurt by truck, you got a flatbed?
RD_ALifeLine_539a0b4b4bb2f7dd: Dually, eight foot, I can throw mattresses on it
RD_ALifeLine_49d22cfa3d579231: Slow, thirty miles an hour tops, nobody should get bounced

RD_ALifeLine_1e7718cd0c9202fb: You're a good man to have around, I want you next to me at the bridge
RD_ALifeLine_3b9bf4c6226f922a: I'm a guy who knows how to fix a flat
RD_ALifeLine_3c4da2c0526b02e9: Something's always breaking out there, I want you right next to me when we cross
RD_ALifeLine_5893369379c35c43: ...Fine, I'm next to you, don't tell the others, I'll have to start being nice
RD_ALifeLine_07849e5d19d8dce6: If a pharmacy was locked, would you know how to get in?
RD_ALifeLine_458cb9295529d73b: I used to be a locksmith before the plant
RD_ALifeLine_021ba0f21b748f8c: Six years. Enough to know a bent wire doesn't open every lock in town
RD_ALifeLine_485c057a7de7b186: Two in front, two in back, you in the middle, nobody ahead of the point
RD_ALifeLine_2a6116af11a586fd: Then you stop, nobody moves till I raise my hand, understood?
RD_ALifeLine_74136d4e55b7cf52: Understood, but I'd feel better if you said it nicer
RD_ALifeLine_5aedb13579b07450: Stack up behind me, hand on the shoulder of the one in front
RD_ALifeLine_5cc9ac89495fba53: Exactly like a conga line, but quiet, if I stop you stop, no humming
RD_ALifeLine_53e8bdcc05ff9a11: If I start panicking just keep talking to me
RD_ALifeLine_7047cb4e55f2b99f: That's it.. give me something besides my own thoughts to listen to
RD_ALifeLine_478cb93277a7f923: I'll talk your ear off.. calmest person who ever lived
RD_ALifeLine_7f97de7b5a371a77: There's something in the plant, I heard it in the pipe room
RD_ALifeLine_7a4a624323ab58a8: Rats don't knock, soldier, it knocked three times
RD_ALifeLine_02ae1da46933b85d: ...We leave it, we lock the door, we never go in the pipe room again
RD_ALifeLine_2f2fae8103edc07c: Water plant's got a diesel generator and I got the key, somebody's gotta babysit it

RD_ALifeLine_64c693da512c8696: You wanna drive out of here

RD_ALifeLine_70b5f1a27b53347d: Then we fill it, the church folks first, I ride shotgun, you pick the road

RD_ALifeLine_385cd8066ebf7683: Then the substation first, I hold the ladder, nobody climbs alone
RD_ALifeLine_26954164002375b1: Your cruiser's dying, officer, that whine's the fuel pump

RD_ALifeLine_4a85db9e476af909: ...Fine, I block the road with the cruiser, you run, I'll wave off anything that comes
RD_ALifeLine_09178cb275842f70: I can feed thirty at the courthouse if somebody finds me a stove

RD_ALifeLine_4ce299fb66b1e956: There's a camp stove in the evidence locker, I'll sign it out to you
RD_ALifeLine_361afd94363b24f0: Our warehouse got four pallets of bottled water nobody's touched
RD_ALifeLine_527e0f2c10ee7f73: Six blocks, the forklift wants gas, somebody who knows the clutch
RD_ALifeLine_46951cc110f831b2: You're the somebody, I'm the one with the shotgun, we go before the heat
RD_ALifeLine_66e393236e808460: I got a dozer at the quarry, I could close the bridge in an hour
RD_ALifeLine_502ca25141e818af: Concrete barriers off the quarry road, and a dump truck for the gap
RD_ALifeLine_76c8870963a297db: Then do it, I'll stand at the east end and turn people around, I hate it already

RD_ALifeLine_67432a7920e872e9: Then climb, I'll watch the lot, don't spill any on my boots
RD_ALifeLine_0950af1b60eb3626: I got every key to the high school, thirty years of carrying 'em
RD_ALifeLine_0a0b8486642375c0: Boiler room, gym, the principal's office, he kept a bottle in the desk
RD_ALifeLine_65e7d144304f4403: Then you open the gym and the desk, I'll count the cots, look the other way
RD_ALifeLine_19e1bf1712cc0e19: Route four, I drove it eleven years, I know every kid who rides it
RD_ALifeLine_2edb8c7e62f96667: I wanna know who's still standing at one, even if it's nobody

RD_ALifeLine_1e29961d089fe7e1: I drove this route twenty years, you want a quiet way to Knox, follow my rig
RD_ALifeLine_2b65f6322ed5c567: I know which bridges hold a loaded truck, and the map don't say
RD_ALifeLine_6b26dd334b19cd45: Then you lead, I ride behind, one flash of the lights means stop

RD_ALifeLine_4fa3870a2a2d9ad1: And work out whether the truck could carry the weight before you start welding
RD_ALifeLine_402a15d4354ab819: I was a short-order cook twenty-two years, I can do forty plates off one griddle
RD_ALifeLine_7b6df9f45abfa8d9: Whatever your boys scrounge, canned stuff, potatoes if you find 'em, I make it hot

RD_ALifeLine_29ad262a2f848123: Two, and one at the barn, I got a wife and a girl in that house, nobody's pulled in yet
RD_ALifeLine_10744f7f78302ae2: Two on the road, one on the barn, I'll take the house myself
RD_ALifeLine_305a273011f5b397: Would more height help a radio reach past a hill?
RD_ALifeLine_029979634ebd1853: If you're thinking of a water tower, I'm not climbing one
RD_ALifeLine_0ac9c9185d18e6f3: I used to wire lights on towers, I'd still want to inspect any ladder before climbing
RD_ALifeLine_3bdd19893873fb3c: And agree how to get you back down, no climbing just because we're desperate to hear somebody

RD_ALifeLine_544644bb74aa2679: Then we look for a way out before anybody starts digging

RD_ALifeLine_2cadcbcd45d63802: ...Then we cross one vehicle at a time, you walk in front, you're the expert
RD_ALifeLine_1a39503d54978e0d: I got a wrecker at my uncle's yard, it'll pull anything on this road

RD_ALifeLine_0511e86e1e7f4295: Plant's got a nurse's station, a stretcher, an oxygen bottle, I got the key
RD_ALifeLine_1130d051030e177b: Green bottle on a cart, says medical on it, I walked past it six years
RD_ALifeLine_363b0d7b6fbeb5b9: Then that's a stop before the church, bring a hand truck, I need that bottle
RD_ALifeLine_229e87c02f384290: My goddamn truck's thirsty, there's nothing in the pumps
RD_ALifeLine_2fa72345073771a6: We got a tank behind the hall, diesel, for the engines
RD_ALifeLine_2b8777bb5970ec86: Then we siphon from the squad truck, it's ugly but it works
RD_ALifeLine_7c3727a1242f41e9: We go back to the damn plant, I'm telling you, the generator ALONE's worth the trip

RD_ALifeLine_3785037a3c04aea4: That's what I like about you, you listen
