RD_ALifeLine_10abcd6a52497f4e: The short way's got a bridge and no people
RD_ALifeLine_2a10e2344d0583b3: No, no people, that's the problem, I need people, I need to know who's still alive
RD_ALifeLine_58a075e733296f8a: I vote we find a place with a bathtub
RD_ALifeLine_3dd1637e79d84536: Because I haven't had a bath since the Fourth of July, and I smell like a goat
RD_ALifeLine_25d737176a44d7f9: You smelled like a goat before the Fourth of July, Marty
RD_ALifeLine_0eedaadc5645c825: In the old days we had a lunch whistle, twelve sharp, everybody stopped
RD_ALifeLine_3b4d013b77d846f7: I'll make one, I'll blow it every day at noon
RD_ALifeLine_3063832b0c91ba63: You'll draw every dead thing for a mile
RD_ALifeLine_196f2d9d70ee60ce: If we find a water tower could we see much from the top?
RD_ALifeLine_40e832580a30c300: I'd want to see the county.. find smoke find people
RD_ALifeLine_0310ee005faab741: I'd want to check the ladder first.. being trained for heights doesn't stop a bad rung breaking
RD_ALifeLine_78290b3f6804f70b: We cut firewood now, in summer, so it's dry by fall
RD_ALifeLine_6029176f41d07aed: Two months is nothing, wood needs six, wet wood's smoke, smoke's a signal
RD_ALifeLine_716d2b970024c1d4: I'll get the saw, you get the ax, a cord by Friday
RD_ALifeLine_5286fa7d3b789705: Seven rounds, SEVEN, that's all that's left for the pistol
RD_ALifeLine_30c59caf584ff2c4: We don't spend seven rounds on ANYTHING that don't need it
RD_ALifeLine_6dc294307c24bcb5: That's what I'm saying, we find a store, or a deputy, or a dead cop with a belt
RD_ALifeLine_56316abe4a6279ad: A dead cop with a belt, that's what it's come to, fine, but I'm not looking
RD_ALifeLine_6b7609a535678694: Save the bullets if there's another way, a gunshot can bring more trouble than the one in front of you
RD_ALifeLine_520cf88b34177a15: Bat only works if they're close
RD_ALifeLine_55e2f0063fbf3654: That's the point, you don't let 'em get close, you go around, you don't pick a fight
RD_ALifeLine_002401690c05eda3: I hate it when you're right, and I hate that you say it so calm
RD_ALifeLine_0b08e3e5378689d6: Buck's Outdoors on the bypass, deer rifles, shells, bows, a whole wall
RD_ALifeLine_7ac10ab71bc9148a: Buck's is where everybody in the county goes
RD_ALifeLine_423f3d9906de834d: They been there already, we're late, but there's always something on the floor
RD_ALifeLine_09bf2694651a756d: Always, my daddy used to pick brass up off the range, he'd find rounds under the benches
RD_ALifeLine_01ea524b505e6999: My brother loads his own shells, he's got a press, powder, primers, the whole garage
RD_ALifeLine_6f14462d3f8c519c: My brother's a nerd with four hundred shells, so be nice
RD_ALifeLine_016f24b157c0b9ce: I'm being nice, I'm being SO nice, let's go see the nerd
RD_ALifeLine_5e1d792a00c47c73: Nobody fires unless I say, not for anything, not a dog, not a cat
RD_ALifeLine_39d175f60041588d: What if it's one of them?
RD_ALifeLine_3527b204525ceed7: You walk away, a gunshot brings ten more, I seen it
RD_ALifeLine_39ed46782302bb41: Walk away, you got it, finger off the trigger, I'm not that stupid
RD_ALifeLine_196b290656f61b02: Remember when you said that pharmacy was safe and Pete came back hurt?
RD_ALifeLine_6933a804106eb086: I said it was SAFER, I never said safe
RD_ALifeLine_46a5705e0f238693: That's the same thing when you're the one holding him down!
RD_ALifeLine_193f52db4d91548f: You're right, I was wrong, I won't call a place safe just because I want it to be
RD_ALifeLine_579510fd07b23155: I'm not going to the school, don't ask me again
RD_ALifeLine_308db65063571a87: My son was in that school, don't you understand? I can't walk past the front steps
RD_ALifeLine_2e908f414f52b02b: We go around it, I'll do the school, you hold the corner, whatever you can do, you do
RD_ALifeLine_0e9fb882464cc1bb: My way's faster, we take the damn highway
RD_ALifeLine_14221428198f619f: Your way's how we lost Pete
RD_ALifeLine_09ef43f71a917274: You don't get to say that!
RD_ALifeLine_39b33b7920fe4d01: I'm saying it because it's true, and because I'm tired of burying people for speed
RD_ALifeLine_210aa386749d609e: You, you don't want a vote?!
RD_ALifeLine_75ac74601452497d: Votes are for people who aren't bleeding, I'm bleeding, I say we go, you can vote on the way
RD_ALifeLine_1f8bba59580ab327: You don't get a say, you've been here two days
RD_ALifeLine_36b7583c15d99afb: I-- I got a say if I'm the one carrying the bag
RD_ALifeLine_5e4a1be7530abb21: Then carry the bag and shut up about the route
RD_ALifeLine_6d3b297465080c08: ...No, I'm done carrying your damn bag, I'm going to the church, you do what you want
RD_ALifeLine_2f1b6da206da3c6e: It counts to me, I'm the one standing here, which way are we going?
RD_ALifeLine_6c90df9c65e1bc1a: Bait shop by the river's got hooks, line, a freezer full of nightcrawlers
RD_ALifeLine_4596a51e0835f4e0: Nightcrawlers don't taste like nothing good
RD_ALifeLine_5824b31b63b92551: Nightcrawlers are BAIT, you moron, for the catfish!
RD_ALifeLine_0b5308eb1f49ac17: Bakery on Main smelled like bread every morning, I walked past it twenty years
RD_ALifeLine_38a784c065742bd9: It won't smell like bread now
RD_ALifeLine_1dc46a5f4006b817: I, I know, I just wanna see it, there might be flour in the back
RD_ALifeLine_6782a379514157ab: Flour, sure, but you're gonna cry, I ain't carrying you
RD_ALifeLine_1a18ec605f70c8e8: I'm not gonna cry, shut up
RD_ALifeLine_4ddf73ec4f6f6a21: I say we hit the bank
RD_ALifeLine_770bf8127a36c79b: I don't know, habit, always wanted to
RD_ALifeLine_6934bd7e4168ac51: It's paper, Mickey, you can't eat it, it don't even burn good
RD_ALifeLine_6e7ce18641b312c4: Fine, grocery, but I'm telling people I robbed the bank
RD_ALifeLine_5696bab562c2c0eb: I look like a bear that lost a fight
RD_ALifeLine_3dc0c8ec6681f032: Barbershop on Elm has clippers and a straight razor and a mirror
RD_ALifeLine_36f50f7a01293b84: A razor don't need power, Hank, sit still, I'll do it
RD_ALifeLine_6d59b5e0044a32e9: Take the batteries out of every remote control in the house
RD_ALifeLine_3daf10056abe36da: The TV remote doesn't work anyway
RD_ALifeLine_2fedd7592f35f87d: Exactly, the VCR one, the garage door, the kitchen clock, the alarm clock upstairs
RD_ALifeLine_303d423f5dbbcb33: I'm on it, that's eight AAs right there, I feel like a genius
RD_ALifeLine_4c98a6db3cea6e19: Smoke detectors have nine-volt batteries in them, did you know that?
RD_ALifeLine_50b06fef622c0cbd: Not when it's beeping at three in the morning
RD_ALifeLine_299e6b2b0e9ac673: Now it's gonna save our lives for real, go pull every one, bring a chair
RD_ALifeLine_40596551435cf7e3: Chair, ladder, I'll do the whole house, I hate those things anyway
RD_ALifeLine_40049c9e1aee09f3: Bowling alley's got a snack bar, a roof, forty bathroom stalls
RD_ALifeLine_016ce3d04ac5eee3: You wanna sleep in a bowling alley
RD_ALifeLine_4299bafe417c7bff: Big open room, you'd see ANYTHING coming down the lanes
RD_ALifeLine_5f64974a2ae0e1fb: And free shoes, I been wearing these three days
RD_ALifeLine_7d2100e2294b2c6a: Mount Zion's got a food pantry in the basement, the church ladies kept it full
RD_ALifeLine_329f391245bbe316: I gave to that pantry every Christmas, now I'm gonna rob it
RD_ALifeLine_0cfd83aa25406abf: We're not robbing it, we're borrowing
RD_ALifeLine_71bbcdf7080c995d: He's got plenty, shit, we got nothing
RD_ALifeLine_508f00535cbf6216: Pastor Wells had a generator and a shortwave, he told us Sunday
RD_ALifeLine_2f4720421933da62: I don't know, but he never turned that radio off
RD_ALifeLine_593179e219b267db: We-- we knock, and if nobody answers we go, I'm not breaking a pastor's door down
RD_ALifeLine_5b985ffa604c45e2: Fellowship hall's got a stove big enough to cook for the whole street
RD_ALifeLine_21a9b37a1281a2b9: Bring flour and lard, nobody makes biscuits like you
RD_ALifeLine_1d7421b31a561388: I'll make biscuits, Lord help me, I'll make two hundred
RD_ALifeLine_7184bbad5fbecb3f: Church van's still in the lot, I saw it from the road, keys are in the office
RD_ALifeLine_0f560c5512e5ffe7: Deacon Hollis drove it last Sunday, it ran then
RD_ALifeLine_096ea20625aab95c: Last Sunday's a long time ago now
RD_ALifeLine_4503ec6d57c23120: Thick walls, one room, we hide in the church till it blows over
RD_ALifeLine_0fd30792347d982a: The bell, though, one wrong rope, the whole county knows we're there
RD_ALifeLine_6c7aa0ad196d208e: I'll tape the clapper, my daddy showed me
RD_ALifeLine_0998816e4532f467: Tape it twice, I'm NOT dying to a hymn
RD_ALifeLine_11d27dc913b54c3a: Mrs. Wells ran out of her insulin, she's been sleeping in a pew
RD_ALifeLine_45485ae8578b7ba2: So ask at the parsonage, the pastor probably kept some
RD_ALifeLine_129ac5f17452102c: I'll go, I know where he hides the spare key, I mowed his yard ten years
RD_ALifeLine_6c9c6ebc019f0025: The free clinic by the post office, they gave my girl her shots there
RD_ALifeLine_6a4f54dc17c6d41b: It was packed Friday, I saw the line from the bridge, I figure it's nothing now
RD_ALifeLine_3aa342c67414a698: Nothing but what? You don't know what's in there
RD_ALifeLine_5e9fe5e704404397: Rosewood Manor's got a nursing home with a medicine room and a hundred beds
RD_ALifeLine_6c438eaa03c08fe3: And a hundred people who couldn't leave
RD_ALifeLine_4be7977d59ae454e: I know, I know, I been thinking about it two days, I can't stop
RD_ALifeLine_494b744503023abe: We go fast, and nobody goes in alone, nobody
RD_ALifeLine_7a4708a821a8393b: Vet's got amoxicillin, same stuff your doctor gives you, just a bigger bottle with a dog on it
RD_ALifeLine_6e927557081ed7b3: If it clears up Dale's leg I'll eat the dog
RD_ALifeLine_391faa4e5a06d482: Easy! Let's just get the pills
RD_ALifeLine_52dc906d79d24a2c: Dr. Mercer's office, he always had those little bottles of the good painkillers
RD_ALifeLine_04de749862a35a34: He's been chewing on one side three days and he won't say a word
RD_ALifeLine_19f647715fa1b850: We go, we get him something, even if I have to hold him down
RD_ALifeLine_154cacd210d90d4e: Hardin Memorial's the closest real hospital, twelve miles
RD_ALifeLine_7dc857222fb4b708: Twelve miles of EVERYBODY heading the same way
RD_ALifeLine_4010f1985ea72419: We, we could walk the railroad bed, nobody's on it
RD_ALifeLine_5ec3ea3412cdf672: If there's even a doctor, I ain't walking twelve miles to read a sign on a locked door
RD_ALifeLine_15a5b3920c1045c9: Doc Landry lives on Poplar, he delivered half this town
RD_ALifeLine_370779a811ac6196: He's seventy-three with a bad hip, he's not going anywhere, he's at home with his bag
RD_ALifeLine_482a3bee4be86a9f: We go get him and bring him along, a doctor's worth more than any drugstore
RD_ALifeLine_648fbad9544926e0: Say it back to me, so I know you heard
RD_ALifeLine_6a1ec3dd25dda96b: We go to the Kroger, the back way, two in, two out
RD_ALifeLine_30208a9f024b2b18: If it's bad, we don't wait, we meet at the church
RD_ALifeLine_5651d9775df662e9: Good, you heard, now eat something
RD_ALifeLine_64f4493403c0b8a5: Why lock it? Nobody's coming back
RD_ALifeLine_4a9b102575683e61: Habit, my mother taught me, you lock up when you leave
RD_ALifeLine_0b5e53796311add0: I'll lock it, I'll feel stupid, I'll do it anyway
RD_ALifeLine_5f71a6983069c751: Anybody who's changing their mind says so now, five minutes, after that you're coming
RD_ALifeLine_2df5bccd42110b83: That's done, boots on, we go in five
RD_ALifeLine_1e8cbd25137ecb00: Write it on the wall so nobody can say they forgot
RD_ALifeLine_3508d7d877db85ec: The place, the time, the one who's going, put my name on it
RD_ALifeLine_5bd814e7698b24a7: Your name's on a wall in lipstick, that's a first, but fine
RD_ALifeLine_02bc19b345dee3c5: Everybody knows their job? If you don't, ask now, not at the door
RD_ALifeLine_50f2a9240e368b1c: And I knock, you two do the rest, go
RD_ALifeLine_0e419638592fd5d3: I just did, ten minutes ago, you were there
RD_ALifeLine_4ee8888871f48e6f: ...I was there, I was just hoping you'd change your mind
RD_ALifeLine_4d45ebf05903b738: Alright everybody, we need a plan, not a fight, a plan
RD_ALifeLine_327d715500f259db: Food's the problem, I say the Kroger
RD_ALifeLine_387da1aa4ca7b4b2: Water's the problem, the creek's drying up
RD_ALifeLine_2f28173c52e5a8d7: I say we sleep, I'm so tired I could eat the table
RD_ALifeLine_0a45c95d6eaedc55: Best one I heard all day
RD_ALifeLine_2bbb686637def53d: The daycare on Walnut, I keep thinking about--
RD_ALifeLine_04ac891d6669c429: I remember cots and juice boxes in the back room, doesn't mean they're there now
RD_ALifeLine_3c510d665d3760ec: I understand wanting to look. We'd have to check the place, not walk in expecting supplies
RD_ALifeLine_159d0f3b594d3907: Dentist on Third, Dr. Hale, he's got a drawer of those little clove oil bottles
RD_ALifeLine_031334f635054235: For my tooth, I haven't slept since Sunday, it's like somebody's driving a nail in
RD_ALifeLine_5b675b0207e8354f: We go now, I don't care if it takes all day, I'm not listening to you moan another night
RD_ALifeLine_678a38276ceb1771: No, no way, I'm not going in that kitchen
RD_ALifeLine_64b740092d9fa8cf: It's the dry storage I want, nobody's making you open the freezer
RD_ALifeLine_06b41ce14bdebafe: You-- you can smell it from the parking lot, Wayne!
RD_ALifeLine_1da353e240759533: We go in the back way, rice, flour, sugar, that's all, five minutes
RD_ALifeLine_16226a4916abf024: ...Fine, but I'm holding my breath the whole time, I'm not talking
RD_ALifeLine_4a6f745d2bb9ce77: It's July, the freezer's been off since Saturday
RD_ALifeLine_7fa02a36612cd52a: It's SOUP now, but it's chocolate soup
RD_ALifeLine_100841e415cd471a: Me too, shit, right out the tub
RD_ALifeLine_3711074f12c66253: Ruth lives above the diner, always has, forty years
RD_ALifeLine_3f00996f4558a299: So she's still up there or she's not
RD_ALifeLine_6a92a3b84d7b7bc6: If she's not there's a pantry and a deep freeze, Ruth never bought less than a hundred pounds of anything
RD_ALifeLine_253f925f215840be: I knock, I walk her to the church, I ain't leaving Ruth, I don't care what you say
RD_ALifeLine_01923ecf08fe64b5: Cooking oil, gallon jugs of it, the steakhouse had a whole shelf
RD_ALifeLine_556fc2e3257a7a08: What the hell are we gonna do with oil?
RD_ALifeLine_75120a017b1b976c: FRY! I wanna fry something, I ain't had anything fried since Friday, I'm losing my goddamn mind
RD_ALifeLine_0ee9b6420965550c: We'll find something, a fish, a shoe, I don't care
RD_ALifeLine_00e561044f23afd5: Dot's keeps a key under the ceramic frog by the back step, everybody knows
RD_ALifeLine_0542bcb8791c4130: I've been eating her pie since I was nine, I know where everything is
RD_ALifeLine_5566296f379885e1: If there's any left it's a fossil by now, but yeah, let's go look
RD_ALifeLine_5404eb4a733234b0: It was packed Friday, the whole dining room, the lunch--
RD_ALifeLine_6b3f7c2c25f8b655: So how many are still in there?!
RD_ALifeLine_4e8f7e866395294b: I'm NOT going through the front, there's a loading dock round the back, one way in, one way out
RD_ALifeLine_28236bc07a1121a4: Dollar store's got candles, batteries, canned soup, it was all a dollar
RD_ALifeLine_7f8691ed6331484f: Nothing costs anything now, shit, we're rich
RD_ALifeLine_700e696604b93014: I-- I don't wanna know, I wanna find something, a can of peaches, a bed
RD_ALifeLine_73c23a507b9eaa0e: ...So do I, so do I, but we won't find 'em sitting here
RD_ALifeLine_6ded0f2b333feff5: What if they're waiting for us?
RD_ALifeLine_6a55fea5157368c1: We find out together, that's the only way I know
RD_ALifeLine_3f9584be60e32dbe: I don't think we're gonna make it
RD_ALifeLine_1c91b96f6637649a: So am I, think it, don't say it, shoes on
RD_ALifeLine_1e47f3e50535c1c2: Is this even the right way? We've been walking an hour
RD_ALifeLine_0449d71f7887db63: You want to stand here till we figure it out? Keep walking
RD_ALifeLine_1ef2f7072e3a191c: I'm not trying to be a smartass, I'm scared too. Walking's easier if I don't think about it
RD_ALifeLine_4c314c784438a687: They said the school gym, buses at noon, one bag each, no pets
RD_ALifeLine_3037844e393aff3b: Dog's my bag, Frank, you go on, I'll come later with the dog
RD_ALifeLine_55339f8639a6933f: National Guard armory in Brandenburg, that's where they'd gather everybody
RD_ALifeLine_2b30379d3f213476: My brother-in-law was Guard, they drill there, big lot, a fence
RD_ALifeLine_746094bb31f2b371: That's twelve miles, we leave first thing, boots on
RD_ALifeLine_1c9ce15a41536bfe: There was a paper stapled to a telephone pole, EVACUATION POINT, an arrow, nothing else
RD_ALifeLine_1beb9b9d698612d0: North toward the river, somebody drew it in marker, I don't think it was the Army
RD_ALifeLine_6f4cf20d3a504a3a: I ain't following a marker arrow, I wanna see it printed
RD_ALifeLine_108ac3270f18a1ab: They, they said wait for the trucks, wait for the trucks, I waited three days for the trucks
RD_ALifeLine_5d56e97d5e68e6bf: Nobody's coming, I been telling you
RD_ALifeLine_08c5f48d5c3f238c: The whole time I'm sitting there being good, being quiet, like they said!
RD_ALifeLine_207b02447393bd94: We stop waiting, we pick a direction, we stick to it
RD_ALifeLine_672cd0822380200d: Trucks were all going north toward the Second Street bridge, a line of 'em
RD_ALifeLine_43cd75670a1281d9: Camp, says one guy, nothing, says another, bridge is blocked, says a third
RD_ALifeLine_1baffa702acbd8e1: We go see, together, NOBODY wanders off
RD_ALifeLine_43d73085331fd094: Marina's got a few houseboats and the diesel's still in the tanks
RD_ALifeLine_2ffcb05014575b49: A houseboat's a floating house, nothing climbs onto a boat in the middle of the river
RD_ALifeLine_3a0c88496dc7c5f7: Nothing that can't swim, which is most of 'em
RD_ALifeLine_4473815024a2e1a9: That's it, we move onto a houseboat, float out, wait, I like it
RD_ALifeLine_05ce960b3ef78aaf: If a helicopter comes we gotta be in the open, a field, with something bright
RD_ALifeLine_09c5d38449b8826b: The red tablecloth from the kitchen, we spread it on the ground, we wave it
RD_ALifeLine_7df656d6571ebdd7: I'm taking the tablecloth, we sit in a field in the sun waiting on God
RD_ALifeLine_00ad8d5a7b2ef116: They're using the stadium in Rosewood, the Army's sorting people on the goddamn field
RD_ALifeLine_2d06f01431a6c74d: Sorting how? Healthy here, sick there?
RD_ALifeLine_1993c0b95be13263: I don't know, just sorting, it's what I heard
RD_ALifeLine_4c26c27a46629b18: If they sort me wrong I'm having a long talk with somebody, but fine, I'm in
RD_ALifeLine_6ecfc2cf32045e9a: Helicopters come over around seven every night, same direction, same time
RD_ALifeLine_16dfe19870a72b0a: The ridge, there's a flat field, I bet they land, we climb up at dusk, wave a light
RD_ALifeLine_1a1c4d5d573538bc: And if they're NOT Army? What if they're something else?
RD_ALifeLine_5c66896d0643e2dd: We're a light on a hill, we learn something, either way we know
RD_ALifeLine_40e9d7a400bb41af: We paint HELP on the barn roof, forty feet tall, white paint, you'd see it from a plane
RD_ALifeLine_134f6fce44065f49: Somebody is, I heard one Tuesday, high up, going north
RD_ALifeLine_7ec99ee466f01767: ...Fine, but I'm not climbing, I'll hold the ladder, you hold the paint
RD_ALifeLine_69191eb419aae25f: Somebody said the Army's got a camp near Bardstown
RD_ALifeLine_35ad2eb94c87d431: East, the bourbon warehouses, big, empty, good roofs
RD_ALifeLine_56162c240e070f7e: Forty miles of walking, I need a plan for water, I need shoes
RD_ALifeLine_540aee6e20dfadbc: If it goes bad you don't help me, you go to the church, understood?
RD_ALifeLine_33f8c54935ab9a7e: You are, I'm not asking, it goes bad you go, I'll catch up if I can
RD_ALifeLine_3f14248c27e6916c: ...Church, I got it, I hate it, but I got it
RD_ALifeLine_15f789025d483a73: If we're chased we drop the bags, drop everything, run
RD_ALifeLine_3f13c0110a17d81a: My bag has all the medicine!
RD_ALifeLine_2beff5581ded27e5: You run with the medicine, I run with the water, nobody stops
RD_ALifeLine_4d79ddd54c5cf9e6: Nobody stops, okay, I'm saying it out loud so I remember
RD_ALifeLine_176a16dd59a342b4: If we split we run different ways and meet at the pond behind the Hollis farm
RD_ALifeLine_4e759603235ec9b9: That one, we wait two hours, then we go to the second place
RD_ALifeLine_7a6aa35d39803a9f: What the hell second place? You never told me about a second place
RD_ALifeLine_276fcee0275ad92c: ...I'm still thinking about the second place, I'll tell you when I know
RD_ALifeLine_02eeee17620db036: If it's a lot of them we don't fight, we hide, we let 'em pass
RD_ALifeLine_6f67c1bb73df5f4d: And if the building's got its own problems inside?!
RD_ALifeLine_7c6ca79835c5744c: So we pick the next building, God, I don't know, I'm making this up as I go
RD_ALifeLine_28822d54155befd2: If I get bit, you don't wait to see, you don't even--
RD_ALifeLine_0c1008c04e3017a9: I'm saying it so you'll do it, I need you to promise, I need it
RD_ALifeLine_19cc5743151dbe82: ...I promise, and I hope to God I NEVER have to
RD_ALifeLine_52baaaaa298c0712: If we're in trouble we say a word, any word, so the others know
RD_ALifeLine_144d1de93ce6a297: Peaches, if I say peaches it's bad
RD_ALifeLine_4ac08f2619661161: We got a hundred jars of peaches, you're gonna say peaches all day
RD_ALifeLine_14ca257b5c1e4c61: Pickles, then, I don't care, pick a word
RD_ALifeLine_6ae7d45372fd9661: If they come at us I'll draw 'em off.. you get clear
RD_ALifeLine_13cf672503cddf12: I'm fast.. that's about all I've got to offer
RD_ALifeLine_7e356cad47abd9cc: You're loud too.. don't mistake that for a plan I'm willing to lose you over
RD_ALifeLine_02149abb7c6f191d: Every morning at nine one of us goes by the water tower, in case somebody left word
RD_ALifeLine_454cfcc06f561f75: Somebody leaves word, we find 'em, that's a plan
RD_ALifeLine_489b04e26cda9cae: It's a thread, and I ain't letting anybody get lost in this county
RD_ALifeLine_5b58725d03f254d2: I'll go tomorrow, I'll leave a chalk arrow so they know I was there
RD_ALifeLine_6335e2244687d6d6: Could a fire engine's water tank be any use if we found one?
RD_ALifeLine_4d6d6ccb39064133: I'd want to know what was in it first
RD_ALifeLine_6df4e3dc7d70a5dc: And whether we could work the pump
RD_ALifeLine_1332964213d334ab: Then we ask somebody who knows.. I'm not guessing with drinking water
RD_ALifeLine_14ad7e17769b366c: Turnout coats, the thick yellow ones, nothing's biting through that
RD_ALifeLine_3633fc1b21fae58a: You wanna wear a fire coat in summer?
RD_ALifeLine_410edd656528bf9f: I wanna be alive in summer, I'll sweat like a hog
RD_ALifeLine_36cb58413b7c012a: I'm taking the helmet too, I like the helmet
RD_ALifeLine_0fc02e4752c5eb98: The firehouse I knew had bunks and a kitchen and a TV room
RD_ALifeLine_543a690a42893f21: Probably nothing worth watching even then
RD_ALifeLine_24b4268a3748273f: There was a couch. That's the part I keep remembering
RD_ALifeLine_7edc592e13972dc1: A couch, God, I'd settle for remembering how that felt
RD_ALifeLine_488eedba09b6f9d1: Firehouse has a base radio, Sam told me, the volunteer lieutenant
RD_ALifeLine_16a9445c3a25e2cb: Could we hear anybody on it?

RD_ALifeLine_487a9d6e0298e988: We go listen, it's more than we're doing here, damn it

RD_ALifeLine_27c332072b61c441: We're not sliding down a pole
RD_ALifeLine_4cfc92b40cb3a7d8: I'm saying we sleep up top and if something comes, I slide
RD_ALifeLine_639a2214394dec16: Dale, you'd break both legs on that pole, we all know it
RD_ALifeLine_27e4f1206a1b6887: It's peanut butter AGAIN, goddamn it, I can't, I physically can't
RD_ALifeLine_288afeec76b8491c: Four jars and no bread, we ate the bread Sunday
RD_ALifeLine_01ec3b556fcd0b3f: We find bread, or flour, or something to put it on, okay?
RD_ALifeLine_1ef45be5544e2a63: A spoon, I'm just gonna use a spoon, I'll cry later
RD_ALifeLine_2e6b2da53b1aac88: Squirrels all over the Tatum place, a hundred of 'em, fat as cats
RD_ALifeLine_76330c734c44c592: You'll eat squirrel and thank me, we got thirty .22 rounds and nothing else to spend 'em on
RD_ALifeLine_7fd92075585095d7: ...Okay, you shoot, I skin, don't tell me what it tastes like
RD_ALifeLine_60efcbd63bbe0abf: Mrs. Hollis's chickens are running loose, eggs everywhere, nobody's collecting
RD_ALifeLine_436142d83c026ac8: And the chickens, if we're being honest, but I'm starting with eggs, I'm NOT a monster
RD_ALifeLine_29827a87313f6176: I'll bring a basket, you bring a grandma voice to talk 'em down
RD_ALifeLine_75a8764a4fd7d407: Forty cans, five people, I did the math, that's eight days at a can a day
RD_ALifeLine_0bdbfe9e317e4b0c: That's barely staying alive, I did the math twice
RD_ALifeLine_70570f973d15f313: So we got eight days to find more, I'd rather start NOW than on day seven
RD_ALifeLine_45ebb07a4946ccdd: Half a can now. Save half for later. That's what we're doing
RD_ALifeLine_0e3998dd1bfa11bd: You get to decide what I eat now? Who put you in charge of the goddamn food?
RD_ALifeLine_32f8235e5ea34b36: I can count. Whole cans and we're out Tuesday, so it's half!
RD_ALifeLine_37b9584f1de07312: Fine. Half. I'm eating mine slow, and I don't want you watching
RD_ALifeLine_76ed67d0400c2b03: Farm stand out on 31W's got corn, beans, cucumbers, it's all just sitting there
RD_ALifeLine_2dcd3bd06b276d1c: It's July, it's ripe, it's also rotting, we got a day or two before it's mush
RD_ALifeLine_1fe2237229f3ae92: We go today, bring every bag, pick till we can't carry no more
RD_ALifeLine_59b1b95a2259f9a5: Funeral home's got a hearse, full tank, nobody's put three miles on it
RD_ALifeLine_1ebf110159cdc14a: We-- we ain't driving a hearse, NO
RD_ALifeLine_65aa769a6b2f83db: Bench seat for six, never been in a wreck
RD_ALifeLine_2b6ef93a2d683bc5: People'll see us coming and think we're dead
RD_ALifeLine_19372cbb6feb3fa0: Then they leave us alone, Dale, drive the hearse
RD_ALifeLine_445190ad1c8a1b56: Pumps are dead, so we pull it out of the cars
RD_ALifeLine_4a67ae020a776100: Garden hose, twelve feet of it, you suck till you taste it
RD_ALifeLine_3956159446c063ae: Did that once, tasted it a week, you can have the honor
RD_ALifeLine_2bdfe5a702c40ef1: Nobody's touched the old Marathon on 31W, the pumps are dead, why would they
RD_ALifeLine_0797180165a4a014: Everybody stares at the dead pumps and forgets the damn tank under the lot
RD_ALifeLine_49eb98c837108ed6: There's a hand crank round the back, from when the power went out in '87
RD_ALifeLine_5049c2646cb8c0a9: I cranked it myself, nine hours, my arm didn't work till Tuesday
RD_ALifeLine_6387dbbc42c0fbde: We keep going in circles, none of us know these back roads
RD_ALifeLine_04bdfd1b295ac6c1: Every gas station's got a map rack by the register
RD_ALifeLine_26bb7e6553422b9d: A real map? Jesus, I forgot those exist
RD_ALifeLine_2b52597c73afa5ff: Rand McNally, I'll grab two, one for the glove box, one for you to spill coffee on
RD_ALifeLine_442f149414a84ed1: Buy your own Coke, they're free now, dummy
RD_ALifeLine_689c0a8131592db4: If we find a generator don't assume we've got fuel for it
RD_ALifeLine_383c4107725275f8: And don't send me blind into a truck stop looking for it!
RD_ALifeLine_6eaf41f22c61cc72: I wasn't.. I don't know who'd be in there
RD_ALifeLine_04199af90048a299: Then we find out before either of us walks in
RD_ALifeLine_27f493952a79c9ee: Little station by the church still has a candy rack, and Dad's Skoal behind the register
RD_ALifeLine_575c4cd748421854: Skoal, Sharon? We're risking a trip for Skoal?
RD_ALifeLine_6f23e9634fc38610: He's been chewing toothpicks since Friday, he's mean, I want the Skoal
RD_ALifeLine_12cfd4a772b18f14: Fine, but you're carrying, I ain't got the hands
RD_ALifeLine_3af8d274397ff9c0: Deal, and I'll carry the candy too, the good kind, the sour ones
RD_ALifeLine_456353e74bc0dc9d: Old man lives behind that Shell, got a twelve-gauge, so we knock first
RD_ALifeLine_517b11fa150fdd66: That or he shoots us, so yeah
RD_ALifeLine_1963ce5f61b130fd: Then I'm bringing the cobbler, it's all I got that looks friendly
RD_ALifeLine_3207d278504018c5: Four propane tanks in the cage behind the Gas-N-Go, I walked past 'em last week
RD_ALifeLine_7c084d216a868924: Good, the stove's about empty, we been eating beans cold
RD_ALifeLine_5bf04ef51461dcd1: They're heavy, forty pounds a tank
RD_ALifeLine_027838b61c197b98: Wagon, two trips, I'm not leaving propane sitting out there
RD_ALifeLine_23ae413c7c7b282f: Two trips means two chances to meet somebody
RD_ALifeLine_4f4f4350244a7839: Then one trip, four tanks, we make the damn wagon work, I'll push
RD_ALifeLine_4b42987d2206f3d0: Truck stop on the interstate has CBs, maps, showers, a hundred trucks
RD_ALifeLine_28023e1457d9f923: CB would tell us what's going on everywhere in a day
RD_ALifeLine_5d2b4ab32b90d1d6: Daylight only, park a mile off, walk in
RD_ALifeLine_2c5c002c05809dfc: Frank's boy works the Marathon, he's got keys to the back
RD_ALifeLine_30edaf6f699fe56e: No idea, I called his mama's, phone's dead
RD_ALifeLine_40a353820f6c514a: Then we break in anyway, forget Frank's boy
RD_ALifeLine_17fddbff76b55528: Every garage has a gas can, and every lawn mower has a half-gallon in the damn tank
RD_ALifeLine_4127bc175c0ac8e9: Mowers! I never thought of mowers
RD_ALifeLine_36e95b3746a7517a: So we walk the street, one garage at a time, take the mower gas, leave the can
RD_ALifeLine_6c64cec171580754: That's got to be eight gallons by the end of the street
RD_ALifeLine_477cf186094a0537: Truck's on fumes, we walk, and the truck sits there, there's a whole tank under that parking lot
RD_ALifeLine_6e1c67cc3837d0aa: Under the lot ain't in the damn truck, genius
RD_ALifeLine_22ab95b53173a93b: I know that! A hose, a bucket, I've done it before!
RD_ALifeLine_2f8bca7e1a0adc59: Then do it, Larry, I'm tired of hearing about it
RD_ALifeLine_2cc329092cb5cc3b: Old man at the Citgo said gas goes bad in six months
RD_ALifeLine_3e2396bf59de9c77: So it's fine, and nobody's gonna check, we take what's there
RD_ALifeLine_06399a4a602d2836: Take what's there, and if the truck chokes, we blame the old man
RD_ALifeLine_325605be3c723dfa: How would you work out how long a generator could run?
RD_ALifeLine_42fb69b069d021b5: Count it, then find out what that generator actually uses, not a number somebody remembers
RD_ALifeLine_73ed1866514f4db0: And make a plan for when it's gone, I don't want lights becoming something we can't live without
RD_ALifeLine_2daa725935f4a0ef: IGA's shelves are empty, everybody says so
RD_ALifeLine_6b9e44ba62276af6: The shelves are, the stockroom ain't, NOBODY thinks about the stockroom
RD_ALifeLine_7fa321f91a0acc24: Stocked there two summers, back's floor to ceiling cases, I'll show you where
RD_ALifeLine_25c0a2b708b19b90: Then why the hell are we still eating crackers?
RD_ALifeLine_07b2da5313d58308: No cart, no wagon, how are we carrying it?
RD_ALifeLine_3d76389751f47b6c: Pillowcases, I got six off the beds
RD_ALifeLine_0482e98e26817d58: My mother'd die, canned beans in her good pillowcases
RD_ALifeLine_2297c3e82892a4ed: Whatever you do, don't open the damn coolers in the back
RD_ALifeLine_4f7866e62219d8bb: I-- I know, Boyd's wife said you can smell it from the lot
RD_ALifeLine_395a44147974723a: So cans and boxes, nothing that needed ice
RD_ALifeLine_23f36c995c9b886b: Ten minutes, in and out, NOBODY browses
RD_ALifeLine_705209dc6725e019: Ray says he don't need coffee and he's been walking into walls since the weekend
RD_ALifeLine_18d3c8b712f43339: You hear EVERYTHING but your own headache, we're getting you Folgers
RD_ALifeLine_69bd174e63df3f7b: A can of Folgers, fine, I'll carry it myself
RD_ALifeLine_5629330f69682c9c: Carl would crawl through hell for a pack of Winstons
RD_ALifeLine_42a9a9963e8fe554: Registers are right up front, I'll be quick about it
RD_ALifeLine_0a9bc0f26a1aeefa: The man's got two boys to feed and he wants cigarettes
RD_ALifeLine_062b8c2236c390f1: He wants a cigarette so he don't strangle somebody, that's the trade
RD_ALifeLine_510a2c2e2f20795e: Get Marlboros too, the red ones, for Pete
RD_ALifeLine_7540719f32a812e5: Who the hell's Pete, now it's the whole camp?!
RD_ALifeLine_3b32791b5bd7ffa3: Dog's eating better than we are
RD_ALifeLine_3108c7fb7550571f: He found a can of dog food, he ain't complaining
RD_ALifeLine_1bac98426a4be32d: Store's got a whole aisle of it, bring him, he'll find the good aisle quicker than us
RD_ALifeLine_14e8ae3b608934d0: There's a Pepsi truck parked behind the Kroger, saw it from the overpass
RD_ALifeLine_020ab96f50561113: Sitting low on its springs, so yeah
RD_ALifeLine_7d5ccc3137b34ca8: A warm Pepsi, God, I'd drink it out of a puddle
RD_ALifeLine_3ce4bb2f41442d68: Warm's a miracle, I'm bringing a straw
RD_ALifeLine_7a8009690eed8bac: Everybody in the county's going to the same grocery, that's the problem
RD_ALifeLine_4c2a3e6336ffcff3: So we hit the little store at the crossroads
RD_ALifeLine_0ba8bee66cad74ab: It's chips and beer, that's about it
RD_ALifeLine_5bfd485779405c8c: Chips and beer is supper, and NOBODY's fighting us for it
RD_ALifeLine_6ccfe794731bf6e5: I still remember how fast our pantry emptied, two days of peaches and arguing
RD_ALifeLine_160607662b91acd2: You blamed the kids, like a case of peaches was ever going to last
RD_ALifeLine_78d15bb027eae11f: I was scared. Kept saying we'd find another case of something
RD_ALifeLine_6d7b51521419d3c0: And I said, anything but peaches
RD_ALifeLine_6ed210f707f98450: Apples, pears, a pineapple, we made a whole imaginary shopping list
RD_ALifeLine_54a63f9d4e6beb8d: Better than arguing over whose fault hunger was
RD_ALifeLine_74f7d0917a3efbb0: Those little jars of baby food, the peaches, the pears, I'm telling you
RD_ALifeLine_28b4ae145eac10ae: Ate a whole jar standing in the aisle, best thing I ever put in my mouth
RD_ALifeLine_38b6726e6f022b8e: Then we get a case for the baby and a case for you
RD_ALifeLine_53301c15650e2f5a: Everything at the Kroger's gonna say best by '91
RD_ALifeLine_07a3c35b156b9977: Nobody, it's a Vienna sausage, it was never fresh in the first place
RD_ALifeLine_019af0f43196f978: Then we eat the whole shelf, I'm done being picky
RD_ALifeLine_7b1a1f5b0727ada3: Yeah, yeah, pick a can, any can, I'm hungry
RD_ALifeLine_76e657ec3a0623bb: Hobbs Hardware's got plywood stacked out back, a whole stack
RD_ALifeLine_15e3c6fc709e9c07: The damn windows! You hear 'em at night, I want boards up, like yesterday
RD_ALifeLine_0f367b9a0cfd5197: Nails, and a hammer that ain't missing half its handle
RD_ALifeLine_5be169d057a84295: Already wrote it down, wrote it on my hand, look
RD_ALifeLine_1382704f7ad5f51f: All I want is one pair of damn bolt cutters
RD_ALifeLine_768b1bb26c95b1e1: Gate at the feed store, Larry's got a pallet of dog food behind it
RD_ALifeLine_2ae28a9006ce5432: Larry left town Friday, Walt, it ain't--
RD_ALifeLine_4716beea11b8c13e: I know it ain't, I just wanna cut something, I'm tired of knocking
RD_ALifeLine_53dc3ade197e941f: My sneakers are shot, I feel every rock out there
RD_ALifeLine_1133fb4f2a2d5a98: Hobbs has work boots in the back, steel toe, the real ones
RD_ALifeLine_3e9c3a585da54033: So they cook, mine are already blistered, get wool socks too
RD_ALifeLine_247ebe823e752a35: I need a Coleman lantern and a gallon of that white fuel
RD_ALifeLine_325ea6cd4cbb60f3: Flashlights are dead in two days, a lantern burns all night
RD_ALifeLine_1f96ca32140f864c: Since when are you the camping expert
RD_ALifeLine_6f279568464e3c02: Since my uncle dragged me to Land Between the Lakes, and get mantles, no mantle no light
RD_ALifeLine_566f0d1242d23ff3: They hit the damn hardware store Friday night, I heard the glass from the porch
RD_ALifeLine_4d9c5a07677b1065: Then it's picked over, we're wasting the trip
RD_ALifeLine_6409a5d12b1b0e40: Nobody takes the little stuff, hinges, hooks, rope
RD_ALifeLine_635f96ff5e5d1585: I wanna HAVE rope, you'd be surprised how often
RD_ALifeLine_138a76e03c9e187e: D batteries, we're down to four, the damn flashlight eats two a night
RD_ALifeLine_7a184bb057014a9b: Hardware, grocery, the little drugstore, anywhere
RD_ALifeLine_63f263af5f66c2ab: Hardware's closest, they keep 'em in a rack by the register
RD_ALifeLine_41ae9fc81fde764b: Take the radio so we can test 'em right there, I'm not buying dead ones
RD_ALifeLine_1a9461eb366a0e55: There's a generator at Hobbs, brand new, still in the box
RD_ALifeLine_5027b5dc0e9c50ca: It weighs a hundred and fifty pounds, Dale, how are we moving it?
RD_ALifeLine_4faf921e65642dd5: Three guys and a hand truck and a bad attitude
RD_ALifeLine_42dd4b8e28072196: And gas to run it, don't forget that part
RD_ALifeLine_1a09ee1105a87702: Why the hell's it always the dumb parts that matter
RD_ALifeLine_5d32419434a93971: We need a padlock, a real chain, something to lock the damn gate with
RD_ALifeLine_6c9c63271612f47f: Park the truck in front of it
RD_ALifeLine_2f1ff9fe190ad75b: Truck's gone, Frank took it Friday, remember?
RD_ALifeLine_701bf26159a4dc6b: Then grab the damn chain, Hobbs keeps it on a spool by the foot
RD_ALifeLine_6861c8114435b5f0: Old hotel on the square's got a lobby with a fireplace and a hundred keys on a board
RD_ALifeLine_683b1e7b0bf91947: Hundred rooms, and a fire escape
RD_ALifeLine_6b7f45280cda71da: We pick one on the third floor, one stairwell, block the bottom with the piano
RD_ALifeLine_225de5725169511f: With the PIANO! I knew there was a reason I liked that hotel
RD_ALifeLine_0d5b37960e309316: The yellow house on the corner, the one with the swing, they left Friday, I watched the truck go
RD_ALifeLine_75d9e79650361729: So it's empty and probably stocked
RD_ALifeLine_75d8c81073620793: Garden in back, you can see the tomatoes from the street
RD_ALifeLine_026096d00d0ed3c4: Tomatoes, God, real food, we go now before the birds get 'em
RD_ALifeLine_08173e517360b4bc: I can't go in people's houses, it ain't right
RD_ALifeLine_5171b3ea0f02736c: I don't, so we leave a note, who we are, what we took, if they come back they'll know
RD_ALifeLine_720d3a7b663f032d: ...A note, yeah, okay, I can do a note
RD_ALifeLine_29a38c8f36bf26f4: Even if a house has been quiet for days?!
RD_ALifeLine_5f2d32b676a6a983: Somebody could be in there, scared, with a gun
RD_ALifeLine_7a969f4a450298c3: Then YOU knock.. I'll keep back how's that
RD_ALifeLine_7512f3737d27cdf9: The trailer across the creek has a dog that won't quit barking
RD_ALifeLine_1969d2db72a627c4: Then somebody's feeding it, or somebody's in there
RD_ALifeLine_76ad9e163769989c: Or the dog's the only one left
RD_ALifeLine_4c4ee29154c08a59: don't say that, we go look, if it's the dog we bring the dog
RD_ALifeLine_74ff92502e8a22c4: Big house up on the ridge, you hear a generator at night
RD_ALifeLine_11fce1aa15dbdac2: Somebody NOT scared of noise, which scares me
RD_ALifeLine_14909f65072286d9: We go look in daylight, hands where they can see 'em
RD_ALifeLine_3c50fc654ed66568: I wanna go home, just for an hour, I left the album on the piano
RD_ALifeLine_0d2794f132d5504c: The wedding one, it's the only copy, my mother had the negatives
RD_ALifeLine_13aa002b3cf80f06: ...Okay, we go, one hour, if the street's bad we turn around, no arguing
RD_ALifeLine_5b1f7f7203ca1003: Mrs. Hargis put up forty jars of green beans in June, she told me at the mailbox
RD_ALifeLine_7d1490d27ed72d04: Her cellar's got to be full
RD_ALifeLine_5f7cc15d2cfbdcde: If she's gone she'd want us to have 'em, she fed half of Rosewood one bad winter
RD_ALifeLine_5e5902f57c2f0096: We eat green beans, I say thank you out loud when we go in
RD_ALifeLine_4cb4c2e13b9aec59: We pick one house, ONE, we ain't going door to door
RD_ALifeLine_1105721b676c2088: Third on the left, no cars in the drive, curtains shut, NOBODY's been there for days
RD_ALifeLine_287f4b283b391eb8: Shut curtains means somebody shut 'em, I say the fifth one, it's got a fence
RD_ALifeLine_04e7650b68339e0f: Fence means dog, we're doing the third, I'm sick of this goddamn arguing
RD_ALifeLine_13e4c3f47f2b240d: My uncle's hunting cabin is out past Ekron, no neighbors for three miles
RD_ALifeLine_607d2a450256fcdb: Hand pump out back, woodstove, rack of canned deer meat in the pantry
RD_ALifeLine_1519702033bd6cc0: Then why the hell are we sitting here! Pack the truck
RD_ALifeLine_1beaba4a729bcb0d: Three days of staring at that wall, I know every crack in it
RD_ALifeLine_25a3804c43465e21: You-- you got a better idea than sitting in here?!
RD_ALifeLine_28cd47ee345a6b9f: ANYTHING is a better idea than sitting in here!
RD_ALifeLine_20e339c721064c8f: Pick a place, one building, we go look at it TOMORROW, no more talking
RD_ALifeLine_1976484d61d8a01e: It's too quiet in here, nobody's coming
RD_ALifeLine_719dccc35e9d6042: Nobody was ever coming, you know that
RD_ALifeLine_16e87c063ab50898: I know, it's just, I keep listening for a truck
RD_ALifeLine_772a892f5896eb07: We go find the truck, whatever's out there, I'd rather look than listen
RD_ALifeLine_51033516401fa662: Every day we say tomorrow, and every day it's the same couch
RD_ALifeLine_6f886cf462dd0ddc: So you pick, you always say I NEVER pick
RD_ALifeLine_5b95a64d1238b259: The Kroger, we hit the Kroger, I'm putting my boots on right now
RD_ALifeLine_3b2deacd5c9df0aa: ...Then I'm coming, damn it, wait for me
RD_ALifeLine_372f5c5342a63ddc: If I hear one more game of gin rummy I'm gonna scream
RD_ALifeLine_7506cee53a757622: I lose because I'm NOT paying attention, I'm paying attention to the clock on the wall that doesn't move
RD_ALifeLine_5c1fd2ec40eab7bf: The clock stopped Friday, dummy, let's go outside, I'll show you something to pay attention to
RD_ALifeLine_372a742420a714fd: Nobody wants to lead, that's why we're still here
RD_ALifeLine_234972df09e1d4b9: School, church, back here for supper, any complaints?
RD_ALifeLine_123a1416073ce2e3: Stop talking about it and go, I'm begging you
RD_ALifeLine_016c6c9d5c8c8850: You've been planning since Monday! MONDAY! Nobody's even laced a boot!
RD_ALifeLine_0daf0de4306c4d3b: ...Fair, I'm going, I'm gonna go right now, watch me
RD_ALifeLine_497448656be1e34e: We stopped at B, I was counting on A
RD_ALifeLine_4580763b3042836a: And I was back every time, wasn't I?
RD_ALifeLine_5de4b40e3212f32c: Barely, your hair's gone gray since Friday
RD_ALifeLine_4d1004b9107e8418: Last one to the pharmacy has to check the bathroom
RD_ALifeLine_704ccd4f667d93c2: There's always a bathroom and it's always the worst one, that's why it's a race
RD_ALifeLine_0b72f4876ac59f62: ...I'm not racing, I'm walking, quickly, with intent
RD_ALifeLine_77e5f19c5b817e4a: It's a Cardinals cap, you got it at a gas station
RD_ALifeLine_6069bdd216131e50: It's lucky, it was on my head when we got out of the house
RD_ALifeLine_159ccb493a3efa68: Then it stays on, I'm never taking it off you
RD_ALifeLine_06e3598b3dbe212e: No, no dying until after we find the Kroger
RD_ALifeLine_6ff8d62d48448a28: I need a cold pop, one cold pop, then you can have me
RD_ALifeLine_19b920f378c5a814: Even I wouldn't make that deal, you're asking God for a refrigerator
RD_ALifeLine_033cb6f042bedf51: We walk up to the damn gate with our hands up and a bedsheet on a stick
RD_ALifeLine_7de55eb14b4e27c8: They're soldiers, they ain't gonna shoot a woman waving a bedsheet
RD_ALifeLine_4c6d97251b67006c: You say that like you didn't hear about the bridge
RD_ALifeLine_3a5132fa4c0147a1: The truck with the loudspeaker said Fort Knox is taking people, I heard it myself
RD_ALifeLine_0129025f0a39e440: Main gate, one bag a person, no weapons
RD_ALifeLine_7da9e8a614db8624: No weapons, I'm not walking up there with nothing, I'll hide the shotgun in the weeds
RD_ALifeLine_13a87c2c156688e8: My brother's a tanker at Knox, Specialist Hatch, anybody there'll know him
RD_ALifeLine_28cf28fa256d4cf0: You haven't talked to him in a year
RD_ALifeLine_3fdc20b4755ce1ef: So what, he's my brother, he'll come to the gate
RD_ALifeLine_4af54a782ffd0966: If he's alive, and if they let him, and if you don't get shot on the way, Cody
RD_ALifeLine_41410d171c30d704: Ireland Army hospital's on the base, a real hospital, with generators

RD_ALifeLine_3da5561e188d8691: He's out of test strips, I'm guessing at his sugar, that's not safe
RD_ALifeLine_7981b3550a69f0e5: We checked, it's gone, the clinic maybe, they test everybody

RD_ALifeLine_549403c310cf7f3a: There won't be anybody, you know that, but fine, we ask

RD_ALifeLine_205a72046693bbdf: Somebody who's not scared of smoke, or somebody who don't know better

RD_ALifeLine_3df8dc300db420aa: I don't KNOW who, but it wasn't them, they don't take canning jars
RD_ALifeLine_07b7f67e2781aa17: We hide the rest, tonight, somewhere nobody looks

RD_ALifeLine_63dbc96b264ee052: Because I don't complain, that's why, nobody ever makes the whiner carry
RD_ALifeLine_3500e5a43115343c: ...Okay, fair, we switch every mile, I'll carry it first
RD_ALifeLine_7931409e78d896d1: Thank you, and I'll stop whining, I'm starting now, I'm already starting

RD_ALifeLine_68c8afe271ae7cff: I know, I just miss it, I wish somebody would
RD_ALifeLine_3f5bbcba44b05a85: ...I'll tap the radiator at six tomorrow with a spoon, it's not a bell but it's something

RD_ALifeLine_68f0c1764a3aee76: RESTING YOUR EYES, there's a whole street out there--
RD_ALifeLine_55577fe347132b0e: ...I fell asleep, I'm sorry, I'm SO sorry, it won't happen again
RD_ALifeLine_253883a5403bb04c: It better not, next time I might not be the one who wakes up

RD_ALifeLine_578dcb0f3eec6891: Did you try to find it again?

RD_ALifeLine_06d835196a43a931: I CAN'T, I'm sorry, I can't, I can't make my legs do it
RD_ALifeLine_4085a7ee415a32be: Look at me, only me, it's twelve steps to the truck, I counted
RD_ALifeLine_3e6b542764d45a01: Twelve, I'll count 'em out loud, you just walk, one, two, three

RD_ALifeLine_5df33c0a431bd3da: Everybody arms up, I need to see your arms, all of you
RD_ALifeLine_11a5ce080a40b99c: Completely, nobody moves till I've seen every arm, every leg, every neck
RD_ALifeLine_5d24c22f3fa692dc: ...Fine, fine, look, there's nothing, you happy now?!
RD_ALifeLine_4f6474311ac3491c: No, but I'm less scared, and that's as close as it gets, go

RD_ALifeLine_2cca7bf801801472: I know when I went, I get scared, I need to go again
RD_ALifeLine_2cc1b3b3639f3597: Go behind that bush, then, hurry up, and no screaming over a spider
RD_ALifeLine_2fd8cdb016475231: Spider! There's a spider, no, I'm coming back!
RD_ALifeLine_6b80153c79a42800: If your feet start hurting, don't hide it just to keep us moving

RD_ALifeLine_6274470b1cdc81a1: I know, but I can't tell how bad it is from you saying fine
RD_ALifeLine_35ca598d109f86a9: Feels silly making a fuss over a blister
RD_ALifeLine_03e6d8f0447cdbfd: Asking for a rest isn't making a fuss, and I shouldn't promise bandages before checking
RD_ALifeLine_539be05703183a9b: One, two, three, four, five, six
RD_ALifeLine_2cd716b27ae98dd0: What the hell are you doing?!
RD_ALifeLine_399db08d44c1db42: Counting heads, there's supposed to be seven
RD_ALifeLine_73e18cff146083fc: Seven, it's seven, Danny's behind the tree
RD_ALifeLine_48298aad3850e7f7: Don't do that to me AGAIN, I'm having a heart attack
RD_ALifeLine_2b79ab8d45e6ce85: Before we go, can we pray? Just a minute, everybody
RD_ALifeLine_2591944838224626: I know, you don't have to, just stand with us, hold a hand
RD_ALifeLine_2d0caded5cdc77e2: ...A minute, one minute, I'm gonna feel stupid
RD_ALifeLine_62e191be59ed5abf: You won't, nobody does, bow your head or look at your shoes, either way is fine
RD_ALifeLine_044b7c4c2c312663: Moss grows on the north side of the trees, everybody knows that
RD_ALifeLine_7449aa07101f088f: Moss grows on every side, ask my uncle, he got lost for two days
RD_ALifeLine_103b5ffa23674ff9: Then we use the sun, east to west, we go north, I'm sure about north
RD_ALifeLine_4abac48131c3d03f: You're sure about north? You were sure about the barn
RD_ALifeLine_2c3aaeb822b4ff6c: I'm sure about NORTH, the barn was a one-time thing
RD_ALifeLine_7399a64c317d087a: What the hell's the plan, boss?

RD_ALifeLine_19712c7b286109a4: The Kroger, boss, yes, boss, right away, boss
RD_ALifeLine_0e509b216dc4350f: You left the gate open, I told you, I TOLD you
RD_ALifeLine_02f6b10468ea6cb2: You closed it like a person who doesn't care if it stays closed
RD_ALifeLine_2d0a51623612fe47: It means go back, latch it, don't come back until you hear it click

RD_ALifeLine_73dbd51330d75875: She said pick up milk, that was it, pick up milk on the way home
RD_ALifeLine_22de73496bb7c75a: I know, I know you've said
RD_ALifeLine_033993363bf52eaa: I'm going to the Kroger and I'm getting milk, I don't care if it's gone, I'm going to stand in that aisle

RD_ALifeLine_40daed4c1745b82d: Rock, paper, scissors, come on, it's fair

RD_ALifeLine_1a7d52c90697443d: So you're due, that's how luck works, throw

RD_ALifeLine_1123e26f2ab7d1d9: I'd sleep like the dead, sorry, bad choice of words, like a baby

RD_ALifeLine_3959b7d773df347e: Then Operation Not Dying, it's got a ring to it

RD_ALifeLine_27657e5540ae61d8: Then take me there, I don't care what they look like

RD_ALifeLine_29d68a2671330c3c: I'd walk ten miles, I'm gonna eat till I'm sick
RD_ALifeLine_11e24d5c316ce7ed: We can't stay here, we CAN'T, they're in the street now

RD_ALifeLine_195ac12b16b7472f: Pawn shop on Dixie's got guns, radios, a big old Zenith, ANYTHING
RD_ALifeLine_0d92508850f4ddad: Then we're there before they are, get up

RD_ALifeLine_7aa6175c5dbc92d0: Then ice! A cooler! Something! I can't sit here counting vials, Jesus
RD_ALifeLine_7bf848ab007ff48c: Hank says Pruitt's got hit already, shelves bare

RD_ALifeLine_19a9427a7b1df704: 'Cause it's locked, Cecil, and I ain't got a key, shit
RD_ALifeLine_30fcb623236ed7b5: Crowbar's in the garage, ten minutes
RD_ALifeLine_0b602d8448ab9561: And if the pharmacist is back there? I ain't going in first, no sir

RD_ALifeLine_6214f6cf11bea0ee: Why am I the one in?
RD_ALifeLine_6d9824b836167488: Nine months in high school, I stocked SHAMPOO

RD_ALifeLine_1d5949e04c636221: I'll go, you keep her quiet
RD_ALifeLine_50ff7a59622b8c7c: If you're not back by dark I'm taking her to your mama's, I don't care what you say

RD_ALifeLine_5bc860471ab3f396: That end of town's crawling, you know it is

RD_ALifeLine_060199721d554dd1: One big door, a hundred gaps in the boards, I can see everything from inside, it's good
RD_ALifeLine_1ed30c5647267f9e: Family meeting.. everybody gets a say
RD_ALifeLine_719f426f2bd36e03: We're deciding, one vote each, even Papaw
RD_ALifeLine_58ae5ba212c397f1: Tuttle's Feed and Seed has seed packets, a whole rack of 'em
RD_ALifeLine_58d485fb3c597cdd: Turnips, Mamaw says turnips go from seed to supper in sixty days, even in bad dirt
RD_ALifeLine_6eb566c944f530c3: I know what month September is! Just get the packets, and a shovel
RD_ALifeLine_619559af6dd2d149: Mrs. Dobbs's garden's still got tomatoes, hanging there red as anything
RD_ALifeLine_556e34e2635eaefd: We pick 'em first, that's what a garden's for, I'll leave her a note
RD_ALifeLine_39ae946f6d9e9cf5: We take half and leave half, that's fair, I'll say a prayer for her
RD_ALifeLine_57bf198d051125c7: We need salt, a lot of it, Mamaw says you can't put up anything without salt
RD_ALifeLine_7c7c627a5de26614: Anything! Beans, meat, fish, the grocery's got a whole aisle of it
RD_ALifeLine_475c05d079ebb35b: Cheapest thing in the store and the most important, I'll carry ten pounds
RD_ALifeLine_1b6fe9f8215a87a7: The little one won't eat, she just pushes it around the plate
RD_ALifeLine_293d694417161325: I know, but I can see her ribs, I need something sweet, anything
RD_ALifeLine_22b4650165bf65ba: Candy store by the bank, I'll go, hard candy, a lollipop, that's what we need
RD_ALifeLine_112df8df2b186f59: I keep thinking about that greenhouse on Route 60. Tomatoes, peppers, little cucumbers
RD_ALifeLine_7777b9fa365086b0: You think somebody's still watering it?
RD_ALifeLine_2e85f7ba60a6117c: I don't know, I just remember how full it used to look
RD_ALifeLine_3fb187e31ec908bd: If we ever find living plants, I'd rather leave some for the next person
RD_ALifeLine_664ca29f53349bdd: Beans, rice, flour, lard, Mamaw says she can cook anything off a sack
RD_ALifeLine_417f510624961cfb: Sacks are heavy, who's hauling fifty pounds of rice?
RD_ALifeLine_00d8057457e6ac20: You are, you're the one eating it
RD_ALifeLine_019ee5665f89d681: Mamaw's the only one in this family that's right about food, fine
RD_ALifeLine_55cf773010328013: Old Mr. Tatum used to grow a garden the size of a football field
RD_ALifeLine_1d4410c256f5c346: I saw chimney smoke Tuesday, doesn't tell me who's there now
RD_ALifeLine_156c1c8528b4247c: If we ever meet him again, I hope we've something useful to offer
RD_ALifeLine_7831ff0e0cfd5764: We save the seeds from the tomatoes, dry 'em on a paper towel
RD_ALifeLine_06c0452a52b4b369: Next year, you plant 'em, you get tomatoes, Mamaw's done it since 1950
RD_ALifeLine_52da5f380f465a3d: Next year, God, you're thinking about next year?
RD_ALifeLine_6dc46ecc5a66cb6c: Somebody's gotta, if we all think about today we're hungry in the spring
RD_ALifeLine_5cec74b46ba7644c: ...Fine, I'll dig the beds, you tell me where
RD_ALifeLine_49557d9c13837dae: I'm not ready to leave this house
RD_ALifeLine_461b1a5249477979: Thirty years, my whole married life, I painted that kitchen yellow myself
RD_ALifeLine_35f45145642547f9: I know, I know, take the picture off the wall, it's what we can carry
RD_ALifeLine_15276da0028479ee: Mama's got dialysis Tuesdays and Fridays, she's missed two now
RD_ALifeLine_7bd4d1b74ea47fa6: There's nowhere to do it here
RD_ALifeLine_4a2005fe6dc626a0: University Hospital in Louisville has a whole floor of it, I took her there once
RD_ALifeLine_0e115060744c036c: Thirty miles with a woman on a machine schedule, and nobody's running a hospital
RD_ALifeLine_79ccd5876ac73dee: I know that! I know! Just let me say it out loud, it's the only place I can think of
RD_ALifeLine_43aebdf60f6028a9: Papaw's out of his blood pressure pills, he doesn't say it but I counted
RD_ALifeLine_1dc12c0f00940942: Zero, he's been skipping every other day, he thinks I don't notice
RD_ALifeLine_63b873ba2346ca53: The drugstore, we bring the empty bottle, the label's got the name, the dose
RD_ALifeLine_50ae7dae28e0d46f: Grain elevator by the tracks has corn, whole kernel, not even wet
RD_ALifeLine_31c94d6a01d4d250: Mamaw's got a hand mill from her mother, she grinds it, that's cornmeal
RD_ALifeLine_2355012145c04830: Then that's bread! Actual bread, load the wagon
RD_ALifeLine_3bfcc7a44da4f2a9: I remember Papaw asking us to leave him behind. Said his knees were done
RD_ALifeLine_3bd0b2427e766716: You weren't going to leave him?
RD_ALifeLine_1673adb323b2830d: He kept saying we'd cover twice the miles without him
RD_ALifeLine_52c1c8122c3e3fe7: Like that made it an argument you could bear to hear
RD_ALifeLine_74aa19e65131b3a1: Said he'd find water and a good chair. Tried to make it sound like a holiday, I hated hearing him bargain with himself
RD_ALifeLine_45b4d54372b3143e: If a kid wanted to bring a Game Boy, would you let him?
RD_ALifeLine_173f2f766581cbff: Four AAs, I remember that much
RD_ALifeLine_73e7dcc916bd7a7a: Might need those for a flashlight
RD_ALifeLine_3a31674263d8b605: Might also need him to have something besides being scared
RD_ALifeLine_5a3d32044343b8f1: I'd want to know what we actually had before arguing over it, then I'd ask for a game of Tetris
RD_ALifeLine_242fe14a41a0acf5: No, we don't need the TV
RD_ALifeLine_6dccff0814379b9c: It weighs fifty pounds, it doesn't work, we're walking
RD_ALifeLine_288ce0517d83d58f: It's got the little antenna, I just wanna look at it
RD_ALifeLine_0e1ec90646b2a6e7: ...Take the antenna, leave the TV, that's the deal, that's the only deal
RD_ALifeLine_00e8bd29368d4330: A garage with a name, the Garage Hilton, Camp Peach, Fort Mamaw
RD_ALifeLine_5e6376912ff9242d: Fort Mamaw! She'll love it, she'll hate it, same thing
RD_ALifeLine_74811b1a255a9dd7: Then it's Fort Mamaw, I'll paint it on the door
RD_ALifeLine_4b753fb120dac737: Mama's recipe book's still on the shelf
RD_ALifeLine_2a2a8793615275f8: It's a book, we can't carry books
RD_ALifeLine_5c80a59321678449: It's forty years of Mama's handwriting, I'm getting it
RD_ALifeLine_558c26ce3bda6e13: ...It weighs two pounds, I'll carry it, you're right, I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_134c2cbb62772db5: I'll go get it, it's four minutes, and I'm going, I'm not asking
RD_ALifeLine_6db208ae3b02328f: Last I knew, the kids were at school, I can't stop thinking about going back
RD_ALifeLine_46dcfe905655c15a: You, you can't! Not by yourself!
RD_ALifeLine_34611ced0fbaffea: Seven and nine, Ray, I know I don't know where they are now. That's what scares me
RD_ALifeLine_3dee78b875a14bd6: Then let's work out what you know before you rush off, I'm listening
RD_ALifeLine_6b3841310a2d5dea: Dad's at the plant, second shift, he doesn't even know
RD_ALifeLine_66d7cc81333ef1e6: Plant's six miles, we can't walk six miles
RD_ALifeLine_12d23ccc4437f4b2: ...I know, I know, get your shoes, we try the truck first
RD_ALifeLine_003a92cc71b93210: Mamaw won't leave without her recliner
RD_ALifeLine_52efc0b12dee3d15: Tell HER that, I'm not telling her that
RD_ALifeLine_028e25c3001e25de: Wheelbarrow, we put her in the wheelbarrow, she'll scream, but she's coming
RD_ALifeLine_4c59dc111d89a240: Papaw says go to the farm, forty acres, one gate
RD_ALifeLine_455934eb634419e3: He's got a shotgun and a smokehouse full of ham, he said so on the phone before it went dead
RD_ALifeLine_6168c14878a44db2: Then why are we still HERE, load the wagon!
RD_ALifeLine_1e00d3f65e605529: The boy's inhaler's making that empty rattle again
RD_ALifeLine_319721cd67f9a886: I quit counting at nine, he's wheezing in his sleep
RD_ALifeLine_7924479c466b7b8e: Pruitt's is four blocks, I can do four blocks, you stay with him
RD_ALifeLine_75e03cbc1202be00: Take the flashlight, watch your hands, there's glass all over the front
RD_ALifeLine_460eaea550fd5d2e: Which one of you took the last of the water?
RD_ALifeLine_7fb32e68065c6875: It was Papaw, he was thirsty
RD_ALifeLine_33ed7c70629ded54: ...Then Papaw gets the cup, the rest of us walk to the creek, get your boots
RD_ALifeLine_01811c9e123cd9c1: Walt keeps one of those little battery TVs in his truck, I seen it
RD_ALifeLine_47a1a307067b66bf: Maybe, or maybe Channel 11's still on, they got a generator
RD_ALifeLine_62f87f6b3d0c435c: We ask Walt, and if he says no I'll trade him cigarettes
RD_ALifeLine_75151f65457ca4e3: Tatum's got the only satellite dish in the county, big as a swimming pool
RD_ALifeLine_7b9e226132830454: Dish ain't gonna get nothing if NOBODY's broadcasting
RD_ALifeLine_05b9916c307bf935: You, you don't know that, maybe somebody up in Nashville is
RD_ALifeLine_3ed2536c16eab3b1: Maybe... fine, I'll bring a chair, we'll watch static together
RD_ALifeLine_5e5cad571adc6caf: Radio at the funeral home's always on, the director had it tuned to the oldies
RD_ALifeLine_3d6c860d6953a11f: That's not gonna tell us anything
RD_ALifeLine_19695f5f69f24d2d: It's gonna tell us if somebody's playing oldies, and if somebody's playing oldies somebody's alive
RD_ALifeLine_15395d1f07ef0187: ...I'll go, I just don't wanna go in that building
RD_ALifeLine_62604f7b1cb1ac44: The Hendersons got four horses, I could ride to Louisville
RD_ALifeLine_0fa5e7312675a460: You can't ride a horse to Louisville
RD_ALifeLine_6949767d37cf9e7f: You ride one, Dan, I lead the others, we'll look like the Pony Express
RD_ALifeLine_672149bf6cd56f8d: We'll look like four idiots on horses, but yes, I'm in
RD_ALifeLine_6dea5b0737b32fe7: Mr. Boyd's got a big green tractor, he'd let us borrow it
RD_ALifeLine_0a41ed8b78b49e1a: Tractor does fifteen miles an hour
RD_ALifeLine_1de40ffd0d61f21f: Tractor goes through anything, a ditch, a gate, I'd rather be slow in a tractor
RD_ALifeLine_2262593c6f50d996: Fifteen miles an hour with the whole family on the back, fine, load the trailer
RD_ALifeLine_2dd0b6674c5bb4f5: The boy says he can run to the corner and look, he's--
RD_ALifeLine_5e0fde28200c2ed4: He's fifteen, he's the fastest one we got
RD_ALifeLine_2c3b7b0d158f63c2: I said no, I'll go, he can watch from the window, that's his job
RD_ALifeLine_41a526dc7dd7e49f: It's spring, first warm day, I smelled the dirt this morning
RD_ALifeLine_60e236cd581e31e2: Peas, lettuce, the cold stuff, seeds in every hole I find
RD_ALifeLine_3a97e0562d61cfbc: Every hole, I like that, it's the first hopeful thing I've heard in months
RD_ALifeLine_3dca8a2b1634f544: I remember arguing about who stayed with the kids
RD_ALifeLine_0171a4a50ee46c29: I kept saying I could shoot.. they listened to you more
RD_ALifeLine_62780f340df84d41: I told you fine.. but you had to come back I needed you to come back
RD_ALifeLine_67845b4f1b908782: Papaw won't leave the house, says he was born in that bed
RD_ALifeLine_6fc3964a4acf9caa: Tell him he's about to die in it
RD_ALifeLine_5481f060196364b3: You tell him! He'll whup you with the cane
RD_ALifeLine_0f8745456261d640: We leave him water and beans and a shotgun, we come back, I'm sorry but we're going
RD_ALifeLine_69fb75e221db3010: Corner store on Fourth, we hit it before the east side does
RD_ALifeLine_3676bd005f508fa3: Looking ain't taking, man, we go now, five of us, quiet
RD_ALifeLine_4394366461f3b3b4: Five's too many, three, the rest hold the street
RD_ALifeLine_7963ef2321947191: Three, fine, but I'm one of the three, I found it
RD_ALifeLine_44d1405c30484aae: I remember somebody saying the block was ours.. we'd know who came through
RD_ALifeLine_242d6dc0192019e8: How were you supposed to know?
RD_ALifeLine_2dc479bb58d481b7: He wanted kids on the stairs and roof.. whistling if anyone walked up
RD_ALifeLine_5eee9cec381dedca: He said they didn't get bored.. like that made it all right
RD_ALifeLine_061b5f820f679b95: Where's the cans? We had forty yesterday
RD_ALifeLine_79baa9ae19570344: Somebody, who's somebody? I wanna know who ate my goddamn peaches
RD_ALifeLine_6a4985f80c159157: ...It was Darnell, he's in the back, he's hiding, he's full
RD_ALifeLine_28e56b5562191622: DARNELL! Get your ass out here!
RD_ALifeLine_48df67d1390b4234: Pharmacy on Main's got what the older guys want, they pay in guns
RD_ALifeLine_72f02ba86296ad5d: Everybody likes guns, that's why we go before somebody else does
RD_ALifeLine_45709646473ce8d9: We should have a name, a real one
RD_ALifeLine_770952777038510e: We got a name from before, I want one for now
RD_ALifeLine_647591473f51ce07: I once saw a crew hang a sheet out a window to claim a whole building
RD_ALifeLine_35bdd47c6e77a4ff: One word, MINE, in red paint
RD_ALifeLine_239d78ec08b5b591: I'd find another building, I'm not fighting for a damn sheet
RD_ALifeLine_331d04b17f491c2e: We move at night, the dark's our friend
RD_ALifeLine_05e21120062895f8: So we move quiet in the dark, that's all I'm saying
RD_ALifeLine_77e7adf85b6f4e1a: I'm saying it too, I got a flashlight with a red filter, it's a gift
RD_ALifeLine_623041b33263cd15: Rule is nobody goes alone, nobody
RD_ALifeLine_74e01bb24d70e8e6: I went to the damn store alone
RD_ALifeLine_378db1a36f29f7b3: And you got back with a bag of chips and a bruise, you don't count
RD_ALifeLine_764ace20413f59e5: It was a good bag of chips
RD_ALifeLine_0de1d09b6f15d8d4: We need a leader, somebody who decides things
RD_ALifeLine_2fcf46ec2c791b5d: You're twenty-two, that's old enough, I'm following you, the rest will follow me
RD_ALifeLine_595f7648066c257a: Starving here, getting shot at out there, I don't love either one, shit
RD_ALifeLine_0eb1e14c4d4ca79c: We go, and we shoot back, I'd rather do something
RD_ALifeLine_47115de9247d382b: We got a radio, but it's all static
RD_ALifeLine_27610410594d22eb: Who knows how to use it?
RD_ALifeLine_14da54c65d134476: The old guys got a ham radio somewhere, a case of beer buys us a teacher
RD_ALifeLine_2a5170a2693e3947: A teacher for a case of beer, I like it, I'm in
RD_ALifeLine_2a5e710a1077b1cc: We hold the store and charge a can to get in
RD_ALifeLine_25bd28a655f3f7a9: It's a membership fee, I read about it
RD_ALifeLine_45e2de3d622e6792: On a cereal box, shut up
RD_ALifeLine_4b245fb323f15a29: We need boots, mine are coming apart
RD_ALifeLine_4dc44be3126118ae: It's picked over, I looked, but there's always a box in the back nobody thinks of
RD_ALifeLine_5c45480e75b28f0f: There's always a box, I'll go with you, I need socks too
RD_ALifeLine_2f24b18c5cad5f77: East side's got a plan, and we got no plan
RD_ALifeLine_0eb426df4f18f1ab: So we do what they do, only a day later
RD_ALifeLine_478beca138a3a857: That's the dumbest plan I ever heard, and it's the best one we got
RD_ALifeLine_58e1ae3c797f7f60: What if we asked the church people for a blessing?
RD_ALifeLine_520f29df43a74eca: For the plan, for luck, for the next job, I don't know, it can't hurt
RD_ALifeLine_2bfa1f2217b7080e: It can hurt, they'll ask what the plan is, then what do we say
RD_ALifeLine_19d63f380a943d17: We say it's a surprise, shit, I'll say it, I'm good at lying to preachers
RD_ALifeLine_229dc42a06743ddc: I thought we were done briefing
RD_ALifeLine_52fe7fe8469ec4a9: We're never done briefing, sit down, we know nothing, so here's what we do about it
RD_ALifeLine_35974968568ef090: We keep the radio on, even if nobody's on it
RD_ALifeLine_14a0e08a4ad08e92: Day somebody comes on, I wanna be the one who hears it
RD_ALifeLine_4af0bf2966ff82d2: ...Fine, then I'm bringing batteries, we're low on D cells
RD_ALifeLine_198f5d7f51717962: I got a list of old folks living alone, thirty-one names
RD_ALifeLine_344397a22ee8f859: Six a day, that's the rotation
RD_ALifeLine_7024cc37587294de: I take the first six, I'm bringing cookies, they like it when I bring cookies
RD_ALifeLine_6dc775340bc14c2a: Cells three and four still got men in 'em, two days with no food
RD_ALifeLine_157d44926a8919b8: We-- we feed 'em, and then what?
RD_ALifeLine_463f80de545074a0: Then we decide, I'm not leaving a man to starve in a cell, I don't care what he did
RD_ALifeLine_69f4aaeb23cd324e: Agreed, I'll get the keys, water first, then food, then we talk
RD_ALifeLine_7e5c38eb5a879d41: Cruiser's on a quarter, we got sixty miles in her, maybe
RD_ALifeLine_2b1f144a3adbf1bb: Pump's behind the fence and I don't have the gate key
RD_ALifeLine_642267f5716da5db: Bolt cutters in the trunk, we're the law, we cut it, leave a note
RD_ALifeLine_4c552c3335605a5c: State police post in E-town, if anybody's left, they'd know where the command is
RD_ALifeLine_7b39b11167c7353a: In daylight, two cars, I take the lead, you cover the rear
RD_ALifeLine_5cd2a1846d30c8d2: We turn around and think of something else, nobody's playing the big man today
RD_ALifeLine_2d9f67a83f6c1923: Four on, four off, I'll write it on the whiteboard
RD_ALifeLine_463ccb0d4742edfb: Whiteboard's got my ticket quota on it
RD_ALifeLine_053251d95a29c7c9: I'll erase it, there's no quota anymore
RD_ALifeLine_54d12fdf06410659: ...Say that again, no quota, I might cry
RD_ALifeLine_4309c6907552ba11: Evidence locker's got shotgun shells from the Teague case, five boxes
RD_ALifeLine_1f7ea18a3b3db611: Property clerk's gone, we cut the damn lock, I'm signing for it
RD_ALifeLine_391f7ddf6c5340cd: Signing for it, in a notebook, nobody's ever gonna read it, but fine, it's right
RD_ALifeLine_634a8d5025b4fdbc: Bridge duty, two at a time, eight hours, you watch the west end, I watch the east
RD_ALifeLine_5a1943757771b1d6: Anybody crossing either way, we don't stop 'em, we just count 'em
RD_ALifeLine_2553b30a7425e5a1: Counting people, that's an old man's job, I'm thirty-four
RD_ALifeLine_3ad6b16814efb3b8: State police headquarters is in Frankfort, they'd have orders
RD_ALifeLine_207a91301df5a250: Two days if we're careful, and we got the cruiser till the gas runs out
RD_ALifeLine_10fcff874b8fbafe: I'd rather know than not know, I say tomorrow, first light
RD_ALifeLine_627f7ce3450e0635: Radcliff PD hasn't answered in four days, I'm going over there
RD_ALifeLine_55f6fff60d4883c8: With you, if you're coming, I need you to cover the car
RD_ALifeLine_6163bce0011da5f3: I'm coming, I just wanted to hear you say it, I hate it when you go off ALONE, damn it
RD_ALifeLine_37c7367845a35849: What the hell's the plan for tonight?
RD_ALifeLine_6ec3c2e178d7b9e2: It's the only one in the handbook, Hatch, I looked
RD_ALifeLine_760c19af1fc467a1: We use ten-codes on the radio, and we keep it short
RD_ALifeLine_4c7a2bbc48dc39fb: Somebody might be, and if they are, I don't want 'em knowing how many we are
RD_ALifeLine_7a6fc4b1596fc696: Ten-four, I'll keep it short, it's the first time you've made sense this week
RD_ALifeLine_17fd8ab56b0a031a: I say we move the station to the high school, it's got a gym, a kitchen, a flagpole
RD_ALifeLine_384759701d74095f: So somebody sees us, a flag says somebody's still here, I don't care what flag
RD_ALifeLine_15d879c553db3b39: We've got an American one in the supply closet, I'll bring that
RD_ALifeLine_02f21c42483bf320: Rex hasn't eaten since Sunday, he keeps looking at me
RD_ALifeLine_1a0ab0f95222493a: He's a K-9, he's got four years on the job, I'm not leaving him in the kennel
RD_ALifeLine_0ce9bb10744f673a: Then he rides with us, and he eats first, I'll find the dog food, I'll find a whole bag
RD_ALifeLine_63d94feb4f435de5: We tack a notice on the courthouse door, church basement, noon, survivors welcome
RD_ALifeLine_405d775c22770892: Whoever comes by, there's always somebody who comes by, a paper on a door's a signal
RD_ALifeLine_4b774e984dedfa9e: Print it big, and put your name on it, Hatcher, it's your signature that makes it official
RD_ALifeLine_12bcc2530f13ed35: My mother's in Elizabethtown, I wanna go see her
RD_ALifeLine_0b5106f5494d0050: I know how far it is, I'd be gone two days, you'd be short a man
RD_ALifeLine_6959eecb3aa83db7: ...Go, take the cruiser, I'll cover, and come back with her, bring her here, we'll make room
RD_ALifeLine_613b95f6352e302d: I look like a hobo, and I want the old man at the church to recognize me
RD_ALifeLine_41b6762a02c5ef7d: He'll recognize you, you're the only one in the county who still wears a tie
RD_ALifeLine_7469108c08738685: The nursing home. Forty residents, and I haven't been there since Friday. It's on my list, I just... haven't been
RD_ALifeLine_36892af90a06832c: I should've gone already, I keep finding excuses because I'm scared of what's in there
RD_ALifeLine_51a339240465ce30: Then I'm coming with you, we go now. Whatever's in there, we talk about it after we're out
RD_ALifeLine_29ca608e248f1394: Somebody stole the goddamn cruiser, I was inside for two minutes
RD_ALifeLine_4e6e374e53eb3c99: Looked like a kid, fifteen, maybe, drove off with the lights on
RD_ALifeLine_4834bfd076c75a19: Then he's got a full tank and a bad idea, I'll find him, I'll walk him back by the ear
RD_ALifeLine_1f6bb5443f50ea4c: Whatever's in the walk-in that isn't DEAD yet
RD_ALifeLine_5126e3e13db104e4: You're not fine, you're twenty-three, you've been on the job a year, you're shaking
RD_ALifeLine_0b2bb78a27e70306: ...What do I do if it's somebody I know?
RD_ALifeLine_1b2cdd8955915d7f: You do what I do, you say their name, quietly, you do the job
RD_ALifeLine_4779d37961cef049: Play it again, the last dispatch
RD_ALifeLine_3ced49c002cad475: I know, I just wanna hear her voice, play it
RD_ALifeLine_3ebcc56c45eb0152: ...All units, be advised, all units, be-- then nothing
RD_ALifeLine_3b18a0b61aae67db: One more time, then we go to the school, I won't ask again
RD_ALifeLine_6e209c8a4509e225: I froze at the roadblock, I just stood there
RD_ALifeLine_19baeb965f21c1d6: It was a lot of people at once
RD_ALifeLine_357113d461caff7b: They were all looking at me and I couldn't move my hands, I'm a cop, I should've moved
RD_ALifeLine_318e45526dceaca1: You moved after, you pulled the woman out of the car, that counts
RD_ALifeLine_271a1b342c0b2805: It better, I'm not doing that twice, next time I move
RD_ALifeLine_55b1ef3c183ed9e1: I remember the captain saying hold the courthouse.. then changing it to the school
RD_ALifeLine_02768286270c1020: And he wasn't there to ask
RD_ALifeLine_09b67b670ed15cde: We had to guess.. and somebody else would've paid if we guessed wrong I hated it

RD_ALifeLine_1bce93577f241cc8: The dog hates everybody, he's a police dog
RD_ALifeLine_36a0e3ca3a5d8abd: ...Fine, but he better not pull, last time I woke up in a hedge
RD_ALifeLine_23205cd149abccd2: Dutton, you take east, I take west, we meet at the courthouse at noon

RD_ALifeLine_0258f2694b5ce179: If he's in there I'd rather we find him upright
RD_ALifeLine_008e4fa21303ddbb: Station's got twelve shotguns in the rack and a case of slugs
RD_ALifeLine_7c86164c0b4065e3: Twelve guns, we got six people
RD_ALifeLine_4131a1ff3f2aa514: So six go to anybody who can hold one and don't shake
RD_ALifeLine_6c4a712a57a8972b: Hands that don't shake, that's about two people in this town, me included

RD_ALifeLine_62f0bb207c561970: People, wrecks with people in them, anything that moves wrong

RD_ALifeLine_03bfa43375acb938: Till somebody tells us different, I got no deadline, I got a building
RD_ALifeLine_3fdf6e623948d437: A building's something, Hatcher, it's more than most folks have
RD_ALifeLine_3f50eb7b6544041f: Forty rounds each, that's what we got for this whole county
RD_ALifeLine_566ed49810c7210d: We count 'em, we don't waste 'em, we don't fire at something walking away
RD_ALifeLine_4a89532470c6cda9: I'll hold my fire like it's my last paycheck

RD_ALifeLine_75e14dac581b3566: I'll wear one, I'll sweat through it, whatever

RD_ALifeLine_2a2e0c8840ddfb7e: Me till two, you till six, I'll wake you with coffee if there's coffee
RD_ALifeLine_4843b8ee329c6889: There's coffee, I hid it behind the toner
RD_ALifeLine_4ac55f0a288e47b8: If we get separated, rally at the Marathon on 31W, I don't care what else is going on
RD_ALifeLine_1dad5fbd3b95bc31: I'm not there in two hours, assume I'm not coming
RD_ALifeLine_0f96fb4a6b20f812: I'll assume nothing, you'll be there, I know you

RD_ALifeLine_4f1c2282165343c3: Rides in the cruiser, back seat, I'll put a pillow behind him

RD_ALifeLine_6572207b1fb8b94c: We tell 'em we don't know anything, it's still the truth, they're gonna ask whether we say it or not

RD_ALifeLine_75d0ded41aaafe91: Because the Dairy Bar's closest, if it's bad we back out, I don't want to be a mile into it when we find out
RD_ALifeLine_0b2c58d016d0362e: Dairy Bar, Marathon, church, I'm writing it on my hand
RD_ALifeLine_33538e9a41a0d7cb: If a pharmacy's windows are broken, would you assume it's been stripped?
RD_ALifeLine_53da19d2772c9538: Or scared people. Glass doesn't tell us what's left or who's inside

RD_ALifeLine_6d90fd6573f94783: We don't go out at night, nobody does, that's my order

RD_ALifeLine_2f914fdf0688a115: I wanna load 'em with the church people, the old folks first, then whoever's left
RD_ALifeLine_73727a901b4a9823: Then somebody's driving, and it's gonna be me, I got a license, I think it's still good
RD_ALifeLine_0fb624622aaae99e: Impound lot's got forty cars, half of 'em with gas, nobody's claiming 'em
RD_ALifeLine_455fb5640697e5ea: Every key's on a tag in the lot office, it's the most organized place in the county

RD_ALifeLine_338794ff51022e24: We don't set roadblocks, we help people through

RD_ALifeLine_5ed19ff64d424f23: Radio the Guard on the hour, every hour, even if nobody answers
RD_ALifeLine_68ca8d69243675e4: Then the fifth day somebody will, that's what I figure, you keep trying

RD_ALifeLine_4c1ae98d2dd45e75: You wanna hole up in a museum

RD_ALifeLine_202d88600f24a94f: I keep wanting to promise I'll find her, I can't even promise when I'd be back
RD_ALifeLine_7d0c1ab438d5a030: Me, I'm done with the east side

RD_ALifeLine_66b4a33f4e2b7080: Squad, listen up, here's the day

RD_ALifeLine_0df1deef22abc1cb: Noon we eat, then we dig, supper if somebody finds supper
RD_ALifeLine_6f1e8c527945bc2f: Relief was supposed to be here Saturday, it's Tuesday

RD_ALifeLine_6756183f0a7cea20: Second wire's where they stopped letting people through
RD_ALifeLine_6ba39f5b51d14069: We find another way, the drainage culvert, I know it from a training exercise

RD_ALifeLine_3a1c126b21b93579: We start now, I want a wall by dark

RD_ALifeLine_36c804f86400bdfe: So we got twenty-seven rounds for ten men
