RD_ALifeLine_0440da01419a285b: I still find sand in my boots from Kuwait
RD_ALifeLine_7c8198860476b676: I shake them out and some falls on the floor, every time, I don't know where it comes from
RD_ALifeLine_431459d77bf6842f: I know there's no mail, I still look
RD_ALifeLine_296960265fcca991: I'm owed three weeks of fucking pay
RD_ALifeLine_3b37d3177ef95125: The finance office, when it opens
RD_ALifeLine_5712e0e856c15d68: Put it on three fucking forms
RD_ALifeLine_37e5c3e74a2a4b1b: I was due to re-up in August
RD_ALifeLine_5777ed303fd6c77e: They'll make you do the paperwork, and the paperwork's the only fucking thing left that works
RD_ALifeLine_699b549c4b075001: Re-up, I'll be your witness, you dumb bastard
RD_ALifeLine_10ffb29b200cee28: I spent my whole career training to fight Russians
RD_ALifeLine_67f8144a3a22584f: And here we are in Kentucky, and not a Russian in sight
RD_ALifeLine_240728516b06ad15: I'd take the Russians, at least they'd be organized
RD_ALifeLine_166e59550bd58056: One's a situation, one's a state of being, I forget which
RD_ALifeLine_28720a9c2c5d16d0: It's FUBAR, I was there for the goddamn invention
RD_ALifeLine_7454822977008836: It's a different kind of cold
RD_ALifeLine_3c192af067c8b81b: Breaking in these boots is a joke, they're from 1990 and they hate me
RD_ALifeLine_7c9e89f6726a17d8: They fit like somebody else's feet
RD_ALifeLine_7c68e7834f45754e: Somebody else's feet had a better time, the lucky bastards
RD_ALifeLine_202a8426665fb821: I'd give a month's pay for a cold Coke
RD_ALifeLine_2f5542fb03c30b52: Any, all of them, I never spent it anyway...
RD_ALifeLine_646ac5a10f7c6de2: Take mine too, I've got a lot of months
RD_ALifeLine_4214888c5739ccb7: Somebody drew a mustache on the Lieutenant's photo, with a Sharpie, the sons of bitches
RD_ALifeLine_363ae33f50c6e779: His wallet, he was showing the platoon his kid
RD_ALifeLine_24ed1d6d22650df9: Count a third time and you'll have none
RD_ALifeLine_420745f5283cee29: Fort Knox taught me to drive a sixty-ton tank
RD_ALifeLine_22f4a9aa2e4ed10f: And not one damn thing about this!
RD_ALifeLine_44ec92c85025f125: They don't make a field manual for this shit!
RD_ALifeLine_67fd9154075efa7d: I'll trade you a pack of gum
RD_ALifeLine_11f4bd8346dcec62: Spit in a can, not on the goddamn floor
RD_ALifeLine_2a556a385e4cd49b: It's a floor, it's already got everything on it
RD_ALifeLine_27eeebd80c0e3387: My first jump, I closed my eyes the whole way down
RD_ALifeLine_23de947b60b10915: The sergeant said open them or break your legs, I opened them
RD_ALifeLine_55f482b942cc4133: I opened mine at the last second, it was a good surprise
RD_ALifeLine_426086f33d5f45e8: Mama's gonna kill me, I haven't called in a month
RD_ALifeLine_734e790431be8f8d: I know, I'm saying when this is over she's gonna kill me
RD_ALifeLine_06f53c146d3241a8: When it's over she'll be too happy to kill you
RD_ALifeLine_0c4e425d30646410: Ranger school, I ate a rat
RD_ALifeLine_032168444f895388: It was a very small rat and a man was watching
RD_ALifeLine_3d2bba5f2f6588e9: It tasted like rat, with hope
RD_ALifeLine_3266b51547cc5207: Everything tastes like chicken with enough hope and a lot of salt
RD_ALifeLine_5afd0c197a430a13: Count the rounds, then count them again
RD_ALifeLine_41f31d7f606c2803: I'll count them a third time
RD_ALifeLine_6318d0215d4c1cba: He sits up with the map every night
RD_ALifeLine_413700035e1a8101: He's got nothing on that map, it's an old county road map from a gas station
RD_ALifeLine_271fb47526d2401a: Take the corner seat, you can see both doors
RD_ALifeLine_3278d7fc74c79350: Everybody likes the corner, that's why it's a good corner
RD_ALifeLine_3c3f802a2deafc09: Boots off, feet up, you're no good to me with blisters
RD_ALifeLine_6941229838af194b: It's a good order, take 'em off
RD_ALifeLine_683ca6eb1675a538: What's the first thing you do when you get home?
RD_ALifeLine_14dc2c2e3cb9cd85: After all this, when the Army says we can go
RD_ALifeLine_18b7158f6fc38ab9: Sleep, in my own bed, with the window open and a fan going
RD_ALifeLine_666af5073ac7da70: And a glass of tea so cold it hurts your teeth
RD_ALifeLine_20c259bc00c2d2d8: The end of things, I thought there'd be more noise
RD_ALifeLine_49cdd41062a62616: There was noise, in the beginning
RD_ALifeLine_3a952a8d796b14da: I mean now, it's just quiet and hot
RD_ALifeLine_40559b8f07afd7d5: It's the quiet that gets you
RD_ALifeLine_0180abb723868c2c: Five, six if somebody doesn't eat
RD_ALifeLine_474bdeef0f53d850: Weather, mostly, it's hot, it's still hot
RD_ALifeLine_1e94cd92613083d4: Nobody's reading it, but we write it
RD_ALifeLine_6704e8074c7fd32c: I'd eat a whole pan, cold, on the floor of the latrine
RD_ALifeLine_19a052085d7e7750: You ever been this far from base?
RD_ALifeLine_732d674a376ad3dc: Thirty miles feels like thirty hundred
RD_ALifeLine_0196616d0d8a6777: It's the longest thirty miles in the world
RD_ALifeLine_3603204a4a57d2ac: My hands haven't stopped shaking since the last one
RD_ALifeLine_09fc2bf87692fbc8: It's me, and I'm not sorry
RD_ALifeLine_6f1c3f4461bb3859: I used to think I was tough, and then I smelled it
RD_ALifeLine_32f4011029ca3149: The first one, up close, in the heat, and my whole body just said no
RD_ALifeLine_14a9884f1054beed: I've got a letter in my pocket, I wrote it to my mother, and I'm not gonna send it
RD_ALifeLine_571fb7ed3338a513: Because then she'd know where I am, and I don't want her coming
RD_ALifeLine_56bf9bce6782b44a: What's the worst thing you ate in the service?
RD_ALifeLine_251b2a7b117f3228: Gray, gray eggs, with the texture of a sponge
RD_ALifeLine_64857a4a0b55d9bb: I had a goat once, in Kuwait, don't ask
RD_ALifeLine_25a6d5ea24c5fbaf: I keep checking my watch, and then I remember there's nowhere to be
RD_ALifeLine_7e00396b591d245c: It's the worst part of every day
RD_ALifeLine_7ce71dbf69f9aefd: The first thing I'm doing when this is over is sleeping for three days
RD_ALifeLine_412f6dcf01aa37c1: And then I'm complaining about how I slept too much
RD_ALifeLine_0bfb41b95bdd1f5a: I'm so fucking tired of MREs I could cry!
RD_ALifeLine_67a27f294cffd5e1: I don't have the fucking water!
RD_ALifeLine_67df8c3215aceaa8: I saw something in the road this morning I'm not gonna tell you about
RD_ALifeLine_58b8c32a1093170b: I'm just saying, I'm not the same as Friday
RD_ALifeLine_011ff6413c8fb7cb: Man, I'd sell my own mother for a cold Coke and a hot shower
RD_ALifeLine_2849e8c850fbb749: You'd kill for a cold Coke, you'd negotiate the shower
RD_ALifeLine_589fc0ea24019ad4: Fuck you, I'd kill for both!
RD_ALifeLine_4bf5be1e267b12b0: I'd take a bathroom with a door
RD_ALifeLine_5ab51eeb416e444b: If the Army doesn't give me a plan by Friday I'm going home
RD_ALifeLine_0f74aea14a29761e: Wherever home is, I'll find it
RD_ALifeLine_3004e9742e55b47c: You'll find it at the bottom of a ditch, shut the hell up
RD_ALifeLine_3c36e4790d96f361: I'm so fucking dirty I could grow potatoes in my armpits
RD_ALifeLine_0da96dd82c3aabc7: Seriously, there's a little farm back there
RD_ALifeLine_1accb69b78c99918: Sergeant's the only thing between us and chaos
RD_ALifeLine_599554123df3adc4: That's what I said, he's an asshole, a necessary asshole
RD_ALifeLine_183f51604d95355f: The thing I can't get over is nobody told us, we were just standing at a gate one day
RD_ALifeLine_1af0b47d5e7b52c3: I'd give my left arm to be back in Fort Knox, eating bad pizza
RD_ALifeLine_66914d3a3c88e510: It's thirty miles through hell, I'm not walking it
RD_ALifeLine_4549367e3562da6d: Then enjoy the pizza in your head
RD_ALifeLine_7891ec2f2f7e9104: It's been moved, it was on the left side of my bag
RD_ALifeLine_7f68dff36dd5cc9c: I moved it, it was in my way, calm down
RD_ALifeLine_51a032814dbb5f38: I don't think we're getting extracted
RD_ALifeLine_31ef6ffa6eef12f6: Too hot to talk about anything
RD_ALifeLine_62e62cea5a07642f: I'm just saying what everybody's thinking
RD_ALifeLine_52b11ffe05e0fe4d: Then keep thinking it, don't say it
RD_ALifeLine_560d3bb47dd97165: What do you say when somebody asks for water and you can't spare any?
RD_ALifeLine_2d6161577bf02706: Even when they only want a swallow?
RD_ALifeLine_0f457e447021fb38: Especially then, don't make them wait on water you haven't got
RD_ALifeLine_7bea84be0e081f37: You had that ace up your fuckin' sleeve, I seen it
RD_ALifeLine_40361d2a0380a12d: I ain't showing nobody my sleeve, back off
RD_ALifeLine_77a4814c0043e3d4: I've been waiting my fuckin' turn for ten minutes, you're hogging it
RD_ALifeLine_66c22a445d695376: It's a bottle, you can hog it later
RD_ALifeLine_34349c7450c5632c: It's empty, you two dumbasses been fighting over fumes
RD_ALifeLine_29d241b33d3eb49d: You found 'em on my side of the fuckin' room
RD_ALifeLine_35f35526294719f8: It's a room, there's no sides, flip a coin for the damn things
RD_ALifeLine_3b6b71063d0d3013: Then make something that looks like coffee
RD_ALifeLine_4440f64e611f2bca: What do I make it out of?
RD_ALifeLine_6965765d155c8e16: Dirt, I don't give a shit, just make it hot
RD_ALifeLine_230378c565306465: And don't spit in it, I'm watching
RD_ALifeLine_1d45fc3f070b8e64: Got four thousand goddamn bucks in my pocket and I can't buy a cheeseburger
RD_ALifeLine_301b7d1d158038aa: Put it on the fire, at least it'll burn
RD_ALifeLine_572cd57f13b6d256: It's all anybody's got, it's worthless
RD_ALifeLine_504032102aca8cc4: It's good for starting a fire, tell me I'm wrong
RD_ALifeLine_79657c9879307e5d: Your breath could kill a fuckin' horse!
RD_ALifeLine_7f55408a0177aa95: It's a gift to horses everywhere, they'd be safe
RD_ALifeLine_2eb66ff75303d714: Blame the teeth, the breath's just along for the ride
RD_ALifeLine_0e4ebe02623e1589: If I had one, not for you
RD_ALifeLine_289df46010eb06a9: Yesterday you owed me, I called it even
RD_ALifeLine_18d822c60bcb5048: You're both full of shit. Arguing over a pack neither of you has shown me
RD_ALifeLine_410a138150892442: I look at everything, it's a free country
RD_ALifeLine_197a7d2978395e96: It's a shithole is what it is
RD_ALifeLine_5076505a0a7ee428: Then daydream about shooting a can
RD_ALifeLine_050e7bcc42b112ab: I'd rather you didn't even joke about doing that inside
RD_ALifeLine_2340ccec1c96cc71: Fine. Imaginary can, imaginary bottle, very safe imaginary boredom
RD_ALifeLine_587c95b517d6f649: Nobody took your seat, you got up
RD_ALifeLine_788b4507755ebbe2: Then somebody's sitting in my seat
RD_ALifeLine_2dbc8ec316233c06: It's my seat, it's got my ass in it!
RD_ALifeLine_1e3e09470270d538: Sit on my lap then, jackass
RD_ALifeLine_485ed3ab19f16999: Arm wrestle, a can of beans
RD_ALifeLine_52ce28a1580c7825: It's what we've got, it's the only currency
RD_ALifeLine_12280f974af70fcd: Fine, but if I win I want peaches
RD_ALifeLine_1b40915224c75be5: I counted it, we're short two cans and a fuckin' lighter
RD_ALifeLine_4a4867d73738aff5: Maybe it fell out of the bag
RD_ALifeLine_659c633531ea4c9a: Everybody here's got sticky fingers, that's why we're in this shithole
RD_ALifeLine_1091d6c7377bacd3: You snore, I'll put a sock in it
RD_ALifeLine_5279a37e2afee083: Yours, it's the one that's been in your boot for a week
RD_ALifeLine_172893a8638051b5: I'd rather be gagged by a dead rat
RD_ALifeLine_71be97501b0c744f: He didn't say where, just keep walking
RD_ALifeLine_677364a35c7d61e4: Then we're moving somewhere, shut up
RD_ALifeLine_320a96d7671cedb8: Somewhere's the one place we haven't been
RD_ALifeLine_31a449a14a158d64: I used to have a pool
RD_ALifeLine_6fca33111c3a2ead: In the backyard, above ground, with a ladder
RD_ALifeLine_661d3355435f0563: Why are you telling me this?
RD_ALifeLine_535c543157085329: I'd give my left nut to jump in it, ladder and all
RD_ALifeLine_79ee6de260293e31: Then shoot three at a time
RD_ALifeLine_7adf34021a0c875c: Shoot it at the guy who sold it to you
RD_ALifeLine_5840e472787c1f8d: Where the fuck'd you get that watch?
RD_ALifeLine_7caa726219a8aff9: You found it on a guy
RD_ALifeLine_6e35877f534b5b2c: Is it set to the right time?
RD_ALifeLine_2ae33e851ec5744c: I never know, no one does
RD_ALifeLine_1e41012e606adb43: It's always Friday on that watch
RD_ALifeLine_2b28c01f6cee33b9: I don't know, but somebody knows where we are
RD_ALifeLine_25a5fd1216213a44: That's just you being a scared little bitch again
RD_ALifeLine_335c4b9644d6f2cf: I'm not scared, I'm paranoid, there's a fucking difference
RD_ALifeLine_4b2c1ab9520c2957: You're not the fuckin' boss of me
RD_ALifeLine_39a07c9f16ec68ea: You keep telling me what to do
RD_ALifeLine_240b0e7c7a4bd9c7: Because YOU keep fucking it up, you dumb shit!
RD_ALifeLine_587220bc508d4534: Draw on his face while he sleeps
RD_ALifeLine_2b42d52300d86984: Do it, I'll hold the light
RD_ALifeLine_0e15af307fa921c6: I'm not getting soft, quit looking at me
RD_ALifeLine_7b9096d82f945a42: Say it again and I'll cut your coffee
RD_ALifeLine_4c6b9da169493222: It means nobody wants to see that shit!
RD_ALifeLine_1354b76f37bee273: One time I stole a whole truck of Pepsi
RD_ALifeLine_4c843e0020ecaaad: A whole semi, drove it to Indiana, sold it in three days
RD_ALifeLine_3d9d8769585d6ba5: You smell like a Pepsi truck even now
RD_ALifeLine_691d63250d8e974e: It's the cleanest he's ever been
RD_ALifeLine_4fe2e8b76498f6f6: My granddaddy ran shine in Hart County
RD_ALifeLine_4ed76f9520f5595a: Mine got caught once, did a year, said it was the best year of his life
RD_ALifeLine_22e2ef51199edc7f: No wife yelling at him, three meals a day
RD_ALifeLine_4b67737f6b83908d: That's every one of us right now
RD_ALifeLine_105780e913b9f568: Who the fuck ate my beans?!
RD_ALifeLine_53876fbf53bca610: There was a whole can, and it's licked clean
RD_ALifeLine_09c5286465c9c29a: I didn't, I'm just saying look at your chin
RD_ALifeLine_11402d48035ff155: I robbed a bank once with a spatula
RD_ALifeLine_7195fc6768cc2f7d: It was in my pocket, the guy didn't know it wasn't a gun
RD_ALifeLine_13f728a017664673: Four hundred dollars and a free toaster
RD_ALifeLine_75bb243c2b8e924b: Tell it right, the toaster was the whole point
RD_ALifeLine_1e11cb712cb373a9: You couldn't hit a fuckin' barn!
RD_ALifeLine_695391b629031d2a: You hit the side of it, sideways, you fuckin' blind bat
RD_ALifeLine_05e13f63410b8dc6: It's a big barn, it counts
RD_ALifeLine_20da455964eb970f: Fair share, that's all I want
RD_ALifeLine_060d850546ab9293: It's how fair works in this room, I've got the gun
RD_ALifeLine_7b98a01849ed27f9: I called for my mama's pie, there's a difference
RD_ALifeLine_369f2a7a7f9da684: Look at 'em, all holed up in their little houses with their little curtains, the lucky bastards
RD_ALifeLine_2eb520c4157fcb64: I'm just looking, I never had a house
RD_ALifeLine_2b84425f661c3a08: New fish, you're on the door
RD_ALifeLine_163e4dbc422206a9: Stand there and look scary, jackass
RD_ALifeLine_55346c62381a19e2: I don't know how to look scary
RD_ALifeLine_79cc0ebf2fd401a8: That's the second time you've kicked my boot
RD_ALifeLine_2d0661b244ceb78a: It's a boot, it doesn't have a way
RD_ALifeLine_5609d9f113cdd211: Both of you shut the fuck up, I'm trying to sleep
RD_ALifeLine_3a52a51f1adbc2e8: You ever wonder if they're looking for us?
RD_ALifeLine_5a10e6b855d78f38: Anybody, the Army, the sheriff, our mothers
RD_ALifeLine_394c9e073c483d48: I can't sleep, I hear stuff
RD_ALifeLine_56a5f94f67de6d95: I thought that was the guard
RD_ALifeLine_0a019f1b3e3f3962: If anybody says we're gonna be fine I'm gonna break their fuckin' jaw
RD_ALifeLine_325c736c160eac55: Keep your hands to yourself, you've got a cigarette to finish
RD_ALifeLine_59e4c4134f2d66b0: I'm so fucking hungry I'd eat my own boot
RD_ALifeLine_33fc1bbc694fa169: You'd have to cook it first
RD_ALifeLine_2b39256855627f65: Practically a steak, with a sole
RD_ALifeLine_4cb3e672738e0b64: I don't know, but if I find out
RD_ALifeLine_454370ed24a710a6: I'll tell 'em to shut it, I'm not a monster
RD_ALifeLine_6a7a6c302533dae3: My old man used to say you can't outrun your own shadow
RD_ALifeLine_2f14f31223f89f2f: He was drunk, but he was right
RD_ALifeLine_02c924ad4fab1e51: We took that whole fuckin' truck of Pepsi and the driver cried like a baby
RD_ALifeLine_6dc45db201f32622: I'm telling it again, the guy cried, I felt bad for a second
RD_ALifeLine_52d2aad9355b8ef2: That prick wouldn't know a plan if it bit him in the ass
RD_ALifeLine_136b3754562276f2: Why? He's not even here, he's off pissing somewhere!
RD_ALifeLine_3071934b7da1229b: You bet my fuckin' boots, you piece of shit!
RD_ALifeLine_4f9270323ae63876: I was gonna win them back
RD_ALifeLine_70e566e56b233a96: You lost my boots on a pair of fours!
RD_ALifeLine_60aaa21c2259e68c: Did you hear that? Shut up and listen
RD_ALifeLine_0ed5d9462cae6896: Wind doesn't make that noise, it's something with feet
RD_ALifeLine_1db21c823b82b203: It's a fuckin' possum, you pussies
RD_ALifeLine_2e90994d763c8c7d: I don't trust the boss, I think he's gonna sell us out
RD_ALifeLine_50d2dd0a1de38b89: To who? There's nobody to sell us to
RD_ALifeLine_5bf35e101c9a9275: That's what he wants us to think
RD_ALifeLine_5e80c6b07905b82c: Did you see that guy's face when I pointed the gun at him? He pissed himself
RD_ALifeLine_4011a3bd5572d2fb: He was seventy and he pissed himself, I rest my case
RD_ALifeLine_69f0821f5b515432: You're a hell of a guy!
RD_ALifeLine_268223322cb3056c: Once saw a cord running from a house to a generator
RD_ALifeLine_17f5f0e17c6f16e6: I told myself that meant power, food, whiskey, didn't actually know any of that
RD_ALifeLine_3c37c1ff035ae37a: Good reason to look before barging in, not a reason to expect a feast
RD_ALifeLine_13989004093c7f2b: It's ninety-five fuckin' degrees and you want me to wear that jacket
RD_ALifeLine_785744d221617c48: I-- I don't need a hood, I need a fucking pool
RD_ALifeLine_11d6015237f21dac: If I get stuck eating cold beans again, I'm gonna dream about steak
RD_ALifeLine_39273ba95593492d: I'd dream about a fuckin' fork first
RD_ALifeLine_7549d11713fdc5e2: You ever eat beans without a fork?
RD_ALifeLine_2275e4fe6de3e7b7: Once with a spoon Lonnie had licked, I haven't forgiven him
RD_ALifeLine_4478f7274475a305: I'm not sleeping next to Rusty, he farts
RD_ALifeLine_0b026215653a81c2: Not like that, it's like a goddamn tornado
RD_ALifeLine_34b579ea085421c5: I'm done with this shit, I'm heading to Indiana
RD_ALifeLine_0eee7a747c57e2b3: My sister's got a place, she'd take me in, I think
RD_ALifeLine_64f6f7916a6bef77: Tell the one about when you robbed the church
RD_ALifeLine_4e6f33da7f063a41: I didn't rob it, I borrowed a collection plate
RD_ALifeLine_00bd401628832b14: He borrowed a plate and the whole fuckin' congregation chased him
RD_ALifeLine_5ecdae30503a2e0e: I ran faster than any man in the choir
RD_ALifeLine_5b4920215478a7fa: I got a dog, I'm keeping the little fucker!
RD_ALifeLine_3aa9ce84090a7ff9: Mine, he followed me home, he's got one ear
RD_ALifeLine_54e2c0ae61e3010b: It's a shotgun, dumbass, everybody's is bigger!
RD_ALifeLine_6f4492553cfff1e5: It's got a longer barrel, that's all I'm saying
RD_ALifeLine_0ed3e1fe534f2a5a: Those church people with their casseroles, all holier than thou, I hope they choke on a fuckin' noodle
RD_ALifeLine_556d4cb47edbbf36: They've never done anything to you
RD_ALifeLine_0ad795db07e5bf79: They looked at me funny, in the parking lot, in '85
RD_ALifeLine_5e11a44a0fff5e09: You still scared of the dark, pussy?
RD_ALifeLine_09ea176115524494: You slept with a night-light in the cell, I saw it
RD_ALifeLine_08a14e293fcdff90: It was a flashlight, you ignorant fuck!
RD_ALifeLine_0aa9d4ef17f0e89a: Don't ever fuckin' touch my bag again!
RD_ALifeLine_6e8be0c701617eea: I was looking for a spoon
RD_ALifeLine_1d6a150b26285633: Ask me, you piece of shit, you ask!
RD_ALifeLine_3a817fee7045d8cf: It's not empty, I can hear it, there's a good swallow
RD_ALifeLine_1f842429421909c5: There's a good swallow of spit, Cecil's been backwashing
RD_ALifeLine_1fae1c0637a311d8: Blame the bourbon all you want, it's your face doing it
RD_ALifeLine_05cd72990fdd43aa: I'm gonna shoot the next bird I see
RD_ALifeLine_390fd37a5775794e: I'm bored, and it'll make a noise, and I'll feel something
RD_ALifeLine_20cc2e8033013021: I told you we should've hit the pharmacy
RD_ALifeLine_45066a9752bb5710: I said the pharmacy, in the fuckin' truck, on the way here
RD_ALifeLine_23ff56922cc10c96: You said 'pharmacy' and then you threw up
RD_ALifeLine_5e7c5cca234a4421: Don't you go telling anybody, but I'm scared. Fuck, I'm scared
RD_ALifeLine_406909bf1d803435: Don't, I mean it, I'll know
RD_ALifeLine_37b4de3d526574bf: I won't tell a soul. Everybody's scared shitless, it's not just you
