RD_ALifeLine_2f353fe74701e867: You asked what I'd do first
RD_ALifeLine_40b9d29b43c7b505: I still count the people who aren't with us
RD_ALifeLine_3f87e1e637cab82d: I don't want to forget their names
RD_ALifeLine_081c3f9b4770b64b: Tell me one, I'll remember it too
RD_ALifeLine_6d6d895216fd0920: We called ourselves Orchard and nobody can grow a damn apple
RD_ALifeLine_0fdcaf3e5505ac86: This coat's older than both of us
RD_ALifeLine_34176b490aab63ee: Keep the food in the other one
RD_ALifeLine_03e48fa53408ef22: I keep counting the same shells
RD_ALifeLine_458faca205946821: Save one for when you really need it
RD_ALifeLine_73207ab741ad3de4: There's a song I can't get out of my head, I can't remember the name
RD_ALifeLine_4e5d6b871d87c782: Da da dum, da da dum, something about rain
RD_ALifeLine_4d90a54d3e4fa5f6: It's the one my mother sang while she did the dishes, if I could find the words, I think I could cry
RD_ALifeLine_4c10abff115ab5d3: Not tonight, I'll tell you but not tonight
RD_ALifeLine_47e318a51813b44a: My grandfather taught me the stars on his back porch, Orion first
RD_ALifeLine_13aa72be497e773f: Three in a row, easiest thing to find, he said that if you can find the belt, you're never lost
RD_ALifeLine_2726e2a03bce1ecd: It's only true if you remember to look up
RD_ALifeLine_0a79c63f60b4a479: Give me a second, there it is, still there
RD_ALifeLine_5c5f3a7b4369b02c: An ambulance went by with the lights on and nobody inside but the driver, he was screaming...
RD_ALifeLine_1bc1e9d6635db8fc: I heard it, I couldn't make myself follow
RD_ALifeLine_21c563b450915c4e: Because I was scared too... I'll tell you that straight...
RD_ALifeLine_352fed973ac1afbd: Are you going to arrest us? We took food from the grocery on Main, the door was already open
RD_ALifeLine_3fa9a992633674ab: Nobody's arresting anybody for groceries today, I'm not even writing it down
RD_ALifeLine_37967ae80f93c718: Thank God, I thought we were done for
RD_ALifeLine_427bb12a3bcab3f1: Just don't take more than you can carry out quiet, noise brings them
RD_ALifeLine_7978245655fac755: Somebody stole my chickens, is that something we do anymore?
RD_ALifeLine_5969763770b6e92b: Ma'am, I've seen the whole county on fire in the last week and you're asking about chickens
RD_ALifeLine_0411c29865b16632: I'll keep an eye out for a man with feathers on him
RD_ALifeLine_03b982f838844fa2: I keep thinking I'll wake up and it will be a regular Tuesday
RD_ALifeLine_5948502214c6ffa7: I've thought the same thing a few mornings, I don't wake up to it
RD_ALifeLine_20938c9d0377c01a: Not yet, but I get less surprised, if that counts
RD_ALifeLine_52b00f7034145e8a: Are you going to protect us or just stand there?
RD_ALifeLine_36f25c7b1515b947: I'm going to do both, sir
RD_ALifeLine_17b0e895715489b7: Then do one of them faster
RD_ALifeLine_295e4c4652ab9bab: Does the badge still mean anything now?
RD_ALifeLine_52c734182c3ffb36: It means I'm obliged to try, that's all it ever meant
RD_ALifeLine_5254267924a5086b: Then try to find my boy, he's fourteen, red jacket, about this tall
RD_ALifeLine_0f23a42267251017: Red jacket, I'll ask every person I meet, go to the school and wait there
RD_ALifeLine_4b823ddf04e2b09f: My husband got scratched on the arm, it's shallow, he says he's fine
RD_ALifeLine_4a72ccb17655a608: This morning, he's in the van, he's sweating, but it's hot out
RD_ALifeLine_01f79d7979e7d101: Ma'am, listen to me, keep your face away from his, if he stops answering you, you walk away
RD_ALifeLine_0777af9b229e87cd: My husband called from the grocery, said the doors were locked from outside
RD_ALifeLine_72c6b68a6a047460: Ten minutes ago! Can you go?
RD_ALifeLine_5556c84a1032872e: I'll check it, stay on the porch with the dog
RD_ALifeLine_1c69f069560bc022: There's a roadblock up ahead, Army or yours?
RD_ALifeLine_214ee94c6270e2cf: Not mine... I've got no roadblocks, only a patrol car with a flat
RD_ALifeLine_4b92a3a02cec777c: They pointed rifles at us and told us to turn around
RD_ALifeLine_121c6000317f5800: Then do what they say, they don't ask twice
RD_ALifeLine_501bf502370c0eac: We showed our papers to a soldier, he just shook his head
RD_ALifeLine_1fee211921a67850: Nothing, he pointed back at the town
RD_ALifeLine_2ba653f715a45929: My girl asked if it's like the chicken pox, something that goes away...
RD_ALifeLine_54852cc0605119e6: That yes, it's a lot like that...
RD_ALifeLine_48b7f51455cc6c6e: I'd have told her the same, some days a lie is easier to carry than the truth
RD_ALifeLine_0cbe3b5732e52e22: Everybody at our church is gone, I looked for the pastor and found his shoes in the road
RD_ALifeLine_5287562c6a0aa248: Just the shoes, set down neat like he'd stepped out of them
RD_ALifeLine_48b9d4a81ed857d9: I'm sorry, I don't have a better word for you than that
RD_ALifeLine_5c2c7fbd2a24596d: Is there a curfew now? We saw a flyer on a pole
RD_ALifeLine_0c080c16476b9500: Not from my office, that's the Army's paper, and they posted it before they left
RD_ALifeLine_3cd7f54559fa4a99: North, I'd stay in after dark whoever's name is on it
RD_ALifeLine_2d895eac654a3d56: You look like you haven't sat down since Friday
RD_ALifeLine_2c27306329bf4887: I sat down yesterday, for eleven minutes
RD_ALifeLine_0b4a0c2e3f650982: Can we do anything for you?
RD_ALifeLine_5de096280e278842: Pour me a cup of something... I'll consider that a favor
RD_ALifeLine_2cb22bdd66a0e471: My dog bit one of them, did that put her at risk?
RD_ALifeLine_275ab17016d576d2: I honestly can't say, nobody has told me what a dog can catch
RD_ALifeLine_587f8cfd461c70da: She's been licking her paw all morning
RD_ALifeLine_00f6363b5385f071: Keep her away from the little ones for a day or two... I'm sorry, that's the only advice I have
RD_ALifeLine_17498b9d0fc66dfe: We're heading into town to find my mother's pills
RD_ALifeLine_7486666a194cfff1: Don't! Muldraugh is bad past the water tower
RD_ALifeLine_40302bc35cf77ce7: She's got a heart condition, she's running out
RD_ALifeLine_6484d0c648e3e3c3: Then go to the pharmacy on the edge of town and nowhere farther, in and out, front door only
RD_ALifeLine_527f4ef90de8c78f: They're slow, we could just outrun them, right?
RD_ALifeLine_3fd4fe5f44217ce3: Some of them are slow, I watched one cover a parking lot faster than I ever could
RD_ALifeLine_7248f94e647db6a6: So you walk, and you keep your head, your legs won't save you
RD_ALifeLine_4fe443812c29ed68: They told us on the TV to wait for the Army, I waited two days, nobody came
RD_ALifeLine_64a2ddb8731b395d: I wouldn't count on them coming for you, ma'am, they've got their own priorities
RD_ALifeLine_4f824bad08f4a6a5: Meaning I saw convoys heading north and none of them stopped
RD_ALifeLine_61cbdbc002063c96: A deputy back at the bridge smelled like a whole distillery
RD_ALifeLine_22af4f26065f401f: He told us everything was fine and then he waved at a tree
RD_ALifeLine_26571d1b495797e2: Everything isn't fine, but I understand why he'd want to believe it
RD_ALifeLine_5166177101bd9935: We fenced off the lane with wire, is that all right with the county?
RD_ALifeLine_6288503727b236dd: The county's whatever I say it is today, it's fine
RD_ALifeLine_2d4daa251cfde07c: Hang cans on it, they'll tell you before you see anything
RD_ALifeLine_6e80e91803022fcd: We found a baby in a shopping cart behind the church, a note was pinned to the blanket
RD_ALifeLine_6d225a4b632f23fc: Please keep her safe, her name is Ruby
RD_ALifeLine_0435b1a43fcadce9: Bring her with me, there's a woman at the aid station who will know what to do
RD_ALifeLine_04da686b68f88725: Is there any gas left? Our tank is nearly dry
RD_ALifeLine_7b66e0a86f742c65: Mackey's on the highway still has a pump that works if you hand-crank it
RD_ALifeLine_0473361b545c7099: Two men in lawn chairs with shotguns, tell them the deputy said it was fine
RD_ALifeLine_1a6471fb26e49b20: If I find my daddy's shotgun, am I allowed to carry it, or would you take it off me?
RD_ALifeLine_2c1029b0330980b9: I'd rather you knew how to handle it. Muzzle down and finger outside the guard
RD_ALifeLine_6df869240dd8c6e6: I never shot at anything but a can before
RD_ALifeLine_20c8fbb526bce1f4: Then don't let having a gun talk you into a fight you could avoid
RD_ALifeLine_512c9af54d07cdf9: We were told to wait at the school, is that still the plan?
RD_ALifeLine_2d9e442a1f22abec: As far as I know, yes, there's a unit set up there and a nurse
RD_ALifeLine_0a1580fb33466670: Then we'll go on, thank you
RD_ALifeLine_0d81ebb131668d89: Stay together on the way, if somebody falls behind, don't go back for them alone
RD_ALifeLine_28d84f6f7535fdb6: We heard the hospital took everyone in, is that true?
RD_ALifeLine_7a9048c74d989507: The one in Louisville did, for the first day... I've heard nothing since then
RD_ALifeLine_0ca25c6d28183f41: I'd think very hard before I drove into a place where everyone was taken in
RD_ALifeLine_11f7dd3f2f453c4b: Deputy, you pulled my brother over last spring for the taillight
RD_ALifeLine_679ee1ed05eef3cd: The Chevy with the duct tape? Yeah, I remember that
RD_ALifeLine_20630d8b6dca810b: He's still driving it, or he was, I haven't heard from him since Friday
RD_ALifeLine_519a576948a6b0e0: Hold onto that, people turn up, I've seen it happen twice this week
RD_ALifeLine_186698e04d77f9f5: We're short on people who know how to fight, would you travel with us a while?
RD_ALifeLine_5d1a2a7a3b69f07e: I'm still sworn to this county, I can't just leave
RD_ALifeLine_3b209b3c4096549c: Just to the crossroads, we'd feel safer with a badge
RD_ALifeLine_4e52c8f63a5ae4e5: The crossroads I can do, after that you're on your own
RD_ALifeLine_0cc1465a381bb7ab: I keep thinking about families stuck without anything to eat
RD_ALifeLine_475b59da4874607b: If we meet any, we ask, no point saying we've got food before we check
RD_ALifeLine_2552176d4a0ad4ce: What if we haven't got enough?
RD_ALifeLine_2e3ae4e7478dd80d: Then we say so, we don't send them somewhere on a guess
RD_ALifeLine_5be1bf992ddd2d47: We got the AM station for a minute last night, it said to stay in our homes
RD_ALifeLine_6a2965340c87e701: Mine said that too... then the signal went to hiss
RD_ALifeLine_3e8cd46613f95864: I decided not to think about it, you shouldn't either
RD_ALifeLine_2a0e0cc5096dbd38: Anything else we ought to do?
RD_ALifeLine_5dda2ec363c6fd3a: Lock your door and keep a flashlight by the bed, do not use the front steps at night
RD_ALifeLine_56fa88e609ddb2fb: They're the loudest part of any house
RD_ALifeLine_4166dfcb0ba40c14: Somebody's been through the hardware store and they were carrying more than they needed
RD_ALifeLine_00a43379326d20c8: I know the type, we're not able to chase them down right now
RD_ALifeLine_333f59646ba41c78: You're the law! Isn't that the entire point?
RD_ALifeLine_76c97e2a4845b602: The point today is keeping people breathing, the rest of it can wait on a judge
RD_ALifeLine_4b1279902d03a94b: Have you seen a little girl in a yellow raincoat? She's six
RD_ALifeLine_49588e6f7bd5d947: How long since you saw her?
RD_ALifeLine_4238efff648f93bf: An hour ago, she let go of my hand at the gas station
RD_ALifeLine_0ae034b4784840ae: Walk me through where you were, we'll start there...
RD_ALifeLine_4b3d1e102d6a8707: My sister is in Louisville, do you know anything about the city?
RD_ALifeLine_074dde2f26cfdd60: I know the interstate's shut... I've heard the hospitals went first
RD_ALifeLine_6fe2410218d6b596: I'd rather not guess, ma'am, if she's smart she's somewhere high up with the door barred
RD_ALifeLine_4b8330c4632a5f16: What the hell is this?! Officer, please, there are monsters everywhere!
RD_ALifeLine_317a3aea0204d7cc: Ma'am, I know... I've seen them
RD_ALifeLine_0e25e3614aae1cb2: It got my mother... and my brother, right in front of me!
RD_ALifeLine_6c510f2670586c73: I'm sorry, come stand behind the cruiser while I figure out where we can send you
RD_ALifeLine_08dbbc261d4aca0c: They got my mother, she was on the porch and I was at the window...
RD_ALifeLine_37c6f91c662e5f10: Hollis Road, my brother is still in there with her, please, somebody has to go back...
RD_ALifeLine_76b2c817171771c0: I can't leave this post tonight... I'll put the address on the list, and that's the best I can do
RD_ALifeLine_0259e03d2a08d652: My neighbor won't come out of his house and he's been calling for help since last night
RD_ALifeLine_00ce4c9f2876b59e: He's got a bite on him, I think, I could hear it in his voice
RD_ALifeLine_646a842c7e6a1a90: Then he's gone, I'm sorry, we'll go by and do what needs doing, you stay here, don't watch...
RD_ALifeLine_18c6166975380689: Is your name Hale? You used to work the night shift?
RD_ALifeLine_49e21edd20104c3d: You gave me a ride home once when my car quit, I never thanked you
RD_ALifeLine_3cce4b9058658f9c: My father won't leave the house, he says he's lived there fifty years
RD_ALifeLine_1a106b40476da86d: Eighty-one, he keeps telling me to go on without him
RD_ALifeLine_5d0da9b0756c02b2: I'd be careful about arguing with him, leave a little water and a note, and come back for him when it's calm
RD_ALifeLine_5059dbe82d287fa4: I tried every payphone from here to the Dairy Bar, nothing but a busy tone
RD_ALifeLine_67ca299f1434136a: Lines went down Friday night, my own phone at the station was dead by midnight
RD_ALifeLine_1497f753054bdffb: Then how does anybody find out anything?
RD_ALifeLine_16c8e0775cbb33b9: They don't! That's what I keep running into
RD_ALifeLine_665e25c26379fe4c: Did you see what's at the post office? There's something in the lot, a lot of somethings
RD_ALifeLine_1771396d1ca05557: I saw it, we're staying clear of that end of the street
RD_ALifeLine_2e78d87a603de334: Go around it, and go slow, running makes them follow
RD_ALifeLine_549a06ef468d4a8d: Is there a plan for food? Anybody giving out portions?
RD_ALifeLine_53df888f03b085e2: The VFW hall has a rice sack and a few cases of peaches, we're keeping a list
RD_ALifeLine_0355fa8e005f848c: Names and head count, give them to the man at the door and he'll mark you
RD_ALifeLine_63ceefb718fb0df5: I want to report a man who shot at my truck, he did it twice
RD_ALifeLine_67863bc913aed5a7: Which direction was he shooting from?
RD_ALifeLine_52e50deb56efb51c: Okay, I'll make a note, I don't have anybody to send but I'll make a note
RD_ALifeLine_32c1bfad7a34b403: Your siren set them off, they came out of the trees when you turned it on
RD_ALifeLine_4e69718d43244785: Yeah, shut it off already, force of habit
RD_ALifeLine_5669c83a37f27bf3: A habit like that gets people killed
RD_ALifeLine_65641c8e4d01404f: You're right, nobody's going to hear it from me again
RD_ALifeLine_4616dae655eed3d6: Is it safe in our house or should we move?
RD_ALifeLine_788e17502728053a: I can't judge a house without checking it, think about a way out as well as keeping people out
RD_ALifeLine_28388c7873619ffc: Would pushing a dresser against the front help?
RD_ALifeLine_09602c3373cd217b: Maybe, but don't block your only escape. Work out which exits you can actually use
RD_ALifeLine_373fc1d445d4e9d4: Anything we should do different when we're out walking?
RD_ALifeLine_013089c029ffb465: Go in pairs, no more than four, a big crowd makes noise and a lone person makes a meal
RD_ALifeLine_6402089955c6e4ec: And if one of us gets hurt?
RD_ALifeLine_6a1c9ddb4b30b5b3: Then you stop and look, and you do not guess, look at the skin
RD_ALifeLine_6127b524695e0811: We borrowed a pickup from the lot at the feed store, the keys were in it
RD_ALifeLine_54846555179d1063: I left a note with my name on the windshield
RD_ALifeLine_252207831cab0085: Then I've got nothing to write up. Drive careful
RD_ALifeLine_1fc16442201f259e: Please take my son with you, he's nine and he's quiet, he won't be any trouble...
RD_ALifeLine_3e913aa327682053: I can't do that, we're headed toward the worst of it
RD_ALifeLine_39e20e2c705330af: Then where is he supposed to go?
RD_ALifeLine_34d8bcb15b1d71de: Where you go, keep him by you, that's the safest place he's got
RD_ALifeLine_73267a140d6a6c70: I just want to say thanks, you didn't have to stay
RD_ALifeLine_5c24a8651bc1054e: I noticed, I'm not planning on it
RD_ALifeLine_386ab10f006d3536: The bridge at the river, is it open? We want to get across to my wife's family
RD_ALifeLine_01030f0b49233785: It's closed! The Army put up wire and they've got vehicles parked across it
RD_ALifeLine_5998a007788df7f2: Tell your wife's family to come to you, because you won't be getting there
RD_ALifeLine_436f7a1f33752416: You hear that bell? It started this morning and hasn't stopped
RD_ALifeLine_3088e4b02c8996fc: I sent a man to see, he hasn't come back
RD_ALifeLine_22e461f94cf41578: My son went to the creek this morning to fish, he hasn't come back
RD_ALifeLine_6362d9da37cccdfd: Dogs sometimes find a way home, give it the night
RD_ALifeLine_78ba27c47da336b6: Officer, I want to report a robbery
RD_ALifeLine_72a14fc87ca19eb5: I'm afraid that's out of my jurisdiction
RD_ALifeLine_6074ce7866f9ed75: How do I know I can trust you? You could be anyone with a badge
RD_ALifeLine_390fb9451b66bc61: You can't know it, you can walk a few feet behind me and see what I do
RD_ALifeLine_7a0dac927bd00ca8: Then we're going the same direction, fall in
RD_ALifeLine_5362bed5561d67e2: Is the tap water safe? Mine ran brown this morning
RD_ALifeLine_242644427e891eee: I wouldn't drink from it, plant at the river was one of the first things that stopped
RD_ALifeLine_0b2915495747c986: Boil it twice if you have to use it, rain barrels are better
RD_ALifeLine_38587b5a04c75473: We've got four guns between us, where do you want us?
RD_ALifeLine_5fc2503d6147a951: I want you home, honestly, but if you won't go, then stay out of our line
RD_ALifeLine_25ae885b13f6b41c: We can watch the south road
RD_ALifeLine_53a95685548a3c6d: Fine, two of you at a time, and nobody shoots at a car before looking inside it
RD_ALifeLine_45101bb229816d3f: What the hell is this?! Officer, what is going on out here?
RD_ALifeLine_288022db38dee133: Ma'am, slow down, anybody in your group bitten?
RD_ALifeLine_3437771240ccde3f: No, no, nobody, we only just got out of the house
RD_ALifeLine_075411ef00953868: Then keep it that way, stay off the road and keep your doors locked
RD_ALifeLine_014374367f4acd4d: Is anyone coming? A real answer please, I won't get upset
RD_ALifeLine_0be7978c2f06d582: I haven't had a word from the state in days, as far as I know nobody is on the way
RD_ALifeLine_15d888b21d87bbee: I've said it a dozen times today, ma'am, it doesn't get easier to say
RD_ALifeLine_02e556542676cde3: Where's the sheriff? Somebody in charge has to know what this is
RD_ALifeLine_2ce219a478acc9b3: The sheriff's been gone since Saturday, I've got a radio that says nothing
RD_ALifeLine_2a278b5908b98ed7: No, sir, I don't, I wish I could tell you different
RD_ALifeLine_3ef6ae03661da3d5: Which way is clear? We came from Rosewood and the whole road was stopped cars
RD_ALifeLine_487f457c2a1a093c: I can't tell you a clear route, a familiar road isn't necessarily a safer one now
RD_ALifeLine_5d800d5f607820de: Then let's keep looking as we walk, I'm not promising a bridge or an open way through
RD_ALifeLine_6c080b7802778852: Are you the ones taking people's cars? A man said you took his!
RD_ALifeLine_59fc8d736385efda: That wasn't us! There are folks wearing old uniforms who are not working for me
RD_ALifeLine_6b05a5b168b373b7: How do I tell the difference?
RD_ALifeLine_29b7918b732d3e72: You can't, always, watch what they do, not what they wear
RD_ALifeLine_3e190d770066d32d: I heard you're going to bomb the whole county
RD_ALifeLine_6eb616bc4c6dea46: I've heard that too... nobody has told me it's true
RD_ALifeLine_0e1b8202539918ed: I wouldn't build a house on it, and I wouldn't ignore it, stay near a cellar
RD_ALifeLine_791ea7267200f3a6: We've got rifles, we can help you hold this street
RD_ALifeLine_7bef7d607342443c: We appreciate it, stay inside your house and let us do the job
RD_ALifeLine_677329c159d1fc75: I want fewer civilians in my line of fire, keep your family behind a locked door
RD_ALifeLine_2995b9765a5d79d2: Are you scared? You look so calm
RD_ALifeLine_21ca8d3775c05ab9: Yes, I look calm because that's the training
RD_ALifeLine_3e721c32669244cf: It is for them, you can be scared as long as you stay quiet about it
RD_ALifeLine_63ce85e058e4b15b: What should we do if it gets worse?
RD_ALifeLine_45945ca26ca49122: Keep a bag by the door with water and a first aid kit, and keep the lights off after dark
RD_ALifeLine_2314ef7338200aa6: They go toward light and noise, give them nothing to go toward
RD_ALifeLine_63d8d42b48be7f59: One of your men shot at us last night! Someone could have died!
RD_ALifeLine_5e01c429525b0b61: Eleven, we were at the barn
RD_ALifeLine_793ebf0e09b2c08d: I don't know who fired.. and I won't pretend I can order them to stop, I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_6f6a66a00e21c3a7: I haven't slept since Friday, I keep hearing it in the walls
RD_ALifeLine_7984771b6ff6c566: Scratching, footsteps, I don't know anymore...
RD_ALifeLine_486934cc2ba83df2: Take turns with someone, even an hour, the mind makes things up when it's tired...
RD_ALifeLine_6a25a18d46d786e8: Is there a medical station? We have a woman with a broken leg
RD_ALifeLine_5a28b1c52553d225: There's an aid tent behind the church, Corporal can walk you over
RD_ALifeLine_69a3b870365365b2: Just you, the rest of your group waits here with me
RD_ALifeLine_3d4213a86e15cc24: Should we board up the windows?
RD_ALifeLine_1a76a89a49151756: Yes, use plywood or furniture, leave a slit so you can see out
RD_ALifeLine_709f39834011c6c0: The upstairs bathroom has a lock, get everybody in there
RD_ALifeLine_7730d53f3b19ad49: Is it true there's a curfew at dark?
RD_ALifeLine_2e9a83f251c3af56: Yes, sir, anyone outside after dusk may be treated as a threat
RD_ALifeLine_3b062dd629078ab7: To everyone, including themselves, please be home by then
RD_ALifeLine_17f316b953333c55: They're not breathing... I put my ear right up against one and it wasn't breathing
RD_ALifeLine_0a5070fc28eddffc: That's consistent with what we've seen
RD_ALifeLine_5e953b8724c48467: I don't know, ma'am, and I'm trained to say so
RD_ALifeLine_1dd95a626a1d46d3: You've got a radio, does it work?
RD_ALifeLine_20899f433d2b5064: It works, there's just no one on the other end
RD_ALifeLine_19d75bcc67550ed0: Can we follow you? We'd feel better
RD_ALifeLine_3fcaa3a25fd67992: No, we'll be moving through places you can't survive
RD_ALifeLine_59f1468849157619: You sit, you eat what you have and you wait for the all-clear
RD_ALifeLine_4a82e87630cc38a1: Is that a body under the tarp?
RD_ALifeLine_1544b4ff728f0b61: Someone I know could be under there
RD_ALifeLine_7ab788f800c65dbf: Then you'll have to remember them the way they were
RD_ALifeLine_656c3f84756ad501: If we see Guard trucks should we go toward them?
RD_ALifeLine_7ffb19b73394f226: I wouldn't assume they're ours.. treat them like anyone else
RD_ALifeLine_4f2b41e27b1ea456: Which means don't wave and don't run toward them, let them pass
RD_ALifeLine_3887e9315ffc911c: Is there anything we can bring you? Food, coffee?
RD_ALifeLine_46ff3f2d2529af12: Don't promise food you might need yourself, thank you
RD_ALifeLine_4d6f02606298ddd8: A little room to think would be a good gift
RD_ALifeLine_48bd36485fefaff7: There's a house on the corner with the door wide open... no one inside
RD_ALifeLine_6aba60d858a149b5: Why are you wearing masks? Is it in the air?
RD_ALifeLine_7f86f04931bce0fa: Precaution, we don't know the vector yet
RD_ALifeLine_0ab69e950d818487: If you have a bandana, tie it on, it won't hurt and it might help
RD_ALifeLine_718c2556287dc411: What are the rules, exactly? So we don't break any by accident
RD_ALifeLine_67d8058e70170b7b: No fires, no lights, no gunfire without a target
RD_ALifeLine_2bd0893878062302: Then make it count, and don't miss
RD_ALifeLine_366f09194ac46ea4: We heard shooting all night from the south, was that you?
RD_ALifeLine_4a8c423c79f2b149: It was a team clearing the retail strip
RD_ALifeLine_4e74338b28fb4ca1: We got what we could, more will come toward the noise, so keep your own noise down
RD_ALifeLine_3df0bd69124fadfb: Please don't shoot, we're not infected!
RD_ALifeLine_056d69ed7191058a: Nobody's shooting, hands where I can see them, then turn around slowly
RD_ALifeLine_45ca0b625f8bb5bb: Are you going to check us?
RD_ALifeLine_656eb6942f82e0b5: Yes, it takes a minute, then you go back the way you came
RD_ALifeLine_6f0c187324b3ed41: Is it true you have to shoot them in the head?
RD_ALifeLine_4e90623a1322f03f: The head.. that's where I'd aim
RD_ALifeLine_74e48063009015d4: I didn't know that... I shot one three times
RD_ALifeLine_170b5b784abde6d7: I wouldn't count on another three doing it.. make each shot count
RD_ALifeLine_1ceb0d0c368cb44c: My kids think you're all heroes
RD_ALifeLine_299c357d257cc3f4: I'll tell them you said so
RD_ALifeLine_20c28ecc0e9bfa9c: Tell 'em sitting still and quiet is the brave bit, honest
RD_ALifeLine_5fd3ccae366665f3: How long until this is over?
RD_ALifeLine_67e709d53f34e9fa: I can't give you a number...
RD_ALifeLine_259010b1624813a3: I don't want to tell you a guess and have you plan around it
RD_ALifeLine_6c9ca3eb2357bdd3: I'll pray for you tonight, soldier
RD_ALifeLine_52c09fe21ef687d5: Thank you, ma'am, I'd appreciate that
RD_ALifeLine_55e2c3132b069bfe: My boy wants to say hello, he wants to be a soldier
RD_ALifeLine_5c906f877a962781: Hey there, buddy, you stick close to your daddy, you hear?
RD_ALifeLine_20b158db0c69cb09: Tell him he's welcome, tell him he's the bravest one on this street
RD_ALifeLine_53d581a26169f73e: My neighbor's girl got bit, she's eleven, what do I do?
RD_ALifeLine_762353ae5b7bb74b: An hour, she's hot to the touch
RD_ALifeLine_10855b731d768f16: Get away from her, ma'am, put a closed door between you, this is not something you should have to carry
RD_ALifeLine_00fa7fae1f2a33a9: One of my group has a fever, can you check her?
RD_ALifeLine_139e96ac43b90301: Bring her to the vehicle, nobody else
RD_ALifeLine_4bf55f2257057155: There are monsters everywhere! They're in the streets, in the yards, you have to help us!
RD_ALifeLine_706e662455fa890c: It got my mother... then my brother, he was holding the door and it just took him
RD_ALifeLine_7fda9bce08105ee3: I'm sorry for your loss, now go back inside and let us do our work
RD_ALifeLine_55fd6d8511369835: My brother was taken yesterday, down by the creek... I want to go look for him
RD_ALifeLine_2f2bbb8759befc13: I can't allow that, the creek area isn't secure
RD_ALifeLine_632247d01335d96c: He might still be alive out there...
RD_ALifeLine_415508475543fc34: Whatever is down there, it isn't something to walk into, I need you to stay put
RD_ALifeLine_3d8a9e004769c92e: My mother is still in the house with them, I heard her last night...
RD_ALifeLine_76bb8cb16426dfa6: She told me to go, so I went, please, I need to go back
RD_ALifeLine_09c1585873912f3e: I can't let you, and I'm sorry for it, she told you to go because she wanted you alive
RD_ALifeLine_14ce0932732ccc5a: We were going to drive out tonight, get to my aunt in Bardstown
RD_ALifeLine_52054250015f3e6f: You'll be turned around at the first checkpoint, or worse
RD_ALifeLine_256e180812ea8149: There's a shoot-on-sight order for vehicles that run the line, I'd rather you didn't test it
RD_ALifeLine_25e03d1e3cdc9aaa: There's a man at our door every night, he knocks twice, then waits
RD_ALifeLine_1e785108588dcabb: Especially then, do not open it
RD_ALifeLine_5da814ef3a59e673: You can't keep us here, this is America
RD_ALifeLine_28844c63353c0acb: Today it's a quarantine zone, I didn't write the order
RD_ALifeLine_3ac23fc87d1ec3fc: Someone with a bigger map than mine, I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_4a808d900a5cbbe3: Our block's all older people, we made a rule that nobody goes out alone
RD_ALifeLine_4aa7538c52644783: A good rule, who's the youngest among you?
RD_ALifeLine_2b4c477d1d68a912: Then you're the one they'll listen to, keep that rule and keep your people off the street at night
RD_ALifeLine_246de3ab6e3e0e6b: The radio said the county is under quarantine, are we trapped here?
RD_ALifeLine_35ac8833248e33ad: There's a quarantine order in force, no unauthorized movement past the river
RD_ALifeLine_5f7087b466c44506: What does that mean for people who live here?
RD_ALifeLine_109deb446f5f364c: It means you shelter where you are, that is the safest thing for you right now
RD_ALifeLine_32597b87316d0639: If you ever get through to anyone outside, will you tell them we're alive?
RD_ALifeLine_1c0cbf6d2965a62f: Give me the name and the town
RD_ALifeLine_59ec171749a46901: Ruth Calloway, Radcliff, I'll put it in the log tonight
RD_ALifeLine_0801387c66fcce68: If I try going home, how do I know it's safe?
RD_ALifeLine_4d469a4f43e17416: I can't give you an all clear, look before you commit, and be careful who you let in
RD_ALifeLine_25a788b574bf685b: A uniform doesn't tell you enough. Talk through the door first
RD_ALifeLine_670691a73eba8ad3: Soldier, we want to help, we can carry ammunition or watch a window
RD_ALifeLine_453a3d061d960d58: Appreciate it, sir, but stay in your house and let us handle it
RD_ALifeLine_0e05353e0236cc9f: What if they get into the house?
RD_ALifeLine_755fab8e55d45909: Then you fight in the hallway where only one can reach you at a time
RD_ALifeLine_67fb8dee3f5b3544: There's a man at the clinic with a rifle and a bag of pills, won't let anyone near
RD_ALifeLine_699df4b523c0a3d8: That one is ours to deal with, move away from the clinic and don't try to talk him down
RD_ALifeLine_5a84fa7b1af79180: Somebody has to tell us what this is, is it a disease? A gas?
RD_ALifeLine_1a16989a443e263a: I'm not cleared to say, ma'am, I can tell you what to do about it
RD_ALifeLine_78b4db5b0b651cfa: Stay away from the infected! And nobody bitten stays in your house, you hear?
RD_ALifeLine_34530748797a43ea: God, am I glad to see you, we figured nobody was left
RD_ALifeLine_2c185f3648907df0: We're not going anywhere, that's what we're here for
RD_ALifeLine_45fc45be69fa54c3: I do, haven't been able to call them, go on inside, ma'am, and look after yours
RD_ALifeLine_6077427b77b11a84: The north gate on the golf course is open, I thought you'd want to know
RD_ALifeLine_69d86a4c0d6861fb: Thank you, how many people use it?
RD_ALifeLine_5a84ea9541129587: A handful at night, mostly families
RD_ALifeLine_488cce3651228f51: It's getting dark, do you want us to go home now?
RD_ALifeLine_15b2d00a189b4533: Yes, be inside before the last light
RD_ALifeLine_7543522f5c1fd54a: We stay out, that's what we're for
RD_ALifeLine_4d8b92b719c5d757: Where's the safest direction to walk?
RD_ALifeLine_10d77ae839955761: Away from the highway... and if you see other troops, keep your hands visible
RD_ALifeLine_5ae3bf4c4f56f52e: There are units out here with orders I don't know, be polite and get out of their way
RD_ALifeLine_60d9c09718dd4ab5: Anything we should know about the trucks that came through last night?
RD_ALifeLine_196c6b9254b1fcf5: Stay clear of any unit that won't identify itself
RD_ALifeLine_2ab701ae0a60be02: They won't have our patches, and they won't answer your questions politely
RD_ALifeLine_3761f62169c95d7b: You took our truck last night, we needed it
RD_ALifeLine_50281ab8075d5632: It was requisitioned under the emergency order, a receipt was left on the seat
RD_ALifeLine_6788b19614d79ad1: Take it up with the Army when this is over, I mean that sincerely
RD_ALifeLine_5b9a1e6f11c62c60: There's a whole bunch of them in the pines behind our house, can't you do something?
RD_ALifeLine_47469b104eb8766a: That's for us to deal with, stay away from the tree line, and keep it quiet
RD_ALifeLine_369342936e4d66ed: What the hell is this?! Please, you have to help us, there's something wrong with everybody!
RD_ALifeLine_2e618af67b508efc: Sir, lower your voice, are you bitten or scratched?
RD_ALifeLine_0dd513613a40ad05: No, but it got my mother and my brother, they were right behind me!
RD_ALifeLine_54062f875fcb4b0e: I'm sorry.. I can't make this right by telling you to stay behind a line, just don't rush toward them
RD_ALifeLine_650e6fdc70429d99: A long way to be, my cousin lives in Oklahoma
RD_ALifeLine_792e6aec4e67e6dc: Then you know about the wind, we don't get much wind here
RD_ALifeLine_0e2d272f42b1991f: Where's the evacuation? They said on the TV there'd be buses
RD_ALifeLine_19d5ef6a11933038: I haven't seen any buses, ma'am, I'm not going to lie to you
RD_ALifeLine_787694e95f11d2b2: I think somebody believed it when they said it, that's not the same
RD_ALifeLine_40da138956092ec4: Who's in charge of you? I'd like a name
RD_ALifeLine_3f36e0dd2d728f9d: A lieutenant! I couldn't give it to you
RD_ALifeLine_52875ec90458714a: It's what I have! Go on home, ma'am!
RD_ALifeLine_202f868144da9436: My husband was in the Guard, he got called up on Saturday, do you know the unit?
RD_ALifeLine_0f8cd0751223eb00: I don't know where that unit is now, ma'am, I hope he's well
RD_ALifeLine_77d49ea93a585fc2: My wife was in Louisville, she went for the doctor Friday...
RD_ALifeLine_45e655ba37bb7226: I don't know what's happening there, sir
RD_ALifeLine_4d63715f4a9d73f6: I can't tell you whether the bridges are open or where she went, I'm sorry, sir
RD_ALifeLine_4f5d2e76386ae630: Do you need help stringing wire? I've done fencing all my life
RD_ALifeLine_478078bd02e27d01: I do, actually, we're short on hands
RD_ALifeLine_5a34e0f5262c8275: Then let me, I'd rather be useful than scared
RD_ALifeLine_2a4dfa296167e3fd: Come with us, then, stay behind the vehicle until I tell you
RD_ALifeLine_6089ef70019cba57: If somebody in your group gets hurt I could help.. I used to be a nurse's aide
RD_ALifeLine_2aec09926e5d3441: I don't want you getting hurt trying
RD_ALifeLine_28a7ceaf0f5668b7: I know what shock looks like.. I'd hate to just walk past
RD_ALifeLine_1be2d0974832dfe0: Then ask first.. don't run up to someone you don't know
RD_ALifeLine_2f030b4f61299c6a: You can't be more than twenty
RD_ALifeLine_36ba44096588658a: Does your mother know where you are?
RD_ALifeLine_69c97ecd1975c52f: She does not, I'd like to keep it that way
RD_ALifeLine_5b0a2a1a1f6f05dc: Somebody once asked me for insulin for their father, I didn't know what to say
RD_ALifeLine_4ed656fc4edfa5d6: Were you able to find somebody qualified to help?
RD_ALifeLine_7b68fc9c6a7ac0dd: I tried, couldn't promise the medicine or tell them to change a prescribed dose
RD_ALifeLine_1a70f90014fcd064: I'd rather hear that than a promise you couldn't keep. Desperate people will plan around one
RD_ALifeLine_101e83b639bfc1ff: I left a man in the road, he was still moving, I couldn't help him
RD_ALifeLine_6d66cfc14000c952: I think so... I didn't look
RD_ALifeLine_5d325bb56e60f184: Then you did the only thing you could, it doesn't feel like that now, I know
RD_ALifeLine_74315c1001776d06: I'm allergic to bee stings, I'm carrying around a pen, but it's expired
RD_ALifeLine_6bdd9fd177a62513: Better than nothing, keep it close and don't go near a hive
RD_ALifeLine_2569a692082b61f3: I once had a mother beg me to help her bitten daughter. Five years old
RD_ALifeLine_5b63f63857f7701a: Nothing certain, she kept describing the child's calf, asking if being warm meant anything
RD_ALifeLine_73c0e6a740f1eed4: You don't forget a question you couldn't answer, I hope you didn't have to face her alone
RD_ALifeLine_329b3abe19cad19d: I burned my hands pulling a pan from the stove, it's fine
RD_ALifeLine_55d8cb731dc6f358: Let me see, that's a second-degree burn, it's not fine
RD_ALifeLine_320a3cdc5e814914: Cool it with water and I'll wrap it, you'll thank me tomorrow
RD_ALifeLine_6ad2d3485fe5e783: Can you look at my arm? I scraped it on a fence, I don't think it was them
RD_ALifeLine_4adb14456c58ac8c: Come here, push the sleeve up
RD_ALifeLine_660543b41b96a63c: It's a fence scrape, wire cut, clean edges, nothing in it, you're all right
RD_ALifeLine_2d42bcaa534ade1b: The church bell was ringing all night, nobody was in the tower
RD_ALifeLine_37f007c661faa1d9: We checked! It was just... swinging
RD_ALifeLine_3360898c01286247: I won't claim to know, stay off the street by the church until dawn
RD_ALifeLine_79453fc73bec24a9: Is there any shelter nearby? We have two elders and a baby
RD_ALifeLine_33048cc14e6d1cc9: The brick church on the hill still has doors that lock, there's soup, there's a stove
RD_ALifeLine_7382db9223d0aecb: Follow the road, stay off the grass, bring the baby's blanket for the cold
RD_ALifeLine_69a5da065db43479: Where's the rest of your crew?
RD_ALifeLine_6e4040c30ca25b33: Three of us left from nine
RD_ALifeLine_4297e3cc0d9eab7c: It happened fast, we lost two on the first call and the others on the second
RD_ALifeLine_0d9b1183629a1754: I'm sorry to bother you, there's a dead dog in my road and I don't know what to do
RD_ALifeLine_38da08d451c23af2: Then cover it with a sheet, it's a small mercy and nobody will think less of you
RD_ALifeLine_22c39bbc7d11cbad: I gave blood last month, they gave me a cookie, this is what the cookie was for
RD_ALifeLine_0c3c68a36dfdcfc2: Find me one and I'll split it with you
RD_ALifeLine_3578b83162afc4e5: There's a man lying in our yard who isn't moving, should I check him?
RD_ALifeLine_5d1f5bf634bbc948: Don't, don't touch him and don't kneel near his head
RD_ALifeLine_30d48e6a47acd664: They often do, leave him and stay up by the house
RD_ALifeLine_0b0d821c4899dd0d: Do these masks work? We found a box at the hardware store
RD_ALifeLine_6dc89e884a717376: Against dust, yes, against whatever this is, I don't know
RD_ALifeLine_15052e9d587f334b: They don't hurt, wear them if you're going near the bodies
RD_ALifeLine_0d55cca5543722c9: How do I know if somebody is going to turn? Is there a sign?
RD_ALifeLine_3d7ec08a019f07e4: Fever that climbs fast, then shivering, then they go glassy
RD_ALifeLine_3bdc4ca7342be629: And then you need to be out of the room, don't wait to find out how long
RD_ALifeLine_7ea3f82b6df66541: The whole east side of town is burning, is anyone putting it out?
RD_ALifeLine_17b7be903619c9be: We're trying, water pressure is nearly gone
RD_ALifeLine_6516d97d4f12e199: Is it going to reach us?
RD_ALifeLine_35a5d16747c074c4: Not tonight, and I'd rather not guess past tonight
RD_ALifeLine_280c9b4133a8f451: I took the Red Cross course last spring, can I help you?
RD_ALifeLine_1115d7e622768304: That's a hundred percent more than most, walk with me
RD_ALifeLine_0ebd49f85dede30f: How many people have you actually been able to save?
RD_ALifeLine_7ca2a7123aa0a01d: It's the only one I can give, sorry
RD_ALifeLine_4ede58a650cb3f40: You look exhausted, have you slept?
RD_ALifeLine_5f062df21b452e4a: Can I get you something? Bread, a cup of tea?
RD_ALifeLine_2e30833147f1bce3: Tea would be a kindness, thank you
RD_ALifeLine_329f969036ae0479: I remember trying to find supplies for children at the grange.. about a dozen of them
RD_ALifeLine_4d60fb3c20b96a3a: Crackers.. somebody had crackers. Felt like they'd handed me a whole meal
RD_ALifeLine_04fbc25d55a32fca: You remember who shared when there wasn't much to share
RD_ALifeLine_40a1847c09458b47: I'm looking for my sister, thirty-four, blond, nurse at the county hospital...
RD_ALifeLine_44b7275d6f5be3df: Did she have a name tag?
RD_ALifeLine_0eb8ae74086a6e08: I haven't treated a Tammy, I'll ask the crew when they're back, check the church board...
RD_ALifeLine_3e778d191ffbdddb: I lost my baby in the evacuation, I put her down for one second
RD_ALifeLine_6c8fc66f362dadc2: At the Gulf station, there was a crowd, I was pushed
RD_ALifeLine_1a50934811e24bd0: Sit down here for a moment, tell me what she was wearing...
RD_ALifeLine_6e5158004d662802: They got my mother... and my brother, I couldn't pull either of them out
RD_ALifeLine_614167a43f4f2eff: I'm sorry... I can hear how heavy that is
RD_ALifeLine_7c27c4a9701f7a48: What do I do with it?
RD_ALifeLine_3780832f7b57a5f0: You carry it a day at a time, you don't have to decide anything today...
RD_ALifeLine_5638e13c7057cafc: My wife has a cough and a fever, she wasn't bitten! She wasn't!
RD_ALifeLine_51d036b935d5df97: I believe you! Sit with me a second, is she breathing fast?
RD_ALifeLine_110674443aa6f8af: Sounds like the ordinary kind, fluids and rest... I'll walk back with you and take a look
RD_ALifeLine_336bbf876802a8eb: What would you tell somebody asking for blood for their husband?
RD_ALifeLine_4cacaa191351a20b: That it takes proper supplies and people who know what they're doing
RD_ALifeLine_2b79464d3980ff27: I wouldn't pretend we could improvise a transfusion, I'd try to get qualified help
RD_ALifeLine_043ed59716fbdcf0: We were going to try the hospital in town, is it worth it?
RD_ALifeLine_4f9909da5bcd79ba: I wouldn't, the ground floor is full
RD_ALifeLine_05a316e54556a5d7: Full of the other thing, don't go in
RD_ALifeLine_5bd758f3759b12c4: Our pastor is gone, all we found were his shoes...
RD_ALifeLine_3100e63c4461148d: I'm sorry, did anyone see which way?
RD_ALifeLine_0cf482327386c67c: No, just the shoes, in the road
RD_ALifeLine_649d21216615e22b: Sometimes people leave them behind to move faster, keep that thought if it helps...
RD_ALifeLine_609e81603ae0eb45: I don't know if I believe anymore, would you pray with me?
RD_ALifeLine_6cfa964d744265a1: I'd be glad to, I'm not sure I believe either, some mornings
RD_ALifeLine_7bfa38490183bce9: Then we're in good company, bow your head
RD_ALifeLine_31558fab1b9e2b8d: We heard there's a quarantine tent at the high school, should we go?
RD_ALifeLine_374661db263bf409: That tent is for people showing symptoms, and there's no coming out once you're in
RD_ALifeLine_65d9522c228b236d: It's a hard rule, whether it's right, I couldn't tell you, stay out unless you must
RD_ALifeLine_6b0df42c1ea2c29e: Do you know any houses that are still safe?
RD_ALifeLine_637317023b78376b: I can't promise you a safe house or somebody else's spare room
RD_ALifeLine_6aa76ef767b60389: You'd have to ask them. Saying I sent you wouldn't make them responsible for you
RD_ALifeLine_78fad21606341c63: I'm sorry, I'm scared of anyone in a uniform right now
RD_ALifeLine_332bae3620fa6da0: You're allowed, I'd think less of you if you weren't careful
RD_ALifeLine_1a9238c22af3bfc8: How do I know you're not infected?
RD_ALifeLine_05ea615e2a60ae85: Look at my eyes, check my hands, anything wrong, I'll be the one telling you to run
RD_ALifeLine_2f0024d337bcb5a7: My son keeps coughing from the smoke, is it dangerous?
RD_ALifeLine_30cac381388bca82: Open air, sit him upright, small sips of water
RD_ALifeLine_3f33ffee220e7ba4: A day, if it gets worse, or his lips look blue, come find us
RD_ALifeLine_73f7fdd57e81b070: I can't stop shaking, is that normal?
RD_ALifeLine_3367a86735a78f9f: Entirely, sit down, put your head between your knees, breathe slowly
RD_ALifeLine_74370806120cedd5: You're not, I did the same on Saturday
RD_ALifeLine_52ed01953b51ac37: We have two cases of bottled water, could we trade for some bandages?
RD_ALifeLine_3b2890ec5a3a6e76: Gladly, take what you need, I'll take what you can spare
RD_ALifeLine_3c3b26725858135d: It's what's left of fair, anyway
RD_ALifeLine_1a7abc570e1ce127: Should we sound the siren to warn people?
RD_ALifeLine_79c5d9d36b43d827: Absolutely not, it will bring every one of them down the road
RD_ALifeLine_75eaf2375dc1fff2: Then how do we warn them?
RD_ALifeLine_15e960c53bbd7a07: Door to door, quietly, in daylight
RD_ALifeLine_02e391fb2bb26ce3: Is the water from the tap safe?
RD_ALifeLine_7e959613269327c9: No, we stopped drinking it two days ago
RD_ALifeLine_28faeeb67e509a50: Rain if you can catch it, and boil whatever you find, don't trust a clear stream
RD_ALifeLine_1fdaaa670bcea886: Can you take my brother? He's got a broken ankle and can't walk
RD_ALifeLine_11e403da39940455: We have a stretcher, which house?
RD_ALifeLine_6685b3ab48367329: Two streets down, past the water tower
RD_ALifeLine_654609a6762f7217: Lead the way, stay where I can see you
RD_ALifeLine_132039594357d278: What is happening to people? One minute my neighbor was fine and the next he was biting his wife!
RD_ALifeLine_31b2230a7dcd78b8: I've seen it eleven times since Friday... I don't have a name for it
RD_ALifeLine_7a8718a1659adc4c: It acts like one, fever first, then it takes them all at once
RD_ALifeLine_0960e32673c6c23f: If we leave, what should we take?
RD_ALifeLine_68b424ea03e3fe13: Water mostly.. bandages something you can eat without cooking
RD_ALifeLine_4081407e3968e261: Whatever you've got, but don't let that be the only thing you pack
RD_ALifeLine_68a424e942f51701: I still hear that baby crying from the shelter
RD_ALifeLine_0716b6be71de10ef: Her mother kept saying she was hungry
RD_ALifeLine_47d30bff675348cf: I wish I'd known what to offer. Milk powder isn't something you just guess at
RD_ALifeLine_262e6d14728bd79b: I didn't even ask the mother's name
RD_ALifeLine_4cd62cde399e41ae: Something doesn't feel right about the house across the road
RD_ALifeLine_637148c574e8ed1f: Then we don't stop there, we keep walking
RD_ALifeLine_51691d793babad1c: There's an old tobacco barn on the ridge, we've been sleeping there
RD_ALifeLine_3f41af8752ac924f: Is it high enough to see them coming?
RD_ALifeLine_3e1f764a3efaa521: You can see the entire valley, we keep a lantern low
RD_ALifeLine_44abccda6f05ed9f: Good, can we stay a night?
RD_ALifeLine_7938604172528cf8: What would you read if you could find a book?
RD_ALifeLine_0837980b7e3b992f: There was a joke in one that I never did get
RD_ALifeLine_3512c3a5008d5bf6: Did you hear what happened on the Ohio River bridge?
RD_ALifeLine_73f7031f37b6d8fb: They shot at the cars, everyone trying to get out, people on the road with their hands up
RD_ALifeLine_3894acaa2d5a7f33: I don't believe that, I won't
RD_ALifeLine_575aee8654a4763b: I have a can of peaches and no can opener
RD_ALifeLine_1d5b999b440ac846: Funny... I got a can opener and no peaches
RD_ALifeLine_350461b35242b83b: I keep thinking I'll see my mom come around that corner
RD_ALifeLine_0f52881c51f1e866: I keep thinking the same about my dad
RD_ALifeLine_4de4b3ee217b5e31: Not yet... but it's easier when there's someone nearby
RD_ALifeLine_55a201d576684683: Our dog wouldn't stop barking that first night, I thought I'd go mad
RD_ALifeLine_7c4c470d7f44bbf7: Mine used to bark at anything that moved
RD_ALifeLine_4cb24de716c49084: I kept thinking it would bring them
RD_ALifeLine_107c409c5355a8b8: And I kept yelling his name. Like that was helping anybody
RD_ALifeLine_324db8744246b123: Don't, a guy came through yesterday from there, his eyes were wrong
RD_ALifeLine_6e6b946347b85c43: He said the city's lights are all out, he said he walked through the middle of it and nobody said a word
RD_ALifeLine_4398fdc4178175bc: Do you know anything about engines? Ours made a noise and stopped
RD_ALifeLine_351c58852b7158c3: We'd be grateful, we can travel together if it runs
RD_ALifeLine_4a679fdc0b87b0d5: Let's see what it is first
RD_ALifeLine_7469c50b7ac18e59: Do you know how to use this? I found it in a truck
RD_ALifeLine_33021fc62a3c906c: Let me see, it's a revolver, hold it flat, don't wave it
RD_ALifeLine_707b97c132ed2433: Five rounds, treat it like it's always loaded
RD_ALifeLine_494925dc4dd86ec4: We buried my grandmother in the backyard last night
RD_ALifeLine_3b658e9923be1ced: I said the Lord's Prayer, I couldn't remember the second half...
RD_ALifeLine_0b97e1f90f794ad4: There's a pump at the farm on Dixie Highway with gas still in the tank, needs a hand crank
RD_ALifeLine_0fa7ae166ac69934: I filled up there last night
RD_ALifeLine_781ce02c3fce85d8: Thanks, I'll be careful on the approach
RD_ALifeLine_12026aa03ec47e53: No, I thought it was you
RD_ALifeLine_41298ffa1d814ee5: Then someone else is out there
RD_ALifeLine_4e1460fe3bac2be9: Let's get inside before we find out who
RD_ALifeLine_31ce4a3551ad7b07: Put that lantern out, they come to light
RD_ALifeLine_2291d9c321e63058: Use a candle behind a blanket if you must
RD_ALifeLine_069f60422363abbb: People say the hospital in Brandenburg took everybody
RD_ALifeLine_59fa22633f0fd732: And then the lights went out
RD_ALifeLine_3ecda96538625d88: Then nobody's coming back out of there
RD_ALifeLine_368052b56144924b: Could be worse, could be a dozen of them in the trunk of the car
RD_ALifeLine_13ae4efc0e79b840: Don't make me check the trunk
RD_ALifeLine_48c058227e746c1e: It's been a very strange week
RD_ALifeLine_1221c7ee50273ca8: We should get going before dark
RD_ALifeLine_545ba2fd74809fed: I'll watch the right side if you watch the left
RD_ALifeLine_37f3c02e7f6c4f8f: I was out getting medicine when it started, when I came back she wasn't home
RD_ALifeLine_157d02276c6eecba: Everywhere, her car's still in the drive
RD_ALifeLine_5bffba070bb51414: Maybe she walked to her sister's... I'd believe that if I were you...
RD_ALifeLine_3dc77c791c1857bb: They said on the radio the whole county's sealed
RD_ALifeLine_7ff7c71d1967380d: Sealed how? There's a hundred roads
RD_ALifeLine_092719a9781b40cd: The Army's got them all, even the farm tracks
RD_ALifeLine_5c1f9ea81edc8e8f: If we find food, don't tell everybody we can share it before we know how much
RD_ALifeLine_508a585f31b769bc: I know, I just hate having to say no
RD_ALifeLine_3fc309cf69d35626: Then we'll be honest. Better than making somebody count on us
RD_ALifeLine_2175538d1e665964: I keep waiting for someone in charge to show up
RD_ALifeLine_3d843f0a5615fe78: Moved my family out of the house and onto the hill
RD_ALifeLine_0f1e0eb501a4717f: An old man on Walnut Street still waters his tomatoes every evening
RD_ALifeLine_15b21ab1763f87af: Sits on the porch with a rifle and a hose, waved at me
RD_ALifeLine_60494fb80ebf26a2: I hope he's all right, I hope there's still tomatoes
RD_ALifeLine_59b8ec551416842c: The pharmacy on Main has been picked clean
RD_ALifeLine_6e0251bb7b0540f4: A box of bandages and a coloring book
RD_ALifeLine_63b87f0517165456: There's a pickup full of canned goods behind the church, nobody around
RD_ALifeLine_50d08b431dfde528: I thought so too, we watched it two days
RD_ALifeLine_3de659b4331dad41: Then I'll help you load it
RD_ALifeLine_23674dda7705341b: Mind if I say a prayer before we go on?
RD_ALifeLine_4cea74902abdaa4b: Lord, watch over everyone we couldn't, amen
RD_ALifeLine_1043a79403bf3639: There's a woman on the shortwave who reads bedtime stories every night at nine
RD_ALifeLine_166b80fc1d83521d: Whoever's listening, she says it's for the kids
RD_ALifeLine_12101c5958185a50: I'll tune in tonight, I could use a bedtime story
RD_ALifeLine_1557711678a00b45: You hear the helicopters last night?
RD_ALifeLine_3723772865b8f663: Every one of them, they flew low over the water tower
RD_ALifeLine_7482f204792e3c7a: I think they're looking for whatever they can't find
RD_ALifeLine_28a7088311e2daa9: Whisper, there's a pack at the end of the street
RD_ALifeLine_68fb5114572328ce: Six or seven, they're standing there like they forgot what they were doing
RD_ALifeLine_647c991f2aebcb7a: Move slow, don't look at them, they notice eyes
RD_ALifeLine_1e09bc1e45b22b00: You wouldn't happen to have a spare pair of socks?
RD_ALifeLine_6f6c150509e00b73: Mine are soaked through, it's been three days
RD_ALifeLine_567006a058868fb0: Here, feet matter more than anything right now
RD_ALifeLine_7d3e21894192d973: Safe, somewhere, I've got to believe that
RD_ALifeLine_4562c55579dddd08: Did you see the crowd by the school?
RD_ALifeLine_5fc9bc300adf8036: Hundreds, all turned the same direction
RD_ALifeLine_39eca54f778df146: Toward the bell! Someone must have rung it
RD_ALifeLine_1b57ca0325eb2833: Do you have any D batteries? Our flashlight died
RD_ALifeLine_29b28597333402f1: I have four, what've you got?
RD_ALifeLine_1d2500d841fff337: A can of green beans and a jar of peanut butter
RD_ALifeLine_558f8d2119a8a03b: Deal, the peanut butter is the real treasure
RD_ALifeLine_7f4fe2df76a73d78: The AM station comes back around dusk, a man reads names
RD_ALifeLine_145f154e6448ae93: People who've been found, it's short, but it's something
RD_ALifeLine_3030c8d77ff051d7: Same, it would be safer in numbers
RD_ALifeLine_6257ec4e14778b3b: I think you lived two doors down from my sister
RD_ALifeLine_4958710e5e5a31ee: She talked about you, said you had the best roses
RD_ALifeLine_2e543f5531c5e2fb: The roses, Lord, I forgot about the roses...
RD_ALifeLine_6a6eef850fbc028b: Rosewood, the whole street was moving, and I don't mean people
RD_ALifeLine_407d984b28969d40: Dragging, slow, but there were so many of them
RD_ALifeLine_4aad9eb929eaf1dd: Does this thing have a name yet?
RD_ALifeLine_052cc3ac421a5c72: My uncle calls them zombies, my neighbor says the sick ones
RD_ALifeLine_71f865b95112cbf0: Anything that gets me out of saying what they used to be
RD_ALifeLine_143be79c2be0fce9: Mine's Cal, good to meet you, Darlene
RD_ALifeLine_394ff1d90d472c17: Likewise, I wasn't going to remember it otherwise
RD_ALifeLine_06d4c1565e306414: Is this the way to Ekron?
RD_ALifeLine_69965b350be8ff91: No, you're about nine miles off
RD_ALifeLine_4f94c8e249602462: The signs got moved, somebody wanted to confuse people
RD_ALifeLine_5d685fc71e5c8db5: Oh thank God, another person, are you bitten?
RD_ALifeLine_7b144ffb5527356f: No, I wasn't sure anyone else was left
RD_ALifeLine_140dc9752456f45f: I met a family at the creek this morning, so there's a few of us
RD_ALifeLine_29d2749e7baac551: Some kid back there called them zombies
RD_ALifeLine_575248e3590134b2: Kids tend to be, I wish I could be sure of anything
RD_ALifeLine_6c9c25fc02d9db80: Everyone roll up your sleeves, bite check
RD_ALifeLine_7703eb464a685077: It is, it's for your safety
RD_ALifeLine_07a8e83e7cd5448d: Whose fault is this? Somebody did this!
RD_ALifeLine_4f2ff19e76d3d122: Ma'am, I don't have that answer
RD_ALifeLine_127c1a4932814180: And when I know, I'll tell you, right now I know nothing
RD_ALifeLine_441e086a3a9d4aa9: Did you see the smoke? The whole neighborhood is burning!
RD_ALifeLine_489fc7f1453d6bf3: The fire department was hit hard... nobody to put it out
RD_ALifeLine_76b2725526fc4b80: We started some of those fires to deny them cover
RD_ALifeLine_441696a86c59853e: I'll want that in writing, Sergeant
RD_ALifeLine_47df34300d6d044d: If another checkpoint turns us back, how do we get through to my sister?
RD_ALifeLine_309dc6531ecc3306: Don't try to push through an armed line, ma'am
RD_ALifeLine_4391db710076591b: Sergeant, they ought to be able to ask somebody
RD_ALifeLine_74a75e3925a8edc8: Ask, yes, I can't promise anyone else's answer, Deputy
RD_ALifeLine_53b6fd924ca43c18: I'd try to explain who they are
RD_ALifeLine_729535eb45287ad1: Then explain, don't hand them a guarantee you can't keep
RD_ALifeLine_73f2881c767eca02: You boys want coffee? It's strong enough to strip paint
RD_ALifeLine_39eb6edf113f099d: Sergeant, it's coffee, not a bribe
RD_ALifeLine_2e0174ea35fba9bf: That's what I like to hear
RD_ALifeLine_2c25375b43abfb55: Ma'am, we can take you as far as the church
RD_ALifeLine_6afaa1564f41ddca: Space for two in the vehicle
RD_ALifeLine_5f88d895707cf99c: Then two ride and two walk behind us
RD_ALifeLine_762a9a5e612a26b4: I saw a soldier lying by a creek once. Young, maybe nineteen
RD_ALifeLine_7cd9037d233602de: Were you able to help him?
RD_ALifeLine_2b1fa1a2387f5831: We tried, couldn't even find out his name
RD_ALifeLine_1c41177651a887df: That's a hard thing to carry
RD_ALifeLine_323eb2e86437a514: I still wonder if he was one of yours
RD_ALifeLine_213c38334430e416: Somebody's, anyway. That's enough reason to remember him
RD_ALifeLine_58a1516f09574076: My husband was Army, he's missing, do you know of any units around Fort Knox?
RD_ALifeLine_0857065850676ff2: I don't recognize it, but I'll ask my captain
RD_ALifeLine_7d88f55172f41a1e: I'll take down his description in case he turns up on our side
RD_ALifeLine_6c28e2f37bbad7a2: Can we come with you? You seem to know what you're doing
RD_ALifeLine_5ac0ded91324cce2: No.. I can't promise you'll be safer with us
RD_ALifeLine_10b1fb44745248de: Don't follow somebody just because they look certain
RD_ALifeLine_7e961e274cf49746: Then we'd better talk about what you need.. not send you toward a place we haven't checked
RD_ALifeLine_51f648ef6d525666: I can't give you a safe route.. I wish I could
RD_ALifeLine_2d4741b600b8db44: That's my neighbor! He's still in there! Don't shoot!
RD_ALifeLine_6c670f6621004a0f: Let me talk to him first...
RD_ALifeLine_389f4d8e67b97386: I knew him thirty years, give me one minute
RD_ALifeLine_0d54470f128ed350: If we got a generator working for a church shelter, how would we keep it fueled?
RD_ALifeLine_678c00df27a41d54: We'd have to find out who actually had fuel
RD_ALifeLine_01be3a0e15efca5c: And how much they could spare, I couldn't authorize ten gallons out of somebody else's drum
RD_ALifeLine_09d1053c41c40016: I wouldn't want thanks for fuel we hadn't found
RD_ALifeLine_5fd7dbcf4e5a7d1f: Especially if somebody was counting on it for medical equipment
RD_ALifeLine_5de7ae336f636197: Check the supply before making the promise, then work out the trip
RD_ALifeLine_5f232b6702cf20fd: Was that you shooting east of town?
RD_ALifeLine_35c967662a3a57a7: It sounded like a lot of guns!
RD_ALifeLine_2d30d9ad6829260d: Everybody get low, let me radio it in
RD_ALifeLine_55f9bf5f2cb7fb77: There's no channel to radio, Deputy
RD_ALifeLine_60b3e1f0751426cf: Weapons ready! Nobody fires without a target
RD_ALifeLine_605c15a32562f5e9: Then they'll answer when I call
RD_ALifeLine_257898e97561bd27: And if not, we'll know soon enough
RD_ALifeLine_27a0bb666d4bc0a7: Would you all mind if I said a prayer for us?
RD_ALifeLine_4cc16c6d6d830d11: Dear Lord, keep these men safe, and us with them, forgive the rest
RD_ALifeLine_0bc839c77beffd1c: I remember a woman looking for her son. Eleven, red shirt
RD_ALifeLine_71737f5b145fbc62: Where had she last seen him?
RD_ALifeLine_1a3a1f243123cc73: A park, they were running and she lost his hand
RD_ALifeLine_532544222295611d: Not finding him there wouldn't tell you what happened
RD_ALifeLine_5dd7080e2c3ff20e: No. That's why she kept asking everyone
RD_ALifeLine_48acd4e528c94159: Eleven, red shirt, some descriptions stay with you
RD_ALifeLine_48638a8a79dadd64: My friend was bitten on the hand, is there a doctor?
RD_ALifeLine_28b20a2013db08b7: I'll radio the school, we'll bring him in
RD_ALifeLine_48282e462bce1525: We escort him, he doesn't walk alone
RD_ALifeLine_6af6ea494c6b6fdd: Pass the word, curfew at dusk
RD_ALifeLine_0633cb6b205bdcea: Anyone caught outside after dark is a target
RD_ALifeLine_0e06918c1adc599b: We seem to be getting along
RD_ALifeLine_7dc465ab5ba85cc8: This is a temporary alignment of interests
RD_ALifeLine_677f882b25f3d1ce: That's a very Army way to say friends
RD_ALifeLine_5f60b29e75365ae6: Is it true the Army's closing the county?
RD_ALifeLine_3a94f1624ea673a2: There is a quarantine order, ma'am
RD_ALifeLine_1877f6904cdbb18d: It came through yesterday, we weren't consulted
RD_ALifeLine_6e52b1f86da70b72: It's a federal matter, please stay within the county line
RD_ALifeLine_51b33c2c073ef117: What about the people who got caught outside it?
RD_ALifeLine_5f199e987b75ee40: We've had no word on them
RD_ALifeLine_0cdbaf492e7cb725: They said on the radio there'd be an evacuation at the high school
RD_ALifeLine_460941087d01db38: I heard that too, there are no buses
RD_ALifeLine_78e93bb643b604d0: I can confirm there is no evacuation scheduled
RD_ALifeLine_66e051213e307ba3: Then why did they say it?
RD_ALifeLine_534463d12dccdeab: If I ever get a pot of stew going again, would you boys sit down to it?
RD_ALifeLine_6c4bc76e36133af7: I'd be grateful, I miss a proper hot meal
RD_ALifeLine_72a3308421966e09: Make room for the deputies before you worry about me
RD_ALifeLine_2c03e95c7ff7eb86: Don't be silly, there'd be room for you too
RD_ALifeLine_52f2efda6fb6ca76: One bowl, if I could spare the time
RD_ALifeLine_6b42e94e4d00a161: Hear that? We've got him planning supper already
RD_ALifeLine_2536e30f777b9660: Let's divide the street, I'll take the east side
RD_ALifeLine_01b7587d258db827: You'll be safest in the middle
RD_ALifeLine_39421b1d532de857: We were going to go through town to find my mother's pills
RD_ALifeLine_7069c687017c65de: Don't go in assuming the way is clear
RD_ALifeLine_29c61b4109d39d60: And don't count on a uniform getting you through
RD_ALifeLine_0d1f79c85960601d: I'd look for a pharmacy before trying the middle of town, but I can't tell you one is open
RD_ALifeLine_07a423710302ef88: Find out what you can before you commit to the trip
RD_ALifeLine_1ab9198f2ae5a61d: It's getting dark, what do we do?
RD_ALifeLine_31b26f0b3ac9b511: Everyone inside before the streetlights come on
RD_ALifeLine_19f825687fa1644c: No lights, no fire, no noise
RD_ALifeLine_67e121ba409a3580: How long do we have to live like this?
RD_ALifeLine_1ea6effe3b92d013: Just through the night, we'll reassess in the morning
RD_ALifeLine_365f92a3041332ae: I shot one in the chest and it kept coming!
RD_ALifeLine_452407a25ba00bd9: Aim for the head, every time
RD_ALifeLine_3f4728a3704d0bbc: He's right, I wasted a lot of rounds learning it
RD_ALifeLine_6bf01f5a158a872a: Pass it on to everyone you meet
RD_ALifeLine_6f03516714d4d20b: I know the back roads, I can lead you to the pump station
RD_ALifeLine_25dea4110e148c90: Two miles, tree cover most of the way
RD_ALifeLine_405824ad4fbbcdf2: I'll ride along, Sergeant, can you spare a driver?
RD_ALifeLine_4b7aad6a657dabe9: Are you going to help us or not?
RD_ALifeLine_2c726cf37a67fb88: Our mission is to contain the outbreak
RD_ALifeLine_6fa48d143ed88478: She's asking if you'll protect us!
RD_ALifeLine_564170e3526289f6: What the hell is this?! Somebody tell me what's going on!
RD_ALifeLine_516379db1ba7ea03: Folks, we're trying to find that out ourselves
RD_ALifeLine_4459bc6839c770ba: Everyone stays calm, who's in charge here?
RD_ALifeLine_4e3c1a8e3a7f4d1d: I'm the closest thing, county deputy
RD_ALifeLine_5694629443060dac: Deputy, I need your civilians behind my vehicle line
RD_ALifeLine_07c6f24241989648: They got my mother, please, they got my brother too
RD_ALifeLine_4ee7438d5b210268: Come with me, ma'am, walk slow
RD_ALifeLine_10f8b61b75c0e1b2: We're going to clear the barn
RD_ALifeLine_136f0d4735ab46f1: Please don't fight about it, just do it
RD_ALifeLine_12c43e1b3d3c1447: Who do I listen to, the badge or the uniform?
RD_ALifeLine_69a095f34213f9ae: In this area my orders take priority, Deputy
RD_ALifeLine_16870de3336765c0: Then say it to her face, Sergeant
RD_ALifeLine_7c3fa4294efedde1: Ma'am, stay inside and let us handle it
RD_ALifeLine_04779095108b7465: And if I don't have a roof anymore?
RD_ALifeLine_0fc2f33d6be825f0: Then the deputy will find you one
RD_ALifeLine_11a996950985feaf: You people shot at my brother's car!
RD_ALifeLine_3e221fe42a68379e: The blue Ford at the overpass!
RD_ALifeLine_7cf1b23c0b551602: Sergeant, the Walsh boy drove a blue Ford
RD_ALifeLine_4d0f659138a226bb: ... A sentry may have fired a warning, I'll look into it
RD_ALifeLine_0a140d8a51d97813: A warning? He's in the hospital
RD_ALifeLine_176eebfd6467a13a: I hate the thought of somebody helping themselves to water we worked for
RD_ALifeLine_7c64aae459e16b02: And I hate having to ask for a drink when there's nothing to trade
RD_ALifeLine_22c075596285d35f: Folks.. we'd have to work out sharing without shouting at each other
RD_ALifeLine_708e83c63dd1630b: That isn't much of a rule
RD_ALifeLine_1b1f1ba0611f9d5c: It's a start.. argue quietly then work out who's keeping watch
RD_ALifeLine_54a9e30a25873e26: That used to be our house, it burned down Friday night
RD_ALifeLine_7aadc729535dcb01: Not that we know of, we were out
RD_ALifeLine_015663493b13119c: People are gathering at the church tonight
RD_ALifeLine_53838dc14cbf3cd7: I'll be there, I'm told the pastor's still preaching
RD_ALifeLine_2b4cd78026030826: I'll bring my sidearm and keep it quiet
RD_ALifeLine_140ea3805f605675: Everybody listen, at dusk, doors locked, lights out
RD_ALifeLine_6aef445811aee79a: Keep them quiet, blankets over the window
RD_ALifeLine_288d7ffe4003a692: Has anyone seen a beagle? Brown and white, answers to Biscuit
RD_ALifeLine_0cd53f4f1150cc62: There was a dog behind the bakery
RD_ALifeLine_425448da2c75e403: A beagle, you say, I saw him sniffing a shoe near the courthouse
RD_ALifeLine_2189e50946daa511: Deputy, didn't you coach Little League?
RD_ALifeLine_14b524313b26a330: Tell him I said keep his head up
RD_ALifeLine_2e3262cc1d0ab061: I heard the Army's not coming back
RD_ALifeLine_37051a01023e6634: I heard it was the sheriff's fault
RD_ALifeLine_5be8cb801e70677c: Neither is confirmed, and neither will help you eat tonight
RD_ALifeLine_5ee1471369bd61d2: Stay in your homes and share what you have
RD_ALifeLine_411b54ce0eb85b7e: I keep thinking someone could shoot at us before we even saw them
RD_ALifeLine_1edd555e225c5873: Don't put that in my head!
RD_ALifeLine_3be8ab5f25126111: Then keep your head down.. don't stand there arguing
RD_ALifeLine_6cdcab840fd82fa3: Would you know whose side they were on?
RD_ALifeLine_080e53655ef5c340: No.. and I wouldn't pretend I did
RD_ALifeLine_62a2b2585122d971: Then let's stop talking about it
RD_ALifeLine_61b7ea5f4fc35297: If we ever set up a trade table, would people bring what they could spare?
RD_ALifeLine_39337a4120f1a6ca: Maybe, I'd ask what they needed before promising bandages or coffee
RD_ALifeLine_4ecfb66916db3d57: And agree who watches while people trade, nobody stops looking just because there's a table
RD_ALifeLine_230e7bb02a2c0907: You'd make a fair deputy at a swap meet
RD_ALifeLine_53d4b46d66f6ada4: I'd settle for nobody getting hurt
RD_ALifeLine_44131d2d755a4aca: That's a better promise to try than everybody getting what they want
RD_ALifeLine_6ea2e17c4f26d2b7: We came off the Rosewood road, lost our car at the bridge
RD_ALifeLine_3761ed6f00aaeb97: We came the other way, same story, different bridge
RD_ALifeLine_6418f302463d6d61: Both of you stay together, don't wander off alone
RD_ALifeLine_0b57417613a57471: Is it safe to share a roof tonight?
RD_ALifeLine_3eee34427cf7ee58: Safer than apart, count heads every hour
RD_ALifeLine_4fc50a5b6efafbd4: We ought to agree on a signal before we split up
RD_ALifeLine_4a44005c2fc9933a: Something we won't mistake for somebody else
RD_ALifeLine_5acdd95c6a41130c: And not so loud it brings everything over
RD_ALifeLine_40582667748864aa: Right.. let's not start whistling just to hear ourselves
RD_ALifeLine_56d9e8f5534cd4bb: I'd want to hear it and know what it meant first
RD_ALifeLine_2997cadd13b15b7e: We have a rain barrel behind the house, it's half full
RD_ALifeLine_14d83e364c058f0d: We've got filters but nothing to filter
RD_ALifeLine_702aa6e106c3b2ef: Combine what you have, I'll walk you both over
RD_ALifeLine_19220dae472aa402: Two streets is plenty if you're alone
RD_ALifeLine_668ec2094fcc0a6e: There's a man in the ditch, he's hurt but he's talking...
RD_ALifeLine_232ac354326197cc: Then we carry him to the aid station, lift on three
RD_ALifeLine_2242c318237e5371: There's an emergency broadcast at nine on the AM band
RD_ALifeLine_1758ff0b17e42422: I'm told it'll repeat the quarantine order
RD_ALifeLine_6fd294be257979a8: Where do we bury our dead?
RD_ALifeLine_2ce7cf3e5072b2b9: Behind the church, there's a detail digging...
RD_ALifeLine_509b184f274dc4e8: As respectful as we can manage...
RD_ALifeLine_2f252e4322146272: It's the least I can do
RD_ALifeLine_7190ab2655f6c999: Everyone gather by the wall, I'm taking a head count
RD_ALifeLine_51e8d99b1a3bfb6a: Send them to the aid station
RD_ALifeLine_0d1902c75e1bd7dc: We were thinking of crossing the field
RD_ALifeLine_120d4d11755d2fd7: Don't, there's a pack in the corn
RD_ALifeLine_3da42996762a27aa: If I had a sandwich, I'd make you eat it
RD_ALifeLine_279e80ef253b8b79: Then I'd have to admit the uniform wasn't the whole problem
RD_ALifeLine_62f8b9c75805f785: We have a ham radio but no power
RD_ALifeLine_12a60063107041ca: We have a generator, bring it by the truck
RD_ALifeLine_1627e17f487c073c: Right behind me, all of you
RD_ALifeLine_6f17910f552a74d2: What happens if they overrun this street?
RD_ALifeLine_4e14121e425dce70: We fall back to the church
RD_ALifeLine_529a4c2b2fb9ac5c: Is that you, Carol? From the Methodist choir?
RD_ALifeLine_7d74835840ca5554: Margaret! I thought you'd moved to Frankfort
RD_ALifeLine_2a51fd3823cc2c98: I did, two years ago, I came back for my sister
RD_ALifeLine_33e289a95e3360d5: Reunions are fine, keep them quiet
RD_ALifeLine_7da83da17434774a: We need volunteers for night watch
RD_ALifeLine_24e3ee0e462bafe9: Fine, you report to me at dusk
RD_ALifeLine_7570c3fc2017a5ea: We have a ration line at noon, one per family
RD_ALifeLine_0305c9c159d2bf1d: One per family, Elect a leader
RD_ALifeLine_147552316ad5b0a3: And ours is the woman at the back
RD_ALifeLine_0f9d64f63ebe5c2e: I need your names and where you're from
RD_ALifeLine_36e3d00a2c6635f9: Good, don't wander without telling me
RD_ALifeLine_0352967e32e0ce2b: We came from the north side, it's all fire up there
RD_ALifeLine_1e0fe2b76c634677: We came from the south, nothing but the sick ones
RD_ALifeLine_688f6db9403a1c5e: Both groups return to your homes, remain indoors
RD_ALifeLine_6f586a756f15fa8c: Then stick together, don't go off alone
RD_ALifeLine_377a7c505547fc3c: I found a case of beer in the cruiser's trunk, confiscated from a party
RD_ALifeLine_7db0cf4d230d43dd: It's going to be a cold night, do you have blankets?
RD_ALifeLine_3fdc117c4c8b79d4: There are some in the VFW basement...
RD_ALifeLine_4f44fa79476706e9: There! That's my sister! Oh, thank God!
RD_ALifeLine_00bcbff967014e69: Let her through, Deputy, it's a family
RD_ALifeLine_72b1d1b40beaf807: Make it quick, and no noise
RD_ALifeLine_62e928d756610c6d: Nobody enters without a bite check
RD_ALifeLine_2d99efca518f7677: We're treating you like people we'd like to keep alive
RD_ALifeLine_463586357d28567a: Is this it? Is this the end of everything?
RD_ALifeLine_1c6177f53042329a: Then why does it feel like it?
RD_ALifeLine_570bab966a7b6ee7: And because you're tired, we all are
RD_ALifeLine_6decdf15407cb97b: I remember a woman screaming that they'd got her mother and brother
RD_ALifeLine_291a296233cb10f8: By a creek, she said, an hour before she found us
RD_ALifeLine_76364d8c66e38e39: She wanted us to take over, like a uniform meant we had a plan
RD_ALifeLine_55be031776cc2769: I wanted to promise her a safe room. Hadn't even checked where we could go
RD_ALifeLine_4256f42511664365: She kept saying, please don't leave us, I still hear that
RD_ALifeLine_15c9fa3d3a6e0758: My mother can't walk far, she needs a chair
RD_ALifeLine_73dfbcc8098d7ab5: There's a wheelchair in the lobby of the bank
RD_ALifeLine_774e3848327ea511: I'll send a man for it
RD_ALifeLine_592cb16b60bb91e6: Wait here, ma'am, nobody moves until he's back
RD_ALifeLine_437b687f5ae77db5: If people start crowding us I'd want somebody doing the talking
RD_ALifeLine_1fd9c3873e2deeae: And somebody watching while the rest of us listen?
RD_ALifeLine_4cba454d31ad81e1: Yes.. without making promises we can't keep
RD_ALifeLine_3c49d76d620e9b2a: Stay quiet and out of the way
RD_ALifeLine_3e9af5bc0c867e63: He's been following my squad since the highway
RD_ALifeLine_358af421359aa83f: That's Mister Biggs! He belongs to the Carters on Alder
RD_ALifeLine_1f37cce505a87e14: I need concertina wire across this road
RD_ALifeLine_6cd0304533e13685: The county garage used to keep a spool, I wouldn't count on it still being there
RD_ALifeLine_0f560d633850ddd9: If we find wire and a truck, I could drive
RD_ALifeLine_3a434478781318ab: We'd need someone riding with you, not another person sent off alone
RD_ALifeLine_285c9882342ec18c: And a good look at the road before we load anything
RD_ALifeLine_0d25efb355617cdf: Yes, sir, a plan first, not just an order
RD_ALifeLine_5aed339309a2ace6: The creek water is brown, is it safe if we boil it?
RD_ALifeLine_3f154d0135f83112: Boil it hard and strain it through cloth
RD_ALifeLine_007d1abf65646b17: Rain barrels are better than the creek
RD_ALifeLine_03037cbb08b43827: Cover them so nothing falls in
RD_ALifeLine_0f0d79320f84a555: Anybody want company for a while?
RD_ALifeLine_56f3f03f5f25a0a1: Depends, you going to argue the whole way?
RD_ALifeLine_52e486933bf1af14: Then let's walk before you get started
RD_ALifeLine_55bcf8560e33e696: Two boys on bikes just rode right through the yard
RD_ALifeLine_6994573455973874: Hard to say, they were pretty fast
RD_ALifeLine_1fefa5e841ade835: Should someone tell them it's dangerous?
RD_ALifeLine_2697e40f4f7216d3: I will if I catch them
RD_ALifeLine_4f89fffc3b5006e1: You won't catch them, they're on bikes
RD_ALifeLine_0cca58d62b8828db: Is Reverend Boone alive? Somebody said he was
RD_ALifeLine_5bf3555d75e6a537: He's at the Baptist church, I saw him yesterday
RD_ALifeLine_44ccf5f3447051e6: I'll take you both, it's on my route
RD_ALifeLine_73608a6d79e6afab: Then he's the right person to see, stay close
RD_ALifeLine_77c386607fc8fd05: Why can't we have a fire? It's freezing in there!
RD_ALifeLine_4478a3d83741f13e: He's right! You can have a stove if it's indoors and vented
RD_ALifeLine_67a094821f6de330: Then sit close together and share the blankets
RD_ALifeLine_192d754550c17c01: People are saying you've been shooting looters
RD_ALifeLine_2fddce456de27f6f: Someone said they saw a body in the road
RD_ALifeLine_20cc029729c3ba4d: The body was infected... nothing to do with looting
RD_ALifeLine_112d2f8a14ea9c7a: Tried calling my mother from the phone booth by the bank, dead
RD_ALifeLine_4094244e76052c90: Same one? I did that this morning
RD_ALifeLine_22e6edf37d2f5262: I tried it yesterday, I'll admit
RD_ALifeLine_170343cd52d8014b: Why do we all keep trying?
RD_ALifeLine_06248f3004a3c78b: We need nails and plywood to board the windows
RD_ALifeLine_2692734d16882ce6: The hardware store on Third is open
RD_ALifeLine_77eb3e1e592d8a51: We haven't seen the Hendersons since Thursday...
RD_ALifeLine_11de31fc15fd7b60: They were on my street too
RD_ALifeLine_3043fea60c701650: We've been sleeping in the hayloft at the Lowe farm
RD_ALifeLine_3e5e134c0843557a: We found a root cellar two fields over, dry, and the door bars shut
RD_ALifeLine_779287d711be6f1b: Anywhere with one door and a way out the other side, that's what I'd pick
RD_ALifeLine_62fa9dd667c7ed2c: The hayloft has a ladder we can pull up
RD_ALifeLine_1b916c88531f6566: Then you both have a plan, stick to it
RD_ALifeLine_2f9f2fe153b3acbe: Someone's got lights on at the end of the road
RD_ALifeLine_49fa60027eb6176d: Step away from that truck, please
RD_ALifeLine_765294ed1e647c69: It's ours, we just stopped to rest
RD_ALifeLine_21938d5668dbf1fb: Just blankets and our canned goods
RD_ALifeLine_5257d5e31f8d10e7: Somebody's been through the pharmacy, glass all over the floor
RD_ALifeLine_6f66077778ba6f0a: Which is worse! Keep your eyes up
RD_ALifeLine_0ac6f4631fe97647: I'll take one for the barracks
RD_ALifeLine_3dee9b8b48d8754d: Some men in uniforms robbed our house last night
RD_ALifeLine_3d4e3d380ee4b8c7: One had a scar on his chin
RD_ALifeLine_5e281a1b300a06fe: Someone who took a uniform from a dead man
RD_ALifeLine_5e6687320d835af6: Avoid the church on Main, it's been compromised
RD_ALifeLine_507f9f576d0be6da: A dozen of the sick ones
RD_ALifeLine_3a38974077a3618b: We tried to go to the hospital
RD_ALifeLine_22ef28e166d0d977: I need two civilians to relay messages between houses
RD_ALifeLine_4cb12016599b3c2a: Use the alleys, stay out of sight
RD_ALifeLine_1ed4298e543183c7: I lost my boots in the creek
RD_ALifeLine_36c1417715fc7d59: I wish I had a spare pair to offer
RD_ALifeLine_4037837d79b1ad01: A surplus store might be worth checking, if you find one
RD_ALifeLine_345049417ee279dd: Don't let somebody tell you every foot's a ten, bad boots can make things worse
RD_ALifeLine_02394fcb79ddf3ba: I'd rather help you look than promise you a pair I haven't got
RD_ALifeLine_57ac1d651ddd7a67: My boy's missing, brown hair, blue jacket
RD_ALifeLine_76cab1255b3a144a: Would you say a few words for the ones we lost?
RD_ALifeLine_6ec74d810cbd8c59: We've set up a sniper position on the grain elevator
RD_ALifeLine_748721f574be5446: Is it safe to be nearby?
RD_ALifeLine_4a33699541166336: Stay clear of the fence line
RD_ALifeLine_69d970ca1beaa975: Your trucks went north all night, where were they going?
RD_ALifeLine_31f1f33c76c812fa: Away from a lot of people, ma'am
RD_ALifeLine_48e328147d69bf86: Are the ones I'm here for
RD_ALifeLine_0f8bcd6f6616aae7: Which road is clear, the Brandenburg pike or the old quarry road?

RD_ALifeLine_421a03d43e2edba2: We came off the quarry road an hour ago, that tells you what we saw then, not what's there now
RD_ALifeLine_0d55cbcb37f87f01: Could somebody walk with us a while?
RD_ALifeLine_6b5e98ec25b724df: I could walk a while. We'd still have to look for ourselves
RD_ALifeLine_1c3eb1683e5bd25d: Then we'll keep together without pretending a crowd makes us safe

RD_ALifeLine_11ca93be06c48abe: Start by checking the water before promising anybody a jug
RD_ALifeLine_15b033d61de8dfe9: Then work out where people would line up?
RD_ALifeLine_325036154a6c468f: Somewhere we could see each other, without blocking a way out
RD_ALifeLine_557702ee752dd390: How long could we keep it up?
RD_ALifeLine_65b270bc2cf5ad9e: Only as long as there was water we could actually spare
RD_ALifeLine_5050b64b6edbb7be: I keep one, names and unit
RD_ALifeLine_6b2134f007059c38: I keep one too, mine is civilians...
RD_ALifeLine_6c4e1f721366f6aa: Let's compare, maybe we can put names to the unknowns

RD_ALifeLine_53e4e11c652a615f: The lieutenant, he's at the staging area, ask him in the morning

RD_ALifeLine_2baded143f2d960c: This is the map I was handed
RD_ALifeLine_63d33d7d69cfd731: I grew up here, Sergeant, I can draw you a better one

RD_ALifeLine_21a50370249ba535: We did, the rest of the platoon is on edge
RD_ALifeLine_5d3f571f721a7fb8: They went in through the front, don't ever do that
RD_ALifeLine_3216ebb2345ba51e: If you shoot a man, I still have to write it up
RD_ALifeLine_54720afa0cab212c: I'll put it in my log, Deputy
RD_ALifeLine_7d0577dc68f37f98: I have a pencil, we'll make do
RD_ALifeLine_37122c7a47c81c45: You have civilians on my side of the river, walking, with rifles
RD_ALifeLine_6539afa2154e6c0e: Yes, we're trying to send them home
RD_ALifeLine_36bec5153a38c2dd: Let me talk to them, they know my face
RD_ALifeLine_5079c59d40ea3d27: Appreciated! Keep them away from the fence line

RD_ALifeLine_2953bb484bfa64c7: We secured a rifle that had been fired at a patrol
RD_ALifeLine_2a6ee4af5c145793: So were we, return it to them if you wish, I won't stop you
RD_ALifeLine_60fb59252396b799: Will your men back me on the curfew?
RD_ALifeLine_0fd6647808493a17: To the extent we're able, we can't patrol every block
RD_ALifeLine_2c33ecff0d79d56c: The main road we can do
RD_ALifeLine_66e667b416ffb4f0: There are men in Army fatigues stealing from houses out by Muldraugh
RD_ALifeLine_22f3cbac1fd1c14b: Ours carry radios and keep their rifle slung, the ones you describe do neither
RD_ALifeLine_77b5614e11ed6219: Have you heard from state police? Anyone at all?
RD_ALifeLine_45fd86af507efa08: Negative, I tried every channel I know
RD_ALifeLine_6274c8be0b46b5b9: Same, my dispatcher's been asking for ten hours
RD_ALifeLine_0872f29959f43089: Maybe the repeater's down, maybe more than that...
RD_ALifeLine_43deedea74272ec1: I used to think my K-9 knew trouble before I did, wish I had that feeling again
RD_ALifeLine_790c5f55019eeff7: Better than most of my deputies
RD_ALifeLine_7a4143eb3ff4faee: I'd have liked to meet him
RD_ALifeLine_7b3710bc5ba96a9e: We buried a few on the school grounds.. I hated thinking somebody would have to see that
RD_ALifeLine_0e399edd5c93736a: I would've wanted somewhere out of sight too
RD_ALifeLine_51975b8c0ca7d4df: Hard enough asking a man to dig.. harder if he knows the family
