RD_ALifeLine_7e5109883842011c: My apologies, it was dark and the lights were on
RD_ALifeLine_242cdb03207ba843: Turn off the sentry's fire-on-sight order for county vehicles, please
RD_ALifeLine_465e92e956b1ca2e: If you see trouble in the south end, fire a flare
RD_ALifeLine_2bb652272b0c9412: Red means stop. White means come over, still look before you move
RD_ALifeLine_7af21ada7089838b: Understood, we'll put someone on the roof

RD_ALifeLine_1c587e867034437d: Mine said it was a lie they tell at funerals
RD_ALifeLine_43450b55580f1e2e: Which one of them was right?

RD_ALifeLine_0a2e1bff02193a80: I have three men in the holding cell who need to be somewhere

RD_ALifeLine_541fe4e33db326e3: Release them, I can't take custody of anyone
RD_ALifeLine_0c9d12fe1e9f437d: How many do you have in the cordon?
RD_ALifeLine_36f70002729f1d9e: Not enough, and I'm not giving you a number
RD_ALifeLine_24d40d6d3598274c: Fair, I've got six deputies and a dispatcher without a phone
RD_ALifeLine_3003a571438a7896: Then between us we've got a very short list
RD_ALifeLine_78716a983e043a9a: We need hands at the roadblock on Route 60
RD_ALifeLine_092317d316b2977c: Four if you can spare them
RD_ALifeLine_175a6e700892213a: I can spare three, we'll ride out together
RD_ALifeLine_06ae73890ddd0474: We're falling back to the courthouse, the east side is too thin
RD_ALifeLine_7cae76db1fea755a: We're holding here, this position is tied to the road
RD_ALifeLine_15a12c7b3b7dbd28: Possibly, but if we leave, nobody's covering the road

RD_ALifeLine_004abf5924496cb5: Understood, Deputy! Orders came down in a hurry!
RD_ALifeLine_303bf24f199351f2: Then let's agree to trade radio channels and talk before anyone does anything
RD_ALifeLine_1cffe1e77239c960: I can do that, channel nine, on the hour
RD_ALifeLine_17f82e9f1a3b90e1: I did, I quit in March
RD_ALifeLine_1905261b1a093631: We have a deputy with a gunshot wound, your medic around?
RD_ALifeLine_013eb0557da2cb05: He's with the trucks, bring him over, Deputy
RD_ALifeLine_39e6576f497cfc87: Follow me, the aid station is two blocks
RD_ALifeLine_7483e8b5381c519f: They're still there, they're not answering
RD_ALifeLine_3fc7b44022fe878c: How do you know they're still there?
RD_ALifeLine_774757533eea6e2d: Because the lights haven't gone out
RD_ALifeLine_62715dce606f01bf: Anything different about the nights lately?
RD_ALifeLine_23d5890a383a7e6c: I hate trying to find a way through in the dark. More guessing than I care for
RD_ALifeLine_71859a4b318b679c: I'd rather look for a place before it gets that late
RD_ALifeLine_345c955f355e5472: Then let's stop arguing and look
RD_ALifeLine_7ba084a71c69a30e: Aren't you Danny Walsh's boy? From the VFW?
RD_ALifeLine_337fb25d5482b353: I wore a badge when you were in diapers
RD_ALifeLine_5469c28f636b835f: Then I'm in good hands today
RD_ALifeLine_53e91c42602a9e97: Contain the area and hold the line, Beyond that, I get nothing
RD_ALifeLine_6c5438dd3b83f157: The last radio call was Saturday at 0400, since then I've been guessing
RD_ALifeLine_3e5ffc9f3905d017: I filed a missing persons report for forty-one people today
RD_ALifeLine_5a8b37442d7b4bd8: That might be the most honest thing anybody's done this week
RD_ALifeLine_3f389b2f19d28cae: There's a reporter in my town asking us to comment, do I say anything?
RD_ALifeLine_46bb8a2d7680f158: Tell him it's an ongoing situation
RD_ALifeLine_06c44de9208558ce: Most of my men are weekend reservists, they've got families right here in the county...
RD_ALifeLine_0406dfba1e9e9de5: They're leaving post at night to check on their kids...
RD_ALifeLine_2a77339a71e17c14: I'd let them, a man who doesn't know where his kids are is no good on the line
RD_ALifeLine_397c07ce25d3b8e6: People are saying the Army will pull out and burn the county
RD_ALifeLine_43c52dd80cb8d383: I'd like you to tell me if you do
RD_ALifeLine_7f1ed29c7f77453a: If I hear it, you'll be the second to know
RD_ALifeLine_57fb5238509520e6: You ever see a thing you can't write up?
RD_ALifeLine_4f16191346c8e3ff: I stood in a kitchen with a woman who had her own husband's arm in her teeth, four feet from me...
RD_ALifeLine_314706806deebee6: What the training said... then I went outside and sat in the cruiser
RD_ALifeLine_6465cb214dc6f582: If we find a pack behind a building don't just start shooting
RD_ALifeLine_5b6ce2b572aeb800: No.. I'd want to see where the shots would go first
RD_ALifeLine_1744be4f6792d971: And know who's on the other side.. I don't want to find out afterward
RD_ALifeLine_71d75a8651790dd9: Right.. we don't guess about that
RD_ALifeLine_7f3d6159119a6f34: Let's divide the town, you take everything south of the tracks
RD_ALifeLine_5a8923c47254c46e: Agreed, north of the tracks is yours
RD_ALifeLine_40291f4d150827e5: And if either of us needs help?
RD_ALifeLine_4f66522567ff8e83: Three shots, spaced, then wait, we'll come
RD_ALifeLine_39117e9765c507f6: We're low on 12-gauge, can you spare any?
RD_ALifeLine_3592a16c70782dfe: Not a lot, I can give you two boxes if you give me one of your radios
RD_ALifeLine_78d1c011132e14df: One radio for two boxes, done
RD_ALifeLine_055ca0e3745e45d8: I have a man who put a bullet in a deputy last night, he's cuffed
RD_ALifeLine_15042a1b2938501a: I'll take him! We can hold him with ours
RD_ALifeLine_70041ce24cea8c57: Understood! I'll bring him to your truck myself
RD_ALifeLine_6cd3260f1af22131: Wait until the patrol's back! I'll send two to escort
RD_ALifeLine_29f0b30d4c00a815: Father Doyle is still ringing his bell every evening, hundreds show up...
RD_ALifeLine_21a2ea2c7e50a824: I'd rather they didn't gather in one place after dark, but I wouldn't be the one to tell him
RD_ALifeLine_5e64027553691477: I need to see your search authority before your men go into those houses
RD_ALifeLine_14783be201fac69d: Deputy, I have a rifle and an order, that's my authority
RD_ALifeLine_7e46569659215338: No, sir, it's an emergency, I'll sign whatever you like after
RD_ALifeLine_3e8d1349359c546f: When did you last eat something warm?
RD_ALifeLine_4cdb14807393c000: Yesterday, beans from a can, heated on the engine block
RD_ALifeLine_1d26977c1429d9ba: My wife's church has a pot of chili going on Cedar, tell your men
RD_ALifeLine_01136d455d378dd9: I'll send a detail, thank you, Deputy
RD_ALifeLine_1a0223da698b1890: What did you see at the Louisville line?
RD_ALifeLine_7f7f8b96082d5e59: Roadblocks and fire, we turned back before dawn
RD_ALifeLine_17780d4f2b41fb75: School gym, it's got two exits and walls
RD_ALifeLine_270555e1595baeb1: We've got the courthouse, stone basement, one stairwell
RD_ALifeLine_0d0bb54d5c3fb4ac: Sounds defensible, keep it that way
RD_ALifeLine_5be3d4884025d901: One of your privates offered one of my deputies a bottle of Jim Beam
RD_ALifeLine_4b2685ca64d52458: I'll speak to him, thank you for the report
RD_ALifeLine_6ca810d2115a8ffb: Who's holding the bridge on 31W? I've got civilians asking
RD_ALifeLine_618bdef20fef3a9e: Second platoon, nothing crosses without a pass from the lieutenant

RD_ALifeLine_6bd9e2ea01d3216d: Seven years driving a school bus, route fourteen, past the lake
RD_ALifeLine_5a7b906948579e19: Terrible, Spitballs, shoes out the window, one boy who sang the same song every morning
RD_ALifeLine_7f9274e347a681c3: Drove me crazy for seven years, I'd hear that song once more and cry like a baby
RD_ALifeLine_78509c3516dcb57b: Some country thing about a truck and a dog, I never learned the name
RD_ALifeLine_2fc9e43202a453b8: I taught fifth grade for twenty-two years, math, mostly
RD_ALifeLine_10d819c007c8a1e4: Which means you can divide the cans fairly
RD_ALifeLine_537bef696760bfbe: Which means I got to watch ten-year-olds learn the thing they swore they'd never learn, fractions
RD_ALifeLine_66e9f6255e46d678: Every day, mostly the ones who gave me trouble, they're the ones I remember
RD_ALifeLine_68b5207e110d5fb3: One, I think, found him in Muldraugh last week, bigger than me, and he still called me ma'am
RD_ALifeLine_38aac7b60a3bf059: Snow days were the best, whole school closed, no questions
RD_ALifeLine_1e5fff620875f9fb: Sled on the hill behind the school
RD_ALifeLine_53269a12174c7dac: Cardboard, mostly, a trash can lid if you were rich
RD_ALifeLine_34ad9de47de9a9da: I once went down on a baking sheet
RD_ALifeLine_1c3dfb9b1674aa43: And came back with all your teeth?
RD_ALifeLine_68330a106d528308: Mostly, we should do it again when the winter comes, just once
RD_ALifeLine_530957ea7efb2aeb: Let's, we could use one good fall
RD_ALifeLine_0b0d3045230e335d: I was a counselor at a camp on Rough River, Canoes, archery, a cook named Pearl
RD_ALifeLine_3f81c306299d1c90: Six feet tall, hands like frying pans, she made pancakes the size of hubcaps and ruled the whole camp
RD_ALifeLine_36302b1343b9818a: Nobody dared, we were all terrified of her and all in love with her
RD_ALifeLine_61ab50f613053d84: She took the last boat out, with the little ones, singing, that's the last I saw of her
RD_ALifeLine_2d2f8f530632ab6c: Sunday drives with Granddad, he'd narrate every barn like he'd built it
RD_ALifeLine_2239336812e9423d: I remember that, he'd say "that one leans, but it leans with pride"
RD_ALifeLine_0932319a7132a6bf: I never knew him, but I'd have liked to
RD_ALifeLine_37a770f95123bc9f: You'd have gotten a lecture about barns, and a peppermint
RD_ALifeLine_4ce181e0273c6188: He always had a peppermint, in his shirt pocket, wrapped in wax paper
RD_ALifeLine_742182b57ec6ffaa: Where were you when the radio said stay inside?
RD_ALifeLine_335b57fd5792482a: At work, the lights flickered, the foreman went white
RD_ALifeLine_47439c1965d947fd: I was at my mother's, she said, "That doesn't sound like the weather"
RD_ALifeLine_7510d4723cc22238: She's the one who handed me the shotgun and told me to find my brothers
RD_ALifeLine_23f79a4e5452e1cd: One of them, I'm still looking for the other
RD_ALifeLine_7c92da5902708272: Family reunion every Fourth of July at Otter Creek, hundred and fifty relatives
RD_ALifeLine_2a6cdfa34df54f39: And one grill, uncle Roy at the grill, arguing about charcoal
RD_ALifeLine_2d771a843583de4f: He'd been using the same recipe since before I was born
RD_ALifeLine_074d35a07fbf5db7: God, I would walk to Otter Creek for one burnt hot dog
RD_ALifeLine_3698f5c7649e895d: Fifteen summers hanging tobacco in my uncle's barn, hundred degrees, leaves sticking to your arms
RD_ALifeLine_7deac0380cc238e5: I thought so too, now I'd pay a lot of cans for one lungful of it
RD_ALifeLine_7ebb5969544d7192: It smelled like August, which is better
RD_ALifeLine_2a9db7b60a7fd238: Burned in the first week, I watched the smoke from the road and kept walking
RD_ALifeLine_3477abc1215cdf9c: I sat on the Muldraugh town council, eleven of us arguing about a stoplight for two years
RD_ALifeLine_12ddf3fb14a7854c: We got the light, the week before it all went wrong, it worked for five days
RD_ALifeLine_6a2c94da659feec9: It's still blinking out there, red, red, red, a very patient light
RD_ALifeLine_18459ba41abd936f: Maybe it knows something we don't
RD_ALifeLine_6d03212c4c5c9dc3: Volunteer fire department, West Point, twelve of us, one truck, a lot of coffee
RD_ALifeLine_05e8ffd46bc79c9d: Mostly cats and chimneys, once a cow in a creek
RD_ALifeLine_6106659f4dce361c: Four hours, three ropes, and a farmer who cried when we got her out, best call of my life
RD_ALifeLine_4b87fab1583de2e0: Better than the fires, nobody died on that one
RD_ALifeLine_3307175d530f9427: We danced at the VFW hall in March, the year before, cheap punch and a DJ with a broken speaker
RD_ALifeLine_732cca9737eb67c6: Dale, he stepped on my foot four times and said sorry every time
RD_ALifeLine_73bec0d6572c6859: He went out for firewood on the ninth day, I waited at the window
RD_ALifeLine_2218068e3adf6c61: He'd want me to keep dancing, I do, in the kitchen, when nobody's watching
RD_ALifeLine_4b59d8241f4df9e8: I still wear his ring, on a chain, under the shirt
RD_ALifeLine_17d9acb84c5aa2a8: Before, a heart attack in the fall, so I thought I was one of the lucky ones, that I'd already done my losing
RD_ALifeLine_7d49e8f409e46f53: Does it get easier to carry?
RD_ALifeLine_12cfe413659900a1: It gets quieter, the weight never changes
RD_ALifeLine_6d9e2b686b183a80: I wasn't sure I would, the fire helps
RD_ALifeLine_6ff3c0cd0c8b4e40: First week, I saw a pack of dogs go through the cornfield, twelve, maybe more, all running the same way
RD_ALifeLine_5afab84a21d13a8d: Away from town, I thought, if the dogs are leaving, I should be leaving
RD_ALifeLine_3d785f6037c6141a: Three days late, I think about those three days more than anything
RD_ALifeLine_42080e560b934be3: Because of the dogs, I owe them a steak, if I ever see a steak again
RD_ALifeLine_176750c94b638dec: Officer, how far to the next place?
RD_ALifeLine_28f922ca0d70fc2f: I know, I'm bad at miles
RD_ALifeLine_4be6d59642c67f78: If your feet give out I'm not carrying you
RD_ALifeLine_53a9cc9a02352203: I'd rather not build up a smoky fire if we don't need one
RD_ALifeLine_6c515a032331ed9f: Even if it means eating cold again?
RD_ALifeLine_04e2fa765b31616f: Then we eat cold beans and I have one less thing to worry about, I'll take that trade for now
RD_ALifeLine_37ba9fe97c9daea2: I'm sweating through my own sweat
RD_ALifeLine_2eda66ad74b3ed41: It's accurate and disgusting, keep walking
RD_ALifeLine_1c4a236c3b451af4: My feet are fucking killing me!
RD_ALifeLine_1b6faecf60c032dd: Shut up and walk, I'm talking to myself
RD_ALifeLine_47343a432c9fc703: If I hear one more 'almost there' I'm sitting down in the road
RD_ALifeLine_40bc10302084b380: Then sit, we'll walk around you
RD_ALifeLine_521bdcb71440842c: It's sweat, it's sweat, it's definitely sweat
RD_ALifeLine_1222a7ef276ce5e5: I'm so goddamn thirsty I could drink out of a ditch
RD_ALifeLine_611835fa50deafa4: I'm gonna, watch me, I'm gonna find a ditch
RD_ALifeLine_17c461e63f01f0e7: Quit stepping on the heels of my shoes!
RD_ALifeLine_13f0ca3374979b15: You are, you're gonna wear a hole in them
RD_ALifeLine_22e895715cabab98: Nobody's stepping on anything, it's the road
RD_ALifeLine_0e7452c32aa1f4a8: I used to run five miles every morning and now I can't walk two
RD_ALifeLine_2c04c8631d9cc7a5: It's the bullshit is what it is, I'm out of shape
RD_ALifeLine_57be782d55dcad1b: I'd sell my soul for a shower
RD_ALifeLine_66269fe21c5a128f: The devil'd take one look and pass
RD_ALifeLine_7fc2a51d03ec0743: I'd stand outside while he sniffed
RD_ALifeLine_2b84ad6b78440e8d: There's a Wal-Mart bag stuck in that fence, and it's the most beautiful thing I've seen all day
RD_ALifeLine_2cb3794e0ce4a06c: It's trash that used to be a Wal-Mart, think about that
RD_ALifeLine_15598350094a1e29: I don't want to go in that town
RD_ALifeLine_5140d08f09a303e1: I know we have to, I'm saying I don't want to, I'm allowed to say it
RD_ALifeLine_2abb59855f567721: Whose idea was this walk anyway?
RD_ALifeLine_3ac7bb7d54eff333: It was Walt's, and Walt's not here, so shut up and carry your bag
RD_ALifeLine_5178f7fe1cf577d1: My dog would've loved this walk, he'd have run ahead and come back with a stick
RD_ALifeLine_07d8017b057c49b7: Home, I left a bag of food and the back door open, I don't know
RD_ALifeLine_5c4c23c358688a17: That's the same fucking cow as before
RD_ALifeLine_132de66871ed2e18: It's got the same stupid look
RD_ALifeLine_66f50e28270b9676: My backpack weighs a thousand pounds and I've got nothing in it
RD_ALifeLine_657f44bd28acda2c: A can of peaches and a damn picture frame!
RD_ALifeLine_4d4e7c0876ebfe88: I'm so tired I'd lie down in a ditch full of wet newspaper
RD_ALifeLine_6f823fa06f119bec: I'd put a jacket on it first, I've got standards
RD_ALifeLine_6705e55145e6ae7b: If one more person says it's not far I'm gonna lose my shit
RD_ALifeLine_5cdb0a14737123b6: I mean it, I'll sit down in the goddamn road!
RD_ALifeLine_0fdcd7ca359b0269: I'd kill somebody for a Mountain Dew
RD_ALifeLine_2fa7bc684a706d66: I'd kill somebody for a warm Mountain Dew, and I'd say thank you
RD_ALifeLine_019b3d844f3d7f93: Why are you walking so goddamn slow?
RD_ALifeLine_7ef153297d88751b: I've got a blister the size of a quarter
RD_ALifeLine_74d6eb522756b01f: Take your fuckin' boot off then and look!
RD_ALifeLine_3bc942e66587bad2: My feet are so swollen I can't tell where the boot ends
RD_ALifeLine_535cf13c10a9dfd6: That's a very sweaty sock, I'll give you that
RD_ALifeLine_46c2b0987700b5b5: I keep thinking I'll hear a car
RD_ALifeLine_5e4b14324c744637: Even now, I hear one and I turn, and it's just my own head
RD_ALifeLine_5af30dd200b7d8af: You're humming, it's the same four notes, I'm gonna lose my fucking mind
RD_ALifeLine_1f5355706f3b4a3f: It's the one about the river, let 'em have it
RD_ALifeLine_465d4a7d52eb9f57: It's a mile if you do it in Louisville
RD_ALifeLine_4b097eb83f6336b3: That is the ugliest cow I've ever seen
RD_ALifeLine_0714a08307fbccb8: It's the ugliest bull I've ever seen, then
RD_ALifeLine_06b6737d6f0489db: Don't tell me how to walk, I've been walking for forty-two years
RD_ALifeLine_253376af205a606f: I walk like a man who's earned it
RD_ALifeLine_1a9d302577259619: I could eat a whole goddamn cow right now!
RD_ALifeLine_099c772d331a4e07: Jerky's not a cow, it's the idea of a cow
RD_ALifeLine_331df3597a0e58fb: It's a cow that's given up
RD_ALifeLine_280c30ba6e3c24b6: I'm so tired I could cry, but I'm too thirsty
RD_ALifeLine_69d006874000171c: I'll save it, I've got a lot of it
RD_ALifeLine_6a568e2739e3541a: If we pass that same fucking house one more time I'm burning it down
RD_ALifeLine_0c2d0c7a6d70dcfa: It's the same goddamn house with a different color door!
RD_ALifeLine_0e8a773572e8768b: It's Kentucky, there's always a banjo, I can hear it in my head
RD_ALifeLine_5f8543f8600fd800: I just don't like them, they're like eyes
RD_ALifeLine_7d5ccb196a0626b4: What's the fastest way to get there?
RD_ALifeLine_1e82ba9c798b2397: That's the only way, that's not fast
RD_ALifeLine_058eb6f0494bdc9a: It's fast if you don't stop to talk about it
RD_ALifeLine_49936b0b0ae2c3c4: Keep up, for fuck's sake, we've got maybe four hours of light
RD_ALifeLine_24ca40e410648dd8: I'm TRYING, I've got a blister the size of--
RD_ALifeLine_5c88642b079abbcd: I don't wanna hear about the blister!
RD_ALifeLine_14e6154007890045: Somebody pick a direction before I pick one for you
RD_ALifeLine_5d03e4b372e41c95: Then why are we walking in a circle, there's the same goddamn mailbox!
RD_ALifeLine_0956034b41a1475b: If that dog follows us one more mile I'm gonna-- I'm gonna name it
RD_ALifeLine_29095b137e1b8f4c: Slow down, you ass, I've got thirty pounds on my back
RD_ALifeLine_226882eb1e50634a: I'd give a month's pay for a goddamn bench
RD_ALifeLine_272a3c390d66832c: A bench, a stump, a tractor tire, anything I can put my ass on!
RD_ALifeLine_7ea82fb0060a57c1: I told you we should've left at dawn!
RD_ALifeLine_1d90988d1b973390: I said dawn, I said DAWN, I said it three times
RD_ALifeLine_48e133566ff3f433: If I see one more cow I'm gonna lose it
RD_ALifeLine_69b60f55550d8cb5: They look at everybody, it's what they do
RD_ALifeLine_1943babf21ded7ba: Don't walk behind me like that, I can hear you breathing
RD_ALifeLine_5f6142e00d326ca1: I know you're walking, I'm saying quit breathing on my neck!
RD_ALifeLine_13458d1a6093758e: I used to run this stretch every morning, I thought I was in shape
RD_ALifeLine_37ffce1167ee15e1: Nobody's in shape for this, Jesus Christ
RD_ALifeLine_195678704c0f5572: How the hell is it still this hot at six?!
RD_ALifeLine_6c2f58a50f7ffb6a: I KNOW it's summer, I'm asking God, not you
RD_ALifeLine_4d5b8b34223beaad: When did socks become something worth thinking about?
RD_ALifeLine_1790d51316c87260: I used to get angry when somebody gave me socks for Christmas
RD_ALifeLine_64d234cf087df82e: You owe several aunts an apology
RD_ALifeLine_17e9691903e45c23: Cut my arm going out the window, hahaha, real clean cut, look at that
RD_ALifeLine_7110295517aa8bea: Glass, or that fella who was already lying in the ditch, hard to say, it all went real quick
RD_ALifeLine_095bebf4102dbba2: Hill the dirt up to the second leaf, not over it
RD_ALifeLine_1c10a0d47d3fc424: I did taxes for twenty-two years, I don't know which one's the second leaf
RD_ALifeLine_02796091486c64af: It's the one right after the first leaf
RD_ALifeLine_24dfc32326ded77a: Thank you, that clears up everything
RD_ALifeLine_0c88001a481ac484: Fella at the gate says he's a dentist
RD_ALifeLine_59a2621c792d00ca: Looked at you from forty feet off and said you grind your teeth at night
RD_ALifeLine_16b224c91762cff8: Well, I do grind at night
RD_ALifeLine_643e932b3c3823e3: Everybody in camp calls me Doc now
RD_ALifeLine_298b3683203370f6: Weren't you the tech at the drugstore counter?
RD_ALifeLine_127fc90c51f424f5: Two years, I counted pills by fives with a little spatula
RD_ALifeLine_356ac75f723d3925: Well, you've counted more pills than the rest of us put together, Doc
RD_ALifeLine_5d78f0f8459a92eb: Knife, water, hammer, matches in the sandwich bag
RD_ALifeLine_44f8afd953ad0017: Wrote it in pen this time, pencil smeared the last one to nothing
RD_ALifeLine_2a4e27ed0762ce91: Little Bethel rang at three this morning, six of 'em, slow, like a funeral
RD_ALifeLine_4d71ff752aac3fda: Rope's loose, wind gets in that steeple
RD_ALifeLine_6b5b38795c73138c: Wind don't count to six and quit
RD_ALifeLine_346c882525d4f4c1: We ain't lighting another one, cold supper till I say different
RD_ALifeLine_271d8b9d550d6f22: No crickets, summer, and no crickets
RD_ALifeLine_29c4d9f02c4fab82: Well... guess I'll sit closer to the fire, then
RD_ALifeLine_338730c956a2ec2d: We lit a fire Tuesday, Wednesday there was one on the far ridge
RD_ALifeLine_094036bc61b844f0: Thursday there was three, we ain't lit one since and I'd like to keep it that way
RD_ALifeLine_0817eb065f2aecef: Oil's fine, water's fine, belts are fine
RD_ALifeLine_57504125485e8de8: Everything on you is fine and you still won't go
RD_ALifeLine_1e7f60e761ebb6a6: Remember sleeping through rain on a proper roof?
RD_ALifeLine_387c989d18907373: Without worrying about the roof part?
RD_ALifeLine_4b9eea0d0ea5a355: We didn't know how good we were at resting
RD_ALifeLine_0c3786cd07cc0d82: Yank the wire under the dash!
RD_ALifeLine_1893862a4d842066: Forget the horn, grab the bags, everything for two miles just heard that, go!
RD_ALifeLine_27e683193343f271: Trader at the gate wants the seed corn, offering a box of shotgun shells
RD_ALifeLine_23b121051206c147: Shells keep us alive this week
RD_ALifeLine_71ac899b2650c30f: Seed keeps us alive next year
RD_ALifeLine_2dd8cf11477375ff: Next year's a long way off
RD_ALifeLine_276ff01a09f306ef: So's the bottom of that box of shells, tell him no
RD_ALifeLine_37f81e4d72094f13: Chapter eleven's going in the fire
RD_ALifeLine_6b3b5a724e44d2d1: Never will find out if it was the nephew
RD_ALifeLine_3498eb6e4a86b788: Heh, chapter twelve, let the smoke wonder about it
RD_ALifeLine_1465f68d23d3c09a: How many rounds you got up there?
RD_ALifeLine_2951f83912e30ef5: Three, and a rifle that looks like it's got thirty, most of this job is standing where folks can see the rifle
RD_ALifeLine_08a8442e3636d4d4: Only doctor in this camp is a chiropractor
RD_ALifeLine_2d64ad63038d5d8c: I came in with a fever, he cracked my neck
RD_ALifeLine_74e587f722f2e71c: No, my neck feels great, though
RD_ALifeLine_721edec147c3d153: No, empty pill bottle and a note on the sink
RD_ALifeLine_732428265752216e: Leave the note, check the cabinet, close the door on your way out
RD_ALifeLine_292f9dfa3e82d4fb: Got a plan for next month?
RD_ALifeLine_79c826750bc98592: I'd like to be available for it
RD_ALifeLine_7666b05d72579ed8: Station wagon's got a good radiator, pull it
RD_ALifeLine_7c0cf20e7d7fea19: There's a car seat still buckled in the back
RD_ALifeLine_24d6d8e65cfc4d6e: Leave the car seat, pull the radiator
RD_ALifeLine_25eec77e20fd7750: Tape tonight, maybe a new handle off that old rake by the shed
RD_ALifeLine_7ef9825f56fc6f46: You and me did alright today
RD_ALifeLine_7b4c42ba1b5391a2: Don't you dare lift that lid
RD_ALifeLine_3e286316629067a1: It's been unplugged a month in August, it's soup, and it hates you
RD_ALifeLine_3be12d9e2bab6793: Knew a guy who'd stop and comb his hair every time the helmet came off
RD_ALifeLine_7457412b2f4ac296: There were about eight hairs, he was very careful with all of them
RD_ALifeLine_390d1c3f0aad8ae5: Leave him alone, that's all he had
RD_ALifeLine_380f5a60067e98f7: Remember your little scenic route? Three hours?
RD_ALifeLine_40522889220b4e06: Same barn, THREE times, and you wouldn't ask anybody
RD_ALifeLine_3901c1a5421a97ba: Who sewed your old jacket? Wasn't you
RD_ALifeLine_0413e64c30d8357e: Aunt did, wouldn't let me leave till she'd told me about EVERY cousin
RD_ALifeLine_49aa0b131f475f9f: She still had my jacket, and there was pie
RD_ALifeLine_352687885a4f4c67: I'm a rider, I don't walk, I ride
RD_ALifeLine_69f87fb93aa9955f: You're gonna ride a long way if you stop complaining
RD_ALifeLine_4f55f56f74af3c54: My ass hurts, and I haven't been on a seat in two days
RD_ALifeLine_08c60ed37d2b2dfd: It's different, it's a different ache
RD_ALifeLine_6cb27d402c41d5ba: Think the patch still means anything?
RD_ALifeLine_6da9a5886b19fa78: Was the answer before all this too
RD_ALifeLine_6cc2d4ed2d935dfc: Took a chunk right out of my leathers
RD_ALifeLine_3309ad8e258e99c1: Why you think I wear leather in summer, brother? Skin's fine
RD_ALifeLine_19c8ffa535ae993b: Roll it up and show me anyway
RD_ALifeLine_449fd286331014c7: I'm not riding on the back of your bike like a prom date
RD_ALifeLine_48531dc92f61edb3: Then walk it, prom queen, it's eleven miles
RD_ALifeLine_73a3b804377be003: It stepped out from behind the billboard, I had nowhere to go
RD_ALifeLine_4ec86e2f0eb95785: You had the whole left lane
RD_ALifeLine_479a095c6b2ece1d: Left lane had three more of 'em in it
RD_ALifeLine_680579063bbd1f31: Then you picked right, can you stand?
RD_ALifeLine_738a1a8c207bb9f7: Ask me again in a minute
RD_ALifeLine_0351e4de08d36ea7: Stack three tires, fill 'em with dirt, drop the seed potatoes in
RD_ALifeLine_78c7ea2934e38bd3: They're potato tires now, the rears hold more
RD_ALifeLine_744104f022c4b6a3: Not Dutch's old front tire, he'd come back and haunt the potatoes
RD_ALifeLine_579baffe19c62f24: Remember the ride out to South Dakota in eighty-six? Rain for three whole states
RD_ALifeLine_727f762b63724284: You dropped your bike at a gas station in Nebraska and blamed the pump
RD_ALifeLine_468c6dee76dd520e: Tell it right or don't tell it
RD_ALifeLine_66da9cce12c73d30: The pump was leaning a little
RD_ALifeLine_321c2b4f277a7b69: I remember a single headlight coming up the road
RD_ALifeLine_120ebfa2453778cf: Bike or a car with one burnt out?
RD_ALifeLine_26c25f312e6cf438: A two-stroke.. some kid on a dirt bike
RD_ALifeLine_17e9877d0349924f: Straight up to your gate?.. Brave or stupid
RD_ALifeLine_40859b784365a86f: Felt like the same thing that summer
RD_ALifeLine_43d448b655bbdc8d: Want me to pull parts off Deke's bike?
RD_ALifeLine_6cb82fcc28c58385: Carb off his would fit yours perfect
RD_ALifeLine_5a8d413a0c5cad13: I said no, put the cover back on it, Tuck the corners
RD_ALifeLine_66981a6900a7d893: Carb's gummed solid, gas went bad
RD_ALifeLine_53cdf6993690fc52: Gas don't go bad in a month
RD_ALifeLine_43bff0242b9dc185: This came out of a lawnmower can that's been in a shed since nineteen ninety
RD_ALifeLine_0cf876405bfb3195: Splash some of that white lightning in there, burns hot
RD_ALifeLine_08dda6ee46e36408: Put moonshine in my bike and I'll put you in the creek
RD_ALifeLine_72fe94fe70aa8dda: Road rash has to be scrubbed out, every bit of gravel
RD_ALifeLine_77a483285730e8ac: Unless you want gravel living in you the rest of your life, bite the glove
RD_ALifeLine_4ecd77b944b1376f: I laid it down in eighty-one, still got a piece of Tennessee in my elbow
RD_ALifeLine_0d9581e90c017129: Scrub it, I don't want a souvenir
RD_ALifeLine_3198c50729e6cc13: Nobody fires up till we're past the church, push 'em
RD_ALifeLine_587ec019176fdd43: Push seven hundred pounds of bike a quarter mile?
RD_ALifeLine_57711f485bdbabaf: Should've put the quiet mufflers on like my old lady said
RD_ALifeLine_2475fbd37ff216fb: Your old lady said a lot of things
RD_ALifeLine_2e835fc158e6db19: She was right about most of 'em, push
RD_ALifeLine_3d27092e08279b6c: My back's shot, thirty years on a hardtail
RD_ALifeLine_481666cb67efdf98: Lay flat on the concrete under the bridge, cold concrete fixes a back
RD_ALifeLine_3e72394a0626d88b: Every man who ever laid down on concrete
RD_ALifeLine_74e33b5e45298593: It's where we put Tiny, I just want to sit a minute
RD_ALifeLine_38a9d308068e2a95: Kill your engine, then, I'll sit too

RD_ALifeLine_233009ef05e08eb3: Two of them three ain't coming in, I move the magnets anyhow
RD_ALifeLine_608ac3126ddc9e8c: Six shot won't do it, you want slug or you want nothing
RD_ALifeLine_3c6f520812dd3189: We got a case and a half of slug for this whole office
RD_ALifeLine_2de6535e77aaa89f: Then that's what we got, count out five apiece and write down who took what
RD_ALifeLine_1a72a5000bfa88ca: They want the take-home cars back at the lot
RD_ALifeLine_5a2c438d679e3eb7: Gas in one place, one set of gates to watch, it's the right call and I still hate it
RD_ALifeLine_3223fd1d14fd4956: You hate walking home is what you hate
RD_ALifeLine_569053667b71ba52: Sheriff's office collects the property tax in Kentucky, we still got a drawer of bills
RD_ALifeLine_4f141ab74328b10d: Everything's county records, the county's dead, burn the damn bills
RD_ALifeLine_01b30e2b2c3654b5: New fella says 10-4 for everything. 10-4 this, 10-4 that
RD_ALifeLine_3fd626283f0d9619: Let him, it's the only part of the job he's sure about
RD_ALifeLine_779591e1730fb625: Trustees are still cooking, you believe that?
RD_ALifeLine_57f2a9324d33c6f8: Doors are open, fence is cut, beans go on at eleven and they're standing there stirring 'em
RD_ALifeLine_53d9174245fd1392: It's their kitchen too, where's a man go from a kitchen
RD_ALifeLine_21f7ba135d6f7900: I still iron the shirt, both sleeves, the collar, the crease down the pocket
RD_ALifeLine_14e06f977100aece: Ain't a soul left to inspect it, there's no inspection anymore
RD_ALifeLine_75e429de78472e9b: It's just I don't know what I am with it off
RD_ALifeLine_7bf832106b176d4f: Who do we answer to now? Truthfully
RD_ALifeLine_4d3fbe2b342b8519: Sheriff, then the county judge executive, then the governor
RD_ALifeLine_4d045eb77d6ff0fc: Sheriff's here, judge executive's in Florida, Governor's a voice somebody heard on a radio once
RD_ALifeLine_5f41316132721084: So we answer to the sheriff and the sheriff answers to nobody, say that one more time slow
RD_ALifeLine_127e1e297719a209: Once saw Cundiff's address on a call sheet
RD_ALifeLine_53ce4b204177d695: Cundiff off Halbert Street? Your Cundiff?
RD_ALifeLine_47486e0f24df2bd4: His wife called it in, then she quit talking and the line stayed open
RD_ALifeLine_718f0f656198274d: You offered to take the call?
RD_ALifeLine_4683c6193747d5ab: My partner wouldn't let me. Said he would, I still remember being relieved and ashamed at once
RD_ALifeLine_547e670c6ba80631: Wanda asked me last night if I'd quit, straight out, at the table
RD_ALifeLine_67252b5e7244821c: I said pass the salt, then I sat in the truck in the driveway till half past two
RD_ALifeLine_5c13daa53b757665: Worst call I ever got was a cat in a tree that turned out to be a raccoon
RD_ALifeLine_3fa1990e3ad69395: The raccoon bit the fireman, the fireman bit the cat, the cat bit me
RD_ALifeLine_6bf7583d0a774118: In Radcliff, that's exactly how it works
RD_ALifeLine_41eaed193395a0a0: My first week as a deputy, I pulled over the sheriff's mother
RD_ALifeLine_1e8840e331268a95: She was doing sixty in a thirty-five, I wrote her up, she thanked me
RD_ALifeLine_1eba8c125075bac4: Gave me a raise, said I had a spine
RD_ALifeLine_33db6dba2326bed5: I carry my dad's badge in my left pocket
RD_ALifeLine_01df1f521e1ca82c: Thirty-one years, Louisville PD, he died of his heart in his chair
RD_ALifeLine_2eac5964594ae5ae: That's what Mom says, but I'd rather he saw this, and told me what to do
RD_ALifeLine_4dd944ca2cd2ba67: First night of the outbreak, I got a call about a man screaming on Church Street
RD_ALifeLine_63f639c942bea490: I thought it was a drunk, I walked up with my flashlight, said 'sir, calm down'
RD_ALifeLine_0c2869382389188c: He turned around, and his eyes, I can't describe it, I emptied my gun and I still see his face
RD_ALifeLine_609606641f2ae10c: Don't be, I'm the one who wasn't ready
RD_ALifeLine_284c7e5a0852ead9: We had a K-9 named Duke
RD_ALifeLine_76eac56141c20842: Belgian Malinois, smartest dog I've ever met, he could open the cruiser door with his nose
RD_ALifeLine_0eb75a6035b7165e: I don't know, I had to leave him with the handler, he was on a chain, I told him to be good
RD_ALifeLine_74cc83b329e1ec58: He always was, that's the part that kills me
RD_ALifeLine_319dc20720699d60: Funniest call I ever took, a woman reported a UFO over Radcliff
RD_ALifeLine_3a40cc02080910da: It was a Goodyear blimp, I told her, she said 'that's what the government wants you to think'
RD_ALifeLine_1ba78e9e5fd4021a: I wrote it up, 'Subject believes blimp is extraterrestrial,' the chief framed it
RD_ALifeLine_72c5bf4005671f67: I once talked a man down from a bridge
RD_ALifeLine_4d96d69645088014: He had a gun in one hand and a photo in the other, I talked for three hours
RD_ALifeLine_5e07a3950937826a: He climbed down, I drove him to the hospital, he sent me a postcard every year
RD_ALifeLine_5099f3f70d4bb6b1: Same message, 'still here', I hope this year's card is in a mailbox somewhere
RD_ALifeLine_09d982ba45e94c61: My dad was the sheriff before me
RD_ALifeLine_31ea4893604f745b: He used to say 'the badge is heavy only if you carry it alone'
RD_ALifeLine_19858b6c421cbbed: He died when I was twenty-six, I've carried it alone ever since
RD_ALifeLine_38a1c3d70fa42e96: Reyes took a bite on the forearm
RD_ALifeLine_14e9136309a07b3d: Bad enough that he asked me to do it, and I did
RD_ALifeLine_08ee45161497e138: Hey, thanks for the cover back there
RD_ALifeLine_526fc5aa5c97388d: How many rounds do you have left?
RD_ALifeLine_37ab6c8765921eeb: Then we're not fighting anything else today
RD_ALifeLine_22ca45307eded015: To me, I'll write it down, so it exists
RD_ALifeLine_055749377fbd74d4: Fifteen infected, one civilian lost, two officers wounded
RD_ALifeLine_3016b09540e77a3f: Take ten, I've got the watch
RD_ALifeLine_16158f2569070eb7: Wake me if you hear anything
RD_ALifeLine_4c1018bd5c958d59: I'll hear everything, that's the problem
RD_ALifeLine_56b6a6c077eaaf01: A box of ammo, a first aid kit
RD_ALifeLine_77e91a504e87818b: Good, we only search the shelves
RD_ALifeLine_741d894a52594990: If you can crack it, crack it quietly
RD_ALifeLine_306cb24654489403: Name, then, and where you're headed
RD_ALifeLine_477e8ede03150ca0: Frank Miller, my sister's in Bardstown
RD_ALifeLine_668d540f2e309c43: Pass, but stay on the road
RD_ALifeLine_79bb622c35552c8d: Quiet means we live another hour
RD_ALifeLine_2f57d7d6019d685a: That's one way to look at it
RD_ALifeLine_48e394d859fd2865: Hold on, I want a second to look
RD_ALifeLine_6fa11ecf13931705: Hold fire, let it come, don't waste a round
RD_ALifeLine_244bae2c093ae584: Friendly Frank, from the north road
RD_ALifeLine_151fa2ed652688bc: Collins is good with a rifle, tolerate the snoring
RD_ALifeLine_342122ff41a32f1c: Best five minutes of the day
RD_ALifeLine_43b822b41d0e2fa6: Walk the left, I'll take the right
RD_ALifeLine_0a0223d3228b0b3e: Keep your hand off your holster
RD_ALifeLine_0f6751aa3fc140c7: Try again at the next corner
RD_ALifeLine_21a3d3a23baf962d: Nothing at the next one either
RD_ALifeLine_022499467f42a1b0: Hold up, I'll check the corner
RD_ALifeLine_079bb78214a009f8: Two miles my ass, that's three!
RD_ALifeLine_314077a2422f408a: It's two and a bit, a very slow bit
RD_ALifeLine_2ab3d90329cc245e: It's a new pair of boots
RD_ALifeLine_430886a813900aa3: It's pointing at the earth, what do you want
RD_ALifeLine_3393b86629613bd0: I wrote a ticket on that stretch every Tuesday
RD_ALifeLine_45aa260e08d92664: It's gonna be gone in an hour
RD_ALifeLine_57eb967c076741f0: Then we'll walk faster in an hour
RD_ALifeLine_6f8c42c42ca5930f: You don't have to say that
RD_ALifeLine_7630e9cf39fbc875: There's no one on the other end
RD_ALifeLine_0c27bc1c0c466d13: Slow down, the Sergeant's getting winded
RD_ALifeLine_2ab3d6b33f96460b: You're making a noise like a bellows
RD_ALifeLine_64977611298b1492: I keep checking the bumper for it, there's no bumper
RD_ALifeLine_417851467a6e6e72: It's a shotgun and a bag of canned corn, you're not fine
RD_ALifeLine_54911417606794a2: Take the corn, I'll take the shotgun
RD_ALifeLine_4e903e030e8a07e5: I forget, I just wanted to whistle
RD_ALifeLine_160c1d3f53309663: I can't close it, you're walking slow
RD_ALifeLine_644b3de659b4c79c: I'm walking at the speed of my feet
RD_ALifeLine_49bfbc93520c45bf: This is the road I drove to work every morning
RD_ALifeLine_4203bd5b0f23de62: Seven a.m., every day, I'd wave at the guy with the dog
RD_ALifeLine_2860e35a75ff7559: I walked a beat in Louisville once
RD_ALifeLine_35431ec4601ba828: Oxfords are not made for this
RD_ALifeLine_6109542d247bbb43: There, by the curb, it's all over
RD_ALifeLine_5ee2837336b805ce: I see it, I see it
RD_ALifeLine_49ef7bc731d44e23: I wrote this road a hundred tickets
RD_ALifeLine_00996c3d0bbf1bf7: I was a very hated man, in a very good mood
RD_ALifeLine_70afaf757e24259a: Back roads, I know them all, ask me anything
RD_ALifeLine_2de047a365c25a6a: Which way to the next town?
RD_ALifeLine_38f285cf5f22c751: Me too, it's in my head, it's a habit
RD_ALifeLine_5047bc156f5b93f8: I know it's on my chest, I'm checking
RD_ALifeLine_2eb137414084be0b: We know, you've checked eleven times
RD_ALifeLine_62e101ba45cce726: He's got his eyes closed and he's still going
RD_ALifeLine_7c85c36d15320f75: That's a skill, I'd like that skill
RD_ALifeLine_5a95f047283a9a18: Never walked this much on duty
RD_ALifeLine_6ddf6bac0f82a289: I rode in a unit for nine years
RD_ALifeLine_7f90767e7b051d4e: Where do you think they put the evidence?
RD_ALifeLine_5467e2974fc21517: From the cases, the lockers, there's a whole building of it
RD_ALifeLine_26928fb65e82f18d: Nobody's thinking about that right now
RD_ALifeLine_0d40c371717cb14e: I'm looking, I'm very thorough with nothing
RD_ALifeLine_0a51a0cf3798ad7b: I'm so damn tired of walking
RD_ALifeLine_4b0647165b8c55a3: I used to drive four miles to get a donut
RD_ALifeLine_481c281a6ed12c15: And now you walk four miles for nothing
RD_ALifeLine_11b3bbb27e4288f6: I walked this beat when I was twenty-two, it was nothing but kids on bikes
RD_ALifeLine_312b299f258cfba3: Now it's the quietest road in the county, and I hate it
RD_ALifeLine_1f8e3d90658bbf1a: If I see one more mailbox I'm gonna shoot it
RD_ALifeLine_111cf25d15531e50: It's been following us, it's the same one
RD_ALifeLine_69060f3b1aa83159: The only thing I miss about the car is the heater
RD_ALifeLine_1cd2dbb818ff0b1f: In January, I'm saying, I miss it in January
RD_ALifeLine_30094fc04f7b32e5: If I step in one more goddamn pothole
RD_ALifeLine_7916d7772e6994a9: I am watching, the potholes are wearing camouflage
RD_ALifeLine_7cdfe4563b2dfcdc: My feet hurt, my back hurts, my vest hurts
RD_ALifeLine_455585a61f67f8be: This one does, it's got a vendetta
RD_ALifeLine_3d74dfee1fd3611f: Take it off and carry it
RD_ALifeLine_6e79e3ed617ae2fc: Did you hear that? Is that a car?
RD_ALifeLine_4246255c0b76fa2b: The only thing I miss about being on duty is the lights and siren
RD_ALifeLine_29420a8c2402abec: I miss going somewhere with a siren, that's all
RD_ALifeLine_438f6ac50141698c: I used to drive this road with the windows down, singing
RD_ALifeLine_5fa3a940009a7e6a: No, but I used to, and nobody told me to shut up
RD_ALifeLine_0028fdc35acc48c2: You walk like a very tired rookie
RD_ALifeLine_2ca355c470688e24: Eyes up, hands off your weapons, this isn't a damn parade
RD_ALifeLine_4aacd6cb3ca62af7: Then walk like you mean it!
RD_ALifeLine_17e216b34e361295: If I step in one more cow pie I'm writing the cow a ticket
RD_ALifeLine_157034784f3ae3f9: We used to patrol this road in a car, you remember, windows down
RD_ALifeLine_172fc8367a3896a8: I never knew how long it was until I had to walk it
RD_ALifeLine_29641bce6c32c4eb: Every Christmas Eve I worked the late shift so the younger guys could be with their kids
RD_ALifeLine_3ea94c53223281b8: Usually, people are gentler on Christmas Eve, even the drunks
RD_ALifeLine_2597ea64259ac207: A woman handed me a plate of cookies through my window and said "for the officer who's alone tonight." I cried in the car
RD_ALifeLine_186dc2e97f585b7d: Lost it, but I remember the cookies, oatmeal, with raisins
RD_ALifeLine_117a4a6152288008: For six years I heard the same dispatcher every night, voice like warm tea, never saw her face
RD_ALifeLine_38188d2b23c6f9de: Once, at a retirement party, she was shorter than I expected, wore glasses on a chain
RD_ALifeLine_2233b7a50bc6e514: Not a bit, I told her she saved my life a dozen times with that voice, she laughed
RD_ALifeLine_5698bed6561d2e77: She sounds like a good woman
RD_ALifeLine_438d9e2037a4f98a: Her name was Doris, I keep hoping I'll hear her on the radio
RD_ALifeLine_3830ff673e44948c: Our old sheriff once arrested himself, seriously
RD_ALifeLine_406ec5e10cc2b434: Drove home from the VFW, blew a stop sign, saw the lights in his own mirror, wrote himself a ticket
RD_ALifeLine_66e140395d8bee13: Paid it, framed the receipt, hung it over the desk, best sheriff I ever worked for
RD_ALifeLine_19d7765c48d251e8: Cardiac, before any of this, I'm almost glad he missed it
RD_ALifeLine_10188f281a9c7b1d: The first day, we had forty officers in the county, by nightfall, nine
RD_ALifeLine_1c07a5712ec0b828: Some stood their ground, some went home to family, I can't blame either
RD_ALifeLine_597b907f46ac3c96: I stayed, told myself it was duty, truth is, nobody was waiting for me
RD_ALifeLine_0fff503c7716e3a3: Don't be, it made me useful, a man with no one to go home to can hold a street
RD_ALifeLine_6417c24b6d2a210c: Four of us used to take the first week of October and go fishing at Nolin Lake, no phones, no pagers
RD_ALifeLine_0be84061156981ca: We never caught a thing, we'd sit and argue about the Wildcats, drink coffee from a thermos
RD_ALifeLine_7f213bc325052a1d: It was a great life, I just didn't know it at the time
RD_ALifeLine_21e666612ef21c98: I had a K9 partner named Duke, German shepherd, hundred pounds, smarter than the sergeant
RD_ALifeLine_043dcf6310a7c656: He ran toward the noise on the third day, I called him back, he didn't come
RD_ALifeLine_7a5554f62a0dbfc2: He was, I took his tags and kept the leash, some nights I put it in my pocket and walk the perimeter
RD_ALifeLine_064966a53dd7b362: It gives my hand something to hold
RD_ALifeLine_3ff72ebe74506aa4: I gave my badge sticker to a kid once, a little boy at a bike safety rodeo
RD_ALifeLine_2b062cb9082f01f3: Asked if I could arrest his sister, I said not today, he looked heartbroken
RD_ALifeLine_202731b65cb128a4: Years later I saw him at the grocery, grown man, a deputy himself, he stuck a sticker on my coat
RD_ALifeLine_0a08f66f557b4639: I think about that when I'm tired, it keeps me up straight
RD_ALifeLine_6bfb901151eda7e8: I worked a missing persons case that I never closed, a girl, sixteen, outside Rosewood
RD_ALifeLine_25eb4805340d559a: Never, three years, every Sunday I drove those back roads, I think of her more than the ones I did solve
RD_ALifeLine_22ae58e77756cb01: That's what I tell myself, alive, somewhere, grown up, laughing
RD_ALifeLine_498797bd3bcb1931: It has to be, otherwise I've been driving for nothing
RD_ALifeLine_1b2e42595d008722: Four years ago we cleared a cabin up in the hills, a man holed up with two hostages, three days
RD_ALifeLine_51081a4c14aa6bba: Nobody fired, we talked him out, one of the negotiators had been his Sunday school teacher
RD_ALifeLine_7af7663f3344b5bb: He gave up crying and asked if he could call his mother first, we said yes
RD_ALifeLine_2bc6e3aa79e24000: The best kind, Rarest, too, I'd like another one of those
RD_ALifeLine_678d11b57b21302e: My first week on the job, I got locked in the back of my own cruiser by a drunk who stole my keys
RD_ALifeLine_7e27434e5ac03961: Two hours, the whole shift watched from the donut shop and took bets
RD_ALifeLine_2f86b0ba5790941a: The sergeant bought me coffee after and said, "Now you're one of us"
RD_ALifeLine_5f3a2bc7065a4315: It's the only reason I stayed, you don't forget being laughed at by people who like you
RD_ALifeLine_4a99a77a7d041910: Our training facility was an old furniture warehouse near Fort Knox, plywood walls, a leaky roof
RD_ALifeLine_48e2bde7303c9b2d: We'd run entries until the sun came up and then go eat at the diner across the road
RD_ALifeLine_53aa75854bc095a1: Same waitress, same pie, she always asked how many we'd arrested, we always said none
RD_ALifeLine_2cfc5b2e5c873ac2: Because nobody ever believed us, she slipped us extra whipped cream anyway
RD_ALifeLine_6ab7ded82fbc0680: Worst call I ever took was a traffic stop on 31W at two in the morning, a man in a pickup, forty miles over
RD_ALifeLine_655f174c51fc8f95: Cold sober, his wife was in labor in the passenger seat, I led him to the hospital with the lights on
RD_ALifeLine_50ed7a240c250907: Seven minutes to spare, he named the boy after me, I still get a card from them
RD_ALifeLine_35628f4925e11593: It's the best one, I hold onto it on nights like this
RD_ALifeLine_0a1c673e349fa595: State's response team is eleven men and nine of 'em live in Louisville
RD_ALifeLine_25a49aeb222aaf16: We've got two, a shield, and the ram out of a trunk that's sitting in Elizabethtown
RD_ALifeLine_7df362b01eb4f610: Then quit calling it a team, call it Sowders and Whitt and plan accordingly
RD_ALifeLine_511022a96a3894a2: Take your boot off at the next halt, I've got moleskin
RD_ALifeLine_61ef97f03cf93988: You walk like you're on parade
RD_ALifeLine_0a45c7170df99c8e: You walk like there's nothing behind us
RD_ALifeLine_3decdde65790f5a4: I'm trying not to puke, give me a minute
RD_ALifeLine_2ff91e101bdc7280: Supply asked if my feet were different sizes
RD_ALifeLine_4781e73942aae660: Boots were, nine and eleven, told me to wear thicker socks
RD_ALifeLine_028917917bded674: I asked that, guy shut the window on me
RD_ALifeLine_7f5bd46d31d05062: I cleaned UNDER the damn chair, for inspection
RD_ALifeLine_0058dfa711cf476b: He wiped the seat, dust everywhere, I'd forgotten the fucking seat
RD_ALifeLine_51709e0731359393: Last letter I sent, I told Mom nothing was happening
RD_ALifeLine_67246bfc48e80455: Before all this, I just... that's the last thing she heard from me
RD_ALifeLine_4883ae337b46e25e: You didn't know, neither did I
RD_ALifeLine_1504403940d405dc: It's a heavy fuckin' weapon, it droops
RD_ALifeLine_32d9cf0b03cdde3d: It's an Army answer, don't ask again
RD_ALifeLine_144966e83d1c5f86: I'm so goddamn tired I could fall asleep walking
RD_ALifeLine_62702eb633ce86d3: What kind of question is that?
RD_ALifeLine_71b2759e4d4709e1: We're the ones with the guns, that's close enough
RD_ALifeLine_07168f4f5b6aa99e: That's the new guy, he's always behind us
RD_ALifeLine_6948123c43685b9e: Ruck's got a hole in it
RD_ALifeLine_2f291b116c5a1fa7: I used the last of the duct tape on my boots
RD_ALifeLine_5264d89137f20261: If you start singing a cadence I'm shooting you
RD_ALifeLine_1e3a971b1f2cfb57: Hurry the fuck up, we're falling behind
RD_ALifeLine_3f4e9fc75ec7ec4f: We're not falling behind, we're walking
RD_ALifeLine_18768bad247794bf: If I take my boots off I'm never gonna get 'em back on
RD_ALifeLine_2f355325079aa11d: That's a risk I'm willing to take
RD_ALifeLine_784e04e7397c135e: You're gonna regret that, my feet are a biohazard
RD_ALifeLine_0fffa7bd027ab4b8: Don't look at the side of the road
RD_ALifeLine_6ab3041d76a45ef8: Yeah you were, I saw your head turn
RD_ALifeLine_0d59b38f3d2ac2fa: How much farther? And don't say two klicks
RD_ALifeLine_15a075b64ee5a7b6: I fuckin' told you not to say it
RD_ALifeLine_68308bc63b04e97e: Close it up, you're twenty meters back, you want a medal for being slow?
RD_ALifeLine_5fa64f764a23eece: Then bleed faster, we're losing light!
RD_ALifeLine_6a9cbe0b79236c61: Rest stop in twenty, then we push through
RD_ALifeLine_38e1d12d779d2ce2: Wherever the map says, it's your map, you tell me
RD_ALifeLine_3acd2483347b1d48: I was meant to be helping my brother move this weekend
RD_ALifeLine_79dce871383bbf34: I'd rather be carrying his damn sofa
RD_ALifeLine_30c472ca12ae3ae2: Yeah, I'd help with the other end
RD_ALifeLine_7cbf796213584013: A few, don't spend them for me
RD_ALifeLine_7447c99d7c87f942: Two mags a man, Sergeant, no casualties, lost one canteen
RD_ALifeLine_62dd308f673c0ba6: Mine, it's still hooked on one of them
RD_ALifeLine_42d14dda48b2fdcd: Sergeant, that one was wearing Guard fatigues
RD_ALifeLine_17e7c11f0290b6ba: Pick up your brass, Private, every piece, count it out loud for me
RD_ALifeLine_650a91af42502fd1: It was checked, it was full when it got checked
RD_ALifeLine_61bb5fe96353b6f1: Sergeant, the wrecker was the first vehicle we lost
RD_ALifeLine_796085a91f59602f: I know that, I like saying it
RD_ALifeLine_7a6a471e1b93dafa: Radio's under me, I think I'm lying on the radio
RD_ALifeLine_458c04b334720feb: Get off the radio, Private, the radio's more fragile than you are
RD_ALifeLine_3d2a69c047e26bdd: Twelve years in the Army and I'm out here hoeing beans
RD_ALifeLine_68ad2d4833e2383c: The Army's hoeing beans, you're just the part of it in this row
RD_ALifeLine_782d32ff187303ca: Sergeant wants the rows dressed right, like a formation
RD_ALifeLine_4418590a3ba434ab: They're beans, they don't know what dress right is
RD_ALifeLine_6502441d610bde16: Then teach 'em, he's coming down the row with a tape measure
RD_ALifeLine_3169fd7827abb90d: Barn on the Harlow place still has last year's burley hanging in it
RD_ALifeLine_5bc4068b6b8ebf7e: That's worth more than ammunition right now
RD_ALifeLine_7988b7c45a47f067: You could cook a whole cow on it from Indiana, pull half those logs, now
RD_ALifeLine_29e76a59166503ac: What were you doing the Thursday night before?
RD_ALifeLine_4b45d59825e1d46b: Laundry, folded it all real neat, too, never did put it away

RD_ALifeLine_79c20edd6665a452: Then I stand up and answer for all three of them sentences
RD_ALifeLine_0656e35137b5edb0: Say 'em again, Sergeant, slow, I want to have 'em right
RD_ALifeLine_233a4f0553deb2ac: Farmer wants to cross and feed his cattle, forty head on the far side
RD_ALifeLine_14ee35ae700b4c76: He ain't leaving, he'll stand there till the cows are dead and then stand there some more
RD_ALifeLine_2f7057ed1e05f69c: Escort him, two men, one hour, and my name goes on it
RD_ALifeLine_1c4bd4be33a54ade: Ran wire out to post two so we quit burning batteries on the radio
RD_ALifeLine_50da2c1b418d18c0: Six hundred meters of commo wire through a bean field, crank it twice and Whitt picks up
RD_ALifeLine_019539a1001085f1: Somebody's going to ask, I'd rather be the one who knows
RD_ALifeLine_3de351bf742d7945: The road, ten feet ahead of a Ford, it stopped, everybody's alive and I'm going to be sick now
RD_ALifeLine_7a61f1852bcdfc9e: One flare left at post three
RD_ALifeLine_339eb90927032304: Save it for a person, not for them
RD_ALifeLine_3572be766c965691: How do I tell the difference in the dark?
RD_ALifeLine_777de4ec13b41ea4: A person stops when you holler, every single time, that's how
RD_ALifeLine_1114a45d1cad6ed9: They had us in the mask and the suit two hours Tuesday, ninety-four degrees
RD_ALifeLine_53ec2f004e242046: Somebody upstairs thought it was chemical, it ain't, you don't catch it out of the air
RD_ALifeLine_58fabd831e6ebe7c: The medic, then he told me not to say who told me
RD_ALifeLine_07534fee28f78839: I remember wire so hot you couldn't touch it bare-handed
RD_ALifeLine_06a1e4a97b1e2c33: Kept telling the boy at post two to take a break. Proud enough to go down before asking
RD_ALifeLine_70bb29b06c7fcd9b: I'll take that order in writing, sir
RD_ALifeLine_39c3fcaa0edb44c0: I know exactly how it sounds, I still want it on paper with your name at the bottom
RD_ALifeLine_7d335b015683e68a: Is that number just them, or is it everybody?
RD_ALifeLine_56828ed059f45b6c: Don't ask me that on the line
RD_ALifeLine_21a7fc304c5d03c0: It's everybody, come find me tonight and I'll give you the split
RD_ALifeLine_1f7a321054ef7e70: Kerns come back up to the wire and asked for his rifle
RD_ALifeLine_11d996057652a861: Asked him what he'd do if a truck came at him right now
RD_ALifeLine_1a78b7473211387c: I said engine block and holler, twice, then holler again
RD_ALifeLine_5627ac18234974e7: Did he refuse or did he freeze?
RD_ALifeLine_06d00fc14493e8c6: Sat there with the safety on and his thumb laid across it
RD_ALifeLine_011844c10194d5fc: Then he didn't refuse and he didn't freeze, he decided, we're calling it a malfunction
RD_ALifeLine_7a0f97fb629cd76e: Log's up to page nine, time, event, who, same as they taught me in 1981
RD_ALifeLine_0d429adf17ae4344: Page nine's mostly one line, nothing to report, nothing to report
RD_ALifeLine_6069f41e261f83f4: Day I ain't got that to write is the day I'd rather have already quit
RD_ALifeLine_70e245967ebeb164: Sergeant, is that a lawful order?
RD_ALifeLine_19ea307f6c110cd6: Say that again, but think about it first
RD_ALifeLine_6e87c61d1026768d: I'm asking, turn back vehicles, warning shots, then fire into the vehicle, is that lawful?
RD_ALifeLine_5d2e45844c7da4a0: It's on the card, it came down on a card
RD_ALifeLine_0ca8dfcd0c5b9aa8: A card ain't a law, neither is me saying it, which is exactly why he asked
RD_ALifeLine_4876fc1f569d6e25: Mail truck ain't come since the second
RD_ALifeLine_1338291b177bd308: Write 'em anyway, put 'em in the bag
RD_ALifeLine_48f1fad77b177a37: Bag's under the cot with forty letters in it
RD_ALifeLine_2007af864c54f336: Then the bag's forty men who still think somebody's coming to get it, leave it be
RD_ALifeLine_72f6b9bf40780565: Write it down, time, who said it, what it was
RD_ALifeLine_32fbc5e47f21019e: Why? Nobody's coming to read it
RD_ALifeLine_6ffa438b23a7fcb1: Somebody always comes to read it, eleven years I've watched somebody come read the book
RD_ALifeLine_6fb40fc143413334: Said he'd give it verbally in front of witnesses
RD_ALifeLine_56f584150017b541: That's a no, that's a man telling you no in a long way
RD_ALifeLine_07037fcc3ebdb3e0: Lieutenant's twenty-four with a map and a flashlight and he is trying
RD_ALifeLine_2e5062b16127f6ed: He's also wrong about the culvert
RD_ALifeLine_46ff0b6970c8684e: He's wrong about the culvert, tell him at the truck, not in front of the posts
RD_ALifeLine_72c9187d15bb979f: We drew A1s out of the armory, skinny barrel, full auto, front sight you set with a bullet tip
RD_ALifeLine_225578ac3e1d4a26: Regular Army's got a lot of things, we got what was on the rack and one bore brush
RD_ALifeLine_05c21ec81e1dc9c3: Hold the road at Ekron, don't let anybody through, we'll send relief
RD_ALifeLine_7633e3d214b74adc: That's the word he used, I wrote it in the log with the time beside it
RD_ALifeLine_454ddd945f902e5f: Woman's been standing at the wire since noon, won't sit, won't take water
RD_ALifeLine_11e0455f2762c5ef: Her boy's on the other side at his grandmother's, he's nine years old
RD_ALifeLine_55788d03527b8e2d: I know we can't, I'm telling you she is still standing there
RD_ALifeLine_24d632c43adfe385: Sir, I'm not passing that one down
RD_ALifeLine_55e4ac0e2307353f: You want it done, walk out to the wire and tell 'em yourself, I'll stand right there with you
RD_ALifeLine_5cc078a54cd7f5c2: He ain't coming out to the wire
RD_ALifeLine_54d9c733632bb99d: Fifty percent security tonight, one up, one down, two hour shifts
RD_ALifeLine_7201e28f06ff4cb9: Nobody's sleeping anyway, at least this way it's official
RD_ALifeLine_3bd6aea67f3cb317: I've got a nephew nineteen, he bags groceries at the Sav Rite
RD_ALifeLine_0e81c2e746164eae: That's what I did before drill weekend
RD_ALifeLine_6c4e486269763aeb: Rodgers' leg's laid open from the wire and the aid station is a tent with one cot in it
RD_ALifeLine_17c3427f6b72aa15: Post four's been on the line thirty-one hours
RD_ALifeLine_1717b3ef38893d15: With who? Eleven men for three posts and two of them eleven are sick
RD_ALifeLine_4815391612b33d13: Nobody's been relieved, not one post, not once, since the sixth
RD_ALifeLine_5acb591422efce82: I rotate 'em between three holes so it feels like something's happening
RD_ALifeLine_6a035f9c78f55051: They know what I'm doing, they let me do it 'cause it makes me feel better, and they're kind
RD_ALifeLine_69dad88c03cdf458: Folks out there think we're the bad ones
RD_ALifeLine_41e2ed9964c04840: Course they do, we're the ones with the wire
RD_ALifeLine_6f39a15e26859c44: I've got a cousin on the far side
RD_ALifeLine_7998ba745198436b: Everybody's got a cousin on the far side, post two, both of 'em do
RD_ALifeLine_19dec694232e29c6: I swore to obey the orders of the officers appointed over me
RD_ALifeLine_56d7488012dd3577: You also swore to support and defend the Constitution, they put that part first
RD_ALifeLine_091acaef052ba746: You reckon somebody wrote it in that order on purpose?
RD_ALifeLine_4a342abf68883b44: I reckon whoever wrote it knew exactly what he was doing, yeah
RD_ALifeLine_3578d4b5200c1a32: Handset's got tape on the cord and the squelch is shot
RD_ALifeLine_122a49e42e0488bc: It transmits, it just don't quit hissing, after a while you hear people in the hiss
RD_ALifeLine_3ccf0e4a7b38be11: There's a state trooper on the low band taking messages at seven
RD_ALifeLine_643c238f4b99cb2c: So I asked him to tell a family their road closes, somebody local ought to say it, not us
RD_ALifeLine_62c8e0857dae703a: Warn, warn again, Disable the vehicle, then, quote, defend the line
RD_ALifeLine_55c5e45f3d7fda2c: Defend the line, that's the part they left soft on purpose
RD_ALifeLine_59e911793e844f27: I remember a school bus stopping at the wire.. full up
RD_ALifeLine_7cd88b821017be56: Woman in a church dress.. maybe thirty passengers half were kids
RD_ALifeLine_23d8115a0e406903: Nothing crossed.. nobody wrote down what to do about a bus
RD_ALifeLine_09422e086f5b9602: Range card's done, steeple at three hundred, culvert at one fifty, mailbox at ninety
RD_ALifeLine_652380982f822629: 'Cause past the mailbox you're out of choices, and I'd rather have a number than a feeling
RD_ALifeLine_05ed208a17018a90: You ain't eaten since yesterday, Sarge
RD_ALifeLine_548da08436020c72: I'll eat when the posts eat
RD_ALifeLine_596acc474c38148e: Posts ate at four, I carried it out myself, both of 'em
RD_ALifeLine_67c91894527e2120: ... Then hand me one and quit looking at me like that
RD_ALifeLine_7f307d7b487e26b2: A sergeant major come through in a humvee Saturday, stood on the road about a minute
RD_ALifeLine_0a02a642258c7168: Told me my wire was sloppy, then shook my hand and said stay off the net after dark
RD_ALifeLine_2807c474271e06ec: Which part you reckon was the real message?
RD_ALifeLine_70c7f99f4761567a: The handshake, he was not a handshake kind of man
RD_ALifeLine_1062616577bbaf15: Fever, won't eat, Napier's got a bandage on his forearm he won't take off
RD_ALifeLine_0c79b8dd53359981: Then you already know, say it or don't, but you know
RD_ALifeLine_57688b0f75566ea9: You're wearing the old steel pot?
RD_ALifeLine_52c0812b3154971e: Kevlar's in the truck, steel pot's got a liner I can sit on and a shell I can wash socks in
RD_ALifeLine_7357bcbb1f8f8bc1: You cannot wash socks in a helmet
RD_ALifeLine_4181984c3a2e5368: My uncle did in Korea, I'm keeping the story and the helmet both
RD_ALifeLine_42ea683901638b6e: Nothing on that card works on 'em, the card was wrote for people
RD_ALifeLine_4cc5f63a4e92667a: Sergeant took my rifle off me
RD_ALifeLine_3b1d3e467f1ad56d: Be glad, better him than the other way that goes
RD_ALifeLine_77e04bac2b2d8d85: One weekend a month, two weeks a year, that's what the man at the mall told me
RD_ALifeLine_365593025c6c0f8b: Recruiter told me I'd learn diesel
RD_ALifeLine_2c281d40678d4592: I learned diesel, I did not learn this
RD_ALifeLine_62069bdd0f3d64e6: Warning shots go over, over, into the field, where they can see the dirt jump
RD_ALifeLine_5ba060836abc013a: Then the engine block, and you pray the driver's got sense enough to stop
RD_ALifeLine_2e7a8d785729b8e5: Set a canteen down on the road and walked back, that ain't opening the wire
RD_ALifeLine_1761454d1aada65f: No it ain't, don't do it again where the lieutenant can see you
RD_ALifeLine_4e9745111dd90f47: You want me to go after him?
RD_ALifeLine_58e143fc5e9d2c81: With what authority and in whose truck?
RD_ALifeLine_5ac13c6c1eff27b8: That's a no, mark him absent and let the paper do it
RD_ALifeLine_6932bdb027b61b9f: Somebody's name has got to be on this
RD_ALifeLine_5010bf8c09de5037: My name's already on the duty roster and the ammo receipt, one more line won't change my week
RD_ALifeLine_74984d411ff085c9: First night this fire's for warm instead of for cooking
RD_ALifeLine_599eb61d50d48f3a: Fella on the CB says it's the twelfth, so I'm calling it the twelfth
RD_ALifeLine_01cc106f08c99154: He'd have taken one look at this county and turned the boats around
RD_ALifeLine_2a56d71f023f7fa6: Basic training, Fort Knox, summer of '87
RD_ALifeLine_792c7e5815f0db0f: A hundred and four, we ran in full gear, a kid passed out, we carried him
RD_ALifeLine_754ed6ca65f1a127: He's a doctor now, or he was, you never know anymore
RD_ALifeLine_51a608dd116bf595: First time I saw the ocean I was nineteen, off a transport in the Gulf
RD_ALifeLine_6674ea0d2ba96494: Huge, and gray, and then the shelling started
RD_ALifeLine_639172d96c81da4a: But for about ten seconds there, it was the prettiest thing I ever saw
RD_ALifeLine_756467b62baa44f2: Because I was tall and thin and always breaking at the worst moment
RD_ALifeLine_4d558dcc07f4aca1: Every time I get scared, 'Pencil, you're not made of glass'
RD_ALifeLine_248f01833b6309d7: Desert Storm, February '91, we were stuck in a ditch for two days
RD_ALifeLine_4ea72203379385df: It poured sideways, one guy lost his boots, another his mind
RD_ALifeLine_6885430e688be84e: We sang, 'Country Roads,' all forty of us, in the mud, in the dark
RD_ALifeLine_3b150cfa6828b134: Not a bit, but I still remember the harmony
RD_ALifeLine_6f2375fd7efdf258: My first night in basic, I cried in the latrine for an hour
RD_ALifeLine_1c3b89bd36584550: The drill sergeant found me, he didn't yell, he just handed me a towel and said 'finish and come out'
RD_ALifeLine_7b7317e02efd7c12: He's the reason I stayed, I think about him every time I'm scared
RD_ALifeLine_08d7760f58296fcf: I got a Dear John letter in the Gulf
RD_ALifeLine_43a82acd60b658fb: She wrote 'I met someone,' in purple ink, with a smiley face
RD_ALifeLine_3e2ae3997ac0b1a7: I laughed so hard I cried, then I cried so hard I laughed, the sergeant thought I'd cracked
RD_ALifeLine_229cff437fd4729e: Best meal of my service was a can of peaches in the desert
RD_ALifeLine_3a7996c013a0f30f: We found a crate in an abandoned truck, six of us, one can each
RD_ALifeLine_6941ea3f05e35a5f: Better, it tasted like home, like Georgia, like my grandma's cobbler
RD_ALifeLine_177b81821c7613c9: Don't thank me, thank the training
RD_ALifeLine_58c1f8684762863d: Four mags, half a mag, a bad attitude
RD_ALifeLine_5eaf218e46ef5845: That's right, if you didn't, I'd worry
RD_ALifeLine_2c5509e81a15976a: It gets quieter, which is different
RD_ALifeLine_2e86ec544a866d88: How long can we hold here?
RD_ALifeLine_736fcca2631040dc: Don't rush a search.. I don't want something coming up behind us
RD_ALifeLine_7d36ed614a8b7582: Food.. batteries a flashlight that works
RD_ALifeLine_6aa8a4273a32d75e: Then we look for those.. and we don't split up
RD_ALifeLine_704ce986564df256: Roll up your sleeves, one at a time
RD_ALifeLine_4068992e6d94fb32: It's the helmet, sir, it's heavy
RD_ALifeLine_4cbc1ec42c56f0e0: Splash some water on your face, I'll take it from here
RD_ALifeLine_13a6ed3870622644: I miss somebody saying coffee's ready
RD_ALifeLine_505e63e9233fc17b: I'd take that lie just to have the morning back
RD_ALifeLine_1715ea8628ea0051: I still think about the crowd at that barrier
RD_ALifeLine_24f447294364ddb3: And somebody told you check for bites.. one at a time
RD_ALifeLine_28a3421332b4b1bc: What were we supposed to do if one was bitten?
RD_ALifeLine_1ce570ac1cd1fa00: That's the question nobody wanted to answer out loud
RD_ALifeLine_548372cb44ffaa50: Quiet is just quiet, don't overthink it
RD_ALifeLine_6e8423d66b41388b: It's a rucksack, it doesn't kill anybody
RD_ALifeLine_681f770d6e290b68: Drink it, that's not a request
RD_ALifeLine_7c59086e75dd50a7: Where are we on the map?
RD_ALifeLine_3877bfe747dd1c5a: I know what it is, I'm saying it out loud
RD_ALifeLine_72934e0f52e3d0f9: Land nav was my best subject
RD_ALifeLine_354b908a7a59cd78: We're not lost, we're on an alternate route
RD_ALifeLine_4b61ac1a25c6a859: That's lost with a better name
RD_ALifeLine_1409309c103cc7dc: Same road we used to run PT on, back when
RD_ALifeLine_42c0f1d42ce2875d: Seven miles, singing the whole way
RD_ALifeLine_0a62e2454e7e3f69: Keep your head on a swivel
RD_ALifeLine_7947f01f2c1d0f0d: Because every time somebody says that, it stops being true
RD_ALifeLine_19ed907b2d49323c: I can't feel my fucking feet
RD_ALifeLine_0a5dfe7e2daaa591: We sit at the next ridge
RD_ALifeLine_30773c7735bd384f: You'll want to sit then too
RD_ALifeLine_595356fc77177178: My boots have a hole in them
RD_ALifeLine_663d4d0530d08bd6: Then walk faster and the hole won't notice
RD_ALifeLine_367aaabe0c3760ea: There's a ridge on the map and one in front of us
RD_ALifeLine_48d89b964b217363: It's half full, don't be like that
RD_ALifeLine_2959403f0f424fd9: Sergeant used to say if it's dark and you're lost, go toward the light
RD_ALifeLine_29ab5cd825eae2ce: Nobody talk, I'm trying to remember the turn
RD_ALifeLine_2234d1fa2778bbe4: Last time I walked this far I got a medal
RD_ALifeLine_52f8f1a61f9d5079: Hurry up and wait, that's the Army
RD_ALifeLine_21193f41669e0d82: That's exactly what the Army does
RD_ALifeLine_6205b17f7decfd1a: My legs remember a longer road than this one
RD_ALifeLine_0c2baa385e71cd39: Kuwait, a march in the sand, I swore I'd never walk again
RD_ALifeLine_317e3bc8476a50df: This is some Charlie Foxtrot shit
RD_ALifeLine_27629fa0653222b4: I wish I was back at Benning, doing pushups
RD_ALifeLine_3f13c3a23eb78e10: I'd do a hundred, right now, for a bunk and a cold shower
RD_ALifeLine_6f4569c308fff706: Ranger buddy, you're walking like you just got shot
RD_ALifeLine_4a835f062576fa3a: Feels like it, feels like a hundred bucks, move your ass
RD_ALifeLine_0a1b669a6641a292: First jump I froze in the door, a thousand feet up, wind roaring, couldn't move
RD_ALifeLine_402fd4291ff5ce74: The jumpmaster put his boot against my back, I've never been so grateful to be pushed
RD_ALifeLine_278b5f59355e866c: Quiet, once the chute opened, I could hear a dog barking in a farmyard, took me a minute to breathe
RD_ALifeLine_74c744bf40baa280: I think everybody needs a boot sometimes
RD_ALifeLine_7c3d30391f15c0c4: A little shove, a lot of faith, hand me that canteen
RD_ALifeLine_2c6a0eaa349daa06: Basic at Fort Knox, summer of eighty-nine, a drill sergeant named Ruiz who never raised his voice
RD_ALifeLine_545a5f684a138851: Terrifying, he'd stand six inches from your face and whisper, "Is that your best, son?"
RD_ALifeLine_35f7781a1816accf: Never, not one time, I hated him for six weeks and thanked him at graduation
RD_ALifeLine_6a6b8d643d4929a8: I'd like to tell you he's alive, I don't know, I like to picture him still whispering to the dead
RD_ALifeLine_3a74e69e29b9e0bf: First Christmas in the barracks, we had no tree, a sergeant spray-painted a mop green and we hung socks on it
RD_ALifeLine_27df743f4d427d89: Everyone put a surprise in one, a candy bar, a pack of gum, a letter
RD_ALifeLine_4b30e8151cfb52f1: A photo of my own grandmother, mailed by a private who'd never met her, he'd found it in the mess
RD_ALifeLine_7fbb7d261ae0cdd0: How did he know it was yours?
RD_ALifeLine_0923c0dd4e486572: She'd written "for my boy" on the back, he remembered my name from roll call
RD_ALifeLine_5f91589c387b676b: I keep a second set of dog tags in my pocket, a buddy's, never wore them
RD_ALifeLine_739419050928887b: Out of the army in ninety-one, back in Tennessee, he mailed them to me as a joke, I never mailed them back
RD_ALifeLine_1a602ea450864455: Because he never called, I figure if I hold onto them long enough, one of us has to come find the other
RD_ALifeLine_7782afd9561f8000: I check my pocket twice a day
RD_ALifeLine_732c66f24b7f928a: First time I had a squad of my own, I was twenty-three and shaking inside
RD_ALifeLine_2c9672276e1c65fb: I lied through my teeth, the older guys all knew, one of them winked and took the point without being asked
RD_ALifeLine_111e71bc2fe7e30e: I never forgot that, when I lead, I try to wink at the young ones
RD_ALifeLine_1e0f2d170e0bebae: Not as well as it did on me
RD_ALifeLine_60c620896b7892f8: Did a rotation overseas I can't talk about, ate rice for a month and watched a sunset I'll never describe
RD_ALifeLine_48b48a732b085fbd: Orange, then purple, then a color without a name, the whole valley went quiet like it was listening
RD_ALifeLine_3847cdd26d714468: You remember that, out of everything?
RD_ALifeLine_744feae82fab8b23: It's the only part I don't mind remembering, the rest I leave in the bag
RD_ALifeLine_589327f73d58a374: Some days I think that sunset kept me human
RD_ALifeLine_281715371ffa8c8f: My mother wrote me every Thursday for eleven years, four pages, both sides
RD_ALifeLine_1a9d3e0039d63d33: The neighbors, the weather, who died, who was pregnant, never a word about herself
RD_ALifeLine_516bfd3225d11988: In a footlocker at Fort Knox, I don't know if the building's still standing
RD_ALifeLine_7808afe27860cab8: Maybe, if it is, I'm going back for those letters before I go back for anything else
RD_ALifeLine_1bad553b7fb06d96: Our mess sergeant could make powdered eggs taste like a Sunday brunch, nobody could explain it
RD_ALifeLine_75ec093c233ead21: Black pepper and a little hot sauce, he swore it was patience
RD_ALifeLine_4f5820cd7377f3b2: So would I, with a cup of terrible coffee and a table of idiots who loved me
RD_ALifeLine_0f1dbbab130fd093: That's what it was, I just wasn't ready to say it
RD_ALifeLine_4168d4a45a889afe: I was a mechanic in the motor pool, Deuce-and-a-half trucks, mostly
RD_ALifeLine_26c44ac76463c8d4: Reliable like a mule, they'd start in January with a prayer and a good kick
RD_ALifeLine_7399c0da128364f8: I miss the sound, that diesel rattle, like a washing machine full of gravel
RD_ALifeLine_7e7bc93476f15aac: I'd listen to that all day
RD_ALifeLine_7f5d77c87804d829: There's one I'd like to find, number two-seven-one, she had a dent in the bumper that I never fixed
RD_ALifeLine_1193be7545cfae18: My first sergeant used to say, "Eat when you can, sleep when you can, and don't be a hero when you can't"
RD_ALifeLine_609f66f73a9eab77: He lived to be seventy-one, died in his own recliner watching a ball game
RD_ALifeLine_580caf465497cd9d: That's the dream, I keep repeating his words in my head so I'll get to a recliner of my own
RD_ALifeLine_736f5e3137f77ea5: I appreciate that, pass the rations
RD_ALifeLine_686802d04c085ed8: Training exercise, crossing the Salt River in January, waist deep, rifles over our heads
RD_ALifeLine_66c3e9d16005dea5: My teeth rattled so hard one of the guys offered me a mouth guard
RD_ALifeLine_46cf6fa040227bf2: Hell yes, we laughed so loud the instructor threatened to double the run
RD_ALifeLine_00d9afde417b9410: Doubled it, we were still laughing at the finish line
RD_ALifeLine_5b473d2c7254bb33: Generator hum, bearing about two seven zero, running since we got here
RD_ALifeLine_6b0b80d94a49b38d: Somebody's got fuel and no lights, four nights, no light anywhere on that bearing
RD_ALifeLine_05944ab04a5c8f57: Keep your eyes on the ridge
RD_ALifeLine_46dbe13873e0b490: Nothing, it's good to have something to look at
RD_ALifeLine_347b5e5b70e6faf6: Burn detail at sixteen hundred, diesel and the bald tires
RD_ALifeLine_3ed0a0055368d434: Upwind of the chow line this time?
RD_ALifeLine_751c97601f7b3cb8: Upwind of everything, I learned my lesson
RD_ALifeLine_5613316d4cb87531: Garcia fell asleep at the wheel, thirty hours up, nobody told him to pull over
RD_ALifeLine_0a444fbd08a0637c: I was in the passenger seat, I was asleep too
