RD_ALifeLine_629081f91b32bf8c: Let me see, give him to me, no, don't leave, stay where I can see you
RD_ALifeLine_0581c19a143172bf: I'm not, I'm just not stopped yet
RD_ALifeLine_0535e2646407575a: About an hour, I'd say, and I'm gonna enjoy that hour
RD_ALifeLine_6cde28b87eda2d46: Somebody, somewhere, maybe, I don't know who got the message, I just know I didn't
RD_ALifeLine_489f7af76aac84bb: Nobody goes near the back, understood? Not one person
RD_ALifeLine_4ae196794d258bfd: People who need things I don't have, and it's not safe, I'm begging you
RD_ALifeLine_7d08eb241f19eda6: I won't go, I won't, I promise, we'll all stay out here
RD_ALifeLine_216066357d096c55: Say something comforting, you're good at it
RD_ALifeLine_1803809e29deece5: Okay, okay, I'm here, I'm not leaving, that's all I've got
RD_ALifeLine_4ab2d5636f3f58b5: When I've seen the last person, and I don't know who that is, so ask me again in an hour
RD_ALifeLine_724bfe9d0d193afb: What if it comes back? What if it's in the town forever?
RD_ALifeLine_6ee5afe6779c137c: Then we'll know a lot more about forever than we do now
RD_ALifeLine_435eec0359e795ee: It wasn't supposed to be, I'm just tired of pretending I know
RD_ALifeLine_594e253b564d8d98: Stay off the road, stay off the road, they see you from the road
RD_ALifeLine_46cd5d327aacef58: In the grass, in the ditch, anywhere but the open!
RD_ALifeLine_2bf3fdda391fb0d6: My shoes are making noise on the gravel, I can't- I'm trying
RD_ALifeLine_74b4641e652ada62: There's a man lying in the middle of the street and everybody's just walking around him
RD_ALifeLine_1804ef3d087e40d7: Maybe, but nobody's stopping, look at 'em, nobody's even slowing down
RD_ALifeLine_334dde9a0bd740d5: Then I'll check, cover me, I'll just see if he's breathing
RD_ALifeLine_0762f3c839323603: Don't cross the street yet, wait, wait for it to pass
RD_ALifeLine_3a7d6fd1238f6e56: Whatever that was, did you hear it, that dragging?
RD_ALifeLine_5045cf9a3238c7e0: I hear it, I hear it, it's turning the corner, get down
RD_ALifeLine_7f0e7564529aced3: The whole highway's backed up to the bridge, nobody's moving
RD_ALifeLine_777e825d40929e05: Because the Guard's at the bridge, and nobody's getting past them, and nobody's turning around
RD_ALifeLine_317697c067ef72dc: Then they're sitting ducks, every one of them, sitting right out in the open
RD_ALifeLine_597cf8ae56148bbd: Walk in the grass, not on the sidewalk, it echoes
RD_ALifeLine_2fddd1de2590f276: I think they hear everything, I think they've got ears like dogs
RD_ALifeLine_0f0f82482cc80fac: Okay, okay, grass, I'm walking like a ninja, don't laugh
RD_ALifeLine_42f2912142e90d8f: It's the power, it's about to go out
RD_ALifeLine_1a012fbd677f4cc3: What happens when it goes out?
RD_ALifeLine_039114e24e8be638: Nothing, it gets dark, that's all, it just gets dark, don't panic
RD_ALifeLine_552d8bef51a14fad: There's glass all over the road
RD_ALifeLine_5986c36816ef747f: From the cars, from the stores, everybody broke everything, look at it
RD_ALifeLine_69a2d16f270fe055: Then be careful, shoes, check your shoes, one cut and you're slow
RD_ALifeLine_67217e34192687fd: I can't see around the dumpster, you go look, I'll wait here, I'll hold your bag
RD_ALifeLine_475534602fc8154d: I keep thinking of the cars people left behind
RD_ALifeLine_381885466974c92d: I try not to think about the lunchboxes
RD_ALifeLine_4d6318353116a46c: Get in the car! GET IN THE CAR!
RD_ALifeLine_724db9844c9f8559: It won't start, why won't it start?!
RD_ALifeLine_31acc4e363253b70: Try again, try again, try again, TURN IT!
RD_ALifeLine_5267b17654de19dd: We can't be out of gas
RD_ALifeLine_034442b263d7ec21: The needle's been on E for ten miles, I kept saying it'd make it
RD_ALifeLine_343259a423e9e79b: Then we're walking, grab what you can, we're walking from here
RD_ALifeLine_0a9b91de6b11b594: Who's got the keys? WHO HAS THE KEYS?
RD_ALifeLine_0079e7e14cbad918: They're in the ignition, they're in the- they've been in the ignition the whole time
RD_ALifeLine_07daa0f27a80346d: I keep picturing hiding under a truck
RD_ALifeLine_0a3eb78940f6ef49: I know. Panic keeps telling me hide before I even see a place
RD_ALifeLine_6150cdab05c793b3: I'd worry about getting stuck, let's look at what we can actually use
RD_ALifeLine_2853b54233a8856d: Somebody's horn is stuck, it's been going for twenty minutes
RD_ALifeLine_5bcc86d11991864a: You go smash it, go ahead, be my guest
RD_ALifeLine_2ebf95464e273169: That car alarm's been going for an hour, I can't stand it
RD_ALifeLine_48f1766f46fe28f9: It'll stop when the battery dies
RD_ALifeLine_04508080081b9fa0: Then let's go the other way, away from the alarm, it's all we can do
RD_ALifeLine_7b86c6d45fe50126: Every car on the highway's empty, doors open, keys still in them
RD_ALifeLine_7657cacf6d6e3cb8: I don't know, they just got out and walked off
RD_ALifeLine_4112171d16fb9b95: Or got pulled off, I don't want to think about it
RD_ALifeLine_49538bd519e51860: Check the trunks, there's gotta be something
RD_ALifeLine_68fd02ac6b02d8b5: Water, a spare jacket, a tire iron, anything
RD_ALifeLine_499a7a230e5b1989: Okay, but quick, quick, I don't like being out here with all these empty cars
RD_ALifeLine_7b68d90518767023: What if it isn't?! DON'T OPEN IT!
RD_ALifeLine_75fdd4af40df8943: Who is it? Say your name! Say your NAME!
RD_ALifeLine_3a72eed5544a6940: Put something against it, the chair, the table, anything!
RD_ALifeLine_1f3d4a703767e8c7: It's moving, the whole door's moving, oh God, oh God
RD_ALifeLine_0c27140e2a0d810e: Check the back door, did anybody check the back door?
RD_ALifeLine_0040f3ed0b8630b2: Go, go, go, both of you, now, if it's open we're- GO!
RD_ALifeLine_32239ff84b930994: Don't look, don't even stand near it, they see movement
RD_ALifeLine_3149ca290f353e2e: Okay, okay, I'm crawling, I'm crawling to the other room
RD_ALifeLine_3e17c699652015c5: There's a face at the window, there's a face at the WINDOW!
RD_ALifeLine_5f8ee6b16736b386: Right there, right there, he's pressing his- he's just standing there, looking at me!
RD_ALifeLine_6915b6ba49ac3325: Get away from the glass, get away, get AWAY
RD_ALifeLine_458303d963b6c824: Could we cover that window? I'd feel less exposed
RD_ALifeLine_5751eb426823d77f: A coat might do, we can look for something
RD_ALifeLine_717766ed7c21418f: All right, let's see what we've actually got
RD_ALifeLine_214e95e946fe2448: Glass just broke, something broke glass in the back!
RD_ALifeLine_73937e4b37b42fd4: Birds don't break glass at three miles an hour, something's inside!
RD_ALifeLine_6cbdc6e800bb4896: Stay together, stay behind me, get the poker, get anything
RD_ALifeLine_470fb78d6fdd6ef1: Don't look out the window, don't look
RD_ALifeLine_210e7bbf17fec491: Just don't, I'm serious, don't look
RD_ALifeLine_5dc89a9f3ec78a73: They can climb stairs, can't they?
RD_ALifeLine_47eecdad5ef4950e: Don't ask me that, I don't want to know, go go go
RD_ALifeLine_4bb0af47149175df: Barricade the top, push the dresser, push it
RD_ALifeLine_16ea4242577e8b79: I once tried to hide in a closet. Kept waving everybody in
RD_ALifeLine_2567e1db359a928b: Not enough, I was so scared I just kept saying squeeze
RD_ALifeLine_79a898e478f92147: You'd want a way out too, not just a door you could shut
RD_ALifeLine_0e8b703a5af17009: I keep worrying our voices will carry outside
RD_ALifeLine_58f8d0c81f0c159d: Then take a breath. You're scaring me more than the talking
RD_ALifeLine_537ef0c87cce0eb0: Just talk low, normal, like we're watching TV. I miss that
RD_ALifeLine_668f5b5811a0948b: It's too quiet in this house, listen to it
RD_ALifeLine_2ea72d0112badbba: No, no radio, there's nothing on the radio
RD_ALifeLine_7b67ba572ffc483c: Then hum something, I don't care, just fill it up
RD_ALifeLine_4d824c452014a49d: Check every room, check the kitchen, check the closets
RD_ALifeLine_1ef20ede32cff456: Because I heard something, I know I heard something
RD_ALifeLine_792c615641f14416: I'll start with the bedrooms, you take the hall, keep talking to me
RD_ALifeLine_0fd91d1a14f0ad09: Do they climb stairs? Does anybody know?
RD_ALifeLine_2138dcc40b817333: I saw one on the porch steps
RD_ALifeLine_744438c440f95fb1: They're all the same to somebody who's trying to eat you, I'd barricade it
RD_ALifeLine_6971d8a1011bfe40: The fence won't hold, it's just chain-link, it's already bending
RD_ALifeLine_5ca010932968ebe2: We've got the other one, the back one
RD_ALifeLine_0a33c9be16039f81: How long before they find the back one?
RD_ALifeLine_0d18fb4a5c799c28: Stop, stop, I can't, I can't do that math
RD_ALifeLine_4118df41143d8a98: Climb the fence, CLIMB, GO GO GO!
RD_ALifeLine_555b75f904d36bd5: I can't, I've got the baby, I can't climb!
RD_ALifeLine_0f0c6dc75030171e: Hand her to me, hand her up, I've got her, I've got her!
RD_ALifeLine_68be4108372b9258: Don't drop her, DON'T DROP HER
RD_ALifeLine_5a9cde3c2aff6992: They're at the fence, they're all at the fence, there's like twelve of them
RD_ALifeLine_40e347977d6cbbf5: They're just pushing, they're all pushing, I think it's gonna go
RD_ALifeLine_244947c436c46f98: Then we go NOW, out the back, don't wait to see
RD_ALifeLine_47b07a2b4fb19af7: It stood up, it stood up like a man
RD_ALifeLine_235d92c34bf827fa: Stop, stop talking, back away slowly, back away
RD_ALifeLine_60e96119646936ce: We should cut through the woods, stay off the road
RD_ALifeLine_6f19d8c76c6840d1: Are you crazy? You can't see anything in the woods!
RD_ALifeLine_74469c273136a9b6: I don't know! I just want to get out of the open!
RD_ALifeLine_0098254424485799: And walk into something we can't see? Slow down, think for a second
RD_ALifeLine_0d16088f635618e0: A man just walked out of the tree line, he's carrying something
RD_ALifeLine_7e09d225240115da: Don't know, it's big, it's wrapped in a sheet, he's coming this way
RD_ALifeLine_3f2b943c549d5796: Don't let him close, tell him to stop, tell him to STOP
RD_ALifeLine_67b30a6b7d2e8c53: The woods are quiet, no birds
RD_ALifeLine_158ca91b6208c71e: Where'd the birds go? Why are the birds gone?
RD_ALifeLine_2b0bdaad59e71f00: They left, everything with sense left, we're the idiots still standing here
RD_ALifeLine_02776c1b0f7e9435: The river's the only way out, maybe
RD_ALifeLine_75ad06fc40a15ffe: Raft, then, or tubes, or anything that floats
RD_ALifeLine_7ee0c218718aac25: Then we'll have to build something, how fast can you tie a knot?
RD_ALifeLine_79c847e407766a11: I saw something floating in it, upstream, don't ask, just don't drink it
RD_ALifeLine_13b7236130fcaedd: Then what do I drink? What do I drink?
RD_ALifeLine_64e40773423c2ddd: The fire's spreading to the next house, look
RD_ALifeLine_359801f636c701fb: Nobody's coming to put it out
RD_ALifeLine_7f89fb2b582e24b3: With what? A bucket? It's a whole row, it's gone, it's already gone
RD_ALifeLine_2e5b8f4b1d40812d: That smoke makes me think of the Kroger fire, I remember seeing the column for miles
RD_ALifeLine_584ea39c28879b57: I worried about what might gather near it
RD_ALifeLine_7b377afd6048ef4b: I'm scared anything we do will bring them! I can't stop thinking about it!
RD_ALifeLine_099c57e13ca48d3a: Then let's look for a way away from the smoke without rushing blind
RD_ALifeLine_4dbc9f7d353d98bc: I keep hoping the rain will cover us, I'm probably fooling myself
RD_ALifeLine_340db8443a374fbe: I don't know what it hides
RD_ALifeLine_7addce0436e45733: So we keep watching the way back?
RD_ALifeLine_2f8108fe49d1a8b3: Yeah, I was really hoping you'd say we could relax
RD_ALifeLine_6469fefd711b75bc: We're soaked, we're all soaked through, my teeth won't stop chattering
RD_ALifeLine_203946356f0cff88: There's nowhere, every place is full of them or full of people with guns!
RD_ALifeLine_7d2c9144454936cf: Then we keep walking, we walk until we find something, keep moving, keep your blood moving
RD_ALifeLine_6c6000c9329fa1f7: If we use a generator, I'm going to worry about who hears it
RD_ALifeLine_7409f382462e4f9b: And I'd worry about food spoiling without one
RD_ALifeLine_042389ca79b5a776: I know. Wanting it quiet doesn't switch it off or solve the food problem
RD_ALifeLine_487dabfa52747294: We'd have to check what we actually had before arguing about running it. God, I miss quiet
RD_ALifeLine_71ddc8d660b56d62: Would climbing a shed help us look ahead?
RD_ALifeLine_1b30d21206638bd2: I just want to see which way to go, I know height isn't a whole escape plan
RD_ALifeLine_59c36ef0531fba74: Then we'd need to check it could hold us and a way down before anybody climbs
RD_ALifeLine_5435a8d479752977: I remember a woman asking me to help. Said there were three in her yard
RD_ALifeLine_08eff723781df5f6: Did she tell you which house?
RD_ALifeLine_6d053a8368c8f2c6: Yellow, with a swing, her kids were there, she said, couldn't get the words out
RD_ALifeLine_5da5941460ed6d3e: I wouldn't promise help I didn't have. Saying sorry can feel like saying nothing
RD_ALifeLine_7ffe99f04b0b3c51: Is the sheriff coming? Somebody said the sheriff was coming
RD_ALifeLine_1b01408d6242b9a8: The sheriff went to Louisville and didn't come back
RD_ALifeLine_4f87b27a3c5cee1d: Is it true the Army's coming? My neighbor said the Army's coming
RD_ALifeLine_678366493ea4d74a: Ask me tomorrow, I'll know less than I do now
RD_ALifeLine_21cc1a4313282067: I'm not joking, I stopped being able to joke around lunchtime
RD_ALifeLine_175697e82d93642c: Is the bridge open? We're trying to get across to Indiana
RD_ALifeLine_09e460e372b7346c: There's a National Guard line across it and a lot of people sitting in front of it, that's all I know
RD_ALifeLine_73a95d8f2f469499: What number do we call? Is there a number?
RD_ALifeLine_74bdfe88299188ce: There was a number, it's 911, I'm the 911 now
RD_ALifeLine_100e05ca6288d7ad: But who's gonna answer if you're out here?
RD_ALifeLine_54dc6f025bd3b8ef: Nobody, ma'am, nobody's gonna answer, that's the problem with being the 911
RD_ALifeLine_1d860e3f6785954b: The radio on your shoulder, what did it say? It just made noise, what did they say?
RD_ALifeLine_011657002300cc2a: They said stand by, that's the entire message, it's been the entire message all day
RD_ALifeLine_02c60a6228468438: Have you seen my mother? She's seventy-four, she's got a blue coat, she walks with a cane
RD_ALifeLine_465b7fc92db1c5aa: Her house on Elm, she wouldn't answer the phone, I couldn't get through, nobody can get through
RD_ALifeLine_4db6f9952917665f: I'll look if I go past, I can't promise, I'm sorry, I can't promise a thing
RD_ALifeLine_593c26c42e0536c7: You left us! Yesterday you drove right past and you didn't stop!
RD_ALifeLine_77c7e9e23ca3e2c8: I had a man in the back seat, I couldn't, I wanted to
RD_ALifeLine_780e360c18ecce52: We banged on your hood! We BANGED on it!
RD_ALifeLine_1a9640a974ba6d09: I heard you, I heard every bit of it, I'll hear it a while
RD_ALifeLine_14b3f1753da6e975: Somebody's looting the hardware store and you're just standing here?!
RD_ALifeLine_48a998d44a3fe8cf: There's a hundred of them in there and one of me
RD_ALifeLine_1d538e0e7cd67147: You want to walk in there and tell them no, go ahead, I'll cover you from here
RD_ALifeLine_7328d44952c9d8e0: My boy's fourteen, red jacket, about this tall, he was riding his bike when the sirens started
RD_ALifeLine_72743e8a4cddfa5d: Cody, Cody Sipes, please, if you see him, tell him to go home
RD_ALifeLine_1780c61d1fa36576: Cody Sipes, red jacket, I'll tell every person I meet
RD_ALifeLine_33a883b82e17b16b: You look dead on your feet, Officer, can I get you some water?
RD_ALifeLine_52429ed77d390ff5: Sit down a second, nobody's gonna bite
RD_ALifeLine_768e4ddb26b9e8bd: Careful what you say about that, ma'am, I don't have a sense of humor left
RD_ALifeLine_0f232e3422851ed5: Does anybody know what this IS?
RD_ALifeLine_46a78b080ab861f0: A guy at the state lab on the phone said maybe a chemical, maybe a disease, and then the line went dead
RD_ALifeLine_22f453eb69c2f1e9: A guy, I never got his name, I've been thinking about him all day, he sounded like he was crying
RD_ALifeLine_0ce3605a036751e5: My husband's a deputy too, have you seen him? Hollis, Hollis Gaines, tall, red hair
RD_ALifeLine_74429682323805be: Hollis was on the north end the last I heard
RD_ALifeLine_3bd4ef73187479a0: Before the radio quit, I'm sorry, that's the last I've got
RD_ALifeLine_47db290b5e57d698: I once watched my neighbor stand in his garage for an hour, thought he'd turned
RD_ALifeLine_61b18aaf5d9be840: Kept turning his head, like he was listening to something
RD_ALifeLine_73d93b2212328f90: You couldn't know from that alone, I'd keep my distance, but I wouldn't call it proof
RD_ALifeLine_71a0e6e305433ddf: Just tell me where the safest place is, even if it's a lie
RD_ALifeLine_7167d8d7670a7647: The Methodist church, they've got good locks and a priest with a shotgun
RD_ALifeLine_53bdd2e11e5246fc: It's a pastor, not a priest
RD_ALifeLine_10ff8ebf2610181e: Ma'am, I'm in no position to ask for credentials
RD_ALifeLine_006ead405185dc8f: Do you have any idea how long this lasts?
RD_ALifeLine_045bcc3b730fc39b: You mean the sirens, the quiet, or the whole thing?
RD_ALifeLine_6fcc96307ebbd373: Longer than I can plan for, which is why I've quit planning past lunch
RD_ALifeLine_0592bf9962268f18: Is it in the air? Is it the air? Tell me if it's the air!
RD_ALifeLine_58b179534137b6fc: Should I wear something? A rag, a towel, something over my face?
RD_ALifeLine_0352694348f03b0f: Tie something on if it makes you feel better, I've got a bandana, here
RD_ALifeLine_68f278b53d48e26d: I keep remembering a bitten man they tied up in a garage
RD_ALifeLine_7e58a1eb09c44f51: Talking, but not to any of us, wouldn't look at us
RD_ALifeLine_6d4ed0b47537a803: That's not something you forget, I hope nobody took a risk trying to handle him alone
RD_ALifeLine_4d9992db4a5b6e1c: My mother's in the brick house at the end of Ash, she's eighty, she can't walk without help
RD_ALifeLine_4a9acfab12eaf92d: Ash Lane, the brick one, there's a ramp, she's got a ramp
RD_ALifeLine_7223028d686bb9c4: Ash, brick, ramp, okay, got it written on my hand, I'll go if I can
RD_ALifeLine_27f0b5c534f24582: Can we light a fire? We're freezing and- well, it's July, we're just scared
RD_ALifeLine_712e4b470d82736c: Because that's how the Pruitt place went, I watched it happen
RD_ALifeLine_2c12c24419acdab9: I won't loot, I won't take anything, I promise, I PROMISE
RD_ALifeLine_18f9b47e632a5833: I'm scared of needing food for my kids and having nothing to offer for it
RD_ALifeLine_12c6182613cc7a53: Then ask before you take anything, I can't promise what another person will spare
RD_ALifeLine_12b21ba84a4bda81: You stayed, you could've gone and you stayed
RD_ALifeLine_6225ce324fef77b1: I'm not staying, I just can't think of where else to go
RD_ALifeLine_3483036335b0033b: That's more honest than anything I've heard today
RD_ALifeLine_08c609685464e147: It's the only thing I've got left to give you
RD_ALifeLine_2cba44be64e45fdc: Why did you shoot that man? He was just standing there!
RD_ALifeLine_11883ed72840b3c9: He wasn't standing, ma'am, he was coming
RD_ALifeLine_0f052d6d1bf23fa8: He had his hands out, he was-
RD_ALifeLine_73f12ed804d72ffd: Hands out is how they come, I hate it as much as you do
RD_ALifeLine_41404c206c50858c: I made a sandwich, it's bologna, it's all I had
RD_ALifeLine_15ddcd5533dd264e: Then eat the whole thing, I'll make another one
RD_ALifeLine_0c88295e6b048b52: You're a good person, I'd ask your name but I'd forget it
RD_ALifeLine_01bf134e34163ec2: Do I need a mask? A bandana? Anything?
RD_ALifeLine_7882ff8c3a9b07dc: Wear whatever makes you feel better
RD_ALifeLine_3f1c6c0c7e9f948b: That's not an answer, that's what you say to a kid
RD_ALifeLine_47a10f9b01671e8f: I know, I know, I'm sorry, I'm out of better ones
RD_ALifeLine_6ce06d8c7b73dbf0: How do you do it? How do you keep going?
RD_ALifeLine_5553f20412a23420: I walk to the next block, then I walk to the next one
RD_ALifeLine_0ddad6085a557cfc: That's all I've got, I can't see past the next block, so I don't try
RD_ALifeLine_6d9d7e064a946530: You left the interstate wide open, you left the whole thing open!
RD_ALifeLine_63fce0781d5a2e9c: There's nothing to close it with, there's three of us
RD_ALifeLine_27f2942a49bb76a9: Then close it with your bodies!
RD_ALifeLine_074979b3777b5cb5: And then who'd be left to tell you how the day went?
RD_ALifeLine_43f48d0523c937fa: What's that on the radio? That sound, like static but with a voice in it?
RD_ALifeLine_41e2b80b139ccc6e: That's the Army's channel, they're talking, but it's all code
RD_ALifeLine_1ce5e4144dbeb559: Can you understand any of it?
RD_ALifeLine_1d87115e32c9563d: One word, "contain," and then a lot of nothing
RD_ALifeLine_75ee59e1664b436b: I just want to go home
RD_ALifeLine_5d34b08c43463c60: Muldraugh, the blue house, it's got a swing set
RD_ALifeLine_3854e0d756081a0c: Then I'll get you as far as I can, ma'am, that's two blocks from where I'm going anyway
RD_ALifeLine_3611c50b57f05988: They said the president was gonna speak, did he?
RD_ALifeLine_7f41054a6bd34bab: If he did, I missed it
RD_ALifeLine_6d4cd3a73e516f56: Then it's up to us, whoever that is
RD_ALifeLine_7a9b47782b9984d3: Could you say a prayer? You're a public servant, you're allowed
RD_ALifeLine_5aed0d6e1c5f2238: I'm not that kind of public servant
RD_ALifeLine_59c2e9a3795e5f4b: Please, just one, I keep thinking about my husband, I need somebody to say it
RD_ALifeLine_6a906d2077741d04: ...Lord, look after these folks, and look after us too, that's all I've got, amen
RD_ALifeLine_458c48ee15481f8c: He's the one who left us at the bridge!
RD_ALifeLine_150897243bb86dff: I left you because the Guard was shooting, I'd do it again, I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_3af0af9331bf1b4d: I know it doesn't, and I'll carry that, I'm not asking you to forgive me
RD_ALifeLine_5180fce25cba56d2: Is the bridge safe to cross?
RD_ALifeLine_626d25d903311d52: I don't know who's there now
RD_ALifeLine_40a2e9a97f6b146b: If anybody stops us, don't make sudden moves, let them talk
RD_ALifeLine_6e2bb0700860fa41: Tell them the truth. Being nervous isn't something you have to apologize for
RD_ALifeLine_09a17ced63043205: Goddamn infection spreading everywhere, deputies, maybe you know where we should go?
RD_ALifeLine_4a3684e013c50ab6: Wish I did, I'm getting the same hiss on the radio that you are
RD_ALifeLine_7656fea8329a65d2: Then what are you even FOR?
RD_ALifeLine_7bec524119f624e6: Right now I'm for standing here so you've got somebody to yell at
RD_ALifeLine_3a3b38dd5fee8fa7: Why isn't anybody DOING something? You're the police!
RD_ALifeLine_49e1f1891a03edb9: I've been doing something since four in the morning, I just can't tell you what it's done
RD_ALifeLine_610535b608db8c67: It's the only one I've got, and I've been saving it all day
RD_ALifeLine_0ddb05f256875f28: Folks, get inside, everybody inside, now
RD_ALifeLine_35ccfcd7327bee45: We ARE inside, we've been inside for two days
RD_ALifeLine_4aa46d9f27c90d3a: Then stay inside, don't open it for anybody, you hear me, not even me
RD_ALifeLine_466d559844ee1050: What does that mean, not even you?
RD_ALifeLine_6c4bb24d2be87dcf: Are they dead? Are those things dead? You shot one, I saw you
RD_ALifeLine_58044b2965165db6: I put four in his chest and he kept coming, so I honestly don't know what dead means anymore
RD_ALifeLine_149712190bbb7c66: Head, ma'am, it's the only thing I've seen work, and I wish I'd never found that out
RD_ALifeLine_746c7e5f73438b89: I once begged a cop to look at my bitten husband in our van
RD_ALifeLine_4ae3f6cd693bb21a: I kept saying he must have a first aid kit. Like saying it would fix everything
RD_ALifeLine_47e5b6e43e841885: A uniform doesn't mean somebody has a kit, or that a kit can fix a bite, I'm sorry you had to ask
RD_ALifeLine_0e1f40e219a72381: Anybody here bitten? Anybody scratched? Don't lie to me, I'm not gonna shoot you, I just need to know
RD_ALifeLine_68ad15687d0e1000: Roll up your sleeves, all of you, slow
RD_ALifeLine_7bdc804a1c358fba: Where do we sleep? Where's anybody sleeping?
RD_ALifeLine_78c8aae40df189b7: The Baptist church on the corner's got room, some of the deputies' families are there
RD_ALifeLine_2538e4d64b68ab25: It's got four walls and some men with guns, that's about as safe as it gets right now
RD_ALifeLine_49b7166771e49f2f: Ever have somebody beg you for a ride for their children?
RD_ALifeLine_1224df195d204ff8: More than once, couldn't promise a seat I didn't have
RD_ALifeLine_3e31e39804fa8bd8: They tell you how little the kids are, how quiet they'll be
RD_ALifeLine_33cd84fb50465409: Makes you want to say yes before thinking, but wanting room doesn't make room
RD_ALifeLine_0c64c9dd3c892622: If I found a gun, would I have to hand it over?
RD_ALifeLine_50ae1c2707190519: I'd want you to learn to handle it safely before carrying it
RD_ALifeLine_7b42ee4151652990: I never shot anything but cans
RD_ALifeLine_3139d8b77ac93b0d: Then don't pretend otherwise. That's a better start than showing off
RD_ALifeLine_0be5cf8f158dcfb4: I need you to show me the neighbor
RD_ALifeLine_11584e9b09627874: I'm not going back there, I'm NOT, he's one of them now
RD_ALifeLine_342c84993e0edca4: Third one on the left, the one with the red shutters, don't go in without- just don't, please
RD_ALifeLine_42cadb8e724ac134: Somebody said the police are leaving town
RD_ALifeLine_7a075f3d7010ece1: But you could, couldn't you? You could just go?
RD_ALifeLine_002b3f5f093398a0: I could, and I've thought about it twice today, so I wouldn't ask me that again
RD_ALifeLine_64831f47750c28fb: Terrified, I wet myself an hour ago and nobody's the wiser
RD_ALifeLine_2d09143472432b4a: Because you looked like you needed company
RD_ALifeLine_5792e8d017d81159: I was a medic in the Guard, I can help, I can do something
RD_ALifeLine_17bd61441ae51f64: Eight years, two tours of nothing, I'm real good
RD_ALifeLine_41c5814c343c8c31: Then come with me, I've got a man bleeding behind the pharmacy
RD_ALifeLine_613465d23bfb0db7: Is there a curfew? Somebody put a flyer on a pole, it says curfew
RD_ALifeLine_0d75fd357e1ce575: Not from my office, I haven't seen it
RD_ALifeLine_385ee62b2ac214c8: Whoever's still giving orders, I'd stay in, it's not worth finding out
RD_ALifeLine_1a13409a4c3c4062: Where's the National Guard? The armory's got a light on, but nobody answers
RD_ALifeLine_2b8b5df05dd1d7cb: Armory's empty, they left before noon
RD_ALifeLine_104e9b22471e5d04: North, with everything they could carry, and they didn't tell me either
RD_ALifeLine_72e628c125831000: The radio says it's rabies, is it rabies? Please say it's rabies
RD_ALifeLine_45bf5f91597c9887: ...I don't know, and neither does anyone I've talked to
RD_ALifeLine_69731556426a4051: I don't know, since before the sirens
RD_ALifeLine_29ee0447313a030b: Go lie down somewhere, I'll take the front
RD_ALifeLine_0aae9dfe4ab0f210: I can't, the Dolan boy's face is just there every time I do
RD_ALifeLine_3b1d741127705c0a: I got a question and I want a straight answer, is it safe to stay here?
RD_ALifeLine_4e03e972067f47d8: You wanted a straight answer, I gave you a straight one, I don't know a place that IS safe
RD_ALifeLine_06a529a621dd5934: I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I can't, I can't stop shaking
RD_ALifeLine_2c8dc1a3442478cf: I know, I'm shaking too, but you hear that dragging sound? Quiet, they're close
RD_ALifeLine_294b9d0258bc24ac: Okay, okay, I'm not breathing, I'm not breathing
RD_ALifeLine_18501d3254a119eb: How many of them are there?
RD_ALifeLine_466360bf63058691: More than I've got bullets for, and that's all I'm gonna say
RD_ALifeLine_541394e12f4bf203: Is that supposed to calm me down?
RD_ALifeLine_02f166da1d4bd07f: Nothing's supposed to calm you down, that's the honest part
RD_ALifeLine_513d58155354c84d: Please tell me it's gonna stop, please, just tell me it's gonna stop
RD_ALifeLine_7812827b303fcec4: LIE to me then! Lie to me, I'm begging!
RD_ALifeLine_1937637c614d89b6: ...it's gonna stop, it's gonna stop, okay? It's gonna stop
RD_ALifeLine_310259251ce0a92c: I remember asking if anybody else was in the house
RD_ALifeLine_5aa0e1e86e2ed963: I told you she was in the back room.. my mother had a fever
RD_ALifeLine_196b0c34791c7121: I asked how long she'd had it
RD_ALifeLine_12eb696a677250ea: I said since the night before.. I couldn't get her to answer
RD_ALifeLine_54ff807012f3e843: I didn't want you going back in alone.. I didn't know what we'd find
RD_ALifeLine_152e945f0f1e799b: What could I tell my kids about this?
RD_ALifeLine_6c81b53767cc957f: What would you want them to know?
RD_ALifeLine_24cd48154d5f9a70: That people can be sick.. without having to see what we saw
RD_ALifeLine_766e0d700c0d7777: Then start with that.. I don't know how to make it less frightening
RD_ALifeLine_2fd0fc5665f1a4f2: Can you shoot them from a distance? Can you pick them off?
RD_ALifeLine_16fc8ec36195d929: I'd run out of ammo before I ran out of them
RD_ALifeLine_4d5fb39638ac38f2: I've been waiting since the radio quit, ma'am, and nothing's changed but the number
RD_ALifeLine_404e481b38c60dfc: Somebody on the CB says Louisville's gone
RD_ALifeLine_2a6f7b1b601f1a82: Just gone, burned, nobody left, that's what he said
RD_ALifeLine_6846f6043114e3c1: People on the CB say a lot of things, don't repeat that to anybody else
RD_ALifeLine_332e5c506a39c6cc: You folks heading to the school?
RD_ALifeLine_10e8b7a618005be7: That's what we heard, is it still open?
RD_ALifeLine_47ae04662595633a: They haven't closed it. There's so many sick people in that gym, it's not working
RD_ALifeLine_46d3a94845686ace: Then why are you sending us there?
RD_ALifeLine_134847946281738f: I'm telling you what's there, not telling you to go, I can't tell you where else to go
RD_ALifeLine_7fac5f3b2db95498: Do you see anybody who isn't walking right, with a vacant look?
RD_ALifeLine_7688b90b41927d9a: There's one by the Dairy Bar
RD_ALifeLine_032d57ec083a1d10: Then don't go near that one, don't shoot unless you've got no other choice, bullets bring more
RD_ALifeLine_4568c4f67a21e408: Every other word out of your mouth is "I don't know"!
RD_ALifeLine_7e7d342624ad0263: Because I DON'T know! You think I'd keep it from you?
RD_ALifeLine_50cb1e3a5e447c86: I'd rather you made something up!
RD_ALifeLine_458e855c6674eb77: I know you would, so would I, I'm sorry, I can't
RD_ALifeLine_2b31891b54c6a898: There's no dialysis, there's no doctors, the whole place is just... don't go, I'm telling you as a favor
RD_ALifeLine_0cb47e697653fb5b: Lock up, put something heavy against it, and keep the lights off
RD_ALifeLine_6e8dd8a945ac1b41: Who's gonna tell us different? Who's left to tell us?
RD_ALifeLine_27f00a1d089dbfc7: Don't leave us here, don't go, you're all we've got
RD_ALifeLine_31fc923952d90fd7: I have to check the next block
RD_ALifeLine_2516093e18d463d1: What if they come while you're gone?
RD_ALifeLine_127759e6687e195c: Then you run, you run to the church and you don't stop, you hear me, you don't stop
RD_ALifeLine_324a597d6fd07eb9: I haven't been paid in nine days
RD_ALifeLine_47f6b20f7041f144: Well- well, that's not my fault!
RD_ALifeLine_037816f61bf944d6: I know it isn't, ma'am, I'm just telling you why I'm not as helpful as I'd like
RD_ALifeLine_22160fba4e172618: Have you got a ride? Something that runs, with gas in it?
RD_ALifeLine_778e3f77733337cc: I need to get five people to the school and I've got no ride
RD_ALifeLine_5c51424854d24e1d: Get in, I'll drive, hurry, tell them to hurry
RD_ALifeLine_5172fda403a24e1f: Is it safe to burn them? To burn the bodies?
RD_ALifeLine_0897d227755fd850: There's one in our front yard that won't stay down!
RD_ALifeLine_7f8e760a04bddccb: Then it's not a body, it's one of THEM, you're gonna need to make a different call
RD_ALifeLine_09a9c68c29fb5e5f: Did you see which way it went?
RD_ALifeLine_5bf7b88362f27b5b: Toward the tracks, I think, I didn't look, I was running
RD_ALifeLine_5a6a755a551728c0: I don't know, I don't know, five? Six? It was loud, I wasn't counting
RD_ALifeLine_4062336b2377c088: They said on the radio we should follow instructions, whose instructions? Where are they?
RD_ALifeLine_68265c167e65ca2c: Then why's the radio saying it?
RD_ALifeLine_04a05a8c1dc13044: Because somebody recorded it a long time ago and it's looping, ma'am, nobody's home
RD_ALifeLine_27000702298cea56: Last I knew, my wife was at her sister's and the kids were at the pool, I was at work
RD_ALifeLine_7e60102d02798886: Just out past the Methodist church, I never needed the number before, and now it's all I can think about
RD_ALifeLine_15c9275e73a73d44: Y'all keep saying head, aim for the head
RD_ALifeLine_689726a5651ddecb: You ever say "it's what's working" about anything else in your life?
RD_ALifeLine_7191292d78c43129: Yeah, my first marriage, but that's a different story
RD_ALifeLine_47d09e195eb60d2b: Is it true they're not people anymore?
RD_ALifeLine_06d577844fda2e23: Please, I need to know if it's okay to-
RD_ALifeLine_09ceacc25e8a0c3d: Don't hesitate, ma'am, that's all I'll say, don't hesitate
RD_ALifeLine_000ee62a30bc8dce: They went past us, the Army convoy, and they didn't even slow down, why didn't they stop?
RD_ALifeLine_7e46bc0740d44ddc: To go somewhere, and we aren't there, that's what I figure
RD_ALifeLine_4e711de04cbda1c8: Get away from the corner, get OFF the corner!
RD_ALifeLine_2f37485918c8eff8: Nothing yet, but it's open and you can see all the way down, now MOVE
RD_ALifeLine_437c32710d88af9b: Okay, okay, I'm moving, I'm moving!
RD_ALifeLine_5bd1fd324682095d: What do I do with the dead? Do I bury Gerald? He's in the bed, he's, he's just gone
RD_ALifeLine_2d7dd9061aae567c: I don't know, he stopped and then I came out, I can't go back in there
RD_ALifeLine_49b5c2e94f92a3e6: Lock it from the outside, don't go in, I'll do what I can when I get a minute
RD_ALifeLine_071d65ff1166fd15: Take us to the fort, they've got soldiers, they've got big gates!
RD_ALifeLine_1e17d4735d7a1bef: The fort's shooting people who walk up to the gate
RD_ALifeLine_5fe2f8a44d770238: A man who walked up to the gate, he got back with a hole in his hat
RD_ALifeLine_20187a1f33487741: My little girl's got a fever, is that it? Is she infected?
RD_ALifeLine_42017a5d493082a8: A fever's a fever, is there a bite on her?
RD_ALifeLine_1eb3f7285be5597f: No, no, I checked, I checked her whole body twice!
RD_ALifeLine_7871e9a62f5fd77c: Then keep her cool and keep checking, I wish I had a doctor to send you
RD_ALifeLine_7df1f35937ebb977: Would you take a pistol from somebody who was scared to use it?
RD_ALifeLine_729dcc992be957b8: I'd ask why they wanted to give it up
RD_ALifeLine_1d476dec72fc2e8c: I've never fired one at a person
RD_ALifeLine_2014b6fb0346a1f8: I'm glad you'd hesitate, but carrying it or handing it over ought to be a real decision, not panic
RD_ALifeLine_275b5aa0611c9ad5: Somebody said you shot Mr. Dolan
RD_ALifeLine_0b152bdf494b5c4a: She's the one who asked me to, ma'am, I'd appreciate it if you'd keep that to yourself
RD_ALifeLine_7e45978619456fd4: Where's the rescue squad? I've been calling for hours!
RD_ALifeLine_32c1732142721fd1: Quit? They CAN'T quit! That's their JOB!
RD_ALifeLine_3c335dc8076cf18d: I know it's their job, ma'am, I'm trying to tell you the squad isn't coming, none of them are
RD_ALifeLine_0cbe480b20c8174e: He's a cop, he'll protect us
RD_ALifeLine_0b849ef7564fbb79: He's one cop, he's got one gun, and he's leaving
RD_ALifeLine_3bdfb2aa7427ffdb: I'm going to the school, I'm not leaving you, I'm just not staying here
RD_ALifeLine_3f0ccdb20a07eb5d: Then call it leaving, I'm still going
RD_ALifeLine_3f8b074802162300: You folks from Radcliff? Anybody know where the nearest Army post is?
RD_ALifeLine_0561dbb14eeef02d: That's the one I mean, how do I get there?
RD_ALifeLine_6eb063de4d9dfa09: Hell, you're a cop, you tell US
RD_ALifeLine_20bc7c5842c0a061: I'd like to report a crime, somebody stole my riding mower
RD_ALifeLine_178ad0575676c5bb: A John Deere, it was in the shed, I saw 'em driving it down the hill
RD_ALifeLine_496d7c9d17250176: Hahaha- sorry, sorry, ma'am, I'll put it on the list, it's right under "end of the world"
RD_ALifeLine_65345d2c10e0f7eb: Everybody who came with the group, count heads right now
RD_ALifeLine_3c060ea71b9c05ef: Two went back for something, I told them not to, I told them!
RD_ALifeLine_53c6fc9e1b24d7e8: The TV said everybody should go to the fairgrounds
RD_ALifeLine_389567e923d9c611: Nobody's at the fairgrounds, I've been there
RD_ALifeLine_45d7d74748b4bfbb: Then who put it on the TV?
RD_ALifeLine_4fe2065776735b5e: Somebody who wasn't there, that's all I can tell you
RD_ALifeLine_60f3e2dd2cdb2cda: I'm a Vietnam vet, I'm not going out like this
RD_ALifeLine_17fd5d1171cf9bc0: Hiding under a bed, I did enough of that in '69
RD_ALifeLine_643b73d43cf03054: I'd rather find somewhere you could rest, sir. Somewhere we've actually checked
RD_ALifeLine_0740262a19602855: What about the ones that are still alive but hurt, the ones lying down?
RD_ALifeLine_01eff574392929c3: Do we help them, or leave them, or- what are we supposed to do?!
RD_ALifeLine_677a9c643c484132: Look for a bite, that's all I know to tell you, and if there's a bite you stay clear
RD_ALifeLine_0c59b63f305e6dde: Unit twelve, say your twenty, say your twenty, come back
RD_ALifeLine_2b6439a05f9adab5: What is that? Why do they keep saying that?
RD_ALifeLine_135c638e4b13e6ea: Because it's how they find each other, and nobody's finding anybody
RD_ALifeLine_2fe709d73419ec42: Sit down a minute, you're white as a sheet
RD_ALifeLine_5e872df4313f708c: Sit! Have some water, it's just water, nothing in it
RD_ALifeLine_7db43dda3b0c3be6: ...okay, thank you, just a minute, a minute
RD_ALifeLine_09bf9e394a9c7933: I need two of you to help me carry my partner, he's hit his head, he's out
RD_ALifeLine_6e10e8a37c29cca1: No! No bite, he fell, he just fell off the loading dock, he's not bit, look at him
RD_ALifeLine_096f9ea502767788: Okay, okay, we'll carry him, tell us where to put our hands
RD_ALifeLine_16e30d702349aed6: Is this the end of the world?
RD_ALifeLine_675934b318cfdbec: I don't know, quit asking me
RD_ALifeLine_531d15925d27bc97: Nobody that I know, and I think about that more than I should
RD_ALifeLine_63b738af0bae0413: I remember hearing somebody breaking into a school
RD_ALifeLine_3dd4e5587e992e0f: No.. only feet through the gap then they were running
RD_ALifeLine_7c608a5121dafd27: You couldn't know who it was from that.. I wouldn't have chased them alone
RD_ALifeLine_089c37be2ce07bc3: Why aren't you at the station?
RD_ALifeLine_7780af74466964e3: The station's got seven dead and a locked gate
RD_ALifeLine_720c5df235f84915: Dead like the rest of them, ma'am, I can't go in there, that's why I'm out here with you
RD_ALifeLine_1a4759be7d5fe7ec: Should we go to the church or the school?
RD_ALifeLine_55cb4839587f6cd0: Church has a better lock, school has more people
RD_ALifeLine_1d4e54352b4ab54b: It means more people is more noise, and the noise is what brings them, so church
RD_ALifeLine_1174438427374445: What did you see, exactly? Tell me exactly what you saw
RD_ALifeLine_7a9181856ca70321: Mr. Whitaker, he was in his yard, and he was- he was eating, I think, I don't know-
RD_ALifeLine_32265d8c518cbc3e: Okay, stop, that's enough, I get it
RD_ALifeLine_0e598dfe7ec28fb5: He was eating, officer, he was ON the ground and he was-
RD_ALifeLine_34d731970783e109: You got anybody in your family?
RD_ALifeLine_2bcf8bde290e3171: Last I knew, my wife and kids were in Elizabethtown
RD_ALifeLine_2772984c57695aa5: No, ma'am. Tried for so long that stopping feels like giving up, but I don't know where they are now
RD_ALifeLine_2598fd7c1595bf25: Look at me, I'm all over blood, it's not mine, it's not mine, it's NOT mine
RD_ALifeLine_2709ecfc04ff2abd: Hold still, let me check you
RD_ALifeLine_39c61f221a6a2323: It's my brother's, I tried to carry him-
RD_ALifeLine_5c65fdf021083670: You're clean, you're not bit, sit down, take a breath
RD_ALifeLine_4269941474dcc38a: If somebody asked how many were sheltering with you would you tell them?
RD_ALifeLine_1bd508283e5dfbd8: I'd want to know why they were asking
RD_ALifeLine_29c7a1522fe23d11: What if they asked about weapons?
RD_ALifeLine_783a1bd2684fd98c: Then I'd want to know even more.. why should I tell a stranger that?
RD_ALifeLine_37fa63ec42971a1a: You shouldn't just because they're wearing a badge.. fair enough
RD_ALifeLine_675d254520298e73: Where do the cops go when the world ends?
RD_ALifeLine_2acc0f6702bd8486: Same place as everybody else, the nearest place with a lock
RD_ALifeLine_72996da104d021e1: It's what we call a plan these days, I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_13c98f2e6c962169: My neighbors are screaming, they've been screaming for an hour, why won't you go help them?
RD_ALifeLine_05b9c0a7040861bb: And there's nobody left to help, I'm sorry, I'm so sorry
RD_ALifeLine_07434f1d3236f9fa: Something at the end of the hall
RD_ALifeLine_65b5f96b6353a288: Don't know, don't breathe, I'll tell you when
RD_ALifeLine_2f6b1ec64aba8e8b: Please don't leave me alone with these people, I don't know them
RD_ALifeLine_23fa4d1929ff4d0b: They're fine, they're just scared like you
RD_ALifeLine_2fc2f2435c994af2: They've got guns, they're looking at me funny, I just want to be with you!
RD_ALifeLine_1258cd601fcadbcb: Okay, okay, stay close, don't talk to anybody, just stay close
RD_ALifeLine_24bf4aae284d7133: Don't just agree with me, I want to fight!
RD_ALifeLine_211b7ca176238ebb: Then fight me, I'm tired, I'd welcome it
RD_ALifeLine_301b3141669500a9: Is he really a deputy? He doesn't look like one
RD_ALifeLine_761073c84752c0ad: I'm a corrections officer, from the county jail, I'm all you've got, so you can quit asking
RD_ALifeLine_0bd20e542aae0ad2: Then why aren't you inside it, locking somebody up?
RD_ALifeLine_3da4de6100571800: Because there's no jail, ma'am, there's a building full of locked cells and nothing good in any of them
RD_ALifeLine_4ef30de0021ac887: Do the bullets even work? On their chests, anywhere?
RD_ALifeLine_1f8b1224585c10e4: How do I hit a head?
RD_ALifeLine_32a087187856d1ed: Get close, closer than you want, and don't stop to think about it
RD_ALifeLine_550252ec5acf3460: When did you last see another officer?
RD_ALifeLine_1773241019702c22: Around noon, a state trooper went by, headed for the interstate
RD_ALifeLine_087076943960ff05: He raised two fingers off the wheel, that's all, I'll hold on to that
RD_ALifeLine_3ab80f9954ebfb46: It's YOUR fault we're stuck here, you said wait for the police!
RD_ALifeLine_1c1bfd31506dcddf: Folks, folks, keep it down, please, every word you yell is a signal flare
RD_ALifeLine_306f15e1218f93bb: Then tell her to stop blaming me!
RD_ALifeLine_345f9fe02d5a7e4b: Nobody's blaming anybody, I need you both to shut your mouths and look at me
RD_ALifeLine_4b99ef0f6a8f0744: Deputies, maybe you know where we should go?
RD_ALifeLine_0f64371902fdd503: The school, they said the school
RD_ALifeLine_4cdc0b6523e25aa1: No, the church, my cousin's at the church!
RD_ALifeLine_5fdd9a5306667afd: I don't know, honestly, I don't know which one's better, pick the one that's closest
RD_ALifeLine_3a8bbfff69332f30: Is he going to be alright?
RD_ALifeLine_08b2a8e67771af4f: I don't know, I'm no doctor

RD_ALifeLine_44b7a6635d9ac96a: ...I'm not ready to talk about it, give me a minute, a minute, please

RD_ALifeLine_417ebd312a5e4d62: Come away from there, come away, we'll let him rest, come with me
RD_ALifeLine_3b68217d2f2a8beb: This is YOUR fault! You said it was nothing!
RD_ALifeLine_751c83781cbf5c64: I thought it WAS nothing, everybody said it was nothing!
RD_ALifeLine_25237e351246b585: Everybody's not my husband! You are!
RD_ALifeLine_1a76ea6860aa3572: Okay, okay, I know, I was wrong, scream at me, scream all you want
RD_ALifeLine_75b8b5a1480cd614: What if somebody comes and we don't know they're friends?

RD_ALifeLine_080772507d1d36b2: Make a list of what we have

RD_ALifeLine_35ae839108b7b375: Then fourteen's gone, write it down, I'll write it down, just- write it down
RD_ALifeLine_0d77816f18206526: Not anymore, I called four times, nobody picks up

RD_ALifeLine_1caf8c052c2ebfc6: "Subject expired, subject got up, subject approached, subject was neutralized"
RD_ALifeLine_5e8e043f2a2f7ca9: Then put it in a drawer, nobody's gonna read it, I'm not even sure what it means

RD_ALifeLine_2337e8c5086eaa0d: They WERE people, they were my neighbors, and I'd do it again, so let them try
RD_ALifeLine_70810d880ca6adc2: Shots fired, shots fired, I'm getting it on the radio!
RD_ALifeLine_0b16f8867757fcbd: It doesn't say, it's all static, a guy saying shots fired over and over

RD_ALifeLine_779bfe075334d516: Well, I'm in the area, so I'd say I'm evacuating, I'm just not sure where I'm going

RD_ALifeLine_78f64d047a9cc3a1: Then look before we move, don't decide we're safe just because we can't see it

RD_ALifeLine_7021878b3ab87852: Our men hold the county road, we check everybody, no exceptions
RD_ALifeLine_4f34b1600a6655f0: Checkpoints keep out the raiders, but they also keep out good folks, it breaks my heart
RD_ALifeLine_303123e5329af1f8: We'll let you through if you're peaceful, just leave your weapons with us
RD_ALifeLine_644838a94e7cd9fe: Checkpoints? Ugh, don't ask, they stop everyone, ask a hundred questions, then maybe let you through
RD_ALifeLine_66ec2d4d11ea97ad: I hear they're turning folks back, and shooting those who argue, I'd avoid them if I were you
RD_ALifeLine_616a449f422d9987: Roadblocks everywhere, it's like they don't want anyone to leave, not that anyone could
RD_ALifeLine_355060ee3d5a86d6: Be polite, hands visible, don't make sudden moves, that's the only advice I've got
RD_ALifeLine_4872e0784732d146: Don't ask me about checkpoints, I want nothing to do with them
RD_ALifeLine_246c6b7d012016f0: Those soldiers are just boys, scared boys, be kind to them and they'll be kind back, mostly
RD_ALifeLine_06b3b8085f226794: Just routine, do what we ask and you'll be on your way
RD_ALifeLine_1d2e6b0a2c13f9bb: We've got a few, and we're strict, nobody wants a bite getting through
RD_ALifeLine_31f0a5e213d447b3: Checkpoints are in place for containment, comply and you'll pass
RD_ALifeLine_15601a5307e5eb3f: Do not approach armed, state your business, wait for clearance
RD_ALifeLine_25dfcda277088d3d: Checkpoints? Ha, I go around them, they're full of sheep with guns
RD_ALifeLine_0184fd4517f9d24d: Don't bother, they'll just rob you, legally
RD_ALifeLine_27f4b8e06ef7352f: What do you care? You planning something?
RD_ALifeLine_1dba92f31940ccc6: Checkpoints are for people who behave
RD_ALifeLine_095cd01b5fd9fe64: Why, so you can sneak past it? Not telling
RD_ALifeLine_3353dd6e7f55bb7a: I don't have a confirmed checkpoint to send you to
RD_ALifeLine_6b7389111cee9c6d: A few cars across a road don't tell you who's giving the orders
RD_ALifeLine_0a8feef26a3ebbe3: Looking for permission to pass? You won't find it in this conversation
RD_ALifeLine_344ad72b70aefe25: I'd like somebody official to tell me which way is alright, I really would
RD_ALifeLine_20e016387842d7ec: No verified passage, do not assume a uniform means an open route
RD_ALifeLine_71f8fc2e64e2a008: I'd rather say I don't know than send you into a standoff
RD_ALifeLine_00b08ea1367a22a6: Nobody ever built a roadblock to make a trip easier
RD_ALifeLine_599b7bd5454ac382: Ask who's collecting the toll before you start counting your change
RD_ALifeLine_35d3d061260ee422: Some people call it a checkpoint because it sounds nicer than what it is
RD_ALifeLine_170959666c47d350: They turned us around at the county line, not mean about it, just turned us around
RD_ALifeLine_23231fc57bf9c033: They took our names on a clipboard and said wait in the car, we waited six hours
RD_ALifeLine_58771ab61d6d03b2: They'll want your hands, show 'em before they ask and the whole thing goes quicker
RD_ALifeLine_15ceb0bc0e3d24ff: They let the ambulance through on the sixth, not the seventh, nothing changed but the day
RD_ALifeLine_4add19860ef035ca: A boy of nineteen with a rifle told me to go home, he called me sir, he was shaking
RD_ALifeLine_44f776421586d5d2: Wave from far off, stop when they say stop, don't get out, don't reach for nothing
RD_ALifeLine_1fc133555f497cf6: They asked my temperature like I'd know it, I said warm, that's all I knew
RD_ALifeLine_47b24a104d4172b6: They run a thermometer on you, anybody warm goes in the second line, don't be warm
RD_ALifeLine_5028b3c675e88b86: That's the Guard, not us, they don't take our calls and we quit taking theirs
RD_ALifeLine_64e474546b9d9cca: Two conversations through a rifle scope this month, both with our own Army
RD_ALifeLine_6aebb013389c3d69: Roadblock procedure, they wave, they call out, then they fire on the road, in that order
RD_ALifeLine_7462368733e7c815: I stood one for two days, I still don't know what I was supposed to be stopping
RD_ALifeLine_60b67f43661eae62: A static post is men told what to do and never told why, behave accordingly
RD_ALifeLine_4e780a525543486d: Rode up on one at dusk, they put six lights on me, I turned around real slow
RD_ALifeLine_61f96a1a1dd2938b: There's a man at one post takes whiskey for a slow look, I didn't say which post
RD_ALifeLine_30e4331428addc21: Been through four, three took a bribe, one took my rifle, cost of doing business
RD_ALifeLine_200fc79e0ad6039e: They bulldozed the road behind theirs, even if they let you by, you can't come back
RD_ALifeLine_36ece09f0b3e8182: Bridge is blocked with two dump trucks and a wire, the wire's the part folks miss
RD_ALifeLine_06d0329169dfa153: Don't drive at it, there's a car out there that drove at it and it's still sitting there
RD_ALifeLine_0508d81c241974d8: I go around, always around, nobody at a roadblock has ever been glad to see me
RD_ALifeLine_22fb2bbd1e5d6517: They don't recognize my badge, I learned that at forty feet with my hands up
RD_ALifeLine_642ab2620951d8d2: On foot, in daylight, hands empty, talking the whole way, or don't approach at all
RD_ALifeLine_75655f7a4ce11c4a: I stood on one, then I walked off one, that's all I'll say, if it's alright with you
RD_ALifeLine_2d61604c20f0cc9b: Ours is a gate and a bell, theirs is a wire and a machine gun, know which you're at
RD_ALifeLine_254bf4e561ac7816: They wouldn't take my daughter, said she had a cough, she's had that cough since May
RD_ALifeLine_6bdee15656973c92: We put a truck across a road too, ours don't come with any rules, though
RD_ALifeLine_525ad56f3b106d35: There's a checkpoint on this street, it's me, what are you carrying?
RD_ALifeLine_0e67785d07ab0b39: Them roadblocks are the best thing ever happened to me, nobody can run anywhere
RD_ALifeLine_456a8bba4bcda064: Gates, wire, a man with a list, I've done this before, different clothes, same deal
RD_ALifeLine_52388b4243f7ad85: Go stand in that line yourself, take a jug of water, you'll be there a while
RD_ALifeLine_27d1e0a03f592038: They ain't letting anybody out and they ain't telling you that part out loud
RD_ALifeLine_40b47df063943029: Checkpoint? That's a toll booth, {g:pal|lady}, and I'm the toll collector
RD_ALifeLine_6b587a2570ece790: Checkpoints are the only thing that works, {g:brother|sister}, nobody wants chaos
RD_ALifeLine_1fc00b00336a968d: Church? yes, there's one down the road, little white one, steeple, the doors are open, people go there, to pray
RD_ALifeLine_5dc40039354326b2: Saint Anne's... or Calvary, or the Baptist one, I forget which, somebody's THERE, I saw a light
RD_ALifeLine_5088806006076748: W-we pray together in the evenings... the few of us who are left, it helps, a little
RD_ALifeLine_1943a36169ffd3c9: I don't go... I'm not religious, but I understand why you'd want to
RD_ALifeLine_355a16c015cfb2b7: There's a service every Sunday, even now, even if only three people come
RD_ALifeLine_1a7cdca51fe4c77c: The church is a gathering spot, a clearinghouse for news, a place to sit, a place to cry
RD_ALifeLine_78d8c4575efc07d2: Pastor's still there, still preaching, still burying, he's a strong man
RD_ALifeLine_3927c865043eeed5: Nuns at the convent take people in, feed them, pray for them, they're tough...
RD_ALifeLine_4af6af0a3d97a655: Thick walls and it's quiet, that's the best I can say for it
RD_ALifeLine_32b599d432d71318: Churches are the first place they look, and the last place they give up on
RD_ALifeLine_1c5c43924a2d27b3: You'd be welcome, there's always a pew, sit wherever you like
RD_ALifeLine_11c72707412abe8a: Church? now? what for? God left
RD_ALifeLine_7438c9ec086c4dad: Our doors are always open... come in, rest, pray, or just sit in the quiet
RD_ALifeLine_03d811425c426dc1: We hold vespers at dusk, you're welcome to stay, there's always a seat
RD_ALifeLine_629b58e450a3a4d2: Honey, I've been to church every Sunday for seventy years, and I'm not stopping now
RD_ALifeLine_344deb2070f060fc: We pray at the table... every meal, even if it's just a cracker
RD_ALifeLine_1ba6d73842f2075d: Church? There's one down the road, full of people praying, they made the mistake of locking the doors
RD_ALifeLine_06f22fc01decd6aa: I don't do church, preacher took my money once and told me it was God's will
RD_ALifeLine_4aae15871853ab2d: Church is for people who still believe someone's listening
RD_ALifeLine_12909a3312aab2ed: Sure, there's one, but if you go in I wouldn't turn my back on the pastor
RD_ALifeLine_0af9dbe118c505aa: Church? You can pray all you like, nobody's answering!
RD_ALifeLine_7d9b5d2019de600e: Honestly? I've been thinking about going, sit in the back, just to feel something
RD_ALifeLine_2a8f4d4207b0ee16: Yeah, there's a little chapel, they take in anyone, no questions, I stayed a night once, they fed me
RD_ALifeLine_5043384517c71778: Church? My grandmother's church is still there, I think, the choir was singing last week
RD_ALifeLine_6ec160744e933a0a: Preacher on the corner takes people in, he's good people, don't mess with him
RD_ALifeLine_63342c2d546b19d9: Church's full of folks hiding, they got nowhere else to go
RD_ALifeLine_10b73b9e59610ce3: Church? There's no church for you!
RD_ALifeLine_2dc0584259e12b21: I go sometimes, sit in the back pew, nobody bothers me
RD_ALifeLine_29cc7ef564e4d184: Church? There's one on the hill, ringing the bell every evening, I like the sound
RD_ALifeLine_0faa216a3e69b874: Not a churchgoing man, but I respect those who are, there's one past the quarry
RD_ALifeLine_4ba76d0772897917: Reverend at the little white one took in a dozen strays, fed 'em for a week
RD_ALifeLine_1801aee32ea00fc7: Church? Not for the likes of you!
RD_ALifeLine_10fb28b1534bf7c5: Church, naturally, there's several in the county, all with congregations, all with secrets
RD_ALifeLine_430983695658756f: Some pastors are more sympathetic than others
RD_ALifeLine_3a1b3b2a187c1ef3: I'd gladly escort you, if you'd like
RD_ALifeLine_2000f06410898c04: Church? Oh God, yes, I want to, I want to pray, but I'm scared I'll burn up when I walk in

RD_ALifeLine_451637e478264075: Don't talk to me about church!
RD_ALifeLine_0645502512c39ecc: There's a small one, quiet, maybe we could sit together
RD_ALifeLine_31918ff27d92e77d: Little country church, back in the woods, still ringing the bell, I think
RD_ALifeLine_718208cf4c479433: Preacher there doesn't ask questions, hands out soup on Sundays
RD_ALifeLine_4a10344a170341a1: I'll take you, friend, I haven't been in years

RD_ALifeLine_3decff2f4604ff4e: Pastor Ellis runs a prayer group each evening, all are welcome
RD_ALifeLine_06f9c5df32ba83a1: I can't confirm any church as a shelter

RD_ALifeLine_1e13a57f6dfa8b7e: I go when I can, it helps, you're welcome to join me

RD_ALifeLine_3595e8425e47afb9: Churches are not on the approved shelter list
RD_ALifeLine_0da6b59c44db70e1: I try to attend, it keeps me sane
RD_ALifeLine_66c1c26765aad831: I pray in my bunk every night, does that count? I'm not sure it counts

RD_ALifeLine_24292dc760c0989b: Go ask somebody who's in a forgiving mood

RD_ALifeLine_7c9d7f9a01278b56: No verified aid station at a church, I can't send you to one

RD_ALifeLine_58ab9f797819a33a: Best roof repair I ever did was for a church, got paid in cash and three casseroles

RD_ALifeLine_698b4d9d37ca59d1: They pray at the Methodist one with the lights off, I sat in the back a while
RD_ALifeLine_0f07cf0b3a29ca9c: Sixty-two years in the same pew, third from the front, left side, seat's still there
RD_ALifeLine_713b010d749e14ea: The clergy fella keeps a list of who's alive, worth more than a prayer right now
RD_ALifeLine_77ff5fb858fc106d: I've buried eleven people out of one church this month... so yes, there's a church
RD_ALifeLine_112bd5535de88fa2: Chaplain went out with the second convoy, we say our own now, or we don't
RD_ALifeLine_0a2a1cd030dda2b6: Mama'd want me in a church, I keep meaning to, I keep not going

RD_ALifeLine_1b6d9f7771221ea5: Got baptized in the Ohio when I was nine, that's the last church business I did
RD_ALifeLine_7a68dfac7dbed86f: Church folks feed people and don't ask questions, don't tell 'em I said useful

RD_ALifeLine_510666031798361d: I don't know, I used to go, I don't know what I'd say in there now

RD_ALifeLine_3454a6241e828769: There's a group in a church that don't want a uniform walking in, I respect that
RD_ALifeLine_3673773813574706: Unconfirmed, any building with fifty people in it, I approach slow
RD_ALifeLine_5d483c1969a404cb: I slept in a church balcony three nights, nobody ever looks up, that's my advice
RD_ALifeLine_504d23c16e5cc1cc: They pray, we watch the road, don't go in armed, they'll ask you to step out
RD_ALifeLine_4666a9310c9d3b2b: My girl asked if God's asleep, I said maybe he's busy, don't make me say more
RD_ALifeLine_6dc594c006c42143: A church? Sure, go on in and pray, see if He gets to you before we do
RD_ALifeLine_3c4996db0ab0bc5e: Church folks are the easiest people in this county, they open the door every time
RD_ALifeLine_2134eba717519cf1: We leave churches alone, not out of respect, they got nothing worth the walk
RD_ALifeLine_3b16cb44475c86a1: Chaplain came round every Sunday for four years, never once brought me a smoke
RD_ALifeLine_74973a6b01fbaecf: I prayed six days straight, don't ask me about churches
RD_ALifeLine_7b3707857ca9dcb8: Go if it helps you, it quit helping me somewhere around the ninth
RD_ALifeLine_2bd42fcb4c3c672a: I'll walk you over, {g:brother|sister}, it's a good place
RD_ALifeLine_385cb0a054867447: It's winter, cold comes with the territory

RD_ALifeLine_7730694c129c795a: Cold? Can't tell anymore, everything's the same temperature now

RD_ALifeLine_0f5956ef7262bfb6: It's part of the job, doesn't mean I like it
RD_ALifeLine_4521b9430a30d24a: Freezing, yeah, but I'm still going out there

RD_ALifeLine_2fd3068d770f2762: Cold? A little, nothing a drink wouldn't fix
RD_ALifeLine_5aa827df2a3efe69: Cold, yes, always cold, my hands are blocks of ice
RD_ALifeLine_32b53d9d5427fb7f: Cold enough, I don't stop walking
RD_ALifeLine_458f17de6c0689d9: A bit, friend, come near the stove
RD_ALifeLine_05c733813465f1c1: Burn them? I don't know, I don't want to think about it, I can't, I just can't
RD_ALifeLine_07ca06941dd5abd3: We put them in the ground, the ones we could, with a prayer, with a flower, with a name
RD_ALifeLine_223d013e66963375: Leave them, don't touch them, don't LOOK at them, just walk away

RD_ALifeLine_473c5d0e4dc1f148: Not my business, and not yours
RD_ALifeLine_6a9c0cdb2b6a75bf: Find a shovel, and a strong stomach
RD_ALifeLine_39e84cbd00cc7c21: Don't touch that one, I don't know what killed it, and I don't know you, move away

RD_ALifeLine_31bb98155fc58282: I bury them, if I can, it feels right, even though it's pointless
RD_ALifeLine_459014d947e30e33: Honestly, I say a few words over them, just in case

RD_ALifeLine_1493ba641a421545: Pile 'em somewhere far away, downwind, don't ask me why

RD_ALifeLine_4a4f435a523b9cd1: Quiet prayers, friend, quiet footsteps, quiet hearts

RD_ALifeLine_4a9e3a6f3924cd50: Don't fire just to solve a problem you haven't looked at yet

RD_ALifeLine_5de9cf28103ee12a: Whispers only, {g:brother|sister}, even when you're drunk

RD_ALifeLine_19d7822903ea1623: If it has a wall, it has a gate, and if it has a gate, it has someone who'll shoot you at it
RD_ALifeLine_3d98a584480f4001: There's rumors of a big camp up north, with food and showers, I laughed when I heard
RD_ALifeLine_5bcfe8fc466b6005: Settlements? There's one here, and you're not welcome!
RD_ALifeLine_0a9e42c452480eb2: I heard of a place, a farm with real walls, they take in anyone who can work, I'm thinking about it
RD_ALifeLine_2dc7f4b368507e72: Camps? Like with tents? Nah, we stay in our own turf
RD_ALifeLine_743ab15d51ca997d: Some folks built a barricade around the school, they let people in for food
RD_ALifeLine_3b26824b7aee6c9b: Safe camps are traps, they take your stuff and make you work
RD_ALifeLine_543bb6493fe95f56: Heard there's one near the stadium, with soup, I might check it out
RD_ALifeLine_02a934173f53a1d0: There's a compound out past the county line, bikers and families, I think they take strangers
RD_ALifeLine_5d4a87f8752228a9: Clubhouse is home, not a camp, and it's built like a bunker
RD_ALifeLine_063bf32761f74da4: I could vouch for you at the compound, if you're serious
RD_ALifeLine_2819385046779521: Several settlements exist, with varying degrees of hospitality
RD_ALifeLine_1443f7127d654821: I could recommend one, though the introduction would cost
RD_ALifeLine_7beeb16738804569: There's a decent place, well managed, I'll write you a note
RD_ALifeLine_3295508e58c56342: Camp? No, no, they'd ask for papers, they'd find out who I am
RD_ALifeLine_4ac159b53395209c: I'd love a camp, with a roof, and soup, and a guard to watch the night
RD_ALifeLine_5bde4a8860bcdc3b: Stay away from camps, they're traps!
RD_ALifeLine_38edc0e25bbb402c: Please, if you find one, tell me, I'll follow you anywhere
RD_ALifeLine_2e4d1ba02fcbcd17: Few and far between, and every one of them suspicious of strangers
RD_ALifeLine_2e39bed328bbc9a0: I've seen smoke from one near the ridge, I never went close
RD_ALifeLine_728771ff0d031707: I know a family with a stockade, they're good people, they'd let you in
RD_ALifeLine_775c93502755b3b6: The courthouse is the closest thing we have to an official shelter
RD_ALifeLine_533a2b43035f468a: We're coordinating with other groups, but nothing formal
RD_ALifeLine_04fe38da4f91e481: Several communities have formed, I can give you a list of the ones we trust
RD_ALifeLine_2b93f856510eb630: I won't call a place secure without knowing who's holding it
RD_ALifeLine_2783e28f3359886d: Come with me, I'll introduce you to the group at the courthouse
RD_ALifeLine_044b60994b2857bb: Official evacuation points have not been established
RD_ALifeLine_11135a3073e7afaf: There's a staging area at the base, but it's restricted
RD_ALifeLine_6beee2720c774804: I'd love to point you somewhere safe, friend, I really would
RD_ALifeLine_021132131adebf4f: I heard the base has a camp, but they won't let us go there, I don't understand
RD_ALifeLine_7115614503cbbc7c: Our township is the nearest, we take in those who can work and follow rules
RD_ALifeLine_7ffcdfdf6c26a0e3: There's a stockade at the Fisher place, twenty families, strong walls
RD_ALifeLine_798ee09d727d4eb9: Come with us, friend, we've room for those who need it
RD_ALifeLine_2114a1ee37b362d2: Even if I knew where, I'd keep my mouth shut
RD_ALifeLine_199dda1f4ec1878d: We're setting up a few, but they're temporary, and not open to just anyone
RD_ALifeLine_4806d18b79bd7d1c: There's one, I can't say where, but we're always looking for good people
RD_ALifeLine_20e2d36031eb0ebb: Unknown, but I'll note your interest
RD_ALifeLine_419e63d9650cb61f: There's a place, run by folks who don't ask questions, I like it there
RD_ALifeLine_11ec731b46daf438: You think I'd tell you? Ha
RD_ALifeLine_6f958f652f38b946: Look for the biggest fence, and a lot of guns
RD_ALifeLine_37642f9b1e90e82a: You'll get no outpost from me
RD_ALifeLine_56de45a93125d209: Move on, that location is need-to-know and you don't need to
RD_ALifeLine_10cb499b15a7b3e2: Plenty of places, none for you
RD_ALifeLine_5126460e341e1529: I can't give you a confirmed outpost location
RD_ALifeLine_48ef8c5e5fd4f63c: I don't hand out other people's hiding places
RD_ALifeLine_41c58404416f01ce: I like the sound of somewhere organized, doesn't mean I know where one is
RD_ALifeLine_3fd2bd6924f385e8: No position disclosure to an unknown civilian
RD_ALifeLine_6abbcb5e3653b29a: I'd want a confirmed welcome before sending someone toward armed guards
RD_ALifeLine_5c07222e14c5b81a: Putting up boards is easier than deciding who gets through the door
RD_ALifeLine_1dd4357b02d717a7: You wouldn't give me the address of everybody you care about, same goes here
RD_ALifeLine_6c29277a7545ee76: Keep asking where people sleep, see how friendly that makes them
RD_ALifeLine_70f939902942978b: There's people in a walled yard somewhere, I heard a generator and I walked the other way
RD_ALifeLine_7d68fbf305d8b301: We're it, four grown, two kids, a block wall and a dog scared of everything
RD_ALifeLine_2c47c59f281f3add: Anybody with a fence and a plan keeps a list on the door, get your name on a list
RD_ALifeLine_452da81f30052bce: Firehouse is holding, big doors, a well, and a hundred feet of hose that's no use now
RD_ALifeLine_1039e9b65f984509: No wall to speak of, we're just sitting in a church with the doors shut
RD_ALifeLine_461cbf62328f23ad: Laundry hanging on a line means they've got water to spare
RD_ALifeLine_77e02f8d0b20da59: This porch is my outpost, been on it since the fourth and I ain't lost it yet
RD_ALifeLine_1ff6bb2b7882cb1d: Find the one with a nurse in it, walls are easy, people who can stitch ain't
RD_ALifeLine_6e048cd03aa378f8: There's a couple places holding, I won't say where, you'd do the same in my boots
RD_ALifeLine_3d6e8f8b659b72de: Everything organized in this county got that way 'cause one hard person made it so
RD_ALifeLine_64a1d1aa7793dcdc: Any position worth the name has two exits and somebody awake, ask about both
RD_ALifeLine_5a35d2ef373dcf36: We were a checkpoint, then we were four guys and a truck, now I don't know what we are
RD_ALifeLine_46ad9c3735687c61: Positions change hands, anything I gave you would be three days old and dangerous
RD_ALifeLine_3efae2b26617f48e: Club's got a shop with a roll door, it's ours, you'd know it if you weren't welcome
RD_ALifeLine_1aab28384c6f51b7: There's a place takes anybody who brings goods, I wouldn't describe it as safe
RD_ALifeLine_3cd4e125602be5f1: Three places hiring, two pay in food, one pays in promises, guess which one's bigger
RD_ALifeLine_7d11b394093574f2: A gate that swings out beats one that swings in, look at the hinges before you walk in
RD_ALifeLine_057ee37e74642bc7: A settlement's just people who agreed on rules, so ask what the rules are first
RD_ALifeLine_0c9d30d519627387: I'm not telling a stranger where people sleep, ask me anything else, please
RD_ALifeLine_3002ce7c356f51c2: I stay away from them, a camp's a bell that rings for miles
RD_ALifeLine_71f244735fc5e541: I'd want to know who's holding a place before I told anybody it was there
RD_ALifeLine_013a085139a7df5d: Negative on locations, if they want you, they'll find you on the road
RD_ALifeLine_357ed3a965fc023c: There's a cordon post that looks like a settlement from a distance, don't make that mistake
RD_ALifeLine_7757d8955e5c5b18: You're standing at one, Wanda reads the list and you ain't on the list yet
RD_ALifeLine_0913682301707720: We got turned away from one, they were real nice about it, that's the part that sits on me
RD_ALifeLine_635e3063017cb632: There's a nice one about four mile out, we're going Thursday, you in or out?
RD_ALifeLine_1947159f7ec93e81: The block's the only settlement that counts and you're stood on the edge of it
RD_ALifeLine_17d43cb245653868: I know every walled place in this county, that's my work, yours is walking away
RD_ALifeLine_3890e63a3c931824: A wall's a wall, I don't much care which side they tell me I'm on
RD_ALifeLine_0358a2c3581b8091: I asked that same question at three doors, go find out what that's like
RD_ALifeLine_779fc90c45ce1836: Every place that was organized in June is a story people tell now, think on that
RD_ALifeLine_6d5958bc58c88fdb: Why, you want a safe place? No such thing, {g:pal|lady}
RD_ALifeLine_36c41ee81be08681: Camps tend to fall apart, {g:brother|sister}, someone always gets bit
RD_ALifeLine_75b2197d090df8b7: A dog, a mutt, named Biscuit, he's- he was, I don't know, I had to leave him, I had to leave him!
RD_ALifeLine_5247c6ed5aac9072: A cat, an orange tabby, she hated everybody, but she liked me, and I miss her so, so much
RD_ALifeLine_076872f664153d24: Had a beagle, he followed me for three days, then he went off after a squirrel, and I hope he's alive
RD_ALifeLine_23b91a061cc9aaab: A parakeet, believe it or not, I let it go, it was the only thing I could do
RD_ALifeLine_54d2c560491f3804: Two dogs, a Lab and a shepherd, they're my security system, they bark if anyone gets close
RD_ALifeLine_2d59daac2f1104b1: A horse, an old gelding, he's in the pasture, the grass is still green, I check on him
RD_ALifeLine_3f0775b64d7649b9: No pets, I couldn't keep a goldfish alive, thank God I never had a dog, I'd have killed him
RD_ALifeLine_06d290a77370b850: Dog, he's my family, he's lying right over there, he doesn't talk, but he's smart
RD_ALifeLine_0842d4c04b5e1630: Saw a stray the other day... a skinny little thing, I left a can of tuna, I don't know why, it just felt right
RD_ALifeLine_19bca76607cf4e53: Chickens, six of 'em, they're alive, they're eating bugs, and laying eggs, it's the one good thing
RD_ALifeLine_7679e07835a1b44c: I had a dog named Boone
RD_ALifeLine_10e3103d3e8c3d3d: There was a cat, an orange one, who ruled the porch
RD_ALifeLine_2594e62b3efef4ac: My horse is the reason I'm alive
RD_ALifeLine_11577fd91fbacd88: A parrot, can you believe that
RD_ALifeLine_032882681556c35a: I've got a pair of beagles
RD_ALifeLine_231d9e9a0b530085: The kids' hamster died on the second day
RD_ALifeLine_06eb10ed11a999f0: My old hound sleeps at my feet
RD_ALifeLine_44a9204416e8ef16: Two cats, a dog, and a rabbit
RD_ALifeLine_74b7947e4025e57f: My dog wouldn't leave the porch
RD_ALifeLine_6d214ce602f5b787: My pets are my own business
RD_ALifeLine_0005daa862e35b0a: Keep any animal away from me, dogs bark, barking brings them, I'm not dying over somebody's pet
RD_ALifeLine_7a4b6b060ab562e2: Hound named Duke, best friend I ever had, best partner, never lied to me once
RD_ALifeLine_326e62b91e7d3d71: A cat named Mittens, thirteen years, she sits in my lap and doesn't care that the world ended
RD_ALifeLine_5a1c4870423b85bd: My dog is the best dog in the whole world, I won't leave without him, I don't care what anyone says
RD_ALifeLine_4d43a46f61f96875: The kids are devastated about the cat, we left her at the neighbor's, and I tell them she's fine
RD_ALifeLine_4f5bd3a66ce925ff: A cat who thinks she's a dog, and a dog who thinks he's a cat
RD_ALifeLine_086c116132303942: Had a dog, a good one, the best, until the dead got him
RD_ALifeLine_681b88b84f8331c3: No, they just get you killed, barking and everything
RD_ALifeLine_1a8b318f375b4280: A cat, but she ran away on day two
RD_ALifeLine_775c33c24e6ab75e: Quit asking stupid questions or I'll make you my pet
RD_ALifeLine_537da5cd690c03c9: A dog, Duke, he's around here somewhere, hell of a guy
RD_ALifeLine_04fbbc647e981fdc: Pit bull, name's Bruiser, he's the toughest on the block
RD_ALifeLine_190fc8d03830909d: My dog bites strangers, just like me
RD_ALifeLine_3bbd0935467ced6b: A mutt named Spud, I'd give anything to find him
RD_ALifeLine_72deb6471969a0fd: A dog, Hank, rides in the sidecar... did, anyway
RD_ALifeLine_52a685e34a3d6d59: Cats, I like cats, they don't ask questions
RD_ALifeLine_61596c7620bffe65: Don't ask about my dog unless you want to meet him
RD_ALifeLine_315846a6287dcc66: A beagle named Dolly, she's my best friend
RD_ALifeLine_70290ab850274c6b: No pets, they leave hair and evidence
RD_ALifeLine_5f5465e44761ac42: A cat, it's independent, I admire that
RD_ALifeLine_4fc977a44683e9f6: A dog, she's the only honest one in the family
RD_ALifeLine_66ecc2c21ad7e016: Had a bird in the cell once, for a week, then they took it
RD_ALifeLine_0e7cb597616f995c: No pets, no friends, no nothing
RD_ALifeLine_7b4982ee48b1e717: Nobody! Don't ask me about anything I love!
RD_ALifeLine_4b9cc34b7267a394: Always wanted a dog, maybe now I'll get one
RD_ALifeLine_08eb199714f55c2a: Hound, best tracker I ever had, lost him in the woods yesterday
RD_ALifeLine_12bf3d997b7e0ebc: A horse, back at the camp, she's like family
RD_ALifeLine_225ff7c85cb8d4ec: Two coonhounds, they're out hunting somewhere, bless them
RD_ALifeLine_0ba241d417ba9459: K-9 partner, Sasha, she's the best dog I've ever known
RD_ALifeLine_038573c60e25d9e0: A cat at home, I hope she's alright
RD_ALifeLine_42f99d0534ab944d: Questions about pets are not relevant right now
RD_ALifeLine_5164f5904e016e11: Yes, a Labrador, she's with my wife, I hope
RD_ALifeLine_2106a0003fe26ba8: An old bloodhound, deaf as a post, but he's my best deputy
RD_ALifeLine_25edea083ca784e4: No, the Army doesn't allow it
RD_ALifeLine_0b75ad141f637ced: A cat back home, I miss her
RD_ALifeLine_16c37423557f5748: A golden retriever, my mom's got him, he's the best
RD_ALifeLine_430e423e4c42196d: I had a hamster, it's stupid, I miss it
RD_ALifeLine_10ac6c2e4696d261: Barn cats and a good hound, he's out on the porch
RD_ALifeLine_7685b9906a67b3ff: Cattle dog, she herds everything, even me
RD_ALifeLine_757ea8f856acdc93: Dogs and horses, they're why we stay on the farm
RD_ALifeLine_0819296c1afc5b78: Our dog Buster won't leave the porch, keeps waiting on the mail truck, mail ain't come since Thursday
RD_ALifeLine_44fad48b48066669: I let the cat out when we left, left a whole bag of food open on the kitchen floor, I hope she's fat and mean now
RD_ALifeLine_312103f86e3e14cf: Have you seen a beagle? Dolly, pink collar, tag's got our phone number on it, not that anybody's answering
RD_ALifeLine_09e00964509b4bba: My daughter's hamster is in a shoebox in my bag, I know how that sounds, it's the one thing she asked me to save
RD_ALifeLine_7d634da81f9280d5: Dogs are good, they hear them before you do, mine growls low when one's coming, and he ain't been wrong yet
RD_ALifeLine_1244dd9054811904: Saw a pack running loose on the road to Irvington, somebody's pets a week ago, now they're something else
RD_ALifeLine_670aeb91145d8c8c: Pets? I'll set my dog on you if you take one more step, how's that for pets
RD_ALifeLine_145e0776090b9179: Pulled a German shepherd out of a house fire on Main, she follows me everywhere now, won't let me out of her sight
RD_ALifeLine_126f85e343a32d18: Farm I worked had forty head of dairy cows, nobody's milked 'em in days, you can hear 'em bawling a mile off

RD_ALifeLine_4b49ab3810a84c75: We had a dozen calls about loose dogs the first night, animal control was the first office we lost
RD_ALifeLine_7f58002b3c65f2a4: There's a cat living in our supply tent, Sergeant says he hates it, he saves it the tuna out of his rations
RD_ALifeLine_26a9154254063965: Dogs mean people nearby, or people that used to be, either way it's worth knowing

RD_ALifeLine_583b10bc4feee01a: Any animal comes through that wire gets shot, don't bring me your dog

RD_ALifeLine_08e628c721eff1c5: I miss having a dog, I'd feel better with one around, though I know that wouldn't solve everything
RD_ALifeLine_3c12c113706f3c5c: Somebody's pointer sits at the church door every morning, waiting on his man

RD_ALifeLine_106d6fc644f17984: We've had more calls about loose dogs than about people, chew on that a while

RD_ALifeLine_1b53743765ffbd9b: There was a dog at the checkpoint, Sergeant said don't feed him, everybody fed him
RD_ALifeLine_7deb09393482e300: A dog gets you killed or keeps you alive, depends whether you can shut it up
RD_ALifeLine_11b1c8ed7438c9b2: Had a blue heeler rode in the saddlebag with his head out, best passenger I ever had
RD_ALifeLine_5ecef37c25d3ce2f: Dogs trade good now, folks'll give up food for something that barks at night
RD_ALifeLine_09c8990c2c830766: I had one, I'm not going to talk about the dog, ask me something else...
RD_ALifeLine_23d46e24469a5509: The kids keep asking about the cat... I keep saying she's at the neighbor's
RD_ALifeLine_3535760556071056: Dogs bark, barking tells me where a house is, so I got no problem with dogs
RD_ALifeLine_04ecc49c0744ff21: Pets? We eat anything that moves, {g:pal|lady}
RD_ALifeLine_59a46c8a1f35eebe: Keep any dog you've got leashed and quiet, {sir}, barking brings them, and then I have to deal with it
RD_ALifeLine_1dae6b162193b104: Saw a fella trade his dog for a box of shells yesterday, that's the market now, {g:pal|lady}
RD_ALifeLine_6d5bcbc0061b1e2d: The president? last I heard he was safe, in a bunker, or on a plane, or in some office with a flag behind him
RD_ALifeLine_46bf981f2e55b626: I don't know if he's alive, I don't know if anyone is, I keep waiting for the address
RD_ALifeLine_72909f2d32415863: He's supposed to say something, a president always says something, why hasn't he
RD_ALifeLine_55d107f23156af21: My mother voted for him, she's going to be furious, if she's alive
RD_ALifeLine_059fe85356e804d1: They'd tell us if he were dead, wouldn't they? they'd have to
RD_ALifeLine_1e81e7572db952ab: Nobody's seen him in weeks, and I don't blame him, I wouldn't show my face either
RD_ALifeLine_2efd42a756d3d47f: The president or anyone else, the office doesn't matter, the man doesn't matter, not now
RD_ALifeLine_364080e6297bb59b: The president can't fix this, nobody can, he'll be the last to say it
RD_ALifeLine_090e302b71817372: Rumor is he's in a bunker in West Virginia, with the cabinet, and a stack of fresh cigars
