RD_ALifeLine_66710fa0594dee22: Commander in chief is somewhere far away, giving orders that never get here
RD_ALifeLine_29187a0f0e668fdc: The president? Probably hiding in a bunker with a good cigar and a bad conscience
RD_ALifeLine_287920465638b86a: I didn't vote for him, I didn't vote for anyone, and look how it turned out
RD_ALifeLine_4961595046080583: He's got a whole army to hide behind, that makes him smarter than most
RD_ALifeLine_1718f0d8189f4505: Last I heard he was on TV saying stay calm, then the TV went blank, you can guess the rest
RD_ALifeLine_764787b30f1bd2c9: Don't ask me about presidents, I only follow one rule, mine!
RD_ALifeLine_537e7e6c0e05856e: I hope he's alive, honestly, someone has to be in charge somewhere
RD_ALifeLine_6261a0225af629d8: The president? He don't know we exist
RD_ALifeLine_5e96eb74357d8a23: President ain't never done nothing for my block, why would he start now
RD_ALifeLine_2810f57a649795db: I saw him on TV playing a saxophone, and now we're getting eaten, you tell me what that means
RD_ALifeLine_7d3bdec3659c3b5b: Last I saw he was in a suit saying everything's under control, funny
RD_ALifeLine_789ef2140b14e652: I hope someone's in charge somewhere, I really do
RD_ALifeLine_585f60d660e241a7: The president, huh? I voted for the other guy, makes no difference now
RD_ALifeLine_1504915821427711: President's gone silent, that tells me all I need to know
RD_ALifeLine_48e2fdf513037031: He'd be the first to run if he could
RD_ALifeLine_4c2d409357fe85d9: Don't mention that name around me
RD_ALifeLine_64fdde334d606c6c: The president has bigger problems than ours, I imagine
RD_ALifeLine_1e549e6c26897d88: The government has a continuity plan, and it does not include Kentucky
RD_ALifeLine_5a25fd9b08dc8aba: I'd pay good money to know where he is right now
RD_ALifeLine_7dc711c04774cdd3: I hope he and his family are safe, the country needs someone at the helm
RD_ALifeLine_7465150b5d4b1549: President? Couldn't pick him out of a lineup
RD_ALifeLine_1a35d945721bb294: Probably got a nice bunker, nice food, nice bed
RD_ALifeLine_433d857401aa5dc4: Why are you asking me about politics?!
RD_ALifeLine_6926e1277cb0159d: I wonder if he's thinking of us, doubt it
RD_ALifeLine_520dde7a3d37ae18: The president's busy, and so are we
RD_ALifeLine_292480cd0d54e682: Probably as lost as the rest of us
RD_ALifeLine_2a14f13070f70d05: He's a long way from Knox County, and good for him
RD_ALifeLine_1b333b060e06f54a: If he's alive, I hope he's doing something

RD_ALifeLine_310b79ff455ef6b3: The president is alive, as far as we know
RD_ALifeLine_56f54c7c6a105ac2: We heard a message on the radio that the president would address the nation, then nothing
RD_ALifeLine_0bef491568124605: Wherever he is, I hope he's got a plan
RD_ALifeLine_5a295e875bec93c8: That's not your concern, and it isn't mine either
RD_ALifeLine_12e0dcaa0e7a4d92: I have faith in the chain of command, even now
RD_ALifeLine_0eff9d482029c4de: I've sent him two letters about the county's situation, he hasn't replied
RD_ALifeLine_4559d2dd792fd22a: The president is the commander in chief, that is all I can say
RD_ALifeLine_6123af3127cfd5d8: Orders come from the top, that's all I know
RD_ALifeLine_2c8ffe4b15dea28c: I hope he's working on a solution, honestly

RD_ALifeLine_50c6a5eb7061e525: Open means open, every survivor and every faction on this band hears us, Raiders, soldiers, kids with a handset, all of them
RD_ALifeLine_4eceace35509349f: How many are with you?, Seats are tight, let me say the offer first and then we talk numbers
RD_ALifeLine_0e7e5df7584572a4: Easy, easy.. this is Captain Ruiz, my operator plays it by the book, We lost track of one survivor out there, I need a name, I need to know it's you
RD_ALifeLine_1b7f31c845b8576e: Authentication code is Kestrel Nine, That is all you get on an open channel
RD_ALifeLine_4390d3aa4fae23d4: That's ENOUGH, This is Captain Ruiz, I'm the one who has to log this, Last chance to take it back
RD_ALifeLine_4a636aeb56248ddd: Ruiz here, I'll give it to you straight
RD_ALifeLine_709ca0557780c932: Our long range sets are dead, this is the only band that still carries, I don't like it either, trust me
RD_ALifeLine_70a4c71a53af2680: Bring what you can carry and nothing that slows you, Weapons stay on you, eat and sleep before the day
RD_ALifeLine_688e40d654caf64b: You get thirty minutes, no more, After that the bird lifts and we try again in three days, if there's fuel
RD_ALifeLine_5b8be1e44e46ad2d: How many are with you?, Seats are tight, I can't promise more than one extra
RD_ALifeLine_5a2b065132ebc95e: Because when the comms go, the line closes with 'em, I'm not supposed to tell you that
RD_ALifeLine_1ef26d8f7f0f0d9c: I'll ask once more.. you sure?, A seat with your name on it, roof of the Oris Tower, 14:00, 3 days
RD_ALifeLine_3eb4f1dd05049aac: A bed, food, a doctor and a wall that holds, A safe zone behind the quarantine line, nobody asks about your past
RD_ALifeLine_54b7c0a660780127: A place to hide and a clean slate, I leave your file where it is
RD_ALifeLine_2ea6595317bfba99: Knox is lost outside the cordon, we hold what we hold, The quarantine line doesn't move for anyone, not you, not me
RD_ALifeLine_6941223e7ca498ea: Captain Ruiz, third relief, I lost my unit in the first month, I'm what's left of the people you wanted to hear from
RD_ALifeLine_7b5f83950e95d444: No.. expect company on the way up, that's why I said careful, Whoever lives in that tower wasn't invited to our party
RD_ALifeLine_79ee97a91af31a64: A trap needs bait, You are one hungry survivor, we would not burn a helicopter on that
RD_ALifeLine_7df46e4841f64427: Because you're still alive, after all this time, We need people who know how to stay that way
RD_ALifeLine_33dd691821161e31: Because people follow you, we want that on our side of the line
RD_ALifeLine_7a6693d31141f1a6: Extraction window is closed, nobody on the roof
RD_ALifeLine_0d9aa426143da8e5: No contact on the roof, window closed
RD_ALifeLine_1ab69ee6589c65a6: Comms are going dark, this is the last call from the US military on this band today
RD_ALifeLine_20d957d829b971c9: This is the US military again
RD_ALifeLine_49785dfb7ed44211: This is the United States military
RD_ALifeLine_50eb396d174c8f58: Copy that, we hear you survivor
RD_ALifeLine_12ae541921e09f9f: Take your time, we wait 20 more minutes
RD_ALifeLine_066d32e03cd65fe1: Yeah, we all keep that list, just don't read it out loud
RD_ALifeLine_203dda70366c45d6: Liar or saint, either way you're still breathing
RD_ALifeLine_0fbb63f653dac270: Trust is a bullet with your name on it, you learned that cheap
RD_ALifeLine_40b148e61dc42b68: Long enough to learn what it costs, welcome to the club
RD_ALifeLine_62f1ea3079c37386: Fair, silence is an answer too
RD_ALifeLine_19dd510362f2204c: Quiet was the first thing they took, keep the memory
RD_ALifeLine_319ff8086c9810e7: They got the easy part, you carry them now
RD_ALifeLine_7c56be391052f12d: Cold, I like it, cold keeps you alive
RD_ALifeLine_728d7d3c273982ca: Ha, aim low, I respect it
RD_ALifeLine_4070b3fc0577f10d: Good answer, worst part is I almost believe you
RD_ALifeLine_7e8b9f137308de1f: Smart, nobody knows till they're on the ground
RD_ALifeLine_3d5034fb26bfc0a8: I would if they could answer
RD_ALifeLine_0c9baf4a24d4287d: Honest, at least you're not selling me anything
RD_ALifeLine_29cf86b03650e89d: What's going on around the city right now?
RD_ALifeLine_022f90cc359c705c: Infected humans, don't get bitten, you'll turn into one of them, there is no law anymore, hit them in the head, those are not humans but monsters, they eat people, they can be killed
RD_ALifeLine_1f0e1d47131a09f6: By the way have you seen any houses nearby with survivors?
RD_ALifeLine_1d61da39040f50c6: Yeah I did, there's some people around
RD_ALifeLine_41fcba0e67f8a5d7: I heard something, not sure where exactly
RD_ALifeLine_78adf0267896d272: You shouldn't play hero with all this going on
RD_ALifeLine_42f3a8ec2eb53b7b: Shit, they might be all dead at this point, this thing.. I heard it spreads in the air? Which means that we are either infected or- we are special!
RD_ALifeLine_45087ddc02bdea80: Good. Humans will be resources if this is a real apocalypse
RD_ALifeLine_3489039565230b91: Not all heroes wear capes, fuck it, we ball
RD_ALifeLine_2330b9826ee85384: But shit, ain't no happy endings in Knox County. Remember that alright?
RD_ALifeLine_5c3ce7cc5035a830: *Smiles* I'm glad I met you, but I have to go now. In a world full of monsters, we do not differ
RD_ALifeLine_201b75e453a7a7dd: Officer, am I in trouble or something?
RD_ALifeLine_3f3548cd1d83ec03: Depends. You got ID on you?
RD_ALifeLine_13dd04de27a6bc59: Depends who's asking. Got some ID?
RD_ALifeLine_3612843964812eed: Lost my wallet running from those things
RD_ALifeLine_73cb1cb1612a095c: Go ask the dead guys for ID
RD_ALifeLine_19ced43c4f88f3ac: Dead serious. Procedure's the only thing keeping my hands from shaking
RD_ALifeLine_74ff1eeb3ee4f89b: Course you did. Everybody did. Fine, go on, keep your hands out of your pockets
RD_ALifeLine_7c7e6afd15c86e37: Hilarious. Keep moving before I find a reason to care
RD_ALifeLine_59e3724b461c8e10: No. But I'm still in uniform and the uniform says I check IDs, so
RD_ALifeLine_3f58951740dc5cf0: Is there still any law out here?
RD_ALifeLine_6fe76a136652064c: I.. honestly don't know. Dispatch went quiet this morning and nobody's picked up since
RD_ALifeLine_4c0bba022596e563: Why are you still wearing the uniform?
RD_ALifeLine_528dd1ac04a91d28: Me? I can't even keep my own street. But yeah. Somebody's got to pretend
RD_ALifeLine_49b9ff97532f8280: Because if I take it off I'm just a scared guy with a gun. People trust the shirt
RD_ALifeLine_1ae22ba946a36999: I tried. Phone just rings. I'm scared of what I'll find, okay?
RD_ALifeLine_461aecc55fe4dd19: Better to know than to wonder
RD_ALifeLine_252da8b20945f17a: Stay off the main roads, lock everything, don't open for anyone who won't talk. That's all I got
RD_ALifeLine_6b9715ec16865843: Yeah. Yeah, you're right. Tomorrow. I'll go tomorrow
RD_ALifeLine_73165a1048e423d5: Don't be. Just.. stay alive, alright?
RD_ALifeLine_4c3386130542597d: Is there an evacuation going on?
RD_ALifeLine_32538e4b4e323f23: That's what they told us. Buses, a staging area, the whole speech. Then nothing
RD_ALifeLine_5a031aba39c658d6: Maybe the army's got it handled
RD_ALifeLine_7b06150819625da3: Thanks for being straight with me
RD_ALifeLine_6331c45a485091a2: Nobody ever told us. The order to set it up never came, I'm not gonna make one up for you
RD_ALifeLine_4b14b8085e0a99fe: Not today. Maybe not this week. Plan like nobody's coming and you won't get your heart broken
RD_ALifeLine_0c534244108439bb: The army closed the roads. Out, not in. That should tell you how handled it is
RD_ALifeLine_39e29c976923fbd1: Straight's all I've got left to give. Go on, get indoors
RD_ALifeLine_3ec982f2445e6bd6: Why are you writing names down?
RD_ALifeLine_7258981128b63e37: Census. Who's alive, where they're holed up. Somebody's got to keep count
RD_ALifeLine_1d45202c3a2ccf90: Put me down as dead, nobody's looking for me
RD_ALifeLine_58849c824ef1560e: None of your business where I sleep
RD_ALifeLine_026bba773e1e35a1: How many names you got so far?
RD_ALifeLine_31c8e36f713832cd: That's dark, friend. I'll put a question mark
RD_ALifeLine_08a0cc18691b7d2e: Fair. I didn't ask where, just who. Suit yourself
RD_ALifeLine_5f31d34207fd5547: Too few. And I've been crossing more out than I've been adding
RD_ALifeLine_046bafb43f3f8796: Because one day someone's gonna ask what happened to their mother, and I want an answer
RD_ALifeLine_6179947b5f09faac: What should I be doing right now?
RD_ALifeLine_5fe3b6b0119a86b0: Stay inside. Lock the doors, cover the windows, fill every bathtub and pot with water while it still runs
RD_ALifeLine_79c21cdc3f4156ca: What about the noise, should I fight them?
RD_ALifeLine_573cb113205a1166: I can't just sit and wait
RD_ALifeLine_68af8a59549b0339: Because when the taps go dry, and they will, you've got days not weeks
RD_ALifeLine_3adc89e407b285e2: Quiet beats brave. Sound brings them. One shot and you've got the whole block on your porch
RD_ALifeLine_33bf4c5a5888c7ce: Then move by day, alone or in twos, and never into a building you haven't watched first
RD_ALifeLine_2d30647225e62d67: I need to get through the roadblock
RD_ALifeLine_2f638c4141d3fcea: Whose orders? Nobody's answering the radio
RD_ALifeLine_76ead2ad2542f397: I'm on the job too, come on, let me by
RD_ALifeLine_685336cc2d77241e: My family's on the other side, please
RD_ALifeLine_0c7c99014cfe4109: Last orders I got. Until I get new ones, those are the orders
RD_ALifeLine_78700d36749decab: Badge? .. Ah hell. Go. And you didn't see me let you
RD_ALifeLine_3e351ebf476892da: I'm sorry. I really am. Not through here
RD_ALifeLine_1f24b4566fb1bdea: Shit. Okay. Go, quick, before my partner turns around
RD_ALifeLine_09adc3e41d704afe: Don't. The cordon past the trees shoots at anything that moves
RD_ALifeLine_7eb720707f2d124d: Can I come a bit closer?
RD_ALifeLine_4cb61eb80ca7170c: Not yet. Roll up your sleeves, both arms, and turn around slow
RD_ALifeLine_1855411f73eeba20: I got scratched, it's nothing, really
RD_ALifeLine_1993753b1f60cb23: Okay. Okay good. Sorry, I had to. Last guy who said he was fine wasn't
RD_ALifeLine_3f2fbadd60931f72: Then stay where you are. I'm not having that conversation with a bullet
RD_ALifeLine_6ba252e568443dff: Scratched? Back up. Back UP. I'm sorry, I can't, I just can't
RD_ALifeLine_4bc7d5d22f17698b: Nah, I'm good where I am
RD_ALifeLine_7108747c7013751a: Partner's checking the houses up the road. Why, you offering?
RD_ALifeLine_2d1ae3c23b7988b0: I'm on the job too. Was off duty when it hit
RD_ALifeLine_7e20c4a82e9e8a11: Did a tour overseas, I know how to watch a road
RD_ALifeLine_600075e77c71d0e9: Just asking. Feels safer near a uniform
RD_ALifeLine_4fcb1a3b436c67cc: Your partner's been gone a while, huh
RD_ALifeLine_5c6153b206afc840: No shit? Then you know. Nothing in the manual for this, nothing
RD_ALifeLine_4dcf1ad475469abc: Good. Then you know not to bunch up. Thank you for your service and all that, I mean it
RD_ALifeLine_2c66c46f7937b885: Don't count on it. Uniform draws more attention than it stops
RD_ALifeLine_2217160217285e4b: Yeah.. yeah he has. He'll be back. He'll be back
RD_ALifeLine_0f379d6a265cb7b2: Keep your badge. Some folks still listen to it. For now
RD_ALifeLine_7063577e661098ef: Maybe we should. Come find me if things go sideways
RD_ALifeLine_1dc23aa679fef039: What's with the guys in orange helping you?
RD_ALifeLine_73b981a934d90171: Trusties. Low level, short sentences. They're carrying sandbags instead of running. Mostly
RD_ALifeLine_79665e5609284bff: What happens to the rest of the cells?
RD_ALifeLine_66635d6b7b669fe6: I trust that they're scared too. That's close enough today
RD_ALifeLine_7aed9f3a04e4c84c: Locked. Fed when we can. Don't ask me about tomorrow, I don't have a tomorrow plan
RD_ALifeLine_2a7a4021615eac35: That's what I keep telling the sergeant. He keeps saying lawsuit. Lawsuit! From who?
RD_ALifeLine_46fb97186cfc46f8: The walls hold. The people inside them, that's another story
RD_ALifeLine_65820d054efe6e3b: Are the inmates getting sick too?
RD_ALifeLine_05f9f0be717f1833: Why don't you just open the gates?
RD_ALifeLine_46aa2b590cd1d040: One bites another, lights out, and by morning a whole tier's banging on the bars. Yeah
RD_ALifeLine_6fdb46e343df038b: Not unless you've got keys to a bigger prison. Just stay clear of the walls
RD_ALifeLine_7132102a29cc214c: *Sighs* I know. I know. I'm thinking about it every hour
RD_ALifeLine_4a58589f21ec244b: Thanks. Don't come near the gate, they'll shoot first and ID never
RD_ALifeLine_1928fd7016a18abe: State. In and out in a day, secure an asset, wait for pickup
RD_ALifeLine_38ecb23e6bd2006f: Sounds like they lied to you
RD_ALifeLine_721c3f2d17cc2f76: Can't say. Doesn't matter now. Nobody's asking for it back
RD_ALifeLine_7f98879a161dfa56: Six hours late. Twelve. Whatever. We hold the perimeter until somebody says otherwise
RD_ALifeLine_6d8e3ae64c2f0224: *Clenches jaw* Maybe. Doesn't change the job. Move along, civilian
RD_ALifeLine_2134e8b840ebf148: Some. Post answers maybe one call in five. The other four are people screaming
RD_ALifeLine_49d273d55515a6a8: Can you call for help for me?
RD_ALifeLine_079d10410bc4e358: Turn it off, that'd drive me crazy
RD_ALifeLine_327fc7450e682360: Hold your roadblock, report numbers, don't engage crowds. Same three lines since yesterday
RD_ALifeLine_5cccdc994070041f: I can call. I can't promise anyone picks up, and I can't promise who comes if they do
RD_ALifeLine_14ae19ea2ef833f0: If I turn it off I'm alone out here. Rather hear the screaming
RD_ALifeLine_402b8f5305be439a: You're not county. Who are you with?
RD_ALifeLine_24e008ed0a280473: Federal. Mint police. And that's about all you get
RD_ALifeLine_26e345a31d7a7381: Federal? So the government's still around?
RD_ALifeLine_61593b997981b4ed: Something nobody needs right now. Ironic, isn't it
RD_ALifeLine_7231f40164197d2a: We got a phone call three days ago. Hold the vault. That's the government I know of
RD_ALifeLine_53d3aad11bcc1ee3: Is it safer out in the woods?
RD_ALifeLine_1296718740ea44fe: Fewer people means fewer of them. But the woods don't forgive you for being stupid
RD_ALifeLine_4a527cfd1cd326c8: What do I need out there?
RD_ALifeLine_0d2d85d12e3ae52c: Do they follow you into the trees?
RD_ALifeLine_617189aa1776e50e: You know the woods well, huh
RD_ALifeLine_60cd6df906f410c5: Water you can boil, a fire you can hide, and a way to see who's coming before they see you
RD_ALifeLine_04658d3d668c47c7: They follow noise. A twig, a cough, a gunshot. In the woods everything echoes
RD_ALifeLine_63c31f240705bc5d: Twenty years writing fishing tickets. Never thought it'd be a survival course
RD_ALifeLine_581acc786084c74f: Can't the city and county guys work together on this?
RD_ALifeLine_5bbd9a3a157de7e4: *Snorts* You'd think. Turns out the end of the world doesn't cancel a twenty year grudge
RD_ALifeLine_1445e31d5e1d607f: Maybe it's time to talk to them
RD_ALifeLine_6b698d3345c104ca: Yep. People die on the line between us because nobody wants to cross it first
RD_ALifeLine_798d325a7ef3909e: Them. Obviously. Ask them and they'll say us. That's the problem
RD_ALifeLine_58c0a66705cef89f: You go talk to them then. Tell them we've got shells and they've got fuel
RD_ALifeLine_4c92164e6d91f123: The sheriff, last I checked. Then his chief deputy. Then me, God help us
RD_ALifeLine_7a71b6e7201e8f01: What do you need from people like me?
RD_ALifeLine_7870f33324aa8ac0: Holding the courthouse road with whoever stayed. Don't go there unannounced
RD_ALifeLine_7745f0751d35a714: Stay put, stay quiet, tell us if you see a house with live people in it. That's all
RD_ALifeLine_2c7f89295df80f2b: Maybe. But while I'm wearing this, I'm going to act like somebody is
RD_ALifeLine_2ff959d04f6bde40: Maybe. Got a call before the lines died. Old woman, alone, nobody ever went
RD_ALifeLine_39a42aef5bf7401e: I found her place. Here's what was left
RD_ALifeLine_42c475a714f11c0b: Thank you. I marked it. If she's.. if she's not okay, bring me something of hers. Anything
RD_ALifeLine_2a349b3761094986: Take your time. Just, you know, not too much time
RD_ALifeLine_5993e632664a9a16: *Takes it slowly* Okay. Okay, at least someone went. That counts for something
RD_ALifeLine_6b9413ad4809ac9c: That wasn't easy. I think it's worth more
RD_ALifeLine_14fdfc1868ff02b0: Keep it. Didn't do it for pay
RD_ALifeLine_4a5714e241d78639: Here. Food. It's what I've got
RD_ALifeLine_4b57b2c26a2bdd11: Yeah. You're right. Take the box, I'll find more
RD_ALifeLine_15143b0a2f64b5e8: Don't push it. Food's all I can do and it's more than most would
RD_ALifeLine_2dab9f9c3ef12a1c: *Smiles* There's still a few of you left. Take this anyway, I insist
RD_ALifeLine_6df8efbf4a3ccdd4: You look like you've got a problem
RD_ALifeLine_70742d7806435a1a: My partner took a bad fall going through a window. Not a bite, swear to god. I need bandages
RD_ALifeLine_7c4b3a1745201616: Three should do. Hurry, he's pale
RD_ALifeLine_7411aa4d2560fa8e: Oh thank god. You might've just saved him
RD_ALifeLine_6510a8107e1f3c25: What can you give me for it?
RD_ALifeLine_6a4344412b3d78f2: A life's worth more than a box of shells, right?
RD_ALifeLine_46ce0a7e35f306bf: I watched it happen. Glass, not teeth. Please
RD_ALifeLine_589d55866183dfe7: Okay. Three bandages, I'm on it
RD_ALifeLine_2323d34c19799ca2: You're right. Take his sidearm, he can't hold it anyway. Bring it back if he lives, ha
RD_ALifeLine_6e7bcbaa0faa79e1: It is. But a box is what I can give. Sorry
RD_ALifeLine_78fa3eae27c15a8e: Yeah. Yeah, I'd say the same
RD_ALifeLine_12c07861318d362c: Is there anything I can do to help?
RD_ALifeLine_799037c41ee53a8a: There's a house up the block. Family I knew. They didn't come out and now something's banging in there
RD_ALifeLine_620c40772ed417e5: Thank you. Be quick and be quiet. Marked it for you
RD_ALifeLine_4e9707dd588934d7: *Nods slowly* Thank you. I'll bury them tomorrow
RD_ALifeLine_0545a7d659dfc698: Rough job. You got anything better?
RD_ALifeLine_680dc5cf6aa9c708: Because I coached their kid's ball team. I can't. I just can't
RD_ALifeLine_6b80c800726c7666: Shells. Use them on anything that comes for you
RD_ALifeLine_2ce968dd179824c5: Take my backup piece. I won't need two. Don't make me regret it
RD_ALifeLine_4b7815d059859117: Better? Pal, I just asked you to kill my neighbours. Take the box
RD_ALifeLine_442dbc52458f9ae3: Right. Nobody's mess. That's how it all fell apart
RD_ALifeLine_041816e4451276f2: You got any ammo to trade?
RD_ALifeLine_2203e7c867e38501: Nine mil, maybe a box. What've you got?
RD_ALifeLine_7e93f38f20d2e6a4: Two cans of beans for a box
RD_ALifeLine_389177482164cda0: Deal. Haven't eaten since yesterday, don't tell anyone
RD_ALifeLine_205021ed30c1f017: Done. Bandages go faster than bullets lately
RD_ALifeLine_4b0ab92a6299f83d: Oh you beautiful bastard. Deal, deal
RD_ALifeLine_239e2d1f7ba6358a: Then don't waste my time asking about guns, it makes people nervous
RD_ALifeLine_420a5d651b8a1925: What would you want for some information?
RD_ALifeLine_79291ba966e46e91: Depends what you want to know. And coffee. I'd sell my mother for real coffee
RD_ALifeLine_697a4daa0998fc8d: Here's some coffee. Where's safe to scavenge?
RD_ALifeLine_11e878ae2312ebf2: What if I just ask nicely?
RD_ALifeLine_44e63c3a6f35c84d: Oh god, it smells like a Monday. Okay, here's what I know
RD_ALifeLine_41d0d3170f67f652: Nice doesn't fill a cup. Come back with something
RD_ALifeLine_3a7cd21129941904: Ha. Fine, you got an honest face. Here
RD_ALifeLine_4b6c88450d108b77: We're not a soup kitchen.. what do you need
RD_ALifeLine_49bfbf4b26868cb3: I'll pay you back, I promise
RD_ALifeLine_3b21708b4d4f57c7: Here. One can. Eat it slow, don't puke it up
RD_ALifeLine_668e88a12b4d4f39: Ask me about the houses up the road. There's always a job
RD_ALifeLine_55b5c994120b3b12: Pride's a luxury, friend. Remember that
RD_ALifeLine_34289a5b78d05aaa: You look like you need something
RD_ALifeLine_6195d2df7d10ad8c: Batteries. This radio's the only line I've got to anybody and it's dying
RD_ALifeLine_052eb0e06e8ef0f9: You have no idea. Here, take this, fair's fair
RD_ALifeLine_30d26e8922ab29de: A box of shells. More if you're good at haggling
RD_ALifeLine_0683d698532b3921: A radio's worth more than a box, come on
RD_ALifeLine_4321b77f40114036: If you find some, you know where I am
RD_ALifeLine_5bd7b16940697042: Ugh. Fine. Box and some bandages. Don't tell my sergeant I got hustled
RD_ALifeLine_1369112b00b06892: Easy, I'm not looking for trouble
RD_ALifeLine_580fd4637e245fc5: Thank you. Hands where I can see them and we're good. See? Easy
RD_ALifeLine_0781988630bde3fc: Oh. Okay, sorry. Jumpy. Everybody's jumpy
RD_ALifeLine_27771a616643b75b: Then back away. Slowly. Don't make me do this
RD_ALifeLine_0271413a2f8dac5e: *Exhales* Okay. One.. two.. three. There. Was that so hard?
RD_ALifeLine_456b9bfc6e0d149a: Whoa whoa, you really want to do this?
RD_ALifeLine_3b7ab1c844cc2ce6: I don't wanna hurt you, I just need your ammo
RD_ALifeLine_638e837513004f40: Okay! Okay. They're up. Take what you want and go
RD_ALifeLine_7fe8f4a31ba80985: Just stay put till I'm gone
RD_ALifeLine_26078ffb1bd96754: Then you ask, you idiot. You don't point
RD_ALifeLine_316b53ad72030a9c: Kidding. Real funny. Real fucking funny. Get out of here
RD_ALifeLine_4f681437628a8b15: There. You'll remember my face. I'll remember yours
RD_ALifeLine_134a1288205cab6a: No. But I'd have thought about it if you didn't start like that
RD_ALifeLine_7eb24282350b6611: Hands on your head! On your knees! Do it!
RD_ALifeLine_22a9eaec66bb4aef: Good. Stay there. ..Alright, get up. You're not under arrest, there's no jail to put you in
RD_ALifeLine_1748baa624b5b3f9: Then you've got nothing to worry about. Knees!
RD_ALifeLine_16db3a574e1a32c3: And put you where? Just stay down a second while I think
RD_ALifeLine_7b3609700a59fc7c: Just don't give me a reason next time, understand?
RD_ALifeLine_2954b7215c7c3a96: You scared the shit out of me
RD_ALifeLine_12d83c585f48d6ba: Join the club. Everybody's scared, I'm just the one with a gun
RD_ALifeLine_6eaad32208b1cabd: How do I find you again?
RD_ALifeLine_1a543b096003b2a2: In case I see something you should know
RD_ALifeLine_40d54ac802873350: Feels good knowing a cop's nearby
RD_ALifeLine_3fd3ffdd37828e88: Fair. I run this stretch mornings. If I'm not here, I'm dead or I'm back at the station
RD_ALifeLine_12bf8bec014e7539: *Smiles* Don't get used to it. But okay, here's where I'll be
RD_ALifeLine_619d615e04c003e9: So I know where to run if it gets bad
RD_ALifeLine_713e982b25db3e4a: You've been decent to me. Here. Don't bring trouble to the door
RD_ALifeLine_20fb6a18681ad16b: Then find somewhere with a lock and two exits. I can't take strays, I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_5320278444d0ec82: Make conversation about the weather then
RD_ALifeLine_4fafd7d914d7f4a2: Yeah. Didn't land. Never lands. Just circles and leaves
RD_ALifeLine_5b012fd24110da2e: It's pulling them in, isn't it
RD_ALifeLine_2b0bb33018ab13b2: Then it's looking real hard and finding nothing. Same as me
RD_ALifeLine_6e6fa74f5b3aed18: Every pass. Half the street follows it like a parade. Stay inside when it's up
RD_ALifeLine_750b913952121dc3: Tried. Flare, waving, screaming. It didn't even slow down
RD_ALifeLine_39b851ae6b55b4b1: Two kids. They're with their mom. I hope
RD_ALifeLine_016c6c4d6afbacdd: Because I swore an oath and right now that's the only thing I'm sure about. And it's killing me
RD_ALifeLine_5237b82271f486c1: You can't be sure. But thanks for saying it
RD_ALifeLine_0b3a7a6d46ebf9e8: Shit. I'm sorry. I'm really sorry
RD_ALifeLine_3266385c12ae3e86: Stay indoors, avoid contact with the sick, wait for instructions. They've been waiting a while
RD_ALifeLine_74322fcb032702f2: I believe the guy reading it is scared shitless. Hear his voice crack at the end? Every time
RD_ALifeLine_7544b9be735d179e: Same as you. Except mine come with a gun and a quota of people I'm supposed to save
RD_ALifeLine_5db4780c7a2b2c4c: What are you doing about the looters?
RD_ALifeLine_24c569a006e648b1: Nothing. Taking food isn't looting anymore. Taking TVs, that's just stupid
RD_ALifeLine_07280a8c17fdc9d5: I took some stuff from a store
RD_ALifeLine_045b100d7aac02a2: No. Hurt somebody for it and you'll find out I still care about that
RD_ALifeLine_0884d1c526b9b59d: *Laughs* Did you pay? No? Good. Dead people don't need beans
RD_ALifeLine_1d250c287d348105: With what jail? Look around you
RD_ALifeLine_02f3a4f20131c209: I shot a man today. A neighbour. He was already.. one of them. I knew his kids
RD_ALifeLine_6ff482305c129d1e: I know. I know that. My hands don't
RD_ALifeLine_0d4443c844c8b65a: He was wearing his church shirt. That's what I keep seeing. The shirt
RD_ALifeLine_144b16b837d04d08: Where can I find guns around here?
RD_ALifeLine_61a2d9c017c0a061: I'm not telling a stranger that
RD_ALifeLine_319c5511557e84f6: You're asking a cop where the guns are. Bold
RD_ALifeLine_3e9ad83e200bdbb3: I need to protect my family
RD_ALifeLine_76fbe0753eb8ed44: No, you're not. Alright. Here's what I know, don't make me regret it
RD_ALifeLine_19893fa5373d9649: Everybody's got a family. Not everybody tells the truth about them
RD_ALifeLine_553e5b584cc6e176: Am I allowed to be out here?
RD_ALifeLine_0a79082d198bf34d: Curfew's at dusk. I can't enforce it but I'm asking. Nicely, for now
RD_ALifeLine_297d41d756808d98: You can't tell me where to go
RD_ALifeLine_462e2b2677794130: Appreciate it. Makes my night simpler
RD_ALifeLine_2caa91602ec9f034: Nope. But I can tell you what I find out here after dark, and you won't sleep
RD_ALifeLine_12aa6af56a8dadf8: Because anything moving after dark is either one of them or someone up to no good. I can't tell which
RD_ALifeLine_5fff8a73756b9b64: What was the last call you got?
RD_ALifeLine_05bc761904ee7905: Domestic disturbance. Guy biting his wife. We thought it was a domestic, can you believe it
RD_ALifeLine_7f93e6721c75b556: My partner pulled him off her. Got bit for it. The rest you can guess
RD_ALifeLine_595553ee3996c2a2: Yeah. Thousands of calls just like it. We were so damn slow
RD_ALifeLine_236df9e20e817c5d: Are you letting the prisoners out?
RD_ALifeLine_2f69ca7413465e67: That's the question, isn't it. Leave them and they starve. Open up and some of them hunt
RD_ALifeLine_6844562d5406f2d8: That's what I'm leaning. Sort by sentence, open by row. Like it's a fucking DMV
RD_ALifeLine_3c8caee201c4ad09: And who brings them water when I'm gone? You?
RD_ALifeLine_120b871419b0c63b: It's exactly my call. That's what's keeping me up
RD_ALifeLine_12a28ef91cae2f44: Is it safe to drive anywhere?
RD_ALifeLine_399a708e3eca7a43: Main roads are jammed with wrecks and the noise of an engine pulls them in from blocks away
RD_ALifeLine_7b02eca35d3c16fc: Walk short, drive long. And never park where you can't pull straight out
RD_ALifeLine_56c864a77d87bbf7: Better. Until you hit a roadblock nobody's manning anymore, and then you're stuck in the open
RD_ALifeLine_0e5ae8e02a11e79b: You sound like you've seen it up close
RD_ALifeLine_67709b104546a35f: Where's the rest of your department?
RD_ALifeLine_0b0e17914ceffb1f: I walked my old beat yesterday. Mrs Carver was still at her bus stop. Still waiting. Still hungry
RD_ALifeLine_784027dc75e55295: Some. Upstairs, behind boards. They don't answer the door anymore, not even for a badge
RD_ALifeLine_1100d04c6159dfac: Home, dead, or out there wearing the uniform and moaning. Take your pick
RD_ALifeLine_2c47112005d6a93f: Me? I'm the idiot who's still out here asking questions. Like you
RD_ALifeLine_341d69265246cddc: Shouldn't you be at your post?
RD_ALifeLine_05f38b4d00169832: Post's gone. I left. Took the cruiser and drove till the tank ran dry
RD_ALifeLine_0e211e484b072bbf: There's no post. There's a car with the doors open and blood on the seat
RD_ALifeLine_30815d7859d15a3b: You ran out on people who needed you
RD_ALifeLine_461a6c162315314b: Tell that to the guy I left at the barricade. He was screaming for me to wait
RD_ALifeLine_5c5db15b4fd9782b: *Flinches* Yeah. I did. You want to arrest me for it? Be my guest
RD_ALifeLine_4f216c7e093b0499: Home. Didn't make it. Turned out the road home was the worst place to be
RD_ALifeLine_0b5c217e3dbaffb8: No. I'd have died next to him. That's the math, and I hate it
RD_ALifeLine_786ba7200d260e25: Maybe. Thanks. Doesn't help, but thanks
RD_ALifeLine_170746642393beb3: Keep the batteries for something useful
RD_ALifeLine_28a7e2881387e6ed: Or it's a radio sitting in an empty car broadcasting to nobody. Like me
RD_ALifeLine_3dc4e4a52b56fb84: Like what? A flashlight to see how alone I am? ..Okay, fair
RD_ALifeLine_1e8717692cf739a9: *Hands it over* There. Hear it? That hum. That's the sound of nobody coming
RD_ALifeLine_0bd43c9a40258c24: It's the only clean shirt I've got. Also.. habit. Also people still hesitate before they shoot a cop
RD_ALifeLine_1ea41bcd0ebc3049: Do you still feel like a cop?
RD_ALifeLine_0ef18fea6e5315dc: Yeah, that's starting to happen too. Maybe I'll switch to flannel
RD_ALifeLine_03271e3423d0b7f3: I feel like a guy who knows how to clear a room. Same thing, minus the paperwork
RD_ALifeLine_353d27b37ad56251: *Laughs* Smells like a week of fear-sweat. But thanks
RD_ALifeLine_658fb2fc223ffcf0: We lost the east tier first. Then the yard. Then the gate. I opened cells on the way out, god help me
RD_ALifeLine_120a660a3502226a: Didn't check. Just ran down the row hitting buttons. Some of those men.. I'll find out what I did, one day
RD_ALifeLine_6d097f6a3a7903bd: The ones who didn't want to leave. They're the ones you should worry about
RD_ALifeLine_315cc4660aaed1cc: Your team still waiting for extraction?
RD_ALifeLine_04d3cd272826d1a0: Extraction's a story we tell the new guy. There's two of us. There was eight
RD_ALifeLine_2efdeeb24cbd5da7: What happened to the other six?
RD_ALifeLine_0755b3f83b4e3b52: Doorway. Stairwell. Bad mag. Two who walked off in the night. Same as anywhere
RD_ALifeLine_77f4bde25227f3ad: We do what we know. Clear, hold, move. Repeat till something changes
RD_ALifeLine_144f14946b519af4: Could. Don't know you. Ask me again when I've seen you move
RD_ALifeLine_71aae1dc56dbcf7d: Post called us in. Then the post stopped calling. Then the post was a building full of dead troopers
RD_ALifeLine_5758f501519dab9f: So you're on your own now
RD_ALifeLine_1226cdb239a5bfaa: Me and the car. The car's got half a tank and a shotgun. That's my department
RD_ALifeLine_5a332d9241271da2: Do you think you did the right thing?
RD_ALifeLine_2df2ecd24f535eeb: About what? Leaving? Shooting? Not shooting? Pick one, I've got a list
RD_ALifeLine_0566fb5a27ae4e63: Tell me about the worst one
RD_ALifeLine_75cb88d462129f99: Some days yes. Today no. Ask me tomorrow
RD_ALifeLine_6a5a9abd7c6a4f30: That's the thing. Alive feels like the thing I'm guilty of
RD_ALifeLine_2b558c5b484909fb: A kid. Maybe sixteen. Not bit, just scared, pointing a rifle at me. I didn't shoot. He did. Missed
RD_ALifeLine_43b009f72dc6b73c: And I keep thinking, what if he didn't miss. And worse, what if I had shot
RD_ALifeLine_43bb28cd285f3b21: *Smiles weakly* Yeah. Human. Hold on to that word for me
RD_ALifeLine_005c5c6602441fee: Maybe. That's the part that scares me, that you might be right
RD_ALifeLine_7fc955597ca2ee1a: My partner went into a house three days ago to grab supplies. Never came out. I.. I couldn't go in after him
RD_ALifeLine_2fa8c858289a85af: I found him. Here's his tag
RD_ALifeLine_728e76c46e8c2a00: Marked it. If he's one of them.. you do it. Don't let him walk around like that
RD_ALifeLine_1248db23178f0043: Still there? I see that window every time I close my eyes
RD_ALifeLine_18fbd86741056512: *Holds it a long time* Thank you. Thank you for going in
RD_ALifeLine_35d8d67e0e2cca6c: Anything you can spare would help
RD_ALifeLine_2d47c9b529059a87: That wasn't pretty in there. I earned more than a box
RD_ALifeLine_0c44226d5e99b739: I know. I just need to know HOW. Please
RD_ALifeLine_13f731fb52cf564d: Take the box. He'd want it used
RD_ALifeLine_18f24db54730593a: Take his sidearm. It should go to somebody who went back for him
RD_ALifeLine_578eb44817b4d90e: I know what it was like. I can't give you what I haven't got. Box. Sorry
RD_ALifeLine_650babdc4a15e945: I will. Take this anyway, please, before I break down in front of you
RD_ALifeLine_35603bcc0d084e77: What do you need most right now?
RD_ALifeLine_490e740422837f59: Shells. Twelve gauge. I've got the gun, I've got the will, I've got four shells
RD_ALifeLine_1a8aa45f49dec538: Gun stores are picked clean, try farmhouses. Every farmer had a box under the sink
RD_ALifeLine_1edac6a97b861cc5: Oh you beauty. Okay, I owe you
RD_ALifeLine_64255d4c00763417: I risked my neck for those. Let's talk real pay
RD_ALifeLine_5cee382140421c17: Meds. Not many. Enough for a bad night
RD_ALifeLine_1db27ac7763c15e1: Fine. Fine! Take the .45. It's heavy and I never liked it anyway
RD_ALifeLine_222008977bda112d: Nice try. Meds, and be happy about it
RD_ALifeLine_633d6f670e4b0c51: There's a crowd of them pressed around the station. Our old station. I want back in, there's still stuff in the locker
RD_ALifeLine_706bf04c36d79572: Fifteen or so. Hit the ones near the doors first. And watch the roof
RD_ALifeLine_7db217d3373bb7e2: *Grins* Okay. Okay! Let's go home. Sort of
RD_ALifeLine_717e35c250525484: That was a lot of dead. Make it worth it
RD_ALifeLine_7635753e50f4bb5a: Spare vest, a box or two, my kid's drawing taped inside the door. Don't laugh
RD_ALifeLine_4d3d300f015d6f05: A box from the locker, fair and square
RD_ALifeLine_540fd4812cdd54ef: Take the spare piece from the armoury. Department-issue. Don't sell it to anyone stupid
RD_ALifeLine_03f52fa41ee67418: It's a box. Department budget, ha
RD_ALifeLine_10496f505c259967: Fair. Nothing's worth it anymore, is it
RD_ALifeLine_687e912d0d56b457: My daughter's running a fever. It's not a bite. I'd know. I need pills, anything for fever
RD_ALifeLine_13913da10d8fed89: You sure it's not a bite?
RD_ALifeLine_45176cee734af525: Pharmacies are stripped. Try bathrooms. Everybody's got old pills in a bathroom
RD_ALifeLine_0d45f2f34bf18f74: Still hot. Still sleeping a lot. Please
RD_ALifeLine_0f1ec47453edd7ca: Oh god. Thank you. You don't know.. thank you
RD_ALifeLine_008ba7c103a7a9c2: I checked every inch of her. Twice. Please don't make me say it again
RD_ALifeLine_1472464428993779: Here. Food. And my word, whatever that's worth now
RD_ALifeLine_05cbafc14f96bc81: You're right. Take a box of shells too, I'll manage
RD_ALifeLine_673f39861a2eeb7d: I know. This is all I've got. I swear it is
RD_ALifeLine_548336d8208a6346: Shells for antibiotics. Bullets for bandages. That's my whole store
RD_ALifeLine_50136fbb31e7a3cc: Antibiotics for a box of shells
RD_ALifeLine_5e0b77b3747613ee: Four bandages for a box of nine mil
RD_ALifeLine_2865007c416b41f6: That might save a life. Deal
RD_ALifeLine_2035ae2b35ceff36: Done, and you got the better end of that
RD_ALifeLine_058064147378fcdc: Anything that stops bleeding or fever. Guns I've got. Being alive to use them, less so
RD_ALifeLine_18648df301f2d8c3: Quit six years ago. Started again on day two. You got some?
RD_ALifeLine_6b4eb5a574ce0106: A pack, for whatever you think is fair
RD_ALifeLine_4462ddb85576ba6f: Deal. Batteries are in. Mostly charged
RD_ALifeLine_4f655d4f24ca94c8: Fair? Here, food. And my eternal love
RD_ALifeLine_47f5c3cf1020ae84: You need fuel for that car?
RD_ALifeLine_051d39ca163be46b: The cruiser's on fumes. Half a can would get me somewhere that isn't here
RD_ALifeLine_2477e54e10731fa0: Hell yes. Here, take this, and if you ever need a ride I'm your cab
RD_ALifeLine_29d328c441488332: Honestly? Don't know. Just away. Away's a direction
RD_ALifeLine_3c1d6f8623746170: I've seen what friendly does now. Lower it
RD_ALifeLine_778a9bde45e91528: I'm keeping it, but it's pointed at the ground
RD_ALifeLine_5d40930d3a910f2c: Okay. Okay. Sorry. Last friendly guy took my partner's boots
RD_ALifeLine_24a4495c07f1d549: Finger off the trigger. I'm watching it. Alright. Talk
RD_ALifeLine_28d41f3f5c648173: Oh. Then why's my heart going like that. Sorry. Come closer, slow
RD_ALifeLine_5b7ffc9725bf81e0: I'm not making anything. I'm backing away, and if you follow, I stop backing
RD_ALifeLine_0f9854c354684bc0: Why are you looking at me like that?
RD_ALifeLine_2c357ad04f425c8d: Question for you. If I handed you my gun right now, what would you do with it?
RD_ALifeLine_11b0ef0c38747302: *Studies you* Huh. I believe you. Okay, you can stay a minute
RD_ALifeLine_141265d37525bd74: Honest. Not smart, but honest. I'll take honest
RD_ALifeLine_64cccbe97b12c99c: I wouldn't. I just wanted to see your face when you thought about it
RD_ALifeLine_2fd6515179d3a6e8: That supposed to be funny? Back up. Now
RD_ALifeLine_4e8711ef4da8feba: Have you seen raiders around here?
RD_ALifeLine_540a3d5364309fd8: Seen them? I arrested half of them last year. Now they've got my old shotgun and a truck
RD_ALifeLine_3fc46d18616f6211: Can you do anything about it?
RD_ALifeLine_3d00387c45e07b08: Wherever there's food and nobody shooting back. Don't go looking
RD_ALifeLine_1e4812e1507dde37: Move at dawn, never on the main road, and if you see a car parked across a lane, turn around
RD_ALifeLine_43b81f245162d455: Like what, write them a citation? Two of me against a truckful of them
RD_ALifeLine_460d3c601e869fca: It's dragging them across the county. Every pass, a hundred more follow it straight through somebody's yard
RD_ALifeLine_3bf4cfbf1bd3e03c: What do I do when it comes?
RD_ALifeLine_562d8c8d1b55ef53: Army, news, some rich asshole, does it matter? It doesn't land. It doesn't help
RD_ALifeLine_45d590627e938459: Get inside, get upstairs, kill the lights. Don't move till the noise is gone
RD_ALifeLine_1b86235f11041db4: Where are you staying these days?
RD_ALifeLine_0c5936bb2d3abbbe: Come on, I've been straight with you
RD_ALifeLine_6403ffbb584003ae: I'm not going to rob you
RD_ALifeLine_29071a672d6093fb: Alright. Here. If you see smoke from that direction, come running, please
RD_ALifeLine_0c69aec70dd8d849: That's what the last guy said. Maybe next time
RD_ALifeLine_0707ee732919e2b5: Thanks for not pushing. That's rare
RD_ALifeLine_0e7347c61f367c32: I'm out of everything. Can you help?
RD_ALifeLine_3758c40649dd026d: Join the club. What do you need
RD_ALifeLine_1e60a13b115aa415: Christ, let me see. Here, keep pressure on it
RD_ALifeLine_25bca5ce38c9fb68: One bottle. Don't drink it all at once, your stomach'll hate you
RD_ALifeLine_72be4792220763cd: For you, yeah. Here. Pay it forward if you can't pay it back
RD_ALifeLine_45f7c7066e1f43f3: Day before yesterday. Half a can of dog food. Don't look at me like that
RD_ALifeLine_259aa3060c4d7865: What'll you give me for a can?
RD_ALifeLine_21bc37684dd9231c: Sorry, I'm in the same boat
RD_ALifeLine_032ad07e2397e957: You.. thank you. Here, I know something you'll want to hear
RD_ALifeLine_64ac85797649086c: Shells. Two. Last ones I can spare
RD_ALifeLine_157dc2c949b86c37: Then good luck to both of us
RD_ALifeLine_6611e1c970a654e4: Yeah. Can't bring myself to toss it. Why, you looking for one?
RD_ALifeLine_5d5b813c34d677b1: Got mine right here. Couldn't toss it either
RD_ALifeLine_4f1c34d10e9c0115: I served. Kept my tags, same thing
RD_ALifeLine_2dfb188862b0b9bb: Seems heavy for a piece of tin
RD_ALifeLine_4a5b9ef71530360b: *Laughs* Look at us. Two cops and no precinct. Want to split a can and pretend it's a donut?
RD_ALifeLine_0a1294e84e4010ce: Rain check, I've got to move
RD_ALifeLine_5765ff0c36c69ef3: Yeah. Same thing. You know what it's like when the people who sent you stop answering
RD_ALifeLine_42678b22014d8232: It's heavier than it looks. Trust me
RD_ALifeLine_05df05264a7155ea: *Smiles* Best shift I've had in a week
RD_ALifeLine_3c625452134b9bdc: Keep your hands up! I don't have cuffs, I have a gun, that's the whole system now
RD_ALifeLine_2c10700770bd741c: Take what you want, just let me go
RD_ALifeLine_7237944618d54cda: Good. Now why were you sneaking up on me?
RD_ALifeLine_2e67646335509884: I wasn't sneaking, I was scared
RD_ALifeLine_6223048d6690f24c: I thought you were one of them
RD_ALifeLine_7e6449d203ec3388: I'm not robbing you, Jesus. I'm a cop. Was. Just walk away
RD_ALifeLine_2e76f65d4731cbd9: *Sighs* Neither do I. Hands down. Go on
RD_ALifeLine_23282aa57e69d978: *Lowers it a little* Yeah. Yeah, me too. Alright, go. Slowly
RD_ALifeLine_7a3f4ac36aa47bf1: Do I moan? Do I shuffle? Don't answer that. Go on, get
RD_ALifeLine_2e88cb8865b82b5c: Take it. Take it, I'm tired of being scared
RD_ALifeLine_0b8f75ff1aa181db: Give me your food and walk
RD_ALifeLine_06d5bf165735b4f8: Relax. I just needed you to listen
RD_ALifeLine_08e5970446cd6337: *Kneels* Done. Now what? You gonna shoot a guy who's already given up?
RD_ALifeLine_7d7d75580f15d2c5: With a gun on me? You've got a funny way of asking
RD_ALifeLine_4cb7a4fe74e3d397: Is anybody holding out at the courthouse?
RD_ALifeLine_2fcd335c0e45a332: Clerks. A deputy. They barred the doors and won't open for anybody, not even me
RD_ALifeLine_6a51457078e20a24: What are they doing in there?
RD_ALifeLine_63598c2f62457c8a: Last I heard, filing. Death certificates. I wish I was joking
RD_ALifeLine_5d0f8fe3310478b9: Vending machines and a basement pantry. Don't get ideas, the deputy's got a rifle and nothing to lose
RD_ALifeLine_7ae5fefa13ba693d: Is the army still holding the roads?
RD_ALifeLine_6ad3d9785af27664: Holding? They're shooting anything that comes near the line. People, them, a dog. I watched it
RD_ALifeLine_6438541c113c9177: Did you try talking to them?
RD_ALifeLine_3b64b32a2674758b: Through a bullhorn, from a quarter mile out. They told me to turn around. Nicely, the first time
RD_ALifeLine_2ef2b0fd3d65f9b7: Like a zoo. Except nobody's coming to feed us
RD_ALifeLine_7e20337b026ae92b: Some stayed. Carry water, stand watch, call me boss out of habit. Some ran with the keys to the van
RD_ALifeLine_3493e8ba29c7e789: The ones who stayed, you trust them?
RD_ALifeLine_5ed687db5164b3ba: More than half the free folk I've met this week. Funny how that works
RD_ALifeLine_1db64b5959ea0ca4: Let them, chased them, what's the difference now? There's no paperwork for this
RD_ALifeLine_023bdb71207b01db: *Long pause* I had to. You understand? He asked me to. Before he turned
RD_ALifeLine_5bfe671713bd1c95: Thank you. I needed somebody to just.. understand
RD_ALifeLine_4f6092ec2f6044e5: Mercy. Yeah. It looked a lot like murder from where I stood
RD_ALifeLine_7c3a48830f35bf5c: Don't be. I need to say it out loud sometimes
RD_ALifeLine_6397a7ac32307c7c: Somebody's hanging looters by the road
RD_ALifeLine_016093e207f23cf6: I saw. Sign around his neck and everything. Real justice, huh
RD_ALifeLine_4cd05f197017c27b: Are you going to do anything?
RD_ALifeLine_0821bbad17af6a7f: Not my county anymore. Not my problem. ..I wish it was. God, I wish it was
RD_ALifeLine_1dbaaa9161919ae6: For a bag of rice? Watch what you say around me
RD_ALifeLine_140609c558dbb2e5: No. It's what's left when justice walks off the job
RD_ALifeLine_52abed750f7e8e50: You living out in the woods now?
RD_ALifeLine_28e727c33663dffb: Always did, more or less. Only difference is now nobody files a complaint about the deer
RD_ALifeLine_1b69dfc71a957d76: Rain barrel, a snare line, and never build a fire in the same spot two nights running
RD_ALifeLine_0075f0f11fbbe1f7: I like lonely. Lonely doesn't bite
RD_ALifeLine_492a12125be997b5: Is the sheriff still running things?
RD_ALifeLine_3db17ba325017167: Sheriff walked out the back door on day five. Didn't say a word. Took the good truck
RD_ALifeLine_28e1ea3856beefca: Whoever yells loudest at the morning count. Today that was me. Tomorrow, who knows
RD_ALifeLine_2d08a7b73a8845f6: I can. I do. Every morning. Also, I get it. Both things, all day
RD_ALifeLine_051da7f2752635c8: Wait here, I'll check the house first
RD_ALifeLine_5ce892ea381f60ad: Since when do you call it?
RD_ALifeLine_51befd4e7239eee2: I'm quieter. You've got the gun to cover me
RD_ALifeLine_7947628a6086d41f: *Huffs* Okay, that's actually smart. Go. I've got the door
RD_ALifeLine_47e9459a655ecaf1: Ha. Okay. Okay boss. Don't get bit
RD_ALifeLine_540ca9ae1f0f9f19: No no, your idea, your house. I'll be right here
RD_ALifeLine_4783f1b4725132cf: Same as yesterday. Dead walking, living hiding, everybody hungry. Somebody's burning houses on the east side
RD_ALifeLine_1b3cb9c77ab45648: You still keep track of all this?
RD_ALifeLine_42cbc9d77c2926a7: Clearing the dead, or clearing the living out of the way. Smoke looks the same either way
RD_ALifeLine_1d5ee95b1ab1aced: Old habit. I can't stop taking notes. Twenty pages of who died where and nobody to give it to
RD_ALifeLine_7367ac1433d96cfa: The water in the creek's still clean. A family moved into the house by the school and they're all alive. That's my good news
RD_ALifeLine_5f188e09647afab6: Do you still think of yourself as a cop?
RD_ALifeLine_3326fa5e4f17e6c6: I think of myself as alive. Badge comes second. Some days third, after dinner
RD_ALifeLine_7d2b20352957fec9: What's the badge good for now?
RD_ALifeLine_7e3bed313b597914: People still look up to you
RD_ALifeLine_56936b4c36d01fe2: Opening doors. Folks still hesitate at the shirt. That second of hesitation's saved my life twice
RD_ALifeLine_4282a6d749704ea5: They look at me like I'm gonna fix it. I can't fix it. I can barely fix dinner
RD_ALifeLine_7804c99f2270fa0f: And be what? Just some asshole with a shotgun? There's enough of those
RD_ALifeLine_77c8d3533cb0e43f: You set up somewhere with other people?
RD_ALifeLine_7cbc0c400f2835c6: I want to trade, not take
RD_ALifeLine_61871adb7627c892: I'm alone. I'm tired of being alone
RD_ALifeLine_1d07b72826c0eb85: Trade's welcome. Raiders aren't. Here, I'll mark the place. You come with your hands visible
RD_ALifeLine_07c32ade544bfee2: *Looks you over a long time* Okay. I'll tell them about you. Come by in daylight. Don't bring company
RD_ALifeLine_11f51f852f334f2d: Curious gets people killed. No offence
RD_ALifeLine_2e5ce619319c523b: Is there anywhere safe around here?
RD_ALifeLine_72390b621ecd4e2b: There. Approach from the road, slow. They shoot sneaky people
RD_ALifeLine_32a269e20689ac02: Because you're a stranger with a weapon and they've been robbed twice by strangers with weapons
RD_ALifeLine_2ecb93377da74c62: They take useful ones. Can you fix a pump? Stitch a cut? Then maybe
RD_ALifeLine_433d8f55300215b4: Got a job for someone with good eyes?
RD_ALifeLine_79574272288b1f58: Yeah. Somebody set up a camp near our water. I need to know who and how many before we go knocking
RD_ALifeLine_51eb34ee055b9c16: I'll take a look from a distance
RD_ALifeLine_073cc779482c3c8b: I counted them. Here's what I saw
RD_ALifeLine_35ef431537d29690: Don't get seen. Don't talk to them. Count guns, count heads, come back
RD_ALifeLine_1d4ca62b466bdbb3: Take your time. Getting seen is worse than being slow
RD_ALifeLine_45859d0d465ee67c: That many? Shit. Okay. Okay, that changes things
RD_ALifeLine_40786bdc4bccdc8c: Because last time we knocked on a stranger's door, they knocked back with a rifle
RD_ALifeLine_424a11545bc3561e: Here's something back. There's a place you should know about
RD_ALifeLine_63d15a687b6b8c31: Alright. I'll show you where we keep our people. That's trust, don't spend it stupid
RD_ALifeLine_53809d2d6e82e311: It's worth a rumour and a thank you. Here
RD_ALifeLine_4ea813bf064ea7a8: Sure. Nobody's fight, until it's at your door
RD_ALifeLine_1b1bd4043b21b544: There's a family I check on. I can't make the walk this week, my knee's shot. Take them this?
RD_ALifeLine_3cd97f306e36f627: I marked their place. Knock three times, they know it
RD_ALifeLine_691e5c0b29b69f07: Good. Good. That's one thing that went right this week
RD_ALifeLine_7903e67a1b1d0967: Long walk. How about something extra?
RD_ALifeLine_52cbce3154b8cb47: Seeds, a letter, and some antibiotics for the little one. Don't get any ideas
RD_ALifeLine_7a25d1f861f5363b: Food. It's what I've got this week
RD_ALifeLine_7084bb2f5fe64643: Ha. Fine, a box of shells too. You walk well
RD_ALifeLine_25fe9a6b1e52efdf: Extra? I gave you my week's food. That's extra
RD_ALifeLine_436aa1b72faa52ce: Infection. Cut my hand on a fence. Not a bite, I swear on my mother. I need antibiotics or I lose the hand
RD_ALifeLine_3a566d202e066861: Thank you. I'm not going anywhere, as you can tell
RD_ALifeLine_36939fbc617d2d2a: Red line's moving up my arm. That's bad, right? That's bad
RD_ALifeLine_3e046f4979deb45b: *Swallows two at once* Oh god. Okay. I owe you my hand
RD_ALifeLine_167af558737530ca: A hand's worth more than a box
RD_ALifeLine_7c1ddabb2b7c3983: *Unwraps it* See? Red, swollen, no teeth marks. Fence wire. Please
RD_ALifeLine_5857cefa492cfc58: Box of nine. And you get a favour, any time
RD_ALifeLine_5152bc5153b20af7: You're right. Take my service pistol. I can't hold it steady anyway, not yet
RD_ALifeLine_38329bdd14856e73: It is. But a box is all I've got. Sorry
RD_ALifeLine_0edf47202775a12b: Trying to. There's a house I need to get to and I'm not walking that road alone again
RD_ALifeLine_7be93ced1c1ddb31: You take point, I'll watch behind. Like a real patrol
RD_ALifeLine_0741d5100d4ccbd2: Keep your eyes on the ditches
RD_ALifeLine_652339884a9de01c: Got jumped. Not by the dead. Two kids with a bat. I didn't want to shoot them so I ran
RD_ALifeLine_04101c0e08d420c0: Tools. Hammer, screwdriver, some nails. Useful stuff
RD_ALifeLine_7287692f3c878433: *Laughs* Fine. The .45, it's been in my bag doing nothing
RD_ALifeLine_2862c0d2411364ec: Then it's a good thing you're not a bodyguard. Tools, take them
RD_ALifeLine_48412e4d489940f2: Another day then. If I'm still here
RD_ALifeLine_508960b124cebf2f: What would make your week easier?
RD_ALifeLine_5720e8a6599804c4: Fuel. One can and the generator runs the freezer for three days. We've got meat in there
RD_ALifeLine_4b0056a0689cea34: One can. The meat thanks you in advance
RD_ALifeLine_2b9bf03674713dc8: Steak tonight! Real steak. You eat with us?
RD_ALifeLine_4b474bf13198c746: I'd love to, and some pay
RD_ALifeLine_17b9d1de1855b525: Steak's nice, but I need something lasting
RD_ALifeLine_66d4610a3b5832cf: Cars in garages. Nobody thinks of garages. Bring a hose
RD_ALifeLine_31119b844dd031be: Food for the road then, cooked and wrapped
RD_ALifeLine_3f5463f8095a9138: Okay okay. Food and a box of shells
RD_ALifeLine_07dd990a27fa893d: Lasting? Kid, nothing lasts. Here's dinner
RD_ALifeLine_6ab011417fc75e15: Maybe one. Service pistol, belonged to a guy who doesn't need it. What's it worth to you?
RD_ALifeLine_0e4d9564376d8bd7: Three cans of food and a bottle of whiskey
RD_ALifeLine_1ea1e95454dda550: Done. Treat it right, it was his whole job
RD_ALifeLine_07e305183e85ab5d: Whiskey I'll take. Keep your cans, you look hungrier than me
RD_ALifeLine_3fa045d4016c3ffb: Because I can't carry two and the antibiotics are worth more than a dead man's gun
RD_ALifeLine_376bca1105ceae50: For the right price. Disinfectant, pills, batteries. I'm a cop, not a charity
RD_ALifeLine_32e4a808559d1509: My back thanks you. Here's your shells
RD_ALifeLine_01f6ddd00bdf47f9: Prices go up every day, just so you know
RD_ALifeLine_5a33fde2489698fe: The ones who should never get out. They run it now. Got the armoury and the guard towers
RD_ALifeLine_1a546e764533f5cf: They already are. Raiding parties. They like houses with kids, because the parents give everything up
RD_ALifeLine_7c55013400c6beda: Mags taped across the chest, guards' shotguns, prison khaki under stolen jackets. You'll know
RD_ALifeLine_0ddcf40101ed772b: Sure. Once. Then they take your boots
RD_ALifeLine_047b996a4346d488: Why are you still in here?
RD_ALifeLine_0119cb87279c10f8: Records. Deeds, births, deaths, who owned what. When this ends somebody's gonna need to know
RD_ALifeLine_7580bccb6cb52883: You're wasting your life on paper
RD_ALifeLine_4ada55784803609f: Maybe nobody. But if somebody does, they'll find out their grandma's farm was really hers
RD_ALifeLine_3b29e1cf3d3923bb: *Blinks* Huh. Nobody's said anything nice about this place in a long time. Thank you
RD_ALifeLine_7facd4b907b0b294: And you're wasting yours on cans. At least my paper doesn't run out
RD_ALifeLine_4238a0893e08303a: Open up, I need to come inside
RD_ALifeLine_0023c9f908ac86ff: The door stays shut. Talk from there
RD_ALifeLine_73ee8bd10b25664e: I can help you hold the place
RD_ALifeLine_17ee828414cf24d4: Everybody's hurt. I've got a bandage, I'll slide it under the door
RD_ALifeLine_3a71f84614671c66: *Bolts slide* Quick, quick, get in. Touch nothing
RD_ALifeLine_2ad277dd19d42d47: We've heard about you. Okay. Just you, nobody else, and you sign the ledger
RD_ALifeLine_7f818cc3636edfd1: The deputy upstairs has a rifle and a view of your head. Try it
RD_ALifeLine_61c837e64ab38646: Thank you. Most people just shout
RD_ALifeLine_409ca7601733ec33: Can you look someone up for me?
RD_ALifeLine_7b26336c57afacd3: Name? Births, deaths, marriages. I've got everyone up to the week it hit, and some after
RD_ALifeLine_5a7b66fb0a7bb833: Do you have the dead from after?
RD_ALifeLine_5430fff4310a67ad: Never mind, I don't want to know
RD_ALifeLine_5a3b87f23e9733a2: *Flips pages* There. You're here. You exist. Want me to write 'still alive' next to it?
RD_ALifeLine_0daba5b23ec42484: Leave it blank, it's bad luck
RD_ALifeLine_7e754eeb41d66738: Some. People come and tell me. I write it down. It's the only funeral most of them get
RD_ALifeLine_10772ee349e78526: Superstitious. I like that. Blank it is
RD_ALifeLine_570a82683f40c8aa: Let me see your hands. Both. Okay. Now tell me why you followed me for three blocks
RD_ALifeLine_4893a9ab60ef6b6d: I wasn't sure you were alive
RD_ALifeLine_2daf72145d72f0f9: I wanted to talk but didn't want to spook you
RD_ALifeLine_2a7f6aed6c869b8c: Following someone's the best way to spook them. Next time, whistle. Okay, what do you want?
RD_ALifeLine_384d541e72ed5630: You did. I saw you in the window reflections. Don't lie to me on day one, it's a bad start
RD_ALifeLine_46b94bae488bc062: Thanks. Okay. Hi. Sorry, I'm out of practice at hi
RD_ALifeLine_095fcc856fbc9f95: Where are the others in your group?
RD_ALifeLine_4a829ba701fd4375: I saw two people with you yesterday
RD_ALifeLine_02eba02a1de2ef04: I'm not a threat to them, I swear
RD_ALifeLine_0e2f0a747e3fcfdb: *Jaw tightens* You've been watching us. That's a bad way to make friends
RD_ALifeLine_4a2c8f365c56ea8e: *Sighs* Four of us. Two kids. I lied because that's what you do now. Sorry
RD_ALifeLine_5beaf49c2b8075df: Thanks. Come by sometime. Daylight, empty hands
RD_ALifeLine_7e908dbf7cbf6da3: Slowly. Maybe. Here, this is where we are. Don't make me regret it
RD_ALifeLine_0c8bb89637b7a372: Did you hear about the raid?
RD_ALifeLine_110c12a676c1a80e: Hit a house two days back. Took everything, left nobody standing. I found the dog still tied up out back
RD_ALifeLine_13aa0baf1c28510e: Tyre tracks, lots of brass, no mercy. That narrows it down to everybody with a truck
RD_ALifeLine_53716c336ae4491a: Hunting them with what? Prayer? If they come here, though, we're ready
RD_ALifeLine_34bfb17d73e68895: *Smiles a little* He's with me now. Only one who doesn't ask me to fix things
RD_ALifeLine_74ac168076965282: Not for days. Last time it was trailing smoke. Maybe it went down. Maybe that's for the best
RD_ALifeLine_4885c8cc200fc484: If it crashed, there's gear in it
RD_ALifeLine_4a3edffd5d349e3a: Every time it flew over, a crowd followed it straight through somebody's walls. I counted
RD_ALifeLine_147f9f4f25df1415: And a few hundred dead that followed it down. Go look if you're tired of living
RD_ALifeLine_33fa14e12e74b210: Can you spare anything? I'm in a bad way
RD_ALifeLine_78106c841e1d1616: Bad way like hungry, or bad way like bleeding?
RD_ALifeLine_3bbdf98c169ed9f1: I've got nothing left at all
RD_ALifeLine_56858f44056800ab: Here. One can. That's my lunch, so you owe me a lunch
RD_ALifeLine_7a1bc8907997e43f: Sit. Let me see. ..Okay, here, disinfectant and a wrap. You'll live
RD_ALifeLine_4b18bc8a28c2f5ac: *Looks at you a long time* Here. Food, water, a bandage. Because it's you
RD_ALifeLine_76c2055b1765fb7f: Antibiotics. The kid in our group's got an ear infection, screaming all night. Draws them
RD_ALifeLine_4a99300a59fb7fd2: Oh thank god. Here, take this. And come by any time
RD_ALifeLine_14cdac851102f86d: A box of shells and our gratitude, which is a real thing out here
RD_ALifeLine_23cfc3d106cacef8: A sick kid's worth more than that to you
RD_ALifeLine_1ba1681f2476a373: Okay. If you find some, please
RD_ALifeLine_2776a86162da350e: *Grits teeth* You're right, and you're an asshole for saying it. The .45. Take it
RD_ALifeLine_3fddf61a65f79273: You were on the job before, right?
RD_ALifeLine_4837ed715afcd8ce: Me too. You can tell, can't you
RD_ALifeLine_32f3d8800da698a1: Served overseas. Different uniform, same nightmares
RD_ALifeLine_7eeb62283b055987: *Laughs* Yeah. The way you stand at the edge of a doorway. Academy never leaves you
RD_ALifeLine_112235f54da64ee4: Then you know about orders that never come. Respect. Real respect
RD_ALifeLine_5796d3272b49b781: The tired look? Yeah, that's the uniform now
RD_ALifeLine_07c4bf6871719a62: Maybe. Here's where I bed down. If you ever need a partner, knock twice
RD_ALifeLine_2a19ef853b7065f5: Colleague. God, I forgot that word existed
RD_ALifeLine_3ba49a486e93d17b: You sure about this? I've got friends who'll ask where I went
RD_ALifeLine_0608fc20436f5a43: Easy. Easy. You don't want this
RD_ALifeLine_580348b75ce6eb67: I just want you to back off from my house
RD_ALifeLine_056061ab697ad018: Then say that. With your mouth, not your barrel. ..Okay. I'll stay off your street
RD_ALifeLine_6479053168bb341a: Done. Remember I could have shot you and didn't
RD_ALifeLine_290c0787274538a6: You'll need it more than you think. Because I'll be back
RD_ALifeLine_60b7e45d680fc2bc: Drop it and step back three steps. Good. Who sent you?
RD_ALifeLine_07d4902a20d27770: I was just looking for food
RD_ALifeLine_6cf3b74852772779: Everybody's alone till their friends show up. ..Alright. Pick it up and go. Other direction
RD_ALifeLine_6183f2a0637b5d72: *Sighs* Here. A can. Now go before I change my mind
RD_ALifeLine_19017c2f1c4f4fcf: Do we look like raiders? Don't answer that. Go on, grab your stuff
RD_ALifeLine_4b1431dc55e6e26c: What do you do with criminals now?
RD_ALifeLine_424f532402085d8c: Turn 'em loose without boots or a weapon. That's the sentence. The road does the rest
RD_ALifeLine_2048a4e9472721bf: Harsh is what they did to get there. Nobody gets that for stealing bread
RD_ALifeLine_41cbfff505dfa4b0: That's the idea. We're not them. Not yet
RD_ALifeLine_13a7af3779c31a65: Three of us vote. It's not a court, it's what we've got. Don't like it? Neither do I
RD_ALifeLine_1387e2f95eea0ebb: How do you stay hidden out here?
RD_ALifeLine_09c1389b4f2b2fc0: Smokeless fire, no straight paths, and I move camp when the birds go quiet
RD_ALifeLine_3e54b7a41714eaa7: They shut up before anything big comes through. Dead or alive. Best alarm there is
RD_ALifeLine_08537107732af148: Not near. Downhill, maybe. And if you're loud, I'm moving
RD_ALifeLine_111fd5ed77a6c70c: What's left. We do what we trained for. Clear, hold, move. Repeat
RD_ALifeLine_4b15dbc95397d8b4: First lesson. Never stand in a doorway. You just did. Second lesson tomorrow
RD_ALifeLine_1245b8e62ca8d8b1: Senior man. Then me. Then nobody. Hierarchy's the last piece of the world that still works
RD_ALifeLine_2db4a3f0400e9ce5: It's not. It's surviving with good posture
RD_ALifeLine_48326178321880ba: Gold. Tons of it. You can't eat it, can't burn it, can't shoot with it. We guard it anyway
RD_ALifeLine_7e66dc707aae2d0f: Give me a bar and I'll leave
RD_ALifeLine_4a35b7d22e990d36: That's the saddest job in the world
RD_ALifeLine_21169985243309ff: Because that's the order. And when you stop following the last order, what are you?
RD_ALifeLine_3b8f6ceb13cf6c71: *Snorts* And do what with it, buy a can of beans for a million dollars?
RD_ALifeLine_330ce7ff32c01253: Second saddest. The saddest is guarding it alone. I'm getting there
RD_ALifeLine_70c06c2e1865baa0: Did you ever find your family?
RD_ALifeLine_1ba7ec8c71fe855a: Found the house. Door was open. Kitchen table set for four
RD_ALifeLine_22c6c85c1a03b2b2: I found my brother. What was left of him
RD_ALifeLine_4bf2607566137f3b: Thanks. Everybody's sorry. It's the new hello
RD_ALifeLine_5981b923059b4d88: Maybe. I tell myself that on the good nights
RD_ALifeLine_36685e432a29b061: Spite, mostly. And people like you asking questions like that
RD_ALifeLine_7742785e21847f86: Can I count on you if things get bad?
RD_ALifeLine_7369d6815ccf3a2a: Worse than now. Raiders at my door bad
RD_ALifeLine_01c2654b21a767cf: Then you run, not fight. But okay, here's where to find me. I'll come if I can
RD_ALifeLine_2151f81178a3d8ed: Deal. Here. Two knocks, then one. That's us
RD_ALifeLine_530f4f970c424dde: Still feuding with the other department?
RD_ALifeLine_23cd5ad44762392b: *Laughs* There's maybe nine of us total between both. We share a fire now. Feels like a joke
RD_ALifeLine_56377c59568bc87c: Took the end of the world
RD_ALifeLine_3c74f0cb2cc734c9: Who's in charge of the nine?
RD_ALifeLine_2853e32d3c3fa862: And a lot of funerals. But yeah. Turns out the other guys are alright. Don't tell them
RD_ALifeLine_6c6948f63d4ec67d: We argue about it every night. It's the only normal thing left
RD_ALifeLine_1321c9512ab09c64: What are the rules where you live?
RD_ALifeLine_7b153f7045d17c44: Three. Nobody eats alone, nobody goes out alone, nobody points a gun at anybody inside the fence
RD_ALifeLine_097ccced2e0b4f16: First time, a talk. Second time, a long walk without a weapon
RD_ALifeLine_671b51087d74bdb5: Cover me while I loot this place
RD_ALifeLine_2a4b9a357dbf266e: Loot? It's called recovering property now. ..Fine. What's my cut?
RD_ALifeLine_05459b7d61908048: Deal. I've got the street. Be quick, quiet, and don't trip any alarms
RD_ALifeLine_28fd1d625e926992: *Snorts* I'll take a can of gratitude. Go, I've got you
RD_ALifeLine_40235f9f042dc78f: Charming. I'll cover you anyway, because I'm a sucker
RD_ALifeLine_3b8f21eb22438ffd: News? There's no news. There's weather and there's who died. Today it's cloudy and a guy named Pete
RD_ALifeLine_6751a8936dbc66b5: You used to care about this stuff
RD_ALifeLine_696995333f523c87: Guy who fixed radios. Nobody'll fix radios now. That's how it goes, one skill at a time, gone
RD_ALifeLine_06f625ba57e3d0d2: I still care. I just stopped thinking caring does anything
RD_ALifeLine_63b6bffa38d0c4b2: *Snorts* Look at you, an optimist. Hang onto that
RD_ALifeLine_40b4fefc2a24694e: *Sighs* It's in a drawer somewhere. With the rest of who I was
RD_ALifeLine_32e925d21476e100: Traded it. Guy wanted it for his kid. Got a can of peaches
RD_ALifeLine_1055dfa727d9c224: Good. Badges never meant much anyway
RD_ALifeLine_53b5ca9a23dfb0a0: I miss knowing what I was supposed to do. The badge just said it out loud
RD_ALifeLine_13168d875387b955: Someone who's good at staying alive. That's the whole resume now
RD_ALifeLine_7995a36154d34023: To you, maybe. To me it was a promise. I broke it. Different thing
RD_ALifeLine_7f991e0e4839cfd6: No. I guess it's not. Thanks
RD_ALifeLine_11e8e0b922c5c77c: It is. You're the first person I've talked to in four days who wasn't trying to take something
RD_ALifeLine_5d8699643e731233: You used to keep order around here, right?
RD_ALifeLine_55511ef6519a2546: Used to. Tried. Then I watched a man shoot his brother over a can of peaches, and I stopped
RD_ALifeLine_25ce61d74796b47c: What would it take to start again?
RD_ALifeLine_053a69c669b90db0: Then you do it. I'll hold your coat
RD_ALifeLine_454356ed4d90a5fa: Nobody blames anyone anymore. That's sort of the problem
RD_ALifeLine_245170271d5f7532: People who'd listen. Enough of them in one place. ..Maybe. Ask me in a month
RD_ALifeLine_6d55fd7e6cf609d2: Who made you judge out here?
RD_ALifeLine_0513999f5633b29c: Nobody. That's the problem. Also kind of the point
RD_ALifeLine_4269a4017308916d: So you just make it up
RD_ALifeLine_48f86ad22f5c1915: I'd follow it, if it's fair
RD_ALifeLine_635838605a73dd32: Every law ever was made up by somebody. We just skipped the voting
RD_ALifeLine_498e99a66e6d23c0: Don't hurt people who aren't hurting you. Share water. Bury the dead. Everything else is negotiable
RD_ALifeLine_7891e5a5765ee0fe: *Nods* Fair's what we're aiming at. We miss a lot. Come by and see
RD_ALifeLine_57db5cde27f77e4d: Where do you live these days?
RD_ALifeLine_04229d7b068beecd: I've helped you before. Trust me a little
RD_ALifeLine_71edb60c0ac27a08: Fair. I'd keep it quiet too
RD_ALifeLine_24e81ace246ea8c9: *Long look* Yeah. You have. Here. Come with empty hands and a white rag, they know the signal
RD_ALifeLine_4fa397a8520db5e6: Traders I'll tell where to wait. Not where we sleep. Here's the drop spot
RD_ALifeLine_4a25320309f6cc1b: Smart. You'll live longer than most
RD_ALifeLine_58c1198d6cc138dc: Visit? Like a neighbour? *Laughs* That's adorable
RD_ALifeLine_0139f05772c94d73: I mean it. Coffee and talk
RD_ALifeLine_46412a7c16151bda: ..Okay. Yeah. Here's the place. Knock, say your name, wait. Bring coffee, actually
RD_ALifeLine_4ab5297a03fbffa0: Hey, no, it's.. it was nice to be asked
RD_ALifeLine_23f0706f1e9bbced: Fuel. Two cans. We've got a car that runs and a sick man who needs to get somewhere with a doctor
RD_ALifeLine_774ab0a60497d104: Is there even a doctor left?
RD_ALifeLine_568578f9635fce52: Thanks. He's got a few days. Maybe
RD_ALifeLine_2cbe97680c45a867: He's coughing worse. Hurry if you can
RD_ALifeLine_68d6292c30c8f7dc: That'll do it. You might've bought him a life
RD_ALifeLine_4db756d554e10018: Fuel's gold now, you know that
RD_ALifeLine_68425c0616f09139: Rumour says yes. Rumours are all we've got. Help or don't
RD_ALifeLine_783e5ab839bfa3de: Box of shells. Same as gold, these days
RD_ALifeLine_11937d2f3c1803cd: I know. *Sighs* Take the pistol. He can't shoot anyway, he can barely sit up
RD_ALifeLine_21886f1c6a7eb537: And bullets are diamonds. Take the box
RD_ALifeLine_450a204a0cb5526b: There's a house we want. Good walls, a well. Problem is the family inside never left. Not alive, anyway
RD_ALifeLine_43e4e3953aef890d: Marked it. Bury them out back if you've got the stomach. If not, we'll do it
RD_ALifeLine_778fbc57061b5413: Still in there? Slow and quiet
RD_ALifeLine_51f8d6d9666af114: Good. We move in tomorrow. Christ, a well
RD_ALifeLine_74406ef4383e22ca: A house with a well is worth a lot more than shells
RD_ALifeLine_2d38a6ac13e2fae7: I did the last three. I'm tired of faces. Your turn
RD_ALifeLine_4bbe0f31334bba4a: Shells. And a room, if you ever need one
RD_ALifeLine_11d63d4c1549c257: Okay, you're right. The .45, a box, and the room
RD_ALifeLine_51f5f7f60742aed0: It's worth what I have. Shells
RD_ALifeLine_7dbba5de4d01b5a7: A herd's been drifting toward our fence. Twenty, thirty. If someone thins the front, the rest wander off
RD_ALifeLine_62b4d71367a64513: Still hear them groaning at night
RD_ALifeLine_1d7aa3be63645f6c: I spent more than I'll get back
RD_ALifeLine_6ad06c366f848a29: Pick them off from the edge. Don't let them bunch. And run if it goes bad, no shame
RD_ALifeLine_29fcd27d76414011: Right. Box and some meds then. You're bleeding a bit, by the way
RD_ALifeLine_70c01d541f0fc974: We all spend more than we get back. That's the economy. Box
RD_ALifeLine_596e4a1870f9512a: Got anything I can help with?
RD_ALifeLine_6200c96d1cef7e2e: Our runner went out three days ago and didn't come back. Kid, nineteen. Bring me something, so I can tell his mother
RD_ALifeLine_52b09eb20fb7ea0a: His last spot's marked. Be careful, whatever got him might still be there
RD_ALifeLine_4e4b064037f97f89: *Closes eyes* Okay. Okay. I'll tell her. Thank you for not making me guess
RD_ALifeLine_180a3c793d1bef54: It cost me to go out there
RD_ALifeLine_5dd8c8bb07cd661a: Maybe. Then bring me proof he ran. Either way she needs to know
RD_ALifeLine_387211c6417ebe4d: Meds. Ours, but you earned them
RD_ALifeLine_31bd99a21da60166: His mother said give you this. His pistol. She doesn't want to see it again
RD_ALifeLine_7231fb9e10e7404e: It costs everyone. Meds, that's it
RD_ALifeLine_27599e2271147544: How's everyone holding up at your place?
RD_ALifeLine_21d533c81b02b3ee: Badly. We've got a fever going around. Real flu, not the other thing. We need medicine
RD_ALifeLine_3c5c9cea1b66b6fe: Anything. Pills, antibiotics, even cough syrup. Thank you
RD_ALifeLine_59f846ed5f51a2e8: This is.. this is a lot. Thank you
RD_ALifeLine_4bcfde8a5679a492: You know what medicine's worth right now
RD_ALifeLine_1d130ba06f5642c0: Food and shells. And you're welcome at our fire
RD_ALifeLine_09c850996f3c35d3: I do. The .45 and a box. And our fire's yours
RD_ALifeLine_174dae534a7fa895: I do, and I can't pay it. Shells, food, sorry
RD_ALifeLine_6bc627ea1280d736: Nine mil, shells, a flashlight. Want antibiotics, batteries, booze. Booze mostly, I won't lie
RD_ALifeLine_02545a9d2f0823df: Whiskey for a box of nine
RD_ALifeLine_6244184b1d4c5be4: Two boxes for that. Don't judge me
RD_ALifeLine_02c07ced7d6adc81: Two boxes. Good trade for both of us
RD_ALifeLine_585307d3522ad755: This? Walkie. Long range. Nobody left to talk to on it though
RD_ALifeLine_29c1bee96da63b32: Done. If you ever hear anyone on it, tell me. Please
RD_ALifeLine_44c976ff036102c4: Because I stopped listening for an answer about a week ago
RD_ALifeLine_1f5b0c252f0b61cd: Yeah. Maybe I'll try one more night
RD_ALifeLine_58d686e3393dc776: Matches. Lighter. Anything that makes fire. Ours got wet and it's getting cold
RD_ALifeLine_2cfdba854ff8ff20: You just saved our night. Here, take some food, it's cooked
RD_ALifeLine_504925941f4aa157: We'll rub sticks together then. Like idiots
RD_ALifeLine_788eaa8276e5ae1c: Don't shoot, I just want to talk
RD_ALifeLine_5a0399302ef9e60c: I keep it, you keep yours, we both relax
RD_ALifeLine_2a75c94210130c1d: *Lowers own* Alright. Alright. I'm sorry. You learn to be like this
RD_ALifeLine_7f40317771ba5bcc: Fine. Fingers off triggers. And you stay on that side of the car
RD_ALifeLine_3972a10e0af47fa7: Then we're done. Walk away. Backwards
RD_ALifeLine_5d23a03077202a0b: Funny, I was about to ask. Tell me something true about yourself. Something you wouldn't tell a stranger
RD_ALifeLine_4c0c20b033cca291: I left someone behind to save myself
RD_ALifeLine_7df46d1f0a75e48a: *Quiet* Yeah. Me too. Okay. I trust you a little more now
RD_ALifeLine_32d410cb436174a2: Good. The ones who aren't scared are the ones who get people killed
RD_ALifeLine_3089f81e743181f2: That's not a secret, that's a fact. But okay, honest
RD_ALifeLine_0ad4f6244cac0fd1: Then I'll keep mine too. And my distance
RD_ALifeLine_350fb34d535e589a: Worse and smarter. They scout now. Watch a house for days, count the guns, then hit at dawn
RD_ALifeLine_5c82325f437fb8bf: How do I know if I'm being watched?
RD_ALifeLine_32102da95caa4f3f: What do I do if they come?
RD_ALifeLine_33c04dc34920276d: Same car twice. Smoke on a hill that wasn't there. Somebody walking past who doesn't look at you
RD_ALifeLine_6378ffa95639285d: Don't defend stuff, defend people. If it's more than you can count, leave the stuff
RD_ALifeLine_755985a018fab261: What's happening at the prison these days?
RD_ALifeLine_4295e5602933fbcc: The yard boys turned it into a fort. Towers manned, gates welded. They send crews out and they don't come back empty
RD_ALifeLine_12b1693d3e94adeb: A cell block barred themselves in from the rest. Just want to be left alone. I respect that
RD_ALifeLine_453a6e287461eb7c: With what army? You see one around? I don't
RD_ALifeLine_54b33d232f6859bd: Every day. Births too, believe it or not. Two this month. Two little people with no birth certificates till I wrote them
RD_ALifeLine_1f9140267db7e9f7: What do you write for the dead?
RD_ALifeLine_34d002473825d03b: Write me in as a citizen
RD_ALifeLine_1cddca4e4585b05b: It is. It really is. I cried on the page, smudged the ink
RD_ALifeLine_4802c61552975c33: Name, if known. Where. 'Put to rest by' and whoever did it. Everyone gets a line
RD_ALifeLine_052ee58313dde2ea: *Writes carefully* Citizen of what's left. Signed and sealed. Congratulations, you're official
RD_ALifeLine_16deca122a3203db: You too? Thought I dreamed it. First one in weeks
RD_ALifeLine_0bcf8c621f0152d4: It'll drag every corpse in the county here
RD_ALifeLine_481bb8cf150586d7: Someone with fuel and a working engine. That's either hope or the worst news yet
RD_ALifeLine_6dca161838af4f58: Yep. Lock down tonight. I'm telling everyone
RD_ALifeLine_6ba88ab85afdf0a8: Wore a badge. Doesn't matter now. You?
RD_ALifeLine_79aa266722225022: Same. Still feels weird to say it
RD_ALifeLine_63cc00dc3d16281c: Army. Feels like a different life
RD_ALifeLine_3cff11453d7782e8: *Laughs* We're a dying breed. Literally. Come here, I'll show you something
RD_ALifeLine_2f7ed8f97b45e170: Then you know. The day the orders stop, you find out who you really are
RD_ALifeLine_30b07c140c238a61: Nobody's useless now. Can you carry water? Then you're useful
RD_ALifeLine_0a68e3bb382361b6: My notebook. Every name I've helped since it fell. I bet yours would look the same
RD_ALifeLine_762457a21783dbc8: Then make it longer. That's the job now, the only one left
RD_ALifeLine_24efa6ac5d05c54e: Water's the one thing we've got. The creek's still clean, god knows how
RD_ALifeLine_228e2bba3f57eafd: Here. Boil it next time, okay? Even clean water lies
RD_ALifeLine_524ee6e562233a15: *Smiles* Nice try. Ask me again when I know you better
RD_ALifeLine_09aabed54dda820f: *Laughs bitterly* Go on then. Do it. I'm too tired to be scared of you
RD_ALifeLine_227ee0411f7b6aab: Hey. I'm not gonna shoot you
RD_ALifeLine_6cb9a59441189837: There. Happy? Take it. Take the boots too, they pinch
RD_ALifeLine_13db24cf02c9583f: Then why point it? ..Sorry. I'm not okay
RD_ALifeLine_23fd082458e1718d: No. No I'm not. Nobody asked in a while
RD_ALifeLine_4f6a8d5c10b02f08: Don't shoot! I'm done, I give up
RD_ALifeLine_3ebf568462d53f5c: *Gun stays up* Give me one reason not to. You came in quiet, you came in armed
RD_ALifeLine_5f1994d040daad71: I've got nobody. I'm just trying to live
RD_ALifeLine_0e8324643ceaee72: I'll leave everything, just let me go
RD_ALifeLine_6200fb76269e3347: Because you're still a cop, deep down
RD_ALifeLine_344e5548576ed568: *Long breath* Yeah. Everybody is. Go on. Other way
RD_ALifeLine_5dd8724f3a460d3c: Keep your stuff. I'm not them. Go
RD_ALifeLine_6f36c0fd3a881687: *Lowers it* Low blow. Effective, but low. Get out of here
RD_ALifeLine_238891c96448bf00: Boring calls. Cat in a tree. Kid lost at the fair. Fender bender, everyone yelling, nobody hurt
RD_ALifeLine_75eca6fc54c30e5f: It was. I complained every day. Idiot
RD_ALifeLine_1bf434d269399db1: *Laughs* Oh god, don't. I'd shoot a man for a hot shower. Kidding. Mostly
RD_ALifeLine_28c75a2072579985: Yeah. That's the real answer, isn't it. Mine too
RD_ALifeLine_1457b04626281c49: Deer are back. Bolder every week. Nobody's shooting them. Except me
RD_ALifeLine_037e703a57459397: Could you teach me to track?
RD_ALifeLine_6ab4c5e646ebaf0c: Watch the ground, not the trees. Fresh dirt is dark. Then wait. Most people can't wait
RD_ALifeLine_7ad54f1c16534f44: Smoked. For ammo. Rifle rounds, not pistol junk
RD_ALifeLine_3b726f6463aced28: You used to be a prison guard?
RD_ALifeLine_0dccccad19033f2c: Corrections officer. Twelve years. Now I live in a house with three guys who used to be in my block
RD_ALifeLine_530e8a7a0566af43: Better than with some free folk I've met. They know what walls are for
RD_ALifeLine_23babd7500e0bc8b: *Laughs* One of them makes the best stew I ever had. Insane's relative now
RD_ALifeLine_2e31e0091ef8bc1d: Same as everyone. Stack wood, salt meat, pray. Mostly pray
RD_ALifeLine_6c465936660e02d0: Do they slow down in the cold?
RD_ALifeLine_3cf9bb8026b2def7: Pick one room and seal it. Heat that room only. Sleep in your clothes
RD_ALifeLine_29a98c0107a32f15: They stiffen up. So do we. It's an even trade
RD_ALifeLine_0acb86115236a2fd: Day one. I'd have gone home. Not to the station, home. Everything after that's just noise
RD_ALifeLine_35c7d0587a9ed36d: You'd do it the same, I think
RD_ALifeLine_000f04b764eb6887: Nobody knew. That's what I tell myself at three in the morning
RD_ALifeLine_3c3f74ec4557f57c: Funny? Okay. A walker in a traffic cop vest was directing traffic yesterday. Arms flapping. Nobody listened. Same as before
RD_ALifeLine_20c2474a666227b2: Grim's all we've got. You laugh at grim or you cry at it
