RD_ALifeLine_7c8257197e517093: The city's a forest with windows now. Weeds through the asphalt, deer on the main street. It's almost pretty
RD_ALifeLine_3b3a08d549aec168: Quiet. The dead are thinning out, or slowing down. Some mornings you hear birds and nothing else
RD_ALifeLine_1f5aa34012439d36: Scavengers in and out. Nobody stays. Too many corners
RD_ALifeLine_4552510919fac133: Everybody who's still here has. The ones who didn't change aren't
RD_ALifeLine_437e55f240e99a29: Is there any law left now?
RD_ALifeLine_37c0d07b45895de7: There's rules. Different place, different rules. That's all law ever was, if you think about it
RD_ALifeLine_7981557417b5605e: Rules are just power with manners
RD_ALifeLine_36b2e88a203311aa: Whoever the place trusts. Sometimes that's me. Old habits, new county
RD_ALifeLine_247304026d4cec34: I miss courts. Somebody other than me deciding. That was the real luxury
RD_ALifeLine_25c60fdc6d6637fa: *Laughs* Yeah. The manners are the important part though
RD_ALifeLine_5268c8c47013a6b9: Do you think about the old world much?
RD_ALifeLine_0b8cdc2044c7a278: Less every week. I forgot my badge number last month. Fourteen years and it's just gone
RD_ALifeLine_7b6fc1e7498bb68d: It used to. Now it's like a coat that doesn't fit anymore. You just stop wearing it
RD_ALifeLine_3cee17580d8a835b: Maybe. Or forgetting. They look the same from the inside
RD_ALifeLine_50c66d8707bc5389: Is your settlement taking new people?
RD_ALifeLine_6c0d4a6b10bed4e3: Depends who. We've had a few bad apples. One of them burned the smokehouse
RD_ALifeLine_11fe34ed505465a4: You know me. I've proven myself
RD_ALifeLine_41f5307469ffcd8f: I can work. Farming, fixing, guarding
RD_ALifeLine_757a614a3c37d633: You have. Here. Show this mark at the gate, they'll know I sent you
RD_ALifeLine_4684613a5b1497a0: That's the right answer. Come for a trial week. Here's where
RD_ALifeLine_544789a1424aaf08: Not till I know you better. That's the price of the last guy
RD_ALifeLine_0cd26c38281de42e: Where do you call home now?
RD_ALifeLine_480daada4eb46cd1: A farmhouse. Garden out back. A dog. Two cats who hate the dog. It's the most normal I've felt since
RD_ALifeLine_00c34e386685409a: It's not. But it's close enough that I'm scared of losing it
RD_ALifeLine_010c21dc5e75867f: *Smiles* Yeah. Here. Bring seeds if you've got any
RD_ALifeLine_4c7ef97a120ee4a0: I'm meeting someone to trade seed for salt. Last time I met someone, it was an ambush. Walk with me?
RD_ALifeLine_55ead40d2927b37f: Stay a few steps back. If I scratch my ear, something's wrong
RD_ALifeLine_7c8b9c4e402310f8: Keep your eyes on their hands, not their faces
RD_ALifeLine_0f0755483b8eb41c: *Lets out a breath* Good. Salt for the winter. Thank you
RD_ALifeLine_0f1807b06984f010: I was ready to die for your salt. Let's talk
RD_ALifeLine_5456e15b357457f0: Because salt. You can't live without it, and they've got a whole truck
RD_ALifeLine_2f4999684d953710: Salted meat. Same thing, but tastier
RD_ALifeLine_4747f0697ec11b58: *Laughs* Alright, alright. The old service pistol. I haven't fired it in weeks
RD_ALifeLine_7b9361bd54328931: You weren't. You were bored. Here, meat
RD_ALifeLine_577710106f182100: There's a group set up near us. Flags, fences, the works. I need eyes on them before we decide neighbours or trouble
RD_ALifeLine_7a11e7f0332d6a1d: I watched them a while. Here's what I saw
RD_ALifeLine_261d630c5cd08046: Distance. Binoculars if you've got them. Don't let them see you, it'd start something
RD_ALifeLine_1202745451affeab: No rush, but they're building fast
RD_ALifeLine_677403b62cf3f2b6: Kids and gardens? Huh. Maybe neighbours then. That's.. that's actually good news
RD_ALifeLine_33b1f5e3448df899: Glad to bring good news. What's it worth?
RD_ALifeLine_2df920586cf6b1d5: Intel like that is worth a lot
RD_ALifeLine_704baba07d563c2d: A tip of my own. There's a place you'll want to know about
RD_ALifeLine_4da650e6363f849c: Fine. I'll show you exactly where our people are. You're welcome there
RD_ALifeLine_2b710a9748c9daa9: Bandages, always. We've got a farm going and farming is just a long way to cut yourself
RD_ALifeLine_218abcb0372818e3: Six would last us a month. Thanks
RD_ALifeLine_2c045f374c49d5df: Someone cut their thumb this morning. Hurry, ha
RD_ALifeLine_58013b1f5fce856c: Perfect. Here, the settlement pays its debts
RD_ALifeLine_4c817c6226be9cfd: Six is a lot to find now
RD_ALifeLine_2f70183654cccccc: Tools. We've got spares from the barn
RD_ALifeLine_4858cda760ced5b2: It is. Tools and a box of shells
RD_ALifeLine_504716096ac36cea: A pack of old ones by the south road. Slow, rotten, but they don't stop. Clear them and we can plant there
RD_ALifeLine_60b58fa023e0c049: Melee's fine with these. They fall apart. Don't breathe through your mouth
RD_ALifeLine_6e3f8c560dcc16b5: Smell still drifts in at night
RD_ALifeLine_38b5bbc37939c0df: Shells. And first pick of the corn
RD_ALifeLine_755e4cd708263f0b: *Laughs* Fair. The .45, then. It's been lonely in the drawer
RD_ALifeLine_6fc756221ad6bfe3: Smoked meat, shells, some tools. Looking for coffee, smokes, medicine. Same as always
RD_ALifeLine_7501f3310e68d9d8: *Smells it* Oh. Oh that's real. Take the box, take two, no, one. One
RD_ALifeLine_49a2d5453a3d8c9b: Deal. I quit four times this year
RD_ALifeLine_16beab626e2dbd3d: Good trade. Somebody's gonna live because of that
RD_ALifeLine_3f4075276bd73836: Browsing. Like a mall. God, malls
RD_ALifeLine_41ac95df5e721034: I keep a list of the dead. Tags help. Bring me one and I'll write a name down and pay you for it
RD_ALifeLine_11e0c6bd520342aa: *Reads it quietly* Okay. I've got you now. Here, thank you
RD_ALifeLine_0e69e8e9667e1b1f: Because somebody might come looking one day. And they deserve an answer that isn't 'nobody knows'
RD_ALifeLine_0d9dc06f09ddcb70: Why are you watching me like that?
RD_ALifeLine_6643e0ff0354a65b: Because I've heard about someone who looks like you. Depends which story is true
RD_ALifeLine_7f72d4af4faa18d1: Whatever you heard, judge me by now
RD_ALifeLine_5d067c952779b4ef: One says you help. One says you take. Which one's walking up to me today?
RD_ALifeLine_1da198bb3dd4b35a: *Nods* That's fair. That's what I'd want too
RD_ALifeLine_5c87927d0613ceab: Then turn around and keep walking. I don't want to find out
RD_ALifeLine_6b7c247729ccc727: We'll see. Come back with your hands empty and we'll talk properly
RD_ALifeLine_7a34261114d16b26: I'd rather keep it in hand
RD_ALifeLine_00a80d992d3d665f: Thanks. Sorry. Last month someone smiled at our gate and then shot it up
RD_ALifeLine_312b7a0178c11e71: Then you stay out past the fence. Talk from there
RD_ALifeLine_36ea0f9c2cc41be2: *Relaxes* Okay. Come on in then, slow
RD_ALifeLine_206c394d31526239: People say you used to be a cop
RD_ALifeLine_168e2b3a42046f67: People say a lot of things. Yeah. Feels like a story about someone else
RD_ALifeLine_5c0e58fa54e2b426: Me too. Doesn't feel real anymore, does it
RD_ALifeLine_0fbb3f3e6611b481: Do you still act like one?
RD_ALifeLine_30156b4627366cdc: *Smiles* No. But when someone yells for help, my feet still move before my head does. Yours too?
RD_ALifeLine_60ef72271c8013e6: Then you know. The uniform comes off and the habits don't
RD_ALifeLine_0b058cee7d975655: I still write things down. That's about it. And I still hate liars
RD_ALifeLine_34407f173a1f0f5b: Then we're still something. Not cops. Something
RD_ALifeLine_10b7b63d25c060c3: That's okay. You did enough of it
RD_ALifeLine_446415012a26121c: You know how many people are watching from those windows? Think hard
RD_ALifeLine_00e4117b4fd3e242: Easy. You're about to make the worst choice of your life
RD_ALifeLine_17442b6612604adf: *Hands rise slowly* Fine. You just lost every friend you had in this place
RD_ALifeLine_3404fc2e2a9c4925: Smart. Go. And don't come back armed
RD_ALifeLine_7b92777f1b35bfdd: *Whistles once* Hear the safeties clicking? Walk away
RD_ALifeLine_6ba6ab716b2598ca: Fewer of them, but meaner. The weak ones died. The ones left are organised, like a business
RD_ALifeLine_04ad33b136be3eb2: Make your place cost more than it's worth. Walls, watchers, and a reputation for shooting back
RD_ALifeLine_099efb6f20e58616: Some do. Tribute, they call it. We call it robbery with a calendar
RD_ALifeLine_3680b63913ee5823: It's their kingdom. They've got the walls, the towers, and a mean streak a mile wide
RD_ALifeLine_20b89a0144f2b232: Stay away from it, got it
RD_ALifeLine_50c1a83b260e2031: With people they can't beat. Anyone else, they just take
RD_ALifeLine_2e1a5c8136858294: Good. Too many good folks walked up to that gate thinking they could talk
RD_ALifeLine_3af121475fd164bd: Disputes. People come from miles to argue over a cow or a well. I listen, I write it down, they mostly accept it
RD_ALifeLine_21dcfcd83a5274ef: Clerk. Judge was a job for someone who wasn't scared. I just keep the paper
RD_ALifeLine_1f663a9c42966a83: Because it's written down. People trust paper more than each other. Always did
RD_ALifeLine_64c4da7e297a6ffa: *Opens ledger* Go on. Names first. I'll hear both sides, I promise
RD_ALifeLine_1bde07c6725c37ad: Do you think it ever gets better?
RD_ALifeLine_1ac9a4716afb56b0: It could all fall apart tomorrow
RD_ALifeLine_7117e3951fa0bc4d: Small hope. The kind you can carry. The big kind got everyone killed
RD_ALifeLine_53bd09471c5dce32: Sure. So could yesterday. It didn't. That's how you have to count
RD_ALifeLine_0d511e052fbfa70c: If the government came back, would you go back to the job?
RD_ALifeLine_69c9c09422c5bb46: *Laughs* Which government? Whose? ..Honestly? I don't know. Maybe I'd just keep the farm
RD_ALifeLine_3278083610e0841f: You'd be good at it now
RD_ALifeLine_5c791fc100af2905: Better than before. I know what people are really like now. That's not always a compliment
RD_ALifeLine_3a7e86a3590c71f1: Yeah. Tomatoes don't lie to you
RD_ALifeLine_38278f375fe5acbb: Smart. Hands where we can see them. Why'd you come at our fence like that?
RD_ALifeLine_6827c2e777ff05b9: I didn't know it was yours
RD_ALifeLine_3da5b0531ebc5782: There's a flag. Next time, look for the flag. Go on, slow
RD_ALifeLine_0fa32f6a6956f79f: Then ask at the gate. We feed people who ask. We shoot people who sneak
RD_ALifeLine_0fdb6d5047202766: Officer has a nice ring to it
RD_ALifeLine_16102e3a70671e46: Nice to meet anyone who isn't trying to eat me
RD_ALifeLine_2e7691d221b39b80: I miss the people. The potholes I can live without
RD_ALifeLine_7481372342375b13: Yeah. Me too. Don't take it out on the ones still standing
RD_ALifeLine_6422ccfc4e19f75c: I buried six guys from my shift. Say that again, I dare you
RD_ALifeLine_7dd9281538a4a7bc: Everything. Too fast. You can't arrest a fever
RD_ALifeLine_5400a17676662956: Thanks for still doing what you do
RD_ALifeLine_394f9de5430a40a5: *Blinks* Oh. Huh. Nobody's said that in a long time
RD_ALifeLine_54217b4655684b09: *Smiles* Thank you. Seriously. That's gonna get me through the night
RD_ALifeLine_6100305c3b323842: Well. You did. Take care of yourself out there
RD_ALifeLine_0ba2b7bb1a8c6b83: Any tips for dealing with them?
RD_ALifeLine_241052f45e2b754e: Head. Always the head. And never fight in a doorway, you get swarmed from both sides
RD_ALifeLine_698543f268e7becd: What if there's a lot of them?
RD_ALifeLine_1a4e7c3443caba2b: Last resort. Every shot is a dinner bell for a mile around
RD_ALifeLine_66e941370eb0a456: Then you're not fighting, you're leaving. Fences slow them, stairs slow them, cars don't
RD_ALifeLine_23535ceb1b67ea91: Rest before you're tired. Eat before you're hungry. Tired people make dead mistakes
RD_ALifeLine_4ffbc46e1aff2bbb: Know where I can find a working car?
RD_ALifeLine_0f8f2224766bd77c: Check garages, not streets. Keys are usually in the kitchen, on a hook by the door
RD_ALifeLine_3aadbef061aa7691: *Laughs* Most are wrecked or out of gas. And the siren's a great way to die
RD_ALifeLine_391f01aa242c26be: Don't drive fast. Hitting one at speed is like hitting a deer
RD_ALifeLine_32f9e2f72020d746: You ever recognise any of them?
RD_ALifeLine_3c50a6dc19622fee: All the time. My barber. The guy from the hardware store. My old sergeant, still in his uniform
RD_ALifeLine_72aea06b5e04376e: I say their name. Then I do it. It feels like the right order
RD_ALifeLine_1e728600594bacdc: It is. You get used to it. That's the most awful part
RD_ALifeLine_7a4fbe8746cd29e9: Follow me, I know a safe spot
RD_ALifeLine_6abf0edd620c66cd: You want me to follow a stranger to a 'safe spot'? That's how bodies end up in basements
RD_ALifeLine_1457d5246012daf4: You're right, I'll tell you where instead
RD_ALifeLine_7c43bb9170f0ea34: Better. Tell me and I'll go look on my own time
RD_ALifeLine_79dea4526b056ce3: *Hesitates* ..You haven't let me down yet. Lead on. I'll be three steps back
RD_ALifeLine_1677eb66309a80da: This is my place. I need you to move on
RD_ALifeLine_33b50a4c241e7330: Your place? There's no deed office anymore
RD_ALifeLine_6a0c5f0a7f241d41: Says me. Please, I don't want trouble
RD_ALifeLine_525c79e40d6ba530: I got here first, that's how it works now
RD_ALifeLine_692c004f6f6bb977: Or we could share the watch
RD_ALifeLine_155c622117bff131: *Shrugs* Asked nicely. Alright. I'll find another roof
RD_ALifeLine_0f71218e2a73f9bc: Fair enough. That's about the only law left. I'm going
RD_ALifeLine_1ef898da1ca8ff0a: Share? ..Yeah. Okay. Two sets of eyes beats one
RD_ALifeLine_37aa9dbe67e9ee98: Have you heard of people being taken?
RD_ALifeLine_330a197f6d8ff461: Taken, held, traded. Yeah. It's the newest business around. I used to work these cases
RD_ALifeLine_1c7ad2e2186ce3d2: What do I do if I find someone held?
RD_ALifeLine_7e7a27e36683de19: Count the guards first, then the exits. Never go in when they're awake. And come get me
RD_ALifeLine_0d29700470214098: Whoever's desperate enough. Which is more people every week
RD_ALifeLine_45ae43676d29d1b8: Is anyone getting out past the cordon?
RD_ALifeLine_48041e8f4f4b80ea: I heard of a family who tried. Swam the river at night. Nobody heard what happened after
RD_ALifeLine_2eefe494184b4e6f: And leave all these idiots to themselves? Nah. Somebody's got to keep count
RD_ALifeLine_3d994a4c57aa623a: When I fall over. Usually around dawn. Night's when they move and when people get brave
RD_ALifeLine_025edce8004aec32: I could take a watch for you
RD_ALifeLine_67c59c05060a1b19: *Looks surprised* You'd do that? ..Yeah. Wake me if anything moves. Anything
RD_ALifeLine_0ed2862a5a1ff169: Burned out a while ago. I'm running on the smoke
RD_ALifeLine_7240d599669dc1fb: A letter. My sister's group is two towns over. First letter I've written since it all fell
RD_ALifeLine_728dc58e467d7c79: Don't read it. Okay, read it if you're bored, just don't tell me
RD_ALifeLine_7b8253c20f3c7e93: No rush. She's waited this long
RD_ALifeLine_6867c0b57471c77f: *Covers mouth* She's alive. She's really alive. Thank you
RD_ALifeLine_0442b6d00294135d: Meds. Good ones. You earned them twice
RD_ALifeLine_580d76eb66ae13f0: It was. Meds, and I'll tell you where our people are, you're welcome anytime
RD_ALifeLine_6c2bc9d52616a766: And I'm grateful. Meds, that's what I've got
RD_ALifeLine_0925df9266e24c6a: Hold this door for me, I'll be quick
RD_ALifeLine_0f10d3d54c954c02: How quick is quick? I've held doors for people who never came back out
RD_ALifeLine_1e560740007f4694: Never mind, I'll go another way
RD_ALifeLine_204c1e6c4d9a98e0: One Mississippi.. go. Go! I'm counting
RD_ALifeLine_36d4590d5054a2ae: Don't say that. ..Alright. But I'll wait three
RD_ALifeLine_6a95e6893fe00dbd: Smart. Never go in where you can't come out
RD_ALifeLine_15a255604f4a6602: Know any other groups around here?
RD_ALifeLine_19338e8e63d26277: A few. Some decent, some you want nowhere near you. Depends what you're after
RD_ALifeLine_2ad07e4b1463989c: Here, there's a rumour worth chasing. Go in daylight
RD_ALifeLine_67abf30b06268a2a: Anyone who wants your name before you've got theirs. And anyone blocking a road with a car
RD_ALifeLine_7e42a7ec62da1efa: That's us, smart guy. What you see is what we are
RD_ALifeLine_7bd118c06f8d2ae8: Still think I can't keep up with your team?
RD_ALifeLine_79c5487c0b2f1a3c: Haven't decided. You stack on doors like a civilian
RD_ALifeLine_6b06bb7f4014d3a8: Patrol, not tactical. Different animal. But you don't flinch. I'll give you that
RD_ALifeLine_695f15e219bca7dd: Then you know fire and movement. Good. We'll see if you know quiet
RD_ALifeLine_032282ae4f8de432: Rule one. The door is where people die. Never stop in it. Rule two, see rule one
RD_ALifeLine_0678c4bd0c3a4ae0: What the hell is going on out here?
RD_ALifeLine_3e7213ae41093245: Quarantine. Whole county's locked down, nobody in, nobody out
RD_ALifeLine_1109da91527f37c6: You didn't hear? County's sealed. Quarantine, all of it
RD_ALifeLine_6852e2033f6b8e65: The sick ones bite. Don't let them close, go for the head, nothing else works
RD_ALifeLine_18c45f351aff7563: They don't stop for bullets in the chest. Head. Only the head, got it?
RD_ALifeLine_45188cc814325de1: How long is this gonna last?
RD_ALifeLine_6782faff39263edf: Two weeks, they told us. They always say two weeks
RD_ALifeLine_0f323f344f19c585: If there's an evac, they didn't tell the guys holding the line
RD_ALifeLine_1d73a14218d0032c: I'm holding a line against the end of the world. Yeah I'm scared
RD_ALifeLine_217c69f20348ce42: Between you and me? Nobody up the chain knows shit
RD_ALifeLine_32e4dd022d8a6813: Then why are you still standing here?
RD_ALifeLine_5c579b3d30bbd1f4: Stay indoors. Board up. If you hear rotors, get high and wave like hell
RD_ALifeLine_77a737bf2aa45d2d: That's it? That's the whole plan?
RD_ALifeLine_38c2e31652b4fd50: Good. Scared people live longer. Keep it that way
RD_ALifeLine_1aa1f40d788d6eaf: Because if we leave, who's standing here? You?
RD_ALifeLine_51fad1321d99a9d4: Orders. And my mom lives ten miles behind me
RD_ALifeLine_6ee5c3c95492c109: *Laughs, not really* welcome to the Army
RD_ALifeLine_7038339a3282cc71: Can I get through the checkpoint?
RD_ALifeLine_00f2c91b5b656d98: No. Not you, not anybody. Turn around
RD_ALifeLine_68955a1e79303b01: My family's on the other side
RD_ALifeLine_43ba0fa93ed443d5: Come on, I'm not sick, look at me
RD_ALifeLine_6ab7369b56d54e56: What if I just go around?
RD_ALifeLine_2ac28d402db33d14: Everybody's family is on the other side, man
RD_ALifeLine_28b141580fa9abee: Everybody says that. Then they turn in the back of the truck
RD_ALifeLine_479a5da235131d6c: The last guy who said that bit our medic
RD_ALifeLine_7ec253212830be81: Then the guys on the tower see you. And they don't shout first
RD_ALifeLine_55b3a43373067cdb: Don't. Please. I don't want to be the one who finds you
RD_ALifeLine_5a4b300800e96e63: I'm sorry. I really am. I can't
RD_ALifeLine_28069ef84a5541e8: Can you at least get a message through?
RD_ALifeLine_3447bbd4192c4183: *Quiet* those are the orders. I'm praying nobody tests them
RD_ALifeLine_1bafed0213f625f9: Radio's for orders only.. but give me a name. If I ever get a phone line, I'll try
RD_ALifeLine_6a72275a445f8555: Hands where I can see them. Now sleeves up
RD_ALifeLine_36ccd5ed76593401: Then you won't mind showing me. Arms. Neck. Slowly
RD_ALifeLine_4da9d21a56309ca7: I'm not taking my jacket off out here
RD_ALifeLine_28ff24e829afffaf: I've got a scratch.. it's from a fence
RD_ALifeLine_67e17f731fc365c8: Who are you to tell me what to do?
RD_ALifeLine_4d8f9ecd7fa42081: Then you don't come any closer. Your choice
RD_ALifeLine_6f96830d32fbe7ce: Whoa whoa, stop, don't come near me
RD_ALifeLine_5484e97d2eb6e23b: The guy with the rifle and the orders
RD_ALifeLine_6a5b7e460b21f9ae: Specialist with a loaded weapon. That's who
RD_ALifeLine_25637a7c3f7bc95c: Sorry for that. We had a guy hide a bite under a bandage yesterday
RD_ALifeLine_607e13823a22e083: Go. Wait it out somewhere far from here. If you still feel fine in three days, come back
RD_ALifeLine_0cd495d45bf3dca5: He turned in the tent. Took two of ours with him
RD_ALifeLine_24d7f9340e5c43cd: You got any food to spare?
RD_ALifeLine_1eaf73417ec73fce: We were supposed to hand out rations at the aid station
RD_ALifeLine_349fddde643ed85d: There was an aid station. Was
RD_ALifeLine_7917819e4f811406: It got overrun on day two. Now I've got what's in my pack
RD_ALifeLine_1a03bf9910821f5a: *Sighs* here. Beans. Don't tell the sergeant
RD_ALifeLine_29177260643caef9: Talk to the guy by the truck, he trades. I just stand here and freeze
RD_ALifeLine_548a59fe5f2ec5e3: ..That's decent of you. Most people just grab
RD_ALifeLine_7daf6f6664014ee6: Huh. Thanks. Here, at least take this
RD_ALifeLine_7da1ab9d19c64344: Rumor is choppers are pulling people out of the city
RD_ALifeLine_71be4cea7e5d300a: I heard the same thing you heard. Choppers, the city, a stadium
RD_ALifeLine_7e6b2ee35b71a31c: Hell no. That's where all of THEM are. Millions of them
RD_ALifeLine_4a753d2440ec5f56: Nothing's official. Command sends one line a day, it's always 'hold'
RD_ALifeLine_76fff3fc35494d8a: Because I'm the guy who makes sure you don't follow the sick ones there
RD_ALifeLine_33861d976326562f: Stay small, stay quiet. Out here you've got a chance
RD_ALifeLine_049327ba4f182d32: ..Nobody's said that to me yet. Thanks
RD_ALifeLine_419e53587c95ccf4: Lower your rifle, I'm not a threat
RD_ALifeLine_5099dcd84ca0e1ed: Not how this works. You lower yours first
RD_ALifeLine_3889c67108c459b5: You don't tell me where to point this, civilian
RD_ALifeLine_06b77b591ff074b9: ..Fine. Muzzle's down. Don't make me regret it
RD_ALifeLine_1b1bf84f3e5f0ec4: Thank you. Okay. We can talk
RD_ALifeLine_55daf1a5472b9827: There are four rifles behind me. You really want this?
RD_ALifeLine_692f0c2576f945aa: You've got about three seconds to think real hard
RD_ALifeLine_759291ca21947091: Walk away and we both live
RD_ALifeLine_1ccd88ec22861736: *Backs off slowly* we see you again, we shoot first
RD_ALifeLine_047b9cd313900258: I served. Twelve years. Open the gate, specialist
RD_ALifeLine_10b083a554d7a1e1: With what, money? Money's paper now
RD_ALifeLine_2634d1c7250ae2f7: You think I'm selling the line? Get out of here
RD_ALifeLine_54c9580a3527f091: Look, I respect it. But my orders don't care. I can get you to the aid tent, that's it
RD_ALifeLine_7ea9193756a05068: Fine. The tent's by the trucks, tell them a vet's coming. Hands visible
RD_ALifeLine_0e459cf349bae558: Sorry, sir. Ma'am. Sarge said nobody. Nobody means you too
RD_ALifeLine_412a111c725776f4: There's a big group of them heading this way
RD_ALifeLine_4ff7219f0d5c954c: I don't know, I just ran
RD_ALifeLine_6bc525cc0e75d9a3: Okay. Okay. Thanks, get inside somewhere
RD_ALifeLine_408686e82b50e34d: Hundreds. We've got eleven guys and a truck
RD_ALifeLine_4ba353905d002ecd: Good. Running's good. Keep doing that
RD_ALifeLine_67e3702b47a3f25c: You think that's funny? People DIE because of jokes like that
RD_ALifeLine_71867999302a6761: Get away from the road. Far. I mean it, thank you, GO
RD_ALifeLine_0f9bf6a445868f5e: One of your guys got bit back there
RD_ALifeLine_5570e9081f8482eb: No. No, everybody's accounted for. Right?
RD_ALifeLine_5f86b4ae26c2128e: By the trucks. He's hiding it
RD_ALifeLine_752fb40e20f3c9aa: I don't know his name, he was young
RD_ALifeLine_0e8daeda24cf049c: Never mind, maybe I saw wrong
RD_ALifeLine_6341d4c22003ed8d: Jesus.. okay. Okay, I'll handle it. You didn't tell me anything, alright?
RD_ALifeLine_481c67af61ee3a26: They're all young. We're all young
RD_ALifeLine_5311b12f29ad55f4: *Rubs face* I'll check. Thanks for saying something
RD_ALifeLine_0ffbf32470861341: Don't do that to me, man
RD_ALifeLine_1f4d6def12fdfc2c: You look like you need something done
RD_ALifeLine_0f2317a83dd43a94: What do you want me to do?
RD_ALifeLine_1b213de706b265a7: Last check-in was here. Go look. Bring back a tag, a note, anything. I need to know
RD_ALifeLine_44815b7b3d606290: Because I've got a line to hold and nine kids who need someone yelling at them
RD_ALifeLine_228513bb1c2bdf5a: At least now I can write it down. Here, you earned this
RD_ALifeLine_73c041e744d497ed: Thanks. I'm sorry about your guys
RD_ALifeLine_7abdd0d21e508b47: That was rough out there. I need more than a box
RD_ALifeLine_2eef1d1b70a346b5: Thank you. Don't play hero. If it's bad, just come back
RD_ALifeLine_7c0b780b631f406c: Ammo. We're not rich but we're not broke yet
RD_ALifeLine_1f25cbb42fe26ccf: ..Yeah. You walked into that place for strangers. Take my sidearm, I've got the rifle
RD_ALifeLine_0fff4fc95864da0d: I lost four men today, and you're haggling? Take the box
RD_ALifeLine_50ad55eb72c412cc: You're the medic? You look wrecked
RD_ALifeLine_7fd0fea9559ad9e6: I'm out of bandages. OUT. I'm using T-shirts
RD_ALifeLine_61da67f960541b20: Corpsman, yeah. I've been wrapping wounds in socks since noon
RD_ALifeLine_217283de38deb265: Five. Five and I can keep two guys from bleeding out tonight
RD_ALifeLine_29d016f217f095b4: Here, rations. It's what I've got
RD_ALifeLine_3a4ab2a86c473d78: I risked my neck for those. Got anything better?
RD_ALifeLine_5198f9964990f287: Food. And my undying gratitude, which is worth exactly nothing
RD_ALifeLine_39b4f43877e2c407: You saved somebody tonight. Remember that
RD_ALifeLine_5a8b38a42d56407d: ..Fine. A box of rounds from the dead guy's pack. He won't need it
RD_ALifeLine_55fee4115cc173a7: Better? I've got blood on my sleeves to my elbows. Take the food
RD_ALifeLine_2d5a5e8124632690: House up the road. They keep coming out of it at night. We can't leave the line
RD_ALifeLine_0595a4b34b635a92: There's a house past the bend, full of sick. They wander onto my wire every night
RD_ALifeLine_1330ef5357530da7: Holy shit, you did it? Alone?
RD_ALifeLine_2a1dd8a601d7049f: Go in daylight. Don't be a hero. Back door's usually open
RD_ALifeLine_4a3a0ace58d2614a: Five? Ten? Whole family, maybe. I'm sorry. I'm sorry I'm asking
RD_ALifeLine_57484c6a5fab9db8: That house nearly killed me. I want more
RD_ALifeLine_42d951bc1d2a6d93: First night of sleep in a week. Thanks
RD_ALifeLine_37ecee43253cca01: Okay, okay. My spare pistol. Don't point it at me
RD_ALifeLine_6640d7c67f5834e3: That's what we've got, man. Box of rounds
RD_ALifeLine_0c2e388f7615f7ff: Not supposed to. What've you got?
RD_ALifeLine_4235c6ca3bd388e6: Three cans of food for a box of 9mm
RD_ALifeLine_5e59e68f0706e2b0: Yeah. Yeah, deal. Quick, before the LT sees
RD_ALifeLine_0b52b9043f1ade8a: Batteries! For the radio! Here, take the bandages, take these, go
RD_ALifeLine_4253f4383e357fb1: National Guard. Weekend warriors, ha. Not anymore
RD_ALifeLine_32353f4246382223: Three days ago I was fixing air conditioners. Today I'm holding a quarantine line
RD_ALifeLine_6ca5861159e22791: Last week I was a part-time student. Now look at me
RD_ALifeLine_1234915b31549dd8: Do you know what you're doing?
RD_ALifeLine_6906d6782ee0cf36: Hey. I am a real soldier
RD_ALifeLine_0b145d864259bc75: The regular Army's in the cities. We got what's left
RD_ALifeLine_422df37b27b7d1f5: *Laughs* no. Nobody does. We just look like we do
RD_ALifeLine_2942195b6c9690b3: Hold the line. Protect civilians. Shoot anything that bites. In that order
RD_ALifeLine_0f2ac6ee77a12496: Hold. That's the whole order. Hold
RD_ALifeLine_0fa8cc2918ffb96a: And if the civilians are the ones biting?
RD_ALifeLine_1e98fe4e7dccbea8: Got it. I'll stay out of your way
RD_ALifeLine_61156b500d311ae4: Then they're not civilians anymore. That's what I tell my kids so they can sleep
RD_ALifeLine_13ab35c93846a20a: Ammo for four days. Food for three. Morale for about an hour
RD_ALifeLine_1991c55717f1a80a: Appreciated. Keep your hands visible near my people
RD_ALifeLine_36c14e7a3fb7a258: You okay? You look really young
RD_ALifeLine_46bf81af658d2900: My mom cried at graduation. Said she was proud. I hope she's okay
RD_ALifeLine_052d59b331f30126: *Wipes eyes fast* yeah. Yeah, thanks. Don't tell the guys
RD_ALifeLine_46df4e7c79cc614f: If you ever pass by.. no. Forget it. Sorry
RD_ALifeLine_34612b6867ca007b: Would you really shoot me if I crossed?
RD_ALifeLine_324884c11b8e565c: I've got orders. Please don't make me find out what I'd do
RD_ALifeLine_13b8696a7264d4e0: It's the only one I've got. Walk away, please
RD_ALifeLine_6b99f5155e4e51f6: There. Approach in daylight, hands up, shout before you're close
RD_ALifeLine_46275ad75adb256a: If you're clean and you don't run at them. Probably
RD_ALifeLine_2926d3c93189aaad: Your call. Stay off the main roads
RD_ALifeLine_1de7a2834bbc3591: What's with the wire and the towers?
RD_ALifeLine_426379fa6ee5358e: Cordon. Everything on your side is quarantined
RD_ALifeLine_260bfb31583b40c5: It's the cordon. You're inside it. Sorry
RD_ALifeLine_5d1813645e6a42a8: That means you. That means me too, if I'm honest
RD_ALifeLine_50d96a7241865da9: So you're stuck in here with us?
RD_ALifeLine_1f2080eb49543c77: Other side of the wire's for the clean ones. We're the wire
RD_ALifeLine_19c8804524cad71b: When they say so. Nobody's said anything in a while
RD_ALifeLine_3f2143ea7ef7842c: People in a building far from here who never smelled one of these things
RD_ALifeLine_2ecfc3792dc313d0: Don't shoot! I just want to talk
RD_ALifeLine_353c7cbc11e46a09: Stop! That's the line, you see the paint? Don't cross it
RD_ALifeLine_22d86b9c042c14ac: Freeze! Hands up, both of them, NOW
RD_ALifeLine_255563187dae6fb1: Hands are up. I'm not crossing
RD_ALifeLine_1f95c3f952cb298f: I'm armed but I'm not pointing it at you
RD_ALifeLine_340df9a92741d102: Okay. Stay there. Talk from there
RD_ALifeLine_2a6999ed087937c9: Just wanted to see a human face
RD_ALifeLine_5449a5d46274c39d: Then sling it. Slowly. My buddy on the tower is watching your hands
RD_ALifeLine_1caf63b505a9adc4: Sick how? Bitten? Then.. I'm sorry. Nothing we have fixes that
RD_ALifeLine_682a02d633812c99: Not through here. Not this week
RD_ALifeLine_31e34a4b2bd797ed: *Throws a can over the line* that's it. Don't come back for more
RD_ALifeLine_22fc26d67f0c68c2: ..Yeah. Me too, honestly. Stay safe out there
RD_ALifeLine_4e60327a3ed15c7b: Good. Walk backwards till you're past the cars
RD_ALifeLine_1231025f0adecf05: Who are you with? You don't look like the Guard
RD_ALifeLine_685de8b45f2de223: Pretty sure you're right in front of me
RD_ALifeLine_238c91ed278f81e1: Are you here to fix this?
RD_ALifeLine_6b2af56521a0f892: *Doesn't smile* then you're seeing things. Walk
RD_ALifeLine_2639d51c7d609e24: We're here for something specific. It's not you. Nothing personal
RD_ALifeLine_3cdd02181e10c7fe: Stay off the highway at night. That's free
RD_ALifeLine_0e9e25e0628f9730: I need to get past you
RD_ALifeLine_103c930a031108fe: Turn around. That's the only time I say it
RD_ALifeLine_52fef88b014c11df: Then go around. Two hours east. Don't come back through here
RD_ALifeLine_50f1227564df0b72: *Raises the rifle a few inches* last chance
RD_ALifeLine_3445562274106a2b: Road militia. Sheriff deputized us. Sort of
RD_ALifeLine_11dcb20426c7d5c9: Official enough. Got a sheriff's say-so and a truck full of hunting rifles
RD_ALifeLine_37209eaf6991329d: What do you need from me?
RD_ALifeLine_2fbfa79f33f99899: He said 'keep the road open, I'll do the paperwork later'. Then he didn't come back
RD_ALifeLine_057b71c056a455fe: We wave at them. They wave at us. Sometimes they give us a box of rounds
RD_ALifeLine_03be4dbf50149264: Nothing. Don't loot the farms on this road and we're friends
RD_ALifeLine_6e53f2c2093fadd2: Need help keeping the road clear?
RD_ALifeLine_1e8759dc200faf10: Hell yes. Dead keep piling on the shoulder, we're stretched
RD_ALifeLine_2bd15cfa3d15e2a2: Every night more of them on the road. You any good?
RD_ALifeLine_3522790470eefd91: Saw you out there. Not bad, not bad at all
RD_ALifeLine_35e2a1e12980fe4f: There's a bunch by the marker. Quiet weapons if you can
RD_ALifeLine_16820496757c4dad: A box of shells and you eat with us tonight
RD_ALifeLine_128bc2560c0d099d: Box of shells, like I said
RD_ALifeLine_65630f825b5cf203: I did a dozen of yours. Bit more?
RD_ALifeLine_78b09e9055bacff5: Anytime you want work, come by
RD_ALifeLine_621d79fe0c219617: Ha, fair. Take a few cans too, my wife made us loot half a store
RD_ALifeLine_7f7b684c0c395522: Don't push it, friend. Box of shells
RD_ALifeLine_46c5ae1a26e06f8a: Emergency broadcast loops every hour. Stay indoors, wait for instructions
RD_ALifeLine_36d1d0c4539e8cbc: Instructions never come. I've got the whole thing memorized
RD_ALifeLine_0ca299727219ed3f: One message a day. 'Hold'. I'm starting to hate that word
RD_ALifeLine_0c548957113fec56: *Flat voice* 'Remain in your homes. Do not approach the infected. Help is on the way'
RD_ALifeLine_19aee3b631a22929: Help. Is. On. The way. Ha
RD_ALifeLine_49529bfa42122186: I'm a veteran. I can help
RD_ALifeLine_664c1c2547465212: Everybody's a veteran this week. What's your story?
RD_ALifeLine_71d8aa582c3e81d6: Two tours. I know a perimeter when I see one, and yours has a hole on the left
RD_ALifeLine_5be938db585740e1: So does every redneck in the county. No offense
RD_ALifeLine_0357a06b4f3576e4: Sarge would kill for someone who's been there. Come back when you want, you're good here
RD_ALifeLine_69ea8e9e12fb2648: I'm a cop. We're on the same side
RD_ALifeLine_474716357c4b703c: Here. County. Twelve years on patrol
RD_ALifeLine_509507b177720ef7: Okay, officer. Your people still out there?
RD_ALifeLine_15e07c797b80cf84: *Nods* yeah. You're welcome at the fire if you need it
RD_ALifeLine_439791aa072cf58a: I have medical training. Anybody hurt?
RD_ALifeLine_00631a61446d6ba7: Nurse. I can clean and stitch
RD_ALifeLine_04823f0f7e2b7a05: Oh thank god. Tent, back left. He's had a fever since yesterday and he won't stop shaking
RD_ALifeLine_5069e0d45c2c2d35: That's more than most of us. Thanks, but our corpsman's got it, for now
RD_ALifeLine_6c6048300b042b4c: Whatever you can do. Whatever. We'll owe you
RD_ALifeLine_1dde16ce18b59364: Was that helicopter one of yours?
RD_ALifeLine_65565e3a5fe3d79f: Medevac. Or the news. Or neither
RD_ALifeLine_3a15f8c34cf3cc2b: No idea. Didn't land. Never lands
RD_ALifeLine_75d74653527a77d9: And every time one goes over, the dead follow it. Watch for that
RD_ALifeLine_1c91aff4130658b8: Like dogs after a truck. Get indoors when you hear rotors
RD_ALifeLine_6161b7fa1d0b5562: Sure. Then you've got a chopper that won't land and a thousand dead looking at you
RD_ALifeLine_20515bb560277269: You're pointing a weapon at a US soldier, you know that?
RD_ALifeLine_5849f12565cf8ae2: Are you out of your mind?!
RD_ALifeLine_1dbb561065737a62: Sorry. Sorry. Panic. I'm lowering it
RD_ALifeLine_3b158025345ae6b4: *Looks at you, looks at the rifle* ..okay. Okay. Easy
RD_ALifeLine_36d108731f0255c0: Jesus.. you almost got shot. Walk. Now
RD_ALifeLine_5f498edc6464b7a3: It's down. Whatever you want, take it. I just want to go home
RD_ALifeLine_486c708c7f7bacf6: You're just letting people die out here
RD_ALifeLine_5c2245837cd96852: I turned a woman and her kid around this morning. I'll see her face till I die
RD_ALifeLine_29857d885e168116: And let what's behind her through too? I can't. I CAN'T
RD_ALifeLine_1341c601441c6914: And get shot by my own sergeant. Get out of my face
RD_ALifeLine_55176f3c5b7c50a0: Stores are cleaned out, people are fighting
RD_ALifeLine_39625fb67e4626c4: Some are boarding up, some are leaving
RD_ALifeLine_4b82d4a9564bdedb: The dead are in the streets
RD_ALifeLine_5d88df844b2880a4: Tell them to stay home. Lock doors. We'll come.. we'll try
RD_ALifeLine_0d4dc4533bce962a: The ones boarding up live. Tell the others not to come to the line
RD_ALifeLine_7de3f6d552565646: I'll trade you news for supplies
RD_ALifeLine_4de5304c0ed2d08b: That's worth something. Here, bandages, and thanks
RD_ALifeLine_7b84a0091fe08d15: If it's real, this is yours. If it's not, I remember faces
RD_ALifeLine_4eb6ad6053fad288: Radio guy calls every hour on the hour. Like a prayer. Nobody answers
RD_ALifeLine_5e609a1346d338d5: So what are you gonna do?
RD_ALifeLine_3f03398a3672e536: Yeah. Yeah, that's what we tell each other
RD_ALifeLine_57fd016831235885: Don't say that out loud here. Half these guys are hanging on by that one thread
RD_ALifeLine_7c919db4695303d7: Hold. Until someone tells us not to. Or until we can't
RD_ALifeLine_3726ca5805f6e58a: *Looks at the road behind you* ..then we walk, I guess
RD_ALifeLine_760c56422f2717ce: Took the Humvee on day nine. Said he'd bring help
RD_ALifeLine_36b75540369a2a23: The LT? Gone. Said he was driving to battalion for orders
RD_ALifeLine_4cc6695f7b818825: Took the good radio too. And the coffee
RD_ALifeLine_0ccb44f641aa65d6: Sure. And my ex is gonna call to apologize
RD_ALifeLine_1a419657564f7465: Yeah. He ran. You'd be surprised how fast officers run
RD_ALifeLine_48faebe82674d277: Sarge. Guy's been awake for three days straight. Don't ask him anything stupid
RD_ALifeLine_4be2b6144d6160fc: Home's behind that wire. And past that I don't even know if it's there
RD_ALifeLine_0761e2bd148e7ea6: Or stupid. Hard to tell the difference this week
RD_ALifeLine_210337312688d961: ..Don't. Don't offer that. I might say yes
RD_ALifeLine_5a5ddbc21dbb9333: Half rations. Then quarter. Tomorrow it's a joke
RD_ALifeLine_761f19cb6c4b2f74: We're eating the stuff we used to throw at each other in basic
RD_ALifeLine_648f66e51ad93164: Sarge says we're not thieves. Yet. Give it a week
RD_ALifeLine_2a841be3519e9f75: Hey, you're welcome here. Anytime. Tell them I said so
RD_ALifeLine_567beed80fa21c92: You ever think about just leaving?
RD_ALifeLine_6decd54534086296: *Looks over shoulder* keep your voice down
RD_ALifeLine_31766416573cf088: Every night. Two guys went yesterday. Sarge called them traitors, then cried in the truck
RD_ALifeLine_706e3b60362816e3: South. I heard the river's still open. Heard, ha. I hear a lot
RD_ALifeLine_4218163d1830d569: Maybe. Not yet. Not while the kid on the tower still looks at me like I know things
RD_ALifeLine_4f5748c16cdf303c: *Nods slowly* yeah. Yeah, someone has to
RD_ALifeLine_45e296874c9a231d: Batteries. For the radio. In case they ever call
RD_ALifeLine_0124b0aa71f49eb4: Batteries, food, sleep, hope. Batteries first
RD_ALifeLine_599ac0da51e73a58: Four batteries for a box of 9mm
RD_ALifeLine_6aa1da3b592f7216: Corpsman'll kiss you. Here, a can and a box of shells
RD_ALifeLine_548d09525b66a490: Then keep your eyes open for them
RD_ALifeLine_0eb50f9e278a248f: Set's dying. If command calls and we're dead air, that's it. We're forgotten
RD_ALifeLine_571c8d8d4d88ab73: I need batteries. If the set dies we can't even hear the static
RD_ALifeLine_680799ff25f2e2a8: *Clicks them in, the static hisses back* ..there it is. There it is
RD_ALifeLine_0934fdca2ffc1715: Six. Flashlights, smoke alarms, remotes, whatever
RD_ALifeLine_6ff0c9067acdab2e: Then let me be wrong with a working radio, okay?
RD_ALifeLine_31877fdf5944837d: Six batteries in this mess? Worth more
RD_ALifeLine_3ac1dc0c09fdd0a8: You're a saint. Ammo when you're back
RD_ALifeLine_5b5b42f00fa6b34e: If they call, you're the first one I tell
RD_ALifeLine_6a6dec586aba8b2c: ..Yeah. Okay. Take my spare sidearm. Don't make me regret it
RD_ALifeLine_4a706f733c94d6d4: It's a box or nothing, friend
RD_ALifeLine_2dfec9952381c651: Here's what I saw. Pay up
RD_ALifeLine_6c550eea53de4fba: Worth more than a box, trust me
RD_ALifeLine_763a3be104e4df04: Don't go in. Count heads, count rifles, come back
RD_ALifeLine_2ee93c16632243c9: Because they'd shoot a uniform on sight. You they might just yell at
RD_ALifeLine_3bbbef6b561475bd: Okay, you know your worth. Here, extra, and a tip on a cache
RD_ALifeLine_3907402c4897c0c0: It's what I've got. Take it
RD_ALifeLine_282a79651b5b143c: I think command is gone. For real
RD_ALifeLine_57f6e30309819d18: I found a dead convoy. Officers inside
RD_ALifeLine_721543ab4819f10f: Nobody's answering anywhere. Not just you
RD_ALifeLine_417c5b6a10da3139: I know. I know. I just.. I needed one more day of not knowing
RD_ALifeLine_23d99c941c1ab6a4: Don't tell the others. Please. Let me figure out how to say it
RD_ALifeLine_4229147e750a09e7: I saw a helicopter go down
RD_ALifeLine_6741005a72eca04a: Didn't see markings, just the fall
RD_ALifeLine_306705e3678a3256: Crews carry rifles, medkits, radios.. and the dead will be all over it by now
RD_ALifeLine_3c3a05062563c94a: *Rubs face* another one. That's how they talk to us now. They fall
RD_ALifeLine_477b2bc2285e400d: If you go, go fast. And if there's a tag on anyone.. bring it back. Please
RD_ALifeLine_6e9019f5232ea64c: Over? Who are you to tell me it's over?
RD_ALifeLine_093909711adfe9e2: It's over when command says it's over
RD_ALifeLine_6d6496aa7689d208: Command's not saying anything. Ever again
RD_ALifeLine_3092142a0da4e32d: Retired sergeant. Look at me, son. It's over
RD_ALifeLine_66b44b772ca1f27d: Then I'll stand here till they do
RD_ALifeLine_7d522d882472016c: *Long breath* ..I know. I know it is
RD_ALifeLine_409350bf104e7af1: I just don't know what I am if I'm not standing here
RD_ALifeLine_44db364a230ab072: I just want to talk, that's all
RD_ALifeLine_3debd20e14a9c6bc: Hands where I can see them. Now turn around. Slow
RD_ALifeLine_13b3c9e0129b702b: Talk from there. Hands up. Higher
RD_ALifeLine_149845a403e4ad52: My rifle stays on my back. It's slung
RD_ALifeLine_5d45fb401cda4083: Why the hell are you so jumpy?
RD_ALifeLine_15c610ab6f1322a1: Alone? Then who's that by the fence?
RD_ALifeLine_2ba446e834ece25e: Okay, there's one more. My friend. They're scared
RD_ALifeLine_399e5d3365bf881e: Keep your hands away from that strap. Good. You can talk
RD_ALifeLine_7c96dbf6689f4f46: Last 'friendly' guy pulled a pistol on our medic. So yeah. Jumpy
RD_ALifeLine_5ccb7c0e6f3f44fe: ..Yeah, it's a mailbox. I'm seeing things. Okay, talk
RD_ALifeLine_2ead88ba605b7172: Just checking who holds this road
RD_ALifeLine_4385d7b54c8c18db: Honest. Good. Tell them to stay where they are and we're fine
RD_ALifeLine_63d4ec9b52073b01: Maybe. Come back when I know your face better
RD_ALifeLine_61212ce4607bacd7: We do. For now. Remember that
RD_ALifeLine_17bfa22c220c126f: You look like you want to ask me something
RD_ALifeLine_292ffe3f140ad315: I wrote a letter. Can't leave the line to deliver it
RD_ALifeLine_0f6b68bc373f83bf: There's someone I need to.. I wrote her a letter
RD_ALifeLine_073fac6e7dac220f: Was she.. did you see anyone?
RD_ALifeLine_4a566e131b6c053e: Left it on the table. House was quiet
RD_ALifeLine_3d7df1345e9ac01e: It's there. Now about payment, that road was hell
RD_ALifeLine_177160a457e17c6e: Quiet's okay. Quiet means maybe. Thank you. I mean it
RD_ALifeLine_5de23b941df50f30: Yeah. Yeah, you're right. Take this. And thank you
RD_ALifeLine_10ff476957eb4091: *Hurt look* I don't have much. Here
RD_ALifeLine_14361d4f04902bed: *Hands it over carefully* don't read it. Okay, read it, I don't care. Just get it there
RD_ALifeLine_37c3989d6f842c5c: Half the towers are empty. The rest are kids who haven't slept since the wire went up
RD_ALifeLine_04ef65f5299edd19: What's on the other side now?
RD_ALifeLine_4f2063d9682e70d3: It's bending. We're bending. Don't push on it
RD_ALifeLine_2cfce8a25be042a0: Same as here, I think. Nobody's come to the wire from that side in four days
RD_ALifeLine_7d89bd3f290273a5: Because I'm tired of lying to people through a fence
RD_ALifeLine_12fade622c4621bb: I heard you shot people trying to cross
RD_ALifeLine_1c60eed956547607: Everyone says a lot of things
RD_ALifeLine_585649f9174c9a63: ..They were running. Some of them were sick. Some of them, we didn't know
RD_ALifeLine_6d30785802143828: I aimed high. I always aim high. I don't know about the others
RD_ALifeLine_2d1d25cd2b48beee: That's on the orders, not you
RD_ALifeLine_37e382cc22e2f7c4: Keep telling me that. Maybe one day it sticks
RD_ALifeLine_0e18d2951180bf00: I know. Get away from me
RD_ALifeLine_2a20390105e2001e: Antibiotics. Anything. I've got infections I can't name
RD_ALifeLine_4a89614400c9ac7e: Meds. I've got a guy with a cut that went green
RD_ALifeLine_6d9fda91390a68f1: Oh thank you. THANK you. He might actually make it
RD_ALifeLine_303eaa475590e90c: Just tell him to stay away from fences
RD_ALifeLine_7b70bfa2666a698e: Meds are worth more than a box now
RD_ALifeLine_35aa85ab61e3032a: Clinics, pharmacies, bathroom cabinets. Please hurry
RD_ALifeLine_3058ec0f4ddee1bd: No. A rusty fence. That's the joke, the world ends and you die of a fence
RD_ALifeLine_2be1db623a37a577: You're right, they are. Here. The LT's pistol, he left it in a drawer
RD_ALifeLine_0fc523e8519c0d73: I know what they're worth. I don't have more than this
RD_ALifeLine_0b6988597ee1d7cd: We wait. It's most of the job
RD_ALifeLine_0ddfade657cd4c3d: *Almost a smile* it won't have room for you. It barely has room for us
RD_ALifeLine_753b02780d184d08: Then we stop waiting and start walking. We're good at walking
RD_ALifeLine_4cd06bab07b6c73b: Who's in charge around here now?
RD_ALifeLine_706ba7cb00417982: Us. Whoever's got the trucks and the rifles. So us
RD_ALifeLine_34571d6b4ddd1b8b: Feels like it. Most days I'm just a guy with a deer rifle and a headache
RD_ALifeLine_56d3642e6bbed21a: Some still at their posts. Some.. took off. We picked up a couple, actually. Good shots
RD_ALifeLine_15010d056d070484: Don't steal from farms. Don't shoot first. Don't bring the dead to the road
RD_ALifeLine_194ba85434df96a7: They pile up every night. We're burning ammo we don't have
RD_ALifeLine_20bfe1534d5e8420: Yeah. Rattling the fence all night, nobody sleeps
RD_ALifeLine_6372376f39c03650: Holy hell, the fence is quiet. I forgot what quiet sounds like
RD_ALifeLine_2c8992155866d49c: Fifteen of them. That's worth more
RD_ALifeLine_6411168031daa2dc: Do it from the outside, we'll watch your back from the tower
RD_ALifeLine_22a60e6326c75eaa: Through a fence? You try it. I've done it two nights straight, my arms are dead
RD_ALifeLine_33e9c27b0a6637f7: I'm sleeping tonight. Thanks to you
RD_ALifeLine_01c8c6bf499f4f53: Yeah okay. Two boxes. Don't tell anyone how I pay
RD_ALifeLine_3c4a7b1730f2c4bc: We're rationing bullets, man. One box
RD_ALifeLine_787591ae60910133: Can you shoot? Can you follow orders?
RD_ALifeLine_19df66bf424b03c1: Join? Why would anybody want to join this?
RD_ALifeLine_5d2b172d6e42da3d: I can shoot and I don't panic
RD_ALifeLine_71bb9105702dd934: I served. I know how this goes
RD_ALifeLine_44f9881a5134589b: I just don't want to be alone
RD_ALifeLine_541ebc0b111e80ee: Good. Problem is we can't feed you. We can barely feed us
RD_ALifeLine_0c1feb4a51b8c4a1: ..Sarge would take you. But a vet's better off out there, free. Help when you can
RD_ALifeLine_258586976fcc6e76: *Softens* yeah. Me neither. Come by the fire sometimes, okay? That we can do
RD_ALifeLine_27eadbd5058d69ca: I heard rotors to the east
RD_ALifeLine_593dab7672b0bb05: Don't. Don't get my hopes up
RD_ALifeLine_6dea175065b4b6df: Low and fast means they're not looking for us. They're looking for something else
RD_ALifeLine_64900d94606211bc: Still.. thanks. It means someone's still flying
RD_ALifeLine_70e15ba804d24693: Every time I close my eyes I hear the fence rattle. Even when it's quiet
RD_ALifeLine_6a80dd7830a2bb4a: Sit down. I'll watch for a bit
RD_ALifeLine_39b1debb23f36463: You'll get yourself killed like this
RD_ALifeLine_184cdb533cade709: You'd.. do that? Ten minutes. Just ten
RD_ALifeLine_5f321c507d47520b: Probably. At least I'll finally rest
RD_ALifeLine_72ea6d3c19e3a854: Hanging. By a thread, but hanging
RD_ALifeLine_77648dc376e925d8: Can you mark it for me?
RD_ALifeLine_129490962193de25: Here. Don't walk in like you own the place. Say a checkpoint sent you
RD_ALifeLine_3da2f5a85b32d814: They were. Week like this changes people. Approach slow
RD_ALifeLine_35c170be30c0a7a0: With what? We're on quarter rations
RD_ALifeLine_75ddbe207daa6fde: Don't you dare lecture me about food
RD_ALifeLine_41cd734f4a164694: You took an oath to protect them
RD_ALifeLine_1b5622a2226cc2b2: Kids, man. There are kids there
RD_ALifeLine_5f9b204741e279d2: And they took an oath to send us supplies. Look how that went
RD_ALifeLine_2436919d40bd9caa: *Long silence* ..take this. For the kids. Not for you
RD_ALifeLine_149085752aa63d43: What's the emergency broadcast saying now?
RD_ALifeLine_23cb2dad1966e8c5: It stopped. Yesterday. Just a tone now
RD_ALifeLine_415ed40f16cff3ec: Nothing. The tape ran out or the guy running it did
RD_ALifeLine_6481991846a8171c: Funny, I hated that tape. Now I miss it
RD_ALifeLine_63c79bbf0cb7cdea: *Smiles a little* you're an optimist. Keep that. Somebody should
RD_ALifeLine_0626ed87559a73e5: How are your people holding up, sergeant?
RD_ALifeLine_4e325cb043a4526e: You want the report or the truth?
RD_ALifeLine_59b08ce66bf64924: Eleven kids look at me like I've got answers. I don't. I make them up every morning
RD_ALifeLine_0cd410101b9c9bed: Sector holding. Ammo amber. Food red. Morale.. we don't have a color for that
RD_ALifeLine_51f693fc7e17a20d: Yesterday I told them help comes Sunday. I don't even know what day Sunday is
RD_ALifeLine_7eff89f50980eb0d: You're keeping them alive. That's the answer
RD_ALifeLine_2af7729e6e5eb59e: ..Thank you. Don't make me cry in front of the squad
RD_ALifeLine_5839d92c5bfc7b38: By then I hope they're tough enough not to care
RD_ALifeLine_1600cfd91e068018: A few. Running low on everything
RD_ALifeLine_7a5da30442ec8da0: *Closes eyes* we can't go. I'm sorry. We can't leave the line
RD_ALifeLine_39d08e9872904da5: Then they're doing better than us. Good for them
RD_ALifeLine_2f29e72a1f5b13ab: With eleven guys and no fuel? I'd lose half of them on the road
RD_ALifeLine_2afe5f03144f4f80: Used to be. Now I'm just a guy in a dirty jacket
RD_ALifeLine_45545cac50b3706e: Command stopped talking. Food stopped coming. The LT ran first. We just ran second
RD_ALifeLine_7d159565244aefe1: You deserted too. Your house, your job. Everybody deserted something
RD_ALifeLine_0dd830650084824a: Good. Keep it that way and we'll get along
RD_ALifeLine_00c8f4b96cdaf8e1: Orders were shoot anybody at the wire. A grandpa came with a kid. I couldn't. So I walked
RD_ALifeLine_67fa40023ccda4a4: That's not desertion. That's being human
RD_ALifeLine_68346d090b72d3a5: I took them with me. Kid's with us. Grandpa didn't make the first week
RD_ALifeLine_4bdb37730ac2a78c: Half my squad left with me. The other half are probably dead at that fence
RD_ALifeLine_0d62b7c620915f27: Half of us left. The other half are stubborn
RD_ALifeLine_54c8e8064fd70d1c: We're not holding for command anymore. We're holding for us. This is ours now
RD_ALifeLine_3f802bcb06b78b77: Like a home. With a fence. And a lot of guns
RD_ALifeLine_1514d6eb5c13992e: Sarge's orders. Not because of rank. Because he's never been wrong yet
RD_ALifeLine_78016d2f5b6fbbe3: You were soldiers. Act like it
RD_ALifeLine_13582a9957be1746: I've got a rifle too. Let's not
RD_ALifeLine_4e29e3b545ba7def: Pleasure doing business. Road's yours till sundown
RD_ALifeLine_7b1ed7100e822695: We WERE soldiers. Soldiers get paid. Nobody's paying. So you pay
RD_ALifeLine_064d165630103b1a: ..Yeah. We're all tired. Go. Don't come back this way
RD_ALifeLine_447ff86951104573: Government property, ha. What's it worth to you?
RD_ALifeLine_495c051c0290bd6c: Ammo. Bit of gear. Depends what you've got
RD_ALifeLine_7941ce3e6bf63a98: Six cans for a box of 9mm
RD_ALifeLine_4e45c02b3368aef7: Antibiotics for a box of rounds
RD_ALifeLine_393fce4e56c511d9: Done. Count 'em if you want, I'm honest. Mostly
RD_ALifeLine_00fc503d0a4ca12e: Oh, that's good. That's real good. Here, two boxes
RD_ALifeLine_3a5ceff01560ca60: Easy rules. Break one, you're out
RD_ALifeLine_45f43cb25ddbd71f: No bites hidden. No stealing. No weapon drawn inside the fence. Ever
RD_ALifeLine_4bbb4995576512bb: Then you walk out the gate. If you're lucky, with your boots
RD_ALifeLine_5d37e360511a2f32: It is. Welcome. Hands visible anyway
RD_ALifeLine_764ac71f4f4f9edf: Every one of them is written in somebody's blood. That's who
RD_ALifeLine_3e6cdc80205f1d57: What would it take to earn your trust?
RD_ALifeLine_7e1fad546f3c4d6e: Bring me rifle rounds and I'll show you something worth your time
RD_ALifeLine_3c65f6f7543d19df: *Weighs the boxes* yeah. Yeah, that's real
RD_ALifeLine_50ea83760dd768b9: Coordinates and a little extra. Those boxes cost me
RD_ALifeLine_3408b9162eafbb1a: Two boxes of five-five-six. Gun stores, police cars, dead soldiers
RD_ALifeLine_4fbb3f667b314e18: Where there's another group holding out. Real coordinates. Not a rumor
RD_ALifeLine_58aa39cb1689a87d: There. Approach slow. They're jumpy like us
RD_ALifeLine_1b7f03c74072f0c1: Okay, you earned it. Coordinates, and a box of 9 for your trouble
RD_ALifeLine_0c757f3310ae7af6: Good hunting. Don't get shot for it
RD_ALifeLine_49a6ad6a06256a0c: You look like you lost someone
RD_ALifeLine_03eadb0264657365: One of mine walked off three nights ago. Good kid. Stupid kid
RD_ALifeLine_39a904f841caf619: My radio operator. Walked out the gate at night and never came back
RD_ALifeLine_1a5ec6271c07e457: *Takes the tag, turns it over and over*
RD_ALifeLine_020a5f18627cab35: Last seen heading for the trees by the mark. Bring back his tag. Or him, if he wants
RD_ALifeLine_25aa548e54b10042: Easy to say. I recruited him. I told his dad I'd bring him home
RD_ALifeLine_4898576d7016d878: ..Okay. At least he's not out there walking. Here
RD_ALifeLine_64b9f8835e2139d1: That took me two days. Make it worth it
RD_ALifeLine_004e8d474203dfb8: If he's alive, tell him nobody's mad. Tell him I'm not mad
RD_ALifeLine_7bf04b7110b4754e: Yeah. Thanks for bringing him back. Part of him
RD_ALifeLine_3586bf2523e246f1: *Hands over a pistol* his. He'd want it used
RD_ALifeLine_501afef2778893be: Not today, friend. Not about him
RD_ALifeLine_044929e77b5e1464: Need someone to watch your back?
RD_ALifeLine_06d7235326aab04c: Actually, yeah. Got a cache stashed nearby. Two guns are better than one
RD_ALifeLine_03090f6e4ea38b31: Need to get to a supply stash. Alone is stupid
RD_ALifeLine_3eff16ad6652721c: We made it. Your stash is safe
RD_ALifeLine_31a28dcb46e7da0a: We made it. Good. Here's your cut
RD_ALifeLine_05f2442021944302: I covered you the whole way. Bigger cut
RD_ALifeLine_5262aa1867f2d5d8: Stay on my left, watch the windows. Moving
RD_ALifeLine_7a5847da6e391d6e: Food, mostly. You get a cut
RD_ALifeLine_08bff0327120f877: Fair. You did. Take the box of rounds too
RD_ALifeLine_59191262626b3ffb: Some deserters set up on the road
RD_ALifeLine_489cdf5637436d62: Some of them looked like your unit
RD_ALifeLine_72e2b7b23383eb56: *Jaw tightens* then I know exactly who. Thanks. Stay off that road
RD_ALifeLine_705f68a35c51d50d: Tolls. Soldiers charging tolls. Jesus, what are we
RD_ALifeLine_2ba979f41dc78995: Okay today. Wait till they get hungry
RD_ALifeLine_13ed288066df59cb: You're one guy. Think about that
RD_ALifeLine_5987a2323d3c570c: Or I fire first. I've got you dead to rights
RD_ALifeLine_1d8f0d79591fb0e7: Nobody needs to die. Put it down, walk away
RD_ALifeLine_6fbb8b5f52e79e68: *Backs into the trees* ..thanks. Weird thing to say. Thanks
RD_ALifeLine_2a2392074389d40a: If command came back tomorrow, would you go?
RD_ALifeLine_06c80e460974fcd6: They left us. If they show up now, I'd want to know where the hell they were
RD_ALifeLine_0c9149c2752cc00c: And if they had a good reason?
RD_ALifeLine_77e2be89369e7e1f: There's no good reason for leaving kids at a fence with three days of food
RD_ALifeLine_5c2be08f47c15d53: I'd go. I'd hate myself, but I'd go. That's the training
RD_ALifeLine_1455ebf4152d7a36: Why do you still wear the uniform?
RD_ALifeLine_44d082016798a43f: Because I don't have anything else
RD_ALifeLine_51bc2de562e56721: And because when people see it, sometimes they still put their guns down
RD_ALifeLine_433c13b057654908: Yeah. It's a coin flip with a flag on it
RD_ALifeLine_21352aad105401c1: Plus it's got a lot of pockets
RD_ALifeLine_630824821145ddd0: We count rounds at night like money
RD_ALifeLine_5fd8cdf269279ba9: Just a few. I'm almost dry
RD_ALifeLine_0c76073607fbf434: *Sighs* here's a box. That's a meal's worth to me. Remember it
RD_ALifeLine_1bcb7a0a186587f7: Yeah, you did. Here. Two. Don't argue
RD_ALifeLine_6d941b19524535a7: Talk to me with food in your hands
RD_ALifeLine_2e923c0c02a796a5: The dead keep drifting toward our perimeter. Thin them before tonight
RD_ALifeLine_009f9d401409d5b5: Always. Kill some of them before they kill some of us
RD_ALifeLine_3abed0313d8eb013: Saw it from the tower. Clean work
RD_ALifeLine_7971a077357898ad: Twenty of them. That's worth a gun
RD_ALifeLine_2e50110e77c25aec: Twenty or so, near the mark. Don't draw the whole county
RD_ALifeLine_2a8556c96fac06b0: Here. Come back tomorrow, there'll be more. There's always more
RD_ALifeLine_150ca8d078799298: Ha. Okay. You've got a mouth on you. Take it
RD_ALifeLine_6beeabd27dbe899b: It's worth a box. Here's a box
RD_ALifeLine_2925dcc4054eeecb: Fever. Three days. It's not a bite, I checked. Twice
RD_ALifeLine_248a5537351244ff: It's not the bite. It's just a fever. Just a fever
RD_ALifeLine_4f3a90fd4380266d: *Grabs them with shaking hands* thank you. Thank you
RD_ALifeLine_7420b83d6491ac35: Meds are worth a lot. I need more than ammo
RD_ALifeLine_3e99aa6a5202e48b: Hurry. Please. He's all I've got left from the platoon
RD_ALifeLine_420604a60c42fba7: I SAID I checked! ..sorry. Sorry. I checked
RD_ALifeLine_682684f02f1e1470: If he lives, he owes you. If he dies.. I still owe you
RD_ALifeLine_1abac80508c9e3c7: Take the pistol. Take it, I don't care, just thank you
RD_ALifeLine_23526a44660cbc9c: I.. I've only got this. I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_32fa4d3b166df9b0: The wire's down on the far side. The cordon's gone
RD_ALifeLine_06bf01516b0d666c: This stretch is still standing. As long as I'm standing
RD_ALifeLine_6830288370f432d6: The point is I said I would. I don't have much else left that's mine
RD_ALifeLine_2348f9b271471ea2: Thanks. Don't tell anyone how scared I am
RD_ALifeLine_27c8240504725bac: Always. Can you shoot? Can you dig?
RD_ALifeLine_30c4f9e2422dcdc8: Then come by our post when you're ready. You'll earn your bunk. Everybody does
RD_ALifeLine_2b662c532ec0bd0a: A wall. Hot food twice a day. People who'll drag you out if you go down
RD_ALifeLine_5b990d740b43e5e9: Ask again when you mean it
RD_ALifeLine_26424e80173ddc9f: Uh huh. What was your MOS?
RD_ALifeLine_0d4f817817b75366: Infantry. Two tours. You still keep your mags dirty, specialist
RD_ALifeLine_72f5ef4c242a37c6: *Laughs* yeah, that's a real one. Sit down, vet
RD_ALifeLine_74f2ff40459967ab: The Army part. Right. Get out of here
RD_ALifeLine_629d5df97fbce512: You get it. You get what it's like when the orders stop. Most people don't
RD_ALifeLine_63f586ed73706590: You don't owe them anything now
RD_ALifeLine_2ce37abb15bf30a9: Maybe. But I owe the guys next to me
RD_ALifeLine_1b7a238e48671543: A helicopter flew over at dawn
RD_ALifeLine_38ac20ef3d6fb3b3: We waved. It didn't wave back
RD_ALifeLine_4149324e18a94e4d: They're picking up their own. Not us. Not anymore
RD_ALifeLine_16b7fb52740e350e: Because we fired flares and it turned away. You don't turn away from your own
RD_ALifeLine_328a9a6c71870bbe: Easy. Lower it. I'm not here for you
RD_ALifeLine_7735f5a16d19c3d4: Then what are you here for?
RD_ALifeLine_1709546639a71de8: Looking for supplies, same as you
RD_ALifeLine_763925d647db37da: Nobody sent me. Nobody's hunting deserters
RD_ALifeLine_7ef729ea0cb73a6b: Not here you're not. Move on
RD_ALifeLine_5287ba065827001f: We keep thinking someone's coming for us. MPs. Anybody. Nobody comes, huh
RD_ALifeLine_1e1b3b485fa53df0: The vet who fixed your perimeter
RD_ALifeLine_26cba3481151740a: I'm the one who brought your medic meds
RD_ALifeLine_7236b09b2b13e918: Honest. Good. Stay at the cones, hands up, someone'll come out
RD_ALifeLine_7e94279f4921b04c: Oh, it's you. Okay, come in. Slow anyway, habit
RD_ALifeLine_0d024f55417d0cba: *Snorts* no. Stay right there and keep your hands up, comedian
RD_ALifeLine_1b55213c323c5c44: I flipped a coin. Honest to god. Heads I go, tails I stay
RD_ALifeLine_7d4ac9314f8515b3: Heads. I stayed anyway. Turns out I just wanted to see what I'd hope for
RD_ALifeLine_1074de245fecbf90: Every day. Doesn't matter which way, I'd regret it
RD_ALifeLine_6e41d6522fce51fd: Do you sleep okay? With what you did?
RD_ALifeLine_11ae952b270b8b07: I sleep better than the guys who stayed. They're the ones dreaming about the fence
RD_ALifeLine_7632e5133f82483f: Some of them are still alive, you know
RD_ALifeLine_099f6cc4409301f4: Yeah. It's not fair. But it's true
RD_ALifeLine_26136ecb13e6ab08: ..Still? Damn. Good for them. Don't tell them you saw me
RD_ALifeLine_5dc78afc22b18013: You guys need a hand with something?
RD_ALifeLine_013ebabc5a3ad1ac: There's a house the dead won't leave. Got stuff we need inside. Clear it, we split
RD_ALifeLine_3750516464b6473c: Maybe. Got a job, if you've got the stomach
RD_ALifeLine_4d441ea33a8f680a: Huh. You're good. Here's your half
RD_ALifeLine_0f67126e0cb21e37: Half? I did all of it
RD_ALifeLine_7ffbf62644309755: Back door's jammed, go through the garage
RD_ALifeLine_2d4d98353b2680ab: Lost two guys there already. You're fresh, we're not
RD_ALifeLine_22dff1502bee4255: Come back if you want more work. We pay. Usually
RD_ALifeLine_03413cc519552218: Ha. Fine, fine. Take a box of rounds too, you earned it
RD_ALifeLine_3a32ce0b3e7860a3: Half's half, friend. Don't get greedy around armed people
RD_ALifeLine_6117e59571f7da68: Eyes on a site. You blend in. We don't
RD_ALifeLine_320b62ac6f9d1ac8: There's a place. We need a count. You're less conspicuous
RD_ALifeLine_33ae24050dc9a35c: Details cost extra. Your guys can't do this
RD_ALifeLine_1cc834481345c806: Marked. Don't get closer than you need to. Don't get seen
RD_ALifeLine_7da0c3ae4081be7d: *Almost smiles* fair. Take this. It's worth more than it looks
RD_ALifeLine_49fe18ea019fc0fa: You're not in a position to negotiate. Take the ammo
RD_ALifeLine_1b174a784a2acf9e: Why are you blocking the road?
RD_ALifeLine_1f88586c57a9d3f1: Raiders. Took a farm two miles back. We're not losing another
RD_ALifeLine_5eded3cf3de20e2f: Because last time we didn't, somebody's daughter didn't come home
RD_ALifeLine_46ace222628f2e9d: Show us your hands and your face, then yeah, go on
RD_ALifeLine_3d74934c6c596c0e: Always. Come by when you've got a day to spare
RD_ALifeLine_46a7dc6a67cd8197: Whose is it then? Yours? You gonna stand here all night?
RD_ALifeLine_215f99cf65beb0f2: Send them here. We'll make room. We always say that, but we'll actually do it
RD_ALifeLine_376d9b1a153fad23: With what? Six rifles and a truck on fumes? We'll double the watch. That's what we can do
RD_ALifeLine_10ce5be85ab1276c: Could I stay here a night?
RD_ALifeLine_1c72486654c48ef4: You've been good to us. One night. You take a watch shift like everybody
RD_ALifeLine_79e969fa30d29e01: Can't you just let me sleep?
RD_ALifeLine_79f64768002136f5: Second watch. Wake the next guy by kicking his boot, not by yelling
RD_ALifeLine_1982bd50752e8534: Nobody here just sleeps. That's how places like this die
RD_ALifeLine_5377f5ff36fab6b4: You're standing on Battalion ground, friend
RD_ALifeLine_2e491a9732eae3a4: No bites. No theft. No weapon drawn on a soldier. Curfew at dark. That's the law here
RD_ALifeLine_4a73c55a50d04dd5: Ours. Nobody else wrote one. Somebody had to
RD_ALifeLine_1021e92814aa8ecc: After dark, anything moving outside the wall gets a warning. One
RD_ALifeLine_0b0b890313ddfcfe: Good. Keep your hands where the towers can see them and you'll do fine
RD_ALifeLine_11a5c102259d6352: One can of food or ten rounds. Battalion keeps the road clear, the road pays
RD_ALifeLine_1582fa522066d1d5: Road tax. One can. Don't make a face, it's cheaper than raiders
RD_ALifeLine_592a0c1328112114: Logged. Road's yours today. Stay off the shoulder, it's mined with idiots
RD_ALifeLine_2a0ed795507fb5fc: Yeah, I know your face. Go on. Free today
RD_ALifeLine_2a50a0f171308b61: Robbery's what happens on the road we DON'T hold. Go try it
RD_ALifeLine_6d577bb65c5a4492: Why do you keep asking me to sign up?
RD_ALifeLine_707bee785c6b79e9: Because we lose people every week
RD_ALifeLine_31243e1d219313fd: Because you're alive, armed, and not stupid. That's rare
RD_ALifeLine_73f78e465c642c41: Sign up, you get a bunk, food, a wall. And a duty roster. That's the catch
RD_ALifeLine_4211f3272521d253: Then you're a civilian. Civilians pay the toll and don't get the wall
RD_ALifeLine_6a6f09bc3f4338c1: *Hesitates* ..not here. Not yet. Some posts, I hear things
RD_ALifeLine_37460a272405c78c: Later's how most people die out there
RD_ALifeLine_78542e9f598e1ee9: Do you guys still use ranks?
RD_ALifeLine_3f7ff895392cdb66: Ranks? We have the guy who knows stuff and the rest of us
RD_ALifeLine_254fa1a93c25e5d6: The Major's a Major because he says so. And he kept forty people alive through the worst
RD_ALifeLine_00ccf0f2343712e5: *Lowers voice* he was a captain in a supply unit. Don't repeat that
RD_ALifeLine_0db75ac25c5ec2f0: He did. Most days I'd follow him into a burning building
RD_ALifeLine_2cf237aa04fe8438: Tell me about it. Nails. We need nails
RD_ALifeLine_7b0e851948853ac0: The north side's held up with prayers. Bring me nails
RD_ALifeLine_3c09486e4cf00518: Your wall stands because of me. Bit more?
RD_ALifeLine_28787ae03df9ee53: Two boxes. Hardware stores, garages, sheds
RD_ALifeLine_3c18eb6d199c6975: It's everybody's wall when the horde comes
RD_ALifeLine_1e1bac862da6a2f8: Come see it when it's done. You'll be proud
RD_ALifeLine_7c339f8759ce7599: Ha, fine. Tools and a sidearm from the armory. Don't tell the Major
RD_ALifeLine_708d1eeb3fe4c5ee: The tools are already generous, friend
RD_ALifeLine_272d32314b3bc832: Good. Tools on return, I keep a spare set
RD_ALifeLine_075fbb5b03b563e8: I risked a lot. I want a weapon, not just a map
RD_ALifeLine_64bc9752181152ba: Binoculars if you have them. Don't engage. If they see you, run, don't come here
RD_ALifeLine_5a174f9b3088584e: Because they know our uniforms. They don't know you
RD_ALifeLine_33eee74437671100: Good intel. Here's where our other post is, in case you need a friend
RD_ALifeLine_1438a2a415160efb: Fair. You earned it. Map and a forty-five from the armory
RD_ALifeLine_542ad23a2906e69d: The map's the payment. Take it or don't
RD_ALifeLine_6193deed6f1f9f2a: Then stay clear of that road
RD_ALifeLine_5348fccf009d6574: They got it? Good. Here's your pay
RD_ALifeLine_5897c57f5ab8600a: That road's crawling. Pay me better
RD_ALifeLine_26e0247962e438ea: Tell them the password's still the same. They'll know
RD_ALifeLine_56cd12825f266efd: None of your business. That's why it's sealed
RD_ALifeLine_162e21b6202f6bc1: Good courier. We'll call on you again
RD_ALifeLine_1c7bbdf15bb31c86: Fine. Extra box, and you're on the trusted list
RD_ALifeLine_55ef0b9e2c18dc2a: Armory doesn't trade. I do. Quietly
RD_ALifeLine_168748a9297e4e63: Depends. Food buys a lot here
RD_ALifeLine_6ed1111d29e4b479: Eight cans for a box of rifle rounds
RD_ALifeLine_3b6fde4b444e508f: Done. Don't wave it around inside
RD_ALifeLine_2b0867e752e7be0c: Come back hungry. Or with food
RD_ALifeLine_0f5947b950456e38: I heard the real Army is still out there
RD_ALifeLine_6aa4848629a94e40: Real Army? What are we, cosplay?
RD_ALifeLine_413a55dc1fefc9f2: I mean the ones with command
RD_ALifeLine_5f96553e46aa2f70: Someone on the radio says so
RD_ALifeLine_42de63f144361a42: Sorry. Didn't mean it like that
RD_ALifeLine_40c8029d000e2d92: If they're out there, they've got reasons for not being here. I don't want to hear them
RD_ALifeLine_083f4a9a62d500c9: Everybody on the radio says something. Half of it's bait
RD_ALifeLine_717eda6164634666: If it's real.. tell me first. Okay? First
RD_ALifeLine_3d955f5e4676d952: What happens to people who break your rules?
RD_ALifeLine_46d93a8c605a7e41: We hold a hearing. Three soldiers, one civilian. Fair as we can
RD_ALifeLine_0533ffbe026bf31b: Thieves get walked out. People who hide a bite.. we don't wait for a hearing
RD_ALifeLine_3c89e3147c9d527a: We lost nine people to one hidden bite. Harsh is what keeps the rest alive
RD_ALifeLine_16ba852b0252051c: You guys made it this long?
RD_ALifeLine_37d91df567f89fd9: Six of us left the line. Three of us are here
RD_ALifeLine_17e1edf47f5b67ed: We hunt, we trade, we stay away from the Battalion. They'd hang us for walking
RD_ALifeLine_79743bd90e37e772: Ask anyone who went back. Oh wait, you can't
RD_ALifeLine_64a8bea9322793fb: *Laughs* back to what? Saluting a supply captain who calls himself Major?
RD_ALifeLine_6a8e646f015b62c7: Your pack. Your boots maybe. Depends on the size
RD_ALifeLine_735158485fe91aea: Everything you've got. Then you can walk
RD_ALifeLine_1cb74f93509686bf: Take one step and you won't make two
RD_ALifeLine_3c57588a7ff3e368: Okay, okay, here, take the food
RD_ALifeLine_246f0dc24768fc1a: Once. Then we got hungry. Bag. Now
RD_ALifeLine_00821f3734149470: *Steps back* ..easy. Easy. We're just talking. Go
RD_ALifeLine_06d1d8270202c21f: Smart. Get out of here before my buddy changes his mind
RD_ALifeLine_77a5c071249e428c: Do you still listen for helicopters?
RD_ALifeLine_31cd81c3711c8c50: *Glances at the sky without meaning to*
RD_ALifeLine_4b9ca38121c9a2dd: Most of us stopped. I can't. I hear rotors in the wind, in the generator, in my head
RD_ALifeLine_2e9c5fe35792de6b: I know. It didn't land. They never land. But it flew, so somebody's flying
RD_ALifeLine_59e9208831097176: If I stop listening I stop being a soldier. I'm not ready for that
RD_ALifeLine_6932e73327b33ee6: My dog. Ha, not my family, my dog. What does that say about me
RD_ALifeLine_6e9af26e6b27a652: *Smiles* yeah. She was a good girl. Hope someone let her out
RD_ALifeLine_601b9f45365a978f: Oh, don't. Don't say that out loud. You'll start a riot
RD_ALifeLine_7333ed563a40a08c: God yes. Remember being bored? On a couch?
RD_ALifeLine_51f5560a2cb607a2: I'm friendly, I want to come in
RD_ALifeLine_13d55c993f79b8b5: Hands where I can see them. Higher. Turn. Slow
RD_ALifeLine_55aa2ede59d3f4fe: Everybody's friendly at the gate. Hands up
RD_ALifeLine_7019a1dd67dde1e7: Hands up. I'm alone and I'm clean
RD_ALifeLine_77eea0d34a0765dd: Okay. Tower's watching you. Walk to the cones and kneel
RD_ALifeLine_278638df03150fc8: Keep it slung. You touch that strap inside, you're out. Or worse
RD_ALifeLine_375683c10718ef93: *Squints* oh. The vet. Okay, come on, but hands visible anyway, it's the rule
RD_ALifeLine_51d959a573e4a431: Last month a 'friendly' walked in with four friends in the trees. We buried six
RD_ALifeLine_59668ce7699b7d17: Arms. Neck. Okay.. you're clean. Welcome to the wall. Behave
RD_ALifeLine_688429c36a30cabb: You know how many rifles are watching you right now?
RD_ALifeLine_386bd4491f98be17: On Battalion ground? You're out of your mind
RD_ALifeLine_7a57bd8a4b385229: *Looks at the tower, looks at you* ..fine. FINE. It's down
RD_ALifeLine_055cab2b6731d29b: Smartest thing you've done today. Now leave
RD_ALifeLine_081d8be149a793cb: You just made a lot of enemies, friend. Walk away while you still can
RD_ALifeLine_27195bf9598092ba: Six beds, two pills, one exhausted medic. Me
RD_ALifeLine_14208452798acb55: Bad. I'm boiling bandages twice now
RD_ALifeLine_1b89fb00202ec42d: *Holds the bottle like gold* you have no idea
RD_ALifeLine_09b58f4c363ce467: I need some for myself too. Trade me back meds
RD_ALifeLine_211c961a04791a30: Anything. Antibiotics, painkillers, even vitamins. Go
RD_ALifeLine_6510aabe1a73a4ec: You just saved someone. Come get patched free, anytime
RD_ALifeLine_34ffed075aa2053d: Fair. Here's a kit. Bandages, wipes. And thanks
RD_ALifeLine_4eb57a8b5cee9750: I can't give back what I just begged for. Take the rounds
RD_ALifeLine_4a6bea0b6d2d99cc: Your sentry's sleeping with his weapon on safe and his back to the gap
RD_ALifeLine_462006f3087b7134: *Turns, sees it* ..son of a. Hey! HEY, wake up!
RD_ALifeLine_1bcf12e0444b8e32: Words are cheap at the end of the world
RD_ALifeLine_7df97b0a129d2245: Okay. Major would give you stripes on the spot. You'd want them?
RD_ALifeLine_689d5e4e5cdafe3c: No. I work alone. But I'll help
RD_ALifeLine_79ef5aae1963aae6: I'll tell him. He'll like that
RD_ALifeLine_1f82487f19eb3273: Where can I find more of your people?
RD_ALifeLine_0e9a4c887e1c7105: Done. Come in daylight, shout your name. Your name's on the list now
RD_ALifeLine_2d46c9d314d99c29: *Hesitates* ..you've earned it. Here. Don't bring trouble there
RD_ALifeLine_6d48d2fd3e5b452b: Food? Always. What do you want?
RD_ALifeLine_527e7b7d67305387: Food's the only real money left. What do you need
RD_ALifeLine_1e3af1bc329233e1: Four cans for a box of 9mm
RD_ALifeLine_71f935f078e9f90a: Four cans for bandages and pills
RD_ALifeLine_581bf6337768b6f6: Are you still on a mission?
RD_ALifeLine_7e2a49cf7de7c913: Original tasking expired a month ago
RD_ALifeLine_1d59aa31376f4f6f: We had a target. A package. A person. Doesn't matter now
RD_ALifeLine_2c37c2a1119dfa66: *Long silence* we found it. Too late
RD_ALifeLine_0ef8ec8878bfd12e: Now we keep the four of us breathing. Same as you
RD_ALifeLine_510d842b7b9a159d: They hold the big roads, we hold the farm roads. They take a cut of the harvest
RD_ALifeLine_195a493c6394f03d: Fair as anything is. Their rifles kept the bikers off us twice
RD_ALifeLine_1780170a5b194398: *Laughs* yeah. Turns out the apocalypse has taxes too
RD_ALifeLine_5af276c418986130: Let those people go. They're not prisoners
RD_ALifeLine_1700f2ed3f6fe35f: They're labor detail. They broke the rules
RD_ALifeLine_3e34d80878051f28: They stole from the stores. They work it off
RD_ALifeLine_09b14f1d478f8133: Two weeks. Then they're free to leave. Or stay. Most stay
RD_ALifeLine_01829fd8508f5e13: *Flinches* ..it's not. It's not. It's two weeks and three meals. Watch your mouth
RD_ALifeLine_23a3f7672941d31c: ..For strangers? Okay. Okay, they're yours. Get them out before the Major sees
RD_ALifeLine_2c052a365ee497ce: Need some of them thinned out?
RD_ALifeLine_0e7d41aa370244b4: A pack's been circling the fields. Thin them before they find the wall
RD_ALifeLine_2be02c73447ea1b0: Yes. Twenty-ish near the mark. Quietly
RD_ALifeLine_1c36a6326c6392e0: The fields are quiet. Good work
RD_ALifeLine_5e38a35f6f6661ef: Twenty of them alone. I want a gun
RD_ALifeLine_7893c59774b86937: Pull them away from the wall first. Then go to work
RD_ALifeLine_29fe091a5797bca6: You're right, you earned it. Armory's spare
RD_ALifeLine_14a7b12230dee094: *Grabs the radio* all posts, all posts, horde inbound, double the wall!
RD_ALifeLine_3b57c1bd506dd8ab: Good. Thank god. Thanks for running here to say it
RD_ALifeLine_0401befa0d47b8f2: We should. Thanks. That's what friends do now
RD_ALifeLine_46dc280e2f87fbad: Which one? There's one every week
RD_ALifeLine_6d5c399e01e49b2e: We heard the gunfire. All night
RD_ALifeLine_3bc0f01b22bb639c: Yeah. We sent a truck in the morning. Too late. Always too late
RD_ALifeLine_4aea9b476f08e96d: We answer it by not being next. Walls up, rifles up. That's the answer now
RD_ALifeLine_522489ce19f12223: The Colonel's road. The Colonel's toll
RD_ALifeLine_70908e162ec37983: This road belongs to the Colonel. You pay or you kneel
RD_ALifeLine_41efe55830b37c16: Who the hell is the Colonel?
RD_ALifeLine_407c47281c8cd84c: *Doesn't blink* everyone kneels. It's quicker than arguing
RD_ALifeLine_10606bbb78cb7f74: A man who kept sixty soldiers alive when command forgot them. You'd kneel too
RD_ALifeLine_69b7d64619dcb756: Then turn back. The trees have eyes, remember that
RD_ALifeLine_73b4932069073d94: *Points up the hill* him. The Colonel
RD_ALifeLine_27cc5578391c1012: Self-promoted. Don't say that near him. He gets ideas about loyalty
RD_ALifeLine_69c7c1852ed1ddef: You don't sound like a fan
RD_ALifeLine_001f46ab14399347: Is he good to his people?
RD_ALifeLine_1c06807d30752d9a: *Quiet* I eat every day. I'm a fan of eating
RD_ALifeLine_6d7271242a46f6bc: To the ones who kneel. Ask the ones who didn't. Oh wait
RD_ALifeLine_211aa1540aad7862: Army? Huh. I forgot that word for a while
RD_ALifeLine_5173bf0f6b60c45f: There's me. A rifle. A patch I can't bring myself to cut off
RD_ALifeLine_50236ee92718f716: You could be part of something again
RD_ALifeLine_38307cf575043c18: Because one day somebody might ask what I was. I want to remember
RD_ALifeLine_335853bf1a3741d6: Been part of something. It fell apart. People do that
RD_ALifeLine_2630dbbf04031b9a: Me and the crows. Crows don't ask questions. You do
RD_ALifeLine_64f5e9802b36717b: Last person I lived with was my squad. Last person I buried was my squad
RD_ALifeLine_282ac5452f7db348: Don't be. It was a long time ago. Two months, ha. A long time
RD_ALifeLine_70cc52c70c0241be: ..Maybe. If you bring coffee. Nobody has coffee
RD_ALifeLine_1d92464040291bf7: How do I get on the Colonel's good side?
RD_ALifeLine_6df53538692f38f4: Tribute. Food. The Colonel feeds sixty mouths
RD_ALifeLine_4625fb0754bee534: Bring food. Lots of it. Then he remembers your name
RD_ALifeLine_0d0173ab6b61d2d8: *Counts, nods* the Colonel's pleased. Here's your due
RD_ALifeLine_00a956995670a606: Ten cans is a fortune now. I want a real gun
RD_ALifeLine_409734212198a7e1: Ten cans. And don't bring dented ones, he notices
RD_ALifeLine_3ec04219426aa9e9: Then the road stays closed to you
RD_ALifeLine_2a04f9f63c0d76c2: Your name's on the list. The road's open to you
RD_ALifeLine_48e8d0c736bc600e: ..You've got guts asking. He likes guts. Here, a forty-five
RD_ALifeLine_117f5c3e7f5826ff: You don't haggle with the Colonel. Take the box and be grateful
RD_ALifeLine_102a683e411f5dfc: Good. Loyal people eat. That's the deal
RD_ALifeLine_4b38f12714f79f93: Every day. Want to help? There's a nest near the mark
RD_ALifeLine_24100570713c09e5: Somebody has to. Bunch of them by the mark. You in?
RD_ALifeLine_1ab80cd75a277a5a: Heh. You're better than half the soldiers I knew
RD_ALifeLine_7c7cbe3f4e66ab52: I'll take that and the ammo
RD_ALifeLine_439a79cc35cbd1d3: Better than your soldiers? Pay me like one
RD_ALifeLine_28c2d851720c2531: Go loud and you'll get the whole county. Go quiet
RD_ALifeLine_0d9438b515a87345: Ha, fine. My old sidearm. It's seen worse
RD_ALifeLine_6b2aecc27a4e60cb: Soldiers got paid in boxes too
RD_ALifeLine_073442f02d4e941e: You're looking for someone, aren't you?
RD_ALifeLine_314e0c245b816baa: My brother. He was at the cordon. I was at the bridge. We never found each other
RD_ALifeLine_13893a351816b400: My brother. Same unit, different post. Two months of nothing
RD_ALifeLine_06004de94ed3dbb2: Two months.. you know what that means
RD_ALifeLine_432ca58d10e25c51: *Takes it, sits down on the ground*
RD_ALifeLine_0a30424f5e4ca044: His post was by the mark. His tag, his lighter, silver, he never put it down. Anything
RD_ALifeLine_36735e420dbab2f2: I know what it means. I want to KNOW it. There's a difference
RD_ALifeLine_7f5a5dad4523b3f9: Thank you. I can stop looking now. Here, take this
RD_ALifeLine_7a0ac32e147cfcd3: That was dangerous ground. I need more
RD_ALifeLine_26f251d235f12302: Thank you. Whatever you find. Whatever
RD_ALifeLine_561fdf174c5872cb: Me too. Me too. Come back sometime, okay? I don't want to be alone tonight
RD_ALifeLine_1fafa4ad2de1887b: *Hands over a pistol without looking* his spare. He'd want you to have it
RD_ALifeLine_17efc1bc585a46ab: Not now. Please. Just take the box
RD_ALifeLine_5b0d9cff7432ad7f: You still have military gear to trade?
RD_ALifeLine_4fe1fa444ff1bce2: What's left of it. What's it worth to you
RD_ALifeLine_140c94d47bb01426: Antibiotics for two boxes of rifle rounds
RD_ALifeLine_460c23b030dac4bb: Ten cans for a forty-five and a box
RD_ALifeLine_49f6aa3e31588f2a: Done. You know what you're doing
RD_ALifeLine_332a619c16340bf4: Ten cans? ..yeah. Deal. Clean it, it's been in a ditch
RD_ALifeLine_6dd907e42601d889: Stand down. You're not soldiers anymore
RD_ALifeLine_4154d7ff6f135dac: Then what are we? Tell me. Go on
RD_ALifeLine_6ad626dc391926fd: You're men with guns, robbing people
RD_ALifeLine_6a69bf22046338e6: You're survivors. Like me. That's enough
RD_ALifeLine_6e7062561427c8fe: And you're a civilian with a mouth. Walk. Before I forget I used to protect you people
