RD_ALifeLine_598aa74d5a120dc0: *Lowers the rifle slightly* ..survivors. Huh. Haven't heard it put like that
RD_ALifeLine_0f8d507f2912272f: I walked past the old cordon. The wire's all rust
RD_ALifeLine_16d975cf2a2c9095: I stood on that wire for nineteen days. Funny it rusted faster than I did
RD_ALifeLine_0f00722408280aef: It did its job, for a while
RD_ALifeLine_5923238e6f372c81: I miss knowing what I was supposed to do. Not the wire
RD_ALifeLine_17840a550dddd5ba: Did it? I never figured out who it was keeping safe
RD_ALifeLine_3e7784077121835b: How did it end? The cordon?
RD_ALifeLine_59a2c8a972d45b66: Not with a bang. With a radio that stopped
RD_ALifeLine_4b80b6a435c41a30: One morning the relief didn't come. Then the food. Then one night the dead came through
RD_ALifeLine_6950d82e0648c914: And nobody shot. We just watched. Too tired. Then we walked
RD_ALifeLine_667dfecf5e42f8c7: Maybe. Maybe not. Thanks for saying it
RD_ALifeLine_41eedd3f1e341300: Wherever the road went. Here, eventually
RD_ALifeLine_27a5f3f24cf30b82: Once in a while. Way up
RD_ALifeLine_5d9bb44835146c20: Somebody out there still has fuel and a pilot. Means somebody still has a plan
RD_ALifeLine_71127a2328396d84: Or they're just looting from the air
RD_ALifeLine_63fb100e6d5361cf: Hope's a strong word. It gives me something to look at
RD_ALifeLine_02c2ae632e9f95cb: Done. Tell them the ghost sent you. They'll laugh. That's the password
RD_ALifeLine_2418b6c019b90a5a: I don't play well with walls anymore
RD_ALifeLine_2f87f6123855604d: I was a soldier too. Before all this
RD_ALifeLine_56dec1990c763e90: Yeah? Doesn't count for much anymore
RD_ALifeLine_1b1d14534dcd9b92: Old habits. I still check corners
RD_ALifeLine_759bb2631c4906a1: *Looks at your stance* ..yeah, you do. Real one
RD_ALifeLine_757babef0de3c86e: Sit. Nobody talks the same language anymore. It's nice to hear it
RD_ALifeLine_0fd319eb28e2747d: *Stares* you think I'm scared of dying?
RD_ALifeLine_464a064b520ef895: Go ahead. I've been dead for weeks
RD_ALifeLine_5ea0292a4fb3c697: I don't want to kill you. Put it down
RD_ALifeLine_6ced7c101232cdec: Because I'm tired of it too
RD_ALifeLine_59d16b6e0346eaf4: *Lowers it slowly* fine. Fine. Do what you came to do
RD_ALifeLine_615092cd4a57eee7: Old wound. Opened again. Infected, I think
RD_ALifeLine_19c2160038e58c91: It's nothing. It's.. it's getting hot. That's bad, right?
RD_ALifeLine_49ceef7e1d3946dd: You came back. People don't come back
RD_ALifeLine_638420ab649895ea: Meds are rare now. What else you got?
RD_ALifeLine_379aff033966b2c3: Okay. I'll be here. Not like I'm running anywhere
RD_ALifeLine_1613ba8c3c387b84: *Rolls up the trouser* ..don't make that face
RD_ALifeLine_27e2133120190d03: Owe you my leg. Maybe my life. I'll remember
RD_ALifeLine_4c2b1cdd3889036b: Take my pistol. I can't run anyway, you can
RD_ALifeLine_25884a20596a3a8f: I'm a cripple with a box of rounds. Take the box
RD_ALifeLine_59598b1c2a6c1cfb: Why keep the flag patch on?
RD_ALifeLine_3f1e9609149f4e1a: Some days it gets me shot. Some days, fed. Most days it reminds me I swore something
RD_ALifeLine_774c92b23bd20fa3: To protect people. I've been bad at it. I'm still trying
RD_ALifeLine_56d358c77c728541: Means something to me. That's all it ever had to do
RD_ALifeLine_0cad8223728ada49: What's your name? Your real one
RD_ALifeLine_4e6cdc905f00a62f: Doesn't matter. Everyone who used it is gone
RD_ALifeLine_70bd25e340411349: Being a ghost keeps the raiders scared and the warlords polite
RD_ALifeLine_6b5319a25e38a895: *Pause* running out of reasons to keep going. That one
RD_ALifeLine_722ec8af59f5f2ff: Everything's an act now. Ours just works better
RD_ALifeLine_150ff33361f690fa: Farmers eat because we patrol. We eat because they farm. Simple
RD_ALifeLine_735555f46ecb2ca0: And if a farmer says no?
RD_ALifeLine_2111718623ac3637: *Shifts the rifle* nobody says no. Nobody's needed to
RD_ALifeLine_643f6ad5638f1d22: Don't know, I didn't stick around
RD_ALifeLine_0c7d82804cd34a38: Three trucks.. that's a real raid. Thanks. We'll be ready. Or we'll be gone
RD_ALifeLine_604c98c260f9b5e0: Smart. Thanks for the heads up
RD_ALifeLine_5a9bf1a1139629cf: They got it? Good. Good people
RD_ALifeLine_753cee6f7597a8ae: Don't open it. Don't keep it. I'll know
RD_ALifeLine_508c4b92209792b8: Because one day they'll give it back. That's how this works now. Or it should
RD_ALifeLine_622afaba5a48af85: Fine, fine. A box for you too
RD_ALifeLine_2d610536376a5e4a: Hands where I can see them!
RD_ALifeLine_30a6355570aff049: Stop! Hands! Show me your HANDS
RD_ALifeLine_65417842321638d4: Keep them there. Now walk. Slow. Stop at the car
RD_ALifeLine_204c7df2310f3bab: Slow.. slower. Okay. Hands away from it. Walk to the car
RD_ALifeLine_4896685264d8216f: Everybody's alone till their friends open up from the trees
RD_ALifeLine_43554f91533d0b94: Then you won't mind if my guy checks the tree line
RD_ALifeLine_22788984320b9f96: You're standing in front of four rifles. You don't get to say 'you first'
RD_ALifeLine_716bb8b40baa9a99: Walk backwards. Don't turn your back on the line till you're past the bend
RD_ALifeLine_292483c92d02799e: *Lowers the rifle an inch* okay. You talk like a person, not a trap. Good
RD_ALifeLine_3bbea07311de1838: Because people who rehearse answers are the ones who shoot. Answer it
RD_ALifeLine_68e83216054ef01a: Couple more steps. That's good. That's close enough to talk, not to touch
RD_ALifeLine_06ff62e81a251e60: I'm not putting my gun down
RD_ALifeLine_4183c76c79cadf86: Then you don't get closer. Simple
RD_ALifeLine_59f4d2975bc709a7: I'll keep it pointed at the ground
RD_ALifeLine_3c89133a222131c2: Your people put theirs down first
RD_ALifeLine_706239463bd83ded: Ground. Finger off the trigger. I'm watching that finger
RD_ALifeLine_4f211d4012d399d2: *Laughs, no humor* we're the ones holding the road. Not happening
RD_ALifeLine_1aa7878b305dab46: Thank you. Now we can be people
RD_ALifeLine_6d1785647fa62d95: Backwards. Slowly. Don't make anyone nervous
RD_ALifeLine_03146ade00292a04: On your knees! Hands on your head!
RD_ALifeLine_5a4c1fcf1ba60f44: Please, I've got nothing worth taking
RD_ALifeLine_2eb41ede75dce22b: *Pats you down roughly* ..okay. You're nothing. Get up. Get out of here
RD_ALifeLine_20a49a766ae33c1d: Everybody's got something. Fine. Keep your rags. Go
RD_ALifeLine_36e45fef37e0dc55: Then stand there like an idiot and walk backwards. Now
RD_ALifeLine_510c2c9d3908a1ce: And don't come back this way. Next guy won't be in a good mood
RD_ALifeLine_5a35d7db6acbb4e7: You've got a shaking muzzle and no cover. I've got a man on your left. Walk away
RD_ALifeLine_18d04fbe693a8e1a: Good call. Don't make it twice
RD_ALifeLine_21f533c75a364dd4: Were you hit in the raid?
RD_ALifeLine_3e50494a4ed22311: *Wipes hands on a rag, it doesn't help*
RD_ALifeLine_3b8501a267d18ae1: They came at night. Two trucks, maybe more. We held the wall, lost the storehouse
RD_ALifeLine_0901752c46a6a0a3: Three. One won't see morning. Don't ask me his name, I can't say it right now
RD_ALifeLine_48a3f5e04e7ec841: Bring nails, food, bandages. Anything. You'll be remembered
RD_ALifeLine_49335d8d133b97de: Didn't stop to introduce themselves. Painted trucks, loud music, laughing. Laughing
RD_ALifeLine_1063d9ff255869bd: Raiders are coming for your post
RD_ALifeLine_1e19d8a65e0f34b4: Heard them talking on the road. Tonight
RD_ALifeLine_0a9cd6b567160d2a: They've been watching you for days
RD_ALifeLine_488c23d513ea7fc3: *Shouts over shoulder* double the wall, everybody up! ..thank you. If we live, we owe you
RD_ALifeLine_07f4900f06892c0a: I knew it. I KNEW those were scopes. Thanks
RD_ALifeLine_155cd45f471a161b: That Black Hawk flying around. Whose is it?
RD_ALifeLine_439e4a6217219183: *Squints at the sky* not anybody's I know
RD_ALifeLine_415e16bd5c78ca6e: Ours stopped flying when the fuel stopped. Somebody out there still has both
RD_ALifeLine_64ad317d330c5786: And tell everybody with a rifle where you are? Your call. I wouldn't
RD_ALifeLine_3d1a63b0768a7011: For somebody. Maybe. Never for the ones who want it most
RD_ALifeLine_575a110d04be168d: If it's hovering over you, it's hostile. Get under a roof
RD_ALifeLine_60b66c965084b0de: How do I get a helicopter's attention?
RD_ALifeLine_3c12296b52d07614: Roof. Smoke. Something bright. And pray
RD_ALifeLine_7252052a2288b272: Get high, get visible, get lucky
RD_ALifeLine_48a270504da6ce46: But the dead hear rotors from miles. They'll come for the noise, every one of them
RD_ALifeLine_3a44999d659124c0: It's a coin flip. One side's rescue, other side's a roof surrounded by teeth
RD_ALifeLine_441eb4175ca3d326: Then pick a roof with a ladder you can kick away. Trust me
RD_ALifeLine_6760820e0190e807: Someone on the radio is looking for a survivor. Is it real?
RD_ALifeLine_7d607d620dc7a497: The open channel? You heard it too?
RD_ALifeLine_203b54a763e1f490: Could be real. Could be bait. Everybody with a radio hears that band
RD_ALifeLine_76bee06230192547: Me? I'd go. And I'd hate myself for hoping. Save first, if you get what I mean
RD_ALifeLine_0a6050637422c5e2: To find out who's alive and where. Raiders love a rescue story
RD_ALifeLine_4b68c9717e6f5d2b: Then they want someone specific. If it's you, it's you. If not, watch what you say
RD_ALifeLine_50b9672662801ce8: There's a guy in heavy armor out there. Bullets don't stop him
RD_ALifeLine_0677fe935fd7be2d: Big plates, helmet, walks like a truck? Yeah. Juggernaut
RD_ALifeLine_1717a7425dd2b9d4: We lost two guys trying to drop one. Rounds just spark off him
RD_ALifeLine_566bc0cc425e9d58: Don't. Go around. If you have to.. legs, joints, and a lot of ammo. Or a car
RD_ALifeLine_626344011c39f952: Whoever's paying in food that week
RD_ALifeLine_496d89cc49536a0c: *Grabs the radio* everybody pull back from the gate! Thanks, friend. Get gone
RD_ALifeLine_04f8090055a64514: Ever fought one of the armored ones?
RD_ALifeLine_2c3dbdea609ccdf6: *Rubs the scar on his arm* once was enough
RD_ALifeLine_2a763b30258c87f2: Emptied two mags into him. He kept walking. Like the dead, but smarter. And angrier
RD_ALifeLine_627bc42749354d4a: Make him run. That armor's heavy. Tired men miss, and tired men fall
RD_ALifeLine_7dc665bb0d38a428: *Snaps a salute out of reflex* ..oh. Ha. Morning, sergeant
RD_ALifeLine_7c7cccd577904226: Don't salute me, I'm a civilian
RD_ALifeLine_5656053578a4c3b0: Holding. Better since you pointed out that gap. Guys still talk about it
RD_ALifeLine_30fa30b30f11bebb: Uh huh. You walk like a sergeant. Can't unsee it
RD_ALifeLine_79c51ec46c0bcbb8: I'm ex-military, I can be trusted
RD_ALifeLine_4fb2bc8e19cca6eb: Yeah? What's the first thing you do when you take a new position?
RD_ALifeLine_03499f00316bb484: Quick question then. What do you call it when you check your gear before moving?
RD_ALifeLine_4db6bbb702d56c12: Security first. Then I check my gear
RD_ALifeLine_7ad73d6e55ff3ba6: *Nods slowly* yeah. You're real. Good to meet you
RD_ALifeLine_0062b56a07254f7e: *Laughs* set up camp. Okay, scout. Nice try
RD_ALifeLine_0e641fcf76a7562b: I'm a firefighter. If you need hands, I've got them
RD_ALifeLine_7f925e357fbda14d: Huh. You don't see many of you anymore
RD_ALifeLine_5324044d39f9d585: We had a fire in the barracks last week, burned half our blankets. Could've used you
RD_ALifeLine_4875a52d425d1b7a: Close enough doesn't put fires out
RD_ALifeLine_624c32113ab8a298: Come by anytime. Anybody who runs toward trouble is welcome at our fire. Ha, fire
RD_ALifeLine_0986b9c3565638ea: Water's the one thing we've still got. Barely
RD_ALifeLine_3a17a7d65249f71e: Here. Drink. Don't take the canteen, it's my only one
RD_ALifeLine_5b9cf331782d09ea: It's water. Don't make it weird. ..you're welcome
RD_ALifeLine_5beeab9200c94e10: Rain barrels. Boil it twice. Never trust a river now, the dead float in them
RD_ALifeLine_093cd364790761ea: It's.. I don't know what it is
RD_ALifeLine_40ae6d655d70a3ae: *Checks it* yeah, that's glass. Here, wrap it tight, keep it dry
RD_ALifeLine_6255743c6063b349: *Steps back* then I don't know either. Here, one, and please go
RD_ALifeLine_0fb96bfb39c863b7: There's a kid with my group. Anything to eat?
RD_ALifeLine_69c9a0831e790f1d: ..Here. Two cans. For the kid. If I find out it's for you, I'll be real disappointed
RD_ALifeLine_74dad2e1126e90b7: It's for the kid. I promise
RD_ALifeLine_7229f88410e768bc: Good. Keep them alive. That's the whole job now
RD_ALifeLine_609e50a26c440d27: Had. Have. I don't know which word to use
RD_ALifeLine_6b1f10165940e023: Huh. Most people want to get away from us
RD_ALifeLine_38d0de1a67554ce5: *Smiles* okay. Here's where I patrol. Shout before you come close
RD_ALifeLine_243b64c66775091c: Fair. Here. No promises we'll come running, but we'll listen
RD_ALifeLine_4080b50267c14522: You've been straight with us. Okay. Bring anyone, ANYONE, and we move. You'd never find us
RD_ALifeLine_7e256db01589e2e5: Keep it. I don't need to know
RD_ALifeLine_26ce101459ff2810: Marked. Knock twice on the gate, wait, knock once. That's us
RD_ALifeLine_344b279c5f336ee1: ..That's actually the most trustworthy thing anyone's said to me
RD_ALifeLine_2c30ef1847f50836: Come with me. I could use a soldier
RD_ALifeLine_576a4ac329e78d0a: Can't. I've got people counting on me here
RD_ALifeLine_3f03eeac243e53b5: Your post is a dead end
RD_ALifeLine_0f0e85e95b2ba358: It's MY dead end. Those guys behind me are all I've got
RD_ALifeLine_533d8e2811dde1c0: Ask again in a month. If I'm still here, maybe the answer's different
RD_ALifeLine_574c6cb80c042acb: *Raises hands* okay. Okay. Just passing through. Leaving
RD_ALifeLine_189987957aa7584b: Maybe. Later. I'll knock next time, promise
RD_ALifeLine_037862222735a69b: There's a pack of them in the trees behind you
RD_ALifeLine_5c67ca5f0954b584: Thanks. Okay. Fall back to the truck, quiet. You too, come on
RD_ALifeLine_70ee30bb40ec4c7b: Jesus Christ, man. Not funny. NOT funny
RD_ALifeLine_379077110d05f4d1: Matches, bandages, food. What's in the bag?
RD_ALifeLine_6126dc4450ac97db: Two boxes of matches for a can
RD_ALifeLine_7a9796be715f2621: Duct tape for a box of shells
RD_ALifeLine_3b84437c6f959881: Duct tape fixes everything. Except this. Deal
RD_ALifeLine_5ed373de6179fc01: I warned you about the raid
RD_ALifeLine_143f37f615d9c1fb: I brought food for your squad
RD_ALifeLine_68f8f74d254e16b5: ..Yeah. Yeah, I remember. Thank you. I still have the tag
RD_ALifeLine_081b5cd17bd9a103: Oh, it's YOU. You saved the wall that night. Hey, sit, eat with us
RD_ALifeLine_1a9cace907d3c6cc: The food guy! Hey, everybody, it's the food guy!
RD_ALifeLine_3db912702b862295: You've been staring at the smoke all day
RD_ALifeLine_5598b36c500cbdff: Chopper went down past the trees. Crew might've been ours
RD_ALifeLine_7906df2e3564161d: That smoke's a crash. Could be people I trained with
RD_ALifeLine_52c24f7e61da67ea: It's crawling with the dead by now
RD_ALifeLine_0d00556b4231548e: Tags. Anything with a name. And whatever's in the crates, that's yours
RD_ALifeLine_355f294264cb833e: I know. That's why I'm asking someone faster than me
RD_ALifeLine_20e142337782fa37: It was a nightmare out there. I want more
RD_ALifeLine_5d561c7a614e5b1e: You did go through hell for them. Take this. M9, it was mine
RD_ALifeLine_79281632026d8104: You got the crates. Don't push it
RD_ALifeLine_001c9b25570467ca: Drove past once. Didn't stop. Didn't want to see who was in the yard
RD_ALifeLine_78ce42127dd95c8c: Boring. God, I'd give anything for boring
RD_ALifeLine_0a56fbc173a09e1d: Why didn't you just shoot me?
RD_ALifeLine_46d8c16365841903: Because you didn't run at me
RD_ALifeLine_4c68f2b975d507cb: Wanted to know if you were a person first
RD_ALifeLine_62a4c4b261046d25: Every bullet I fire at a living person I keep. Up here. I don't have room for many more
RD_ALifeLine_5deefdea1ce70486: Most people out here don't think like that
RD_ALifeLine_46f211eb59a74102: Don't thank me. Just don't make me regret it
RD_ALifeLine_68687e8829a2048c: I know. That's why I'm careful. Now you know why the rifle's still up
RD_ALifeLine_1d10fe133487f7c2: What? Show me. Don't move fast
RD_ALifeLine_5de0acca662b9dcc: Okay. Okay. You told me. That means something. Most people hide it
RD_ALifeLine_179c99e449bdbb35: Will you.. if it comes to that?
RD_ALifeLine_292b569b37f94e27: Stay off the wall. Drink water. Wait. Still you in a few days? You're lucky. Some are
RD_ALifeLine_0a1560612838ac5a: *Long silence* ..if you ask me to. Yeah. I'd make it quick. I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_5c9446962e34808b: Our cook saluted a dead guy in a general's uniform. Full salute. Then ran screaming
RD_ALifeLine_67ab697620cda8b3: Private on watch tried to arrest a dead guy for looting. Read him his rights and all
RD_ALifeLine_7f2bd2f712ed0081: It's the best we've got. Thanks for laughing. Feels human
RD_ALifeLine_1921dde576ffc349: Then somebody out there has Army rifles and no problem using them. Watch yourself
RD_ALifeLine_22a47c5d0a20fc3d: *Closes eyes* buckled in. Waiting for orders. God

RD_ALifeLine_707fa72979307d80: Keep your voice down, they'll hear us
RD_ALifeLine_507cf4221d0158f9: *Drops to a whisper* yeah. Habit. Drill sergeant voice
RD_ALifeLine_29631d6422443c5c: How many of you are out here?
RD_ALifeLine_7de99ab1275cce28: Enough. More than you can see
RD_ALifeLine_72fb275c04d04117: Come on, I'm not counting you for anyone
RD_ALifeLine_5cea916f7c1bb1cd: We've talked before. You can tell me
RD_ALifeLine_25b75c0f32f39757: *Glances at the empty trees* thirty. Thirty rifles. Watching you right now
RD_ALifeLine_69e15764292b9fca: *Sighs* four. There's four of us. And one of us can't walk. Don't tell a soul
RD_ALifeLine_0c1be9f552a62b7a: Smart. People who count us usually come back with friends
RD_ALifeLine_07f424fc04fa9516: What the hell is going on out here
RD_ALifeLine_07268baf58502f4d: Ha! You serious? The world ended, man, and nobody sent a memo
RD_ALifeLine_1a15de0d6f1e1754: Dead people walking around biting folks, cops gone, stores open for business.. free business
RD_ALifeLine_7090d9cd6200d7c9: So it's real, the dead are up
RD_ALifeLine_3aa0070953d3ece9: You seem pretty happy about it
RD_ALifeLine_542dcdeb3d0228e9: Real as my bad knee. Hit em in the head, don't let em bite, that's the whole manual
RD_ALifeLine_1c2e9c3b10b24777: Looting's when there's somebody to arrest you. This is shopping
RD_ALifeLine_05dc1b0a3fd38316: Last cop I saw was eating another cop. So.. yeah
RD_ALifeLine_7eafd5bc5bcd3e49: I spent twelve years doing what other people told me. Now nobody tells me shit
RD_ALifeLine_7e2d9afd338ed837: Took me two days to stop throwing up. Now? I'm kinda thriving
RD_ALifeLine_792d0d95094110b6: You should grab something too, before the smart ones take it all
RD_ALifeLine_1dd3c54614107388: No law, no rules, no tickets. Honestly? Best week of my life, minus the screaming
RD_ALifeLine_6df8f68a6f38a246: Scared? Sure. But I'm scared AND free
RD_ALifeLine_66d3d2b239fbb3b5: Anyway. Get moving, this street gets busy at night
RD_ALifeLine_63eb1fbc4254b119: Style? Style's gonna starve you, buddy. Think about it

RD_ALifeLine_2216efa40b731f1c: I-I could be a robber. I got a bat
RD_ALifeLine_5a59614c3ef04f67: Put the bat down and we both walk
RD_ALifeLine_349683743e594ff3: ..Yeah. Yeah, okay. Forget you saw me
RD_ALifeLine_6fafd1eb0a06a368: Okay.. it's not cold. I just.. my kid needs food. You got food?
RD_ALifeLine_14e7b1d775afb7e1: Ironic right? Nobody's covered for this
RD_ALifeLine_4cd4928d61725868: Oh.. oh man. Thank you. I wasn't gonna hurt you, I swear
RD_ALifeLine_3e7222035277a576: You think I don't know that?! Get outta here before I prove you wrong
RD_ALifeLine_3d3db1784510d523: You look like you just got out of somewhere
RD_ALifeLine_57a6456010a441b1: Ha, good eye. Guards ran when the screaming started. Doors were open by lunch
RD_ALifeLine_7630df5979faca3e: Eight years inside. Three days out. And the world's a bigger prison now, funny huh
RD_ALifeLine_3b10539f257e3add: Does it matter now? Judge is probably walking around chewing on somebody
RD_ALifeLine_12c13806640ffbe9: Some. The ones that ain't dead. They're hungry and they're angry, so stay outta their way
RD_ALifeLine_4ff74f094200eeda: Thanks, first person to say it
RD_ALifeLine_51177663641d3da6: Let's just say I'm good at taking things that ain't mine
RD_ALifeLine_22d169da179d2e04: Then keep your hands off mine
RD_ALifeLine_52c0e3fc695415be: Not all of us are animals though. Just most
RD_ALifeLine_3f7ad3927bcb6305: Relax, I like you, you're funny
RD_ALifeLine_77f767593da894c0: See? You get it. Maybe we'll work together sometime
RD_ALifeLine_628773b838e6f8d4: No you ain't. I called it. That's MY store
RD_ALifeLine_0143181930e4b440: Hey! Hey hey. Dibs. We got dibs on this whole block
RD_ALifeLine_7c7a92222eafb153: Enough? There's nine cans of soup left in this town and I want all nine
RD_ALifeLine_16fa4ed66ee0bd3e: Says me and the two idiots behind that car with shotguns
RD_ALifeLine_269a8200009c02e0: Smart. You live longer being smart
RD_ALifeLine_5a0ced740b3649ac: Tell you what. You can have the shampoo. Nobody's using shampoo anymore

RD_ALifeLine_2cf80df9383964c3: Define good. I found a TV. Can't plug it in anywhere so I just stare at it
RD_ALifeLine_65b80da31403c4e5: Got a blender, a golf club and a whole lotta disappointment
RD_ALifeLine_6f1b09d967b9d64f: Old habits man, you see a TV you take it. It's in my blood
RD_ALifeLine_69dab6d04db03149: Yeah? Nine iron to the skull, works like a charm. Learned that on day two
RD_ALifeLine_1317b2391897f8a0: Nah, the grocery's picked clean already. Try houses, people hide food like squirrels

RD_ALifeLine_7644e11655b4e2cb: Nah. Whoever's got the guns makes the rules now
RD_ALifeLine_43f777233c644796: Somebody's gonna be the king of this shit pile. Why not me

RD_ALifeLine_7b30e23c03b5980c: Good. Then we're just two people now. Weird, huh
RD_ALifeLine_065d381d49361711: Remember it all you want, badge. Ain't no court left
RD_ALifeLine_1eb5819d0b05806e: Maybe. What you got? I got car keys, no idea which car

RD_ALifeLine_35bc8f71166d0ab9: Smokes are gonna be gold soon. You got a can of something?
RD_ALifeLine_636ee09b7ed0601a: Worth? Nothing. It tells the time though. Time to run, mostly
RD_ALifeLine_6658619d045b2ebb: Give me something to eat and they're yours
RD_ALifeLine_6f2c950934e589dc: Pleasure. Don't smoke em all at once
RD_ALifeLine_3483caa215fc3a41: Hardware store. Front window. It was the best day of my life
RD_ALifeLine_09ad49337f9612d6: Took it off a dead guy. He didn't need it. You need it? Too bad
RD_ALifeLine_6e815e7b25004c50: You ever used it on a person
RD_ALifeLine_0bfcf79610718384: Right? Opens doors, opens heads, opens cans if you're desperate
RD_ALifeLine_5711ab1950fad5c7: A few guys from my building. We're thinking of sticking together. Strength in numbers, all that
RD_ALifeLine_0f27f3173297ea0e: Don't make me find out if I can
RD_ALifeLine_48a501d907193759: You could join. Or we could rob you. Still deciding
RD_ALifeLine_6f4cdedb2bf5b1f2: Damn right. Club was a club before all this and it's a club now
RD_ALifeLine_11269438385d5a20: Three generations riding together. Some dead thing ain't gonna break that
RD_ALifeLine_4537153108c81895: Same as always. Taking care of our own. Everybody else can take care of themselves
RD_ALifeLine_636813a665163f14: Join? You gotta prospect, sweetheart. Earn it. Years, normally
RD_ALifeLine_6005d7a278b03670: Don't touch her. I'm serious. Don't
RD_ALifeLine_3368ea4d7f6c604d: Prez says we gather at the clubhouse, then we see who's left
RD_ALifeLine_729b7f8609f8e65f: World's moving faster now though. Do something useful and we'll see
RD_ALifeLine_015c2cec6eba5033: We put a car across it, that makes it ours. That's how countries started too
RD_ALifeLine_608158be463d164b: Whatever's in your left pocket. Right pocket too
RD_ALifeLine_75c909754154ec4d: Oh, a smartass. Read me a book about it while I take your shoes
RD_ALifeLine_6096dad64bf4f869: Smart. Around's long though. Lots of dead around
RD_ALifeLine_5c98e9c76e206add: Kidding! Kinda. Just this once, go. First day jitters, I'm feeling generous
RD_ALifeLine_6cfb1cac670c431a: Why are you just standing here
RD_ALifeLine_5921a21f5ee634fe: Waiting for the homies. Phones died, so we said meet at the corner
RD_ALifeLine_2de732d4087c3767: We always meet here. Apocalypse don't change the corner
RD_ALifeLine_0c0a25c72c45f096: How many of you are there
RD_ALifeLine_29d3a10b75671ebe: Corner's always been dangerous for us. Now it's dangerous for everybody. Welcome
RD_ALifeLine_33d2d03e4bce124d: Why you asking that? You counting us?
RD_ALifeLine_32e0c9940332222a: Curious gets you hurt. Keep it moving
RD_ALifeLine_7a84927a0acd3a0c: Ha. Maybe. Come back when you got something to bring to the table
RD_ALifeLine_62997d7451452986: Am I alright? Am I.. ALRIGHT? I'm wasted, friend, I found a liquor store
RD_ALifeLine_497fec715c1fb694: Slow down? The world's ENDING, man, this is exactly the speed
RD_ALifeLine_453bd3b12ba21ff3: Hah, nice try. That's my secret. My beautiful secret
RD_ALifeLine_797415173b0b7f43: Water's for.. for.. people who wanna live longer
RD_ALifeLine_64c829b333eb7736: Ugh.. okay maybe a little slower

RD_ALifeLine_4d48108d222c90d4: Guards turned first. Bit their way through the cage. We were faster
RD_ALifeLine_412f14d8503c001d: What are you gonna do now
RD_ALifeLine_6459026626abaf2a: Enough to start a softball team. Two teams. The second one's mean
RD_ALifeLine_13046cdc37b21469: All of us, sweetheart. That's why we were on the bus
RD_ALifeLine_1f78785135a69eb3: Eat. Sleep in a bed. Then probably something illegal
RD_ALifeLine_2f0fe1173267c75e: Me though? I was in for checks. I'm the nice one
RD_ALifeLine_3429a98f2e2b9ef0: You're trying real hard to look tough
RD_ALifeLine_56423a75362dedc8: Shit. Okay. Look, I just need people to leave me alone, alright?

RD_ALifeLine_365160bb27503af2: So if anybody asks, I'm a psycho. Deal?

RD_ALifeLine_6568cbca78a8417d: There's a house up the street. Old guy had a gun cabinet. Dead things in the yard now
RD_ALifeLine_4c70b81e1d59c263: Then go clear it. Pop the dead ones, mark it safe, I'll split what I find with you
RD_ALifeLine_5a9ffd1c445f7c3d: A box of rounds. Maybe more if you're nice

RD_ALifeLine_509f8e697c928958: Do it and I got something for you. Real something

RD_ALifeLine_0b65135015396cd8: Nice. Don't get bit, I hate the smell
RD_ALifeLine_15de848e4338d5b3: Nah. Box is the deal. Be happy I paid at all
RD_ALifeLine_4bbfb5d936dff282: ..Fine. You earned it. Take the pistol, don't point it at me
RD_ALifeLine_1879358f266ba027: Square. Come back if you need work
RD_ALifeLine_0cd019855f0877c2: Keep it DOWN? Who are you, my landlord?
RD_ALifeLine_7aed332b34f54449: Us? You. I'm faster than you
RD_ALifeLine_0fae2e5c1cf9b9d5: You look like you've seen a ghost
RD_ALifeLine_41205029229bca10: I.. I did a thing today
RD_ALifeLine_4248a1c806665771: Guy came at me for my bag. Not dead. Alive. And I.. I hit him
RD_ALifeLine_761af20826226831: Yeah. It was him or me. I keep saying it. Doesn't help
RD_ALifeLine_06a35a773befff68: That's what my cousin said. He's the one who said we should start taking stuff
RD_ALifeLine_3d50871c2d5b6140: I think he likes it. That scares me more than the dead
RD_ALifeLine_0a8260166e7d4c65: Pills. Painkillers, the good kind. Pharmacy was wide open
RD_ALifeLine_4ddb8530349c0ef8: I sell what people need. Right now people need to not feel anything
RD_ALifeLine_7d4c4bca2e299d57: For you? First one's free. That's how it works, right
RD_ALifeLine_66b998a537734b75: Antibiotics, bandages? Gone. Everybody took those first. Smart people
RD_ALifeLine_54dc762469682ded: Messed up is dying slow with a busted leg. I'm a public service
RD_ALifeLine_4d66bfb1347d3f57: Nah, I'm kidding. Give me something to eat and we'll talk
RD_ALifeLine_793f5b8b7c3dcf96: Habit. I used to rob gas stations
RD_ALifeLine_764c01da256b2327: Cameras. Oh wait. No more cameras. Huh
RD_ALifeLine_172da4c1640b7f6a: Keeps the blood off I guess
RD_ALifeLine_04413e7922038e00: Nah. I like it. Makes people nervous. Nervous people pay
RD_ALifeLine_24c6d53f4c1e5b9f: Good point. Didn't think of that
RD_ALifeLine_4f54cedf4ac70030: Three of em. Never shot anyone. Got caught because I sneezed
RD_ALifeLine_57e88a1c02111d1b: Pulled the mask down to sneeze. Camera got me. True story
RD_ALifeLine_71ae38c76711ac39: My brothers. All four. Mom always said we'd end up in trouble together
RD_ALifeLine_184f27761aa3096c: That's my crew. Neighbors. We're watching each other's backs
RD_ALifeLine_1712f4e12948b802: Damn right. Nobody touches my family. NOBODY
RD_ALifeLine_2e6998f24b6f6cdd: Hell yeah! Big houses up on the hill, man, wine cellars, generators
RD_ALifeLine_08015054259725ae: Rich folks stocked up. Bunkers, guns, all that prepper shit
RD_ALifeLine_746b100a1584fae9: Leave regular people alone at least
RD_ALifeLine_0f7154055a491776: So do I. And I'm hungrier
RD_ALifeLine_153a2f0a7f19f533: I'm gonna drink a hundred dollar bottle out of a shoe. Life goal

RD_ALifeLine_1c67587d4e1b1388: Depends. Can you shoot, can you run, can you shut up
RD_ALifeLine_14bb6cff276e02db: We're always looking for bodies. Live ones preferably
RD_ALifeLine_11c436cc32b05611: I can run, and shut up
RD_ALifeLine_54978deb363b6d8a: Everybody says that. Then they miss a walker at five feet and cry
RD_ALifeLine_1cc1c3c10f0a9a55: Running's underrated. Shutting up? That's the rarest one
RD_ALifeLine_0d4e3bb44824b7de: The catch is you do what the boss says. Every time. No questions
RD_ALifeLine_3657858a7c2157e0: Look at that, a stray that fetches
RD_ALifeLine_608892bd7198cd07: Tell you what. Prove yourself, then we talk about a seat at the fire
RD_ALifeLine_453262640b390e8a: What do I have to do
RD_ALifeLine_11d4f00a24072b99: The upside is nobody robs you, cause you're the ones robbing
RD_ALifeLine_5580d67e1c036294: Here, eat something. And sit with us tonight, you're alright
RD_ALifeLine_4d5dc0ee7c58ace2: Bring me some gas. Two cans. Our truck's thirsty
RD_ALifeLine_5c3dda6633d97de4: Do that and you're not a stranger anymore
RD_ALifeLine_4fc0d89179753687: Who's in charge of you guys
RD_ALifeLine_18b7d2ea2dfe5dc3: Big guy. Ex-Marine, or says he is. Nobody's checked
RD_ALifeLine_7739a4333e35131c: We voted. Well. He voted and we didn't argue
RD_ALifeLine_27adb6c93ca2fcf3: He kept eleven of us alive. Lost three. That's good math these days
RD_ALifeLine_465831297d456edd: Cause he's got a plan and I don't. I didn't even have a plan before the end
RD_ALifeLine_56e6643f39151d40: Ha. He meets people he wants to meet. Do something loud and he'll hear about you
RD_ALifeLine_4c21f5e452741949: What happened to that guy's face
RD_ALifeLine_1fb6422c17b619b9: Initiation. You get jumped in. Three minutes. Everybody gets a swing
RD_ALifeLine_3ab828f959d9877a: Ha! That's Danny. He wanted in. Now he's in
RD_ALifeLine_01b679850f8c831e: Would I have to do that
RD_ALifeLine_102eb46b4a916010: Brutal's what's outside. This is love, man. Ugly love
RD_ALifeLine_794d34442e45ed1b: You? Nah. You'd have to do something worse
RD_ALifeLine_52da7f334198f8b7: It's not about the hits. It's about who helps you up after
