RD_ALifeLine_66ffd4b575105794: Couple. The ones by the highway are animals. Worse than us, and that's saying something
RD_ALifeLine_451ec83a5a1d4d66: Maybe I should join them instead
RD_ALifeLine_747851135eaf0013: Alone? Shit. That's either brave or real dumb
RD_ALifeLine_7525832a78b9cc1a: They don't let people walk. Ever. They take everything, then they take you
RD_ALifeLine_0d9706195d6af70a: Go ahead. Tell em I said hi. They'll shoot you for it, but tell em
RD_ALifeLine_75f60400561041ec: Pick a side soon. Neutral don't last
RD_ALifeLine_3783c96b3c0b44b7: We at least leave you your shoes
RD_ALifeLine_3f9397e27b308a64: Toll booth's open. Everything's got a price now
RD_ALifeLine_76ab92f92b12d380: You wanna pass, you pay. New rules. My rules
RD_ALifeLine_40f8cc275925cd7a: Something to eat or something to shoot. Pick
RD_ALifeLine_6b1abeab45954da8: Oh shit, you're THAT one. Sorry, go, go
RD_ALifeLine_2a5c402250027e32: I'm gonna let you go, ONCE. Cause I'm in a good mood. Don't come back empty
RD_ALifeLine_3effaf4e1a40821c: Beans. Great. Again. Go on through
RD_ALifeLine_3dddf8355ef11ff8: Oh now we're friends. Go on, take your time
RD_ALifeLine_6947e6ac51269947: Then turn around. Next time bring something
RD_ALifeLine_7d89c7e94881cba0: Where are all the bikes headed
RD_ALifeLine_24c27b5a013a833b: Clubhouse. Every chapter that's still breathing is coming in
RD_ALifeLine_3962901f5a434713: Prez called it. Everybody rides home
RD_ALifeLine_7f2d345b24a54284: Other clubs gonna be a problem
RD_ALifeLine_37d6feca76e351f4: We count heads. We bury who needs burying. Then we decide who runs these roads
RD_ALifeLine_1c459c173d5a8f21: You? On foot? Behind a hundred bikes? You'd die of exhaust
RD_ALifeLine_6adbf7776fe7dce4: There's always beef. Now there's no cops to stop it
RD_ALifeLine_44f4103c14247c7b: Stay off the road when you hear more than ten engines. Trust me
RD_ALifeLine_6fa599c71a49353c: You don't seem like the others
RD_ALifeLine_31edfac35d6a6cbf: I'm.. not. I'm just here cause they had food
RD_ALifeLine_2ccb472b5eca2bef: I fixed computers. Now I hold a shotgun for a guy named Tank
RD_ALifeLine_1ecc69c24f5a3bb9: Right? Nobody judges you for wanting to eat. Except my mom. She'd judge
RD_ALifeLine_03b4a420512d4444: They laugh at me. But they share. That's more than the world did
RD_ALifeLine_2b62b50b47117101: Nah. I'll stick with Tank. Tank's scary but the dead are scarier
RD_ALifeLine_77f47910724f1062: What's in that house you're guarding
RD_ALifeLine_24dda28505d4a9a1: Insurance. Ha. Get it? No? Nevermind
RD_ALifeLine_0630cc4e74c6ffb6: I didn't say that. You said that
RD_ALifeLine_7d96670b0b1d0be6: Good. Then you didn't see nothing
RD_ALifeLine_64fdf45708d34ba2: The kind that keeps the other crew from hitting us. They hit us, their boy doesn't come home
RD_ALifeLine_42e01c242c218017: Walk away, or join em in there. Your choice
RD_ALifeLine_70e01f584713f37a: You guys look like you're fighting
RD_ALifeLine_3b3fb8b63efd07df: Ugh. Tommy wants to go north, Raylene wants to stay. Everybody's yelling
RD_ALifeLine_54a0a2fd2170536a: Crew's splitting. Half of us wanna hit the big stores, half wanna lay low
RD_ALifeLine_6c61f11454a8164f: Me? I wanna sleep somewhere without a dead thing scratching the door
RD_ALifeLine_455a2b0328852d3d: I KNOW. Tell them, they don't listen to me
RD_ALifeLine_4d22e8e7180290b6: This is our block now. Was before, sort of. Now it's official
RD_ALifeLine_30a268636605d845: Through here? Who said you could come through here
RD_ALifeLine_7d62f5e71501a026: Passing's a privilege. Get a nod from us first
RD_ALifeLine_64b65e877b7e16f5: Public! There's no public, homie. There's us and there's everybody else
RD_ALifeLine_2608a2c601a38707: Polite. I like polite. Go ahead, quick
RD_ALifeLine_7bb22ed96488a846: Fine. You got the nod. Once. Don't make it a habit
RD_ALifeLine_695f7a6335f30703: Walk around, before somebody gets jumpy
RD_ALifeLine_464e8953174b1366: Shh! Not so loud. Everybody wants guns, nobody wants to pay for guns
RD_ALifeLine_058c2f7c699530f6: What do you want for a pistol
RD_ALifeLine_0714e7f15fb14989: Word gets people killed. Keep it quiet
RD_ALifeLine_4f19aa5f6d8a46dd: A pistol costs. Food for a week, or a favor. Favors are cheaper, for you
RD_ALifeLine_75b5e8c9677dce13: Ammo's harder than guns, man. Everybody's shooting at everything
RD_ALifeLine_70856a732de0922e: Heh. I didn't think you'd make it. Here, she's clean, comes with boxes
RD_ALifeLine_26e432bf1876bab9: There's a house full of dead ones. Clear it and the pistol's yours
RD_ALifeLine_2bbe47073ecbc27d: Good. Come back alive, the deal dies with you
RD_ALifeLine_7a2fffc9318b2d3f: Then you stay soft. Your call
RD_ALifeLine_1d71373206b1d514: My little brother. Went out for smokes two days ago. Classic him
RD_ALifeLine_3bae53d6085cec41: Idiot. If you find him tell him I'm gonna kill him. Then hug him
RD_ALifeLine_592938587aa0c314: The gas station, for smokes. There's always dead around gas stations
RD_ALifeLine_674a9fa46052a81d: Don't. Say that again and you'll be dead
RD_ALifeLine_02b519e00a90f5f9: Check the spot I marked. If he's there.. bring something back. Anything
RD_ALifeLine_1cdbda7a48395515: Take this. Take it and go, I need a minute
RD_ALifeLine_4055c6b32252ef2c: Thank you. Really. Don't tell my crew I said thank you
RD_ALifeLine_2be1a6c138baecd0: Means I belong to something. Means if you hurt me, a hundred guys hurt you
RD_ALifeLine_0738b1df0694d6a6: Each one means something. This one I got for riding through a storm with a broken arm
RD_ALifeLine_41c0acf34c41e057: What's the one on the back
RD_ALifeLine_78eba5520955be49: Thanks. Not many folks get it
RD_ALifeLine_7e50a7f15b7f7a53: Colors. You don't touch the colors. You don't even look at em too long
RD_ALifeLine_62a3a92f77ceec85: Say that again. Slower. So I can enjoy it
RD_ALifeLine_3c6a75f11fa7db1d: We hit a car yesterday. Family. Dad pulled a gun
RD_ALifeLine_5ff1d4ec42d1ff3e: Boss shot him. Kids watched. We took their gas
RD_ALifeLine_5966925d1e90a66e: Is it? I was holding the flashlight
RD_ALifeLine_727ea5425b16dc06: Yeah. Maybe. And then I'm the next one in the ditch
RD_ALifeLine_49b80d8626f177f3: That's what everybody keeps saying. Doesn't sound true when I say it
RD_ALifeLine_71436ff240f3c3b7: Lookout, bait, punching bag. Whatever they need
RD_ALifeLine_33554e454e1e53f3: Sounds like they don't respect you
RD_ALifeLine_2001671d5c7935af: Dead guy over there's been walking into the same fence for an hour. Peak entertainment
RD_ALifeLine_45362aaa12dd4ac9: Smoke to the east this morning. Somebody's cooking, or somebody's burning
RD_ALifeLine_0bdf9bf900f0e01b: They will. Give it a month. I'm gonna be running this
RD_ALifeLine_359b808b00860734: Either way somebody's having a bad day
RD_ALifeLine_7f8142090b5864fe: You selling stuff from your own crew
RD_ALifeLine_1a3c8f7531674511: Shh! Shut up. Who told you that
RD_ALifeLine_147b925f3723e30a: Okay, look. A man's gotta have a retirement plan
RD_ALifeLine_26407e17660cfa1c: Your boss would love to hear this
RD_ALifeLine_6d7d0c6c61b63636: You better not. Here, take this for your silence
RD_ALifeLine_3f3232df22412cca: Batteries, a lighter, half a bottle of whiskey. The boss's whiskey
RD_ALifeLine_3eeb5ac46d8a66ca: You wouldn't. Cause if you did, I'd tell him you stole it
RD_ALifeLine_6aca278b75984f76: Food for the whiskey. Quick, before he counts
RD_ALifeLine_153c3428748fd1ad: Me! I had a gun before the end. Tattoo gun, I mean. Still got ink
RD_ALifeLine_6b5753b104f63582: Crew mark. Everybody gets one now. Makes it easy to tell who's ours, dead or alive
RD_ALifeLine_4d678b787e9935e2: What if you leave the crew
RD_ALifeLine_0846cff332da9a01: Yeah, after the third time somebody shot their own guy in the dark
RD_ALifeLine_75ca97be6b7559f9: You? You gotta be crew first. Then you get ink. Then you never leave
RD_ALifeLine_1d30211e4fcb1b7b: Nobody leaves. Well, they leave. Feet first
RD_ALifeLine_2414f8d72912da10: Is it just your crew out here
RD_ALifeLine_08af3445711755a2: Not anymore. Three crews merged last night. Big party. Somebody got stabbed
RD_ALifeLine_616c54a7752310a3: We're getting bigger every day. Small crews join or get eaten
RD_ALifeLine_7450111d1783d4ba: What happens to the ones who don't join
RD_ALifeLine_1e14a58327345057: Some loudmouth who wanted to be boss. Turns out the boss wanted to be boss more
RD_ALifeLine_61e9c96b318f6008: Not yet. Give it a few weeks
RD_ALifeLine_4507072308cce219: How are you doing on ammo
RD_ALifeLine_322dd61158e6ca5c: Why? You looking to sell or you looking to rob?
RD_ALifeLine_1252038421bf8632: Ha. That's the question everybody's asking and nobody's answering
RD_ALifeLine_071c929c3a27f011: Now we're talking. Come see me when you got a box
RD_ALifeLine_390020595aafe151: Ha! Balls. I like it. Still gonna shoot you if you try
RD_ALifeLine_0a99e52671409ea3: Found a whole truck of booze. Merry apocalypse
RD_ALifeLine_0748bc4d2e07c734: The noise is gonna bring them
RD_ALifeLine_763b9674476ce32f: You bring anything? No? Then stand over there and look sad
RD_ALifeLine_75d9c4286814bce4: That's what the fence is for. And Gary. Gary's the fence too
RD_ALifeLine_0ebff44d64b5c6ed: THAT'S the spirit! Somebody get this one a drink
RD_ALifeLine_65658a92347689eb: You took something from a house we cleared. That's our house. That's our stuff
RD_ALifeLine_012206f35ffced5c: You owe us. You just don't know it yet
RD_ALifeLine_449fd2f2081e6d37: Now you know. Next time look for our mark on the door
RD_ALifeLine_7efa3ff35086f094: I don't gotta prove shit. I got a gun, that's the proof
RD_ALifeLine_7038809d7e7cbbb8: Give us a box of rounds and we'll call it even
RD_ALifeLine_7fe6bd0417697c32: Then next time you got it, you find us
RD_ALifeLine_4061bca23f287ca7: Oh, you're gonna regret that, friend
RD_ALifeLine_10e8c20e03c25899: See the painted doors? Red X's? Everything with a red X is ours
RD_ALifeLine_1a7b12b124af5c28: Everything inside the painted doors. Past that, you're somebody else's problem
RD_ALifeLine_5efecfbb694d5743: What happens if I loot a marked house
RD_ALifeLine_7cef4f7b05ee4e4f: Can I live inside your turf
RD_ALifeLine_3c1b05cc182925af: Past that is the other crew. They don't paint. They hang people on fences
RD_ALifeLine_52088ee86a01bede: Then you're a thief, and thieves get the fence
RD_ALifeLine_32900ca67cf1113a: You can. Rent's due every week. Food, ammo, or work
RD_ALifeLine_2cc7062f6d716e0b: Pay it and nobody touches you. That's a better deal than the dead give you
RD_ALifeLine_7a889b1244f99dca: Why do you keep coming to my place
RD_ALifeLine_6a7306fa39e33d12: Checking in. Making sure you're safe. That's what we do
RD_ALifeLine_3a2456e23590920b: Neighborhood watch, sweetheart. We watch. You pay
RD_ALifeLine_345598132dacaa89: From the dead. From the other crews. From us, mostly
RD_ALifeLine_358bf2476e91c825: Everybody needs protection. Especially the ones who say they don't
RD_ALifeLine_1db56c1071193ca0: Weekly. A box of rounds or two cans of food. Cheap, considering
RD_ALifeLine_25ce4d177cd9d672: Talk to me like that again and see
RD_ALifeLine_338e4cd41025039d: Even better. You're my favorite house now
RD_ALifeLine_22d4d97f02abb788: That's a shame. Fires happen, you know. Accidents
RD_ALifeLine_65f2866f4e98e77e: ..Okay. Okay. You're not worth the trouble this week
RD_ALifeLine_0fc98dbd2b02d6b5: Since we said so. You see a law against it?
RD_ALifeLine_03fe8cf459246af5: Since we got here first and brought the guns
RD_ALifeLine_4c9f001d23c073de: Something useful. Food, ammo, meds. Not your stupid watch
RD_ALifeLine_207a289273fbdd71: Every road's got a toll, friend. Some of em just shoot first
RD_ALifeLine_048434e259cad0bf: Pay up and you got a free pass for today
RD_ALifeLine_073174b361f50497: Bandages! Somebody actually thought ahead. Go
RD_ALifeLine_7c792572003861f2: Broke? Then you're walking back the way you came
RD_ALifeLine_13a493463f1f47f3: Of course it's real. Official. Very official. See the cones?
RD_ALifeLine_658e0ff972ca176a: Yes sir, ma'am, military checkpoint. Please hand over your weapons for inspection
RD_ALifeLine_78d77d1866ec0fad: Those cones are from a parking lot
RD_ALifeLine_1bb1b398150a91ce: Ha! Okay you're too easy, I can't do it. Keep your stuff, go
RD_ALifeLine_58ebd3880501a3b4: Okay fine, it's not real. Still gotta pay though
RD_ALifeLine_727d0e022a846ae5: Yeah. I need eyes on the other crew. How many, what guns, where they sleep
RD_ALifeLine_57ae824d0363e208: The other crew's getting bold. I wanna know what they got
RD_ALifeLine_22bb197465ae80e6: I looked. Here's what I saw
RD_ALifeLine_37b2dea22b87ecae: Good. Stay far, stay quiet. You get seen, I don't know you
RD_ALifeLine_29589fbf732c6b71: Rounds. A pistol if your report's good. Real good
RD_ALifeLine_5aba2c487bc074d5: Everything's a death wish now. This one pays
RD_ALifeLine_2267cca01df02f35: Shit.. more than I thought. Okay. That's worth something
RD_ALifeLine_1867c89e61901d88: That intel saved your crew, it's worth a pistol
RD_ALifeLine_36f3701c0cdfe5fc: Box of rounds. Don't push it
RD_ALifeLine_259c55eb3d61607f: ..Yeah. Yeah it did. Take it, it's a good one
RD_ALifeLine_6f0ce5d97bbb00c0: We got a place. Walls, beds, a guy who cooks okay
RD_ALifeLine_5b9e2d3048fac9c9: Hmm. You been decent to us. Alright, I'll mark it for you. Knock first
RD_ALifeLine_2ea750ee687e8679: Curious, huh. Come back when you're more than curious
RD_ALifeLine_610d115540f277b3: Everything's better than a car seat. Earn some trust and I'll show you
RD_ALifeLine_4cfba256396b7e44: And don't bring friends. We count heads at the door
RD_ALifeLine_0fd6e5737bc76a38: Got a place I can rest
RD_ALifeLine_364f74e00a0c6484: Sure, sure! Got a whole house, warm, food. Come on, it's real close
RD_ALifeLine_01cfc903172f0ba3: Oh you look tired. We got beds. Follow me, we're friendly
RD_ALifeLine_564304a168786bc1: Right this way. Don't mind the boys at the door
RD_ALifeLine_02537ad65c8f3075: Can't a guy be nice? ..okay fine, you got good boots
RD_ALifeLine_5afcb6b0655e84a6: Your loss. Probably your life too, out there
RD_ALifeLine_032786712e37c27c: Walk away before I change my mind about being honest
RD_ALifeLine_6fd1507237b7687e: Right now? Whoever's got the most bullets. That's us this week
RD_ALifeLine_484bbd5f5642f7d7: How long you think you'll hold it
RD_ALifeLine_1746bdce30fe9985: Some animals with no rules. Even we got rules
RD_ALifeLine_3db296f239aba64f: The pharmacy, the gun shop. Well. The gun shop's empty. But the sign is nice
RD_ALifeLine_2033954e6bd20aaa: Till somebody bigger shows up. Then we either join or die
RD_ALifeLine_338e58237468c682: Like, don't eat people. Low bar. They don't clear it
RD_ALifeLine_37dbbedb7059cabc: Dead keep piling up by our wall. Somebody's gotta thin the herd
RD_ALifeLine_4225b6c170415f18: My boys are tired. You go kill some dead by the marked spot, I'll pay
RD_ALifeLine_3308d92665f39602: Enough that my boys stop crying about it
RD_ALifeLine_272c5d642798b53f: Good. Make noise somewhere else first, pull em off the wall
RD_ALifeLine_3d21425a45c625c9: Fair. Don't come begging for walls then
RD_ALifeLine_5251b8633bbb2028: Hah, I heard it from here. Nice work
RD_ALifeLine_3d9b62b86f44579c: That was a lot of dead, I want more
RD_ALifeLine_5ef886fb7ced2c80: Here. Food and a box. Fair's fair
RD_ALifeLine_24df41f4314745f6: Alright, alright, take the meds too. You earned em
RD_ALifeLine_25dc8d9f411e8010: You guys own the highway now
RD_ALifeLine_2d5cd8f467de3ca5: We own anything with two lanes and a yellow line
RD_ALifeLine_4234091838f33056: Club rides the roads. Anybody on wheels pays respect, or pays something else
RD_ALifeLine_644aee1a56ebf610: Pull over when you hear us. Kill the engine. Wave
RD_ALifeLine_0f9b05884c1d0161: Walkers we ignore. Unless they look like they got gas
RD_ALifeLine_41c0cdb166501593: Some do. Some are learning. Some are in ditches
RD_ALifeLine_4669c3a77ca1d0a3: Simple. You'd be amazed how many people can't do simple
RD_ALifeLine_48bf9b5215e5b241: What's with all the shooting downtown
RD_ALifeLine_6b35a9ab6b9d0b20: Beef. Old beef. Older than the dead
RD_ALifeLine_17c8e98c64df5fb3: They think now there's no cops they can take our blocks. They're wrong
RD_ALifeLine_358a151a024ddcf2: It's ours. Was my granddad's block. Yeah, it's worth it
RD_ALifeLine_1f84c7c53ca7bd35: You? Ha. Maybe. Bring us ammo and we'll remember your face the good way
RD_ALifeLine_006eedf40fa877c6: Smart. Stay off our blocks and you'll be fine
RD_ALifeLine_7c3837ff696982f5: Was. Still got the boots. Lost the faith
RD_ALifeLine_63fa229d57e5f6a6: Guard. Unit fell apart in a week. These guys pay better
RD_ALifeLine_49b76ad32873c404: Orders were to shoot civilians at the fence. I shot one. Then I walked
RD_ALifeLine_4f150179715eeac6: Miss the chow line. Miss knowing who's in charge
RD_ALifeLine_174240662ee98237: So are generals. Ours just don't have medals
RD_ALifeLine_110fcb9106c63199: Here at least I know. It's whoever yells loudest
RD_ALifeLine_38e75b524790c85c: What do those symbols on the doors mean
RD_ALifeLine_5ee865c4744d8be8: Code. X means cleared. Circle means people inside. Triangle means don't bother
RD_ALifeLine_6025ee45440118a9: Our language. Tells the crew what's in the house without saying it
RD_ALifeLine_5457c8474f8641be: What does a circle with a line mean
RD_ALifeLine_129dc0c32605bf1f: Means people inside who pay. Leave em alone, they're ours
RD_ALifeLine_5d5d2fb319a73d44: Cause you're gonna see it everywhere now. Better you know what you're walking into
RD_ALifeLine_6ec77f7f0a95a219: Good. Then don't mess with a circle or the crew'll have your head
RD_ALifeLine_24f15298263e502b: Yeah. A package. Don't open it. Don't ask what it is
RD_ALifeLine_70597eac78082c33: My guy at the other place needs this. My legs are shot
RD_ALifeLine_2fcf990136214c72: Good. Straight there. You get stopped, it's yours, you found it
RD_ALifeLine_616e2f5619de3013: He get it? Didn't open it? Good
RD_ALifeLine_37166c7b7fbf6ce3: ..Fine. It's pills. People pay a lot for not feeling things
RD_ALifeLine_62b580154bcb418c: Take this. Couple of the pills too, for emergencies
RD_ALifeLine_161754452055c4fb: New boss. Took over last week. The old one's.. not around
RD_ALifeLine_049df33f06508f0d: He's different. He's got a list
RD_ALifeLine_33ab38742caae92c: People who owe. People who crossed us. People he just doesn't like the look of
RD_ALifeLine_38865ca52e8e7910: Nobody leaves this one. That's the first thing on the list
RD_ALifeLine_16ee2b9572a560ad: Booze, smokes, batteries. Whatever makes the nights shorter
RD_ALifeLine_6696bed517fab04b: Moonshine, cousin's recipe. Tastes like gas, works like gas
RD_ALifeLine_655115aa11cd900f: What do you want for a bottle
RD_ALifeLine_4b5131277e0a5a74: Two cans. Or one box of nine mil
RD_ALifeLine_4d5d9ea169662ffb: One can, one pack. Fair trade
RD_ALifeLine_3fbd5efc2a7c574b: Cash? HA, no. Cash is for starting fires
RD_ALifeLine_7648915002084796: Enjoy. Don't drive. Ha. There's no cops, drive all you want
RD_ALifeLine_1a1bfb4f2c69d097: Who are those people hanging out there
RD_ALifeLine_5951f94d603a1e5b: Thieves. Or snitches. Or people who said no
RD_ALifeLine_2b1c08f02fe5c38f: Is that a warning for me
RD_ALifeLine_362b917b3c768128: Sick is what keeps the rest in line. You think I like it?
RD_ALifeLine_68522c925f60eb74: ..I don't. But I like it better than being up there
RD_ALifeLine_59d818c923fecfbe: What do you guys eat out here
RD_ALifeLine_5db4e66c164868de: Whatever we take. Lately that's a lot of dog food
RD_ALifeLine_3b8351080e60ef15: I could get you real food
RD_ALifeLine_106472b62a45f64d: It's not bad with hot sauce. Everything's not bad with hot sauce
RD_ALifeLine_31c50a501caa3ba9: Yeah? You bring real food, you're welcome at our fire any night
RD_ALifeLine_7a29cdd15ad83c30: Who are the guys in the clean trucks
RD_ALifeLine_4dceacd81db66fad: Shh. Don't point. Those aren't locals
RD_ALifeLine_37829676795ac525: Big money before the end. Now big guns. They're buying up crews, or burying them
RD_ALifeLine_5021614a01bfed28: Guns, medicine, fuel. Stuff nobody else has. Makes you wonder where they got it
RD_ALifeLine_2845c5670a9cdead: Not yet. Everybody's waiting to see who they pick
RD_ALifeLine_42e2909309335533: Far away. They don't rob you. They just make you disappear
RD_ALifeLine_427cf8023c115f4b: Why are you collecting from that family
RD_ALifeLine_43ba765b3f310455: Cause they pay and they don't argue. Best customers
RD_ALifeLine_10b15ccf0327f5dd: How about I pay their share
RD_ALifeLine_0fad26007b0288c6: Kids eat less. That's why their rate is lower. I'm not a monster
RD_ALifeLine_735903dd74b6c962: You? ..huh. Okay hero, two cans and they're off the list this week
RD_ALifeLine_5c23a90b03d87204: Low? I'm keeping their windows unbroken. That's a service
RD_ALifeLine_6e7774c65be87c7f: Huh. Alright. You're a weird one
RD_ALifeLine_662dad8b11146861: I want the other crew's dog tags. Their scout's been hanging around our wall
RD_ALifeLine_0c9ea6be7d769c65: There's a body I need checked. Their guy. Went down near the old car, I wanna know it's him
RD_ALifeLine_6a2994db79c7afce: Bring me something off him. Tag, note, anything
RD_ALifeLine_4a9111682d320e53: Cause my face they know. Yours they don't
RD_ALifeLine_741af39d77ab926f: Everybody does somebody's dirty work. You just picked a cleaner boss
RD_ALifeLine_5110ae9111d8227b: I want a gun for this
RD_ALifeLine_2afe39002f7efd41: Fine. He had this on him anyway. Ironic, huh
RD_ALifeLine_139fb6cd0eb7b43b: You know stuff about the area
RD_ALifeLine_6447b01878d20aed: I know everything about the area. Knowing costs though
RD_ALifeLine_09249fcc3912ba87: What do you want for it
RD_ALifeLine_09acf3bf52abb9ec: A can. One can and I'll tell you something worth ten
RD_ALifeLine_254a60015b34a135: Have fun dying on the way
RD_ALifeLine_0fd3c6695694f645: Okay, lean in. You didn't hear this from me
RD_ALifeLine_0475c02d04bcf6c7: Crews talk now. Channel nine. Who's where, who's dead, who owes
RD_ALifeLine_24ca1d1a5a8c4cdb: Get your own radio. And if you hear us talking about you, run
RD_ALifeLine_66727f9a70eadaac: Couple times. Something about a loner who doesn't die easy
RD_ALifeLine_2ac4cfab175776e7: Organized is how you stop being prey. Took us two weeks to figure that out
RD_ALifeLine_254dccf92a0851f2: Could be you. Could be somebody dumber
RD_ALifeLine_6eee7f3740d7ea69: What do you want this time
RD_ALifeLine_226148d464881a4c: Tax day. Don't make that face, everybody pays the King
RD_ALifeLine_215fb1ba3d284efe: What do I get for paying
RD_ALifeLine_19f6248a74920d3c: Ten percent. Of everything. We're very fair
RD_ALifeLine_5cdfb2776563848a: You get to keep your house. And your fingers
RD_ALifeLine_66794bf504e50cf7: Then I write your name down. You don't want your name in the book
RD_ALifeLine_529954472df653fa: Yeah? ..oh, right, you're in the book. Clean. Carry on
RD_ALifeLine_06ee6bf466cb874f: For you, today, a box of rounds or some meds
RD_ALifeLine_65ccdc89348dfdd8: Can we talk about the rate
RD_ALifeLine_35cf6a005eaa5542: Good citizen. The King thanks you
RD_ALifeLine_27a802553ea97fd2: Ooh, the boys are gonna love you
RD_ALifeLine_23eb8dd77aacc800: The rate's the rate. Talk again and it doubles
RD_ALifeLine_69d2cbec48aae4b3: Heh.. fine. You're useful alive. Skip this month, don't tell anyone
RD_ALifeLine_0ec0226a57259cde: I want to talk to whoever runs this
RD_ALifeLine_1d1378bd56a449db: You don't talk to the boss. The boss talks to you
RD_ALifeLine_3823aece4e5dc843: Oh, you want an audience? Like a little peasant? Cute
RD_ALifeLine_0695aee71f2e4098: I've done work for your crew
RD_ALifeLine_17f2519234840f5f: Everybody thinks that. What is it
RD_ALifeLine_7708ca892d2cacbf: Oh, it's you. Yeah, he's heard. He says keep it up and you get a seat at the table
RD_ALifeLine_5254c1390bf9aaf8: Smart. Last guy who insisted is wearing a new hat. It's a bucket
RD_ALifeLine_69ee1dcb30e51435: Information? Guns? Gas? Spit it out
RD_ALifeLine_40179f0325dd15f9: Hm. Fine. Talk to me, I'll pass it up. If it's good, you'll hear from us
RD_ALifeLine_5dd34b1853147222: ..Okay. Okay, he'll want to know your name. You're on the good list now
RD_ALifeLine_6c7ba6326164e4da: Who are those people working on the wall
RD_ALifeLine_6545f12c462d2eeb: ..Okay, debtors. They owed, now they work. When they're square, they go
RD_ALifeLine_2be98cf91aeb0417: One guy did. Last month. We think. He left in a hurry
RD_ALifeLine_2c590dd231cf1ea8: It's economics, sweetheart. Look it up. Oh wait, no internet
RD_ALifeLine_0f6f66d8306a4708: Good attitude. Keep it and you won't end up on the wall
RD_ALifeLine_4ded6a93361f409b: What would it take for you to leave my place alone
RD_ALifeLine_0c1f4c9755d02c3a: Now THAT'S a good question. Smartest thing anyone's asked all week
RD_ALifeLine_246518db04efa67e: Leave it alone? Like, forever? That's a big ask
RD_ALifeLine_5402993e6c8c3fd8: What if I just shoot whoever comes
RD_ALifeLine_22ec126f66debc1a: Weekly tribute. Food or ammo. Pay it and we paint a circle on your door
RD_ALifeLine_20b5a86f5c4dce88: Jobs! Now you're talking. Ask around, there's always dirty work
RD_ALifeLine_11e5b9184cd80289: Then we send twenty. Then forty. You got forty bullets?
RD_ALifeLine_4d0608ee3403cdc6: Circle means hands off. Even the other crews respect the circle. Mostly
RD_ALifeLine_0eb6002342eb008f: Circle it is. Welcome to the family
RD_ALifeLine_698a4eff298af23e: Think fast. Our memory's short and our patience is shorter
RD_ALifeLine_79c11b8a5158f71d: The price is the price, friend
RD_ALifeLine_03ae1677394b0206: Ugh. Two cans. And you owe me a smile every time I come by
RD_ALifeLine_77becd0668a8742a: We ARE guns. But sometimes we need a cheap one. Like you
RD_ALifeLine_6f65166d0f64b5b8: Contractor work. Quiet stuff. Pays in steel, not promises
RD_ALifeLine_527e65903338da5c: I don't kill people for money
RD_ALifeLine_1a246caf5a0e7502: Recon. Get eyes on a camp, count heads, count rifles. Don't engage
RD_ALifeLine_0cf182a74cbc64a8: A good pistol. Forty-five. And the boxes that go with it
RD_ALifeLine_640b8ba912412baf: Then you're a civilian. Civilians are targets
RD_ALifeLine_00f473867acc1f82: Good count. Clean work. Here's what we agreed
RD_ALifeLine_65654e8058b0a640: You take the job, you finish the job. We don't like quitters
RD_ALifeLine_6021f4415c1a25e9: There's more where that came from. Don't get sloppy
RD_ALifeLine_2355e15b4507a199: Look at the jacket, genius. Bones on the back
RD_ALifeLine_6c4c3fc77fc70c19: We're what came after the crews. Bigger teeth
RD_ALifeLine_09c62d092b8a3c58: I want no trouble with you
RD_ALifeLine_1d0d5e67215a5227: Ate em. Not like that. Well.. mostly not like that
RD_ALifeLine_4fcc330075fb015a: Every bone's a kill. Human ones count double
RD_ALifeLine_45612e2141b848a7: Then stay off our roads and pay when you're told. Easy
RD_ALifeLine_41b45ae7773b15a9: That one's my old boss. Don't look at me like that, he had it coming
RD_ALifeLine_4f529c1e2efb34e7: Who's the big guy in armor
RD_ALifeLine_7a4e6bac52500d39: That's our Tank. Bullets bounce. Dead things bounce. He doesn't
RD_ALifeLine_67966a48033ad6df: Juggernaut. Military plates, riot gear, two sizes too small. Don't piss him off
RD_ALifeLine_088e043d48011477: Everybody can be killed. Nobody's done it yet though
RD_ALifeLine_3cccffae71313579: Prison riot squad. Guard didn't need it anymore. Guard didn't need his face anymore either
RD_ALifeLine_6dd29e00203cb0d8: Slow? He doesn't need to be fast. He just walks at you, and you run out of bullets
RD_ALifeLine_7f00752802fbebe1: Since week one. Back when it was just me and four idiots with bats
RD_ALifeLine_639b3acb630d35c6: Now look. Forty people. Walls. A guy with a cannon. Insane
RD_ALifeLine_5a389226277a0d73: Two dead. One's the boss now. One's.. I don't know. He left
RD_ALifeLine_24dff868669a4cdc: We took it. Building's harder. Taking's what we're good at
RD_ALifeLine_4a3d8f0b5e5c0a94: Yeah. Weirdly. It was simpler when we were scared
RD_ALifeLine_371f420d1e0c9908: Yeah, a real one. Dead cluster by the marked spot is blocking our convoy route
RD_ALifeLine_5186d7ee53c6e15c: Need someone to clear a route. Lots of dead. Big ones too
RD_ALifeLine_49a86ee41e07a06f: More than you'd like. Less than you'd fear
RD_ALifeLine_7a32a45055f436ca: Good. If you die I'm keeping your gear
RD_ALifeLine_3febbf5749bbf5ff: He's busy. Being scary takes all day
RD_ALifeLine_5ff422db47063331: You're tougher than you look. That's a compliment
RD_ALifeLine_58bcd00c7e3c6123: A route like that's worth a pistol
RD_ALifeLine_445d8abe3a273754: Cartel's a dirty word. We're a supply company. We supply. You buy
RD_ALifeLine_52bf7c2828848a56: I want nothing to do with you
RD_ALifeLine_614127354439871b: Medicine. Real medicine. Fuel. Guns that work. Things your little crews can't find
RD_ALifeLine_00e7e35731b50c45: Loyalty, mostly. You work for us, you never run out of anything again
RD_ALifeLine_7f7a2e707e7fb223: Everybody says that. Then they get sick
RD_ALifeLine_0746efde478f789d: You cross us, you never run out of problems
RD_ALifeLine_6c2a0d42329e8116: Think. But not too long. The offer has a shelf life
RD_ALifeLine_3db0c5c731c3d9c0: Small jobs. Show me you deliver and we talk big
RD_ALifeLine_7c990a137aff923a: Why do they call him King
RD_ALifeLine_1e558aff6775e2cb: Cause he said so and everybody who disagreed got real quiet
RD_ALifeLine_1efb1ca507e0f664: He brought us through the worst. Fed us. Killed for us. That's a king, isn't it
RD_ALifeLine_6bd11d7b355bf8a2: Long live the king I guess
RD_ALifeLine_09e1d8370ed7365f: He's fair. Brutal, but fair. You do your job, you eat
RD_ALifeLine_699528ee4c90d2b8: Say that louder. Go on. I wanna watch
RD_ALifeLine_12433e9f4d2020a5: Hah. Smart mouth. I like it
RD_ALifeLine_153206a364a6dbd7: Two clubs, one highway. Someone's gotta go
RD_ALifeLine_070275462dab1d14: Share? You know any club that shares?
RD_ALifeLine_42f4f6600ae18703: Us. Obviously. Ask me again next week
RD_ALifeLine_12d1992e047d9a57: Ha. Now you're thinking like us. Bring ammo, both sides will buy
RD_ALifeLine_0a8f52d25aba2f3b: You patch people up for them
RD_ALifeLine_6a71c47231208a7c: Nurse. Before. Now I'm the crew doc. Bullets, bites, one guy with a fork in his eye
RD_ALifeLine_65d8c97d65472342: They keep me alive cause I keep them alive. That's the deal
RD_ALifeLine_683f0bbd337b16cf: You're a good person in a bad place
RD_ALifeLine_02fa8c1811d489bc: Cause the good people already died. I watched
RD_ALifeLine_2df7d1c5718d993f: Got a bandage, maybe. Nothing more. The boss counts every pill
RD_ALifeLine_4b395b0a4813ae2d: Don't. Don't say that. I've done things
RD_ALifeLine_22cbfb5745cab111: Raid. Big one. Don't ask where
RD_ALifeLine_1093bd92790609dc: We're gonna hit something soft. Could be you. Kidding. Mostly
RD_ALifeLine_534f3fd3544d0378: I'll stay out of the way
RD_ALifeLine_44abdfbf5a04e26d: Ha. Prove you can shoot first. Then maybe you get the leftovers
RD_ALifeLine_56fe0d4e05d52524: Good. Stay out of the way and you'll get to hear about it
RD_ALifeLine_3aa90b69224f8d50: The big tower? Don't. Just don't
RD_ALifeLine_22e7053f54c00c10: Three crews holding the big tower. Bigger than us. Way bigger
RD_ALifeLine_2ed6af77582840a9: Why would anyone fight for a building
RD_ALifeLine_2d24031e7b4cd466: Red Vulture Cartel, Iron Choir, the Glass Kings. And they hate each other more than they hate you
RD_ALifeLine_6185275735dc39f9: Inside? Nobody goes inside. Well, people go. Nobody comes back
RD_ALifeLine_05e46c3e34139fb8: Roof, man. They say a helicopter lands up there. Way out
RD_ALifeLine_460cb9a42913691e: They shoot on sight. Everybody. No talk, no toll
RD_ALifeLine_0870119d49dcc668: You know who stole from you
RD_ALifeLine_6d5cd46a00aee29a: Not yet. But I will. And then their whole family pays
RD_ALifeLine_37fb74e97906c8a9: Yeah? Talk. It's worth something to me
RD_ALifeLine_708a0fca32294d15: Didn't say it was. You're awful defensive though
RD_ALifeLine_075820341b64efaf: Let it go? Out here? That's how you get eaten
RD_ALifeLine_386647522b5bbfdc: Give me a name and you get a reward
RD_ALifeLine_35a459536782c0c1: You what?! Get out of my sight before I add you to the list
RD_ALifeLine_4f9143fb6db9b68f: Ugh. Yeah. Everybody tiptoes around me
RD_ALifeLine_756086555d070fca: Don't treat me different. Everybody does it and I hate it
RD_ALifeLine_4c18125e66c8d3bf: Before? He fixed cars. Sang badly. Now he signs off on executions
RD_ALifeLine_5853282639127f66: Safe from the dead. Not from what he's turning into
RD_ALifeLine_6fc43faa15a43af6: Every day. But where would I go? He'd burn the county looking for me
RD_ALifeLine_75ec6f6f4a28fac9: Do I still have to pay
RD_ALifeLine_4f40b5e32c72ee29: You? Nah. The King knows your name. You're good people
RD_ALifeLine_383aebc02b1cca13: Word came down. You're exempt. Whatever you did, he liked it
RD_ALifeLine_169a9d162632dd1b: Does that make me one of you
RD_ALifeLine_5aa2e21609ec364d: Don't know, don't care. Exempt is exempt
RD_ALifeLine_2258a0596806a3aa: Don't thank me. Thank the guy with the crown. It's a hubcap. Don't tell him
RD_ALifeLine_702c25a14af525c1: Not one of us. But one of ours. There's a difference
RD_ALifeLine_076a1adb6a5d7bb1: Gas. We're running dry. No gas, no trucks. No trucks, no raids. No raids, no food
RD_ALifeLine_7c67c06654aa53c9: Seriously? Bring me two cans of gas and I owe you, big
RD_ALifeLine_085060cf1ab13768: It's everybody's problem when we get hungry
RD_ALifeLine_71ec17dc57625c5e: Oh you beautiful bastard. Smell that
RD_ALifeLine_74520d5927e7c78e: I want a gun for it
RD_ALifeLine_07e172212cbf6aa5: Ugh, fine. Forty-five, take it before I cry
RD_ALifeLine_596f1c570d85ab02: My hero. Don't tell the boss I said hero
RD_ALifeLine_53748cbb6d74bff0: Us. The prison runs itself now. Walls, guard towers, the works
RD_ALifeLine_786995643c3735ea: We took it back. Funny, huh? We built our kingdom in our old cage
RD_ALifeLine_739a001903f66ec9: First night I couldn't sleep. Door was open. Now I lock it myself
RD_ALifeLine_29bda7775e3d9f23: Some joined. Some turned. Some we turned
RD_ALifeLine_76c3b26b6c1bf9b5: Boss says rules are rules. First time you lose a hand. Second time..
RD_ALifeLine_270c9ad4020bd968: Barbaric is a word for people with courts. We got a rope
RD_ALifeLine_6a3faae35d97f840: Yeah. That's what I keep telling myself
RD_ALifeLine_61cafb262ddc803f: Then turn around. Some of us don't get to
RD_ALifeLine_68e7dec108a410ca: Your crew seems to like me
RD_ALifeLine_4063df02404dfc14: They do. Boss says you got a head on your shoulders. Wants you closer
RD_ALifeLine_61180edb5e679cc6: You've done right by us. There's a place for you, if you want it
RD_ALifeLine_06c24b6c27668001: Not in the crew. Beside it. Contractor. Steady work, first pick of the loot
RD_ALifeLine_16836ba215f4a1c2: Lone wolves die alone. But okay. The offer stands
RD_ALifeLine_0fe93e675ae43c3c: How do I get in good with the club
RD_ALifeLine_554e63870ce2a2e1: Prospects run errands. Want to be a prospect for a day?
RD_ALifeLine_2400b12b2021d307: Club needs gas. Club always needs gas. Bring some and we'll remember you
RD_ALifeLine_267eef5d0c6a2d34: I don't want to be a prospect
RD_ALifeLine_55bb6d8b2e6dfdcf: What happens if I bring it
RD_ALifeLine_39dc4d105c96f1a1: Good. Don't spill it. Don't drink it
RD_ALifeLine_6e9b1a764bc559db: You get a nod. A nod from us is worth more than you think
RD_ALifeLine_5e8203fd0c6e9701: Here. Club pays its debts. Always
RD_ALifeLine_51129f7c08cd398a: Are the gangs at peace now
RD_ALifeLine_014e9697063a6dcc: Truce. For now. Too many dead on both sides
RD_ALifeLine_7cda88a50bbceca9: We shook hands. First time in twenty years. Felt weird
RD_ALifeLine_19c902db3738867d: Till somebody gets drunk and says the wrong thing
RD_ALifeLine_1883ee4a1ce8b47a: My nephew. Their guy saved him from a pack of dead. Just.. did it
RD_ALifeLine_6c95e3f64b5b7073: Why is everybody avoiding the big guy
RD_ALifeLine_3bcfd9e736061825: Tank's in a mood. Somebody ate his peaches
RD_ALifeLine_44f4717c649bb1be: He crushed a guy's hand yesterday for touching his helmet
RD_ALifeLine_078e0ad770a1c028: Is he dangerous to you too
RD_ALifeLine_6d8ddac177d0ddfd: Why not get rid of him
RD_ALifeLine_398854533ee8df22: Me. Don't tell him. I'm serious, don't
RD_ALifeLine_00d520151d1821c5: To everybody. That's what makes him useful
RD_ALifeLine_4a0cc72602264ad6: You wanna try? I'll watch from over here
RD_ALifeLine_1f4379c25e119687: The Choir always has room. Can you sing?
RD_ALifeLine_6d7c4c9662275d7e: Join? You'd have to learn the songs. And bleed for them
RD_ALifeLine_2dca5d783cdef5c9: Nobody can. That's not the point
RD_ALifeLine_683456af0f08bcc7: That the dead are deaf and we are not. That's enough
RD_ALifeLine_7f3ee418048a1d34: Then don't be in front of us when we march
RD_ALifeLine_3ac04fdb1e56d5b1: Cause they got stuff and I got nothing. Pretty simple
RD_ALifeLine_56162ffe4d8def12: Survival. You're doing it too, you just feel bad about it
RD_ALifeLine_466e88bc7555c326: Ask! Ha! I asked my neighbor for water on day two. He shot at me
RD_ALifeLine_105bffb45f63aebd: Everybody's getting killed. I'm just getting killed with a full stomach
RD_ALifeLine_2f3f8660213e8100: What should I watch out for
RD_ALifeLine_376e2e36074fd107: The armored ones. Some crews dress a guy in plates and send him first
RD_ALifeLine_73082207734fa169: Juggernauts. You see a guy who doesn't go down, stop shooting his chest
RD_ALifeLine_1c32abb95494c4e9: Legs. Gaps. Or just run. Running's always on the table
RD_ALifeLine_0476617066cb13b3: Riot squads, prison guards, army trucks. Lotta dead people with good gear
RD_ALifeLine_29647cfd2810d2ba: Don't thank me. I want you to fight THEM, not us
RD_ALifeLine_0fc0468818094099: With fists? Ha! Okay, I like you
RD_ALifeLine_22f252b4293244fb: Ha. Nah. You're crazy. Crazy people fight dirty. I'm out
RD_ALifeLine_0136afdf32d0404a: Your friends? The ones who shot first?
RD_ALifeLine_489a94507187bf9a: Yeah. They came at us. Would you rather we let them?
RD_ALifeLine_50f27fe71d5ad10f: I just want to know why
RD_ALifeLine_6f56846f7d09df47: Nobody deserves anything out here. You get what you can keep
RD_ALifeLine_379246ff24dd3b9c: Then come on. Or walk away and live with it
RD_ALifeLine_42501c402e9465f1: Cause they wanted what we had. Same reason everybody does everything now
RD_ALifeLine_5bc131a507530235: How long have you been out here
RD_ALifeLine_4048033f7a7e7284: Since the start. Since we were nobodies. Now we're kings. Kings of trash, but kings
RD_ALifeLine_23fc20ce6ece2f96: You don't look like a king
RD_ALifeLine_3b4cce566aeedfe8: Everything you can see from the roof. Burned houses, dead roads, and us
RD_ALifeLine_6ef3210323853414: Ask me when I'm dying. I'll know then
RD_ALifeLine_4981c7e83bd34ed1: Kings don't look like anything anymore. They just stay alive longer
RD_ALifeLine_36cd91fd2a5c2b5a: Tired? I'm two months tired. My bones are tired. My gun's tired
RD_ALifeLine_47b0ff60148e4366: You know what I want? A Tuesday. A stupid boring Tuesday with a job I hate
RD_ALifeLine_7803199078458620: And be what? Food? Nah. This is what I am now
RD_ALifeLine_39ff0aff6b653db6: Says someone who never worked retail
RD_ALifeLine_276919db0e5153e3: Would your boss ever make peace
RD_ALifeLine_53cf76ef0ffcd952: Peace? With who? Everybody's either dead or paying us
RD_ALifeLine_748de6b1735b325a: He talks about it. Farms. Walls. Kids. Not stealing. Then he stops talking about it
RD_ALifeLine_25177c9c64f19bd7: The farm folk? Maybe. They grow, we guard. Not crazy, actually
RD_ALifeLine_6f3e643c00508696: Tell him. Go on. He might even listen to someone who isn't scared of him
RD_ALifeLine_241d5ea311ff5a70: That's what the boys say. That's why he stops talking
RD_ALifeLine_2b82cf711df438ca: Hell of a thing, raiders turning into cops. Who'd have thought
RD_ALifeLine_53978f9871730fab: Are you guys growing food now
RD_ALifeLine_4a14540974a37975: Turns out you run out of stuff to steal. Who knew. Potatoes don't shoot back
RD_ALifeLine_05472f63163c44c6: Took us long enough. Half the crew starved first
RD_ALifeLine_5535e3d30e317796: Laugh it up. Come back in winter and see who's laughing
RD_ALifeLine_1792961449522811: For you? Maybe. Help us guard it and you get a share
RD_ALifeLine_48fcaed67e6a15d2: What happened to the old boss
RD_ALifeLine_55689c2a7529b410: Died in his sleep. Like a king. Now his two lieutenants are tearing the crew apart
RD_ALifeLine_678e4399375ba614: Old King's gone. Half of us follow the son, half follow the guy who actually did the work
RD_ALifeLine_24695ebc328bce0a: The one who pays. Right now that's the son. Tomorrow? Ask me tomorrow
RD_ALifeLine_1d2274ff064470d2: Already is. Two of ours shot two of ours last night. Funeral's at noon
RD_ALifeLine_4cf3555157d2e6ff: Neither. Wait for the winner. Then smile at him
RD_ALifeLine_2526c640057528b3: Why are you guys always singing
RD_ALifeLine_6481c0ba376bc252: The Choir sings. The dead hate it. We love it
RD_ALifeLine_735e72274b45b908: Before a fight, we sing. After a fight, we sing louder. Keeps the fear out
RD_ALifeLine_3dd11bf2388c1ef0: Old stuff. Church stuff. Bar stuff. Whatever we remember
RD_ALifeLine_029bf9b64c612a1a: You'll hear it. Right before we come for you. Kidding. Mostly kidding
RD_ALifeLine_163ab80d18ea37ed: Showoffs. They live high, behind windows, and think nobody can reach em
RD_ALifeLine_27589f71075ab428: Glass Kings? They took the tallest building they could find and called it a throne
RD_ALifeLine_171e810a2478b461: The Vultures are trying. The Choir's trying. Everybody's trying
RD_ALifeLine_70852184340d1a35: Cause they can see everything coming. And cause it sounds cool. Mostly that
RD_ALifeLine_60f37e2f416cad82: Dangerous? They shoot from forty floors up. You don't even hear it
RD_ALifeLine_20a284416291ef7b: Tell me about the Red Vulture Cartel
RD_ALifeLine_6a6fc25c149fcea7: Don't say that name so loud
RD_ALifeLine_0d69818e31f24688: They were real money before. Now they're real guns. The best guns. Fast little SMGs
RD_ALifeLine_21e3fb8d4f6f795f: Everything. And the roof. Always the roof
RD_ALifeLine_3c0cf7b005e45d58: Everybody can be bought. They just can't be bought by you
RD_ALifeLine_150ca777510ecb9e: Stay away from Louisville. Stay away from anybody wearing red. Easy
RD_ALifeLine_3d191c4476ef836d: Black Ledger. We keep books. Who owes, who paid, who's dead
RD_ALifeLine_540ed6cf7d2abfbc: Private security. Was private. Is still private. Just no more paperwork
RD_ALifeLine_0e15eab241dd89fc: Whoever pays best. Today that's nobody, so I'm talking to you
RD_ALifeLine_2d9a6ece3a6ec9af: Depends. What's your budget? Ha, look at your face
RD_ALifeLine_33cdca3d0b6cdc95: Names. Yours isn't in it. Keep it that way
RD_ALifeLine_627a514216063c96: Bring me something real and we'll talk rates
RD_ALifeLine_202ab343437bbec4: I remember cops. I remember running from cops. Now I miss em
RD_ALifeLine_1c91713f48adfe44: Isn't that something? I'd give a finger for a speeding ticket
RD_ALifeLine_5046cea97655841a: Cause back then the worst thing that could happen was jail. Now it's.. everything
RD_ALifeLine_72682ca56ec39dd0: Yeah. Three square meals and a bed. Sounds like paradise now
RD_ALifeLine_263fe8de0bd37d53: Yeah? Huh. Didn't think I'd ever say that out loud
RD_ALifeLine_22686aa8535fb8cc: You heard anything about a way out
RD_ALifeLine_1ed9ba8a4a76871e: The heli. Everybody's heard about the heli
RD_ALifeLine_22bf92a061c8b99d: Some roof somewhere. Some bird that lands and takes you away. Fairy tale
RD_ALifeLine_1b054ea978fd4a99: I believe in canned beans and bullets. That's my religion now
RD_ALifeLine_20e5bb9d147da8b5: ..Yeah. Yeah, I'd go. I'd leave all of this. Don't tell the crew
RD_ALifeLine_672212872f8e6d97: The tower. The one the three crews are killing each other over. That's your answer
RD_ALifeLine_4653e43b5fc378f0: Yeah. You're the one who didn't die. I keep track
RD_ALifeLine_1fdaf0e073635fec: You again. You know, at this point you're like the weather. Always around
RD_ALifeLine_1e177bb5005e3c7e: One day one of us gets the other
RD_ALifeLine_4d393df41a1ebc34: Maybe. Bring a job. I'm bored of the usual
RD_ALifeLine_683ade58213f09fd: Ugh. Don't get sappy on me. ..thanks
RD_ALifeLine_2e6c5be13fa291e3: Probably. But not today. Today I'm too tired
RD_ALifeLine_1c42df6e5fcca6a3: Big? I got huge. I need eyes on the Vultures' street crew. Where they come out, what they carry
RD_ALifeLine_5a1555b73967a53e: You want the big leagues? Scout the cartel's sortie point. Don't get spotted
RD_ALifeLine_22e09557349c76d2: Good. If you die, I'll sing at your funeral. Badly
RD_ALifeLine_7bd90da336435512: Everything's suicide now. This one pays
RD_ALifeLine_7ededee414450997: A forty-five, and coordinates to a place nobody's looted
RD_ALifeLine_53e39ccb7e9b595a: Holy shit, you came back. Talk
RD_ALifeLine_53ad7cda78743d7b: Gun and the coordinates, like you said
RD_ALifeLine_542b9fb1694ce8bd: Pistol. The coordinates cost extra, sorry
RD_ALifeLine_01d44ef265ad7127: Fine, fine. Here's both. You earned every bit
RD_ALifeLine_6749226632334d14: And this. A spot nobody's touched. Go see
RD_ALifeLine_1f0b96e20a7ac7e6: How many raids you been on
RD_ALifeLine_3fd719f51284eeb3: Lost count after fifty. Lost friends after ten
RD_ALifeLine_4556a24a5d71fa02: Enough to know which houses fight back. Yours looks like it fights back
RD_ALifeLine_160a73b7699312ae: The doing gets easier. The after doesn't
RD_ALifeLine_1ce8cddc15cf7d08: The ones with boards on the windows and nothing on the porch. Means they're ready
RD_ALifeLine_2c77e26c7859a78a: Cause I like you. And because I'll know if you're lying when the boss asks
RD_ALifeLine_02ea1bc565420b03: Land. Ha. Yeah, it's land now, with borders and taxes and everything
RD_ALifeLine_595253d71bb40e76: You're passing? Then pay, or show me the mark
RD_ALifeLine_45aea03928f36530: I'm passing whether you like it or not
RD_ALifeLine_70f2d1815bb3197b: Oh, you're one of the circle folk. Go ahead, safe travels
RD_ALifeLine_3ce467e304ea1c9b: One box of anything that goes bang
RD_ALifeLine_341ec53429222538: Brave words for one person against.. well, all of us
RD_ALifeLine_685fc76f0acdb3dc: Or meds. We always need meds
RD_ALifeLine_5fd6df933cf5c28c: Pleasure. Don't stop on our roads
RD_ALifeLine_5ecadec517e2d434: Around's a long way. Lots of hungry dead
RD_ALifeLine_6c4d2e44216db711: Is that a kid with your crew
RD_ALifeLine_168bdc483abebc73: Yeah. Found her in a car. Nobody else was gonna take her
RD_ALifeLine_1a1c31ab13b0b14c: Don't look at me like that. She's safer with twenty killers than alone
RD_ALifeLine_519ecc710beda567: What kind of life is that
RD_ALifeLine_0b2aa6e7639552eb: Does she know what you do
RD_ALifeLine_4831c3a418a7e334: Don't tell anybody. I got a reputation
RD_ALifeLine_2529875253816011: A life. That's more than most get
RD_ALifeLine_506714a21d035aba: She knows we keep her fed. That's all she needs right now
RD_ALifeLine_24cee00f7baf64e6: What happens when the ammo runs out
RD_ALifeLine_0289ad9d4fb01e10: Knives. Then teeth. Then we die. Simple plan
RD_ALifeLine_4f8a1c533216f0a9: We're already making bullets. Badly. Half of em jam. The other half explode
RD_ALifeLine_1e6c1ea10c0d7881: Grim's the weather now. Get used to it
RD_ALifeLine_309d38010e1f6f09: Old guy in the crew used to reload. Brass, powder, prayers
RD_ALifeLine_3aea443d273600f5: Trade with who? People hide when they see us coming. That's on us, I know
RD_ALifeLine_1208bdea36c981e6: There's faces. You don't forget faces
RD_ALifeLine_00c3c1747b017a95: Everyone did bad things to survive
RD_ALifeLine_38ea9dba4f0628a5: Yeah? Maybe. Help me start. Bring something to the farm folk with me, not taking, giving
RD_ALifeLine_0624eef4240acefe: No. But it's what I got
RD_ALifeLine_3cdf42bc296706cd: Not like me. Not like us
RD_ALifeLine_18d94ec957074242: What's the world look like now
RD_ALifeLine_3168e74249285799: Little kings. Little countries. Walls everywhere. Some of us got it better than before
RD_ALifeLine_558b643e6fdc1bdb: Raiders here, farmers there, soldiers who forgot what they're fighting for. It's medieval, man
RD_ALifeLine_6be29a3668eeefbb: Back then I was a nobody with debt. Now I got a crew, a gun, a bed. Messed up, right
RD_ALifeLine_467374032c3e81c2: You? You're the wanderer. Every story's got one. They usually die in the middle
RD_ALifeLine_7ab5f093621ae27d: Nothing lasts. That's the only rule that survived
RD_ALifeLine_0ad343991dd28764: What does the boss think of me
RD_ALifeLine_2daf51e85d1b865e: He says you're the only person out there he'd trust with his back. That's huge
RD_ALifeLine_314ce5e713716eac: He wants you at the table. Real seat. Your say on raids, your cut of everything
RD_ALifeLine_595de77b6c87af88: What would I have to do
RD_ALifeLine_0d9eff131c3af585: He'll be happy. Watch the others though, envy kills faster than lead
RD_ALifeLine_25c1f505266e5f9f: He knows. That's why he likes you. You keep him honest
RD_ALifeLine_6505283975af3cd2: Show up. Tell him when he's wrong. Nobody else does
RD_ALifeLine_6c574dbf7b6f75ac: Whoa, easy, I'm not looking for trouble
RD_ALifeLine_18b3a3c84a598c43: Nobody's ever looking for trouble. Trouble's looking for you. Bag. Now
RD_ALifeLine_1fe0b2b0342d8b4a: Hands up. Bag on the ground. Don't make me ask nice twice
RD_ALifeLine_1867e4aa35e4feaf: You really wanna do this here? It's loud, the dead will come
RD_ALifeLine_675281134a311639: I know your boss, he won't like this
RD_ALifeLine_1778b27b7059536c: Everybody's got something. Shoes. Teeth. Let's see
RD_ALifeLine_3be7ab7c30e95194: Good. Smart. Smart people live longer
RD_ALifeLine_58ac159e4a040b40: Then I'll be quick about it. Bag
RD_ALifeLine_3e5213e1646cd4b5: ..Shit, you're right. Okay. Go. GO, before I change my mind
RD_ALifeLine_6592c7c36393c783: You.. wait, you're that one? Shit. Okay, forget this, walk
RD_ALifeLine_7d326faf56db0be2: ..Wow. You really are broke. That's sad. Get outta here
RD_ALifeLine_13d9e6ef7b10bc55: You've got a nice smile for a robber
RD_ALifeLine_0359146643fc7567: I'm serious, you've got kind eyes
RD_ALifeLine_314f48842e9f0f59: Kind eyes. Ha. My eyes are the last thing a lot of people saw. Bag
RD_ALifeLine_2a1499e04fe99c1d: Shut up. ..okay. Okay, go. Nobody tells anyone this happened
RD_ALifeLine_43f4f99b5d46c5d1: What if I just give you something and we both walk
RD_ALifeLine_6641f10673516074: A deal? I love a deal. What you got
RD_ALifeLine_7e020b7a7d9b7343: Ooh. Real currency. Walk, friend. Walk happy
RD_ALifeLine_6637f67266a391b0: Oh you beautiful thing. Go on, scram
RD_ALifeLine_54eb847d21991b7d: Then why'd you open your mouth? Bag. All of it
RD_ALifeLine_20defdc6564bcfb3: No. You're not taking my stuff
RD_ALifeLine_774fd8df5ccf2b35: Excuse me? I got a gun on you and you're saying no?
RD_ALifeLine_254cc22f787c7e94: Oh, we got a hero. Look boys, a hero
RD_ALifeLine_05bf961a4b952200: You'll have to kill me first
RD_ALifeLine_3732c3f132e08c9b: ..Fine. You're not worth the bullet. Not today
RD_ALifeLine_2952a54c6b09ff54: Don't tempt me. ..ugh, you're crazy. Crazy's bad for business. Go
RD_ALifeLine_20600fc6120bbe14: That's what I thought. On the ground
RD_ALifeLine_29a7094c5f547d16: Please, I've got people waiting for me
RD_ALifeLine_6a21420123896842: Everybody's got people. I got people. My people are hungry
RD_ALifeLine_3900e7ef2b1cda67: ..Sick how. Bit sick or cold sick
RD_ALifeLine_50ec43f57aa693ef: Your crew. Sure. I see nobody. Bag
RD_ALifeLine_55615a4e46b7e336: Close? How close? ..shit. Fine. We never met
RD_ALifeLine_389a9f7b45effa80: Ha! Honest at least. I'll only take half then
RD_ALifeLine_4e821dcd1c94e5df: Ugh. Go. Keep your meds. I had a mom too
RD_ALifeLine_09a6319b462a7606: Come on, we're on the same side here
RD_ALifeLine_2647f6907015c1a7: Same side? There's no sides. There's me and there's lunch
RD_ALifeLine_2a4a236815827703: Against the cops that left us
RD_ALifeLine_3be7e9824f8f8e72: I've done work for crews like yours
RD_ALifeLine_22e04b0d45d056d3: Dead don't take my stuff. People do. You're people
RD_ALifeLine_2a59284c24b9ad41: Ha. Okay, that's a good one. You get a pass for that
RD_ALifeLine_133025445dfdacc0: Yeah? ..yeah, I heard about you. Fine. Walk
RD_ALifeLine_7785ca3664ca85d5: You call yourself a robber? You're shaking
RD_ALifeLine_59ae9e9d5387a1be: I'm not shaking! It's- shut UP
RD_ALifeLine_490a4a445f445ff2: Put it down before you hurt yourself
RD_ALifeLine_7e415895084abb36: Nice try. It's off. Wanna see?
RD_ALifeLine_7a5659aa7aa97041: Shut up! Just.. give me the food and I'll go
RD_ALifeLine_42bdabb01810a3b3: SHIT. Okay, okay, I'm leaving, don't- don't follow me
RD_ALifeLine_250dd1e815b83abd: I'm just walking through, no disrespect
RD_ALifeLine_7046ae83585bde5c: No disrespect? Walking through our block without asking IS disrespect
RD_ALifeLine_11a2b29d68965460: You know whose corner this is? Do you?
RD_ALifeLine_4d3e2df8152af444: Yours. I'm sorry. I'll go around
RD_ALifeLine_79e6c92f051c7005: I don't care whose corner it is
RD_ALifeLine_39d02d964d098a42: That's better. Next time ask first
RD_ALifeLine_4698c83d2bafd112: Respect. See? Respect's easy. Go ahead
RD_ALifeLine_77e7c5e42acdaa5a: Oh, you don't care? Let's teach you to care
RD_ALifeLine_5017b05527167304: Club's road. You were on it. That's a fine
RD_ALifeLine_577fa2d2331e3c9e: We saw you from a mile off. Nice ride. Wanna keep it?
RD_ALifeLine_4fef268d7fbe35ba: Gas. A can. Or that pretty rifle on your back. Your call
RD_ALifeLine_106323c269737774: Now you know. Knowledge is a gift. Gifts deserve gifts
RD_ALifeLine_1432e9b009c31342: Brave. Real brave. We got ten bikes and you got one opinion
RD_ALifeLine_4003508402845c4c: That's how it's done. Ride safe, citizen
RD_ALifeLine_3aa4bc8f5e8cc1b2: Then you're walking. Leave the keys
RD_ALifeLine_24499b1012c1cb24: Drop it. I've got you covered
RD_ALifeLine_44830ac37591f819: Whoa. Whoa whoa. Where'd you come from
RD_ALifeLine_751896b660c310c3: Okay! Okay, I'm down, I'm down, don't do anything stupid
RD_ALifeLine_294d55b202539a40: You're robbing ME? That's.. okay, that's fair. Here
RD_ALifeLine_1ce7615d465fa9a7: Are you gonna rob me too
RD_ALifeLine_46d7df4f69ceabca: Me? Nah. I'm off the clock
RD_ALifeLine_0c107b5d12ad8b0a: Not today. Robbing's for when you're hungry. I just ate
RD_ALifeLine_51515be439cac8f2: What do you do off the clock
RD_ALifeLine_0775d04861f35852: You rob people for a living?
RD_ALifeLine_55759b3b011e023a: Sit. Smoke. Think about my life choices. Mostly the smoking part
RD_ALifeLine_1195829b2ec36e05: Tomorrow I might be hungry again, so don't stick around
RD_ALifeLine_5a2c030532a1972b: It's not a living. It's a dying. Slower than the other options
RD_ALifeLine_11d71a8428d435b0: You're the one who robbed me
RD_ALifeLine_74c1edd80fef7dda: Did I? You all look the same with your hands up
RD_ALifeLine_6a06028853c7222f: Oh. Yeah. Hey. No hard feelings, right?
RD_ALifeLine_1c829f0042780420: Spent it. Ate it. Shot it. Sorry, it's gone
RD_ALifeLine_17063b274d47382b: See? You're a big person. Here, a smoke, on me
RD_ALifeLine_321e035a05c7b285: Good. Remember I let you walk too
RD_ALifeLine_3231366b76f2ef64: Tell your crew to back off
RD_ALifeLine_18f179116edbe4f7: My crew does what it wants. That's why it's a crew
RD_ALifeLine_7d8ee3c1503ef43e: And why would I do that
RD_ALifeLine_326b4d280f498ecf: Start then. Let's see who's faster
RD_ALifeLine_5215585d02ef3f06: ..Alright. Alright. Boys! Back up, give em room
RD_ALifeLine_491be49e4eb4bedf: Pay how much? A box gets you an hour of peace
RD_ALifeLine_324fb70e0bc42098: Boys, relax. Our friend here bought a little quiet
RD_ALifeLine_0d917671400764af: Oh, last warning, she says. I'm shaking
RD_ALifeLine_666d12295fc7516a: Wow. Tough talk. Got the guns to back it up?
RD_ALifeLine_7ae1b0fc5f39f933: You saw what I did to the last crew
RD_ALifeLine_171da38f4f447c6e: ..That was you? Shit. Okay. We're going, we're going
RD_ALifeLine_40af27600e0dee0e: ..Not worth it. Not worth it. Let's go
RD_ALifeLine_5e6cc73718c7598d: I'm the one who wiped out the last crew that tried this
RD_ALifeLine_1a62fb6842690b13: I'm the one who helps people around here
RD_ALifeLine_2346a1274570b8a3: ..Oh. Oh shit. Okay. Yeah. We're cool, right? We're cool
RD_ALifeLine_01837e1b7f239b76: Sure you are. And I'm the Pope. Move along
RD_ALifeLine_68b11ef318ef50b8: The do-gooder. Ha. Okay, do-gooder, I'll leave you be today
RD_ALifeLine_3e1c38a05652a828: Give me one reason not to shoot you
RD_ALifeLine_3702ac4a057fee7f: I-I got stuff! Good stuff! Take it!
RD_ALifeLine_2832557b1902801a: Please! I didn't even shoot! I was just holding it!
RD_ALifeLine_6763daf0386a540b: Tell me where your camp is
RD_ALifeLine_5fa0503767516417: Okay! Okay! Thank you! Thank you!
RD_ALifeLine_6b988e110f4dfc75: I.. they'll kill me. They'll KILL me
RD_ALifeLine_1d8e779c78094b65: Cause I'm crying! Who fakes this?!
RD_ALifeLine_56e3ac1f274300d0: Home? I.. I don't have one. But thank you. I won't forget
RD_ALifeLine_42bd959545a74f9b: ..Okay. Here. It's marked. Please don't tell em it was me
RD_ALifeLine_59286dc948083a00: Okay, okay, what do you wanna know
RD_ALifeLine_03315bd24cb8f147: Where do you keep the supplies
RD_ALifeLine_189620c62f80adfd: Twelve. Maybe ten now. You.. you got two of em
RD_ALifeLine_45737b3f246056a0: A guy. Big. Mean. I don't know his real name, we just call him the King
RD_ALifeLine_04b51e214fa593d6: Back at the camp. Under the floor. Please, that's all I know
RD_ALifeLine_5870d25c00e4e01e: They had food. They had guns. I had nothing
RD_ALifeLine_7fd4d8960485ed33: I'm nineteen. I didn't sign up for this. I didn't sign up for anything
RD_ALifeLine_343f274d01ed4427: Where?! Where do I go? ..okay. Okay. I'll try
RD_ALifeLine_5dd4e70769655680: I know. I KNOW. Just.. make it quick, or let me go
RD_ALifeLine_371f9cec444bb683: ..Why are you being nice to me. Thanks. I won't forget
RD_ALifeLine_38d113a9630eb3bc: Your friends are dead. What now
RD_ALifeLine_0095fc6a1e48c0ba: Do what you're gonna do. I'm too tired to beg
RD_ALifeLine_7287ee7a21edbcea: Leave. Tell others what happened here
RD_ALifeLine_59d66c1e1a05c090: Drop the weapon and the bag
RD_ALifeLine_38004e8d4e9bdc93: Yeah. I'll tell them. I'll tell them not to come
RD_ALifeLine_3aa911056b421fb4: Fine. Take it. It's all I got
RD_ALifeLine_51b1410f241c6af8: Boss said you had stuff. Boss is over there. Dead. Funny
RD_ALifeLine_4973cfda36976b08: Why did your crew hit my place
RD_ALifeLine_365f7fc731b82fbb: Business. Nothing personal. Your place had walls and food. That's a target
RD_ALifeLine_519951e83fe0ca6c: You stopped paying. Or you never started. Same thing
RD_ALifeLine_670b929967bec1f4: Smart. Talk to the collector. He'll paint your door
RD_ALifeLine_119824ad69ade4d8: Yeah? We'll bring more next time. We always bring more
RD_ALifeLine_680182d80d97b568: Same guy who gives every order. You wanna complain, you go up there
RD_ALifeLine_7c2984a505c446b2: Hit the wrong house. They had a sniper on the roof
RD_ALifeLine_2c6d03a130e123f1: Raid went bad. We lost three. Three!
RD_ALifeLine_5a17268b34cfff87: Luck. Ha. Luck's what you call it when the other guy planned better
RD_ALifeLine_206afff70381820a: And starve? Every week you're either the hammer or the nail
RD_ALifeLine_7da0eade73438f84: Somebody who's gonna get a visit from the whole crew next time
RD_ALifeLine_467e17f0191c14f5: Hey. Listen. I'm not supposed to tell you this
RD_ALifeLine_69ed651c24640d54: Big raid's coming. This way. Couple of nights. Board up or move out
RD_ALifeLine_44c113c7504bc302: Cause you've been decent to me. And I'm tired of burying people I like
RD_ALifeLine_6d5881a116f6892a: Too many. A dozen, maybe more. One of em's a tank in armor
RD_ALifeLine_6e71bbf317ec564f: Don't thank me. Just don't be there
RD_ALifeLine_261d8fe96b465646: Nobody kills the tank. That's.. that's the whole point of the tank
RD_ALifeLine_63f5c4b26c2be486: He didn't give me a choice
RD_ALifeLine_7f9359951174552f: ..Shit. Shit shit. The boss is gonna lose it
RD_ALifeLine_35cee5ec4cd202b0: No! No. I'm good. I'm real good
RD_ALifeLine_0665db1751d15bb3: He never gives anyone a choice. That's why we kept him in front
RD_ALifeLine_30199833255a7b23: The tank. Our own tank. When he gets mad, even we hide
RD_ALifeLine_17e761a04d7f55dc: Honestly? The big guy in armor. Even when he's on our side
RD_ALifeLine_319ade520c21cf8d: Seems like he's the real boss
RD_ALifeLine_75f6852525879944: Cause he's on our side. Mostly
RD_ALifeLine_07098417432867fc: You don't. You point him at someone else
RD_ALifeLine_2e1abc9469dc901c: Shh. Don't let the real boss hear that
RD_ALifeLine_6ad0a1fe16b8e607: Who did this to your camp
RD_ALifeLine_6c6a86a63336af98: Another crew. Bigger. They came at night, took everything
RD_ALifeLine_47090d8c08407e6b: Somebody hit us like we hit everybody else. Funny, right? Not funny
RD_ALifeLine_436f3d6a0522c844: Say that again. I dare you
RD_ALifeLine_45690b8560750b44: You'd help us? After everything crews like us did? ..huh
RD_ALifeLine_2c0ef0a92b67a783: Regroup. Then pay them back. Double
RD_ALifeLine_68ab42780daa4e2c: Bring us food if you got it. We'll remember
RD_ALifeLine_3934e7930aa86fc1: Boss got stabbed. Not bad. Okay, kinda bad. We need meds
RD_ALifeLine_6ca48a3d4e23eeed: My guy's leg is going green. I need pills, real ones, and I need em yesterday
RD_ALifeLine_3ed9d9d516a37ce0: Hurry. He's starting to talk to people who aren't there
RD_ALifeLine_5a311b245793dea0: Cause the pharmacy's in somebody else's turf, and they know my face
RD_ALifeLine_7b9f1d941fbb25a5: Then don't be around when he dies. He gets mean when he's dying
RD_ALifeLine_38b8e63d490a9746: Oh thank god. Okay. You saved a life. A bad one, but a life
RD_ALifeLine_7d7836687db735df: Pay me well, I saved your boss
RD_ALifeLine_653199e6684ad9da: Ammo, and our thanks. That's worth more than you think
RD_ALifeLine_0dff7b607bbe9fec: Yeah. Yeah you did. Here, his own piece. He won't miss it, he can't walk
RD_ALifeLine_71da3a862f5ca190: Yeah actually. I gotta walk to a trade spot. Not far. Dead everywhere
RD_ALifeLine_73a0ba2f61d731a2: Short walk, big bag. If someone jumps me, you shoot first
RD_ALifeLine_6fd70fdc5fa1d02c: Stay close. Not too close. I sweat when I'm nervous
RD_ALifeLine_5269befb207c288b: Things. Valuable things. Stop asking, start walking
RD_ALifeLine_2ac778b276c294be: My crew's the reason I need a bodyguard
RD_ALifeLine_07da723a077ca998: Alive! Both of us. That's a good day
RD_ALifeLine_2ebc8fd82eb8a693: Here. Food and a box. Come by if you want more work
RD_ALifeLine_35ee02c3617b963e: Always. The other crew has a stash. I want what's in it
RD_ALifeLine_167cae3e1623885b: Dirty? How dirty. Like.. stealing from thieves dirty?
RD_ALifeLine_26c38541315b99f1: Bring me three boxes of nine. Keep anything else you find
RD_ALifeLine_0b000c233680abe5: Risky's the only kind of job left
RD_ALifeLine_3627406f08fde53d: Look at that. Hah! They're gonna be SO pissed
RD_ALifeLine_0d3bd3d860ea534a: One box goes back to me, plus a gun
RD_ALifeLine_6ebe557805ec912e: Your cut. Box of rounds. Clean
RD_ALifeLine_63466a5c5780b536: There's a rat. Used to ride with us, sold us out. Last seen near the marked spot
RD_ALifeLine_52ce57962a108634: Bounty. One guy. Doesn't matter if he's walking or not anymore, bring proof
RD_ALifeLine_7e8129393d932dfa: Good. Bring me his tag or his note. Everybody in the crew wore one
RD_ALifeLine_7ecae8f7658ab6bf: Told the army where our camp was. We lost six
RD_ALifeLine_7c85b2c01787705c: Then you're a coward with a gun. Most people are
RD_ALifeLine_4651154e4cc01ecb: How do I earn your trust
RD_ALifeLine_181b155036f56631: Kill stuff. Dead stuff. Lots of it, where I marked
RD_ALifeLine_15065b937eeccc22: Trust? Go thin the herd by our spot. Then we talk trust
RD_ALifeLine_08ef719428f57036: Don't die. Dead people can't be trusted
RD_ALifeLine_6723eebd0d264877: That's it. You'd be surprised how many people run
RD_ALifeLine_5364dd681dc5b9cc: Alright. You're not a stranger anymore
RD_ALifeLine_3036edbe207c13e9: Here, eat something. And come back, I got more work
RD_ALifeLine_0715574b5d4143dc: Nails. Always nails. Our wall's held together with spit
RD_ALifeLine_6bd2f4a0645843cd: Our wall's falling apart. Bring nails, I'll make it worth your while
RD_ALifeLine_52b5645f5bfef9ac: Use the dead for a wall
RD_ALifeLine_4c0272c43f3d8137: Twenty, at least. More if you love me
RD_ALifeLine_2bfefdf66892f709: We tried. They keep walking off
RD_ALifeLine_73c61501673bab39: Take these. Tools we don't need. Well, we need em, but you need em more
RD_ALifeLine_067be75c463bfa88: About the payment for that job
RD_ALifeLine_6431be9a061f0d01: What about it? You got paid
RD_ALifeLine_14b6c9d40c74cef8: Oh no, you're one of those. The renegotiators
RD_ALifeLine_66bee64a1f2e26df: I want a better deal next time
RD_ALifeLine_6438823b6a4b6fda: You underpaid me and you know it
RD_ALifeLine_56779a0b6a81f4c9: Next time? Do it faster, do it cleaner, and maybe
RD_ALifeLine_48d5f3742285b674: I paid you what you were worth. Get better, get paid better
RD_ALifeLine_1635ee4e5a62442b: ..Okay, yeah, I did. Here, call it a bonus
RD_ALifeLine_5b275711047d37f4: I'd like to trade with you
RD_ALifeLine_06a1efa273a4e590: I want to know so I can stay away
RD_ALifeLine_1ceb581d712533bc: Trade. Yeah, okay. You've been straight with us. Here, I'll mark it
RD_ALifeLine_03744d050c520853: Just asking gets you shot. Earn it
RD_ALifeLine_224393f04f74b972: Ha. Smart. Just don't come knocking at night, that's all I'll say
RD_ALifeLine_1698cebe6d72c53b: Come from the front, slow, hands visible. The guards are twitchy
RD_ALifeLine_439ab8227bcdea19: Can you show me your camp
RD_ALifeLine_1d661ce6070fa0d3: Sure! Sure, it's that way. Big house. Go knock
RD_ALifeLine_3f16e8b658a6ae4b: Oh, absolutely. Just keep walking that way, you'll see it
RD_ALifeLine_45305a515e447fa0: No problem. Tell em I sent you. They'll love you
RD_ALifeLine_1c21bfa319f96ff5: ..Yeah. I'm lying. Got a problem with it?
RD_ALifeLine_5885974638118725: Walk you? Ha. No. You walk. Alone. Bye
RD_ALifeLine_015ab3e65475ca9e: In? Who said anything about in?
RD_ALifeLine_26e5289760ea11fe: Stop there. That's the line. You cross it, you're a target
RD_ALifeLine_1c19333c47a4c64a: Trade's at the gate. Not inside. What you got
RD_ALifeLine_370497783d1e6dc8: Yeah? ..yeah, I know your face. Fine, you can see the yard. Not the house
RD_ALifeLine_3ae8616e0bd67561: Shelter's for crew. You crew? No. Then no
RD_ALifeLine_20729fe13f16817f: Fair. Two cans. Now back off the gate
RD_ALifeLine_035a828319789030: How do I find you again
RD_ALifeLine_02f5d1924029707e: Here. I'll mark our place. Don't share it
RD_ALifeLine_2b4df3760d747607: If somebody else shows up with that mark, I'll know it was you
RD_ALifeLine_0331e81b2be0838d: Then come. Bring something, but come
RD_ALifeLine_5ee98c1f3bdd9dff: Me? You don't. I reach you
RD_ALifeLine_0186b41c40fe3158: I move around. But I'll find you. Here, so you know my face on the map
RD_ALifeLine_3d517bb16bfdd39f: Can I at least know your name
RD_ALifeLine_756b07da48a1b70f: You know where the other crews hide
RD_ALifeLine_060d02bd6ae867fc: Sure I do. But that kind of info costs blood or bullets
RD_ALifeLine_78d62ee961fdc7ac: Their camp? Course I know. They know where mine is too. It's a whole thing
RD_ALifeLine_321691f143a654d3: Box of rounds. And you never heard it from me
RD_ALifeLine_196f42d31efe8a50: To hit em, or to stay away. Either way it's worth knowing
RD_ALifeLine_328d180a0ffe57d3: There. Marked. Don't get yourself killed, you're a good customer
RD_ALifeLine_172c1cdc17d3bdd2: Then stay ignorant. Ignorance is cheap
RD_ALifeLine_297a144e25192baa: Born and raised. Same three blocks my whole life

RD_ALifeLine_745c52f51cdfd7f0: Don't get seen. If they see you, they see me

RD_ALifeLine_2a83c5b533096027: Fish, frogs, whatever floats by. Some of it's even food

RD_ALifeLine_5b54a36d14f55265: Okay. Tomorrow then. If we're both still.. you know. Here
RD_ALifeLine_100466b411d9b82a: *Laughs* At least you're honest. Okay, tomorrow. I'll find a bat or something

RD_ALifeLine_565e6867651b32ff: I can't. Every time I think about food I think about.. what they eat
RD_ALifeLine_39871ec013e95d40: You think so? *Wipes face* Thanks. I needed one person to say that
RD_ALifeLine_155d9e5a0639dc2c: Okay. Crackers. I can do crackers

RD_ALifeLine_79a2534809050164: Since yesterday. He's warm, like really warm. Fever. Fever is good, right? It means he's fighting it

RD_ALifeLine_48e069a51be7be5b: ..Shut up. Just- shut up. You don't know him

RD_ALifeLine_2f31552220bd1759: Want a tip? Stay off the main streets

RD_ALifeLine_73b207ec5042a190: Back streets, okay. Thanks. You got one more of those tips?
RD_ALifeLine_57a386d06895fb46: Don't run unless you have to
RD_ALifeLine_5f6ec5cb20ee8992: His name is Biscuit and he hates everyone except me. He's waiting. I know he is
RD_ALifeLine_5dbf1f8531a9abd4: Got it. Writing it down in my brain. Okay. Wish me luck
RD_ALifeLine_18c0ecc65e149499: *Smiles* Yeah. I'll tell him a stranger said hi. He'll hiss at you, it's a compliment

RD_ALifeLine_28f1c31d509046c4: Two days ago? Half a can of beans. Cold. I'm saving the other half

RD_ALifeLine_3ee36c1969fbb6f6: Ration it, you're doing it right

RD_ALifeLine_5343daba1e9c6344: Oh- oh my God. Thank you. I don't- thank you. I won't forget this

RD_ALifeLine_57edd93b07cef595: Okay. I'll hold you to that. If we're both around to check

RD_ALifeLine_6c95109062b06ba2: Go further. Morning, when it's quiet
RD_ALifeLine_5528e3392015ee64: Chips! Real chips! Oh I'm gonna cry. I'm not gonna cry. I'm crying a bit
