RD_ALifeLine_027fd2216a73b4cf: With who? Everyone I knew is.. yeah. Unless you're volunteering?
RD_ALifeLine_585fc3f53da63f15: Right? Porcelain! They can't bite through porcelain. Probably. I hope
RD_ALifeLine_129ee4ef2938fcf9: Yeah. No, I get it. Can't trust anyone. I wouldn't trust me either
RD_ALifeLine_593966af0aec0a0b: The tap's still running but it tastes like pennies. Is that bad? That's probably bad
RD_ALifeLine_386fbd4b552b1373: I've been drinking from the water heater. Learned that from a guy on day two. He's dead now
RD_ALifeLine_42e2753d005a7bac: Fill everything you've got while it runs
RD_ALifeLine_0ed99aec14d5f14b: The water heater trick is a good one
RD_ALifeLine_1d12926b004d031e: Boil it. Right. Takes forever but okay. Pennies plus fire. Delicious
RD_ALifeLine_1996fceb09018e8e: Everything? Like.. the bathtub? Pots? Oh. OH. Because it's gonna stop. Shit
RD_ALifeLine_10a9f33506ab938e: Yeah. I said a little prayer for him every time I fill a bottle. Weird, huh
RD_ALifeLine_4c98a03320b1e581: Okay. Going home to fill every bucket I own. Thanks, seriously
RD_ALifeLine_687373141997a28c: The noise is getting worse at night. There's more of them. Every night more
RD_ALifeLine_703c190b3d54cbeb: Someone set the gas station on fire. Saw the smoke from my roof. Burned all day
RD_ALifeLine_1940a81f2da10aeb: A car went by yesterday. Honking. Like a parade. Then it stopped honking
RD_ALifeLine_263274816e6ba2c4: That car was a dinner bell
RD_ALifeLine_270fb96a3dd62e06: From everywhere. Every person who didn't make it. That's where they come from
RD_ALifeLine_0e9f3a5e1181862d: No idea. Maybe an accident. Maybe someone wanted the noise somewhere else. Smart, kinda. Evil, kinda
RD_ALifeLine_016115277d736f75: Yeah. I watched it all from the window. Didn't even help. Couldn't. I couldn't
RD_ALifeLine_57025f59724ff273: You get used to it. That's the worst part, I don't even smell it anymore
RD_ALifeLine_59a568e06370089b: That's the whole street. Every house. Hot days are the worst
RD_ALifeLine_6fa953505c58c70c: Mint gum. I found a whole box of mint gum. My jaw hurts but everything smells like spearmint
RD_ALifeLine_5ac4c0aa0c62a6c7: Like in the movies! The cop movies with the morgue! Look at us, being professionals
RD_ALifeLine_7a974a20542376df: Still breathing. That's the bar now. Still breathing
RD_ALifeLine_2b5fc5302b807f45: Fine. Killed three on my way here. Didn't even think about it. That's the scary part
RD_ALifeLine_755757d94f86c265: Better than last week. Worse than yesterday. It's a weird math
RD_ALifeLine_64f098cb3cdf8e1d: Strong? I'm just too stubborn to die. Mom always said I'd be stubborn till the end
RD_ALifeLine_118d5dbc68517044: It did. First one I cried for an hour. Now I just check their pockets
RD_ALifeLine_2b5773b3478d40d5: Yeah? Good. I mean, not good. But good to know I'm not the only one going numb
RD_ALifeLine_0a59076b58a80d06: Car keys mostly. Gum. A wedding ring once. I kept that one. Don't know why
RD_ALifeLine_6f5a41ed030c41c5: Yeah. Survival. We say that a lot now. Like it fixes it
RD_ALifeLine_6b061ed370949294: Got any rules you live by now?
RD_ALifeLine_2c3ea2cb0fd82118: Three. Never sleep where you can't leave. Never trust a quiet house. Never ever say it can't get worse
RD_ALifeLine_3dd532822c37d67e: I've got one: aim for the head
RD_ALifeLine_34e5989121c1379b: Learned every one the hard way. You want the stories? No you don't
RD_ALifeLine_655f4dc06e36dba6: Not people, not places, not dogs. Dogs especially. You don't want to know why
RD_ALifeLine_216f87f65751e390: *Laughs* That's not a rule, that's like.. the alphabet. Everyone knows the head thing now
RD_ALifeLine_7cd59939663ada79: People are forming groups. Good ones, bad ones. You can tell by how they greet you
RD_ALifeLine_433086336f8539af: Power flickered last night. Lights everywhere for one second and then black. I almost cried
RD_ALifeLine_5736bb255a977203: Some crew took over the hardware store. They shoot at anyone who gets close
RD_ALifeLine_1863678c4b31c951: How do you tell the good groups from the bad?
RD_ALifeLine_4bd3ec6155c704b4: The power thing was beautiful though
RD_ALifeLine_211b96c0702c56e5: The good ones talk first. The bad ones talk after they've got you on your knees
RD_ALifeLine_0bbf41c700f2b25b: It WAS. For one second the whole street looked like before. Then it didn't
RD_ALifeLine_1c02438a54d9d17b: Didn't stop to ask their names. They had rifles and those vests. That's all I needed to know
RD_ALifeLine_14e83b364b5493c9: I killed someone. A person. A living one. He came at me with a knife for my backpack
RD_ALifeLine_5875408202feecc3: ..Do I? Yeah. Yesterday something happened. I don't want to talk about it. I kinda want to talk about it
RD_ALifeLine_256328b90baf0499: Want to tell me what happened?
RD_ALifeLine_5956246a15c2a9ca: That's what I keep telling myself. On loop. Did what I had to. Did what I had to
RD_ALifeLine_32e1fba4132b96b3: He was skinny. Like starving skinny. He probably just wanted my food. I could've given him some
RD_ALifeLine_6724ad047b76b9d8: No. But I'm alive. Those don't feel like the same thing anymore
RD_ALifeLine_7da2eefa64b27fd7: But he had a knife and I had a pipe and.. yeah. Thanks for listening. Really
RD_ALifeLine_36ebc7915ee8df59: What do you do all day?
RD_ALifeLine_11175fed151307eb: Wake up, check the traps, check the windows, scavenge till noon, hide till dusk, check the windows again
RD_ALifeLine_753b87b91bd93f3a: Same as you I bet. Find food. Avoid the dead. Avoid the living too. Repeat
RD_ALifeLine_72da09a43ea637c6: It is. I talk to myself. I've had some really good conversations
RD_ALifeLine_5276b56e3314ffa9: Cans on string. Not for food, for noise. If it rattles, I'm out the back
RD_ALifeLine_791a8f4c41cc4ccf: Ha. Look at us. Office workers of the apocalypse. Nine to five, surviving
RD_ALifeLine_5991dbf9012c8af9: You shouldn't. I shouldn't trust you either. Yet here we are, talking
RD_ALifeLine_716e67fd6a655586: Because I haven't shot you. That's how trust works now
RD_ALifeLine_5b3883ce4f2ed547: I'm not here to hurt anyone
RD_ALifeLine_67bbddb36f7fcd0f: Yeah. Let's keep it simple. You don't touch my stuff, I don't touch yours
RD_ALifeLine_25cc02ab74c60dae: Everything's low now. The bar is on the floor. We're all crawling under it
RD_ALifeLine_6dbf6f40356ea27a: That's what the last guy said. Then he took my boots. Keep your hands where I can see them, okay?
RD_ALifeLine_714e48292179c7e3: Every night. Always the same. I'm at the grocery store and the shelves are full and nobody's dead
RD_ALifeLine_0e5fd5667d311a48: Not anymore. I just close my eyes and it's black and then it's morning. I miss dreams
RD_ALifeLine_241015110036e2c1: It is. Then I wake up and I'm in a closet. Hard comedown
RD_ALifeLine_6eac683533981461: Oh I have those too. Daytime ones. With my eyes open
RD_ALifeLine_573de5e32813c87b: I found a spot. Good walls, a well nearby. I grow tomatoes now. Tomatoes! In the apocalypse!
RD_ALifeLine_34c0940a02c317cc: I made peace with it. Not with them, with it. The way things are now
RD_ALifeLine_6be3903f70332712: How'd you make peace with this?
RD_ALifeLine_61f1955d744e1c0c: Seriously! Small and ugly but they're MINE. First one I ate standing in the garden. Juice everywhere
RD_ALifeLine_5aca72a62ced52f5: I stopped waiting. For the army, the news, a cure. When you stop waiting, you start living
RD_ALifeLine_71933b1f383ff09a: Thanks. That's.. nobody says that anymore. I'm happy for me too, I think
RD_ALifeLine_0a7e3bcb12ffd214: Sounds like a fridge magnet. But it's true
RD_ALifeLine_17a6fc4c30cb34dd: Alright? *Laughs* I talk to my dead wife every night. She answers sometimes. So I'm great
RD_ALifeLine_3069944067595f4f: I stopped boarding the windows. What's the point. They come or they don't
RD_ALifeLine_0992f5df37db4b98: I don't know what day it is. Or why I'm out here. I just walk
RD_ALifeLine_5b632a093754be08: Do you want company for a bit?
RD_ALifeLine_60645b37259dcd5a: Why not? Give me one good reason. Just one
RD_ALifeLine_6907d13337f707d8: For a bit. Yeah. You don't have to talk. Just.. stand there. Be a person
RD_ALifeLine_623ffbfa1a4c8431: She says eat something. She says I look awful. She always was right
RD_ALifeLine_754b8bc7205bde66: ..That's a stupid reason. But it's a reason. Fine. One more day. Just one
RD_ALifeLine_77e2cba9023db9c2: Groups are setting up proper camps now. Walls, guards, rules. Like little towns
RD_ALifeLine_190701672f583eee: The dead are thinning in the open. They gather in buildings now. Big buildings scare me
RD_ALifeLine_307315b43394a8e3: Saw a guy trading cigarettes for ammo. Cigarettes are money now. Who'd have thought
RD_ALifeLine_7d1f67434b466e07: Good to know about the buildings
RD_ALifeLine_0298da80264f2636: What's a pack worth these days?
RD_ALifeLine_29fd69d119755707: Some. Depends on you. Bring something useful and don't start trouble
RD_ALifeLine_175d510f2fc3b65a: Yeah. Malls, schools, hospitals. Stay out unless you have a real reason
RD_ALifeLine_108567bd29b9dc00: A pack? A whole box of shells. Some guys would trade their mother for a pack
RD_ALifeLine_273db5da423c00f7: Firewood. Lots of firewood. And canning everything that grows
RD_ALifeLine_0fb6737d5e316efc: You need to think about it, trust me
RD_ALifeLine_0a19a6db5c5bda4e: Never enough. But I've got a full shed and a stubborn heart
RD_ALifeLine_08c374707dcc2478: Yeah, yeah. Everyone's a survival expert now. ..You're right though. I hate that you're right
RD_ALifeLine_3323e62c73d6638f: It's my birthday. I think. I've been counting on the wall. Thirty-something days since it started, so.. yeah
RD_ALifeLine_239e9f634200939b: My daughter's birthday. She'd be nine
RD_ALifeLine_7d3d5d6f2cabcaee: *Smiles* You're the only one who said it. Thanks. I'm gonna eat a whole can of peaches. Celebration
RD_ALifeLine_60599fd04accc3bc: It is! Potatoes, cabbage, and something I think is a carrot. Could be a weed. Time will tell
RD_ALifeLine_39c2254f039c3a3d: Yep. First thing I did when I found this place. Dirt doesn't care about the dead
RD_ALifeLine_04cef90347fe58dd: Watch out, they come for the noise when you dig
RD_ALifeLine_43f253470509966d: Seeds, water, patience. Mostly patience. And yelling at the crows
RD_ALifeLine_1a6eb8070f9ed7cd: I know. I work at dawn. Quietest time of the day. Even the dead sleep in a bit
RD_ALifeLine_061ac8505645af63: A journal. So someone knows we were here. That we were people
RD_ALifeLine_33bdceac12899b82: A list. Everyone I've met. Who's alive, who's not. Mostly not
RD_ALifeLine_606640195c2ce6a3: That's a good thing to do
RD_ALifeLine_5aa5840a1e4afd7a: You are now. *Scribbles* Met a stranger. Didn't shoot me. Five stars
RD_ALifeLine_63d88dd16e4999b4: Someone has to remember. Or else it's like none of it happened
RD_ALifeLine_4d47f3bd24354e65: Weird. Good weird? I have a routine. I have a chicken named Gary. Gary's great
RD_ALifeLine_74c99fe8589b67d1: Honestly? Better than my old job. No boss, no traffic. Just dead people
RD_ALifeLine_673024ae4e032b48: Normal. That's the scary part. This is just normal now
RD_ALifeLine_50e0e6e111f30a55: Best decision I ever made. He lays eggs. Well, she. Gary's a she. I found out late
RD_ALifeLine_233b0c346651e9de: Insurance claims. Eight hours a day. Honestly the dead are less soul-sucking
RD_ALifeLine_3ba6e20a58ef4f92: I don't flinch at the moaning anymore. I sleep through it. I miss flinching
RD_ALifeLine_66d31c9035b79a81: Good. It's freeing. Sundays don't exist. Every day is a Tuesday
RD_ALifeLine_198095875c870e70: Do you miss how it was before?
RD_ALifeLine_3ef9b9234b23aa16: Some things. Hot showers. Pizza. My mom's voice. Not the commute though
RD_ALifeLine_07bbfebc23d20a8b: I don't remember it right anymore. Like it was a TV show I watched
RD_ALifeLine_0a32222e68407585: Don't. DON'T. I dream about pepperoni. I wake up drooling. It's humiliating
RD_ALifeLine_3c215d755e50749a: Yeah. But missing it's like holding a hot pan. You gotta let go or burn
RD_ALifeLine_63d84ed938502ce4: Better? *Thinks* ..Maybe. Smaller. Kinder maybe. If we don't screw it up
RD_ALifeLine_6883328e0b01e0a8: I used it to start a fire last week. A hundred bucks in twenties. Felt AMAZING
RD_ALifeLine_49463d9d10a74dc1: Money? I've got a wallet full of it. Can't eat it, can't shoot it, can't wear it
RD_ALifeLine_0b92b73c5838f215: Bullets, painkillers, batteries, seeds. And people you can trust. Those are the rarest
RD_ALifeLine_28a1ed723b7c9d10: Right?! Every bill I ever paid, I thought about it. Gas bill, phone bill, rent. Whoosh
RD_ALifeLine_56b0cda96e916df2: Oh! Sorry. Old song. I can't remember the words anymore, only the tune
RD_ALifeLine_0c0384ff28e368f7: Yeah. I hum to stay sane. Quietly. They don't like singing. Or they like it too much
RD_ALifeLine_24caca8c1384fc51: Ha. No. Last time I sang out loud I had company for three hours
RD_ALifeLine_31132f0d2d58b5ed: Me too. Found a guitar once. Two strings. I played it anyway. Terribly
RD_ALifeLine_5fa1c5e14088e3dd: Do you name them? The dead ones?
RD_ALifeLine_750627b576eaf4da: Some. There's one by the bridge in a wedding dress. I call her the Bride. She's been there forever
RD_ALifeLine_0d4af182513a0b38: No. They had names. Real ones. Feels wrong to give them new ones
RD_ALifeLine_10f762bc363ca582: I say good morning when I pass. From very far away. She never says it back. Rude
RD_ALifeLine_48bced9e643472ec: Somebody loved every one of them. I try to remember that. Even when I'm swinging
RD_ALifeLine_33f502973d674dc3: Do you think anyone's out there? Like outside?
RD_ALifeLine_6037785c225cef3b: Outside Knox? I used to think about it every day. Now I don't. This is the world
RD_ALifeLine_632c94e55f8e3cf0: Somebody somewhere has electricity and cold beer. I'm sure of it. And I hate them
RD_ALifeLine_1c8fe8f1643f3490: Maybe they'll come back for us
RD_ALifeLine_1a8c8681269f642e: If they do, they'll find a bunch of people who learned how to live without them. Good luck to them
RD_ALifeLine_725acc7b30f022ad: No. It really doesn't. That's sad and also kinda freeing
RD_ALifeLine_58ae6c7e59f8fedf: Mechanic. Had a shop. Well, my uncle's shop. I had the keys
RD_ALifeLine_38ddb6cc76bc9957: Fixed cars. Brakes, transmissions, the works. Funny, cars are the only thing still working
RD_ALifeLine_3d32546b59a719cc: Can you get a car running?
RD_ALifeLine_74cfa2a2254d4096: Cars won't save you from this
RD_ALifeLine_66f2f6ca46e019fe: Most of 'em, sure. Keys are the problem. Hotwiring's a whole thing, not like the movies
RD_ALifeLine_49fc48c56bb449c8: If it's got gas and a battery? Gimme ten minutes and a flashlight
RD_ALifeLine_6a10301d0baec0d8: No, but they'll get you away from it. Hundred miles an hour, baby. They don't do a hundred
RD_ALifeLine_0fb59a99139fba59: When I can. Siphoned gas from a minivan yesterday. Kids' car seats in the back. Empty. Thank God empty
RD_ALifeLine_45a4014477457106: Nobody's paying. But a running car's the best thing you can own right now
RD_ALifeLine_458ce48d7a62d055: Hose, a bucket and a strong stomach. You WILL swallow some. Everybody does
RD_ALifeLine_5fe78ce726302567: Pickup. Hidden. Not telling you where, no offense. People kill for wheels now
RD_ALifeLine_42f33a467ee8350f: Can you look at my car?
RD_ALifeLine_53f41c0368796451: Sure. What's it doing? Or not doing?
RD_ALifeLine_13478bfc7202c11b: Car trouble? Music to my ears. Feels like a real job again
RD_ALifeLine_790627db488618d5: Battery or gas, nine times outta ten. Check the gas first. Seriously, people forget gas
RD_ALifeLine_2fd612a14913678e: Grinding or clunking? Grinding's brakes. Clunking's.. well clunking's bad. Drive it gentle
RD_ALifeLine_6c9ba41b6211e44d: Food. Gas. Whatever. A can of soup gets you a free diagnosis and my old wrench set
RD_ALifeLine_1f8dce4b50c8e2e6: I'm a mechanic too, you know
RD_ALifeLine_629c319509489d40: Tell you what. Bring me something to eat and I'll throw in some of my old tools
RD_ALifeLine_58828ec3680d9e49: Pleasure doing business. Like the old days, except now I'm the one who's hungry
RD_ALifeLine_6857a4bb24ffdcb4: No shit? Fellow grease monkey! Here, take these, you'll use 'em better than me
RD_ALifeLine_4d9d441638f14613: Sure thing. I'll be around. Probably under something
RD_ALifeLine_363fa4df6762a918: Booming. I'm building a car with metal sheets bolted on. Ugly as sin. Tough as hell
RD_ALifeLine_11e587345313f8e8: I stopped. Last guy I helped stole the car I fixed. With me standing there
RD_ALifeLine_51867e2533ffa0b9: When it's done. Plow on the front, cage on the windows. Zombies go WHUMP. Very satisfying
RD_ALifeLine_77e5e9532272986c: Yeah. Now I take the spark plugs out when I'm done. Lesson learned
RD_ALifeLine_639b7a3a01a2f1b2: Always. Belts, filters, batteries that actually hold a charge. Batteries are gold
RD_ALifeLine_064bb7c202a09c6e: I need a reason to keep fixing stuff. Parts are easy. Reasons are hard
RD_ALifeLine_330e798811c1a532: Appreciate it. Bring me something good, I'll make it worth your while
RD_ALifeLine_497e027967c9d148: These are flashlight ones, buddy. *Laughs* But okay, flashlights matter too. Here, eat something
RD_ALifeLine_52f694644fe91b0b: Gas is going stale. Cars are dying one by one. I'm becoming a bicycle guy
RD_ALifeLine_069b8e846199bb33: I fix generators now. And water pumps. Anything with a motor. Mechanic of the end times
RD_ALifeLine_521bde9954d4092f: Generators are worth a lot now
RD_ALifeLine_7725819651bcebe0: Don't laugh. Bikes are quiet, no gas, and you can carry 'em over fences. Future's on two wheels
RD_ALifeLine_2b583f197704392c: Worth more than anything. One running generator and suddenly you have friends. Lots of friends
RD_ALifeLine_7374c903409b0840: The scrubs gave it away? I walked off my shift. I just.. walked out. They were biting the doctors
RD_ALifeLine_5ef5451f131aa0cc: I was. Am. I don't know. The ER was a slaughterhouse by Wednesday
RD_ALifeLine_1dcddd7347ec5804: You did the right thing leaving
RD_ALifeLine_0005dad97a0ed2ac: What did you see in there?
RD_ALifeLine_1e28a4095a8e55c4: Can you help me if I get hurt?
RD_ALifeLine_65d459bb798e36a8: Did I? I left patients in their beds. Strapped in. I hear them at night
RD_ALifeLine_28698e3b76e64d27: People coming in with bites. Fever, then nothing, then they sit up. Every single one. Every one
RD_ALifeLine_225f69ef7aa5caad: Bandages, stitches, sure. Bites? Nothing helps bites. Don't get bitten. That's my medical advice
RD_ALifeLine_19bf317f0445123f: Low. I'm splitting pills in half. Making bandages out of bedsheets
RD_ALifeLine_4921016b76e5583a: Gone mostly. I'm a nurse with a sewing kit and a bottle of vodka
RD_ALifeLine_096f0ab125ee5f14: If you find painkillers or antibiotics, bring them. I'll make it worth it, I promise
RD_ALifeLine_282c6deb4456bdd3: For cleaning. And for the nurse. Mostly the cleaning. Some of the nurse
RD_ALifeLine_10d6e1fb77535a29: Depends what you've got. I'm not giving painkillers away for a smile
RD_ALifeLine_15fcf9264da8f855: Medicine's the last real currency. What are you offering?
RD_ALifeLine_1b4d0818632cd18f: Can you just patch me up?
RD_ALifeLine_77a56d6964547aef: Two cans, one strip of pills. Fair's fair
RD_ALifeLine_35b3fa720579c348: Sit. Arm out. This'll sting, don't be a baby. *Works* There. Keep it clean, change it daily
RD_ALifeLine_2e8238a22b993a88: Oh thank God, someone who gets it. Here, a colleague discount. Don't tell anyone
RD_ALifeLine_73f12edb0ed483b3: Okay. Don't bleed on my way out
RD_ALifeLine_320c35de6134ed27: Pleasure. Take them with food. Not on an empty stomach, I mean it
RD_ALifeLine_5edb1030751753e0: So is dying of an infected cut. Come back when you change your mind
RD_ALifeLine_468c0f2d0f770706: Stopped calling myself that. I amputated a guy's finger with garden shears last week
RD_ALifeLine_422e82bb751bbfec: Busy. Everyone gets hurt. Nobody pays. Just like the old job actually
RD_ALifeLine_6c1aa5cf62d5177f: It was bitten. Didn't work. He turned anyway. So now I know. Doesn't work
RD_ALifeLine_7585ef6608aa986f: When I'm dead. Which, statistically, is next Tuesday
RD_ALifeLine_4486e5963d9cb0e5: When they ask nicely. When they don't point a gun at me first
RD_ALifeLine_64fbd0072aede238: I run a little clinic in my kitchen. Tuesdays and Thursdays. Joking. Kind of
RD_ALifeLine_446bbdaa536b25a0: I'm a tired person with a needle and thread. But thanks
RD_ALifeLine_6b6c2e0a49479b17: Bring me antibiotics. Any. Even expired. Expired is better than nothing
RD_ALifeLine_67b2f20857838d92: Willow bark. Honey for wounds. I'm basically a witch now
RD_ALifeLine_72d7be0527f5e779: The pills are gone. All of them. I'm back to what grandmas knew
RD_ALifeLine_2471bd7716c60c92: A witch nurse, that's a combo
RD_ALifeLine_76cd7c9a3fc2ac2f: Better than nothing. A lot better than nothing. Medicine is mostly paying attention anyway
RD_ALifeLine_277b18625a0c5e44: Ha! Put it on my business card. Nurse slash witch. Tuesdays only
RD_ALifeLine_7279ae7f16b1a88c: You look like you were heading somewhere
RD_ALifeLine_3991500d376630f6: The school. I was a teacher. Third grade. I thought.. maybe some kids were hiding there
RD_ALifeLine_2215defd19e94131: I teach. Taught. The district sent an email saying school's cancelled. An EMAIL
RD_ALifeLine_0d1bd17c598a3108: No. The classroom was empty. Their drawings are still on the wall. Family portraits
RD_ALifeLine_7c2826bf5e3c8b45: I know. I know. I still keep walking that way. Habit
RD_ALifeLine_44bc44b515e14964: Every day. I'd give anything for a room full of screaming eight year olds
RD_ALifeLine_790353a212e3a9b5: I miss being useful. I knew what to do every morning. Now? Nothing
RD_ALifeLine_78ea2f3a66c658de: You can still teach people things
RD_ALifeLine_0a6ddb20013195a5: Screaming kids sound nice right now
RD_ALifeLine_6c3065df6431eb98: Like what? Long division won't stop a bite
RD_ALifeLine_415ead6b69d40388: Right? I used to want silence. Now silence is the scariest thing there is
RD_ALifeLine_691f0d58566f896b: ..Okay. Okay maybe. You're a good student, you know that
RD_ALifeLine_4d9562073cdd8b9d: What are you up to these days?
RD_ALifeLine_4c93397322ba2dec: Teaching. There's a group with two kids and nobody to teach them. So, me. Again
RD_ALifeLine_448393ba627c9071: Writing a guide. How to survive. Simple words. For whoever comes after
RD_ALifeLine_5c6623543e8f5bf2: It's chapter three. Chapter one is just DON'T PANIC in big letters
RD_ALifeLine_32cd08c423a89dd9: They are. Kids bend. We break. Wish I knew their trick
RD_ALifeLine_10eeb60b2c8598d6: Taught a teenager to read a compass yesterday. Best lesson I ever taught
RD_ALifeLine_3b79cb462ad5270e: Every day. Reading, writing, how to set a snare. Curriculum's changed a bit
RD_ALifeLine_41755d2356e6ce4d: Practical skills! The school board would've fired me. The school board's dead
RD_ALifeLine_2a3f02c8551616c1: That's all I ever wanted. Took the end of the world to feel it
RD_ALifeLine_60bba6aa267ded46: Chef. Line chef. Fourteen hours a day for a guy who threw pans at me. Is it bad I'm a little relieved?
RD_ALifeLine_798155234a75fd66: Yeah. Kitchen at a diner. The fridge is still full there. If the power holds
RD_ALifeLine_4e0f727e04aa29ec: Was yesterday. Steaks, eggs, everything. But the waitress is still in there. Walking around
RD_ALifeLine_5cf67529186f273a: *Laughs* Thanks. My boss is probably one of them now. Still angry. Still throwing pans
RD_ALifeLine_32d7c1100f81ac8b: Rice and canned tuna with a little hot sauce. Gourmet. Five stars
RD_ALifeLine_29271b84726f2f3c: Whatever's in the can. But I make it nice. Presentation matters, even now
RD_ALifeLine_6eab2ca100d8faf6: It's the hot sauce. I'll trade my last bullet before my last hot sauce
RD_ALifeLine_17c8513a5f87f58f: Salt everything. Burn nothing. And eat the perishables first, every time
RD_ALifeLine_42b7c5aa1c8adaf1: I trade COOKED food. You bring ingredients, I make it edible. Small fee
RD_ALifeLine_735635652d2573ce: Got some jerky I made. Deer. Probably deer. Want some?
RD_ALifeLine_02fdc6871d2b1f1d: Here, a can for a meal
RD_ALifeLine_7c78bc4532b181cb: One beans to go, chef's special. Enjoy. Don't tell me if you don't like it
RD_ALifeLine_22fe381125a1146b: It had four legs and it didn't bite me back. That's my whole standard now
RD_ALifeLine_7d88f3e160f1f991: I made bread. Actual bread. From flour I milled with two rocks. I cried. Again
RD_ALifeLine_0eedf4880129e81e: Mushroom stew. I know which ones won't kill you. Mostly
RD_ALifeLine_3405c237018b92eb: Don't kill for it. Trade for it. I'm not making bread for murderers
RD_ALifeLine_5b3f08c17768bb95: Mostly. Ninety-five percent. Ninety. Eat with me sometime and find out
RD_ALifeLine_434262c20bc23bd7: Construction. Twenty years. I build walls for a living. Well, now I build walls for living
RD_ALifeLine_4df475cc66a07642: I was on a site when it started. Guy fell off the scaffold and got back up. Broken neck and all
RD_ALifeLine_0b0f1f543887d99e: Can you help me board up?
RD_ALifeLine_3f94cf9e6000d342: Nails, planks, a hammer. Two nails a side minimum. Don't cheap out on the nails
RD_ALifeLine_561833bb687268bb: My whole truck's full. Not giving them away though. My tools are my kids
RD_ALifeLine_032065533af902ee: A wall. Around my whole yard. Pallets, sheet metal, car doors. Ugly, works
RD_ALifeLine_37ddbe4f5521e222: Watchtower. Second floor of my place. Gotta see them before they see me
RD_ALifeLine_5e4cae7b4869a9b4: Can I see it when it's done?
RD_ALifeLine_62a826df1ac5d38f: If you're not a creep. You're not a creep, right? ..Okay. Maybe
RD_ALifeLine_6d519c6a4f473745: Always. Bring planks or nails. I'll pay you in coffee. Real coffee. I have twelve jars
RD_ALifeLine_768ae1a23d2bf1a5: Solid. Had a horde push on it last week. Wall flexed. Didn't break
RD_ALifeLine_5ffd21a51893796d: Took a beating. The north side is just cars now. Stacked cars
RD_ALifeLine_4858f52a48d66ca9: Twenty years of building strip malls and THIS is my masterpiece. A pile of junk that works
RD_ALifeLine_39655f074a1a8598: Then I run. Always have a back door. Rule one of construction. Rule one of everything
RD_ALifeLine_685769e40b3305d1: Building houses again. For people. Little ones. For groups who need walls
RD_ALifeLine_4974f93008ead14b: I'm a contractor again. I get paid in eggs and ammo. Better than the union rate
RD_ALifeLine_7d160ec05a30a15d: Bring me lumber and a good reason. I'll build you something that won't fall over
RD_ALifeLine_336696987dd1b8d6: Don't tell the union. Oh wait, there isn't one. *Laughs*
RD_ALifeLine_602e6c944f2974cd: The cows are going crazy. They know. Animals always know first
RD_ALifeLine_592684ef0f5ad58d: My neighbour's down at the fence line. Been walking into the barbed wire for a whole day
RD_ALifeLine_1b636fc237d677f4: What do you mean, they know?
RD_ALifeLine_0b704cc22a5dd77c: They wouldn't come in from the field. Just stood there bellowing. All night
RD_ALifeLine_299042290703b2e0: I know. I raised hogs twenty years. I know dead when I see it. Still can't make myself do it
RD_ALifeLine_5103767c522e186e: Are you staying on the farm?
RD_ALifeLine_0ad7616d5750698d: Where else would I go? The land's mine. The well's mine. They can come and get me
RD_ALifeLine_1a57ed3e67c80b98: City folk keep coming. Asking for food. I give what I can. Can't give much
RD_ALifeLine_6b5c90fe4cd3a8bc: Always was. Farming's lonely. Zombies are just new neighbours
RD_ALifeLine_4e9b93d57d5c1711: Pull weeds for an hour and I'll give you a sack of potatoes. Fair?
RD_ALifeLine_04c7caab7ed72517: Good. Gloves are by the shed. Don't step on the beans, they're the ones with flowers
RD_ALifeLine_465f8e6154952d04: Offer's open. Weeds don't stop for the end of the world
RD_ALifeLine_0dd162616635671a: Seeds are worth more than bullets now. What you got?
RD_ALifeLine_0e94712d49f90caa: Maybe. Depends who's asking. You gonna plant them or eat them?
RD_ALifeLine_04c680cb6719967a: Plant them deep, water them every evening. Here. Don't make me regret it
RD_ALifeLine_6d5235bc63e73bb3: My back thanks you. Here, take this and don't come back for a week
RD_ALifeLine_7ecd92e13c150dfc: Ha! I knew you had dirt under those nails. Take double, help me feed the county
RD_ALifeLine_3f400d7a45c55f40: Corn, squash, beans. The three sisters. Grandpa knew it, his grandpa knew it, now I know it
RD_ALifeLine_2e9aa54d5bb375b5: Everything I can. Winter's coming one way or another
RD_ALifeLine_561ed215753682f3: Can you feed a lot of people?
RD_ALifeLine_7aa0197c2664ff75: Twenty maybe. If the crows don't win. The crows are winning
RD_ALifeLine_56d5764703772fa4: Compost everything. Even the stuff you don't want to think about. I said EVERYTHING
RD_ALifeLine_61e9699c0c996301: Better than ever. No more banks, no more contracts. Just me and the dirt
RD_ALifeLine_70f844235169e312: We had a harvest. A real one. Three families ate for a month off my field
RD_ALifeLine_6e5d923b3a9ffb16: That's the only thing that makes sense anymore. Plant, wait, eat. Repeat
RD_ALifeLine_18481715356b5d80: Burned the loan papers in the stove. Kept me warm one whole night. Best night of my life
RD_ALifeLine_217134451480e078: At the grocery store. Register four. Last Thursday people were fighting over toilet paper and I was still scanning stuff
RD_ALifeLine_1da362ea09d2c280: The mall. I folded sweaters. I was SO good at folding sweaters. Useless now
RD_ALifeLine_224beeec0cca2990: Bet you know where the stock room is
RD_ALifeLine_5b99122c043d18c7: Back left, past the dairy. But.. the dairy guy didn't make it. He's still guarding the yogurt
RD_ALifeLine_2728dee76992dcc9: Sweater folding? Name one apocalypse use for sweater folding
RD_ALifeLine_076d4ded7b3b7c91: ..Huh. I CAN fit like four days of stuff in my bag. Okay. Okay I'll take it
RD_ALifeLine_70be5e147ee270f5: You don't look like you used to work a register
RD_ALifeLine_047c4ba55b887d15: Ha. You should see me with a bat now. Price check on aisle DEAD
RD_ALifeLine_26da9c8d27652d96: I worked retail. Customers were worse than zombies. Okay, maybe not worse. Close
RD_ALifeLine_21ccd043616bd7fa: Price check on aisle dead, I like it
RD_ALifeLine_62d4d7556ac405d7: I've been saving that one. Nobody to tell it to till now
RD_ALifeLine_506990c436f11a61: Totally. Angry crowds, grabbing hands, screaming. I'm a veteran, basically
RD_ALifeLine_0955e5897ddd646f: I keep the books for a group. Who traded what. Turns out the till girl was good at math
RD_ALifeLine_6b46e6c04fae8d17: Trading. I'm good with people, good with numbers. Retail all over again but nobody yells
RD_ALifeLine_392426c80612ce48: My manager said I'd never amount to anything. Look at me now. Amounting
RD_ALifeLine_62506b6d31984865: Yeah. Hilarious. Ha ha. I'd still give it all back for one boring Tuesday shift
RD_ALifeLine_1025776e44f91b01: The woods. I was cutting near the ridge when the radio said stay inside. I don't have an inside, I have a truck
RD_ALifeLine_2f353ada602863cd: Logging camp. The crew went to town for supplies. Never came back. I waited three days
RD_ALifeLine_317aa4571091af45: You okay out there in the woods?
RD_ALifeLine_217c61fc72c31759: Better than town. Trees don't bite. Haven't met a tree that wanted me dead yet
RD_ALifeLine_12e6e2a0336f84a0: Axe is for everything now. Trees, doors, them. Doesn't judge
RD_ALifeLine_701c5ab522e0bb76: Got a whole stack. What's it worth to you?
RD_ALifeLine_054bbb3a6df0832c: I'm the guy with the firewood. Every winter I'm gonna be the most popular person alive
RD_ALifeLine_22640f463107e96a: Done. I'll drop it outside your place. Don't shoot me when I do
RD_ALifeLine_5d9381935cbfb766: Curiosity doesn't keep you warm. Come back when you're cold
RD_ALifeLine_4f1ad2ca09ceecb2: Built a cabin. Me and two others. Trees all around. Sound carries, we hear them coming a mile off
RD_ALifeLine_1e21a69a0b9f08db: Yep. City's for dead people. Woods are for us
RD_ALifeLine_376e3bc247be5a26: It is. First time in my life I'm not cutting trees for someone else's paycheck
RD_ALifeLine_39bf76062b56933c: Lonely's a city word. Out here there's birds, wind, deer. Plenty of company
RD_ALifeLine_4703ead940d3b91c: Uh. Stuff. My stuff. Mine. That I definitely owned before today
RD_ALifeLine_389e68874297298f: Look, I'm not gonna lie, I used to do houses. Now everybody does houses. I'm just better at it
RD_ALifeLine_4e71dc454b5933f8: Teach me how to pick locks
RD_ALifeLine_72a14a0e7922a463: WAS. Now I'm a scavenger. It's the same job but nobody calls the cops
RD_ALifeLine_7291534b789d3251: Ha! Bobby pins and patience. Or a brick. Brick's faster, louder. Your call
RD_ALifeLine_361b776a2b2e432a: You seem to know your way around houses
RD_ALifeLine_0383a7335d97b4a2: Professional habit. Garage first, master bedroom second, kitchen last. Kitchen's where they eat you
RD_ALifeLine_2618d41c2d578b69: Nineteen houses this week. My old fence would've given me a medal
RD_ALifeLine_2c7d803144ff4076: Bet you never thought this would happen
RD_ALifeLine_448645172ac2da4e: Gun safe in a basement. Couldn't open it. I KNOW. Me. Defeated by a safe
RD_ALifeLine_1b18161f381a8e47: Swear to God, I used to dream about a world without cops. Careful what you wish for, right?
RD_ALifeLine_0c9553467ca5491f: Maybe. A tip costs. Not much. I'm a reformed man, basically
RD_ALifeLine_15d367573fa53cee: I know a place. Gun safe, still locked. Bring a crowbar and I'll tell you where
RD_ALifeLine_32c87e1d01f55ed5: Here, take this for the tip
RD_ALifeLine_093e652d196f5dde: Pleasure. Check the cellar door, not the front. Nobody ever checks the cellar
RD_ALifeLine_6f47792463900588: Friend. Ugh. Fine. Friends are worth more than beans these days. Here
RD_ALifeLine_4640c21b315735db: Honest work. Kinda. I find stuff in places for people who pay. Locksmith of the end times
RD_ALifeLine_30f385857ed6b5cb: I run the scrap trade. Turns out stealing's just recycling with extra steps
RD_ALifeLine_1947e2215b2d99df: Put it on my tombstone. Here lies a recycler. Misunderstood
RD_ALifeLine_732205385d321869: More honest than most folks out here. I never killed anyone for a can of beans
RD_ALifeLine_40b0a5b54a0f297f: Nothing! I was between jobs. Like, years between. My mom's basement. Now my mom is.. you know
RD_ALifeLine_3283789d3507a046: I applied to forty jobs this month. Forty. Then the world ended. Kinda feels personal
RD_ALifeLine_6a4b88703db62df5: At least you're not missing work
RD_ALifeLine_27383c896eebd0d2: Ha. True. Finally, an apocalypse where everyone's unemployed. Equal opportunity
RD_ALifeLine_2cb4e356471800ec: She got sick on day one. I left her in the basement. Swapped places with her, I guess
RD_ALifeLine_7d067dec56c3b8c5: Weirdly good? I played survival games for years. My mom said it was a waste of time. WHO'S LAUGHING NOW
RD_ALifeLine_4f7716b119a842d6: I've got skills nobody wanted before. Like sleeping anywhere and living on noodles
RD_ALifeLine_28f4994e2478d050: Mostly I learned that crowbars are good. Crowbars ARE good. I was right
RD_ALifeLine_62bb299b3aa21c92: Dry ones. Crunchy. Like chips. You haven't lived till you've eaten them dry
RD_ALifeLine_71fdc00d17c72b5b: Found anything to do with yourself?
RD_ALifeLine_7831b2b64ed2be56: Yeah. I'm useful now. I carry stuff, I guard stuff, I keep watch. People say thank you. Never happened before
RD_ALifeLine_009269f842d271f1: I have a job! Kind of! I'm the group's runner. First job in four years. No interview!
RD_ALifeLine_64a1e251365d997d: Took the end of the world, huh
RD_ALifeLine_7762d4eb24e7a620: Thanks! No salary, no dental. Still the best job I ever had
RD_ALifeLine_22346b25407da686: Took the end of the world for someone to need me. Messed up. But I'll take it
RD_ALifeLine_4902e2d12785b378: You look like you need help with something
RD_ALifeLine_7f3956225ec28d73: My brother. He lives a few streets over and he's not answering. I can't go, I can't, my legs won't do it
RD_ALifeLine_7614b8a8389efa6f: Please. My brother's place. Just look in the window. I need to know if he's.. if he's still him
RD_ALifeLine_417ebdef2bed420e: Thank you. Oh God, thank you. I marked it for you. Blue door. He painted it himself, it's ugly
RD_ALifeLine_2a5c3e6c2ee04d52: I'll mark it. Please be careful. And please.. tell me the truth, whatever it is
RD_ALifeLine_1e72396274f119cc: Then.. then bring me something of his. His watch. A note. Anything. So I can stop waiting
RD_ALifeLine_70fba0c8555c16e1: Then what are you doing HERE?! Sorry. Sorry. Please hurry
RD_ALifeLine_1fa8707176a3d408: Yeah. Yeah, I get it. Nobody does that anymore. Nobody checks on anybody
RD_ALifeLine_2379aec01d981785: My dad. He's diabetic and the insulin's spoiled, no fridge. Now his foot's infected. I need antibiotics
RD_ALifeLine_1b054e58197ed248: My grandma's foot. It's going black. The insulin's gone. Antibiotics might buy her time
RD_ALifeLine_3bdbd303592e00a8: Thank you. Please hurry. He keeps calling me by my mom's name, he's so feverish
RD_ALifeLine_748f41fa2bd1f4bf: Bless you. Really. I'll be right here. I'm not going anywhere
RD_ALifeLine_775ba4152b64d724: The one on the main road got hit day one. Try the clinics. Or houses with old people. Old people always have pills
RD_ALifeLine_27d8581d1334d93b: Okay. Okay. Every hour counts, I'm sorry, I'm not rushing you. I'm rushing you
RD_ALifeLine_59d453115d3bccd9: Right. Of course. I'll.. I'll figure it out
RD_ALifeLine_2dd4a3e8458e49a6: I KNOW it is. I'll make it worth it. I have things. I'll give you anything
RD_ALifeLine_1298760d610cc42b: My street. There's a house full of them. Every night they bang on the walls and more show up
RD_ALifeLine_13511bc64c46f132: The house next to mine. The family turned. All of them. I can hear them. I can't sleep
RD_ALifeLine_5db0c48f032139f7: I marked the house. Thank you. I'd do it myself but I just.. I knew them
RD_ALifeLine_067541d90406ce91: Marked it for you. Be careful, the back door doesn't lock. That's how it got in
RD_ALifeLine_28b066a33ca18acf: Four? Five? Two adults, kids.. I don't know. Please don't make me say it
RD_ALifeLine_649af55f6739e4a4: Okay. I heard noise last night, was that you? Was that them?
RD_ALifeLine_2b555be070ffd388: Yeah. Nobody's problem. Until it is
RD_ALifeLine_2ab5b475730b8d49: They wandered into my yard. A whole bunch. I'm stuck going out the window every morning
RD_ALifeLine_032520255839cff7: There's a crowd of them by my place. If they don't leave I'll starve inside
RD_ALifeLine_7479c55f6ae04185: You're a lifesaver. Literally. I'll mark the spot. Don't get bit, I can't pay a dead person
RD_ALifeLine_324ccebb5d8b6fff: I owe you. Marked it. Take care of yourself, okay?
RD_ALifeLine_36e267f604753f14: Tried. Banged pots, threw a radio. They came back. They like me, I guess. Lucky me
RD_ALifeLine_76e23ac30ad01f70: Great, great. I'll stay inside and cheer. Quietly
RD_ALifeLine_4bbddf4905e8d559: Yeah. Thanks for nothing, I guess
RD_ALifeLine_2654255b7d9d9c9b: My kids haven't eaten since yesterday. They're hiding at home. I'm not asking for much, just cans
RD_ALifeLine_2297259346739fe3: Food. I need food. Not for me, for my little ones. They think I'm out getting groceries like before
RD_ALifeLine_586605c433d1d5ff: Here, I have some right now
RD_ALifeLine_514065d67840581f: Three cans. That's.. that's three days. Thank you. You don't know what that means
RD_ALifeLine_467e3568263ec43c: God bless you. My youngest asked if people still help each other. I said yes. Make me right
RD_ALifeLine_581f5c2a00520bdb: Oh- oh. You.. *Holds the cans like they're gold* They're gonna have dinner. Thank you
RD_ALifeLine_6683cb34773f462f: I know. I know. I'm sorry. I just keep hearing them ask
RD_ALifeLine_0e2e325f38240334: Nobody's asking you to feed everyone. Just two kids. Just two
RD_ALifeLine_3356cc5a32d03e06: You keep looking down the road
RD_ALifeLine_0d967bcf3138b7d6: My wife worked at the store down there. She was on shift when it started. I never went to look
RD_ALifeLine_35d7a88d501a16e4: That way's where my husband worked. I need to know. Even if.. even if
RD_ALifeLine_3e49537464168842: If she's.. bring me her ring. Gold, with a little scratch. She hated that scratch
RD_ALifeLine_5dbfe87249effc3a: Okay. Okay. Marked it. Whatever you find, tell me straight. Don't spare me
RD_ALifeLine_6c94de0833605e09: Because as long as I don't know, she could still be alive. You get it?
RD_ALifeLine_06a1ffe0234ed70b: Some things are better not known
RD_ALifeLine_656f6f8f5adeebe7: Thank you. I keep rehearsing what I'll do. Every version I cry
RD_ALifeLine_0f09c8d957ef822d: Maybe. Maybe you're right. Forget I asked
RD_ALifeLine_1967ceb46f016c41: A note. For a friend in another group. I can't cross the open road, they'll see me
RD_ALifeLine_18c8ae6d4897bd9d: Yeah, actually. A letter. For someone I left behind. Long story, short walk
RD_ALifeLine_13ca0094579f3a04: Thank you. Don't read it. I mean you could, I'd never know. But don't
RD_ALifeLine_303de9d23599995c: That's private. It's just.. it's an apology. I said some things. Before
RD_ALifeLine_4c717a2d4ae35809: Did they.. did they say anything? No? Okay. Okay
RD_ALifeLine_38ab800a172ed1f0: Walk with me? Just a few blocks. I need to get to my sister's and I'm terrified
RD_ALifeLine_5157a26f7ccf652f: I need to get somewhere close. But alone? I can't. I tried. I turned back three times
RD_ALifeLine_1c027e63574d67c1: Okay. I'll stay right behind you. Close. Like, annoyingly close
RD_ALifeLine_15bb2ecf37dc46ad: Thank you. I'll be quiet. I'll carry stuff. Just don't leave me
RD_ALifeLine_6151a8e77cbdee8f: I froze last time. One turned the corner and I just.. froze. Stood there like a statue
RD_ALifeLine_0a0f96615a780543: Right. Right. Let's go. Keep going. Don't stop for me
RD_ALifeLine_2a5440ed6ac9f3f2: Yeah. Okay. I'll wait until it's dark. Or until never
RD_ALifeLine_6c587be02ffb931c: Batteries. Any size. My radio and my flashlight are both dying and the dark is the worst part
RD_ALifeLine_481467b220dc31e2: Batteries. I hear them at night and I can't see them. That's the nightmare
RD_ALifeLine_2fbfe1af4714fc62: Four would be perfect. Four is a whole week of light. Thanks
RD_ALifeLine_0fcd3ed25b851505: Sometimes there's music. Some guy plays records at night. It's the only thing that keeps me human
RD_ALifeLine_3422d87d20b29268: Okay. I'm using it sparingly. Ten seconds at a time
RD_ALifeLine_6d545a8d609bed7a: Twisted my knee jumping a fence. It's swollen like a melon. I need painkillers, anything
RD_ALifeLine_4f1506c70346f1a3: Back's gone. Slept on a floor for three weeks. I can barely stand. Pills, please
RD_ALifeLine_50bb3d0377a9224f: Thank you. If I can't run, I'm dead. You're saving my life, kind of slowly
RD_ALifeLine_6822682104967016: Oh you beautiful human. *Swallows two dry* I'll pay you back. I don't know how. I will
RD_ALifeLine_66ebac7115524f33: Okay. I'll be here. Not like I can go anywhere
RD_ALifeLine_359e89814aa47d08: Bandages. Real ones. I've been boiling the old ones and they're falling apart
RD_ALifeLine_61e2a1bd50ff3928: Dressings. I've got three people with cuts going bad and nothing clean to wrap them
RD_ALifeLine_421470c52723b79b: Three, at least. I'll owe you a stitch job, free. You'll need one eventually, everyone does
RD_ALifeLine_3e7eb6735c0b4dfd: Need anything for the car work?
RD_ALifeLine_198a3c0923bb24f0: A screwdriver. I lost mine in the last mess. Can't do anything without one
RD_ALifeLine_1adf66fc0a2fc950: I need tools. Somebody stole my box. Who steals a toolbox in the apocalypse? Everyone. Everyone does
RD_ALifeLine_5c6eec8846594be0: Bring it and I'll get your engine purring. Or whatever. I'll owe you
RD_ALifeLine_4bb6a6965189077c: Great. I'm fixing stuff with a butter knife right now. It's not going well
RD_ALifeLine_3992a9687c265be3: They're in my field. Trampling everything. I can't harvest with them stumbling through the rows
RD_ALifeLine_61694b7f59203514: A pack of them came through the corn. If they stay, I lose the season
RD_ALifeLine_11ea9eac75606c6f: Thank you. You clear the rows, I'll fill your bag with whatever comes up
RD_ALifeLine_093a9744135610dd: Bless you. I'll mark the field. Watch the irrigation ditch, one's been lying in it for days
RD_ALifeLine_3425d96c2c6e5787: Good. I'm watching from the porch. With a shotgun. For moral support
RD_ALifeLine_35fe8d0c7ce76051: Right. Crops don't care if you're busy. Neither do I, really
RD_ALifeLine_1031f1723db3d821: My son was a soldier. National Guard. They went out to the roadblock and never came back
RD_ALifeLine_322c8abb76748c05: My boy was in uniform. I heard they all fell at the checkpoint. I need his tags. I need to bury something
RD_ALifeLine_29183b3322e8e232: Thank you. His name's on them, you'll know. Bring them home. Bring HIM home, sort of
RD_ALifeLine_6d48092d39b5e6df: Thank you. I'll mark the checkpoint. I'll sit here. I'm good at sitting now
RD_ALifeLine_290511ca1ac67c23: Don't. Don't do that to me. I've done hope. Hope is worse
RD_ALifeLine_38d82dc6656ca2a4: Okay. Thank you. Every day I clean his room. Stupid, isn't it
RD_ALifeLine_037918c33c3716dc: Books. Any books. The kids in our group are going crazy with nothing to read
RD_ALifeLine_1c999604068bdb01: A book. One book. Doesn't matter what. Kids need stories or they stop being kids
RD_ALifeLine_74953d617a7426c2: Thank you. No horror though. They've got enough horror. Something with dogs. Or dragons
RD_ALifeLine_172260b218955ca7: Great. I'm telling them the same three fairy tales on rotation. They're revolting
RD_ALifeLine_6e5b73f573f4caa3: SALT. I need salt. I've got meat, I've got time, I don't have salt. No salt, no curing, no winter
RD_ALifeLine_45cda4d22df48cbb: I'm a chef without salt. That's like a surgeon without hands. Find me salt?
RD_ALifeLine_4b37083a11b75526: Thank you! I'll make you the best jerky in the county. Possibly the ONLY jerky in the county

RD_ALifeLine_119d022941803ba7: Thanks. Today was a good one. Mostly because I met somebody who didn't try to kill me
RD_ALifeLine_2423449c10511d44: You shouldn't play hero out here
RD_ALifeLine_62143f11146b4b8c: Hero? I'm just trying to make it to lunch. But if I'm a hero.. fuck it, we ball
RD_ALifeLine_501f5efe06c989c5: Somebody's gotta be. Might as well be the idiot with the shovel
RD_ALifeLine_7260b9d61793ad1c: Just don't die being a hero
RD_ALifeLine_3f9e7a9e260e4dd1: *Laughs* We ball. Ain't no happy endings in Knox County, but we can try for a happy middle
RD_ALifeLine_34fbd2414a4f644b: No promises. But I'll try real hard. I've got plans. Big plans. Like eating dinner
RD_ALifeLine_000c3c36317f9bcc: Look up. No city lights anymore. I've never seen so many stars
RD_ALifeLine_65f8f82a196679db: I can't sleep. But look. The stars. My dad used to name them for me
RD_ALifeLine_03b2c5a20744decf: The end of the world has one good view. This is it
RD_ALifeLine_595c1bf14dc45370: Only the Big Dipper. Dad made the rest up. Captain Pancake. The Angry Goose. I still use his names
RD_ALifeLine_538b8a8c2fcfdec3: Are you all from around here?
RD_ALifeLine_7b1c4d6630a7a1cb: Most of us. Neighbours. We grabbed what we could and stuck together
RD_ALifeLine_18b4425333d16ae2: It's the only thing we know how to do. We're terrible at everything else
RD_ALifeLine_68ee73e920dcc767: Don't let him near your teeth. No anesthetic left. He's eager though. VERY eager
RD_ALifeLine_463d276f4c9b39bc: Holding together. Barely. Votes on everything. We argued an hour about who washes the pots
RD_ALifeLine_63f5377f7cae3168: We lost two on a supply run. We don't talk about it. We just set the table for less
RD_ALifeLine_3a65dbbc768c07fa: It's slow and annoying and I love it. Feels like something worth saving
RD_ALifeLine_4032f9e811df806e: Thanks. Their names are on the wall. We read them every Sunday. It's what we've got
RD_ALifeLine_0c8ffe16280be445: We are! We've got a schedule now. Watch rotations, cooking duty, even school for the young ones
RD_ALifeLine_5c13df2d23feb87a: Still here. Still arguing. Still sharing. That's the miracle
RD_ALifeLine_50ebe85608689a2f: Don't say it too loud. Every time someone says that, something goes wrong
RD_ALifeLine_7416d8000f99801e: Always. Come by. Bring an extra pair of hands and an appetite for arguments
RD_ALifeLine_2aa4959e5e8c5fd9: Work crew. We were on a job when it happened. Stuck together since. Like a union, but for not dying
RD_ALifeLine_2c9bb62f4abf446d: Just some guys from work. Construction, plumbing, a little electrical. We fix things
RD_ALifeLine_2fd576d9247ddb31: Can you fix things for me?
RD_ALifeLine_7c34004e205fe9f5: Depends. What you got and what you paying? We're not a charity. We're a crew
RD_ALifeLine_2568c8f22b6842da: The foreman. Same as before. Some things don't change
RD_ALifeLine_037bb464717994af: Always. We need materials. Nails, planks, metal. You bring it, we pay in food
RD_ALifeLine_5d64eba8450b2347: Work? We've got plenty. Pay's lousy but it's real
RD_ALifeLine_545f6074585de3bf: I'll bring you what I find
RD_ALifeLine_54ee3b605425f26d: Good. Ask for anyone in a hard hat. We'll treat you right
RD_ALifeLine_5074b2362aee0d9f: Twenty nails. Boxes or loose, don't care. Bring 'em and you eat
RD_ALifeLine_76adcda87998a3b1: Busy. Building walls for half the county. Everybody needs walls
RD_ALifeLine_049719cd44622393: Tired. Everyone wants something built. Nobody has anything to pay with
RD_ALifeLine_3cb4dd8e2ad4350e: Best business there is. Only one left with customers, ha
RD_ALifeLine_3d7e82327c3e8134: We do, don't we? Tell your friends. Word of mouth is all the advertising left
RD_ALifeLine_52a9c31a152791e6: A farm co-op. Families, a few hands, a lot of dirt. Everyone works, everyone eats
RD_ALifeLine_58123abe753790fd: We farm. Together. Feed each other, feed whoever comes peaceful
RD_ALifeLine_0a8a9eed336232ad: Always. Weed, haul water, keep watch. Do a day's work, eat a day's food
RD_ALifeLine_6f3b4b7757abbc9e: Enough to keep the fields. Not enough to keep the dead out every night. Never enough
RD_ALifeLine_5e13a36a77fa51f8: We run the river. Boats, rafts, whatever floats. People, goods, messages
RD_ALifeLine_55adcb1a0f092f0f: The river's the only road that's still clear. We keep it moving
RD_ALifeLine_334c212460a3f850: Maybe. Depends where. And depends what you've got. Rivers aren't free
RD_ALifeLine_1311d89a6ff0cb27: Food, fuel, bullets. Or news. Good news is worth a lot on the water
RD_ALifeLine_299b31a707cd7fde: Tools. Blades. Hinges. Anything metal. Someone has to make things again
RD_ALifeLine_47f595900933a318: We melt the old world down and make the new one. Sounds fancy. It's mostly hinges
RD_ALifeLine_5383799408e43246: Bring scrap or food. We'll see what we can make
RD_ALifeLine_35f90a052ead909d: It's sweaty is what it is. But yeah. I'm proud of it
RD_ALifeLine_18be41154ce24b7b: Done. Good steel too, not the junk from the hardware store
RD_ALifeLine_6f1cbf0c7599c332: Ours now. Truckers, mostly. We know the roads better than anyone alive
RD_ALifeLine_6d4c8d6662cde05b: We hold the truck stop. Fuel, food, a roof. Don't make trouble and you can stay a night
RD_ALifeLine_5a4e96b3631d17df: One night. Pay with something useful. Don't touch the diesel, we'll know
RD_ALifeLine_63c8e804321816d0: Highways are jammed with wrecks. Back roads are better but you'll meet people. Pick your poison
RD_ALifeLine_0c255607493961d3: Was. Now it's home for a lot of us. Teachers, parents, kids. We keep it running
RD_ALifeLine_0ab273f20ee68181: We hold the school. Kids, families. If you're decent you can rest here
RD_ALifeLine_42d96a3a2c49d908: It's good to see kids safe
RD_ALifeLine_4191a21c44c77b37: Safe as we can make them. We still do lessons. Math, reading, and how to be quiet
RD_ALifeLine_639502713ef5337c: Food, medicine, books. In that order. Kids eat a LOT
RD_ALifeLine_23d94796550f5253: A commune. Don't laugh. We share everything and nobody's in charge. It works. Mostly
RD_ALifeLine_43882a5d7e935737: Home for anyone who wants one. Pitch in, get fed. Fight, get out
RD_ALifeLine_535d8cc34cc73438: We all are. Meetings are long. Very long. But nobody gets left behind
RD_ALifeLine_6696387541d09dc2: Come back a few times. Help out. We'll know you. Then we'll talk
RD_ALifeLine_7843603b5c95e7e4: Took me ten years. Everyone laughed. Nobody's laughing now
RD_ALifeLine_54a39a1a16c35f1a: Don't get any ideas. Every inch of this place is covered. Every inch
RD_ALifeLine_4e71c90510ce7ae9: You were right, they were wrong
RD_ALifeLine_5faebcbb4ae3d22f: Damn right. I had canned food in 2003. My wife left me over it. Look who's eating now
RD_ALifeLine_58c3eca6330d29cc: Look from out there. Thanks. Nothing personal. Everything personal
RD_ALifeLine_12e8899b42ee7d97: You've been straight with me. That counts. I've got some spare ammo. Not much
RD_ALifeLine_0f57c1aa475b8de4: Okay. You're on my list. The good list. What do you need?
RD_ALifeLine_6f1dd41c50cfb0be: Ammo, if you can spare it
RD_ALifeLine_156c18d906296056: One box. Because you didn't try to rob me. That's my loyalty program
RD_ALifeLine_449a5dc7309270c2: Checking in. Huh. Okay. Thanks. Weird feeling. Good weird
RD_ALifeLine_267e5ef334013afb: Lines. Trying to keep a little power going. Generators, panels, whatever works
RD_ALifeLine_2bce73b37dd44057: Electrical. Somebody's gotta know how to make the lights turn on
RD_ALifeLine_16ac8a317284aa0e: For a building or two. Not the grid. The grid's dead. Dead like everything
RD_ALifeLine_041f173258ec4331: Live wires don't bite. They just kill you faster. Choose your death, I guess
RD_ALifeLine_3de2ae627a3fee1c: Did. Now we work for ourselves. Boards, firewood. Whatever keeps us alive
RD_ALifeLine_6f14e465390e57ad: We do. Lumber's worth a lot when everyone's building walls
RD_ALifeLine_640753c2086f1b36: Bring food or bullets. We'll cut you some. Fair price, no haggling. Okay, a little haggling
RD_ALifeLine_3522fe9d1ea51499: Always was. Just no paycheck now. Just bread
RD_ALifeLine_2081080f7d23a928: Twenty-two years. The dead can't stop us, they're just one more thing to argue about
RD_ALifeLine_19f466cc50d66f9e: She's my wife. I'm hers. We're a team. She's the brains, I'm the bait
RD_ALifeLine_107285aa678cfd8f: She still steals the blanket. Even now. Even here. Some things are forever
RD_ALifeLine_43e5049e5cefdd14: I'm loud and slow. She's quiet and fast. It works. Don't tell her I said she's the brains
RD_ALifeLine_707041291f225250: We fought about the last can of peaches. For an HOUR. Then we split it. Like always
RD_ALifeLine_4fe859ef526a0169: Fine. We had a fight about which way to go. I was right. She'll never admit it
RD_ALifeLine_1e6faef11a6cb9d5: We always do. You don't go to bed angry. Even if bed is a car seat
RD_ALifeLine_0112bfb90a62760b: Nobody wins. That's marriage. Apocalypse doesn't change it
RD_ALifeLine_2495591b087b5b88: Always. I was hiking when it started. Didn't even know for three days. Came back to this
RD_ALifeLine_4b2c2c40009b97e4: Yep. Alone's easier. Nobody to slow you down. Nobody to lose
RD_ALifeLine_595202e942b6b385: No signal on the trail. Came down to a gas station and the clerk tried to eat me. Some welcome back
RD_ALifeLine_16c236a54c8a4cab: Sometimes. But the trail taught me how to be alone. That's useful now
RD_ALifeLine_492415dc165c792a: Any tips for living out in the woods?
RD_ALifeLine_58d2922f69ca2d5c: Stay off ridgelines, you're visible. Camp near water but not too near. Bugs, and them
RD_ALifeLine_6158f96c705a1468: Fire small, fire low, out by dark. They see the light from far away
RD_ALifeLine_0e8b1b15421da4d4: Ever see them in the woods?
RD_ALifeLine_56d1ad86650b3c45: Sure. Woods are kinder than towns. Not kind. Kinder
RD_ALifeLine_3b35a95e2b96cfe4: Fewer. But they're out there. Wandering. Following roads mostly. Like they remember the way home
RD_ALifeLine_2858c9e567dc2ca1: Most of us. Cousins, aunts, uncles. Family sticks together. Always has
RD_ALifeLine_7863544c2a91da33: What's left of us. We don't take strangers in. No offense. Blood first
RD_ALifeLine_62efaaba5a6be008: Good. Then we'll get along fine. From a distance
RD_ALifeLine_0cb0f5ca0e93c201: Maybe. Bring something for the kids and we'll see
RD_ALifeLine_7ee2342d5bf6cea1: Find anything good on the road?
RD_ALifeLine_323f9fb824c107af: Cars are full of stuff. People packed to run and never made it. Sad. Useful. Both
RD_ALifeLine_3932f4ee7d656251: Suitcases, coolers, a guitar once. You'd be amazed what people tried to save
RD_ALifeLine_04f31d944e4c0a01: Still have it. Missing a string. I play it badly every night. Nobody complains. They're all dead
RD_ALifeLine_5b75cb3042ea5eb1: Some. Most's gone off. Check the trunks. People keep the good stuff in the trunk
RD_ALifeLine_1769913542ce7604: Wreck. Six cars, maybe seven, I stopped counting when the bitten ones started getting up
RD_ALifeLine_4ce8454d01ab5432: Bus went into the rail, half of them were sick already, and then.. then the sick ones got up
RD_ALifeLine_4021d07422a38091: Is anyone still alive in there?
RD_ALifeLine_6180513a4d5da565: Dead. Pupils blown, no pulse, I called it myself. Four minutes later he bit my partner
RD_ALifeLine_2ed1da981aeb7c82: Two. Maybe. A kid with a broken leg and a guy who won't stop screaming
RD_ALifeLine_4da3952c26595fcc: *Exhales* Okay. Keep anything that moves away from me for five minutes, that's all I need
RD_ALifeLine_31514b7a44f3a4e6: Grab the board out the back, we're moving the kid first
RD_ALifeLine_5fcb32291746b694: And go where? Dispatch stopped answering at noon, there's no where
RD_ALifeLine_412ef8177474378d: So don't tell me they're sick people. They're not people. Hit the head, it's the only thing that works
RD_ALifeLine_22c775ea727f33ce: I can't carry both and watch the road. I can't
RD_ALifeLine_0a969cae4c34c2d9: Take the kid, leave the screamer
RD_ALifeLine_23793bbd116905f8: Thank you.. I don't even know your name and you're the best partner I've had all week
RD_ALifeLine_34fdd1222a41b3d0: Ten more minutes. If they get up, I run. Promise
RD_ALifeLine_73dde02e64534149: *Looks at the ambulance* In the back. Strapped down. I couldn't.. I can't do it
RD_ALifeLine_0e98ab486fce07f8: Go. And if you see an ambulance with the lights on, don't stop for it
RD_ALifeLine_31e4cda7489c8f9b: That's.. yeah. Yeah, you're probably right. God I hate that you're right
RD_ALifeLine_1a0f5f232428ad5f: Then get out of my way
RD_ALifeLine_08437d5c3d801bc7: Don't open that door. Please. Just don't
RD_ALifeLine_780633c938a4c87c: Is anyone coming? Like, real help?
RD_ALifeLine_5c455d9a2c42713c: Real help.. *laughs* I AM the real help. That's the joke
RD_ALifeLine_27accbc741a82ccb: Dispatch keeps saying hold position. Hold it where? The position's on fire
RD_ALifeLine_37a680ba32403606: Then I guess I'm help too
RD_ALifeLine_4886824409fcee86: Same tape loop since this morning. Stay indoors, avoid the infected, wait for instructions
RD_ALifeLine_2eb4802046b49366: Nobody's coming. Say it out loud once, it hurts less the second time
RD_ALifeLine_54463cab41db278a: *Smiles* Okay, help. Rule one, don't touch blood with bare hands. Rule two, there's no rule two yet
RD_ALifeLine_2fa3ac0a0dc909e9: Nobody's giving instructions. There's a guy on the other end who just breathes and keys the mic
RD_ALifeLine_03ac4047661e1661: So we act like somebody is. Gloves on, keep working, keep the panic off the faces
RD_ALifeLine_1f3385b7409207eb: Yeah. I keep listening anyway. It's company
RD_ALifeLine_0b1443512d23fee6: *Quiet* Yeah.. yeah, I think he is. I talk to him sometimes
RD_ALifeLine_5a43445945771c57: Running it? It's a very expensive shed now. Fuel ran out three days ago
RD_ALifeLine_588c86c315016295: The rig's dry. No fuel, no oxygen, two bandages and a bag of saline I'm saving for someone I like
RD_ALifeLine_4b12e8ac00ab1cc8: Mike went home to his wife. Didn't come back. Dana got a scratch on day three and asked me to.. *stops*
RD_ALifeLine_68b9b5ba589f22b7: Antibiotics. Anything with -cillin or -mycin on the label. And gauze. God, I'd kill for gauze
RD_ALifeLine_0080677c37fba115: Because the radio's in it. Because if someone calls, they call the ambulance. Stupid huh
RD_ALifeLine_419ea32f50a67b35: Anyway it's just me. Me and the rig and the radio that only plays static
RD_ALifeLine_79d1b99243fdf6aa: Pharmacies got hit first. Everyone ran to the drugstores like it was gonna fix this
RD_ALifeLine_7089796032915e78: Don't be. Just.. if you find somebody hurt, bring them. I need to be useful or I'll lose it
RD_ALifeLine_3743590455bfbfc7: That's what I keep telling myself. Most days it works
RD_ALifeLine_1d4a58b61534ccea: You'd do that? Okay.. okay, I'll be here. Not like I've got anywhere to drive
RD_ALifeLine_1d9cf0442ca8788d: Thanks. I'll put it on the shelf next to my hope
RD_ALifeLine_084fbebf350d1285: You turned a house into a hospital?
RD_ALifeLine_7db38a2a049acd28: Kitchen table's the OR, the bathtub's the ICU. Don't laugh, it's worked twice
RD_ALifeLine_746f190b23b19b28: House, hospital, whatever. Has a roof and a door that locks, that's a five star facility now
RD_ALifeLine_78aa3782030aa40b: What can you actually treat here?
RD_ALifeLine_7b6301823620fe08: Cuts, breaks, burns, fevers if they're the normal kind. Bites I can't. Nobody can
RD_ALifeLine_58e18a781263bb3f: *Smiles* Thanks. Took me a week to stop setting the alarm for my shift
RD_ALifeLine_7decc48f3b0d0a68: I can stitch you, splint you and lie to you about how bad it looks. That's the whole menu
RD_ALifeLine_6cca53da566204be: Nine. Twice out of nine. The other seven had bites they didn't tell me about
RD_ALifeLine_02c05b537d60d9df: It is though. I'm the one with the shovel
RD_ALifeLine_54514e6752753a93: Everybody lies about a bite. Everybody. You would too
RD_ALifeLine_6412e148231c795d: You want the honest answer or the one I give the patients?
RD_ALifeLine_6351b6de53dc15c0: Holding? I'm not holding, I'm just.. not falling yet
RD_ALifeLine_2529dc73598330b4: I sleep two hours a night. I stopped crying around day twenty. I think something in me broke and I like it better this way
RD_ALifeLine_042fbf3f375ea89d: *Smiles wide* You're gonna be fine, this'll pinch a little, you're doing great
RD_ALifeLine_3bc2e19147fee52d: Thanks. Nobody's asked in weeks, I didn't know I'd need that
RD_ALifeLine_2775fb930e64d5ee: I used to get into this to save people. Now I triage who I won't waste supplies on
RD_ALifeLine_1fabaacb504c538a: See? Convincing. I've said it to forty dead people
RD_ALifeLine_10eb30dd5746fa8e: Is there a difference anymore? Tell me if you find one
RD_ALifeLine_4cabb0286d64353e: It is. And I'm good at it, which is worse
RD_ALifeLine_04f9f008791334ce: *Laughs* And who works the table while I sleep? You?
RD_ALifeLine_43aabad638994a33: Maybe, if you show me how
RD_ALifeLine_14c164a46efc8c30: ..You serious? Okay. Tomorrow, sutures on a pig foot, don't be late
RD_ALifeLine_0f881b67450b05d2: Yeah. Take care of yourself, I mean it
RD_ALifeLine_30b60e552c3d2492: People talk about you, you know
RD_ALifeLine_514e50324c815831: Do they? What do they say, that I'm crazy?
RD_ALifeLine_088861cc0de18b9c: Uh oh. Good things or the thing with the leg?
RD_ALifeLine_08c151e304f11250: They call you the road doc
RD_ALifeLine_2a30172674184b67: They say you go out for anyone
RD_ALifeLine_4929c689244dd9de: *Snorts* Road doc. I've got a driver's license and two years of EMT school. That's the doc part
RD_ALifeLine_1dcd7de75c9517a3: I do. Someone has to keep the old rules alive. Can't see a crash and drive past, never could
RD_ALifeLine_4f0a2b046bcf7878: Guy got pinned under a tractor. No saw, no time, the dead were coming over the field
RD_ALifeLine_5d9b3c116736aad8: But fine. If the name gets people to come to me before the wound goes green, I'll wear it
RD_ALifeLine_033e1ab2746c45de: Even now. Even with what's walking around. It's the last thing they didn't take from me
RD_ALifeLine_238d9c1516262705: Now I really want to know
RD_ALifeLine_20571f8919969a87: *Smiles* Good. Some stories are better as rumours
RD_ALifeLine_712f433d417c45ec: Hatchet and a belt and a lot of screaming. His, mostly. Okay, some mine
RD_ALifeLine_116fec423d5d6293: You look like you've seen something bad
RD_ALifeLine_6712689112c0d4c3: *Rubs eyes* Is it that obvious? Yeah. Yesterday was bad
RD_ALifeLine_205c77a979b74fed: Woman flagged me down, baby wasn't breathing. I did everything right. Everything
RD_ALifeLine_02ac33b039f7a544: Not really. But thanks for asking like you meant it
RD_ALifeLine_1e2885060497e70e: Already forgotten. That's my superpower now
RD_ALifeLine_0b442f9638317b75: Then the baby opened its eyes and I knew. I knew from the eyes
RD_ALifeLine_7a61dd342f50fbf3: He wasn't there. Nobody was. Just me and her and the.. sorry, give me a second
RD_ALifeLine_1ed9f6386662fa11: I could. That's the thing, I could, and I kept going because she was watching me
RD_ALifeLine_36dbe2074278d597: Some of it. Gloves, always. Scene safety, always. The rest burned with the hospital
RD_ALifeLine_319a60f6607f9dda: Protocol says wait for police to clear the scene. I've been waiting two weeks
RD_ALifeLine_6ef4a5ba470580f0: You should've dropped all of it
RD_ALifeLine_531dd97e5c078209: Wash your hands. Check your own body every night, every inch, mirror if you got one
RD_ALifeLine_130a5c552f6f6b75: Do no harm. Turns out sometimes harm's the kind option
RD_ALifeLine_4b4afc877ab27593: Drop it and what's left? A guy with a bag full of nothing. No thanks
RD_ALifeLine_287c17e338ff09ff: And never, ever let someone bitten sleep inside. I don't care who they are
RD_ALifeLine_2e4fde6554e127fd: You guys are still answering calls?
RD_ALifeLine_17b05e0e337ff668: Pagers keep going off, so yeah, we keep going
RD_ALifeLine_77ddb7753bab09bd: Nobody told us to stop. So we didn't stop
RD_ALifeLine_41e7f5e27cc5c4c4: Is it safe to be out with the trucks?
RD_ALifeLine_59d77c1f4ff1c522: House fires. Candles knocked over behind barricades. One guy set his own lawn on fire to keep them off
RD_ALifeLine_234809e266ff510f: The siren pulls 'em in like moths. We drove in quiet today, first time in my life
RD_ALifeLine_64f70bfc073fc588: Both, most days. Fire service has always been both
RD_ALifeLine_06f681a66fc72545: Did it work? Kinda. Then it took the house. Then the next house
RD_ALifeLine_21da93a15feae60f: Felt wrong. Like sneaking up on the people you're trying to help
RD_ALifeLine_06892c7c46d6948d: Him. And three of them came out of the smoke still burning, still walking. Fire doesn't stop 'em fast enough
RD_ALifeLine_572c9a6022d34d33: Long week and it's Tuesday. Or Thursday. Whatever
RD_ALifeLine_455224fb1cd9a455: You remember that. Burning ones keep coming and now they're also on fire. Worst of both
RD_ALifeLine_616acbc571068167: Hydrants are dropping pressure. Engine's on a quarter tank and we're siphoning lawnmowers
RD_ALifeLine_594363d93143a740: We've got a pumper with no water and an axe with plenty of work, that's how
RD_ALifeLine_6fb743b024c1babb: Why keep the station at all?
RD_ALifeLine_58ab53535223f13d: Because people know where it is. Big red doors. Every kid in the county knows where the fire station is
RD_ALifeLine_598e86c81fe7c2ec: Was eleven on the roster. Four now. Two of the four are probationers who never saw a real fire before this week
RD_ALifeLine_07376aa56ec78d5b: We do. Thing is the cars that still have gas usually have someone in 'em who didn't make it out
RD_ALifeLine_5e4144616c9c5da9: If somebody's in trouble they'll come here. I want somebody to be here when they do
RD_ALifeLine_427ff6492a68f5a9: They're good kids. They learn fast. Faster than I'd like
RD_ALifeLine_78ddbe9178748708: Two decades of forcing doors. Turns out a skull's easier than a steel door
RD_ALifeLine_31c874ba6e5ea08d: It's a Pulaski, I don't name it, the probie named it. Don't ask
RD_ALifeLine_0ecb7db9604d8b84: Teach me how you swing it
RD_ALifeLine_2b8a94ec7fcc6761: What did the probie name it?
RD_ALifeLine_3bb1a70178eecf73: Short swings. Don't wind up like it's a movie. Feet planted, aim behind the head, pull it out on the way back
RD_ALifeLine_1fde030724cddd89: *Sighs* Susan. After his ex-wife. Says it's therapeutic
RD_ALifeLine_38a4a1f563fddb5e: Every one of 'em was somebody's neighbour. I knew the guy from the hardware store. Took him down on day nine
RD_ALifeLine_5c44998015f735a4: And breathe. Everyone forgets to breathe. Then they're winded and there's four more
RD_ALifeLine_5c30b63020fc70d8: So yeah. It gets to me. I just don't let it get to me while I'm swinging
RD_ALifeLine_4e94e85d4a8ee382: Any time. Better you learn it from me than from a mistake
RD_ALifeLine_051697b50b631008: That's us. Body pile. We burn them twice a week, upwind, away from the wells
RD_ALifeLine_13367a4333453cd0: Burn day. Can't bury 'em fast enough and the flies are worse than the dead
RD_ALifeLine_6131b74e09661293: You enjoy it a little, huh
RD_ALifeLine_785b619e3f59a1d0: Fire's always dangerous. Leaving them rot by the creek is worse. Ask anyone who drank the water last week
RD_ALifeLine_0aa4f7367cfa9205: Helps with the smell, the sick, the flies. Helps with the nightmares, a little. Watching 'em go
RD_ALifeLine_05426fac1b02f013: Firebreak, wet blankets, two people on watch. Not our first fire
RD_ALifeLine_407a15c375c839d2: I put out fires for twenty years. You know what it costs me to light one every Tuesday?
RD_ALifeLine_7f93c86001449eb2: Is it true you still roll the engine out?
RD_ALifeLine_5ce0d0fc43bd0dfd: Once a week, whether there's a fire or not. Keeps the battery alive. Keeps us alive too, in here
RD_ALifeLine_2cfdd6ef3ffed480: True. Folks hear the engine, they know somebody's still in charge of something
RD_ALifeLine_50f74d6c0ca7606c: Doesn't the noise bring the dead?
RD_ALifeLine_5bf91c4d0c0973b4: Who are you working for now?
RD_ALifeLine_03b68d8a104b7f10: It does. So we drive it out where we want them to follow. Then we drive it back the long way
RD_ALifeLine_74e9cd427740e4d2: Anybody who'll trade. Water, fuel, a hot meal. Fire doesn't care whose house it is and neither do we
RD_ALifeLine_44410aa610008a3d: *Laughs* Don't tell the crew you said that, they'll get ideas about polishing it
RD_ALifeLine_2008501a05b44556: Dead are like a bad chimney fire. You don't fight it, you tell it where to go
RD_ALifeLine_6bc6c7de2e3ef505: Rich folks, poor folks, the crazies down the road. We go. We always go
RD_ALifeLine_7f57c483515e4f2f: What do you charge for a call out?
RD_ALifeLine_04533883498150ba: Depends on the fire. A barn, a house with people in it, a car you just don't want burning near your door
RD_ALifeLine_076209ec13ddcdb6: Fuel, mostly. We run on fuel, so we take fuel
RD_ALifeLine_63c24fd558e490c9: Then we come anyway and complain the whole drive. Don't tell anyone that part
RD_ALifeLine_1ff477bf110a7c7b: Two jerry cans. Or tools, good ones. Or food that's not beans, God, anything that's not beans
RD_ALifeLine_2a20b41f4d7e041f: Cold is a pumper with no diesel and a house going up with kids inside. Fuel keeps the engine warm
RD_ALifeLine_07405cec1b701d21: *Groans* ..Fine. Fine, beans it is. You're on the list, we'll come if you call
RD_ALifeLine_2cb8012d068d15dc: You do that. Big red doors, you know where
RD_ALifeLine_05d773e671ad5e9e: The young one looks scared out of his mind
RD_ALifeLine_7f3441bc2f2e4ba5: He is. He's nineteen and his first real call was the end of the world
RD_ALifeLine_07e48c8453fa9d1d: Probie? Yeah. Don't tell him I said so, but he's doing better than me
RD_ALifeLine_1e0c05a258d3fa32: Want me to talk to him?
RD_ALifeLine_00f0dd6e3d31112b: I don't know. I keep giving him jobs so he doesn't have time to think. Works on me too
RD_ALifeLine_619c70a84624dddc: Tell him a joke. A dumb one. He laughs at dumb ones, it's the only time he looks his age
RD_ALifeLine_77f8b2d75b57ae96: That's what I told him. Scared keeps you looking over your shoulder. Brave gets you a plaque on the wall
RD_ALifeLine_7b62430c7b40fce3: Why do you still wear the helmet?
RD_ALifeLine_787bd5c367b5b957: 'Cause it's mine. Because it fits. Because it stops a crowbar, I've tested that
RD_ALifeLine_3bd205e3689b7e44: Somebody has to look like help. Helmet does half the talking
RD_ALifeLine_30f5ec806e328a14: Everything's a target. I'd rather be shot for being a fireman than for being nobody
RD_ALifeLine_21cc58f9049f6e1a: Mostly. Some folks see it and ask why we didn't save their house. Fair question
RD_ALifeLine_6a7a146e63acfcec: I don't have an answer. I just tell 'em we tried. We did try
RD_ALifeLine_2c5257693c3bc615: What's it like at the hospital?
RD_ALifeLine_6cf7d70a53f68a2b: Hallways full. Beds in the parking garage. They stopped letting us leave on day two
RD_ALifeLine_0682827b79c943dc: You want the truth? We lost the third floor last night. We lost it to our own patients
RD_ALifeLine_049c7ff513ce4d79: Are they telling you what this is?
RD_ALifeLine_3550d5e44eb60097: Why are you out here then?
RD_ALifeLine_27f9ea7535dbaa19: Fever, coma, then they.. wake up. And they don't know anyone. And they bite. We had them strapped down and it wasn't enough
RD_ALifeLine_3462906327fd6f4e: Officially? A rabies-like illness, stay calm, isolate the bitten. Unofficially the doctors stopped talking to each other
RD_ALifeLine_3946fa8c19abf571: I walked out. Shift ended and I just.. kept walking. Nobody stopped me. Nobody was left to
RD_ALifeLine_371978e903b2ce06: We sealed the doors with patients still inside who weren't sick. I held the door. I held the door
RD_ALifeLine_110a320e09fb7e8e: A resident said it's in everyone's blood and the bite just.. wakes it. He got pulled off the floor an hour later
RD_ALifeLine_521196a849a158a1: *Wipes face* Everybody keeps saying that. Somebody has to be at fault. Might as well be me
RD_ALifeLine_791ccae46c03d32b: Men in masks. Not ours. I don't know whose
RD_ALifeLine_44c46ecc767364d8: I believe I haven't seen a single bitten person survive. Anything past that is somebody's guess
RD_ALifeLine_46385b822a4ad10a: What do the coloured tags mean?
RD_ALifeLine_7230a8ab5c906b15: Green walks, yellow waits, red goes first. Black means we've stopped
RD_ALifeLine_17d6ec4f2884017f: Triage. I used to do it on exercise days with actors and fake blood
RD_ALifeLine_1c3f5ddd253a2ea0: There's a new colour. We don't have a tag for it so we use tape. You don't want the tape
RD_ALifeLine_4dcd852321bbe516: Me. Today it's me. Four hours of sleep and I'm deciding who gets the last bag of blood
RD_ALifeLine_3e74dca804830304: *Looks you over* No blood, no limp, eyes clear.. green. Go stand by the wall and stay out of my way, please
RD_ALifeLine_56752b725d7fb336: They go in the back room and we give them what we can. Morphine if we have it. Company if we don't
RD_ALifeLine_678551f700b2251b: Do you have any medicine left?
RD_ALifeLine_7610f6437eaf8050: Left? I've got aspirin, half a roll of tape and a lot of opinions
RD_ALifeLine_5d0f30c66ed83c3c: *Laughs bitterly* Look at this shelf. That's my whole pharmacy. I've been rationing Tylenol like it's gold
RD_ALifeLine_0f7f971e49378526: What do you need the most?
RD_ALifeLine_76c5aabb14b2be17: How do you treat people then?
RD_ALifeLine_36fea1c33d7934b7: Antibiotics. Wounds go bad in three days in this heat. I can stitch all day, the infection kills them anyway
RD_ALifeLine_73736eff2d0766ee: Looted on day two. People took everything. Somebody's out there eating heart pills like candy
RD_ALifeLine_29c4dc4f180d28cf: Clean water, clean hands, rest and lying. Placebo works better than you'd think, when it's all you have
RD_ALifeLine_285cc4f803eb3123: If you ever find a bottle, any bottle with a pharmacy label, bring it here. I'll make it worth it
RD_ALifeLine_2d6d1d5332904c0b: What would you trade for it?
RD_ALifeLine_4b1dd03d7b42d86a: Thank you. Really. Check medicine cabinets, glove boxes, old ladies' purses. Old ladies always have something
RD_ALifeLine_67807f5008f875a7: Whatever I've got. Food. A splint. My honest opinion on that rash you're hiding
RD_ALifeLine_50a270641a137f31: Where'd you learn to do surgery?
RD_ALifeLine_6d5238433ab9fc03: Watching. Then doing. Then doing it badly and the patient living anyway
RD_ALifeLine_58dc8f4a67ee5b54: I'm a nurse. Was a nurse. Now I'm whatever walks in needs me to be
RD_ALifeLine_706a91925bd2f20b: Have you ever lost someone on the table?
RD_ALifeLine_3cb920dc181e8158: Can you teach me the basics?
RD_ALifeLine_27d4d3f5025cc903: Three. And the fourth one I saved, he died of fever a week later. That one counts double
RD_ALifeLine_2badf7df6d9dd9fa: Okay. Boil everything. Then boil it again. Stitches close the skin, not the meat, pack it and let it drain
RD_ALifeLine_4a5a16402bf666a7: Yeah. You get used to it. That's the most terrifying part
RD_ALifeLine_30d2ac0c068311c0: Don't feel sorry for me. Feel sorry for them, they had me
RD_ALifeLine_371a4a20378bd198: And if it smells sweet and the skin goes dark around it, come find me fast. Fast, you hear?
RD_ALifeLine_4bf4931c241fa5cf: Good. Now you know more than half the people out there who call themselves medics
RD_ALifeLine_20e016ca7027ef8f: Why do you keep doing this?
RD_ALifeLine_6d380c6b51d31e06: Good question. Ask me when I've slept
RD_ALifeLine_35734f7822dc5ca3: Because I'm too stubborn to stop and too tired to think of something else
RD_ALifeLine_3685871159e08006: You could just look after yourself
RD_ALifeLine_530f8d1e5118f65b: I tried. For three days. I sat in a house and ate soup and listened to someone screaming two streets over
RD_ALifeLine_310039e90bf52808: People need antibiotics and clean water. They get me instead. I'm a bad substitute
RD_ALifeLine_7383fc294eb3d64a: Yeah. Someone. I keep waiting for the someone to show up and take over
RD_ALifeLine_6f5f37135dded3ee: On day four I went to see who it was. Broken ankle. Silly thing. So here I am
RD_ALifeLine_0a87087e3e8cb9d6: *Quiet* Sorry. That came out mean. I'm grateful when people show up, I just.. I'm grateful
RD_ALifeLine_315a16543ab0a8b9: You're running a pretty tight ship here
RD_ALifeLine_5ac0f66250b3422f: I have to. One slack day and we've got a fever going through the whole house
RD_ALifeLine_1b0e5f6605f306fb: Rules on the wall, read them. Boots off at the door, hands washed, nobody hides a scratch
RD_ALifeLine_10a90b063e1abb15: What happens if someone hides one?
RD_ALifeLine_0708fff6089bdf63: They leave. I'm not cruel, I give them food for the road. But they leave
RD_ALifeLine_1a208f5040c45bb6: It is a bit much. It's also why everyone in here is still breathing
RD_ALifeLine_0037f3c75efa4e00: *Nods* Thank you. People think I'm a tyrant. I'm a nurse with a list of names I won't add to
RD_ALifeLine_2edd1d0862267f18: I lost a whole family of six because one boy hid a bite from his mother. Never again. Never
RD_ALifeLine_015ed0a4510dc435: You're the one everyone sends people to
RD_ALifeLine_1af723e25b9b8c05: That's what they tell me. I think it's because I'm the only one who doesn't charge with a gun
RD_ALifeLine_39c7429b281d25b9: I don't know when that happened. I just kept opening the door
RD_ALifeLine_33a8b8af6168ccbb: I stopped counting at three hundred. Most were cuts and fevers. A few were miracles. A few I don't talk about
RD_ALifeLine_3489ca3f69e83ce3: Honestly? Spite. This thing wanted all of us. I'm keeping some of us
RD_ALifeLine_18d68b4679c3c94b: To bites. Only bites. I give them something for the pain and a chair by the fire and I sit with them
RD_ALifeLine_2ec64e8024a349f0: There's a boy I set his arm on day twenty. He brings me eggs now. I count that one every morning
RD_ALifeLine_4a8e33a603bada1a: Nobody should turn alone. That's my only rule that isn't about hand washing
RD_ALifeLine_2a6ce89573b207aa: They say you're the only doctor left around here
RD_ALifeLine_0d94be990d2047c6: I'm a vet. Horses, cows, the odd dog with a fishhook in its lip. But yes, apparently I'm the doctor now
RD_ALifeLine_3687828b661ed5e8: *Snorts* A doctor. I spayed the mayor's cat, that's my credentials
RD_ALifeLine_35f0a0a4260642ef: Is it any different, treating people?
RD_ALifeLine_48e4ece7628a4c9d: People complain more and kick less. And a horse never asked me if it was going to turn
