RD_ALifeLine_63ba782a5bbb17d4: More than you'd like. Medicine doesn't grow on trees and I'm keeping a barn full of people alive
RD_ALifeLine_4e13322f286361f7: Sit on the hay bale. No, the other one, the clean one. Hm. You'll live. Eat something green
RD_ALifeLine_1e81c6167d6131ca: The dosages are the hard part. I did a lot of math on day one. A lot of praying too
RD_ALifeLine_2ba566a47a922c03: Bring me antibiotics and I'll treat you for free for a month. That's the best deal in the county
RD_ALifeLine_44b5e9ea07d436bc: Inmates, guards, whoever. Behind that door they're all just patients
RD_ALifeLine_63e2b57f4c4b6e1c: There's a locked wing and two of us and a doctor who hasn't left the building since Tuesday
RD_ALifeLine_2a1bbc076b32ae43: Why not lock up and leave?
RD_ALifeLine_6a9c59d10c4585e6: Of the inmates? No. Of what's coming up the corridor, yes. That's the only kind of afraid I have time for
RD_ALifeLine_1946be8741a69008: Half of them went home. The other half are in the yard, and some of them aren't guards anymore
RD_ALifeLine_6235b80f6ae2703e: And go where? I've got a man in bed four with a collapsed lung who's in for check fraud. He doesn't deserve to die in a cell
RD_ALifeLine_6bcf04166676c445: Don't go in the yard. Just.. don't
RD_ALifeLine_52fea33429a9f3d2: Where are you heading with that kit?
RD_ALifeLine_5b53c3d43844e503: Wherever someone's hurt. That's the whole plan
RD_ALifeLine_4584c36877e27f01: Nowhere. Everywhere. I walk until someone needs a bandage, then I stop
RD_ALifeLine_256b550c5524ee02: Have you got anything to spare?
RD_ALifeLine_3fe6e67b27ea04ab: Groups argue. Groups get noticed. Alone I can sleep in a closet and nobody hears me cry
RD_ALifeLine_0fbba866419ae7ab: For a bit? Sure. Walk ahead though, I like to see who I'm with
RD_ALifeLine_18dce19d76640938: A bandage. One. Don't waste it on a scrape
RD_ALifeLine_316956dd573f39a7: Is this the end of the world, preacher?
RD_ALifeLine_4cbead852ab210c2: *Long breath* I've preached on Revelation forty times. I never once pictured it in a Kentucky July
RD_ALifeLine_765e0774597210ed: People keep asking me that like I've got the schedule. I don't. Nobody does
RD_ALifeLine_5e4f9dcc48b1c4f2: Does it say anything about this in the Bible?
RD_ALifeLine_24d0f6335ce36465: I don't believe in any of that
RD_ALifeLine_73df6c741b459b8e: I think it's sickness. I think God is bigger than sickness. Some hours I believe both, some hours neither
RD_ALifeLine_4e720e5d6a3bf9a3: The dead rising, sure. Usually there's trumpets first. I didn't hear any trumpets, just sirens
RD_ALifeLine_0c5ba12d762583e2: That's alright. Soup doesn't check your beliefs at the door. Sit down, eat
RD_ALifeLine_69aabb2f6ff9de3e: Either way the hungry still need feeding. That's never been confusing
RD_ALifeLine_26dc402638f47073: Don't quote me on that to the congregation. They're scared enough
RD_ALifeLine_577fd154774926d7: Can I stay here a while?
RD_ALifeLine_15612a2724a4c25e: Maybe. First tell me, what do you believe?
RD_ALifeLine_5e5b6096005e6bee: We take people in. We ask one thing first. What do you believe in?
RD_ALifeLine_1ca96eb73faa5206: *Smiles* Then you're home. Bed's in the basement, chores at dawn, prayer before supper
RD_ALifeLine_3377898b23b96cc8: Honest answer. That's worth more than a dozen loud ones. You can stay, we'll talk more
RD_ALifeLine_03a1a7c4222b861a: Then you'll leave the gun at the door. We'll feed you. We won't arm you and we won't fight your fights
RD_ALifeLine_067ab12c04240288: It matters to us. Everything else got taken, what we believe is what's left
RD_ALifeLine_00cc4ac064ff174f: That's not a judgment. It's the rule. Rules kept this place standing
RD_ALifeLine_4b5dc6f80683e3b9: Every night. Louder at first. Now it's more of a.. conversation where one side's quiet
RD_ALifeLine_0765a4074583e6ce: I pray. I'm just not sure it's going anywhere. Don't tell anyone I said that
RD_ALifeLine_5ccd5f9616722427: Food. Rain on the garden. That my sister in the city got out. That the little Henderson girl stops coughing
RD_ALifeLine_74ad9dbd17db4a6a: Because the moment I stop, the people here will notice. They watch my face to know if it's okay to be scared
RD_ALifeLine_42f4aabf2687d4bc: *Smiles* Good. Then we're two voices. Maybe two is loud enough
RD_ALifeLine_2c869d8937a6c8d1: Small things. I stopped asking for big things around day five
RD_ALifeLine_1e136b1819fd1235: So I keep praying. If it's only for them, maybe that's still worth something
RD_ALifeLine_0e6cb0b63a7ea49c: How many people are you sheltering?
RD_ALifeLine_511a04bd22fd739a: Thirty one last night. Twenty nine this morning. I won't say what happened to the two
RD_ALifeLine_206a3c3f77d96489: Too many for the pews and not enough for the food. That's the math every day
RD_ALifeLine_10e28eb626416e86: How do you feed them all?
RD_ALifeLine_6808469e36745abc: One left on her own. One.. got sick. We did it gently. As gently as you can
RD_ALifeLine_5e5e2f5b3bd1d2b3: The garden, the canned drive we had planned for Christmas, and a lot of soup that's mostly water
RD_ALifeLine_77e11fb7231b1f39: Is it you? Are you asking for yourself?
RD_ALifeLine_7f149bd54a763698: Someone I found on the road
RD_ALifeLine_440bff6904846ae3: Anything you can bring helps. Even a can. Even a single can
RD_ALifeLine_1f57a797558f4eec: Then come in. Check-in's with Martha at the door, she'll check your arms. Don't take it personal
RD_ALifeLine_3171edea5e2be0e8: Bring them by daylight. We don't open after dark, not for anyone, I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_26211a3b22f66eb2: I am. I've seen too much now to doubt. The dead walk and we're still here. That's a sign, friend
RD_ALifeLine_40fc7088063777b1: We were spared. Do you understand? Spared. There's a reason, and I intend to find it
RD_ALifeLine_0fdce435371c4cb3: That we're meant to carry on. Build again. Be kinder than the world that ended
RD_ALifeLine_2daf9b440cd22fd6: *Smiles thinly* Lucky every day for a month? That's a lot of luck. I'll call it grace, you call it luck, we both eat
RD_ALifeLine_017a14b8311bf029: It does. More than you know. Faith's the only thing in this building that doesn't run out
RD_ALifeLine_6eec62b607d00184: Some here think it's punishment. I think it's a second chance. I'd rather preach the second chance
RD_ALifeLine_07295b72299ad6a1: Where's the cross you used to wear?
RD_ALifeLine_5fbb90e53c4f0a6c: In a drawer. Took it off the day I buried my brother. Haven't put it back on
RD_ALifeLine_6a5b059535c51e51: Gave it to a dying woman. She asked for it. I didn't want it back
RD_ALifeLine_3b29e5835e239f47: You should put it back on
RD_ALifeLine_0f1f9e255b71c8b1: I believe in people. Some days. The God part I've put away, like the cross. Maybe for later
RD_ALifeLine_3da77cbe36fec682: Maybe. When I can look at it without being angry. Not yet
RD_ALifeLine_10f9765f751b6fe9: Thank you. He was a deacon. He'd have hated what I said at his grave. I said it anyway
RD_ALifeLine_20add63900ce7c94: Could you say a few words for someone I lost?
RD_ALifeLine_4edda12432bf7d67: Of course. Sit with me. Tell me their name
RD_ALifeLine_338d30d7532e6480: *Takes your hand* Yes. Always yes. Who were they?
RD_ALifeLine_2f04b6a03bf74c78: Someone I had to put down myself
RD_ALifeLine_685529ad53407d21: Then they suffered and now they don't. That's mercy, even if it came ugly
RD_ALifeLine_5f14b19d3ee87998: *Holds your hand tighter* Oh, child.. all of them. Alright. Alright, we'll say all their names
RD_ALifeLine_3e40b87b5ad6fa27: Then you carried a weight no one should carry. That's love too. A hard love, but love
RD_ALifeLine_4f529a232e6f947b: Lord, keep them now, they were tired. Keep this one here too, they're still walking
RD_ALifeLine_707ab2332c386a59: *Quiet a while* There. They're remembered. Come back if you need to say it again
RD_ALifeLine_12b47c172e66f995: A kitchen, a schoolroom and a gate. That's what we've got, and it's more than most
RD_ALifeLine_029858b20742e7bc: Families who took each other in. Nobody's in charge, which means everyone's in charge, which means a lot of meetings
RD_ALifeLine_25af03710a78d936: What do you need from outsiders?
RD_ALifeLine_1f074f12019f73d4: How do you keep trouble out?
RD_ALifeLine_73e2de5f0b4e3fec: Anyone who helps and doesn't bring trouble. We'll watch you a few weeks first. Don't take it hard
RD_ALifeLine_666fcc786227b04f: Hands. Seeds. A doctor if you find one. Someone who knows engines, God, we need someone who knows engines
RD_ALifeLine_68103a1002269092: A gate watch and a long memory. We forgive a lot. We don't forget anything
RD_ALifeLine_3d2e00f7402b4ff4: How can you believe God let this happen?
RD_ALifeLine_631438fc08ff0d80: *Sighs* That's the question, isn't it. I've asked it myself, loud, at three in the morning
RD_ALifeLine_2391854546a5e184: You're not the first to ask. You won't be the last. I don't have a neat answer
RD_ALifeLine_575868af133880e0: I don't think He let it. I think it happened, and He's in the people who stay to help. That's the best I've got
RD_ALifeLine_32c62144196eb772: I don't. Anyone who says they know is selling something. I'm just giving soup away
RD_ALifeLine_5eb812cb424e69f8: Don't be sorry for asking. Be sorry if you stop asking
RD_ALifeLine_7753058510fd0a16: You can throw it out. But you came here and asked a preacher, so part of you wanted an answer
RD_ALifeLine_3247f58873e622bc: Do the dead out there still have souls?
RD_ALifeLine_27f46dae259fa2ea: I hope not. I hope they left. The thought of someone trapped in there.. *shakes head*
RD_ALifeLine_3abe739a4f7bdcee: I tell myself the soul goes when the eyes go grey. I have to, or I couldn't stand next to the ones who swing the axe
RD_ALifeLine_59d2a86f67846ed0: Killing them is setting what's left free. That's what I say over every one we burn
RD_ALifeLine_7d7540d4398f4937: Then God forgive us all. And I think He would, given what we're up against
RD_ALifeLine_33e80ebf5e20ec90: Technically me. I have a clipboard, that's how you can tell
RD_ALifeLine_3907ab4c0623cce9: *Flips pages* Me, I guess. Are you registering? Name, town, anyone missing?
RD_ALifeLine_02dbe7235833ce7e: So when the buses come, we know who's here. So families can find each other
RD_ALifeLine_7d2b759f42cb06f8: We were told the high school gym. When we got there it was.. not a shelter anymore. So, here, for now
RD_ALifeLine_4bc6bf9639c40b91: Good. Cot forty-two, water's at the back, one cup each, I'm sorry it's only one
RD_ALifeLine_78997dc94105047f: *Pen stops* Show me. Now please, not later
RD_ALifeLine_639247dc4d56a02b: *Quieter* The buses are coming. They said buses. I'm sure they're coming
RD_ALifeLine_35db01902aaa9ca0: ..Okay. Okay it's a nail, not a nail, not teeth. You're fine. You scared me half to death
RD_ALifeLine_189b7b380bc51eab: No. No buses, no trucks, no helicopters except the ones that fly past and don't land
RD_ALifeLine_5eb6afc911a86046: *Laughs, too loud* The buses. Right. I stopped writing the bus list on Sunday
RD_ALifeLine_5330327c27eee706: Now we're not a relief column. We're just people with a lot of cots and not enough food
RD_ALifeLine_7725ff95509f77f4: *Looks at you a long while* ..You're kind. Don't be kind about that, it makes it harder
RD_ALifeLine_706adf182e33dc2d: I know. I knew on day three. I just needed one more day where I didn't say it out loud
RD_ALifeLine_160ec879606b8f7b: I keep doing the clipboard. It's the only thing that makes me feel like it's still a job
RD_ALifeLine_48d2b14e0954b23d: What's that board with all the photos?
RD_ALifeLine_5b011df946594c31: Missing persons. People pin up who they're looking for. Nobody's taken one down in a week
RD_ALifeLine_68b30f2637144380: That's the wall. Pictures, names, where they were last seen. Read it if you've got a minute
RD_ALifeLine_73c3bd077519251b: Two. A grandmother found her grandson. He was at the next shelter over the whole time. Everybody cried
RD_ALifeLine_07fe2889014d43d2: Of course. Write their name big. Describe what they were wearing, people remember clothes
RD_ALifeLine_1472c087384e0355: It is. I put up my husband the first night. I walk past him every morning
RD_ALifeLine_1ea0bd765cc9e0c0: So the wall stays up. Two is enough to keep it up
RD_ALifeLine_07a12fb527e0eaa6: You're carving names into the wall?
RD_ALifeLine_1469ecd32a651be7: The ones we lost here. Someone has to remember they were here, and paper burns
RD_ALifeLine_44c24b5c0f1f3725: Yeah. Kids asked where people go. I said here. On the wall. They stay
RD_ALifeLine_2c69912667f2bc8c: Forty eight. Two last night. I've gotten fast at it, which is the worst thing I can say about myself
RD_ALifeLine_6fbdb28f4be0385f: *Hands you the nail* Take your time. Spell it right. That's all that matters now
RD_ALifeLine_68a93dc81ecd7d41: It helps the ones still here. The dead don't care. The living need a place to put it
RD_ALifeLine_4e0c643d4528ea60: Who else knows how to keep thirty scared people in one room and get them to do chores?
RD_ALifeLine_1193ecb909c542e3: We had the building, the keys and the patience. Turns out that's a lot
RD_ALifeLine_5dad0fc17eb84e00: Food. We're out. Well, nearly out. We've got crackers and a reading list
RD_ALifeLine_171cf85951bceb70: They're doing lessons. Math, reading, how to be quiet. They're better at the last one than any class I ever had
RD_ALifeLine_1fd4719e616fb697: Another week. Maybe. After that we start making choices I won't make. So we'll find food before then
RD_ALifeLine_57e2eb915a08e420: Seriously, any food. We'll trade lessons, chores, a warm room for a night. Anything
RD_ALifeLine_59fd3f0634ea1b64: Cops, firemen and medics in one crew?
RD_ALifeLine_5aaeb08704eba90f: Turns out when nobody's dispatching, the turf wars stop pretty quick
RD_ALifeLine_7f2c12b337d3e5d8: Deputy drives, fire breaks the door, medic goes in. Same as always. We just stopped waiting for the radio
RD_ALifeLine_1bd689c971a9b528: Whoever knows the most about the thing that's on fire right now. We switch a lot
RD_ALifeLine_13178eae216c0a39: Arrest them and put them where? We tell people to leave. If they hurt someone we don't help them again. That's the law now
RD_ALifeLine_0de123d310285f65: Maybe. Help us on a few calls, see if you panic. If you don't, we'll talk
RD_ALifeLine_65a1804244754295: I'd like to talk to your council
RD_ALifeLine_07b0547a1112d1b9: Show me your hands first. Both of them. Sleeves up
RD_ALifeLine_7280375f4e65453f: Hands. Then we'll see about the council
RD_ALifeLine_6ba0802c067343bf: I'm armed, but I'm not here for trouble
RD_ALifeLine_73ae986264da10ff: *Looks* No bites, no shaking, you've worked. Okay. Council sits on the first day of the week, at dusk
RD_ALifeLine_2529db1a4d52c52f: Hands tell me if you're sick, if you work, if you've been fighting. Badges tell me nothing anymore
RD_ALifeLine_050fa1da27a80bad: Then the weapon stays with the gate watch. You get it back when you leave. Not before
RD_ALifeLine_2bb7b95633f5c366: Come in daylight, no weapons past the gate. You speak when the bell rings. You'll get heard
RD_ALifeLine_6a2dfb8a59bf650c: Then the council will still be here. Come back when you're ready to be one of the neighbours
RD_ALifeLine_208dabc14653df48: How does the Commonwealth actually work?
RD_ALifeLine_25fab6cc784306ff: One vote per household. Farmers, former responders, a couple of teachers. We argue a lot
RD_ALifeLine_13343ce252b7aeba: A council, a watch rota and a ledger. The ledger is the most important. Who gave, who took, who owes
RD_ALifeLine_54f1927868c14f8e: What does the ledger say about me?
RD_ALifeLine_1289c87d675f0260: That you've been fair so far. Keep being fair and the ledger stays kind
RD_ALifeLine_54490d5f02fec241: Everybody. Everyone over sixteen takes a watch shift, even the doctor. Especially the doctor, she's a good shot
RD_ALifeLine_537bdc6f31ef1395: Slowly. A season on the outer farms first. Some leave, some stay. The ones who stay usually stay for good
RD_ALifeLine_5ec5e2ed0287f13f: What does the relief column actually have?
RD_ALifeLine_552cbd740947ba39: Cots, water purification tabs, blankets and a satellite phone nobody answers
RD_ALifeLine_3cc78bb56b2ad6b3: Three trucks. One's broken, one's for the cots, one's mostly paperwork. Sorry. That's honest
RD_ALifeLine_1d233a6076697bda: Water tabs? Can I get some?
RD_ALifeLine_2583bb5b39baf991: Who's on the other end of the phone?
RD_ALifeLine_58c92c032a662163: Two. Per person. Per day. That's what the sheet says and I'm sticking to the sheet till something better comes
RD_ALifeLine_336d0e2b2398954f: A recording, a long way from here. Remain at your designated location. I don't know what our designated location is
RD_ALifeLine_5a5dfe511da14aca: Requisition forms. In triplicate. For an apocalypse. *Laughs* I used one to start a fire last night
RD_ALifeLine_422772081cadfff1: Is the church taking people in?
RD_ALifeLine_15e3bdbe517828c7: Every pew's a bed now. We're taking anyone who isn't sick, God forgive me for that part
RD_ALifeLine_45a6ee651d41aa47: Yes. Yes, come. We've got coffee and blankets and a lot of very frightened people
RD_ALifeLine_51e4c35d51f3a62e: There's a room behind the vestry. We sit with them. We pray. And then.. we do what we must
RD_ALifeLine_75882a5f4f940745: Safer than the road. We've got the doors barred and the men take turns on the bell tower
RD_ALifeLine_7ab55f197f4aa68f: Come before dark. We stop opening the doors at sundown, I'm sorry, it's the rule now
RD_ALifeLine_28894c6d17734021: The bell tower's the best lookout in the county. Nobody thought of that till Tuesday
RD_ALifeLine_439fe87008798571: Where do you get supplies now?
RD_ALifeLine_089e183346678c8e: Dead people's houses, mostly. Sounds bad when I say it out loud
RD_ALifeLine_32b68eb000746ea7: We go house to house. Bathroom cabinets, first aid kits under kitchen sinks, sewing kits for sutures
RD_ALifeLine_7957932b4d179446: Thread's thread if you boil it. Fishing line's even better. Don't tell my old instructor
RD_ALifeLine_6ab9254c3ca95426: The first ten. Then it's just a shared cabinet. They'd want it used. I hope they'd want it used
RD_ALifeLine_602d8fba1e4ec08f: A diabetic's stash. A full kit in a minivan. And a wedding album I couldn't stop looking at
RD_ALifeLine_4e521ed50551201d: You stayed on the ward the whole time?
RD_ALifeLine_0bf1572478f30806: Someone had to. When the hospital fell we barricaded both ends and just.. kept going
RD_ALifeLine_73277d871cbf042b: The patients couldn't leave. So I didn't leave. Simple as that
RD_ALifeLine_58c5644858ef6d0a: How many are still with you?
RD_ALifeLine_004d9acd7f30d141: Fire doors, a vending machine and a supply closet nobody else knew about. We made the crackers last nine days
RD_ALifeLine_6bf6ed3d5d1dbfb2: Eleven patients. Three got better and stayed to help. One of them's a plumber, he fixed the sinks. Miracle worker
RD_ALifeLine_548ee90d0a5de5c9: Every second. I'd hear them in the stairwell scratching at the doors. I'd sing to cover it so the patients didn't hear
RD_ALifeLine_37352551713a04a7: Do you think we deserved this?
RD_ALifeLine_5da088da50acca21: No. No, I won't believe that. Children didn't deserve this. The old ladies in my choir didn't deserve this
RD_ALifeLine_69c700a95ea4f682: Some here think so. They say it every night at prayers. I don't let them say it to the kids
RD_ALifeLine_73e5d6ce0102461d: I don't know. Things break. Bodies break, towns break, the world broke. Blame doesn't fix it
RD_ALifeLine_593171ee211d5629: *Looks at you sharply* ..Maybe. But I'm not the one who gets to choose who. Neither are you
RD_ALifeLine_71a2bda11d01f24c: Who runs the food line now?
RD_ALifeLine_089571c10d3b9a61: Whoever's not sick that day. It's a rota. I'm on Tuesdays and Saturdays, and every other day too, apparently
RD_ALifeLine_2ac8a0cc05204467: Me, mostly. One meal a day, one ladle each, kids get a second ladle
RD_ALifeLine_08d805c603a84bbb: Two weeks if nothing changes. Then we start hunting, fishing, foraging. Some of us know how. Most don't
RD_ALifeLine_0bc653fb1b7f8df9: Can you carry? Can you count? Then yes. Grab an apron, it's not glamorous
RD_ALifeLine_382d219f7a6bb853: Once. A man pulled a knife on the line and the whole line just looked at him. He put it away. Shame still works
RD_ALifeLine_6923a0f46a6f9ba5: In chairs. In doorways. Once standing up, I swear, I woke up holding a bandage
RD_ALifeLine_39f1581075a78163: Sleep's for people who don't hear coughing in the dark
RD_ALifeLine_7c515d2065fef6d3: I know. I'm a nurse, I've given that speech a thousand times. I'm a terrible patient
RD_ALifeLine_274192d142ec2152: The hospital. Before. Fluorescent lights and bad coffee and a vending machine that ate my quarters. Good dreams
RD_ALifeLine_46e828452c82fb1d: Then I wake up. That's the nightmare part
RD_ALifeLine_4c9ec606791515e3: What do you tell the kids?
RD_ALifeLine_02b3db8c5abd699e: The truth, mostly. Kids know when you're lying. They just don't say it
RD_ALifeLine_1565413e4844ba6e: That it's bad out there and good in here. And that we'll keep it good in here, no matter what
RD_ALifeLine_4a9004ca0fa9b23a: The little ones do. The older ones look at me like I'm the kid. Maybe I am
RD_ALifeLine_6b44353b3492d04f: Some of them are here. Some are on the wall. We don't hide the wall. They visit it like a grave
RD_ALifeLine_2633448a499ffa1a: Apprentice. She's fourteen and she's already better at sutures than me. Steadier hands
RD_ALifeLine_67a62b4550a1cbe3: *Proud* That's my student. Three months ago she fainted at a nosebleed. Now look at her
RD_ALifeLine_1025fafa1cd2ee43: Anyone who'll sit still. Boiling, splinting, how to tell a bad fever from a normal one. Someone has to carry it on
RD_ALifeLine_6a26aebb4fd73580: Then they keep going without me. That's the whole point. That's the only thing I want to leave behind
RD_ALifeLine_6686e8123572b72f: What do you preach about these days?
RD_ALifeLine_66369fbd252d2f12: Bread. Water. Each other. I gave up on the big sermons. People need small ones
RD_ALifeLine_00014d6f7118e534: The Samaritan. Over and over. The man by the road and the people who walked past. We're the ones who stop now
RD_ALifeLine_2dd006b95f02296a: More than before, honestly. They don't come for God. They come because it's the only place where somebody sings
RD_ALifeLine_63bcb6bc797a7fe0: It's smaller now. And harder. Like a stone in my pocket. I hold onto it when it's bad
RD_ALifeLine_4cc1e1e40f7f8ee6: Is that a garden behind the station?
RD_ALifeLine_04c20d3b1579a07e: Yep. Tomatoes, beans, a sad row of corn. Turns out firefighters are good at watering things
RD_ALifeLine_0c3980c272f71ea2: *Grins* Four guys with hoses and nothing to put out. What did you think would happen?
RD_ALifeLine_5fd7c34468c00b15: When they come. Cooking fires get out of hand, lightning hits a barn. We go. Then we come back and pick beans
RD_ALifeLine_396b7d7f032bd620: For you? A couple. Don't tell the chief, he counts them
RD_ALifeLine_0e463a78204b1ec7: *Laughs* Same clipboard. New paper. Well, old paper, I write on the back of seed catalogues now
RD_ALifeLine_33904af974291712: Always. It's not a bus list anymore. It's who's alive, who's where, who needs what
RD_ALifeLine_48752fad53ee7594: You are. Under "reliable". That's a short list. Don't ruin it
RD_ALifeLine_4d3730b853ab3830: Two hundred and twelve living. Across the whole county, that I know of. Two hundred and twelve, and I know every name
RD_ALifeLine_7e2b07492becaaad: Do you think it'll ever get better?
RD_ALifeLine_25326f0b756ebac7: Better? It already did, a little. We have babies and gardens. Two months ago we had neither
RD_ALifeLine_63506cf83ae7e73a: *Thinks a long time* I think it gets different. Better's a word for later
RD_ALifeLine_0a22ed435b8d5ab6: Me too. Hope's cheap and it doesn't spoil. Keep some on you
RD_ALifeLine_7b3074dc4d9c8aac: That's fine. You don't have to. Just don't take it from the people who do
RD_ALifeLine_503beaf8706ff6f8: Sit. Where's it hurt? Don't be brave, just point
RD_ALifeLine_7daa47427fe517bd: Yeah, yeah, sit down. Let me see.. arms first, then whatever you're hiding
RD_ALifeLine_0218698444724fa0: It's a cut on my arm
RD_ALifeLine_6773aa2212e0540a: *Cleans it* Glass? Okay. Not teeth, good. This'll sting like hell, don't punch me
RD_ALifeLine_67f055437fcdd4b2: Breathe in. Deep. Hurts? Sharp or dull? ..Dull. Probably bruised, maybe a cracked rib
RD_ALifeLine_450faa6934ab6057: *Laughs* Tired I can't fix. Join the club. Drink water, eat something, sleep if they let you
RD_ALifeLine_058bfacb2f91dc29: There. Keep it dry and change it tomorrow. Here, take a spare, I've still got a few today
RD_ALifeLine_78a0a6863f93466a: Nothing I can do for a rib except tell you to stop falling. Take these for the pain
RD_ALifeLine_15b74af24a1380f9: Could you take a look at this wound?
RD_ALifeLine_5c37bcd9733cf3ae: I can look. Looking's free. Fixing is.. complicated now
RD_ALifeLine_668486822f80bed3: *Sighs* Let me see it. I'm almost out of everything, so don't get your hopes up
RD_ALifeLine_3e44e1780b4df0cb: Hm. It's red at the edges. Not bad yet. Wash it with boiled water, twice a day, and don't pick at it
RD_ALifeLine_66b2b1f82759035c: *Hesitates* ..Okay. I hate this. A can of anything and I'll do it properly
RD_ALifeLine_495669970fbc99ee: Oh thank God, someone prepared. Hold out your arm, I'll do it right
RD_ALifeLine_22b1a12f0072160b: If it gets hot and swollen, come back. Don't wait. Waiting's how people lose arms
RD_ALifeLine_37d30b326793f613: Thank you. Hold still. *Works quickly* There. Clean and wrapped, and I won't feel guilty eating tonight
RD_ALifeLine_6224c89b555bd7cf: You need a miracle and a pharmacy. I'm what you get
RD_ALifeLine_762f34625c0d4d1e: Sit down. You walk in, you're not dying, that's already a good day
RD_ALifeLine_1c6f84fa408bdf64: Can you just give me something for the pain?
RD_ALifeLine_600bd92e015eea77: *Sniffs it* Yeah. It's going. Without antibiotics I can clean it and hope. With antibiotics I can clean it and expect
RD_ALifeLine_40d0c26310493a0d: Bite down on this. No, it's clean, mostly. Ready? Don't watch my hands, watch the ceiling
RD_ALifeLine_209a842e3c298d23: I've got two pills left in the whole house. You'll get one. And you'll owe me
RD_ALifeLine_432f250b7ba866f8: Have you got any? Even one course?
RD_ALifeLine_07278e140da3a95f: *Ties off* Six. Not pretty. You'll have a scar to brag about. Keep it clean or it's all for nothing
RD_ALifeLine_5640424c74203053: Okay. Okay, good. Take one now, one in the morning, finish them all even if you feel better. ALL of them
RD_ALifeLine_443c0fe7207d297b: Then wash it with alcohol, it'll hurt like fire. Here, take this, it's what I can spare
RD_ALifeLine_2805e8b2432140c0: For you? Always, if you're breathing and not bitten. Come in, wipe your boots
RD_ALifeLine_47bc798f2af322e3: Clinic's open. Door watch will check you, then come through to the back
RD_ALifeLine_206cc7d37049b0b7: Up on the table. Hm. You keep doing this to yourself, don't you? Alright, I've got you
RD_ALifeLine_02b6612a1a468e4a: *Blinks* Really? Okay. Water needs boiling and the linen needs washing and someone needs to read to the old man in bed two
RD_ALifeLine_5816124850a652ca: That's sweet. Nobody checks in. Everybody checks in when they're bleeding
RD_ALifeLine_539b7713288223eb: Clean, stitched, wrapped. And a little extra, because you're one of the ones who comes back
RD_ALifeLine_668ade0c57e20032: Is it in the air? Should I wear a mask?
RD_ALifeLine_2b13f357396d9dd4: Nobody knows. Honestly. The memo said bites and blood. Then people with no bites started dying in their sleep
RD_ALifeLine_245e977171df687f: I'm wearing one. Does it work? I have no idea, it makes me feel better
RD_ALifeLine_7e2fe21e4de14ef3: So the bites are what kills you?
RD_ALifeLine_64d8d1bc47490aa0: Fever, then gone. Then.. not gone. Some had a bite, some we couldn't find one. Maybe we didn't look hard enough
RD_ALifeLine_61b1c3fa2a34c6ef: Bites, for sure. Every bitten person I've seen got sick. Every single one. Scratches, sometimes. Lucky people
RD_ALifeLine_01d18f7433357f4b: Bandana's fine. Cover the mouth, wash your hands, don't touch your eyes. Basic stuff, it's all I've got
RD_ALifeLine_0a0597586c2dd4e6: If you get a fever, tell someone. Don't sleep alone. That's all I can tell you
RD_ALifeLine_33d09faf28b62966: How long do people last after a bite?
RD_ALifeLine_4ea120746d5b548c: *Quiet* Why do you want to know? Are you asking for you?
RD_ALifeLine_75bc81e937787567: A day. Two, if they're strong. I've seen one hold on for three, he was too stubborn to die
RD_ALifeLine_5ef7d10d77d791fc: Is there anything that slows it?
RD_ALifeLine_2134870909a0a28c: Okay. Good. Most people asking that question aren't fine, so I had to check
RD_ALifeLine_70e311e425f0d969: Then go to them. Make them comfortable. And when it's time, don't hesitate, they'd want you not to hesitate
RD_ALifeLine_202eaf8905b6d41f: Rest, water, keeping the fever down. It buys hours, not days. I wish I had a better answer
RD_ALifeLine_57665a131edfe978: I'm sorry. I know that's not what you came for
RD_ALifeLine_4a1bc04b7c45319b: How do I know if someone's turning?
RD_ALifeLine_39c6aad85bbc9911: Fever first. Pale and grey around the mouth. Then they get quiet. Too quiet, like they're listening to something
RD_ALifeLine_21f2925b239a7c12: Sweats, shakes, then they stop shaking. That's when you worry. When they stop shaking
RD_ALifeLine_13e651400409999f: Can you tell from a scratch?
RD_ALifeLine_7bc144cf14e14647: What do I do when it happens?
RD_ALifeLine_6677fac212c30c4f: Then they sleep, and they don't breathe, and then they get up. Doesn't take long. Sometimes minutes
RD_ALifeLine_7c1bad84316c719e: Watch it a day. If it's just red, probably fine. If they get a fever, it's not fine. Most scratches are just scratches
RD_ALifeLine_7f4d017f589b3b79: Head. Fast. Before they get up if you can. I'm a nurse and I'm telling you to do that. Think about that
RD_ALifeLine_2e56d58c35eb5414: Don't sit too close at the end. I learned that from a good man who wanted to hold his wife's hand
RD_ALifeLine_009fc57e7c714971: Do you think we're all infected?
RD_ALifeLine_1a4f2cb059cc655f: Yes. I think so. Everyone who dies gets up, bitten or not. Ever noticed that?
RD_ALifeLine_3d1f2f2e4882d32b: I opened one up. Don't look at me like that, somebody had to. It was in everything. Blood, brain, all of it
RD_ALifeLine_1db68d2f337d3ed3: So the bite isn't the cause?
RD_ALifeLine_4cb68f871d42de99: Then what's the point of any of this?
RD_ALifeLine_145a102a58606269: The bite makes you sick fast. But we all carry it, it just waits. That's my theory, I'm a nurse, not a scientist
RD_ALifeLine_62fda07122269dba: Gloves, mask, a lot of bleach and nobody watching. I wanted to know what we're dealing with
RD_ALifeLine_188c11f14db8729d: The point is staying alive long enough for something to change. Somebody, somewhere, is working on this
RD_ALifeLine_0e083faa0b2b1ecf: So don't die. That's my medical advice. Don't die, because you won't stay dead
RD_ALifeLine_10d5469f23e165cb: I wish I hadn't. Some things you can't unknow
RD_ALifeLine_3384c0b120c1ddaa: That's what I tell myself. Don't argue with me, I need it
RD_ALifeLine_0cb9444f56e2fb62: Is there a cure? Anything at all?
RD_ALifeLine_44736a4c3a0219ad: *Long silence* No. Not that I know of. If there was, I'd have it in my pocket right now
RD_ALifeLine_1170a0640302fae5: People keep asking. The answer's still no
RD_ALifeLine_0ea4e99b22b4a930: Someone must be working on it
RD_ALifeLine_23ba246d02a559de: What about cutting off the bitten part?
RD_ALifeLine_2a805e5d3d9558f3: I heard the army has something
RD_ALifeLine_7c2a17f97d58561d: Maybe. Somewhere. If they are, I hope they're faster than us. And I hope they're kinder than the army
RD_ALifeLine_6111fba84f2299b1: I've seen people try. A hand, a foot. They died anyway, just slower and in more pain. Don't do it
RD_ALifeLine_1b5cb25a797483f9: The army has guns and a fence. If they had a cure, they wouldn't need the fence
RD_ALifeLine_1f996d830d69dfbb: Ever figure out what this thing is?
RD_ALifeLine_1d917dfa43d76086: I stopped asking. Somewhere around day forty I realised the question doesn't change anything I do in a day
RD_ALifeLine_73b3899a6cd68b62: No. And I'm okay with that now. Mostly
RD_ALifeLine_0f1917c16bc31811: What do you focus on instead?
RD_ALifeLine_3d8ea76b0fafb2f1: Fevers. Broken bones. Babies. We had two babies born here. Two. The world ended and people are still having babies
RD_ALifeLine_401f120219c69c38: Every night, a little. Then the morning comes and somebody's cut their hand on a fence and I forget about it
RD_ALifeLine_652aa2d8514d75ad: WHAT? Where? Show me, show me right now!
RD_ALifeLine_170473365d811852: Oh no.. oh no no no. Okay. Okay let me see, maybe it's not, let me see
RD_ALifeLine_6e1f952b19226e22: I'm lying, it was a dog
RD_ALifeLine_766a33cb7023810e: *Looks a long time* ..That's teeth. I'm so sorry. I'm so sorry
RD_ALifeLine_006400c319dc34a6: You- what? A DOG? Don't you EVER joke about that, I nearly had a heart attack
RD_ALifeLine_55228c3f68fb6230: I don't know. Nobody knows. Rest. Fluids. Pray if you pray
RD_ALifeLine_5c8fe43d737bbb89: Listen to me. You've got time. Go somewhere you want to be. Call someone if the phones work. Don't be alone
RD_ALifeLine_1e2cee071eb9ee4c: Painkillers. That's all. Take them, please, it'll make it easier
RD_ALifeLine_0160ca9274efaae7: You're braver than me. God, you're braver than me
RD_ALifeLine_2bf45dfb2c84be2e: I got bit. Be honest with me
RD_ALifeLine_2b52f9f867e58acc: Honest? Alright. I'll be honest. Sit with me
RD_ALifeLine_56ff908521578828: You've got a day, maybe two. It'll be fever, then sleep. It doesn't hurt as much at the end as you'd think
RD_ALifeLine_7288e18830d73df7: I'm sorry. I've said that a lot this month. I mean it every time
RD_ALifeLine_7b2ebc2f3a60528f: Is there someone you'd want to be with?
RD_ALifeLine_3b16d61d05a4d799: I'm not going out like that
RD_ALifeLine_37bcc68b635fa3d2: Go to them. Tell them while you still can. Don't make them guess what you meant
RD_ALifeLine_6cbb93ac5746677a: Then make it count. And when it's close, find somewhere quiet. Don't let someone you love have to do it
RD_ALifeLine_1b76d1482b591d98: *Takes your hand* Yes. As long as you want. I'm not going anywhere
RD_ALifeLine_6294bb3251cc0233: I've been bitten, I need help
RD_ALifeLine_254cd9ee619d8a46: Stop. Stop right there. Not one step closer, I mean it
RD_ALifeLine_7e85a3074d6a201d: Don't come in. I'm sorry, I'm sorry, you can't come in
RD_ALifeLine_0ce658bf2f07b908: I'm not going to hurt anyone
RD_ALifeLine_08169e42649408e7: *Throws them across the floor* There. Take them. Please go. We've got kids in here
RD_ALifeLine_24d84a1d15ad9e6c: You won't mean to. Nobody means to. Please. Go
RD_ALifeLine_259009df4e731e1c: Thank you. I'm sorry. God, I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_2c5cee4942fa6d91: My friend got bit. What do I do?
RD_ALifeLine_7400220f455e52b8: *Closes eyes* Okay. Tell me when it happened
RD_ALifeLine_391da2c268683446: Last night, they've got a fever
RD_ALifeLine_7118f3aa2af40fbf: They want to keep going like nothing happened
RD_ALifeLine_2f30449714c4b1be: Then you've got time to say what you need to say. Don't waste it on hoping. Hope later
RD_ALifeLine_54cf5ffc6f4109b4: Then it's close. Don't sleep in the same room. Stay by the door. When it's over, be quick about it
RD_ALifeLine_2c968be5441923eb: Some people do that. Let them, for a bit. But keep your eyes on them, and keep a weapon close
RD_ALifeLine_1c6ba82310563fda: I'm sorry. You'll be alright after. Not okay, but alright
RD_ALifeLine_083f6c29586035d6: I've got antibiotics. What's it worth to you?
RD_ALifeLine_31cfcc222c114c45: *Eyes go wide* You- are you serious? Real ones? Let me see the label
RD_ALifeLine_7e502d2a31eb6aca: Antibiotics? Don't joke. Don't you joke about that
RD_ALifeLine_3b3eded456bf6c49: *Holds it like a baby* Oh thank God. This is a life. Maybe three. What do you want? Name it
RD_ALifeLine_58e349040bdd513d: Food, if you can spare it
RD_ALifeLine_5feaf826322585f1: Supplies, food, a bed if you need it. Anything I've got, honestly. Just come back with them
RD_ALifeLine_2af4cfad695f61a7: Here. Gauze, a splint, whatever's in the good drawer. Fair's fair
RD_ALifeLine_6a6e30427ddbe0eb: Here. It's not much, but it's what we have. Thank you, really
RD_ALifeLine_67baf30327232cfd: Can I buy some bandages off you?
RD_ALifeLine_2977cd49400afac6: Buy with what? Money's for starting fires now
RD_ALifeLine_464842b57f5d448a: Depends what you've got. I need food more than I need bandages, and I really need bandages
RD_ALifeLine_6973cb7055242e8d: Deal. Two bandages for the can, and don't tell the others I'm doing deals
RD_ALifeLine_36d55484306078ca: Water's good. One bandage and some wipes, fair?
RD_ALifeLine_6bae55775ec0ed51: You're the ones with the stock room?
RD_ALifeLine_03d2ae6047b596f2: Who told you that? ..Doesn't matter. Yes. And no, you can't just walk in
RD_ALifeLine_37fb92895b490970: *Tense* Everyone wants the stock room. Everyone. What are you offering?
RD_ALifeLine_33ca1caa6c398afc: I'm not here to rob you
RD_ALifeLine_26ebeac01590b792: I can do a job for you
RD_ALifeLine_07d12fa57f07f7b1: That's what the last ones said. Then they came back at night with friends
RD_ALifeLine_3e77052a7af628b8: *Considers* ..Okay. One box for a course of antibiotics. That's a good deal, take it before I think about it
RD_ALifeLine_33dd13c9175d26b1: Go on, I'm listening. We need someone who doesn't mind the outside
RD_ALifeLine_3b7f7a4b4acb18ac: Do a run for us, or bring something we need. Then we'll talk like neighbours
RD_ALifeLine_22e1936470632358: Pleasure. Don't tell anyone where you got it, please. Please
RD_ALifeLine_002fedfc02580f01: Then we're done. Door's that way
RD_ALifeLine_4e4fe874274ec423: I've got spare painkillers if you need them
RD_ALifeLine_04f7ca2303d37b1a: Spare? Nobody has spare. Let me see
RD_ALifeLine_7e348a7f76029045: *Perks up* What kind? Doesn't matter, any kind. What do you want for them?
RD_ALifeLine_3e71d96763ff494e: *Pockets them fast* Thank you. There's a man in the back with a broken hip who'll sleep tonight because of you
RD_ALifeLine_1b9bcf1b40d74577: Fair. Here, the good stuff, don't let the kids see
RD_ALifeLine_420aeb7539ee9d13: Smart. Keep them close. You'll need them, everyone does eventually
RD_ALifeLine_27e2671a65b65d88: I need antibiotics. Two courses. There's a boy in the back with a wound that's turning and I've got nothing
RD_ALifeLine_2416b3be61069faa: *Rubs face* Yeah. I need a miracle in a pill bottle. Two, actually
RD_ALifeLine_766b9ac03322147c: *Grips your arm* Thank you. Be quick, okay? He's twelve. Be quick
RD_ALifeLine_0c3e8a8a45ee7890: Pharmacies are picked clean. Try houses. Bathroom cabinets, bedside drawers, old folks' kitchens. Cars too, glove boxes
RD_ALifeLine_3f9b315f5156a054: Medical supplies, the good drawer. More if you bring them fast. I'm not above begging, but I'll pay
RD_ALifeLine_173b1b4f57f09c03: Okay. I understand. Everybody's got their own dying to do
RD_ALifeLine_6f0f6c4373586caa: Did you find any? Please tell me you found some
RD_ALifeLine_0b1a43ea3e65f5b8: *Takes the bottles, hands shaking* Oh you beautiful.. okay. Okay, what do I owe you?
RD_ALifeLine_7cc80364753e37d9: That run nearly got me killed. I need more than gauze
RD_ALifeLine_5dc9e6751c4ccb99: Okay.. okay. Hurry, please. The fever's up again
RD_ALifeLine_1814543f48e9fc33: Hot. Delirious. Asking for his mom. I keep saying she's coming
RD_ALifeLine_4fcd4c041b4af7a0: Nearly killed? Everyone out there nearly gets killed. You got what I promised, I've got a boy to save
RD_ALifeLine_3426fcb27a809e8d: *Hesitates, then nods* ..Yeah. You're right. Our security guy left this when he went home. You'll use it better than me
RD_ALifeLine_0f9cb9d614de0a7f: There's another clinic. A small one. They went quiet four days ago, no radio, no smoke
RD_ALifeLine_51dfe85f27c667c8: We used to swap supplies with a little clinic. Now nothing. I need someone to go look
RD_ALifeLine_6067ddd278d12513: Go careful. Look before you knock. If it's bad, don't be a hero, just come back and tell me
RD_ALifeLine_62d0783d088f0878: Because I'm the only one here who can set a bone, and if I die there's nobody. That's not bravery, it's arithmetic
RD_ALifeLine_671de15e2c374955: Then bring me something of theirs. A note, a name tag. I want to know. I need to know
RD_ALifeLine_27efb4f13e55b159: Alright. I'll keep listening to the radio then
RD_ALifeLine_155c655e1fd0f0a9: You went? Tell me. Don't soften it
RD_ALifeLine_5f0f49336fd11aa1: I haven't made it there yet
RD_ALifeLine_5633d81a5c3a5227: *Reads the note a long time* ..Okay. They tried. That's what it says. They tried
RD_ALifeLine_5c4f8fbc29f15f33: Okay. Go when you can. Not at night
RD_ALifeLine_46085aab285b1fa0: You did a hard thing for me. I want to pay you properly
RD_ALifeLine_17553aeb78440e7c: Just tell me what you know about the area
RD_ALifeLine_71579d441918abe4: I saw people out there, I need somewhere safe to go
RD_ALifeLine_117c12ed7d658b45: Somewhere safe.. I don't know anywhere safe. I wish I did. Here's what I do know
RD_ALifeLine_23f3030713047684: Alright. There's a place. Good people, a gate, a garden. I'll mark it for you. Tell them I sent you
RD_ALifeLine_2d766c5a648a8b4e: A little girl. Fever three days now. No bite, we checked every inch. Just a normal fever and I can't even fix that
RD_ALifeLine_5234eaaf0a28e175: *Looks toward the back* Yeah. A kid. Normal fever, I think. I've got nothing for it
RD_ALifeLine_11e45afc3553f2aa: How do you know it's normal?
RD_ALifeLine_6fcf389d5b51adca: Thank you. I'll tell her someone's coming. She'll like that
RD_ALifeLine_7d2ac89c32e5632c: Because she's still talking. Still crying for her bear. The other kind goes quiet. I'm praying I'm right
RD_ALifeLine_3c71fd7c49de59d1: Okay. If you change your mind, she's not going anywhere
RD_ALifeLine_5d6bf3643d661f80: Anything, really. Fever pills, painkillers, anything with a label
RD_ALifeLine_1c2187db5eebdb53: I brought medicine for the girl
RD_ALifeLine_022a3c12460c7049: You did? Oh thank God, come, come
RD_ALifeLine_5e685119420d0710: *Stands up so fast the chair falls* Really?
RD_ALifeLine_414740a3646f5919: *Takes it, tearing up* ..Thank you. She's been asking about you. The one who's bringing medicine
RD_ALifeLine_3d9ec8e0219d7cc6: Okay. Hurry if you can. She's tough, but she's small
RD_ALifeLine_1e63b0fe6801870d: We don't have much. But you should have something
RD_ALifeLine_18ef8618197df6fb: I went through a lot for this. I could use more
RD_ALifeLine_0b5ed8f54ad2b1d5: Here. It's not much, it's what we were saving. You earned it twice over
RD_ALifeLine_5a72d5640a9773f8: *Hurt look* ..It's a sick child. Here's the food. That's what we have
RD_ALifeLine_108f9eea4927433f: You're right, you did. Take these, we had them for a rainy day. Today's raining
RD_ALifeLine_06bfebde1d79f980: My partner. She went on a supply run two days ago. Said she'd be back by dark. That was two darks ago
RD_ALifeLine_139eefe94f47662a: *Stares at the road* How'd you know? Yeah. My partner. She didn't come back
RD_ALifeLine_39a4e2a076009b0e: She's got red hair. Carries a jump bag with a white cross. You'll know her. Thank you
RD_ALifeLine_26c2e24726de79d8: I know. I know she might be. But I need to know, either way. Bring me her tag if you find.. if you find her
RD_ALifeLine_46d760b8684fc16c: Okay. I'll go myself then, tomorrow. Or the day after
RD_ALifeLine_25acfc254c9e4595: *Takes the tag, holds it close* ..Okay. Okay. Thank you for bringing her back to me. Some of her
RD_ALifeLine_47ed45583dd08556: Okay.. I'll keep the radio on
RD_ALifeLine_4d91ae573391b503: She kept a pistol in the rig. I can't look at it anymore. Or I can give you her map, she knew every road
RD_ALifeLine_4b6173325197b194: I'd rather have the pistol, honestly
RD_ALifeLine_3c14361457984fc2: Here. Her handwriting's all over it. Look after it
RD_ALifeLine_5cc735204097df9a: ..No. Not yet. I can't give that away yet. Take the map
RD_ALifeLine_63a666c373fc6873: *Nods slowly* She'd want someone to use it. Someone who brought her home. Take it
RD_ALifeLine_009a2f795885e911: Bandages. For the people at the other shelter. We promised and nobody's had the nerve to walk it
RD_ALifeLine_775afb471867b7f8: Yeah, actually. There's a parcel that needs to go to friends of ours, and I'm not getting any younger
RD_ALifeLine_1fd94c7d52a5c3af: Bless you. Tell them it's from us. Tell them we're still here
RD_ALifeLine_190287232dea4719: Dead on the main road, so don't take it. Backyards, fences, slow and quiet. That's how we used to do it
RD_ALifeLine_393e12d14a5ce2c2: That's alright, we'll figure it out
RD_ALifeLine_11f764685e0f6301: You did? How are they? Are they alright?
RD_ALifeLine_0f34d13467d9295a: Oh good, good. Did they say anything?
RD_ALifeLine_21a7db720bdfb39c: They said thanks. They're holding on
RD_ALifeLine_0d87fbdd2b4e5486: Holding on. That's all any of us are doing. Thank you for walking it
RD_ALifeLine_6df4e70c56623f51: Okay. They'll wait. They're good at waiting
RD_ALifeLine_1bb31cf700ee1e56: I ran into the dead twice on the way. Got anything stronger?
RD_ALifeLine_3f5220d047c90807: It's food. Real food. Eat it somewhere safe
RD_ALifeLine_306966710a4627d2: I'm sorry, we don't have anything stronger. We're bandages and soup people
RD_ALifeLine_32a9457004d3f7bd: Twice? Lord. Here, these are no good to us, we don't shoot. You might
RD_ALifeLine_5905ee361339af7f: Anything I can help clear out?
RD_ALifeLine_02155e491146b7d8: The house down the way. It's got a full medicine cabinet, I saw it before the dead moved in. Five, maybe six inside
RD_ALifeLine_7316c8493cbf7877: There's a house we need. Supplies inside, dead inside. We can't do the second part
RD_ALifeLine_247f7dd47710b4ac: Be careful. Upstairs bedroom's the bad one, there's a lot of noise up there at night
RD_ALifeLine_450a1c035a9a7c16: Fair enough. It'll keep. The dead aren't going anywhere either
RD_ALifeLine_4d399d01012fc001: All of them. You can go in
RD_ALifeLine_7322a7b613884850: *Exhales* You have no idea what that means for us. Okay. Okay, payment
RD_ALifeLine_4851386476c85ff7: That was six of them. I want something real
RD_ALifeLine_2a4c73ea7c1777e0: Okay. Take your time. Don't get bit for a medicine cabinet
RD_ALifeLine_71e7d4856f1853e3: Tools. Good ones, we've got spares. You'll get more use from them than we will
RD_ALifeLine_06d9ae8878bb8fa0: Something real? Tools ARE real. That's what we've got, take it or leave it
RD_ALifeLine_1857073e72e5820b: *Sighs* Fine. You earned it. It was in the rig when we found it, never fired. Take it
RD_ALifeLine_156a9e4509f9c055: Stuck in a ditch half a mile back, surrounded. All our gear's still in it
RD_ALifeLine_7faf964a335a0f7c: We had to bail out. Ambulance is still there. So are about a dozen of them
RD_ALifeLine_6e8a5003207cd32d: Thank you. We'll be right behind you once it's thin. Well. A safe distance behind you
RD_ALifeLine_4b27c07a04b42385: It's oxygen, a defib with half a battery and every bandage we own. That's not stuff. That's everything
RD_ALifeLine_4e7ef1485d396082: Yeah. Probably smart. It still hurts
RD_ALifeLine_61e2e4b9150b5c93: The road to your rig is clear
RD_ALifeLine_2bff71a141a95c1b: *Already grabbing a bag* Is it? Seriously?
RD_ALifeLine_798a0f5c30434368: You're insane and I love you. Here, before I forget
RD_ALifeLine_2d621e80691068ae: I emptied a lot of ammo out there
RD_ALifeLine_1a0c6861279bef0b: Okay. We'll wait. Not like the rig's going anywhere
RD_ALifeLine_4a0d09680fba5d11: Ammo. Found it in a cop car. We don't need it, you clearly do
RD_ALifeLine_5c0fc30a6510bf11: Everybody empties a lot of ammo. Take what we've got, I'm sorry it's not more
RD_ALifeLine_533c2a4323fd5627: Yeah, I heard. Half the county heard. Here, this too, our partner's sidearm. She'd want it to keep you alive
RD_ALifeLine_25c785f65ec09ad5: Need someone to walk with you?
RD_ALifeLine_62c8d85220fc23ec: I've got a patient who needs to get to the shelter down the road. She can walk, slow. I can't leave the others
RD_ALifeLine_5e9163db293b6dc5: Actually yes. An old man. Needs a bed I don't have. It's not far, just not safe
RD_ALifeLine_7902d98b32c3e4e0: Go slow. Talk to them, they like that. And watch the corners
RD_ALifeLine_65ecb14655bd4443: Because I've got no room and they've got a stove. Old bones need warm. It's that simple
RD_ALifeLine_6aabdb3f14ba7d2e: *Smiles wide* Did you? Did they give you trouble?
RD_ALifeLine_143c7cf969c98f1a: Safe? Oh good. Good. Thank you
RD_ALifeLine_4de81cc7124f02c2: Safe and warm. They talked the whole way
RD_ALifeLine_1bd387c4153c064a: *Laughs* Yeah, they do that. Here, for the walk
RD_ALifeLine_069a6c9f75122e24: Walking that road nearly cost me, I need more
RD_ALifeLine_2cf624460f3485e8: Okay. They'll be ready when you are
RD_ALifeLine_767fad2328b0f569: Medical supplies. Wrap your feet tonight, you walked a lot
RD_ALifeLine_669437f41c5f754a: I hear you. I don't have more. This is what I've got
RD_ALifeLine_07411494425636cd: Fair. Here, tools too, the shelter sent extras. I'd rather they go to someone who walks people home
RD_ALifeLine_569ac8c33510e3a9: Where are you set up? In case I need a doctor
RD_ALifeLine_538313095d5f4cc7: *Studies you* ..You're asking where the medicine is. Everyone asks where the medicine is
RD_ALifeLine_01c2a8c90cc4b431: Just in case I get hurt
RD_ALifeLine_16c750216e509b26: Hm. Fair. I'll tell you roughly. If you come, come in daylight, hands up, call out first
RD_ALifeLine_2c8303e92b585da0: *Smiles a little* Now that's a better reason. Here, I'll show you. Don't share it around, okay?
RD_ALifeLine_371dee421ce8c3ee: Thanks for understanding. It's not personal. It's just how it is now
RD_ALifeLine_210169122db53ca8: Show me exactly where you are
RD_ALifeLine_182d723f1d0327b1: For you? Yeah. You've earned it. Give me your map
RD_ALifeLine_7d7ab4586c90207b: You've been good to us. Alright, I'll mark it exact
RD_ALifeLine_40e824ff27aed832: There. Back door, knock twice, then once. If nobody answers, we're out on a call, wait by the shed
RD_ALifeLine_5a4e7acc5b6914d0: *Thinks* There's people. Decent ones, last I heard. That's as close to safe as it gets
RD_ALifeLine_6a396e6c676a3afb: How do you know they're decent?
RD_ALifeLine_79c2731333b19f97: I'll mark it. Rough spot, I haven't been in a while. Go slow and call out before you get close
RD_ALifeLine_05de85aa5fedcc69: They gave us water once and didn't ask for anything. These days that's practically sainthood
RD_ALifeLine_6b2a5ddb32770c0f: Ask around for the medic. People know
RD_ALifeLine_3e62cdd704277c1c: You want to? That's nice. Most people try not to need a medic twice
RD_ALifeLine_3a72d7336d90511d: *Nods* Okay. Put me down, I'll be around. Bring news when you come
RD_ALifeLine_5f23b5a85dfd20d7: Just in case is how most friendships start now. Here
RD_ALifeLine_04ce657e7f57b3db: A few. Some are good people. Some take your shoes and call it a toll
RD_ALifeLine_547f17f52d7278b7: People talk when they're being stitched. You'd be amazed what I hear
RD_ALifeLine_5c16a6912a7fb27a: One. They took in a guy I patched up, he sent word he's still there. Here, roughly where
RD_ALifeLine_710f2a7e22c2f6cb: The ones with fresh paint on the walls and nobody old. Old people mean they share. No old people means they don't
RD_ALifeLine_19c4613a787a6b63: Same place it always was. Big red doors, you can't miss it
RD_ALifeLine_3ca539e01dfa97f2: We moved. The old one burned. Ironic, I know
RD_ALifeLine_2fc6d5b16ca8e197: Come by. Bring water, we're always low. And don't honk, God, don't honk
RD_ALifeLine_7a45c1ab0c93b1f1: Here. If the doors are shut, we're out. If they're open and nobody's there, run
RD_ALifeLine_2345784c7e99d736: Where it's always been. The doors are open in daylight to anyone who comes in peace
RD_ALifeLine_3c93c3bb3493409a: Not far. You'll see the steeple. We ring the bell at noon so people know we're still here
RD_ALifeLine_3e18820f66c234a0: Please do. Supper's at six. You'll be asked to wash and to pray, you only have to do one
RD_ALifeLine_1f3b53d770a04826: It is. The dead hear it too. We ring it anyway. It's the only thing louder than our fear
RD_ALifeLine_24f58a2903fb6269: How do I get to your people?
RD_ALifeLine_4f47f39d29f20008: You don't just get to us. You get invited
RD_ALifeLine_0b40b25d7dcb5d0d: Depends. Are you trading, joining or looking for trouble?
RD_ALifeLine_24e124f1618fb6cf: Just want to know where you are
RD_ALifeLine_15a23f822d0206c4: Traders we like. I'll tell you where the outer gate is. Not the inner one, not yet
RD_ALifeLine_7ff77dcb1a60e24e: Then come trade first. Then help. Then we'll talk about joining. Here's the gate
RD_ALifeLine_08c274bd732479ef: That's what raiders say too. No offense. Earn a bit more trust first
RD_ALifeLine_5b5585af4e2b598f: Know any pharmacies that haven't been hit?
RD_ALifeLine_0b06d84f5b531509: *Laughs* No. But I know one that was hit by people who didn't know what they were looking for
RD_ALifeLine_74e12bbd3ad0fc68: Hit, all of them. But looters grab the painkillers and leave the good stuff
RD_ALifeLine_350be6cf7245dccd: Antibiotics. Sutures. The boring bottles with long names. People take the fun pills and leave the ones that save lives
RD_ALifeLine_1eaf334e233b9dca: Hey, relax, I just want to talk
RD_ALifeLine_4957c50d50de8927: Talk? With that in your hand? Put it down first
RD_ALifeLine_26e8c35f668a94ae: I'm keeping it, but I won't use it
RD_ALifeLine_4c1bdacc0abd5f7e: *Breathes out* Thank you. Sorry. The last guy who said he wanted to talk shot my friend in the back
RD_ALifeLine_29c253601abc62c2: Then keep it pointed at the ground and we'll talk from here. Not one step closer
RD_ALifeLine_2cea980f535a85c8: ..Okay. Okay, I see that. Sorry. Everyone looks armed to me now
RD_ALifeLine_66ca1794019fd258: People shoot medics now. On purpose. We've got bandages and pills and that makes us a target
RD_ALifeLine_72faeac1088fa020: So yes. I'm jumpy. Give me a reason not to be
RD_ALifeLine_3c69c5e67b60b013: Yes. Just me. Why do you ask?
RD_ALifeLine_2074ac2d49222af4: Just wondering if you need help
RD_ALifeLine_2941147967094d0d: I'm fine. I'm fine. Thank you, but I'm fine
RD_ALifeLine_67997cf17d117b3d: *Jaw tightens* Then you should know there's more of us watching you right now. So be nice
RD_ALifeLine_3a0dd65a5f54cdb8: No. I've got four with me. Two of them are kids. I wouldn't tell just anyone that
RD_ALifeLine_48f729ee1c08fc85: *Relaxes* No, there's a few of us. You're alright, I don't mind you knowing
RD_ALifeLine_042349916528bfdf: Thank you. That's worth more than you know
RD_ALifeLine_2198a9b45b9b0baa: Shoes. Their feet grow and the world stopped making shoes. If you see small ones, think of us
RD_ALifeLine_22e1031226589a0c: I'm not going to hurt you
RD_ALifeLine_05d4a1cf3ca23e24: Prove it. Take two steps back and tell me what you had for breakfast
RD_ALifeLine_672e5ff64aef3c80: Everybody says that. Show me your arms, then show me you're not lying
RD_ALifeLine_0791bde572f30697: Step back and show your arms
RD_ALifeLine_352f7c6a2e091a93: *Looks you over* ..Okay. No bites. You stepped back when I asked. That's more than most do
RD_ALifeLine_73f3575e0a76439c: No, you don't. And I don't have to stand here. Bye
RD_ALifeLine_606a400744fd16ea: *Snorts* Join the club. Okay. Okay, you sound like a person. Come a little closer, slowly
RD_ALifeLine_05da6885545796dc: Why do you hide your gear?
RD_ALifeLine_14e24c6a0a299d78: Because a red cross on your bag is a bullseye now. People see it and think pills
RD_ALifeLine_1c821caf2d22902f: We had armbands. Took them off after the second time somebody shot at us for a bag of saline
RD_ALifeLine_2343eb0f58d78ae5: That's people. Not all of them. Enough of them
RD_ALifeLine_3d293f3472716f5c: I've got a pistol I've never fired at a person. I'll fire it if I have to. I'm praying I don't have to
RD_ALifeLine_51c2f352656e75fc: Wait, I'm not with the people who shot at you
RD_ALifeLine_38441ff929e243a4: How the hell would I know that?! You all look the same with a gun
RD_ALifeLine_4d818fd24bd0159a: *Shaking* Stay back. They shot Danny. They shot Danny in the face and laughed
RD_ALifeLine_367a11d055fb5547: I can help you get away from them
RD_ALifeLine_4d57b3a62b4347ee: ..Okay. Okay. I believe you. I don't want to, but I do
RD_ALifeLine_37997e292ed05847: I don't need help, I need everyone to stop shooting at people with bandages!
RD_ALifeLine_7fdc271512df5b6d: You used to make me lower my weapon. Not anymore
RD_ALifeLine_2aae1d4f2e6e317d: *Smiles* Yeah. You stopped being a stranger somewhere along the way
RD_ALifeLine_41c86df114102238: Because I know you now. You put people back together same as me, just with a different toolkit
RD_ALifeLine_3a248866289f62c8: Don't get careless on my account
RD_ALifeLine_1a12abc85b647e7f: Me too. There's not many of you left. People I don't have to watch
RD_ALifeLine_2290e8bc0f7e957e: I won't. But I'll let you have a seat by the fire without counting your hands. That's my version of love now
RD_ALifeLine_427de1671790223c: Sure, yeah. Here. We've still got stock, take a couple
RD_ALifeLine_1a78a02745ad9fe7: Take this, go on. It's what we're for
RD_ALifeLine_2031d56c6c761ee1: *Winces* Things are tight. Really tight. What do you need it for?
RD_ALifeLine_5fcf3d966074ae43: I want to say yes. I always say yes. What's it for?
RD_ALifeLine_44b505fd1e759e4f: Then you get one. Don't argue
RD_ALifeLine_6b25c6726f2d586b: Then no. I'm sorry. I can't stock your pockets while people bleed in here
RD_ALifeLine_4ca45e613e1a29f7: Bring them here if you can. If not.. here. One. Tell them it's from us
RD_ALifeLine_001742a91dcd9b38: Could you spare anything at all?
RD_ALifeLine_2cee2f99770d1c6b: Spare? Look around. Nothing in here is spare, everything is someone's tomorrow
RD_ALifeLine_3627d345784ecec4: No. I'm sorry. I'd have to take it from someone sicker than you
RD_ALifeLine_1cdb3ec3321ba653: Thank you. Bring something if you can, it goes around. It always comes back around
RD_ALifeLine_3b606540214858de: Then bring me something. Food, water, meds. You'll find me fair
RD_ALifeLine_36962cb80de2c385: *Long pause* ..For you. One. Because you helped before. Don't tell anyone
RD_ALifeLine_17e36d0430d2ccdc: We'll feed you. Here, sit. We don't hand out food to take away, but you'll eat tonight
RD_ALifeLine_5d952c1f56b69d9c: A bowl. Here. It's mostly broth. Say grace or don't, either way, eat
RD_ALifeLine_7fbe722e34d84e75: I need something for the road
RD_ALifeLine_13cc16cb28cdb1d3: Of course. Come back tomorrow if you need. The door's open in the day
RD_ALifeLine_278192047d27a8b5: We can't. If we give food out the door, we'd have nothing for the people inside. I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_0d298b387a12df59: Hand over the medical bag. Now
RD_ALifeLine_1b4dba07190b6059: *Freezes* You.. you're robbing a medic? Seriously?
RD_ALifeLine_09491b55698e97f1: Oh God. Okay. Okay, don't, please, there's people who need this
RD_ALifeLine_7008c5c659dd013b: Bag. Now. Don't make me ask again
RD_ALifeLine_6d4b5c6b7df9e84b: Just the antibiotics, keep the rest
RD_ALifeLine_1beeb1c7301784ab: *Drops it, hands up* Take it. Just take it. You'll need a medic someday, remember this
RD_ALifeLine_4af58a6e1a4a6311: *Shaking, pulls a bottle* Here. That's all of it. You just killed someone in my care, I hope you know that
RD_ALifeLine_6eb6e65b1211968a: That's not funny. That's NOT funny. Get away from me
RD_ALifeLine_6f5c4e8975cd31ab: Hands up! Get on the ground
RD_ALifeLine_246df96f5604e633: Okay okay okay! I'm unarmed, I'm a medic!
RD_ALifeLine_50f7046c2c83f622: *Hands shoot up* Don't shoot! We're not armed, we're not anybody!
RD_ALifeLine_696a31cc66557f06: Nobody! Nobody, just me, I swear. *Eyes flick to the house*
RD_ALifeLine_4b8e8ef7628ed2eb: *Fumbling* A lighter, a bandage, a picture of my mom.. that's it, I swear that's it
RD_ALifeLine_18f8548e5f705908: Two kids and an old man with a broken leg, okay?! Please. Please don't go in there
RD_ALifeLine_219145ae31138d99: ..Thank you. I won't forget this. I really won't
RD_ALifeLine_1599067450946f55: For robbing you. I was desperate
RD_ALifeLine_44b5b79b2423acd2: *Face hardens* ..YOU. You've got some nerve coming back here
RD_ALifeLine_2e5a9c683c01707a: I brought something to make up for it
RD_ALifeLine_73e29f2235485fef: Relax, I'm not here for that
RD_ALifeLine_1278d0be0c500366: Everybody's desperate. Not everybody robs a nurse. ..I'll think about forgiving you. Don't hold your breath
RD_ALifeLine_46f883031fe80e4b: *Looks at the bandages, then at you* ..That doesn't fix it. But it helps someone. Fine. We're not friends
RD_ALifeLine_4f56a2e01549db70: I give up! Don't shoot, I'm not a threat
RD_ALifeLine_2fc6a7462ba23155: *Startled* Wh- okay! Okay, stay down, keep your hands up
RD_ALifeLine_328727934e6e2902: Put it down. All the way down. Kick it away. Good
RD_ALifeLine_363c2f8708ae6dda: *Keep hands up* I just need help
RD_ALifeLine_52b442637d9a2d80: Help with what? Talk slow, keep your hands where I can see them
RD_ALifeLine_1dfce56f18c1c6e7: Then pass through. That way. Don't stop, don't look back, and we'll all have a nice day
RD_ALifeLine_1e7b6019101a3a3a: *Lowers the weapon a little* ..Show me. Slowly. If it's a bite, you need to tell me right now
RD_ALifeLine_3859de1b63426d84: Lost is everyone. Go back the way you came, that road's clearer. And don't come at people that fast again
RD_ALifeLine_6d6c0252783727b5: Not a bite. Okay. Okay, come here. I'm sorry, we've had a bad week
RD_ALifeLine_14f45a713a48a2c1: Your patients are dead weight. You know that, right?
RD_ALifeLine_7568db3a06e98303: *Very still* Say that again. I dare you
RD_ALifeLine_29f5c9170a17b57b: Easy, I'm just saying what everyone thinks
RD_ALifeLine_6a9819ae6728644c: Get out. GET OUT. Before I do something I'll pray about later
RD_ALifeLine_78af32c7197955be: *Breathes* ..Yeah. It did. Go cool off somewhere else
RD_ALifeLine_4fad0d1c69acfeb1: Then everyone can get their own damn stitches. Leave
RD_ALifeLine_4dacb2446ec6da9e: My friend's hurt. Come with me, quick
RD_ALifeLine_22f223b55b787166: How hurt? Bleeding? Bitten? Talk to me
RD_ALifeLine_5fcd323b35b56156: Where? How far? Is it a bite? Don't lie to me
RD_ALifeLine_28e1537c1fd013b6: Okay. Okay, show me, I'm right behind you. Go, GO
RD_ALifeLine_10655bf15cbe647a: *Stops* ..Then I can't help them. I can only help you say goodbye. I'm sorry
RD_ALifeLine_18a4c5c63625adf8: Then don't move them. I'll grab the splint. Lead the way and don't run, I'm not as fast as you
RD_ALifeLine_70638569136edb70: *Already reaching for the bag* How many? How bad?
RD_ALifeLine_448bb12327b5c2d3: You came all this way to ask? Then it must be bad. How many?
RD_ALifeLine_008107025e79b1c5: I don't know, I just heard screaming
RD_ALifeLine_08280ba443b66183: Okay. I'll go. I'll go, but you walk in front, and if it's a trap I'm going to haunt you
RD_ALifeLine_4d622a94496ef468: Screaming's sometimes the living, sometimes the.. other. I'll come, but we look first
RD_ALifeLine_77721b5e1033b931: Leave this place. It's not safe here
RD_ALifeLine_147555f352510230: Not safe? Where is? Tell me where it's safe and I'll pack tonight
RD_ALifeLine_79cd3aef564c0a4c: *Tired laugh* You think I don't know that? Where would we go with six people who can't walk
RD_ALifeLine_4733fc0b5a917b45: There's a horde coming this way
RD_ALifeLine_1834d1454f6d3464: *Goes pale* ..How many? Never mind, I don't want the number. Okay. Okay we move the worst ones first
RD_ALifeLine_1b591e624407dac1: About us? ..By name? God. Okay. We'll go quiet, lights off, maybe move the meds. Thank you for telling us
RD_ALifeLine_279e82f859309aca: Trust is expensive. I've got patients. I'm not moving them on a feeling
RD_ALifeLine_3c2622a2107996ec: *Stares* ..You're kidding. You're not kidding. Oh thank God
RD_ALifeLine_1ce37417565e678e: A real one? Like, medical school, the whole thing?
RD_ALifeLine_571e9e1e6bc29fc9: I've got a man with a hand that's.. I don't know what's wrong with it. Would you look? Just look?
RD_ALifeLine_68cd40b823e11c5c: Even better, honestly. Nurses know the stuff that actually keeps people alive. Pull up a chair, colleague
RD_ALifeLine_75d9739d7bee82f6: *Face falls* ..Don't. Don't do that to me
RD_ALifeLine_3983bf33357122fa: And then maybe tell me if I've been doing this right. I've been guessing for weeks
RD_ALifeLine_33cbe33f47143974: I used to be on a crew too
RD_ALifeLine_5531b7506a6563f3: Yeah? Which house? Doesn't matter. Once a crew, always a crew
RD_ALifeLine_79fa9098309ace89: *Grins* I thought so. You walk into a room like you're checking the exits
RD_ALifeLine_2c81695b6423b5ce: Then you know how it is. Eat when you can, sleep when you can, and the coffee's always terrible
RD_ALifeLine_31610e31010ca925: *Snorts* Should've known. Real firefighters don't brag, they complain
RD_ALifeLine_70bf88ab28186015: Come by the station. There's always a bunk and a lousy meal for crew
RD_ALifeLine_03a11d376268b13f: I'm a cop. Was a cop
RD_ALifeLine_23bdcb6a2a386a16: Hm. A badge used to mean I'd feel safer. Now it just means you've got a gun
RD_ALifeLine_1e0dfc34239a8f64: Yeah? We worked a lot of scenes with your people. Some good ones. Some not
RD_ALifeLine_5a8914a46f7f991b: I'm one of the good ones
RD_ALifeLine_60aa203c2569590d: *Nods* Then you can help us. The roads aren't safe for people carrying bandages. An escort here and there
RD_ALifeLine_6b6085af3964c56b: No. They don't. People mean something. Badges just used to tell you which people
RD_ALifeLine_236d2ddd38d3a580: You don't think this is natural, do you?
RD_ALifeLine_3b0f8d954e80eda7: *Quiet* Who said that? I didn't say that
RD_ALifeLine_23a20fe71bf9859e: I worked in a lab. Two years. Cleaning, mostly. But I heard things
RD_ALifeLine_2424c79d3cee23bc: Contracts. Men in suits who weren't doctors. Freezers we weren't allowed to open. It's probably nothing
RD_ALifeLine_1a0988404a4d3e50: I don't know. A virus that wakes the dead? Nature doesn't do that. Nature kills you and stays done
RD_ALifeLine_4c08ac3a6ce37f7d: Yeah. You're right. Knowing won't stitch anyone. Thanks
RD_ALifeLine_40d41ec9330e94b8: It's probably nothing. I tell myself that a lot
RD_ALifeLine_11cf0c300e9a7492: I saw it. I waved. I jumped up and down like an idiot. It didn't even slow down
RD_ALifeLine_1af4de6c6cac3ff1: *Bitter* Oh I saw it. All of us saw it. Twenty people screaming on a roof
RD_ALifeLine_1e4958471ed53387: It could. It just didn't. That's what I can't get past. They saw us and they chose
RD_ALifeLine_2f2af08711d967d1: Away. Away from here. That's where everyone with a helicopter is going
RD_ALifeLine_71d32bd657b6a676: How are you managing without power?
RD_ALifeLine_5d0ab74c5b9637f3: Candles and prayer. The fridge with the insulin died first. That was a bad night
RD_ALifeLine_3fbe12203ad8267a: Badly. Everything that needed cold is gone. Everything that needed a machine is gone. We're back to hands
RD_ALifeLine_79be3fdf4681bcd6: Two diabetics. I kept the bottles in the creek for a week. It wasn't enough. I'm sorry, you didn't need to hear that
RD_ALifeLine_7cc9689a2bfbe55e: *Small smile* They do. Hands and boiled water and a little stubbornness. People did this for thousands of years
RD_ALifeLine_756c6e9909277f78: *Shrugs* Weather changes, the sick change with it. That's all I know about weather now
RD_ALifeLine_0b36d98f349db165: Coughs. Stomachs. Feet, God, everyone's feet are wrecked. Nobody's sat still in weeks
RD_ALifeLine_01349c953e517e9a: Bring dry socks. I'm serious. Dry socks save more people than I do some weeks
RD_ALifeLine_0c0735516cd30190: You know what day it is?
RD_ALifeLine_07038a261e4e3133: Every day's a week. Every week's a year. I've aged ten years since this started, look at my hair
RD_ALifeLine_51c888c369f2598c: For you maybe. For me it was a hundred bandages ago
RD_ALifeLine_0143025a78198b21: Who are you and what do you want
RD_ALifeLine_34aacbd07cb77196: What do you want from me
RD_ALifeLine_4b41ef905fef0944: Honestly? I don't know what's happening, people are eating people out there
RD_ALifeLine_1cd5fc8c3cddade1: I saw a guy bite a cop, like BITE him, and nobody's coming to help
RD_ALifeLine_3ce2b72d3fcac946: Saw your lights from the road, it's the only house that looked.. normal
RD_ALifeLine_4981a3853d95a8b3: I just wanted to see a living face, ask if you know anything
RD_ALifeLine_35c510cd75e528cf: Nobody knows anything, just don't get bitten
RD_ALifeLine_3fd367a361dc1d0f: Come in for a minute, catch your breath
RD_ALifeLine_608ea4da2dfadc23: Should I not have come? I can go
RD_ALifeLine_154a1eca5ace593e: No it's fine, just keep your voice down
RD_ALifeLine_422e93b6476c8c23: Lights, damn, I gotta cover the windows
RD_ALifeLine_140627f01cc9adb4: Don't get bitten, yeah, okay, okay I can do that
RD_ALifeLine_20d8dbb242913eaa: Head, right? You hit them in the head? God this is insane
RD_ALifeLine_7d80fa23297312ac: Really? Oh thank god, thank you, I won't touch anything
RD_ALifeLine_5b48fec940100c2e: No, I get it, I'd be scared of me too
RD_ALifeLine_110c224b1cdc52f2: Thanks.. I mean it, I'll get out of your hair now
RD_ALifeLine_2d21d7535b7c1ede: Yeah, maybe, I could see you from pretty far, sorry
RD_ALifeLine_2662eca4200a400f: Who are you, and why are you at my door
RD_ALifeLine_18e5bd071328c17b: You bitten? Show me your arms
RD_ALifeLine_6a498afd10b6be2a: Water would be nice.. and maybe ten minutes where nothing tries to eat me
RD_ALifeLine_38b9ec6769fbb1b0: *Rolls up sleeves* Look, clean, both arms, I check every morning
RD_ALifeLine_7a2494704352ba5d: Army's gone, did you know that? Trucks just left, I watched them leave
RD_ALifeLine_5b472361296c8b74: Yeah I saw, we're on our own now
RD_ALifeLine_77bc5b3a29b394b4: Sit on the porch, I'll bring water
RD_ALifeLine_5c61c5c076c8e602: Smart of you to ask though, the last guy didn't and his friend turned in the kitchen
RD_ALifeLine_7aea0b0b6b5f8952: On our own.. yeah, guess so, it's weird hearing it out loud
RD_ALifeLine_4392d39f1257669d: You serious? Thank you, I mean it, really
RD_ALifeLine_0f8488306020b9e8: Yeah, nobody can anymore, I get it
RD_ALifeLine_2a3db319754c5064: How many of you are out there
RD_ALifeLine_6428533b6119f37f: I know where the dead are thick and where they aren't, that's worth something right
RD_ALifeLine_53fdf66a714dac60: Just me, I swear.. I had two friends a week ago, now it's just me
RD_ALifeLine_2e4aef971cdde9e7: Fine, but you're making a mistake, I'm useful
RD_ALifeLine_4202eeeb63650dc3: I give you that, you let me rest a bit, fair?
RD_ALifeLine_644f776727befcb2: You can look around, nobody's hiding in your bushes
RD_ALifeLine_53a4de0279bce1d2: I'll keep an eye on you
RD_ALifeLine_5f3c91380d29561c: Nobody sent me, nobody's sending anybody anymore
RD_ALifeLine_55708ed141a04dc8: Your place looks lived in, lived in means people, people means maybe a trade
RD_ALifeLine_4d7ba6001407e751: I was, they got picky about who eats, so I left before they picked me
RD_ALifeLine_7581ee9331e287b6: Yeah, I believe you could, alright, going
RD_ALifeLine_4cbf5dc84769ec91: I've got stuff, you've got stuff, we don't kill each other, everybody wins
RD_ALifeLine_05e629370abe4279: Some cans, a little medicine, a lighter, you want something specific?
RD_ALifeLine_09ffcd3255e580b2: Everybody's a stranger now, that's the whole problem
RD_ALifeLine_0215063a051dd1c5: Two months of this, you stop being a person and start being.. a habit
RD_ALifeLine_51ac606e00749853: Talk, mostly, I forget what my voice sounds like
RD_ALifeLine_71cd159e2d936659: Okay, it's fine, I'm used to it
RD_ALifeLine_69ca413005b6ae08: Wake up, find water, don't get bit, sleep, again and again
RD_ALifeLine_34bb624c2ce616da: I know exactly what you mean
RD_ALifeLine_0b39eb116ab7b3de: You need to hold on to something
RD_ALifeLine_19d1a15b7df51b7c: Yeah? *Laughs* Nice to meet another habit
RD_ALifeLine_5726e883408f913a: Maybe that's why I knock on doors, to remember I still can
RD_ALifeLine_7f30aaa47d2bb30a: Bit early to be knocking, isn't it
RD_ALifeLine_2af1ff9a70e220e7: I know, sorry, I walked all night, didn't wanna sleep outside
RD_ALifeLine_3e7e9f0670def3ce: Sun's barely up, I know, I couldn't wait any longer
RD_ALifeLine_79be0a2c12b3bade: Why'd you walk at night, that's insane
RD_ALifeLine_34960dd852771aaf: Come back at a decent hour
RD_ALifeLine_32e6afe42ab2e3c0: Couldn't sleep where I was, they were scratching at the door all night
RD_ALifeLine_57ccb7691e283ce9: God, yes, starving, but I didn't come to beg
RD_ALifeLine_66fa3dbd05a1dfe7: Ha.. a decent hour, sure, I'll come back when the clocks work
RD_ALifeLine_772851e10da6db0e: So I just.. left, kept walking till I saw your place
RD_ALifeLine_51f433c73f42bb01: For now's more than I had yesterday, thank you
RD_ALifeLine_01552185119e7b9f: Don't think so, I went through a creek, they don't like water much I think
RD_ALifeLine_7c48cabd45a125e5: Beans.. I could cry, thank you, really
RD_ALifeLine_3f1681d90f78b7b6: It's dark out, what are you doing here
RD_ALifeLine_237a43bb60b5a056: I know, I know, I got lost and then it got dark and then.. here I am
RD_ALifeLine_4fc331c779a297cf: It got dark way too fast, please, I just need somewhere for the night
RD_ALifeLine_33d6465433707332: Why should I trust you in the dark
RD_ALifeLine_59f1f5f55329d789: One night, I swear, I'll be gone before you're up
RD_ALifeLine_77437c9d581a04aa: You shouldn't, I wouldn't either, but I'm standing here with empty hands
RD_ALifeLine_390b092014e13933: Okay.. if I'm still alive in the morning, maybe then
RD_ALifeLine_647b6f4b4231936e: Thank you.. I'll sleep by the door, I won't bother anyone
RD_ALifeLine_3845034904191719: You can lock me in a room if you want, honestly fine by me
RD_ALifeLine_1bc28503368050f8: Sleep on the porch, door stays shut
RD_ALifeLine_3e361aec581cf26d: That's fair, porch is better than a ditch
RD_ALifeLine_08e353946fa2e35a: Fell in a ditch running from like six of them, I'm fine, I'm cold but fine
RD_ALifeLine_2696c0b0742878e6: Rain, and then more rain, and then a ditch
RD_ALifeLine_675e40d172d47613: Come warm up by the fire
RD_ALifeLine_0b38dce0795e14e5: A fire? A real one? I could kiss you, I won't, but I could
RD_ALifeLine_5ef302091c6ed6d6: Scraped my knee, that's it, not a bite, I swear, look
RD_ALifeLine_39d838500d472461: Sure.. I'll drip on your porch then
RD_ALifeLine_61b48a940f2dd39e: Okay maybe a bandage if you have one, if not whatever
RD_ALifeLine_47739c8d7325ad80: Wash it, that's all I can do
RD_ALifeLine_46f0fc902a50ab10: Thank you, I'll pay you back, somehow
RD_ALifeLine_6d6f63040424eacb: You need a place to stay
RD_ALifeLine_652f66a038ef7d99: Just a night or two, my place got overrun, I hid in the attic for a day
RD_ALifeLine_0765f1fc14ead8f9: You can stay, house rules though
RD_ALifeLine_19fcac517372ada2: Can't take anyone in right now
RD_ALifeLine_1a65ae2752fe3583: My neighbour.. he was banging on my door, then he wasn't him anymore
RD_ALifeLine_71cf6ae125276a2b: Rules, sure, anything, no guns out, no noise, I can do that
RD_ALifeLine_4e3cb7a177739c1b: I understand, it's okay.. do you know anywhere else?
RD_ALifeLine_7f3a91297339ddfa: I can still hear him, isn't that stupid
RD_ALifeLine_7fdb4e7825a895f2: Thanks for this, really, I'll keep my stuff in one corner
RD_ALifeLine_09d690bc6c066462: Never mind, I'll figure it out
RD_ALifeLine_3040496a081ead69: Fresh.. yeah, God, it was only a few days ago
RD_ALifeLine_7b0c4f306c1c603d: You're looking for somewhere to sleep, right
RD_ALifeLine_50a67bba3838eb1f: Somewhere with walls, yeah, I'm tired of sleeping in cars
RD_ALifeLine_2ce4f1d120b0237c: Walls and a door, that's luxury now
RD_ALifeLine_614710a30ad3e919: What can you do for me in return
RD_ALifeLine_2ba0e351303539c3: A floor's perfect, honestly, floors don't bite
RD_ALifeLine_12b219e6442fecd6: I can keep watch while you sleep, I'm good at staying up
RD_ALifeLine_006152343d76ad6d: Or I fix stuff, I'm alright with a hammer
RD_ALifeLine_7e64c0a55485686d: Fix the back fence and you can stay
RD_ALifeLine_3bf18d08671dc8c6: Deal, I'll wake you if anything moves
RD_ALifeLine_6a237c501b9bede6: Fence it is, got nails? Kidding, I'll find some
RD_ALifeLine_4fc0bf1b2088d6a6: You look like you ran here, what's wrong
RD_ALifeLine_027a902f511dae23: There's a horde moving, a big one, I saw it from a rooftop, it's coming this way-ish
RD_ALifeLine_6a4fbcb96123ec19: Which way are they coming from
RD_ALifeLine_5da601f539801423: Hundreds? I stopped counting, it looked like the road was moving
RD_ALifeLine_48268446479aa8d4: I wish I was, man, go see for yourself, from far away
RD_ALifeLine_67fd141358187def: Board up, stay quiet, don't light anything tonight
RD_ALifeLine_6e23363476228a57: Stay with us till it passes
RD_ALifeLine_441cbb4b23894f83: Just.. I didn't want to walk past and say nothing
RD_ALifeLine_6e32390e2920e42f: Really? I.. yeah, okay, more eyes is better
RD_ALifeLine_05cb292a438847e6: Yeah, there's people out there, armed, checking houses one by one
RD_ALifeLine_56debcd318226069: Did they see you come here
RD_ALifeLine_378382546177362d: For anything, food, guns, people.. I saw them drag a guy out of a garage
RD_ALifeLine_644774af6ea4ff1a: No, I went round the long way, twice, I'm not stupid
RD_ALifeLine_6d6b685c4ddc1865: It will be, when they knock
RD_ALifeLine_18c5809a09e3e134: They're not like us, they enjoy it
RD_ALifeLine_337fa10f70a2fc8a: Loud, cocky, they don't hide, they want you to see them
RD_ALifeLine_5e49a0e030d22343: Be ready, and don't open the door for anyone you don't know.. except me, obviously
RD_ALifeLine_63c244252ca7cd85: Heard it? It flew right over me, and then every dead thing for a mile followed it
RD_ALifeLine_6b571f3723060ee9: Nothing with a few hundred zombies attached, sure
RD_ALifeLine_5c4cfd6904c88077: If it comes back, get inside and stay down, trust me
RD_ALifeLine_5a108c12161a51de: *Laughs* Rescue.. sure, a rescue that doesn't land
RD_ALifeLine_620916816e2327f2: Radio says stay inside and wait for help, TV's just the same picture over and over
RD_ALifeLine_3ae8150040da4020: Do you believe help is coming
RD_ALifeLine_494100bb11f8f33e: Some say it's a virus, some say chemicals, one guy said aliens, I hit him
RD_ALifeLine_411f7d9472e76682: I want to, God I want to, but I saw the cops leave in a hurry
RD_ALifeLine_3e730fc61934d4b7: But they're all saying don't get bitten, that part's real
RD_ALifeLine_24002b5e3064bfdd: That's the only part that matters
RD_ALifeLine_71f907f13a969547: Yeah.. yeah, head and teeth, that's the whole world now
RD_ALifeLine_641bdce925328c42: They're putting up fences, but fences around what? Around us?
RD_ALifeLine_3e94e2cb1d63defc: Radio went quiet two days ago, just the emergency tone now
RD_ALifeLine_3cd260471825ab21: The broadcasts stopped, did you notice that?
RD_ALifeLine_3e64bfdd7d3fc0f8: It's creepy, right? Like someone switched off the world
RD_ALifeLine_559806152bab2f51: People are leaving town in cars, getting stuck, getting eaten in traffic
RD_ALifeLine_0ef2ded54b74d97f: Walk, don't drive, that's what I learned
RD_ALifeLine_19339ec2752ee1a4: It's the only advice I've got, take it free
RD_ALifeLine_3af3481847f64ec2: Word is nobody's coming, word is it's like this everywhere
RD_ALifeLine_0226241e0d86b847: Word? The word is groups, people are banding together, some good, some really not
RD_ALifeLine_2deeece62807dad4: Tell me about the good ones
RD_ALifeLine_2fadd1303fc43378: Folks with farms, mostly, they trade if you're polite and don't bring trouble
RD_ALifeLine_45c152814ce02def: They take, that's all they do, they take and they laugh
RD_ALifeLine_2886b7ff7401da8d: Safe? No, but some people got a place set up, I can tell you who to ask
RD_ALifeLine_32be5838661dd085: Don't let them see you're comfortable, comfortable is a target
RD_ALifeLine_34319a0d4e3092e6: I'll mark it for you if you want, roughly
RD_ALifeLine_6682f97c400b2714: Good, I like you being alive
