RD_ALifeLine_1b6934783921327c: There, don't go in shooting, they're jumpy
RD_ALifeLine_2fdec5de7d65de0b: The dead are slower when it's cold, and the living are meaner
RD_ALifeLine_233791270b50d99a: Food's running out, the easy stuff's gone, people fight over a can now
RD_ALifeLine_23f62b183ed9f926: Something, sure, still bite just as hard though
RD_ALifeLine_077c41d8639f34dd: I saw two guys kill each other over a box of cereal, cereal, man
RD_ALifeLine_3901296467989dd3: That's why you keep your head down
RD_ALifeLine_3bd96fa11149f657: Still nothing from out there, huh
RD_ALifeLine_61b28640394b02a1: Nothing from the government, nothing from the radio.. nothing from God either
RD_ALifeLine_2b8341f904f8275f: I believe in boots that don't leak, and in people like you, maybe
RD_ALifeLine_3a1cc4864bb2dbf3: Fewer and fewer, the ones left are tough or lucky or both
RD_ALifeLine_182af54c0c3f7934: Which one are you, do you think
RD_ALifeLine_24c4a80724957a2b: You keep looking around like you want to stay
RD_ALifeLine_300b305029261d36: Is it that obvious? I'm scared, okay, I don't wanna be alone out there anymore
RD_ALifeLine_2ab322ed0418cc4e: Really? You mean it? Oh my god, okay, I won't let you down
RD_ALifeLine_4ad975191d4a22e5: I can cook, I can carry, I can run, I'm good at running
RD_ALifeLine_52da56c154be0bf8: I'll pull my weight, I promise
RD_ALifeLine_71343c2151cb0a6a: Another time.. okay, I'll hold you to that
RD_ALifeLine_1caf5d6d442f9dbf: You want to come with me, don't you
RD_ALifeLine_2726626c2cd29942: Look, straight up, I'm better with people, and you look like you know what you're doing
RD_ALifeLine_23c3764a517fdea1: I've got a knife, two working legs and I don't complain much
RD_ALifeLine_116841844233ae27: Then grab your stuff, you're in
RD_ALifeLine_7357bec370f62c3a: Why'd your last group drop you
RD_ALifeLine_2e4441cc4e4d875a: Hell yes, okay, you won't regret it
RD_ALifeLine_0d7f8fdb3c9e678c: They didn't drop me, they died, it's different
RD_ALifeLine_07a0790f2bff8475: Alone's how everyone dies, but okay, your call
RD_ALifeLine_525b194855b65922: I was out on a run when the dead came through, I came back to.. nothing
RD_ALifeLine_6e4acf662d48af8a: Two months alone does things to you, I talk to birds, I named one
RD_ALifeLine_7fde859b46183e1f: Gerald, he's a crow, he's a terrible listener
RD_ALifeLine_45f406ae6557b045: *Smiles* Okay.. okay, let's go before I cry
RD_ALifeLine_30328b872129bb75: So.. what do you say, room for one more
RD_ALifeLine_6fd5309f362720ca: Stay and join me, we could use you
RD_ALifeLine_27006f576730a74f: Join you.. like actually come with you?
RD_ALifeLine_2ab5edfe251e8683: Only if you pull your weight
RD_ALifeLine_59931a9446eff997: Okay, okay, yes, God yes, I'm in
RD_ALifeLine_6555e3d4565bc265: I will, I'll carry, I'll watch, I'll do the dishes, if there's dishes
RD_ALifeLine_610d776f06304163: You could come with me, you know
RD_ALifeLine_3d61763e3007c2f9: With you? I don't even know if you're gonna shoot me in my sleep
RD_ALifeLine_041d108d0fae5bfe: I won't, you have my word
RD_ALifeLine_12c9e6e66ca8e6bc: Words are cheap now.. but okay, you've been decent so far
RD_ALifeLine_1dcdf078176f037a: I'll think, I'm not saying no
RD_ALifeLine_541a1dc570ae432c: I'll come, but I sleep with my back to the wall
RD_ALifeLine_66765a2f36c3cb27: Alright, let's see where this goes
RD_ALifeLine_6252492d7f022d25: Did you think about my offer
RD_ALifeLine_17d5facf078cd697: About joining you? Yeah.. I thought about it all night
RD_ALifeLine_3cf993d22c03a113: I'm in, if it's still on the table
RD_ALifeLine_6f92cfdf2e5b480f: Oh.. okay, that stings, but okay
RD_ALifeLine_0b00b23a50d24381: I'd take you along, but I've got a full crew
RD_ALifeLine_37cbc043179cd1ea: Five people? Damn, you're running a whole town over here
RD_ALifeLine_643e5ff14bc1099b: Fair, food's food, I'll stop by sometimes
RD_ALifeLine_14cbb68c018ae53d: Leaves or dies, you mean.. dark, but sure, keep me in mind
RD_ALifeLine_2e0ccb6c3b0dc5c2: I haven't eaten since yesterday morning, and it was half a granola bar
RD_ALifeLine_016396b14d457316: Here, have a can of soup
RD_ALifeLine_6b3a635414cf4859: Some chips, it's all I got
RD_ALifeLine_31cbeb02770aae2f: Soup.. real soup, I could hug you
RD_ALifeLine_09ceda1734868a35: Hey, chips are food, thank you
RD_ALifeLine_5da0967c2dbd5fd7: When did you last drink something
RD_ALifeLine_1592a7f341bc966e: Rain this morning, off a car roof, does that count
RD_ALifeLine_77fa58361c796c7e: The tap still works, go on
RD_ALifeLine_23626c393e3b75b8: Oh my god, cold water, thank you, thank you
RD_ALifeLine_6a8074ed48c0c865: It still works? Lucky you, don't tell anyone
RD_ALifeLine_2b97a8b240dd1eb4: Yeah, a creek, with dead guys floating in it
RD_ALifeLine_13e1ddbc29fc7b47: You didn't have to come back
RD_ALifeLine_335906a52bdc3792: You fed me when you didn't have to, so.. here, I found this
RD_ALifeLine_0077f1582fb2de83: It's not much, but it's yours
RD_ALifeLine_17a6f32e417304b6: Keep it, you need it more
RD_ALifeLine_10af0ee241b4b28a: *Smiles* We take care of each other, or what's the point
RD_ALifeLine_5b9c11fe6e767316: You sure? Okay.. you're a weird kind of person, the good kind
RD_ALifeLine_42051d551c672c70: I found a pharmacy nobody'd cleaned out, back room, I grabbed what I could
RD_ALifeLine_746036d24f449e08: I don't need all of it, you've been good to me
RD_ALifeLine_36e112cf76f86251: Don't thank me, just don't die, okay
RD_ALifeLine_6b9fa3b02209ce81: Deal, beans for pills, the new money
RD_ALifeLine_5201f4a66c12a0eb: Cut my leg on a fence, it's getting red, hot, I think it's going bad
RD_ALifeLine_15b80f10728ba0f1: Let me see, I've got disinfectant
RD_ALifeLine_2ff8bd2b5657cf4e: I can try to find you something
RD_ALifeLine_32332b3f1e069a08: Ow- shit, okay, okay, that stings like hell.. thank you
RD_ALifeLine_3a64911d43af0da7: You'd do that? I'll wait here, I can't really go anywhere anyway
RD_ALifeLine_556634e540b5d93f: You did? Seriously? Let me see, oh thank god
RD_ALifeLine_286805e73ed3312e: I don't have much to give you back, but I've got something
RD_ALifeLine_3009025e2982c0fa: [Charm] I went through hell for that, come on
RD_ALifeLine_3f881bd51b93678d: This is all I can do, I'm sorry, I'm not hiding anything
RD_ALifeLine_7d375a261e381be4: Fine, you earned it, take my spare box, I trust you more than I need it
RD_ALifeLine_19ed033b034b09cc: You're too good for this world, you know that
RD_ALifeLine_3f22182a2d299994: You keep looking at the road, waiting for someone
RD_ALifeLine_70136d97075174f3: You'd do that? There's a spot we used to hide, I'll mark it, bring me anything of his
RD_ALifeLine_5fdd148b0359b3f9: Yeah, maybe, he's stubborn, stubborn people last
RD_ALifeLine_0d2bd10868381b30: I went to that spot you marked
RD_ALifeLine_3ed59e782bab8cf8: Nobody was there, just this note
RD_ALifeLine_107cd6bd5c1f6f2c: *Holds it* That's his.. okay.. okay, at least I know now
RD_ALifeLine_6981ab600651927b: He left? He's alive, he must be, oh my god
RD_ALifeLine_2612660917f3b747: Thank you for going, nobody else would have, take this, please
RD_ALifeLine_62af23297a71a40b: Here, take something, you brought me hope, that's worth more than this
RD_ALifeLine_768941a343349966: He'd want it to be used, not rusting in my bag
RD_ALifeLine_54b3df076013d251: No.. no, I insist, but okay, thank you
RD_ALifeLine_4fefc4c5161e48c4: I'm gonna find him, I know it now
RD_ALifeLine_6cbb19460a019ec3: Kind of.. there's someone I owe, I can't go back that way, too many dead
RD_ALifeLine_26469f764ba78db5: Could you bring them a package for me? They'll know it's from me
RD_ALifeLine_33ba515c56b48281: Thank you, they're good people, tell them I'm okay
RD_ALifeLine_2e93cc4844c7a657: Just food and a letter, nothing weird, you can look
RD_ALifeLine_46a6f94e6aa23aca: Where are you staying these days
RD_ALifeLine_543971eb589eb82d: Nowhere, that's the problem, I found a house but there's dead in it, a bunch
RD_ALifeLine_654c7ff25dcdb952: If someone helped me clear it out, I'd have a home again, and I'd owe them
RD_ALifeLine_5d1c66f97709614a: Seriously? I'll mark it, be careful, the kitchen's the worst
RD_ALifeLine_51e4a9353b8604f4: Five? Six? I didn't stay to count
RD_ALifeLine_5b51999d608b5a99: Yeah, sure, another one with dead in it
RD_ALifeLine_03f65e5619a1954a: It is? All of them? You're insane, in a good way
RD_ALifeLine_7f369a1e6adae9f9: I can't pay much, but I found this in the garage
RD_ALifeLine_3dd39b975f14c350: [Charm] That was a lot of dead, you can do better
RD_ALifeLine_10d973bf6fa9f901: Here, and come visit me sometime, I'll have a home to visit
RD_ALifeLine_377c844c0df17478: Honestly, this is it, but you can visit, that's worth something right
RD_ALifeLine_6bebbfab7e41a057: Alright, you got me, I've got a pistol I never use, take it
RD_ALifeLine_442dff1d78d50f6f: Relax, I'm not gonna shoot you
RD_ALifeLine_23b6d16650719c5e: Then why's your hand on the gun?
RD_ALifeLine_447ea9964caeb4e6: Easy to say with a gun in your hand
RD_ALifeLine_40bcf9882c1322d4: I'm keeping it, for both our sakes
RD_ALifeLine_3231a3375fa3f04f: Okay.. okay, thank you, sorry, last guy said the same and then he didn't
RD_ALifeLine_0e8e8bf70dfcbeab: Then I keep my distance, that's fair, right?
RD_ALifeLine_32a7a95e3f31f46b: Nowhere's safe, but you can rest a bit
RD_ALifeLine_603a1e66292dab7c: Just tell me what you want
RD_ALifeLine_710a15397fa8019f: Nothing, honestly, just checking if you're human, human-human
RD_ALifeLine_3517ad5d32973355: Not yet, first tell me something, what did you do before all this
RD_ALifeLine_27a1e15c4e6d08ce: People who lie about that, they're usually lying about other stuff too
RD_ALifeLine_4725836475dba770: Maybe, but it matters to me
RD_ALifeLine_11c1ce3526109cf6: Then you're not my business either, bye
RD_ALifeLine_2535cbf858447a37: Hi.. sorry for the interview, you gotta be careful
RD_ALifeLine_492aecbb68249793: No, there's three of us, they're right behind those trees, watching you
RD_ALifeLine_273ac9b33afe5222: My friends are close, just so you know
RD_ALifeLine_15b86c7e09b3a788: Then tell them to come out
RD_ALifeLine_45b3bad77993da5a: *Sighs* Okay, fine, it's just me, but I had to try
RD_ALifeLine_7fc70e64637218b5: They're.. shy, okay, there's nobody, happy?
RD_ALifeLine_69068660288cdc82: Can't blame me for lying, can you
RD_ALifeLine_0ed3a6723075c4fe: Lie to me again and we're done
RD_ALifeLine_52ab3c233a30039c: Yeah? Then we understand each other
RD_ALifeLine_28daed8c7e4cf396: Here, look, empty, both of them
RD_ALifeLine_4d5e73c742527fd8: *Raises hands* See? Nothing, can I put them down now
RD_ALifeLine_259e2ee6773ba271: Okay, you can put them down
RD_ALifeLine_10cd36d964dde58a: Seriously? Okay.. nothing in my belt, nothing in my back
RD_ALifeLine_0a00fdba5137c1ff: Thanks.. I'm not here to make trouble
RD_ALifeLine_0fce51571d8a41ef: Satisfied? My arms are getting tired
RD_ALifeLine_49f3745b479cdde3: Yeah, sorry, you can't be too careful
RD_ALifeLine_19f1758f063dd0bb: No, you're right, I'd do the same
RD_ALifeLine_7f3488375f1a0814: Just a minute of not being alone
RD_ALifeLine_4f5352be30972cf5: Last group I trusted took my boots and laughed at me walking off barefoot
RD_ALifeLine_5675bc625de42068: Not all of us are like that
RD_ALifeLine_735df4b80011ec0c: I know, I know.. it's just hard to tell from the outside
RD_ALifeLine_229bedb12c2f8562: Yeah.. thanks, it's nice to hear
RD_ALifeLine_08cd716507b129db: Tough, sure, said the guy with boots
RD_ALifeLine_218ae6d867660389: You seem okay, I'll give you that
RD_ALifeLine_5316fbfa659094d4: Sure, no problem, it's away, see
RD_ALifeLine_0e09655f7c5dd87a: Fair, I don't like guns in houses either
RD_ALifeLine_00a4824a1275f322: And no flashlights near the windows
RD_ALifeLine_14d72c8510857685: That's all, make yourself at home
RD_ALifeLine_6c9798cf289afb7e: Got it, no lights, no noise, no guns, I'll be a ghost
RD_ALifeLine_756844cc1f273500: Home.. that word hits different now, thanks
RD_ALifeLine_25d0c6a92c840dbe: Don't tease me, I've been sleeping on concrete
RD_ALifeLine_5f81cce805265903: I'm gonna sleep like the dead.. bad choice of words
RD_ALifeLine_24b6fe541ac2f213: I wasn't! I was just looking, it's nice stuff
RD_ALifeLine_5c134a74508a4c47: Hey, I just touched a book, relax
RD_ALifeLine_7d33b17f503d01dc: You keep staring at the photos
RD_ALifeLine_25da7c3f5d78a7e4: Who are they? The family who lived here, I mean
RD_ALifeLine_2a7dc04c7d1ce0b8: Sorry, it's weird, sleeping in someone else's life
RD_ALifeLine_4a28f053215a716f: No idea, they were gone when I came
RD_ALifeLine_5b2876e92c294212: I try not to think about it
RD_ALifeLine_7afd4f8647f750ca: Gone where, right.. I hope somewhere good
RD_ALifeLine_086d66e33e58e505: Yeah, me too, I fail every night
RD_ALifeLine_1947c67a1f62183e: Before? God.. it feels like someone else's life
RD_ALifeLine_1dfdb24636a9ce15: I worked, I paid bills, I complained about my boss, I'd give anything to complain about my boss
RD_ALifeLine_4bfc37ef53dfb524: Doesn't matter now, nobody needs what I used to do
RD_ALifeLine_070d2f067e2d1275: Right? The worst thing in my life used to be a phone bill
RD_ALifeLine_7d5125864659cf23: Well, that might still be useful, lucky
RD_ALifeLine_58e226eb00cb0117: Had.. have? I don't know anymore
RD_ALifeLine_6218e2cf26ad48bf: My sister was in the city, last call I got was her screaming, then nothing
RD_ALifeLine_5546993a55f92ed7: Better not to think about it
RD_ALifeLine_0390b01b1e6f7504: Thanks, it's okay, it's not okay, but you know
RD_ALifeLine_3f793c977b9d7611: Maybe.. you're the first person who said that, thank you
RD_ALifeLine_05ae51f428d86174: Yeah, that's what I tell myself, doesn't work
RD_ALifeLine_6d3556e24055f803: First time in days I didn't wake up screaming, so yeah, great
RD_ALifeLine_2a7e5b4c5839679f: I heard you talking in your sleep
RD_ALifeLine_7e649607426615d5: Oh no.. what did I say? Don't tell me, actually
RD_ALifeLine_686909da24759787: Was I? Oh God, sorry, it's a song my dad used to play in the car
RD_ALifeLine_74eaf84b08982c50: It's okay, just keep it quiet
RD_ALifeLine_65529f6d470f5d46: *Smiles* Nobody's said that about my singing ever
RD_ALifeLine_2b638710080cbef9: Yeah, I've got somewhere to be, or somewhere to look for
RD_ALifeLine_51b1073874879a67: I should, I don't wanna wear out my welcome
RD_ALifeLine_0a9ba9ca060d61af: You can stay a bit longer
RD_ALifeLine_0c768c2766b3d744: You sure? Okay, one more hour, then I go
RD_ALifeLine_245e632545679fa1: You too, lock up behind me
RD_ALifeLine_6f3939b651bb1011: Careful, I might actually do that
RD_ALifeLine_3f6c292344bb8b67: It's time for you to go
RD_ALifeLine_145b63214b02dc6c: Oh.. okay, sure, yeah, I get it
RD_ALifeLine_3e0160b02a9c11fe: No, I get it, you've got your people to think about
RD_ALifeLine_0e09fef455cfbe47: You want to? Huh.. nobody's asked me that in a while
RD_ALifeLine_5a4be4003f83ee96: I move around, but there's a place I keep going back to, I'll show you on your map
RD_ALifeLine_7cfce5490194feac: Just come by when you can
RD_ALifeLine_5b6a982b42e937eb: There, roughly, knock twice, then once, so I know it's you
RD_ALifeLine_6bb0917f4563912a: You look like you're saying goodbye for real
RD_ALifeLine_38a1763b6a6512e9: Maybe I am.. I'm heading out of the county, if there's an out
RD_ALifeLine_01f412ab336c489c: Stay, we'll figure it out together
RD_ALifeLine_534dc00c3434fa19: You'd want me to? Like, as one of yours?
RD_ALifeLine_5573d85c03104059: Thanks, for everything, you were the good part of this
RD_ALifeLine_473d7bf4098e4f09: You're gonna make me cry, okay, I'm crying
RD_ALifeLine_7bda6bec3e14c665: Okay.. okay, maybe going alone is the dumb idea
RD_ALifeLine_55efac39294018a7: Told you I would, you thought I was lying, admit it
RD_ALifeLine_4ef173ec38494cc8: Hey! I'm still alive, you're still alive, look at us
RD_ALifeLine_62f0cf9c08906095: Yeah, good to be seen, you know?
RD_ALifeLine_7b9ebf416a713429: Nothing, I just.. wanted to see a friendly face, is that weird
RD_ALifeLine_4c3058b9397f3472: You gave me food when I had nothing, you think I'd forget that?
RD_ALifeLine_2107f60f6fde4946: I tell people about you, the good one with the house
RD_ALifeLine_536e962e6a17a628: You tell people where I live?!
RD_ALifeLine_776dc6c57fce6e86: No! No, not where, just that you exist, relax
RD_ALifeLine_77e0366415f2a2d1: Didn't think you'd come back after last time
RD_ALifeLine_129705f163208b22: Me neither, you weren't exactly friendly
RD_ALifeLine_2d9c083e5f7032c0: But your door's the only one around here that opens
RD_ALifeLine_606fd94103c3652c: Today? Kinda beautiful, and kinda awful
RD_ALifeLine_0130f4e142a2b837: Trying, it's harder than it sounds
RD_ALifeLine_5a59e67f3814eb5c: Laugh? Huh.. two days ago, a zombie tripped over a lawnmower, I almost died laughing
RD_ALifeLine_6a816ab52a666721: Get it? Because.. never mind, it's funnier at three in the morning
RD_ALifeLine_412ce5b3638a1a9d: Dark's all we've got, gotta laugh at something
RD_ALifeLine_79092a870f493dcb: Am I? Huh.. yeah, I guess I am, I didn't notice
RD_ALifeLine_3c04512b2770919f: It doesn't stop anymore, my hands just shake
RD_ALifeLine_43ff6a0336b85e48: Safe.. okay, I'm safe, I'm safe in here
RD_ALifeLine_65016ad55f70d7db: In.. out.. okay, okay, that helps a bit
RD_ALifeLine_02d775f93db39b44: Sorry.. this room looks like my friend's place, she had the same lamp
RD_ALifeLine_03a86a4d00923663: She turned in front of me, I had to.. I had to do it myself
RD_ALifeLine_37cc2b9448c5ce08: Thanks.. I don't really talk about it, I don't know why I'm telling you
RD_ALifeLine_2e97a49228388b55: I know, I know I did, it doesn't feel like it
RD_ALifeLine_25235ae048be9a73: You know of any groups set up nearby
RD_ALifeLine_44c950756e486e4b: They might trade, they might shoot, depends on the day I guess
RD_ALifeLine_7eff4e436f1bad7e: There, go easy, wave a lot, smile, don't run at them
RD_ALifeLine_0a777431547f1ba7: They've got guns, a lot of them, and they're organised, that's all I know
RD_ALifeLine_04c183eb688b5027: You've been out there alone this whole time
RD_ALifeLine_3bce61cb0b86f612: Pretty much, yeah, I know, everybody says that like it's a surprise
RD_ALifeLine_0efd41b1265d3638: Turns out alone just means you run faster, nobody to wait for
RD_ALifeLine_54fad2db44754f81: It's the only way that doesn't make me cry
RD_ALifeLine_02bd911c685e555a: *Looks away* Don't.. ask me something else
RD_ALifeLine_262d7ce672c708d3: Honestly? I keep waiting for someone to tell me it's a prank
RD_ALifeLine_702071a16eea322e: I'm okay, I think, I don't know what okay means anymore
RD_ALifeLine_0dc4f47236df38de: It's real, we have to deal with it
RD_ALifeLine_36c67daf0066c531: Yeah.. yeah I know, I just keep hoping
RD_ALifeLine_621e3bf800db68f9: Together, okay, I like that word
RD_ALifeLine_02d63d8a3996b2d2: Close, got it, closer than close
RD_ALifeLine_244bf1966cea3856: Thanks for not leaving me out there
RD_ALifeLine_5816cc6530079795: *Smiles* Good, cause I'm kinda useless alone
RD_ALifeLine_1dcd9d895b05a4d0: Tired, like bone tired, I didn't know you could be this tired and still walk
RD_ALifeLine_18f0ad9a20d13f0c: Real rest? With a door? I'll hold you to that

RD_ALifeLine_12494b882cca90c0: Which way you think we should go
RD_ALifeLine_77e7d84d0e8c4381: Back roads, slow, quiet, boring, boring is good
RD_ALifeLine_555fa80a73666e5d: Boring and alive, my two favourite things

RD_ALifeLine_77057e6444acdab7: I know.. one day though, one day I play it loud

RD_ALifeLine_4e174e3f49a35a26: Where'd you learn to stitch like that

RD_ALifeLine_2079453b1598bd32: Keep me stocked with bandages and I'll keep you in one piece
RD_ALifeLine_7de93b9041772f7d: Perfect, now try not to need them
RD_ALifeLine_20d1108b74f1e483: Good, and wash your hands for once
RD_ALifeLine_16b664424d03b2f2: Yeah.. it's me, surprise, I'm not dead

RD_ALifeLine_4852aabc748b02be: You really wanna do this at the door? Okay, fine

RD_ALifeLine_3f9b75ca711eaf61: Leaving doesn't change that, it just makes it hurt more
RD_ALifeLine_5556b13b50a61c7c: I never stopped thinking about it
RD_ALifeLine_49b6fcf272dbfdbe: Come back.. I.. okay, yeah, okay, let's do it
RD_ALifeLine_5e35b13a46fda8b1: You still mad about that guy I shot

RD_ALifeLine_2460b3a2635c5dc4: Pull me out, pull me out!
RD_ALifeLine_4e4c04b6374f08e7: Just a scratch.. just a scratch
RD_ALifeLine_1b960c2e5fbcdfcd: Tell my mom.. no. No, I'm fine
RD_ALifeLine_4212b6116c8f867f: Radio's been static for two days
RD_ALifeLine_4ed24eb4389a4326: Remember when the worst thing was a ruck march?
RD_ALifeLine_398fd7c203f39712: Sarge says the evac is coming. Sarge says a lot
RD_ALifeLine_1a1014177c243e3b: I keep counting rounds in my sleep
RD_ALifeLine_1d6b7d4d7593cfdd: I miss pizza. Like, real bad
RD_ALifeLine_20a88ada7540c126: It's so fucking cold on night watch
RD_ALifeLine_3ff2b0ab2d212d71: It's so hot my plate carrier's cooking me alive
RD_ALifeLine_179bbfec155cdb29: You think they nuked the cities?
RD_ALifeLine_06aa7ba32bc8533e: I wrote a letter. Don't know where to send it
RD_ALifeLine_4e3d12a335b12aa5: We used to be National Guard. Now we're.. whatever this is
RD_ALifeLine_256131413990a829: The LT left on day nine. Took the good truck
RD_ALifeLine_16ba92cf0d7ed052: Funny, I joined for college money
RD_ALifeLine_07a86e402f2ae79d: If you hear rotors, don't get excited, it's never for us
RD_ALifeLine_354f98ee11a04647: Kid on watch keeps humming the same song
RD_ALifeLine_563d18dc7c58f146: I used to clean my rifle every night. Now I just sleep
RD_ALifeLine_201cda173881f885: We buried two guys behind the trucks yesterday
RD_ALifeLine_0ccceeef2d9b24bb: I swear the dead are getting smarter
RD_ALifeLine_0995759b1b66fc4d: Rules are simple. Don't get bit, don't get lazy
RD_ALifeLine_054ddb284e7fbaaf: Nobody remembers the cordon was supposed to keep THEM in
RD_ALifeLine_7bc9fede40bb2aa0: Still got my wedding ring. Still got the wire cutters too
RD_ALifeLine_65e320fb314ee840: Colonel says we're an army. Feels more like a gang that salutes
RD_ALifeLine_033fed45395a2fed: Haven't turned the radio on in a week. Static hurts worse than silence
RD_ALifeLine_20902e5f2b822090: I traded my dress uniform for a can of peaches. Best deal I ever made
RD_ALifeLine_1145c47d675098d0: Don't call me private. Nobody's private anymore. We all sleep in one room
RD_ALifeLine_75b4e08a467a93e7: Rain's good. Rain means water and the dead move slower
RD_ALifeLine_63c91b1e29287a67: Any station, any station, this is.. anyone
RD_ALifeLine_10e5b2a53c72f1d6: Checkpoint to command, do you copy? Command?
RD_ALifeLine_7d2f892b75447f59: Command, this is the line, requesting orders, over
RD_ALifeLine_1a3dd2ee2a635638: Repeat, the cordon holds. Do not approach the wire
RD_ALifeLine_181cd0ee3a78c8dc: This is an automated message from the.. it's looping again
RD_ALifeLine_0bccb47c53bfc62e: If anyone can hear this, the evac is cancelled
RD_ALifeLine_20343a7620b24352: Two klicks out, heavy infected, avoid
RD_ALifeLine_208a445229981f10: Copy, rotor sound east, not ours
RD_ALifeLine_535492ac676f989d: Requesting resupply, we are black on food, over
RD_ALifeLine_20dea3a03216d6ec: Command went quiet on day six. We're still calling
RD_ALifeLine_5660a8ae1ae39dd7: Battalion to all units, hold your positions, hold, hold
RD_ALifeLine_6a95335d4632c59f: This is a free channel now. Say what you want
RD_ALifeLine_4d19360729387f71: Remnant net, check in by callsign
RD_ALifeLine_64d5ace323dc9615: Don't trust anyone saying they're the Army. We're the Army. What's left of it
RD_ALifeLine_4fb67df17983a938: Rolling out at dawn, two trucks, keep the road clear
RD_ALifeLine_19a639702b62d7f3: Watch the open channel, everybody's listening
RD_ALifeLine_272fc5107a40b9bd: Last call on this band today. Whoever's out there, hang on
RD_ALifeLine_2580eba04cb8fc4a: Remnant net, all callsigns, curfew in one hour
RD_ALifeLine_7d1346bc2305dfa4: Patrol two, you're late. Patrol two? ..damn it
RD_ALifeLine_358b679d0ed15c55: Rotors west of the river, low, unknown, do not signal
RD_ALifeLine_70b4325e160681ab: Gate, open up, we're coming in hot with three behind us!
RD_ALifeLine_3bca69f464e0981e: Got nothing to say to you
RD_ALifeLine_3ffea736268234e0: Not in the mood, keep moving
RD_ALifeLine_52f72801654e2a46: I'm not allowed to talk to civilians
RD_ALifeLine_471733c443414326: I don't know you, I don't talk to you
RD_ALifeLine_4888a5fe58a6cffd: Sarge sees me chatting, I'm dead
RD_ALifeLine_3f6701d654836959: Eyes on my sector, not on you. Move
RD_ALifeLine_158d7e4841f15917: Wait wait wait! I give up!
RD_ALifeLine_52c3cc9a7b47c744: I got a family, man, please
RD_ALifeLine_240b67204e33b081: Don't, I'm just a kid from the Guard
RD_ALifeLine_3ed545ee6593d41d: Take it, take all of it, just let me go
RD_ALifeLine_0d1575580586abbf: Don't kill me, I was never supposed to be here
RD_ALifeLine_0c2d9f555b525881: Okay.. okay. Don't do anything stupid
RD_ALifeLine_78f8d25311fc1654: Shit, there's a lot of them
RD_ALifeLine_190ead9d33256b2e: Big one! Armored! Don't waste rounds on the chest!
RD_ALifeLine_5214387367964d81: Rotors! Everybody under cover, the dead will come
RD_ALifeLine_0eba5c1310925927: Hey, it's me, from the checkpoint
RD_ALifeLine_653ac4cc014ee059: Easy, easy, I'm here to talk
RD_ALifeLine_590fae7c5a1d5077: Moving out, thanks for having me
RD_ALifeLine_793ce2667eae475d: Heading out. Stay safe in there
RD_ALifeLine_7d49ec22408fa6a3: I'll come by again if I'm still breathing
RD_ALifeLine_655c6daa381ce31f: Thanks. I'll tell the others you're good people
RD_ALifeLine_2b2f2fb23b396003: Take your time, I'll hold here
RD_ALifeLine_14d2419548885bf0: Not coming in till you say so
RD_ALifeLine_467158dc4f523258: I'll keep an eye on the road while you decide
RD_ALifeLine_6c41532d43a84bef: I'm good out here, no rush
RD_ALifeLine_7b1ef4f1243459f6: I'll be right here, rifle down
RD_ALifeLine_4529f76f06f8d5ec: You don't want to be here, trust me
RD_ALifeLine_150b34ed02d15a3b: Go home. Whatever's left of it
RD_ALifeLine_0cf3e03e495b10b0: Take ten steps back and we're friends
RD_ALifeLine_11a57a7754544567: Move along, nothing for you here
RD_ALifeLine_036f90bd7f3247c6: Don't make me fire a warning shot, ammo's tight
RD_ALifeLine_49b72a420775b6e5: Curfew's in effect. Off the road, now
RD_ALifeLine_3b63da3145956f5a: Toll first, then you talk. Or you walk
RD_ALifeLine_38479fbe240f129f: Muzzle down or this ends bad
RD_ALifeLine_1317012b748bd303: Don't. Don't even think about it
RD_ALifeLine_03ee91a346084090: Barrel to the ground, I won't say it again
RD_ALifeLine_6681883f219d14bd: Easy with that thing, my finger's real twitchy today
RD_ALifeLine_0bacc2814bcea67a: You want to talk, you lower it first
RD_ALifeLine_6f7bae314d28732c: Weapon down, hands up, then we talk like people
RD_ALifeLine_0db9dc271218bcae: Nobody needs to die over this, put it down
RD_ALifeLine_0ea305907348f13d: I got three rifles on you, think real hard
RD_ALifeLine_21148c851a7bd53a: Your hands are shaking, so are mine. Lower it
RD_ALifeLine_63ee8205286b0e4b: Put it away and we both walk home
RD_ALifeLine_3ea801573001f321: Not with that pointed at me, nope
RD_ALifeLine_146bd3bc580b3657: Everybody stay calm, I've got this
RD_ALifeLine_73e0c2c9155b4dda: Listen to me! Wounded inside, everybody else on the doors
RD_ALifeLine_67b62f567270dce5: Nobody panics, we do this by the book
RD_ALifeLine_2a57eadf5b544674: Triage, now! Red, yellow, green, move!
RD_ALifeLine_38958d5c35a13fd9: Keep the line, keep the kids in the middle
RD_ALifeLine_2f65084c7139294d: Okay people, eyes up, hands steady
RD_ALifeLine_583cdd98233c40de: I'm in charge till someone better shows up
RD_ALifeLine_07d467ff43d61125: Wounded to the back room, everyone else on doors!
RD_ALifeLine_4e406b034a2725af: Okay, I'm calling it, we move now
RD_ALifeLine_53c405107b709584: Listen to my voice, nobody runs, we walk
RD_ALifeLine_7e76e7c34abe43f8: No no no, stay with me, stay with me!
RD_ALifeLine_3686d5db756654d7: She's hit, cover me, I'm going in!
RD_ALifeLine_5986ac953f3a0421: Don't you dare die on me!
RD_ALifeLine_0e7cb7f95deb5468: I've got him, I've got him, keep them off us!
RD_ALifeLine_0232cae74f626a10: Medic! Wait.. I'm the medic, move!
RD_ALifeLine_11eeb6d91b4fac33: Talk to me, look at me, look at me!
RD_ALifeLine_661ec9c4058535fe: He's bleeding bad, I need a minute!
RD_ALifeLine_24c802746c4d4116: Keep pressure, I said KEEP PRESSURE
RD_ALifeLine_5c4d56d252904c4d: Cover me! I'm pulling them out!
RD_ALifeLine_017b413930cbdd07: Stay awake, stay awake, look at me!
RD_ALifeLine_1cf9979453065cf3: Keep pressure on it, I said keep it!
RD_ALifeLine_1195ad183b768b4c: I'm sorry, I've got nothing to spare
RD_ALifeLine_5eea78746ad1e887: I wish I could, I really do, but no
RD_ALifeLine_19edde22750fba5f: If I give you this, someone here dies tonight
RD_ALifeLine_62c5f90a4427deab: We're down to rags and prayers, sorry
RD_ALifeLine_25ab47527a0170ad: I can't. I've got kids with fevers in there
RD_ALifeLine_396cc5e07c68a3b6: Everything I have is already promised
RD_ALifeLine_0849ae0e2ecc0826: Ask me again when we find a pharmacy
RD_ALifeLine_5a3bae980efb4cb5: Look at these shelves, what do you see? Nothing
RD_ALifeLine_207233e83428993a: Bring me something first, then we talk
RD_ALifeLine_1f1cdc7426a3e9af: I'm not stingy, I'm empty, there's a difference
RD_ALifeLine_28856c8a198412c2: No. Don't ask again, it breaks my heart every time
RD_ALifeLine_3b7f2b093203d4d8: No, I'm sorry, there's a list and you're not on it
RD_ALifeLine_2466e1b125814747: I gave the last of it away an hour ago
RD_ALifeLine_2dddd08473b33c29: Ask the dead, they're the only ones with full cabinets
RD_ALifeLine_69dcf1d52776a02d: Here, take it, just use it right
RD_ALifeLine_24398cc8098b93f5: Okay.. okay, one, that's all I can do
RD_ALifeLine_11a3bab603c987a4: Take this, you need it more than the shelf does
RD_ALifeLine_033ab4052c64c2dd: Fine, here, don't tell the others
RD_ALifeLine_26f9e0c76e41fed2: It's not much but it's yours
RD_ALifeLine_78d66169178731c6: Here you go, God knows I can't save everyone
RD_ALifeLine_5ea48bff7f54f228: One bandage, keep it clean, keep it dry
RD_ALifeLine_79e47655490268f7: Go on, it's what we're here for
RD_ALifeLine_6020b3632010bd44: Alright, here, and eat something too
RD_ALifeLine_15c9340029dc5a9a: Here.. it's the last one of these, use it well
RD_ALifeLine_599fbf2f2dc797b1: You helped us, so yeah, take it
RD_ALifeLine_66bd3bc40cc225dd: Here, two painkillers, take them with water not whiskey
RD_ALifeLine_28e3268f3e94b8f3: One for you, don't make me regret it
RD_ALifeLine_11e7f052671b40a5: Fine, here.. I never could say no to a sad face
RD_ALifeLine_62ef4b9e751a1e5b: Stay safe, keep your arms covered
RD_ALifeLine_09da299825ccb127: Go on, and don't get bit, I mean it
RD_ALifeLine_085c9cd648d4e1e2: Take care of yourself, nobody else will
RD_ALifeLine_06b6e63507b6ca1e: Drink some water, you look half dead
RD_ALifeLine_7b8bfd241de25eda: Bye.. come back in one piece
RD_ALifeLine_18178858666e2cd4: God keep you, whatever's left of Him
RD_ALifeLine_05ec16e555fd755b: Keep your head down and your wounds clean
RD_ALifeLine_7e20a36f2469de1e: See you around, hopefully not on my table
RD_ALifeLine_7a4449172493e58e: Off you go, and wash that cut
RD_ALifeLine_7ff33fad0d6b0456: Watch the windows on your way out
RD_ALifeLine_372eef9f67f7cfb4: Don't be a hero, heroes I bury
RD_ALifeLine_00f7ad61478294c3: If you see anyone hurt, send 'em my way
RD_ALifeLine_3c82c8602c2458a8: Go with God, or go with whatever you've got
RD_ALifeLine_2ce54d0c52f9d2d9: Change that dressing tomorrow, I'll know if you don't
RD_ALifeLine_7f1f7c404d0569ce: Get some sleep, that's an order from a nurse
RD_ALifeLine_1e851c9f3ea5505d: Don't make me patch you up again, okay?
RD_ALifeLine_437a849e3c8774f0: Keep your boots dry, trench foot's a real thing
RD_ALifeLine_2f714c8d4c900613: Lead the way, I'll watch your back
RD_ALifeLine_133a4cdb45761e5b: Fine, but if you get bit I'm saying I told you so
RD_ALifeLine_29c9fbc82b9ac82c: On your six, medic kit ready
RD_ALifeLine_416c9be90ef609b0: Okay, I'll wait, don't take long
RD_ALifeLine_1a5f783b786b0e34: Got it, I'll guard the bag
RD_ALifeLine_3e4458b81022cb20: Let me check that bandage while we're stopped
RD_ALifeLine_127a9ddd4861c2a7: I'm counting what we've got left, give me a minute
RD_ALifeLine_5099f09602895f1c: My back is killing me, how's yours?
RD_ALifeLine_6780e3021af952a4: I don't mind the walking, it's the waiting
RD_ALifeLine_168de9cd1d63a635: Hold still, there's something on your neck.. just dirt, relax
RD_ALifeLine_2892851633877927: Do you want me to look at that hand again?
RD_ALifeLine_3e63c1213e29acee: If you're tired say so, tired people get bitten
RD_ALifeLine_14ead9615e4b3664: I can't do this anymore, I can't!
RD_ALifeLine_066f3e087232441c: I'm not a soldier, I'm not a soldier!
RD_ALifeLine_12efa34d66af9463: I signed up to save people, not this!
RD_ALifeLine_75c3edbe3ccb543c: Oh God oh God oh God
RD_ALifeLine_03f9dba2333de63f: I'm done, I'm done, I'm leaving!
RD_ALifeLine_2abee0372dcd6fa7: It's too much, it's too much
RD_ALifeLine_75d0752630634e14: Forgive me, I have to go
RD_ALifeLine_19882a72416a057e: I can't watch another one die, I can't
RD_ALifeLine_5d121f64735aa0b0: Somebody else do it, I'm done, I'm DONE
RD_ALifeLine_50347ecf49927690: I want to go home.. there's no home
RD_ALifeLine_03ea299d7cb29f6b: Get out, get out, everybody out!
RD_ALifeLine_3b2b2ddb1f6347d9: I'm not dying here, no way!
RD_ALifeLine_3f418f670a4dcf9b: Leave it, leave the bag, GO!
RD_ALifeLine_212c400e2d6dcc71: Run! Don't look back, just run!
RD_ALifeLine_7fcc112717f2473c: I can't, there's too many, I can't!
RD_ALifeLine_6db522964f8f6b05: Thank you.. you have no idea
RD_ALifeLine_3419d1ad75dee3b2: God bless you, I mean that
RD_ALifeLine_614c955b63838c88: That's gonna keep someone alive, thank you
RD_ALifeLine_51be02b84cc21e68: Oh thank you, thank you, really
RD_ALifeLine_38af30f702c6c864: You're a good one, you know that?
RD_ALifeLine_0ce2aa2e3be5441d: That's.. that's the kindest thing all week
RD_ALifeLine_7452178c02c11566: You just saved a life, maybe two
RD_ALifeLine_6a279e417044dd85: Thanks, I'll put it to good use, promise
RD_ALifeLine_07bb733a50240488: *Sighs* Thank you, I needed a win today
RD_ALifeLine_3c7eb53b44c54a4c: You're an angel, I don't even care if you're not
RD_ALifeLine_705f010e7a178dc8: Oh, that's going straight to the kids, thank you
RD_ALifeLine_4b2e172b0e6d458a: I could kiss you, I won't, but I could
RD_ALifeLine_0ead3c620eb10c9a: God it's good to see a face I trust
RD_ALifeLine_1440cb630143e950: You're a sight, you know that? A real sight
RD_ALifeLine_3e8790a761683a46: Hey friend.. I mean it, friend
RD_ALifeLine_5406087b75080716: There you are, I prayed you'd make it back
RD_ALifeLine_45e1ccf058cacbb0: Look at you, still kicking, still stubborn
RD_ALifeLine_7023e90523937ead: Thank God, I was about to send people looking
RD_ALifeLine_584118617404d389: My favourite patient who never stays put
RD_ALifeLine_0f2c75ee33b75b6e: Come in come in, the kettle's still warm
RD_ALifeLine_727b3dea7363d28b: I kept your name off the list, you know which list
RD_ALifeLine_66d060176f2b0726: Hey you, the kids asked about you
RD_ALifeLine_5a49738f56fce023: Every time you walk in I breathe a little easier
RD_ALifeLine_7313d9890605b28a: Sit, sit, I've got a minute and I'm spending it on you
RD_ALifeLine_206640a3198a98c4: I prayed for you last night, and here you are
RD_ALifeLine_282e52c2192f41c8: Hey, I saved you the good chair
RD_ALifeLine_5969e844589e02e1: Every time I see you I count one less name to worry about
RD_ALifeLine_365b064f34742bc9: Oh it's you, good, I was starting to worry
RD_ALifeLine_324451f800bf78a7: Hey, you came back, people don't usually
RD_ALifeLine_25f9c8d803aa8afb: You again.. please tell me you're not bleeding this time
RD_ALifeLine_755dd91514b73c77: Hey stranger, not so strange anymore huh
RD_ALifeLine_00d515e113bb78f4: You keep turning up, I'm gonna start charging rent
RD_ALifeLine_26fe3c19294f8198: Glad you're still in one piece, honestly
RD_ALifeLine_3af80cbf4e62b7f3: Ah, the one who doesn't shoot first, hi
RD_ALifeLine_0d49c98923c86680: Hey you.. sit, I'll find something warm
RD_ALifeLine_22fc9db33adb09be: Back again? What did you break this time?
RD_ALifeLine_77a1e68d2ed39b95: Oh hey, you still owe me a bandage, I'm kidding, mostly
RD_ALifeLine_31ff123764830fb1: I was just thinking about you, how's that arm?
RD_ALifeLine_7e47870a3a02c461: There you are, still ugly, still alive
RD_ALifeLine_460d436d7d06e697: Good, you made it through the night
RD_ALifeLine_20a722106b00b376: Stop right there, let me see your arms first
RD_ALifeLine_7aae6d7a204a1545: Easy, easy, I'm a medic, I'm not gonna hurt you
RD_ALifeLine_56edb6ec36e2571c: You look like hell.. come here, sit down a second
RD_ALifeLine_4f8ab4773be81472: Are you bit? Don't lie to me, just tell me
RD_ALifeLine_6a5fec0a092b9c3e: Hi.. sorry, I haven't slept, who are you?
RD_ALifeLine_02df11a05238c512: Hands where I can see 'em, then we talk
RD_ALifeLine_6e3d88f464aa8814: Oh thank God, someone who's still standing
RD_ALifeLine_449f2cfb76a28fbb: Keep your distance till I get a look at you
RD_ALifeLine_6b2841eb48e7815d: Lord.. another one walking alone out here
RD_ALifeLine_5729bffb732543de: Fire crew, we're friendly, just don't make it weird
RD_ALifeLine_5feacdc1517d2131: You need a doctor or you need directions?
RD_ALifeLine_1a7c70bf34f5f0b8: Whoa, slow down, nobody's in a hurry to get shot today
RD_ALifeLine_58b0135a6d7760f7: Okay. Okay hi, you're alive, that's a start
RD_ALifeLine_2fe3fb9d5b652e6b: I don't have much, so if you came to rob me, bad timing
RD_ALifeLine_550c2ad01c2a0959: Hold it, sleeves up, let me see your arms
RD_ALifeLine_29e1e2f93cfebb8e: You're not limping, good, that's half my job done
RD_ALifeLine_79757eed00a4511b: Hi.. if you're here for the medicine, there isn't any
RD_ALifeLine_4ec991d553758518: Oh good, a living one, I was starting to talk to the walls
RD_ALifeLine_620d28d902f0b202: Stay on the porch, we'll talk through the screen
RD_ALifeLine_5f8cf5df78c13cee: Over here, I need hands, NOW!
RD_ALifeLine_460bd3b308ebfb26: Please! I can't lift him alone!
RD_ALifeLine_4820ca993440abfe: I need someone on pressure, quick!
RD_ALifeLine_2f0c208130aba6d1: I can't do this alone, help!
RD_ALifeLine_7ff5932009509ca8: Hey you, yes you, hold this!
RD_ALifeLine_55b611442c9a6471: Hands! I need hands over here!
RD_ALifeLine_60ec06e14d2b3460: He's bleeding out, somebody help me hold this!
RD_ALifeLine_7fb9e65955ad02e5: Please, I can't carry her alone!
RD_ALifeLine_387da7f15c8eff6d: Ah God, that's deep, that's deep
RD_ALifeLine_523e3c29747d06fa: I'm hit, I'm hit, oh hell
RD_ALifeLine_31d6ac7847ddf52f: Don't look at it, don't look at it
RD_ALifeLine_4ba950295c4d35c0: Okay.. okay, I can work with this
RD_ALifeLine_0994d552300f5152: I'm fine, it's fine, keep moving
RD_ALifeLine_13d3301f42229354: Can't feel my hand, why can't I feel my hand
RD_ALifeLine_5fb9c483336a0546: Don't panic, medic's hurt, don't panic
RD_ALifeLine_72a2ff0e0bb317ee: Okay.. that's mine, that's my blood, great
RD_ALifeLine_798d68ec2a573599: Somebody grab my bag, I'm the patient now
RD_ALifeLine_2cbc083f07d16952: Hhh.. don't tell anyone the medic got hurt
RD_ALifeLine_503cbeac7e674043: I haven't slept in two days.. or three
RD_ALifeLine_1c69b6645af414b4: My hands won't stop shaking, isn't that funny
RD_ALifeLine_6bb661df7378f1e3: I keep counting bandages like it'll change the number
RD_ALifeLine_31dd88810a6266ad: Someone has to boil more water
RD_ALifeLine_3796b7a352c655af: I miss the sound of a siren, weird huh
RD_ALifeLine_46a353e80050bbd8: I used to complain about double shifts
RD_ALifeLine_36c5b0a779cc14b4: I wonder if anyone's still running the hospital
RD_ALifeLine_68f6873245afd499: My feet are killing me, literally killing me
RD_ALifeLine_3ad65d243c97661e: Clean hands, clean hands, always clean hands
RD_ALifeLine_04ad2c01091caeb9: Some days I pray, some days I just count
RD_ALifeLine_577289c802f9e6f5: It's so quiet at night it makes my ears ring
RD_ALifeLine_6689a891476ee7f7: I dream about the ones I couldn't help
RD_ALifeLine_24cae0713eb5b6de: We're out of gauze again, wonderful
RD_ALifeLine_2c2adc3509da2092: Do you think the radio will come back on?
RD_ALifeLine_53c1e1a6104760c6: I've stopped looking at the calendar
RD_ALifeLine_659381456fb0595f: I could sleep standing up right now
RD_ALifeLine_69f0e4173f95c7fe: I used to hate night shifts, now everything's a night shift
